# P3 Back-office pro Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Give the pro the full back-office of the tickets & events model on top of the P2 engine: tickets and offers, events with recurrence, planning and séance actions, time off with conflicts, booking settings, clients and the client record with wallet actions, payments, overview KPIs and alerts, admin, the P3 e-mails, Google sync keyed on the séance, and the personal link with a read-only client space.

**Architecture:** Every action body and every read lives in a testable module under `src/lib/back-office/` (plus `notify-core.ts`, `calendar-sync-load.ts`, `admin-reads.ts`) that takes `(db, pro, input, now)` and is DB-tested on tickets-test; `"use server"` and `server-only` files are thin wrappers built on `runProAction` (session, French result, revalidation, post-commit effects in `after()`). Pages are Server Components with client leaves only for interaction, built from the existing `src/components/ui` primitives; UI is checked in the browser against the seed v2 data on tickets-dev.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 16.2.9 App Router, React 19, Drizzle 0.45.2 + Neon HTTP, Better Auth 1.6.19 (emailOTP), Stripe 22, Resend, Tailwind v4, lucide-react, zod 4, @date-fns/tz, node:test via tsx.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-tickets-evenements-design.md` (binding). Architecture contract (module declarations, engine call table, routes, decisions, test strategy, controller rulings): `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-14-p3-back-office-contract.md`. P2 decisions and carry notes: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-12-p2-domaine-outcome.md`.


## Global Constraints

- **Spec (binding):** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-tickets-evenements-design.md`, §§ 2, 4, 7, 8, 9, 11 (E2, E6, E7, E8, E13), 12, 13.1, 13.4-13.9, 14, 15.1. **Rulings:** the P3 planning rulings (controller, 2026-10-14) and this contract.
- **Worktree:** `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets`, branch `feat/tickets-events`. `node_modules` is a junction to the main checkout. Every Bash command starts with `cd /c/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets && ` (a multi-line block starts with `cd /c/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets || exit 1`). Read, Edit and Write use absolute worktree paths `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/<path>`, never the main checkout.
- **Never** run `pnpm install` or `pnpm <script>` inside the worktree. Call `./node_modules/.bin/{tsx,tsc,eslint,next,drizzle-kit}` directly.
- **Typecheck:** `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`
- **Lint (touched files only):** `./node_modules/.bin/eslint <every file created or modified by the task>` → no error, no warning.
- **Pure tests:** `./node_modules/.bin/tsx --test 'src/**/!(*.db).test.ts'`
- **DB tests, one file:** `./node_modules/.bin/tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env.test --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-isolation=none <path>.db.test.ts`
- **DB tests, all (group ends and Task 43):** `./node_modules/.bin/tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env.test --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-isolation=none --test-timeout=300000 'src/**/*.db.test.ts'`, run in ONE process, in the background (`run_in_background`) or with a timeout ≥ 1 500 000 ms; never capped below its runtime.
- **Build:** `./node_modules/.bin/next build` (uses the worktree `.env.local` → tickets-dev).
- **Every task ends green:** tsc, eslint on its files, all pure tests, the DB test files the task creates or modifies, `next build`. Tasks 8, 13, 20, 29, 38 and 43 also run the full DB suite.
- **Neon:** only `tickets-dev` (worktree `.env.local`, demo data from seed v2) and `tickets-test` (`.env.test`). Never `main`, `development` or `preview`. Neon MCP calls always pass `project_id` AND `branch_id`; never print a connection string.
- **Migrations:** P3 needs **none** (every column it uses exists since 0011). Never run `db:migrate` or `db:push`. If a task proves a migration is required, it stops and reports to the controller: generation would be `./node_modules/.bin/drizzle-kit generate --name=<name>`, application `./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/apply-migration.ts drizzle/<file>.sql` on tickets-dev, then tickets-test.
- **Engine:** `src/lib/booking/*` keeps its rules (no `server-only`, `db` first, `now` last before test-only `opts`). P3 changes the engine only where this contract says so (Tasks 7, 9, 23).
- **Testable cores (ruling):** every action body and every read query lives in a module that takes `(db, ctx | professionalId, input, now)` and imports neither `server-only`, `next/*`, `@/lib/db` (index), `@/lib/env`, `@/lib/session` nor `@/lib/auth` (`src/lib/back-office/*`, `src/lib/notify-core.ts`, `src/lib/calendar-sync-load.ts`, `src/lib/admin-reads.ts`). The `"use server"` files (`src/server/pro*.ts`) and the `server-only` query files are thin wrappers: `requireProContext()` + core + revalidate + `after(runEffects)`.
- **Identity:** `professionalId` and `actorUserId` always come from `requireProContext()` (session), never from input. Every id in an input is checked against that pro, by the engine (its `professional_id` filters) or by the core's own query (`usableTickets`, `activeBookingOf` and `bookingsExpiringBefore` callers verify ownership first).
- **Validation:** every core validates its input with `parseFr(schema, input)` (`src/lib/zod-fr.ts`) BEFORE calling the engine, with the same schema the engine uses; no English zod message ever reaches the UI. Engine failures become French through `fromEngine(res, context)` (`src/lib/back-office/result.ts`, which maps the code through `proErrorMessage` of `src/lib/pro-messages.ts`).
- **Effects:** every engine `effects` array is executed after commit by `runEffects` (`src/server/notify.ts`), scheduled with `after()` by `runProAction`. A failing effect never fails the action and is logged without e-mail addresses, codes or tokens.
- **Revalidation:** every successful pro action (`runProAction`) calls `revalidatePath` for each target of `revalidationTargets(publicPage)` (Task 6): the `/dashboard` layout always, plus, for the actions that change what the public page shows (`publicPage: true`: catalog, event, time-off, settings and profile actions), the route pattern `/[slug]` with type `"layout"` (never the literal `/${ctx.slug}`: with a type it tags a path no page carries). Client components never call `router.refresh()` right after a Server Action (Next 16 updates the current page itself), and never `router.push(x)` followed by `router.refresh()`. Navigation after an action = `router.push(x)` alone.
- **Next.js 16.2.9:** read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before touching a page, route or Server Action. `params` and `searchParams` are `Promise`s (await them). A page that only redirects awaits a request API first (`await requireProContext()`), never a bare static `redirect()`.
- **Client/server boundary:** client components import labels from `@/lib/tickets-vocab` (never `@/lib/tickets` for labels), schemas from `@/lib/tickets` only when they validate a form, view helpers from `src/lib/back-office/{format,labels,notice,confirm-copy,recurrence-form,event-defaults,planning-view}.ts`, and actions from the `"use server"` files. They never import runtime values from `@/lib/booking/*`, `@/lib/db/*`, `*-reads.ts`, `*-actions.ts` or `src/server/*-queries.ts` (`import type` is fine: types are erased). Props of client components carry no `Date`: instants are ISO strings (`toISOString()`), calendar days are `DateKey`.
- **UI rules (rulings):** load the `design-taste-frontend` skill before writing UI. Keep the existing system: `src/components/ui/*` primitives, `globals.css` tokens, `lucide-react`, existing radius and spacing; no new dependency. Server Components by default, client leaves only for interaction. Label above the input, helper or error below, never a placeholder as label. Every page and dialog has a loading state (route `loading.tsx` or inline spinner), an empty state (spec § 13.9 copy + action) and an error state. Every destructive action opens a `ConfirmDialog` that states its consequences (texts in `src/lib/back-office/confirm-copy.ts`). WCAG AA contrast. Below 640 px: planning in day view, client record in stacked sections, no horizontal page scroll. **Zero em dash (U+2014) and zero en dash (U+2013)** in UI strings, e-mails and Google event bodies. French with vouvoiement, one label per intent, buttons never wrap at desktop width. No emoji in the UI: 🔴 / 🟠 are rendered by `StatusMark`.
- **SWC whitespace bug:** keep on ONE line any JSX text that contains an HTML entity (`&apos;`, `&nbsp;`…), or use a JS string.
- **Dashboard `<main>`:** never give it `overflow-auto`, `overflow-y-auto` or `overflow-hidden` (after Task 1 it is `min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-x-clip`); the window scrolls.
- **Browser checks:** dev server = the `skedul-tickets` entry of the MAIN checkout `.claude/launch.json` (port 3102; `pnpm -C .claude/worktrees/tickets --config.verify-deps-before-run=false dev --port 3102`), started with `preview_start` name `skedul-tickets`. Sign in at `http://localhost:3102/sign-in` with the « Pro · back-office » one-click demo login (seeded `pro@skedul.app`, page `altinha-paris`; the password is the demo one from AGENTS.md: never type it into UI copy, commits or logs). E-mails are mocked: the dev-server log shows `📧 [email:mock] → … subject: …`.
- **Files:** Windows, CRLF working copies. Whole files with Write, partial changes with Edit. Never bash heredocs for files containing an apostrophe.
- **Language:** code, comments and plan prose in English; user-facing strings in French.
- **Commits:** one per task: `git add <files>` then `git commit -m "<type>(<scope>): <summary>" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"`. Never `--no-verify`, never push.
- **No new dependencies.** zod 4.4.3, drizzle-orm 0.45.2, better-auth 1.6.19, stripe 22, lucide-react, @date-fns/tz are installed. tsconfig target ES2017: no regex `s` flag, no named groups.
- **Test naming:** pure `*.test.ts`, DB `*.db.test.ts` (use `dbTest` from `src/test/db.ts`, which checks I1-I6 after each test); helpers in `src/test/` are never `*.test.ts`.

## Review Focus

The five failure modes P3 is most likely to ship that its automated tests would not catch. Reviewers
check them first on every task.

| # | Failure mode | Why the tests miss it | Owning task(s) and proof |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Tenancy through reads and previews.** A Server Action or a page passes an input id (occurrence, customer, booking, ticket, segment) to a query or to an engine read that does not filter `professional_id` (`usableTickets`, `activeBookingOf`, any new read), or `/api/c` and `/[slug]/espace` trust the token or cookie without checking the customer's pro. | Core DB tests use one pro unless they deliberately add a second; a missing filter returns correct data for the only pro present. | Every core and read DB test file has one cross-tenant case (`createTestPro` second pro → `null` / « introuvable »): Tasks 9, 10, 15, 16, 21, 22, 23, 28, 31, 32, 36, 37, 41, 42. Task 41 adds the cookie and token cases. Reviewer greps each new query for `professional_id`. |
| 2 | **Wall-clock and time zone done in the browser.** Dates or times typed in a form, a click on the planning grid, « today » in a calendar or a « valable jusqu'au » day converted with the browser's zone (`new Date(y, m, d)`, `toISOString().slice(0, 10)`, `getHours()`), instead of `instantAt(dateKey, minute, pro tz)` on the server and `todayKey(now, pro tz)`. | Tests and the dev machine both run in Europe/Paris, like the demo pro. | Pure modules take `tz` explicitly and their tests use a pro tz different from the host (`America/Los_Angeles` and `Europe/Paris` cases): Tasks 3, 14, 21, 30. Cores receive `DateKey` + minutes, never instants built by the client: Tasks 22, 26, 28, 32. Reviewer greps client components for `new Date(` with arguments other than an ISO string. |
| 3 | **Stale UI state after an action.** A dialog keeps the clicked object instead of its id (shows old seats or attendees), a form keeps the old `seenVersion` / `seenStartsAt` and every second save fails with « a changé », a client component calls `router.refresh()` after an action (Next 16 hang) or forgets that a failed action must leave the form filled. | No component test framework; DB tests call cores, not components. | `runProAction` revalidates the dashboard layout on every success (Task 6). Dialogs select by id (Tasks 24-27, 34-35). Forms read `seenVersion` / `seenStartsAt` from props at submit time (Tasks 20, 25, 26). Each UI task's browser check performs TWO consecutive actions on the same object. |
| 4 | **Effects pipeline.** Effects not run, run twice, run before commit, or a thrown e-mail / Google / Stripe error turning a committed write into a failed action; « séance annulée » mailed to lapsed holds; Google insert without the deterministic id; a P4 effect type crashing the switch. | `after()` and the external services are not exercised by tests; DB tests of `notify-core` only plan e-mails. | Task 5 (`planEffect` exhaustive switch with `never`, dedupe, lapsed-hold filter; DB tests per effect type), Task 4 (pure sync core tests: 409 → patch, 404 → insert, delete 404/410, no token when nothing to do), Task 6 (`runProAction` runs effects only on `ok`). Browser checks read the dev-server log: exactly one mock e-mail per expected recipient. |
| 5 | **Copy and destructive confirmations.** English zod text, a client-worded engine message (« Vous êtes déjà inscrit(e). ») or a dash reaching the UI; a destructive action without `ConfirmDialog`, or with wrong consequence counts (tickets rendus, inscrits prévenus, séances supprimées). | Copy is only partly unit-tested; counts come from previews the UI must pass through. | Task 2 (`zod-fr` and `pro-messages` tests), Task 6 (`ui-copy.test.ts` dash scan of P3 directories), Task 8 (`confirm-copy.test.ts`), Tasks 20, 25, 28, 35 (confirmations fed by `deleteFromPreview`, attendee counts, conflict lists). Browser checks open every confirmation and read its text. |

```ts
import { FIELD_LABELS, parseFr, zodFr, zodFrMessage } from "./zod-fr";

/** fr-FR thousands, exactly as zodFrMessage prints them. */
const n = (value: number) => value.toLocaleString("fr-FR");

/** The message of the first issue of a parse with the French error map, or null when it passes. */
function message(schema: z.ZodType, value: unknown): string | null {
  const res = schema.safeParse(value, { error: zodFr });
  return res.success ? null : res.error.issues[0].message;
}

const ENGLISH = /\b(Too|Invalid|Required|Unrecognized|expected|must|received|string|number)\b/;
const DASH = /[\u2014\u2013]/;

const WEEKLY = {
  startDate: "2026-10-12",
  startMinute: 1140,
  freq: "weekly",
  interval: 1,
  weekdays: [1, 3],
  monthlyBy: null,
  monthWeek: null,
  endMode: "never",
  untilDate: null,
  occurrenceCount: null,
};

test("zodFrMessage: strings", () => {
  assert.equal(message(z.string().min(1), ""), "Ce champ est obligatoire.");
  assert.equal(message(z.string().min(3), "ab"), "3 caractères au minimum.");
  assert.equal(message(z.string().max(5), "abcdef"), "5 caractères au maximum.");
  assert.equal(message(z.string().max(2000), "x".repeat(2001)), `${n(2000)} caractères au maximum.`);
});

test("zodFrMessage: numbers, integers and multiples", () => {
  assert.equal(message(z.number().min(2), 1), "Minimum 2.");
  assert.equal(message(z.number().gt(2), 2), "Doit être supérieur à 2.");
  assert.equal(message(z.number().max(10), 11), "Maximum 10.");
  assert.equal(message(z.number().lt(10), 10), "Doit être inférieur à 10.");
  assert.equal(message(z.int().min(2), 1), "Minimum 2.");
  assert.equal(message(z.int().max(2), 3), "Maximum 2.");
  assert.equal(message(z.number().max(10080), 10081), `Maximum ${n(10080)}.`);
  assert.equal(message(z.number().multipleOf(5), 7), "Choisissez un multiple de 5.");
});

test("zodFrMessage: arrays", () => {
  assert.equal(message(z.array(z.string()).min(1), []), "Choisissez au moins un élément.");
  assert.equal(message(z.array(z.string()).min(2), ["a"]), "2 éléments au minimum.");
  assert.equal(message(z.array(z.string()).max(20), Array.from({ length: 21 }, () => "a")), "20 éléments au maximum.");
});

test("zodFrMessage: wrong types", () => {
  assert.equal(message(z.number(), "x"), "Indiquez un nombre.");
  assert.equal(message(z.number().int(), 1.5), "Indiquez un nombre entier.");
  assert.equal(message(z.string(), 1), "Ce champ est obligatoire.");
  assert.equal(message(z.boolean(), "x"), "Valeur invalide.");
  assert.equal(message(z.object({ a: z.string() }), "x"), "Valeur invalide.");
});

test("zodFrMessage: formats", () => {
  assert.equal(message(z.email(), "x"), "Adresse email invalide.");
  assert.equal(message(z.iso.date(), "2026-02-30"), "Date invalide.");
  assert.equal(message(z.iso.datetime(), "x"), "Date et heure invalides.");
  assert.equal(message(z.string().regex(/^a$/), "b"), "Format invalide.");
  assert.equal(message(z.string().startsWith("a"), "b"), "Format invalide.");
});

test("zodFrMessage: values, unions, unknown keys, custom and fallbacks", () => {
  assert.equal(message(z.enum(["a", "b"]), "c"), "Choix invalide.");
  assert.equal(message(z.union([z.literal(1), z.literal(2)]), 3), "Valeur invalide.");
  assert.equal(message(z.strictObject({ a: z.string() }), { a: "x", b: 1 }), "Champ inattendu.");
  assert.equal(message(z.string().refine(() => false), "x"), "Valeur invalide.");
  assert.equal(zodFrMessage({ code: "custom", message: "Texte propre.", input: 1, path: [] } as unknown as z.core.$ZodRawIssue), "Texte propre.");
  assert.equal(zodFrMessage({ code: "invalid_key", input: 1, path: [] } as unknown as z.core.$ZodRawIssue), "Valeur invalide.");
});

test("a message set by the schema (refine, superRefine, explicit text) wins over the error map", () => {
  assert.equal(message(z.string().refine(() => false, { message: "Message propre." }), "x"), "Message propre.");
  assert.equal(message(z.string().min(1, "Texte du schéma."), ""), "Texte du schéma.");
  const res = parseFr(ticketTypeInputSchema, { name: "Cours", rdvEnabled: true });
  assert.deepEqual(res, {
    ok: false,
    error: "Indiquez la durée du rendez-vous.",
    fieldErrors: { rdvDurationMin: "Indiquez la durée du rendez-vous." },
  });
});

test("the error map is per parse: a plain parse keeps zod's own English text", () => {
  const res = z.string().min(1).safeParse("");
  assert.equal(res.success, false);
  if (!res.success) assert.match(res.error.issues[0].message, /^Too small/);
});

test("FIELD_LABELS is the contract table", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(FIELD_LABELS, {
    name: "Nom",
    email: "Email",
    phone: "Téléphone",
    title: "Titre",

test("parseFr: a valid value comes back parsed", () => {
  const res = parseFr(customerInputSchema, { name: "  Léa Martin ", email: "Lea.Martin@Example.COM" });
  assert.equal(res.ok, true);
  if (res.ok) {

    assert.equal(res.data.email, "lea.martin@example.com");
  }
});

test("parseFr: the first issue is prefixed with its field label", () => {
  const empty = parseFr(ticketTypeInputSchema, { name: "" });

test("parseFr: fieldErrors are keyed by dotted paths, first issue per path", () => {
  const overrides = parseFr(ticketTypeInputSchema, {
    name: "Cours",
    rdvOverrides: { bookingHorizonDays: 400, minNoticeMinutes: null, cancelDeadlineHours: null },
  });
  assert.equal(overrides.ok, false);
  if (!overrides.ok) {
    assert.deepEqual(overrides.fieldErrors, { "rdvOverrides.bookingHorizonDays": "Maximum 365." });
    assert.equal(overrides.error, "Réservable jusqu'à : maximum 365.");
  }

  const questions = parseFr(eventInputSchema, { title: "Roda", rule: WEEKLY, questions: [{ label: "", type: "text" }] });
  assert.equal(questions.ok, false);

  const settings = parseFr(bookingSettingsSchema, {});
  assert.equal(settings.ok, false);
  if (!settings.ok) {
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(settings.fieldErrors).sort(), ["bookingHorizonDays", "cancelDeadlineHours", "minNoticeMinutes"]);
  }

  const root = parseFr(answersInputSchema, "x");
  assert.equal(root.ok, false);
  if (!root.ok) assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(root.fieldErrors), [""]);
});

    ["rule end mode", recurrenceRuleSchema, { ...WEEKLY, endMode: "x" }],

    ["rule end before start", availabilityRuleInputSchema, { dayOfWeek: 1, startMinute: 780, endMinute: 600 }],
    ["rule weekday out of range", availabilityRuleInputSchema, { dayOfWeek: 7, startMinute: 600, endMinute: 780 }],
    ["rule negative start", availabilityRuleInputSchema, { dayOfWeek: 1, startMinute: -1, endMinute: 780 }],
    ["answers long", answersInputSchema, [{ questionId: "q", value: "x".repeat(2001) }]],
    ["answers many", answersInputSchema, Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, k) => ({ questionId: `q${k}`, value: "x" }))],
    ["answers no id", answersInputSchema, [{ value: "x" }]],
    ["answers not an array", answersInputSchema, "x"],
  ];
  for (const [name, schema, value] of cases) {
    const res = parseFr(schema, value);
    assert.equal(res.ok, false, name);
    if (res.ok) continue;
    assert.equal(ENGLISH.test(res.error), false, `${name}: ${res.error}`);
    assert.equal(DASH.test(res.error), false, `${name}: ${res.error}`);
    assert.ok(Object.keys(res.fieldErrors).length > 0, name);
    for (const [path, text] of Object.entries(res.fieldErrors)) {
      assert.equal(ENGLISH.test(text), false, `${name} ${path}: ${text}`);
      assert.equal(DASH.test(text), false, `${name} ${path}: ${text}`);
      assert.equal(path.includes("["), false, `${name}: path ${path} is dotted`);
    }
  }
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Tickets & événements vocabulary: enum values (pgEnum sources), French
 * labels, bounds, engine constants, engine error codes and their client-facing
 * messages, small helpers. No import at all (not even zod), so client
 * components may load it without pulling the schemas; src/lib/tickets.ts
 * re-exports everything here next to the zod input schemas.
 */

/* ───────────────────────── Enum values (pgEnum sources) ───────────────────────── */

export const BOOKING_MODES = ["tickets", "free", "none"] as const;
export type BookingMode = (typeof BOOKING_MODES)[number];

export const RECURRENCE_FREQS = ["once", "daily", "weekly", "monthly"] as const;
export type RecurrenceFreq = (typeof RECURRENCE_FREQS)[number];

export const MONTHLY_BY = ["day_of_month", "weekday"] as const;
export type MonthlyBy = (typeof MONTHLY_BY)[number];

export const RECURRENCE_ENDS = ["never", "until", "count"] as const;
export type RecurrenceEnd = (typeof RECURRENCE_ENDS)[number];

export const VALIDITY_UNITS = ["day", "month"] as const;
export type ValidityUnit = (typeof VALIDITY_UNITS)[number];

export const OCCURRENCE_STATUSES = ["scheduled", "cancelled"] as const;
export type OccurrenceStatus = (typeof OCCURRENCE_STATUSES)[number];

export const BOOKING_STATUSES = ["pending", "confirmed", "cancelled", "expired"] as const;
export type BookingStatus = (typeof BOOKING_STATUSES)[number];

export const BOOKING_COVERAGES = ["ticket", "free", "guest"] as const;
export type BookingCoverage = (typeof BOOKING_COVERAGES)[number];

export const ACTORS = ["client", "pro", "system"] as const;
export type Actor = (typeof ACTORS)[number];

export const PURCHASE_STATUSES = ["pending", "paid", "expired"] as const;
export type PurchaseStatus = (typeof PURCHASE_STATUSES)[number];

  "timezone_locked",
] as const;
export type EngineErrorCode = (typeof ENGINE_ERROR_CODES)[number];

export function isEngineErrorCode(value: string): value is EngineErrorCode {
  return (ENGINE_ERROR_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

export const ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES: Record<EngineErrorCode, string> = {

};

/* ───────────────────────────── Helpers ───────────────────────────── */

/** Trimmed, lower-cased e-mail: the `customer.email` key. */
export function normalizeEmail(email: string): string {
  return email.trim().toLowerCase();
}

/** « À l'unité » / « Carnet de 10 » unless the pro typed a label. */
export function offerLabel(offer: { label: string | null; quantity: number }): string {
  const typed = offer.label?.trim();
  if (typed) return typed;
  return offer.quantity === 1 ? "À l'unité" : `Carnet de ${offer.quantity}`;
}

/** « 3 mois », « 30 jours », « 1 jour »; null without validity. */
export function validityLabel(count: number | null, unit: ValidityUnit | null): string | null {
  if (count == null || unit == null) return null;
  if (unit === "month") return `${count} mois`;
  return count > 1 ? `${count} jours` : "1 jour";
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Tickets & événements: the zod input schemas shared by the booking engine, the
 * server actions and the forms. The vocabulary (enum values, labels, bounds,
 * engine error codes and messages) lives in tickets-vocab.ts, which imports
 * nothing, and is re-exported here so `@/lib/tickets` keeps every name.
 * No drizzle and no Node APIs, so client components may import it; a client
 * component that only needs labels imports `@/lib/tickets-vocab` instead.
 */
export * from "./tickets-vocab";

import { z } from "zod";

import {
  BOOKING_MODES,
  BOUNDS,
  DEFAULT_COLOR,
  MONTHLY_BY,
  QUESTION_TYPES,
  RECURRENCE_ENDS,
  RECURRENCE_FREQS,
  VALIDITY_UNITS,
  normalizeEmail,
} from "./tickets-vocab";

/* ───────────────────────────── zod schemas ───────────────────────────── */

const intIn = (min: number, max: number) => z.number().int().min(min).max(max);
const optionalOverride = (min: number, max: number) => intIn(min, max).nullable();

export const dateKeySchema = z.iso.date();
export const hexColorSchema = z.string().regex(/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/);
export const idSchema = z.string().min(1).max(64);

export const customerInputSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(BOUNDS.name),
  email: z.email().max(254).transform(normalizeEmail),
  phone: z.string().trim().max(BOUNDS.phone).optional(),
});
export type CustomerInput = z.input<typeof customerInputSchema>;

export const answerInputSchema = z.object({
  questionId: idSchema,
  value: z.string().max(BOUNDS.answer),
});
export const answersInputSchema = z.array(answerInputSchema).max(BOUNDS.questions);
export type AnswerInput = z.infer<typeof answerInputSchema>;

export const bookingSettingsSchema = z.object({
  bookingHorizonDays: intIn(BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.min, BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.max),
  minNoticeMinutes: intIn(BOUNDS.minNoticeMinutes.min, BOUNDS.minNoticeMinutes.max),
  cancelDeadlineHours: intIn(BOUNDS.cancelDeadlineHours.min, BOUNDS.cancelDeadlineHours.max),
});
export type BookingSettings = z.infer<typeof bookingSettingsSchema>;

export const windowOverridesSchema = z.object({
  bookingHorizonDays: optionalOverride(BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.min, BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.max),
  minNoticeMinutes: optionalOverride(BOUNDS.minNoticeMinutes.min, BOUNDS.minNoticeMinutes.max),
  cancelDeadlineHours: optionalOverride(BOUNDS.cancelDeadlineHours.min, BOUNDS.cancelDeadlineHours.max),
});
export type WindowOverrides = z.infer<typeof windowOverridesSchema>;

export const questionInputSchema = z
  .object({
    id: idSchema.optional(),
    label: z.string().trim().min(1).max(BOUNDS.questionLabel),
    type: z.enum(QUESTION_TYPES),
    options: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(BOUNDS.questionLabel)).max(BOUNDS.questionOptions).default([]),
    required: z.boolean().default(false),
  })
  .refine((q) => q.type !== "choice" || q.options.length >= 2, {
    message: "Une question à choix demande au moins deux options.",
    path: ["options"],
  });
export type QuestionInput = z.input<typeof questionInputSchema>;

export const ticketTypeInputSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(BOUNDS.name),
    description: z.string().trim().max(BOUNDS.description).nullable().default(null),
    color: hexColorSchema.default(DEFAULT_COLOR),
    rdvEnabled: z.boolean().default(false),
    rdvFree: z.boolean().default(false),
    rdvDurationMin: z
      .number()
      .int()
      .min(BOUNDS.rdvDurationMin.min)
      .max(BOUNDS.rdvDurationMin.max)
      .multipleOf(BOUNDS.rdvDurationMin.step)
      .nullable()
      .default(null),
    rdvBufferBeforeMin: intIn(BOUNDS.rdvBufferMin.min, BOUNDS.rdvBufferMin.max).default(0),
    rdvBufferAfterMin: intIn(BOUNDS.rdvBufferMin.min, BOUNDS.rdvBufferMin.max).default(0),
    rdvOverrides: windowOverridesSchema.default({
      bookingHorizonDays: null,
      minNoticeMinutes: null,
      cancelDeadlineHours: null,
    }),
  })
  .refine((t) => !t.rdvEnabled || t.rdvDurationMin !== null, {
    message: "Indiquez la durée du rendez-vous.",
    path: ["rdvDurationMin"],
  })
  .refine((t) => !t.rdvFree || t.rdvEnabled, {
    message: "Le rendez-vous gratuit demande le RDV libre.",
    path: ["rdvFree"],
  });
export type TicketTypeInput = z.input<typeof ticketTypeInputSchema>;

export const offerInputSchema = z
  .object({
    ticketTypeId: idSchema,
    label: z.string().trim().max(BOUNDS.offerLabel).nullable().default(null),
    quantity: intIn(BOUNDS.offerQuantity.min, BOUNDS.offerQuantity.max),
    priceCents: intIn(BOUNDS.offerPriceCents.min, BOUNDS.offerPriceCents.max),
    validityCount: intIn(BOUNDS.validityCount.min, BOUNDS.validityCount.max).nullable().default(null),
    validityUnit: z.enum(VALIDITY_UNITS).nullable().default(null),
    isActive: z.boolean().default(true),
  })
  .refine((o) => (o.validityCount === null) === (o.validityUnit === null), {
    message: "Indiquez une durée et une unité de validité, ou aucune.",
    path: ["validityCount"],
  });
export type OfferInput = z.input<typeof offerInputSchema>;

/** Recurrence columns of `event` (spec § 8); refinements mirror the DB CHECKs. */
export const recurrenceRuleSchema = z
  .object({
    startDate: dateKeySchema,
    startMinute: intIn(BOUNDS.startMinute.min, BOUNDS.startMinute.max),
    freq: z.enum(RECURRENCE_FREQS),
    interval: z.number().int().min(1).max(52),
    weekdays: z.array(intIn(0, 6)).min(1).max(7).nullable(),
    monthlyBy: z.enum(MONTHLY_BY).nullable(),
    monthWeek: z.union([z.literal(1), z.literal(2), z.literal(3), z.literal(4), z.literal(-1)]).nullable(),
    endMode: z.enum(RECURRENCE_ENDS),
    untilDate: dateKeySchema.nullable(),
    occurrenceCount: intIn(BOUNDS.occurrenceCount.min, BOUNDS.occurrenceCount.max).nullable(),
  })
  .superRefine((r, ctx) => {
    const fail = (path: string, message: string) => ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: [path], message });
    if (r.interval > BOUNDS.interval[r.freq]) fail("interval", "Intervalle trop grand.");
    if (r.freq === "once") {
      if (r.interval !== 1 || r.endMode !== "count" || r.occurrenceCount !== 1) fail("freq", "Une séance unique se répète une fois.");
      if (r.weekdays !== null || r.monthlyBy !== null || r.monthWeek !== null || r.untilDate !== null) fail("freq", "Champs de récurrence inattendus.");
    }
    if (r.freq === "weekly") {
      const days = r.weekdays ?? [];
      const sorted = [...new Set(days)].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      if (days.length === 0) fail("weekdays", "Choisissez au moins un jour.");
      if (sorted.length !== days.length || sorted.some((d, i) => d !== days[i])) fail("weekdays", "Jours en double ou non triés.");
    } else if (r.weekdays !== null) fail("weekdays", "Jours réservés aux séries hebdomadaires.");
    if (r.freq === "monthly") {
      if (r.monthlyBy === null) fail("monthlyBy", "Choisissez le jour du mois.");
      if (r.monthlyBy === "weekday" && r.monthWeek === null) fail("monthWeek", "Choisissez la semaine du mois.");
      if (r.monthlyBy === "day_of_month" && r.monthWeek !== null) fail("monthWeek", "Semaine inattendue.");
    } else if (r.monthlyBy !== null || r.monthWeek !== null) fail("monthlyBy", "Réservé aux séries mensuelles.");
    if (r.endMode === "never" && (r.untilDate !== null || r.occurrenceCount !== null)) fail("endMode", "Fin inattendue.");
    if (r.endMode === "until") {
      if (r.untilDate === null || r.occurrenceCount !== null) fail("untilDate", "Indiquez la date de fin.");
      else if (r.untilDate < r.startDate) fail("untilDate", "La fin précède le début.");
      else {
        const [y, m, d] = r.startDate.split("-").map(Number);
        const max = `${String(y + BOUNDS.untilYears).padStart(4, "0")}-${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d).padStart(2, "0")}`;
        if (r.untilDate > max) fail("untilDate", "La série ne peut pas dépasser 5 ans.");
      }
    }
    if (r.endMode === "count" && (r.occurrenceCount === null || r.untilDate !== null)) fail("occurrenceCount", "Indiquez le nombre de séances.");
  });
export type RecurrenceRuleInput = z.infer<typeof recurrenceRuleSchema>;

export const eventInputSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().trim().min(1).max(BOUNDS.title),
  description: z.string().trim().max(BOUNDS.description).nullable().default(null),
  location: z.string().trim().max(BOUNDS.location).nullable().default(null),
  color: hexColorSchema.default(DEFAULT_COLOR),
  bookingMode: z.enum(BOOKING_MODES).default("tickets"),
  isPrivate: z.boolean().default(false),
  capacity: intIn(BOUNDS.capacity.min, BOUNDS.capacity.max).default(BOUNDS.capacity.default),
  durationMin: z
    .number()
    .int()
    .min(BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.min)
    .max(BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.max)
    .multipleOf(BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.step)
    .default(BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.default),
  rule: recurrenceRuleSchema,
  overrides: windowOverridesSchema.default({
    bookingHorizonDays: null,
    minNoticeMinutes: null,
    cancelDeadlineHours: null,
  }),
  ticketTypeIds: z.array(idSchema).max(50).default([]),
  questions: z.array(questionInputSchema).max(BOUNDS.questions).default([]),
});
export type EventInput = z.input<typeof eventInputSchema>;
export type EventInputParsed = z.infer<typeof eventInputSchema>;

export const availabilityRuleInputSchema = z
  .object({
    dayOfWeek: intIn(0, 6),
    startMinute: intIn(0, 1439),
    endMinute: intIn(1, 1440),
  })
  .refine((r) => r.startMinute < r.endMinute, { message: "Plage horaire invalide.", path: ["endMinute"] });
export type AvailabilityRuleInput = z.infer<typeof availabilityRuleInputSchema>;
```

```ts
/**
 * French messages for zod's built-in checks, applied per parse
 * (`schema.safeParse(value, { error: zodFr })`), never through `z.config()`:
 * Better Auth shares this zod instance and its own messages must not change.
 * A message the schema sets itself (refine, superRefine, `.min(1, "...")`)
 * always wins. Pure: cores, forms and their tests use it.
 */
import type { z } from "zod";

type AnyIssue = z.core.$ZodRawIssue | z.core.$ZodIssue;

/** The fields zodFrMessage reads, whatever the issue code. */
type IssueView = {
  code?: string;
  origin?: string;
  minimum?: number | bigint;
  maximum?: number | bigint;
  inclusive?: boolean;
  expected?: string;
  format?: string;
  divisor?: number | bigint;
  message?: string;
};

const fr = (n: number | bigint): string => n.toLocaleString("fr-FR");

/** French field names keyed by the LAST path segment of an issue. */
export const FIELD_LABELS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  name: "Nom",
  email: "Email",
  phone: "Téléphone",
  title: "Titre",
  description: "Description",
  location: "Lieu",
  locationOverride: "Lieu",
  color: "Couleur",
  label: "Libellé",
  quantity: "Quantité",
  priceCents: "Prix",
  validityCount: "Validité",
  capacity: "Places",
  durationMin: "Durée",
  rdvDurationMin: "Durée du rendez-vous",
  rdvBufferBeforeMin: "Marge avant",
  rdvBufferAfterMin: "Marge après",
  bookingHorizonDays: "Réservable jusqu'à",
  minNoticeMinutes: "Délai minimum",
  cancelDeadlineHours: "Annulation par le client",
  startDate: "Date de début",
  startMinute: "Heure de début",
  interval: "Intervalle",
  weekdays: "Jours",
  untilDate: "Date de fin",
  occurrenceCount: "Nombre de séances",
  options: "Options",
  questions: "Questions",
  ticketTypeIds: "Types de ticket acceptés",
  reason: "Motif",
  note: "Note",
  value: "Réponse",
  businessName: "Nom de l'activité",
  headline: "Accroche",
  bio: "Présentation",
  timezone: "Fuseau horaire",
  endDate: "Date de fin",
  startTime: "Heure de début",
  endTime: "Heure de fin",
  q: "Recherche",
};

function tooSmall(i: IssueView): string {
  const n = i.minimum ?? 0;
  switch (i.origin) {
    case "string":
      return Number(n) === 1 ? "Ce champ est obligatoire." : `${fr(n)} caractères au minimum.`;
    case "number":
    case "int":
      return i.inclusive === false ? `Doit être supérieur à ${fr(n)}.` : `Minimum ${fr(n)}.`;
    case "array":
      return Number(n) === 1 ? "Choisissez au moins un élément." : `${fr(n)} éléments au minimum.`;
    default:
      return "Valeur invalide.";
  }
}

function tooBig(i: IssueView): string {
  const n = i.maximum ?? 0;
  switch (i.origin) {
    case "string":
      return `${fr(n)} caractères au maximum.`;
    case "number":
    case "int":
      return i.inclusive === false ? `Doit être inférieur à ${fr(n)}.` : `Maximum ${fr(n)}.`;
    case "array":
      return `${fr(n)} éléments au maximum.`;
    default:
      return "Valeur invalide.";
  }
}

function invalidType(expected: string | undefined): string {
  switch (expected) {
    case "number":
      return "Indiquez un nombre.";
    case "int":
      return "Indiquez un nombre entier.";
    case "string":
      return "Ce champ est obligatoire.";
    default:
      return "Valeur invalide.";
  }
}

function invalidFormat(format: string | undefined): string {
  switch (format) {
    case "email":
      return "Adresse email invalide.";
    case "date":
      return "Date invalide.";
    case "datetime":
      return "Date et heure invalides.";
    default:
      return "Format invalide.";
  }
}

/** Generic French text for a zod issue that carries no message of its own (no field name in it). */
export function zodFrMessage(issue: AnyIssue): string {
  const i = issue as unknown as IssueView;
  switch (i.code) {
    case "too_small":
      return tooSmall(i);
    case "too_big":
      return tooBig(i);
    case "not_multiple_of":
      return `Choisissez un multiple de ${fr(i.divisor ?? 1)}.`;
    case "invalid_type":
      return invalidType(i.expected);
    case "invalid_format":
      return invalidFormat(i.format);
    case "invalid_value":
      return "Choix invalide.";
    case "invalid_union":
      return "Valeur invalide.";
    case "unrecognized_keys":
      return "Champ inattendu.";
    case "custom":
      return i.message ? i.message : "Valeur invalide.";
    default:
      return "Valeur invalide.";
  }
}

/** Per-parse error map: `schema.safeParse(value, { error: zodFr })`; schema-level messages (refine / superRefine) still win. */
export const zodFr: z.core.$ZodErrorMap = (issue) => zodFrMessage(issue);

export type ParseFrResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | { ok: false; error: string; fieldErrors: Record<string, string> };

/** The text parseFr compares a final message with: a custom issue is generic only when it had no message of its own. */
function genericText(issue: z.core.$ZodIssue): string {
  return issue.code === "custom" ? "Valeur invalide." : zodFrMessage(issue);
}

/** Label of the last named segment (array indexes are skipped: `options.1` reads « Options »). */
function labelOf(path: readonly PropertyKey[]): string | null {
  for (let k = path.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
    const segment = path[k];
    if (typeof segment === "string") {
      return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(FIELD_LABELS, segment) ? FIELD_LABELS[segment] : null;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function lowerFirst(text: string): string {
  return text.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + text.slice(1);
}

/** The message shown for one issue: « {label} : {generic text} », or the schema's own message verbatim. */
function frenchError(issue: z.core.$ZodIssue): string {
  const generic = genericText(issue);
  if (issue.message !== generic) return issue.message;
  const label = labelOf(issue.path);
  return label ? `${label} : ${lowerFirst(generic)}` : generic;
}

/** safeParse with zodFr; `error` = first issue, prefixed « {label} : » when its text is the generic one; fieldErrors keyed by path.join("."). */
export function parseFr<S extends z.ZodType>(schema: S, value: unknown): ParseFrResult<z.output<S>> {
  const res = schema.safeParse(value, { error: zodFr });
  if (res.success) return { ok: true, data: res.data };
  const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const issue of res.error.issues) {
    const key = issue.path.map(String).join(".");
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(fieldErrors, key)) fieldErrors[key] = issue.message;
  }
  return { ok: false, error: frenchError(res.error.issues[0]), fieldErrors };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * What the pro reads when the booking engine refuses an action: one French
 * message per engine error code, worded for the person running the back-office
 * (the client wording lives in ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES, for the public pages).
 * A few codes read differently depending on the action, hence the per-context
 * overrides. Pure: no drizzle, no server module, no dash.
 */
import type { EngineErrorCode } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

/** The kind of action that failed; it selects the override table. */
export type ProErrorContext =
  | "catalog"
  | "event"
  | "series"
  | "occurrence"
  | "cancel"
  | "restore"
  | "register"
  | "unenroll"
  | "move"
  | "timeOff"
  | "customer"
  | "wallet"
  | "settings"
  | "profile";

/** Pro-facing French message for every engine code (never the client wording). */
export const PRO_ERROR_MESSAGES: Record<EngineErrorCode, string> = {
  full: "Cette séance est complète.",
  unavailable: "Cette séance n'est plus disponible : rafraîchissez la page.",
  changed: "La séance a changé entre-temps : rafraîchissez la page.",
  stale: "Les données ont changé entre-temps : rafraîchissez la page.",
  already_booked: "Ce client est déjà inscrit à cette séance.",
  slot_taken: "Ce créneau vient d'être pris.",
  no_ticket: "Ce client n'a aucun ticket utilisable ici.",
  too_many_holds: "Ce client a déjà deux paiements en cours.",
  too_late_or_done: "Cette inscription est déjà terminée.",
  not_found: "Élément introuvable : il a peut-être été supprimé.",
  not_eligible: "Ce ticket n'est pas accepté pour cette séance.",
  in_use: "Cet élément a déjà servi : il a été archivé.",
  invalid: "Certaines valeurs sont invalides.",
  throttled: "Trop de demandes. Réessayez dans un moment.",
  offer_too_short: "La validité de cette offre ne couvre pas la date de la séance.",
  ticket_expires_before: "Ticket expiré à la date de cette séance : déplacer quand même ?",
  retire_paid: "Un ticket payé ne peut pas être retiré : utilisez « Clore ».",
  timezone_locked: "Fuseau verrouillé : vous avez des séances planifiées.",
};

/** Per-context overrides of PRO_ERROR_MESSAGES. */
export const PRO_CONTEXT_MESSAGES: Readonly<Partial<Record<ProErrorContext, Partial<Record<EngineErrorCode, string>>>>> = {
  register: {
    full: "Complet : cochez « +1 place » pour l'inscrire quand même.",
    unavailable: "Cette séance est annulée : rétablissez-la pour inscrire quelqu'un.",
    not_eligible: "Ce ticket n'est pas utilisable sur cette séance.",
    no_ticket:
      "Ce client n'a aucun ticket utilisable ici : inscrivez-le comme invité, ou offrez-lui un ticket depuis sa fiche.",
    not_found: "Séance ou client introuvable.",
  },
  move: {
    full: "La séance choisie est complète.",
    not_eligible: "Cette séance n'accepte pas le ticket de ce client : choisissez un type vers lequel le convertir.",
    already_booked: "Ce client est déjà inscrit à la séance choisie.",
    stale: "Cette inscription a changé entre-temps : rafraîchissez la page.",
    not_found: "Inscription ou séance introuvable.",
  },
  restore: {
    not_found: "Seule une séance future d'un événement peut être rétablie.",
  },
  unenroll: {
    stale: "Une de ces inscriptions est déjà terminée : rafraîchissez la page.",
    not_found: "Inscription introuvable sur cette séance.",
  },
  cancel: {
    not_found: "Séance introuvable.",
  },
  occurrence: {
    invalid: "Modification invalide.",
    not_found: "Séance introuvable.",
  },
  series: {
    not_found: "Événement introuvable ou terminé.",
    invalid: "Modification invalide.",
  },
  event: {
    not_found: "Événement introuvable ou terminé.",
    invalid: "Un type de ticket choisi n'existe plus.",
  },
  timeOff: {
    stale: "Des inscriptions ont changé pendant la vérification : voici la liste à jour.",
  },
  wallet: {
    no_ticket: "Pas assez de tickets pour cette action : rafraîchissez la page.",
    not_found: "Ticket ou type introuvable.",
    invalid: "Choix invalide.",
  },
  catalog: {
    not_found: "Type ou offre introuvable.",
  },
  customer: {
    invalid: "Vérifiez le nom, l'email et le téléphone.",
    not_found: "Client introuvable.",
  },
  settings: {
    invalid: "Valeurs hors limites.",
  },
  profile: {
    not_found: "Profil introuvable.",
  },
};

/**
 * The engine's own `message` when it has one (always French and pro-facing after
 * pre-validation), else the context override, else the general pro message.
 */
export function proErrorMessage(fail: { code: EngineErrorCode; message?: string }, context: ProErrorContext): string {
  if (fail.message) return fail.message;
  return PRO_CONTEXT_MESSAGES[context]?.[fail.code] ?? PRO_ERROR_MESSAGES[fail.code];
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

  currencySymbol,

  formatWhenShort,

  plural,
} from "./format";

const PARIS = "Europe/Paris";
const LA = "America/Los_Angeles";
const at = (iso: string) => new Date(iso);
const DASH = /[\u2014\u2013]/;

test("formatTimeRange and formatWhen read in the given zone, host zone ignored", () => {
  const start = at("2026-10-12T17:00:00Z");
  const end = at("2026-10-12T18:00:00Z");
  assert.equal(formatTimeRange(start, end, PARIS), "19:00 à 20:00");
  assert.equal(formatWhen(start, end, PARIS), "lun. 12 octobre 2026 · 19:00 à 20:00");
  assert.equal(formatTimeRange(start, end, LA), "10:00 à 11:00");
  assert.equal(formatWhen(start, end, LA), "lun. 12 octobre 2026 · 10:00 à 11:00");
});

test("formatWhen crosses the day boundary per zone", () => {
  const start = at("2026-10-12T02:00:00Z");
  const end = at("2026-10-12T03:00:00Z");
  assert.equal(formatWhen(start, end, PARIS), "lun. 12 octobre 2026 · 04:00 à 05:00");
  assert.equal(formatWhen(start, end, LA), "dim. 11 octobre 2026 · 19:00 à 20:00");
});

test("formatWhen on the DST days of Paris and Los Angeles", () => {
  assert.equal(
    formatWhen(at("2026-03-29T00:30:00Z"), at("2026-03-29T01:30:00Z"), PARIS),
    "dim. 29 mars 2026 · 01:30 à 03:30",
  );
  assert.equal(
    formatWhen(at("2026-10-25T00:30:00Z"), at("2026-10-25T01:30:00Z"), PARIS),
    "dim. 25 octobre 2026 · 02:30 à 02:30",
  );
  assert.equal(
    formatWhen(at("2026-03-08T09:30:00Z"), at("2026-03-08T10:30:00Z"), LA),
    "dim. 8 mars 2026 · 01:30 à 03:30",
  );
  assert.equal(
    formatWhen(at("2026-11-01T08:30:00Z"), at("2026-11-01T09:30:00Z"), LA),
    "dim. 1 novembre 2026 · 01:30 à 01:30",
  );
});

test("formatWhenShort, formatDayMonthOf and formatDayMonthTime", () => {
  const start = at("2026-10-12T17:00:00Z");
  assert.equal(formatWhenShort(start, PARIS), "lun. 12/10 · 19:00");
  assert.equal(formatWhenShort(start, LA), "lun. 12/10 · 10:00");
  assert.equal(formatWhenShort(at("2026-03-29T01:30:00Z"), PARIS), "dim. 29/03 · 03:30");

  const late = at("2026-10-12T22:30:00Z");
  assert.equal(formatDayMonthOf(late, PARIS), "13/10");
  assert.equal(formatDayMonthOf(late, LA), "12/10");

  const history = at("2026-10-12T12:03:00Z");
  assert.equal(formatDayMonthTime(history, PARIS), "12/10 14:03");
  assert.equal(formatDayMonthTime(history, LA), "12/10 05:03");
});

test("expiryLabel: no expiry, same year, other year", () => {
  const now = at("2026-10-14T10:00:00Z");
  assert.equal(expiryLabel(null, PARIS, now), "sans limite de validité");
  // Expiry = local midnight after the last valid day (12/12 in Paris).
  assert.equal(expiryLabel(at("2026-12-12T23:00:00Z"), PARIS, now), "valable jusqu'au 12/12 inclus");
  assert.equal(expiryLabel(at("2026-12-31T23:00:00Z"), PARIS, now), "valable jusqu'au 31/12 inclus");
  assert.equal(expiryLabel(at("2027-01-12T23:00:00Z"), PARIS, now), "valable jusqu'au 12/01/2027 inclus");

test("expiryLabel reads the last valid day and the year in the given zone", () => {

  assert.equal(expiryLabel(at("2027-01-13T08:00:00Z"), LA, now), "valable jusqu'au 12/01/2027 inclus");
  // The same last day (31/12/2026) shows its year once "now" is in 2027 in the zone.
  const expiry = at("2026-12-31T23:00:00Z");
  assert.equal(expiryLabel(expiry, PARIS, at("2027-01-01T03:00:00Z")), "valable jusqu'au 31/12/2026 inclus");
  assert.equal(expiryLabel(expiry, PARIS, at("2026-12-01T03:00:00Z")), "valable jusqu'au 31/12 inclus");
  // Still 31 December in Los Angeles at 03:00Z on 1 January: same year.
  assert.equal(expiryLabel(at("2027-01-01T08:00:00Z"), LA, at("2027-01-01T03:00:00Z")), "valable jusqu'au 31/12 inclus");
});

  assert.equal(

  );
```

```ts
/**
 * Formatting helpers of the back-office and of the client e-mails. Pure: every
 * function takes the time zone explicitly (never the host zone), and no output
 * contains an em or en dash (UI rule), unlike datetime.formatSlot.
 */
import { formatDayMonth, formatDayMonthYear, mondayOf, parseKey, todayKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { lastValidDay } from "@/lib/ticket-expiry";

const formatters = new Map<string, Intl.DateTimeFormat>();

/** One Intl.DateTimeFormat per (zone, shape): building them is the slow part of formatting. */
function formatter(tz: string, shape: "time" | "weekday" | "dateLong"): Intl.DateTimeFormat {
  const key = `${tz}|${shape}`;
  let f = formatters.get(key);
  if (!f) {
    const options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions =
      shape === "time"
        ? { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: tz }
        : shape === "weekday"
          ? { weekday: "short", timeZone: tz }
          : { weekday: "short", day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: tz };
    f = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fr-FR", options);
    formatters.set(key, f);
  }
  return f;
}

/** « 19:00 à 20:00 » in tz. */
export function formatTimeRange(start: Date, end: Date, tz: string): string {
  const time = formatter(tz, "time");
  return `${time.format(start)} à ${time.format(end)}`;
}

/** « lun. 12 octobre 2026 · 19:00 à 20:00 » in tz (the dash-free twin of datetime.formatSlot). */
export function formatWhen(start: Date, end: Date, tz: string): string {
  return `${formatter(tz, "dateLong").format(start)} · ${formatTimeRange(start, end, tz)}`;
}

/** « lun. 12/10 · 19:00 » in tz. */
export function formatWhenShort(start: Date, tz: string): string {
  return `${formatter(tz, "weekday").format(start)} ${formatDayMonthOf(start, tz)} · ${formatter(tz, "time").format(start)}`;
}

/** « 12/10 » (local day of an instant in tz). */
export function formatDayMonthOf(instant: Date, tz: string): string {
  return formatDayMonth(todayKey(instant, tz));
}

/** « 12/10 14:03 » in tz (history lines). */
export function formatDayMonthTime(instant: Date, tz: string): string {
  return `${formatDayMonthOf(instant, tz)} ${formatter(tz, "time").format(instant)}`;
}

/** « valable jusqu'au 12/01 inclus » (« 12/01/2027 » when that last day is not in now's local year), or « sans limite de validité ». */
export function expiryLabel(expiresAt: Date | null, tz: string, now: Date): string {
  if (expiresAt === null) return "sans limite de validité";
  const last = lastValidDay(expiresAt, tz);
  const sameYear = parseKey(last).y === parseKey(todayKey(now, tz)).y;
  return `valable jusqu'au ${sameYear ? formatDayMonth(last) : formatDayMonthYear(last)} inclus`;
}

/** « 1 séance » / « 3 séances » (fr-FR thousands; 0 and 1 take the singular). */
export function plural(n: number, one: string, many: string): string {
  return `${n.toLocaleString("fr-FR")} ${Math.abs(n) < 2 ? one : many}`;
}

/** /dashboard/planning?semaine=<Monday DateKey of the séance, tz>&seance=<id> (Q20). */
export function planningHref(args: { occurrenceId: string; startsAt: Date | string; tz: string }): string {
  const monday = mondayOf(todayKey(new Date(args.startsAt), args.tz));
  return `/dashboard/planning?semaine=${monday}&seance=${encodeURIComponent(args.occurrenceId)}`;
}

/** « 25 », « 25,50 », « 25.5 » → 2500 / 2550; anything else (≤ 0, more than 2 decimals, letters) → null. */
export function parseMoneyInput(text: string): number | null {
  const match = /^(\d{1,7})(?:[.,](\d{1,2}))?$/.exec(text.trim());
  if (!match) return null;
  const cents = Number(match[1]) * 100 + Number((match[2] ?? "").padEnd(2, "0"));
  return cents > 0 ? cents : null;
}

/** 2550 → « 25,50 », 2500 → « 25 ». */
export function moneyInputValue(cents: number): string {
  const whole = Math.trunc(cents / 100);
  const rest = Math.abs(cents % 100);
  return rest === 0 ? String(whole) : `${whole},${String(rest).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

/** « € » for eur (Intl narrow symbol of the currency). */
export function currencySymbol(currency: string): string {
  try {
    const parts = new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
      style: "currency",
      currency: currency.toUpperCase(),
      currencyDisplay: "narrowSymbol",
    }).formatToParts(0);
    return parts.find((part) => part.type === "currency")?.value ?? currency.toUpperCase();
  } catch {
    return currency.toUpperCase();
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * HTML building blocks of the client e-mails (registrations, changes,
 * cancellations, offered tickets). Pure: every text and every URL goes through
 * escapeHtml, so values typed by pros and customers cannot break the markup.
 */
import { escapeHtml } from "@/lib/email-layout";

const BUTTON_STYLE =
  "display:inline-block;background:#6366f1;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px;margin:0 8px 8px 0";

/** The three « Ajouter à mon agenda » links of a confirmed registration. */
export type MailCalendarLinks = { googleUrl: string; outlookUrl: string; icsUrl: string };

/** <p> with escaped text. */
export function mailParagraph(text: string): string {
  return `<p>${escapeHtml(text)}</p>`;
}

/** Two-column table of escaped label / value rows. */
export function mailDetails(rows: readonly { label: string; value: string }[]): string {
  const lines = rows
    .map(
      (row) =>
        `<tr><td style="padding:6px 0;color:#71717a">${escapeHtml(row.label)}</td><td style="text-align:right">${escapeHtml(row.value)}</td></tr>`,
    )
    .join("");
  return `<table style="width:100%;font-size:14px;margin:16px 0;border-collapse:collapse">${lines}</table>`;
}

/** Button link; href and label escaped. */
export function mailButton(href: string, label: string): string {
  return `<a href="${escapeHtml(href)}" style="${BUTTON_STYLE}">${escapeHtml(label)}</a>`;
}

/** « Voir mes réservations et mes tickets » button + « Ce lien est personnel : ne le transférez pas. » */
export function mailPersonalLink(url: string): string {
  return `<p style="margin:24px 0 8px">${mailButton(url, "Voir mes réservations et mes tickets")}</p>
    <p style="color:#71717a;font-size:13px">Ce lien est personnel : ne le transférez pas.</p>`;
}

/** Subject-safe text: CR/LF and runs of spaces collapsed to one space. */
export function oneLine(text: string): string {
  return text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * « Inscription confirmée »: sent to a client once a registration is confirmed
 * (a ticket, a free place, a guest place or a paid one). The personal link opens
 * their space; the three buttons add the séance to their calendar.
 */
import { escapeHtml, layout } from "@/lib/email-layout";

import { mailButton, mailDetails, mailParagraph, mailPersonalLink, oneLine, type MailCalendarLinks } from "./parts";

export type BookingConfirmedArgs = {
  customerName: string;
  businessName: string;
  title: string;
  whenLabel: string;
  location: string | null;
  coverageLabel: string;
  ticketTypeName: string | null;
  ticketsLeft: readonly { typeName: string; count: number; expiryText: string }[];
  cancelText: string;
  personalLinkUrl: string;
  calendar: MailCalendarLinks;
};

export function bookingConfirmedEmail(a: BookingConfirmedArgs): { subject: string; html: string } {
  const rows = [
    { label: "Séance", value: a.title },
    { label: "Date", value: a.whenLabel },
    ...(a.location ? [{ label: "Lieu", value: a.location }] : []),
    { label: "Couverture", value: a.ticketTypeName ? `${a.coverageLabel} (${a.ticketTypeName})` : a.coverageLabel },
  ];
  const ticketsLeft =
    a.ticketsLeft.length > 0
      ? [
          mailParagraph("Vos tickets restants :"),
          ...a.ticketsLeft.map((left) => mailParagraph(`${left.count} × ${left.typeName}, ${left.expiryText}`)),
        ].join("\n    ")
      : "";
  const cancel = a.cancelText.trim() ? mailParagraph(a.cancelText) : "";
  const calendar = `<p style="margin:20px 0 8px">${mailButton(a.calendar.googleUrl, "Ajouter à Google Agenda")}${mailButton(
    a.calendar.outlookUrl,
    "Ajouter à Outlook",
  )}${mailButton(a.calendar.icsUrl, "Télécharger pour mon agenda (.ics)")}</p>`;
  const html = layout(
    escapeHtml("Inscription confirmée"),
    `
    ${mailParagraph(`Bonjour ${a.customerName}, votre inscription chez ${a.businessName} est confirmée.`)}
    ${mailDetails(rows)}
    ${ticketsLeft}
    ${cancel}
    ${calendar}
    ${mailPersonalLink(a.personalLinkUrl)}
  `,
  );
  return { subject: oneLine(`Inscription confirmée : ${a.title}`), html };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * « Inscription annulée »: sent when a registration is cancelled by the pro
 * (P3), or by the client themselves (`by: "client"`, wired in P4).
 */
import { escapeHtml, layout } from "@/lib/email-layout";

import { mailParagraph, mailPersonalLink, oneLine } from "./parts";

export type BookingCancelledArgs = {
  customerName: string;
  businessName: string;
  title: string;
  whenLabel: string;
  by: "pro" | "client";
  ticketReturned: boolean;
  reason: string | null;
  personalLinkUrl: string;
};

export function bookingCancelledEmail(a: BookingCancelledArgs): { subject: string; html: string } {
  const intro =
    a.by === "pro"
      ? `Bonjour ${a.customerName}, ${a.businessName} a annulé votre inscription à « ${a.title} » (${a.whenLabel}).`
      : `Bonjour ${a.customerName}, votre annulation pour « ${a.title} » (${a.whenLabel}) est bien enregistrée.`;
  const reason = a.reason ? mailParagraph(`Motif : ${a.reason}`) : "";
  const returned = a.ticketReturned ? mailParagraph("Votre ticket a été rendu à votre portefeuille.") : "";
  const html = layout(
    escapeHtml("Inscription annulée"),
    `
    ${mailParagraph(intro)}
    ${reason}
    ${returned}
    ${mailPersonalLink(a.personalLinkUrl)}
  `,
  );
  return { subject: oneLine(`Inscription annulée : ${a.title}`), html };
}
```

```ts
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import {
  GUEST_COOKIE,
  GUEST_COOKIE_MAX_AGE,
  guestLinkKey,
  personalLinkUrl,
  signGuestLink,
  verifyGuestLink,
} from "./guest-link";

const KEY = guestLinkKey("test-secret-0123456789abcdefghijklmnop");
const LINK = { customerId: "V1StGXR8_Z5jdHi6B-myT", linkVersion: 3 };

test("constants", () => {
  assert.equal(GUEST_COOKIE, "skedul_guest");
  assert.equal(GUEST_COOKIE_MAX_AGE, 2_592_000);
});

test("a signed link verifies and round-trips", () => {
  const token = signGuestLink(LINK, KEY);
  assert.match(token, /^V1StGXR8_Z5jdHi6B-myT\.3\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
  assert.deepEqual(verifyGuestLink(token, KEY), LINK);
  assert.equal(signGuestLink(LINK, KEY), token);
});

test("the key depends on the secret", () => {
  assert.equal(guestLinkKey("a").length, 32);
  assert.notDeepEqual(guestLinkKey("a"), guestLinkKey("b"));
  const token = signGuestLink(LINK, guestLinkKey("other-secret"));
  assert.equal(verifyGuestLink(token, KEY), null);
});

test("tampering with any part is refused", () => {
  const token = signGuestLink(LINK, KEY);
  const [id, version, mac] = token.split(".");
  const flipped = mac.slice(0, -1) + (mac.endsWith("A") ? "B" : "A");
  assert.equal(verifyGuestLink(`${id}.${version}.${flipped}`, KEY), null);
  assert.equal(verifyGuestLink(`${id}.4.${mac}`, KEY), null);
  assert.equal(verifyGuestLink(`${id}x.${version}.${mac}`, KEY), null);
  assert.equal(verifyGuestLink(`${id}.${version}.${mac}A`, KEY), null);
});

test("a bumped link_version yields a different token (revocation is the caller's comparison)", () => {
  const v3 = signGuestLink(LINK, KEY);
  const v4 = signGuestLink({ ...LINK, linkVersion: 4 }, KEY);
  assert.notEqual(v3, v4);
  assert.deepEqual(verifyGuestLink(v4, KEY), { ...LINK, linkVersion: 4 });
});

test("malformed tokens are refused", () => {
  const mac = signGuestLink(LINK, KEY).split(".")[2];
  for (const bad of [
    "",
    "abc",
    `${LINK.customerId}.${mac}`,
    `${LINK.customerId}.3.${mac}.x`,
    `${LINK.customerId}.0.${mac}`,
    `${LINK.customerId}.03.${mac}`,
    `${LINK.customerId}.-3.${mac}`,
    `${LINK.customerId}.3.5.${mac}`,
    `${LINK.customerId}.abc.${mac}`,
    `.3.${mac}`,
    `${LINK.customerId}.3.`,
    `${LINK.customerId}.3.${mac.slice(0, 20)}+/`,
  ]) {
    assert.equal(verifyGuestLink(bad, KEY), null, bad);
  }
});

test("personalLinkUrl points at /api/c/<token> and the token verifies back", () => {
  const url = personalLinkUrl("https://myskedul.com", { id: LINK.customerId, linkVersion: LINK.linkVersion }, KEY);
  assert.ok(url.startsWith("https://myskedul.com/api/c/"));
  assert.equal(url, `https://myskedul.com/api/c/${signGuestLink(LINK, KEY)}`);
  const token = url.slice("https://myskedul.com/api/c/".length);
  assert.deepEqual(verifyGuestLink(token, KEY), LINK);
});

test("personalLinkUrl ignores trailing slashes of the app URL", () => {
  const customer = { id: LINK.customerId, linkVersion: LINK.linkVersion };
  const plain = personalLinkUrl("https://myskedul.com", customer, KEY);
  assert.equal(personalLinkUrl("https://myskedul.com/", customer, KEY), plain);
  assert.equal(personalLinkUrl("https://myskedul.com///", customer, KEY), plain);
  assert.equal(personalLinkUrl("http://localhost:3102/", customer, KEY).startsWith("http://localhost:3102/api/c/"), true);
});

test("personalLinkUrl signs the link version of the row", () => {
  const v3 = personalLinkUrl("https://myskedul.com", { id: LINK.customerId, linkVersion: 3 }, KEY);
  const v4 = personalLinkUrl("https://myskedul.com", { id: LINK.customerId, linkVersion: 4 }, KEY);
  assert.notEqual(v3, v4);
  assert.deepEqual(verifyGuestLink(v4.split("/api/c/")[1], KEY), { customerId: LINK.customerId, linkVersion: 4 });
});
```

```ts
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import {
  buildIcs,
  googleCalendarUrl,
  outlookCalendarUrl,
} from "./calendar-links";

const base = {
  title: "Coaching 1h",
  description: "Rendez-vous avec Altinha Paris",
  startAt: new Date("2026-07-03T12:00:00.000Z"),
  endAt: new Date("2026-07-03T13:00:00.000Z"),
};

test("googleCalendarUrl → render?action=TEMPLATE with UTC compact dates", () => {
  const url = new URL(googleCalendarUrl(base));
  assert.equal(url.origin + url.pathname, "https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("action"), "TEMPLATE");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("text"), "Coaching 1h");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("details"), "Rendez-vous avec Altinha Paris");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("dates"), "20260703T120000Z/20260703T130000Z");
});

test("outlookCalendarUrl → deeplink/compose with ISO dates", () => {
  const url = new URL(outlookCalendarUrl(base));
  assert.equal(
    url.origin + url.pathname,
    "https://outlook.live.com/calendar/0/deeplink/compose",
  );
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("rru"), "addevent");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("subject"), "Coaching 1h");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("body"), "Rendez-vous avec Altinha Paris");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("startdt"), "2026-07-03T12:00:00.000Z");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("enddt"), "2026-07-03T13:00:00.000Z");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("path"), null);
});

test("buildIcs → valid VCALENDAR with CRLF lines and UID", () => {
  const ics = buildIcs({ ...base, uid: "bk_123@skedul.app" });
  const lines = ics.split("\r\n");
  assert.equal(lines[0], "BEGIN:VCALENDAR");
  assert.ok(lines.includes("UID:bk_123@skedul.app"));
  assert.ok(lines.includes("DTSTART:20260703T120000Z"));
  assert.ok(lines.includes("DTEND:20260703T130000Z"));
  assert.ok(lines.includes("SUMMARY:Coaching 1h"));
  assert.ok(lines.includes("END:VCALENDAR"));
  // file ends with a CRLF
  assert.ok(ics.endsWith("\r\n"));
});

    uid: "bk_esc@skedul.app",
    title: "Yoga; doux, matin",
    description: "Ligne 1\nLigne 2",
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement the personal link**

Replace the whole content of `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/guest-link.ts` (the existing code is unchanged; `personalLinkUrl` is added at the end):

```ts
/**
 * Personal link (spec § 12): every client e-mail points to /api/c/<token>,
 * which sets the `skedul_guest` cookie for this pro's path. The token is
 * `customerId.linkVersion.mac`, MAC = HMAC-SHA256 under a key derived from
 * BETTER_AUTH_SECRET. Bumping customer.link_version revokes every link: the
 * caller compares the verified version with the row's. Pure (node:crypto).
 */
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";

export const GUEST_COOKIE = "skedul_guest" as const;
/** 30 days, in seconds (2_592_000). */
export const GUEST_COOKIE_MAX_AGE: number = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;

export type GuestLink = { customerId: string; linkVersion: number };

const VERSION = /^[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$/;
const PART = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/;

/** HMAC-SHA256(secret, "skedul-guest-link-v1"). */
export function guestLinkKey(secret: string): Buffer {
  return createHmac("sha256", secret).update("skedul-guest-link-v1").digest();
}

function mac(link: GuestLink, key: Buffer): string {
  return createHmac("sha256", key).update(`${link.customerId}|${link.linkVersion}`).digest("base64url");
}

/** `${customerId}.${linkVersion}.${base64url(HMAC-SHA256(key, `${customerId}|${linkVersion}`))}`. */
export function signGuestLink(link: GuestLink, key: Buffer): string {
  return `${link.customerId}.${link.linkVersion}.${mac(link, key)}`;
}

/** The link when the token has exactly 3 parts, an integer version ≥ 1 and a matching MAC (constant time); else null. */
export function verifyGuestLink(token: string, key: Buffer): GuestLink | null {
  const parts = token.split(".");
  if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
  const [customerId, versionText, given] = parts;
  if (!PART.test(customerId) || !VERSION.test(versionText) || !PART.test(given)) return null;
  const link = { customerId, linkVersion: Number(versionText) };
  const expected = Buffer.from(mac(link, key));
  const actual = Buffer.from(given);
  if (actual.length !== expected.length || !timingSafeEqual(actual, expected)) return null;
  return link;
}

/** `${appUrl}/api/c/${signGuestLink({ customerId: customer.id, linkVersion: customer.linkVersion }, key)}` (appUrl without trailing slash; the version comes from the row at send time). */
export function personalLinkUrl(appUrl: string, customer: { id: string; linkVersion: number }, key: Buffer): string {
  const token = signGuestLink({ customerId: customer.id, linkVersion: customer.linkVersion }, key);
  return `${appUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/api/c/${token}`;
}
```

Replace the whole content of `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/calendar-links.ts` (`location` is optional on the input, the Google and Outlook links carry it as a `location` parameter, the ICS file as a `LOCATION:` line after `DESCRIPTION:`; everything else is unchanged):

```ts
export interface CalendarLinkInput {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  startAt: Date;
  endAt: Date;
  /** Where the séance takes place; the link or file carries it only when set. */
  location?: string | null;
}

/** 2026-07-03T12:00:00.000Z → 20260703T120000Z (RFC 5545 UTC form). */
function compactUtc(d: Date): string {
  return d.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, "").replace(/\.\d{3}/, "");
}

/** "Add to calendar" web link for Google Calendar. */
export function googleCalendarUrl(input: CalendarLinkInput): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    action: "TEMPLATE",
    text: input.title,
    details: input.description,
    dates: `${compactUtc(input.startAt)}/${compactUtc(input.endAt)}`,
  });
  if (input.location) params.set("location", input.location);
  return `https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?${params}`;
}

/** "Add to calendar" web link for Outlook.com. */
export function outlookCalendarUrl(input: CalendarLinkInput): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    rru: "addevent",
    subject: input.title,
    body: input.description,
    startdt: input.startAt.toISOString(),
    enddt: input.endAt.toISOString(),
  });
  if (input.location) params.set("location", input.location);
  return `https://outlook.live.com/calendar/0/deeplink/compose?${params}`;
}

function escapeIcsText(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/\\/g, "\\\\")
    .replace(/;/g, "\\;")
    .replace(/,/g, "\\,")
    .replace(/\r?\n/g, "\\n");
}

/** Minimal RFC 5545 file for one event. DTSTAMP mirrors DTSTART to stay pure. */
export function buildIcs(input: CalendarLinkInput & { uid: string }): string {
  const lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Skedul//Booking//FR",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    `UID:${input.uid}`,
    `DTSTAMP:${compactUtc(input.startAt)}`,
    `DTSTART:${compactUtc(input.startAt)}`,
    `DTEND:${compactUtc(input.endAt)}`,
    `SUMMARY:${escapeIcsText(input.title)}`,
    `DESCRIPTION:${escapeIcsText(input.description)}`,
    ...(input.location ? [`LOCATION:${escapeIcsText(input.location)}`] : []),
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
  ];
  return lines.join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Implement the Google event body**

Replace the whole content of `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/google-event.ts`:

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";

export interface GoogleEventBody {
  id?: string;
  status: "confirmed";
  summary: string;
  description: string;
  location?: string;
  start: { dateTime: string; timeZone: string };
  end: { dateTime: string; timeZone: string };
}

const FOOTER = "Géré par Skedul : ne pas modifier ici.";

/** hex(sha256(occurrenceId)): 64 lowercase hex chars, a valid Google event id (base32hex). */
export function googleEventId(occurrenceId: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(occurrenceId).digest("hex");
}

export interface OccurrenceEventInput {
  occurrenceId: string;
  title: string;
  isRdv: boolean;
  location: string | null;
  startAt: Date;
  endAt: Date;
  capacity: number;
  timezone: string;
  attendees: readonly { name: string; email: string }[];
}

/**
 * Full Google Calendar body of one occurrence (pure): deterministic id, status
 * confirmed (a PATCH revives an event Google keeps as cancelled), summary
 * « {title} · {client} » for an RDV, « Places : n/cap » for a séance, one
 * « • name (email) » line per attendee, the footer, and the location. An unknown
 * location is sent as "": Google PATCH only changes the fields it receives, and an
 * empty string clears a place the event had before (override removed).
 */
export function buildOccurrenceEvent(input: OccurrenceEventInput): GoogleEventBody & { id: string } {
  const client = input.attendees[0];
  const summary = input.isRdv && client ? `${input.title} · ${client.name}` : input.title;

  const lines: string[] = [];
  if (!input.isRdv) lines.push(`Places : ${input.attendees.length}/${input.capacity}`);
  for (const attendee of input.attendees) lines.push(`• ${attendee.name} (${attendee.email})`);
  lines.push("", FOOTER);

  return {
    id: googleEventId(input.occurrenceId),
    status: "confirmed",
    summary,
    description: lines.join("\n"),
    location: input.location ?? "",
    start: { dateTime: input.startAt.toISOString(), timeZone: input.timezone },
    end: { dateTime: input.endAt.toISOString(), timeZone: input.timezone },
  };
}
```

Replace the whole content of `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/google-calendar.ts` (`createSkedulCalendar` and `deleteEvent` are unchanged; `insertEvent` answers `"created"` or, on a 409, `"exists"`; `patchEvent` answers `"patched"` or, on a 404 or 410, `"missing"`):

```ts
import "server-only";

import type { GoogleEventBody } from "@/lib/google-event";

const API = "https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3";

async function call(
  accessToken: string,
  path: string,
  init: { method: string; body?: unknown },
): Promise<Response> {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, {
    method: init.method,
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: init.body ? JSON.stringify(init.body) : undefined,
  });
  return res;
}

async function ensureOk(res: Response, action: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text().catch(() => "");
    throw new Error(`Google Calendar ${action} failed (${res.status}): ${text}`);
  }
}

/** Creates the dedicated "Skedul" secondary calendar; returns its id. */
export async function createSkedulCalendar(
  accessToken: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const res = await call(accessToken, "/calendars", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { summary: "Skedul" },
  });
  await ensureOk(res, "create calendar");
  const json = (await res.json()) as { id: string };
  return json.id;
}

/** POST the body (with its id); 409 (id already known, even a cancelled event) → "exists". */
export async function insertEvent(
  accessToken: string,
  calendarId: string,
  body: GoogleEventBody,
): Promise<"created" | "exists"> {
  const res = await call(
    accessToken,
    `/calendars/${encodeURIComponent(calendarId)}/events`,
    { method: "POST", body },
  );
  if (res.status === 409) return "exists";
  await ensureOk(res, "insert event");
  return "created";
}

/** PATCH the full body; 404 / 410 → "missing". */
export async function patchEvent(
  accessToken: string,
  calendarId: string,
  eventId: string,
  body: GoogleEventBody,
): Promise<"patched" | "missing"> {
  const res = await call(
    accessToken,
    `/calendars/${encodeURIComponent(calendarId)}/events/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}`,
    { method: "PATCH", body },
  );
  if (res.status === 404 || res.status === 410) return "missing";
  await ensureOk(res, "patch event");
  return "patched";
}

export async function deleteEvent(
  accessToken: string,
  calendarId: string,
  eventId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const res = await call(
    accessToken,
    `/calendars/${encodeURIComponent(calendarId)}/events/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}`,
    { method: "DELETE" },
  );
  // 404/410 = already gone → treat as success.
  if (res.status === 404 || res.status === 410) return;
  await ensureOk(res, "delete event");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Google Calendar sync of ONE occurrence (spec § 13.7), with injected deps so it
 * is testable without network or DB. The Google event id is derived from the
 * occurrence (googleEventId), `occurrence.google_event_id` is only a marker that
 * says « an event may exist ». A Google event is wanted for a scheduled
 * occurrence with at least one confirmed attendee, a séance or an RDV.
 */
import { buildOccurrenceEvent, type GoogleEventBody } from "@/lib/google-event";
import type { OccurrenceStatus } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export interface LoadedOccurrence {
  occurrenceId: string;
  userId: string;
  googleCalendarId: string | null;
  googleEventId: string | null;
  status: OccurrenceStatus;
  isRdv: boolean;
  title: string;
  location: string | null;
  startAt: Date;
  endAt: Date;
  capacity: number;
  timezone: string;
  attendees: { name: string; email: string }[];
}

export interface SyncDeps {
  enabled: boolean;
  loadOccurrence: (occurrenceId: string) => Promise<LoadedOccurrence | null>;
  getAccessToken: (userId: string) => Promise<string>;
  insertEvent: (token: string, calendarId: string, body: GoogleEventBody) => Promise<"created" | "exists">;
  patchEvent: (token: string, calendarId: string, eventId: string, body: GoogleEventBody) => Promise<"patched" | "missing">;
  deleteEvent: (token: string, calendarId: string, eventId: string) => Promise<void>;
  saveEventId: (occurrenceId: string, eventId: string | null) => Promise<void>;
}

export type SyncOutcome = "disabled" | "skipped" | "noop" | "deleted" | "created" | "updated";

/** A Google event is wanted for a scheduled occurrence with ≥ 1 confirmed attendee (séance or RDV, spec § 13.7). */
export function wantsGoogleEvent(o: Pick<LoadedOccurrence, "status" | "attendees">): boolean {
  return o.status === "scheduled" && o.attendees.length >= 1;
}

/**
 * Reconcile one occurrence with Google. Nothing wanted and no marker: no token
 * and no API call. Nothing wanted and a marker: delete (404 / 410 count as
 * success) then clear the marker. Wanted: PATCH when there is a marker (a 404
 * falls back to the insert); insert with the deterministic id, and when Google
 * answers « exists » (an event it keeps as cancelled) PATCH the full body, which
 * revives it; then store the marker.
 */
export async function syncOccurrenceWith(occurrenceId: string, deps: SyncDeps): Promise<SyncOutcome> {
  if (!deps.enabled) return "disabled";
  const o = await deps.loadOccurrence(occurrenceId);
  if (!o || !o.googleCalendarId) return "skipped";
  const calendarId = o.googleCalendarId;

  if (!wantsGoogleEvent(o)) {
    if (!o.googleEventId) return "noop";
    const token = await deps.getAccessToken(o.userId);
    await deps.deleteEvent(token, calendarId, o.googleEventId);
    await deps.saveEventId(o.occurrenceId, null);
    return "deleted";
  }

  const token = await deps.getAccessToken(o.userId);
  const body = buildOccurrenceEvent({
    occurrenceId: o.occurrenceId,
    title: o.title,
    isRdv: o.isRdv,
    location: o.location,
    startAt: o.startAt,
    endAt: o.endAt,
    capacity: o.capacity,
    timezone: o.timezone,
    attendees: o.attendees,
  });

  if (o.googleEventId) {
    const patched = await deps.patchEvent(token, calendarId, o.googleEventId, body);
    if (patched === "patched") return "updated";
  }

  const inserted = await deps.insertEvent(token, calendarId, body);
  if (inserted === "exists") await deps.patchEvent(token, calendarId, body.id, body);
  await deps.saveEventId(o.occurrenceId, body.id);
  return "created";
}
```
