- [ ] **Step 14: Implement the loader**

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/calendar-sync-load.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Database side of the Google sync of one occurrence. No `server-only`, no
 * next/* and no session: the pure sync core (calendar-sync-core.ts) takes these
 * functions as deps, and the DB tests call them directly. The occurrence id
 * comes from the engine (an effect), never from user input; the pro, the user
 * and the calendar are always read from the occurrence's own professional.
 */
import { and, asc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { LoadedOccurrence } from "@/lib/calendar-sync-core";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, customer, event, occurrence, professional, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";

/**
 * The occurrence as the sync needs it: pro user and calendar, title = event
 * title or type name (RDV), location = COALESCE(location_override, event.location)
 * (null for an RDV), confirmed attendees by created_at.
 */
export async function loadOccurrenceForSync(db: Db, occurrenceId: string): Promise<LoadedOccurrence | null> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      occurrenceId: occurrence.id,
      userId: professional.userId,
      googleCalendarId: professional.googleCalendarId,
      timezone: professional.timezone,
      googleEventId: occurrence.googleEventId,
      status: occurrence.status,
      eventId: occurrence.eventId,
      eventTitle: event.title,
      eventLocation: event.location,
      locationOverride: occurrence.locationOverride,
      typeName: ticketType.name,
      startAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endAt: occurrence.endsAt,
      capacity: occurrence.capacity,
    })
    .from(occurrence)
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, occurrence.professionalId))
    .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
    .where(eq(occurrence.id, occurrenceId))
    .limit(1);
  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row) return null;

  const attendees = await db
    .select({ name: customer.name, email: customer.email })
    .from(booking)
    .innerJoin(customer, eq(customer.id, booking.customerId))
    .where(and(eq(booking.occurrenceId, occurrenceId), eq(booking.status, "confirmed")))
    .orderBy(asc(booking.createdAt), asc(booking.id));

  const isRdv = row.eventId === null;
  return {
    occurrenceId: row.occurrenceId,
    userId: row.userId,
    googleCalendarId: row.googleCalendarId,
    googleEventId: row.googleEventId,
    status: row.status,
    isRdv,
    title: (isRdv ? row.typeName : row.eventTitle) ?? "",
    location: isRdv ? null : (row.locationOverride ?? row.eventLocation ?? null),
    startAt: row.startAt,
    endAt: row.endAt,
    capacity: row.capacity,
    timezone: row.timezone,
    attendees,
  };
}

/** Stores (or clears) the Google marker of one occurrence. */
export async function saveGoogleEventId(db: Db, occurrenceId: string, eventId: string | null): Promise<void> {
  await db.update(occurrence).set({ googleEventId: eventId }).where(eq(occurrence.id, occurrenceId));
}

/**
 * Disconnect (Q33): one batch clears the pro's calendar id and every Google
 * marker of the pro. Nothing is backfilled when the pro connects again: only
 * occurrences that change afterwards are synced.
 */
export async function clearGoogleLink(db: Db, professionalId: string): Promise<void> {
  await db.batch([
    db.update(professional).set({ googleCalendarId: null }).where(eq(professional.id, professionalId)),
    db.update(occurrence).set({ googleEventId: null }).where(eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId)),
  ]);
}
```

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/calendar-sync.ts` (no test: it only wires `env`, `auth`, `db` and `google-calendar.ts` into the tested core; Task 5's `runEffects` is its first caller):

```ts
import "server-only";

import { auth } from "@/lib/auth";
import { syncOccurrenceWith } from "@/lib/calendar-sync-core";
import { loadOccurrenceForSync, saveGoogleEventId } from "@/lib/calendar-sync-load";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { deleteEvent, insertEvent, patchEvent } from "@/lib/google-calendar";

/**
 * Best-effort Google sync of one occurrence, with the real dependencies. It
 * never throws: the pro's action is already committed, so a Google failure is
 * only logged (the next change of the occurrence reconciles it).
 */
export async function syncOccurrence(occurrenceId: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await syncOccurrenceWith(occurrenceId, {
      enabled: env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ENABLED,
      loadOccurrence: (id) => loadOccurrenceForSync(db, id),
      getAccessToken: async (userId) => {
        const { accessToken } = await auth.api.getAccessToken({ body: { providerId: "google", userId } });
        return accessToken;
      },
      insertEvent,
      patchEvent,
      deleteEvent,
      saveEventId: (id, eventId) => saveGoogleEventId(db, id, eventId),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error(`[calendar-sync] occurrence ${occurrenceId} failed: ${message}`);
  }
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/notify-core.ts (DB, no server-only, no env)
export type OutgoingEmail = { to: string; subject: string; html: string };
export type NotifyDeps = { appUrl: string; guestKey: Buffer; now: Date };
export type EffectPlan =
  | { kind: "emails"; emails: OutgoingEmail[] }
  | { kind: "google"; occurrenceId: string }
  | { kind: "stripe"; purchaseId: string; checkoutSessionId: string }
  | { kind: "deferred"; type: Effect["type"] };
export function dedupeEffects(effects: readonly Effect[]): Effect[];
export async function planEffect(db: Db, effect: Effect, deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan>;
export function logSafeMessage(err: unknown): string; // addition: the log-safe one-line message used by runEffects

// src/server/notify.ts (server-only)

// src/lib/stripe.ts (add)
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import type { Effect } from "./booking/types";
import { dedupeEffects, logSafeMessage } from "./notify-core";

const changed = (bookingIds: string[]): Effect => ({ type: "email.occurrence_changed", occurrenceId: "o1", bookingIds });
const sync = (occurrenceId: string): Effect => ({ type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId });
const confirmed: Effect = { type: "email.booking_confirmed", bookingId: "b1" };
const expire: Effect = { type: "stripe.expire_session", purchaseId: "p1", checkoutSessionId: "cs_test_1" };

test("dedupeEffects collapses e-mails whose bookingIds only differ by order and keeps the first one as it was", () => {
  const out = dedupeEffects([changed(["b2", "b1"]), changed(["b1", "b2"])]);
  assert.equal(out.length, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(out[0], changed(["b2", "b1"]));
});

test("dedupeEffects puts the Google syncs last and keeps the first-seen order otherwise", () => {
  const out = dedupeEffects([sync("o1"), confirmed, sync("o2"), expire, sync("o1"), confirmed]);
  assert.deepEqual(out, [confirmed, expire, sync("o1"), sync("o2")]);
});

test("dedupeEffects keeps effects that differ by any field", () => {
  const effects: Effect[] = [
    { type: "email.booking_cancelled", bookingId: "b1", by: "pro" },
    { type: "email.booking_cancelled", bookingId: "b1", by: "client" },
    { type: "email.occurrence_changed", occurrenceId: "o1", bookingIds: ["b1"] },
    { type: "email.occurrence_changed", occurrenceId: "o2", bookingIds: ["b1"] },
    { type: "email.occurrence_cancelled", occurrenceId: "o1", bookingIds: ["b1"] },
    { type: "stripe.expire_session", purchaseId: "p1", checkoutSessionId: "cs_1" },
    { type: "stripe.expire_session", purchaseId: "p2", checkoutSessionId: "cs_2" },
  ];
  assert.deepEqual(dedupeEffects(effects), effects);
});

test("dedupeEffects does not touch its input and accepts an empty list", () => {
  const first = changed(["b2", "b1"]);
  const input = [first, changed(["b1", "b2"])];
  dedupeEffects(input);
  assert.equal(input.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(first, changed(["b2", "b1"]));
  assert.deepEqual(dedupeEffects([]), []);
});

test("logSafeMessage hides e-mail addresses, personal-link tokens and Checkout session ids", () => {
  assert.equal(logSafeMessage(new Error("boom for marie@example.com")), "boom for [email]");
  assert.equal(
    logSafeMessage(new Error("GET https://app.test/api/c/abc.1.def_ghi failed")),
    "GET https://app.test/api/c/[token] failed",
  );
  assert.equal(
    logSafeMessage(new Error("No such checkout.session: 'cs_test_a1B2c3'")),
    "No such checkout.session: '[session]'",
  );
});

test("logSafeMessage gives one short line and survives a non-Error", () => {
  assert.equal(logSafeMessage(new Error("a\n  b\tc")), "a b c");
  assert.equal(logSafeMessage(new Error("x".repeat(500))).length, 200);
  assert.equal(logSafeMessage("plain string"), "unknown error");
  assert.equal(logSafeMessage(undefined), "unknown error");
});
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { mockLinks } from "./mock-links";

test("mockLinks: finds the personal link and the calendar file link of a mail", () => {
  const html =
    '<p>Bonjour</p><a href="https://app.test/api/c/cus_1.2.mac_x" style="display:inline-block">Voir mes réservations et mes tickets</a>' +
    '<a href="https://app.test/api/bookings/b1/calendar.ics" style="color:#000">Télécharger</a>';
  assert.deepEqual(mockLinks(html), ["https://app.test/api/c/cus_1.2.mac_x", "https://app.test/api/bookings/b1/calendar.ics"]);
});

test("mockLinks: decodes the entities an escaped href carries", () => {
  const html = '<a href="https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&amp;text=Cours&amp;dates=1/2">Google</a>';
  assert.deepEqual(mockLinks(html), ["https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&text=Cours&dates=1/2"]);
});

test("mockLinks: ignores mailto, relative and anchor links, and repeats", () => {
  const html =
    '<a href="mailto:a@b.test">mail</a><a href="/relative">rel</a><a href="#top">top</a>' +
    '<a href="https://app.test/x">x</a><a href="https://app.test/x">again</a>';
  assert.deepEqual(mockLinks(html), ["https://app.test/x"]);
});

test("mockLinks: keeps at most max links", () => {
  const html = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((n) => `<a href="https://app.test/${n}">${n}</a>`).join("");
  assert.equal(mockLinks(html).length, 5);
  assert.equal(mockLinks(html, 2).length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(mockLinks("<p>no link</p>"), []);
});
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import { addDaysMs, addMinutes, createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, testEmail, type Db } from "../test/db";
import { dayIn, giveTickets, makeCustomer, makeEvent, makeOffer, makeType } from "../test/fixtures";
import { expiryLabel } from "./back-office/format";
import { cancelBookingsByPro, cancelOccurrence } from "./booking/cancel";
import { attachCheckoutSession, registerPro, startBuyAndBook } from "./booking/claims";
import { updateOccurrence } from "./booking/series";
import type { Effect } from "./booking/types";
import { moveAttendee, offerTickets } from "./booking/wallet";
import { professional } from "./db/schema";
import { escapeHtml } from "./email-layout";
import { guestLinkKey, personalLinkUrl } from "./guest-link";
import { planEffect, type EffectPlan, type NotifyDeps, type OutgoingEmail } from "./notify-core";

const APP = "https://app.test";
const KEY = guestLinkKey("test-secret");
const NONE: EffectPlan = { kind: "emails", emails: [] };
const esc = escapeHtml;

const depsAt = (now: Date): NotifyDeps => ({ appUrl: APP, guestKey: KEY, now });
const linkOf = (customerId: string): string => personalLinkUrl(APP, { id: customerId, linkVersion: 1 }, KEY);

function must<T extends { ok: boolean }>(res: T): Extract<T, { ok: true }> {
  assert.equal(res.ok, true, JSON.stringify(res));
  return res as Extract<T, { ok: true }>;
}

function emailsOf(plan: EffectPlan): OutgoingEmail[] {
  assert.equal(plan.kind, "emails", JSON.stringify(plan));
  return plan.kind === "emails" ? plan.emails : [];
}

function effectOf<T extends Effect["type"]>(effects: readonly Effect[], type: T): Extract<Effect, { type: T }> {
  const found = effects.find((e): e is Extract<Effect, { type: T }> => e.type === type);
  assert.ok(found, `no ${type} effect in ${JSON.stringify(effects)}`);
  return found;
}

async function businessNameOf(db: Db, proId: string): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.select({ name: professional.businessName }).from(professional).where(eq(professional.id, proId));
  return row.name;
}

dbTest("booking_confirmed: one e-mail with the links, the ticket, the tickets left and the cancel deadline", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const business = await businessNameOf(db, pro.proId);
  const collectif = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const essai = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours d'essai" });
  const { occurrences: [occ] } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha du soir", ticketTypeIds: [collectif] });
  const email = testEmail("conf");
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, collectif, 2);
  const expires = addDaysMs(now, 40);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, essai, 1, { expiresAt: expires });
  const reg = must(
    await registerPro(
      db,
      { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: occ.id, customerId, asGuest: false },
      now,
    ),
  );

  const plan = await planEffect(db, { type: "email.booking_confirmed", bookingId: reg.bookingId }, depsAt(now));
  const mails = emailsOf(plan);
  assert.equal(mails.length, 1);
  const [mail] = mails;
  assert.equal(mail.to, email);
  assert.equal(mail.subject, "Inscription confirmée : Altinha du soir");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(`Bonjour Beatriz Almeida, votre inscription chez ${esc(business)} est confirmée.`));
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(linkOf(customerId)), "personal link");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(`${APP}/api/bookings/${reg.bookingId}/calendar.ics`), "ICS link");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes("https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE"), "Google link");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes("https://outlook.live.com/calendar/0/deeplink/compose?"), "Outlook link");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes("Ticket (Cours collectif)"), "coverage with the ticket type");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes("1 × Cours collectif, sans limite de validité"), "tickets left, no expiry");
  assert.ok(
    mail.html.includes(esc(`1 × Cours d'essai, ${expiryLabel(expires, pro.tz, now)}`)),
    "tickets left, with expiry",
  );
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc("Vous pouvez annuler en ligne jusqu'au ")), "cancel deadline sentence");
});

dbTest("booking_cancelled: the reason, the personal link and the ticket line only when a ticket came back", async ({ db, pro }) => {

  const holderEmail = testEmail("holder");

    await registerPro(

    ),
  );

      { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: occ.id, customerId: guest, asGuest: true },

      db,
      {
        professionalId: pro.proId,
        actorUserId: pro.userId,
        occurrenceId: occ.id,

        reason: "Cours annulé pour travaux",
      },
      now,
    ),

  assert.equal(res.effects.filter((e) => e.type === "email.booking_cancelled").length, 2);

  assert.ok(m1.html.includes(linkOf(holder)));

  const [m2] = emailsOf(
    await planEffect(db, { type: "email.booking_cancelled", bookingId: asGuest.bookingId, by: "pro" }, depsAt(now)),
  );
  assert.ok(m2.html.includes("Motif : Cours annulé pour travaux"));
  assert.ok(!m2.html.includes("Votre ticket a été rendu"), "a guest has no ticket to give back");
  assert.ok(m2.html.includes(linkOf(guest)));

  const [m3] = emailsOf(
    await planEffect(db, { type: "email.booking_cancelled", bookingId: withTicket.bookingId, by: "client" }, depsAt(now)),
  );
  assert.ok(m3.html.includes("est bien enregistrée"));
  assert.ok(!m3.html.includes("a annulé votre inscription"));
});

dbTest("occurrence_cancelled mails the confirmed client only: a lapsed hold hears nothing; the open session is planned for expiry", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId);

  const confirmedEmail = testEmail("kept");
  const confirmed = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: confirmedEmail });
  const abandoned = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Thomas Leroy" });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, confirmed, typeId, 1);
  must(
    await registerPro(
      db,
      { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: occ.id, customerId: confirmed, asGuest: false },
      now,
    ),
  );
  // the hold lasts 45 min: started 60 min ago it has lapsed when the pro cancels
  const hold = must(
    await startBuyAndBook(
      db,
      { professionalId: pro.proId, occurrenceId: occ.id, customerId: abandoned, seenStartsAt: occ.startsAt, offerId },
      addMinutes(now, -60),
    ),
  );
  const sessionId = `cs_test_${hold.purchaseId}`;
  must(
    await attachCheckoutSession(db, {
      purchaseId: hold.purchaseId,
      checkoutSessionId: sessionId,
      checkoutUrl: "https://checkout.example.test/s",
    }),
  );

  const res = must(
    await cancelOccurrence(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: occ.id }, now),
  );

  assert.ok(mails[0].html.includes("Votre ticket a été rendu à votre portefeuille."));
  assert.ok(mails[0].html.includes(linkOf(confirmed)));

  assert.deepEqual(
    await planEffect(db, { type: "email.booking_cancelled", bookingId: hold.bookingId, by: "pro" }, depsAt(now)),
    NONE,
    "the lapsed hold gets no « Inscription annulée » either",
  );
  const expire = effectOf(res.effects, "stripe.expire_session");
  assert.deepEqual(await planEffect(db, expire, depsAt(now)), {
    kind: "stripe",
    purchaseId: hold.purchaseId,
    checkoutSessionId: sessionId,
  });
});

  const upd = must(
    await updateOccurrence(
      db,
      {
        professionalId: pro.proId,
        actorUserId: pro.userId,
        occurrenceId: occ.id,
        seenStartsAt: occ.startsAt,
        patch: { startsAt: addMinutes(occ.startsAt, 60), locationOverride: "Studio Marais" },
      },
      changedAt,
    ),
  );
  const reg2 = must(
    await registerPro(
      db,
      { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: occ.id, customerId: lateComer, asGuest: false },
      addMinutes(now, 10),
    ),
  );

  const own = effectOf(upd.effects, "email.occurrence_changed");
  assert.deepEqual(own.bookingIds, [reg1.bookingId]);
  const [first] = emailsOf(await planEffect(db, own, depsAt(changedAt)));
  assert.equal(first.subject, "Séance modifiée : Altinha du soir");
  assert.ok(first.html.includes("Studio Marais"));
  const cancelLine = esc("Si ce changement ne vous convient pas, vous pouvez annuler en ligne jusqu'au début de la séance.");
  assert.ok(first.html.includes(cancelLine), "booked before the change: may cancel until the start");

  const both: Effect = {
    type: "email.occurrence_changed",
    occurrenceId: occ.id,
    bookingIds: [reg2.bookingId, reg1.bookingId],
  };
  const mails = emailsOf(await planEffect(db, both, depsAt(addMinutes(now, 11))));
  assert.equal(mails.length, 2);
  const toLate = mails.find((m) => m.html.includes(linkOf(lateComer)));
  assert.ok(toLate, "one e-mail per listed booking");
  assert.ok(!toLate.html.includes(cancelLine), "booked after the change: the normal deadline applies");

  must(
    await cancelBookingsByPro(
      db,
      { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: occ.id, bookingIds: [reg2.bookingId] },
      addMinutes(now, 12),
    ),
  );
  assert.equal(emailsOf(await planEffect(db, both, depsAt(addMinutes(now, 12)))).length, 1, "a cancelled booking is skipped");
});

dbTest("attendee_moved: before and after; a séance of another pro is never read", async ({ db, pro }) => {

  const moved = must(

      db,
      { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, bookingId: reg.bookingId, targetOccurrenceId: to.id, force: false },
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Add `expireCheckoutSession` to `src/lib/stripe.ts`**

Edit `src/lib/stripe.ts`: replace the import line

```ts
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
```

with

```ts
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { logSafeMessage } from "@/lib/notify-core";
```

(`notify-core.ts` does not import `stripe.ts`, so there is no cycle; Stripe's « No such checkout.session » message carries the session id, which `logSafeMessage` masks.) Then replace the end of the file

```ts
  const checkout = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create(sessionParams);
  return checkout.url!;
}
```

with

```ts
  const checkout = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create(sessionParams);
  return checkout.url!;
}

/**
 * Best effort: closes a still-open Checkout session whose seat ended (the
 * pending purchase of a cancelled or released booking), so the client cannot
 * pay for a seat that no longer exists. "mock" when Stripe is off; "not_open"
 * when the session is already complete or expired (retrieved first, so Stripe
 * is never asked to expire what is not open); "expired" after sessions.expire;
 * "failed" on any error. Never throws.
 */
export async function expireCheckoutSession(
  checkoutSessionId: string,
): Promise<"expired" | "not_open" | "mock" | "failed"> {
  if (!stripe) return "mock";
  try {
    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(checkoutSessionId);
    if (session.status !== "open") return "not_open";
    await stripe.checkout.sessions.expire(checkoutSessionId);
    return "expired";
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[stripe] expire failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
    return "failed";
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Create `src/lib/notify-core.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Post-commit effects (spec § 10, § 13.6). The engine returns descriptors that
 * carry ids only; `planEffect` turns one of them into what must be done, from a
 * FRESH read of the database (names, dates, places and balances as they are
 * now). No server-only, no env: the public URL, the personal-link key and the
 * clock come in as `deps`, so the DB tests run this module as it is.
 * src/server/notify.ts executes the plans (sendEmail, syncOccurrence,
 * expireCheckoutSession), best effort, after the response.
 */
import { and, asc, eq, inArray, type SQL, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { expiryLabel, formatWhen, formatWhenShort } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { walletBalance } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import type { Effect } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { googleCalendarUrl, outlookCalendarUrl } from "@/lib/calendar-links";
import { clientCancelDeadline } from "@/lib/cancellation";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, customer, event, occurrence, professional, ticket, ticketMovement, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { attendeeMovedEmail } from "@/lib/emails/attendee-moved";
import { bookingCancelledEmail } from "@/lib/emails/booking-cancelled";
import { bookingConfirmedEmail } from "@/lib/emails/booking-confirmed";
import { occurrenceCancelledEmail } from "@/lib/emails/occurrence-cancelled";
import { occurrenceChangedEmail } from "@/lib/emails/occurrence-changed";
import { ticketsOfferedEmail } from "@/lib/emails/tickets-offered";
import { personalLinkUrl } from "@/lib/guest-link";
import { COVERAGE_LABELS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export type OutgoingEmail = { to: string; subject: string; html: string };
export type NotifyDeps = { appUrl: string; guestKey: Buffer; now: Date };
export type EffectPlan =
  | { kind: "emails"; emails: OutgoingEmail[] }
  | { kind: "google"; occurrenceId: string }
  | { kind: "stripe"; purchaseId: string; checkoutSessionId: string }
  | { kind: "deferred"; type: Effect["type"] };

/* ───────────────────────────── Dedupe ───────────────────────────── */

/** JSON of the effect with its keys sorted and its id lists sorted: two effects with the same content share a key. */
function effectKey(effect: Effect): string {
  const sorted: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(effect).sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0))) {
    sorted[key] = Array.isArray(value) ? [...value].sort() : value;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(sorted);
}

/**
 * Drops exact duplicates (the id lists compared sorted), keeps the first-seen
 * order, and puts the google.sync_occurrence effects last: a sync then reads
 * the state every e-mail of the same action was planned from.
 */
export function dedupeEffects(effects: readonly Effect[]): Effect[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const others: Effect[] = [];
  const syncs: Effect[] = [];
  for (const effect of effects) {
    const key = effectKey(effect);
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    (effect.type === "google.sync_occurrence" ? syncs : others).push(effect);
  }
  return [...others, ...syncs];
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Log safety ───────────────────────────── */

/**
 * One line of an error for the server log: no e-mail address, no personal-link
 * token, no Checkout session id; whitespace collapsed; 200 characters at most.
 */
export function logSafeMessage(err: unknown): string {
  const raw = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown error";
  return raw
    .replace(/[^\s@<>"'()]+@[^\s@<>"'()]+/g, "[email]")
    .replace(/\/api\/c\/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/g, "/api/c/[token]")
    .replace(/\bcs_(?:test|live)_[A-Za-z0-9]+/g, "[session]")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 200);
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Reads ───────────────────────────── */

const bookingFacts = {
  bookingId: booking.id,
  professionalId: booking.professionalId,
  occurrenceId: booking.occurrenceId,
  status: booking.status,
  coverage: booking.coverage,
  createdAt: booking.createdAt,
  confirmedAt: booking.confirmedAt,
  holdExpiresAt: booking.holdExpiresAt,
  endedAt: booking.endedAt,
  movedAt: booking.movedAt,
  cancelReason: booking.cancelReason,
  customerId: customer.id,
  customerName: customer.name,
  customerEmail: customer.email,
  linkVersion: customer.linkVersion,
  businessName: professional.businessName,
  tz: professional.timezone,
  title: sql<string>`coalesce(${event.title}, ${ticketType.name})`,
  location: sql<string | null>`coalesce(${occurrence.locationOverride}, ${event.location})`,
  startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
  endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
  changedAt: occurrence.changedAt,
  cancelHours: sql<number>`coalesce(${event.cancelDeadlineHours}, ${ticketType.rdvCancelDeadlineHours}, ${professional.cancelDeadlineHours})`.mapWith(
    Number,
  ),
};

/** Bookings with their customer, pro and occurrence, oldest first. Every join follows the booking's own professional_id. */
async function readBookings(db: Db, where: SQL | undefined) {
  return db
    .select(bookingFacts)
    .from(booking)
    .innerJoin(customer, eq(customer.id, booking.customerId))
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, booking.professionalId))
    .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
    .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
    .where(where)
    .orderBy(asc(booking.createdAt), asc(booking.id));
}

type BookingFacts = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof readBookings>>[number];

/** The title and times of one occurrence of this pro, or null. */
async function readOccurrence(db: Db, professionalId: string, occurrenceId: string) {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      title: sql<string>`coalesce(${event.title}, ${ticketType.name})`,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
    })
    .from(occurrence)
    .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
    .where(and(eq(occurrence.id, occurrenceId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId)));
  return row ?? null;
}

/** The bookings (of this pro) that got a ticket back when they ended. */
async function returnedBookingIds(db: Db, professionalId: string, bookingIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (bookingIds.length === 0) return new Set();
  const rows = await db
    .selectDistinct({ bookingId: ticketMovement.bookingId })
    .from(ticketMovement)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticketMovement.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(ticketMovement.kind, "return"),
        inArray(ticketMovement.bookingId, [...bookingIds]),
      ),
    );
  return new Set(rows.flatMap((r) => (r.bookingId === null ? [] : [r.bookingId])));
}

/** The type name of the ticket booked on this booking (coverage ticket), or null. */
async function bookedTicketTypeName(db: Db, b: BookingFacts): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ name: ticketType.name })
    .from(ticket)
    .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, ticket.ticketTypeId))
    .where(and(eq(ticket.bookingId, b.bookingId), eq(ticket.professionalId, b.professionalId)));
  return row?.name ?? null;
}

/** What the client still holds right now, one line per type, by type name. */
async function ticketsLeftOf(db: Db, b: BookingFacts, now: Date) {
  const balance = await walletBalance(db, { professionalId: b.professionalId, customerId: b.customerId }, now);
  if (balance.length === 0) return [];
  const types = await db
    .select({ id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name })
    .from(ticketType)
    .where(and(eq(ticketType.professionalId, b.professionalId), inArray(ticketType.id, balance.map((r) => r.ticketTypeId))));
  const names = new Map(types.map((t) => [t.id, t.name]));
  return balance
    .map((r) => ({
      typeName: names.get(r.ticketTypeId) ?? "Ticket",
      count: r.usable,
      expiryText: expiryLabel(r.nextExpiry, b.tz, now),
    }))
    .sort((x, y) => x.typeName.localeCompare(y.typeName, "fr"));
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Small helpers ───────────────────────────── */

const emails = (list: OutgoingEmail[]): EffectPlan => ({ kind: "emails", emails: list });
const noEmail = (): EffectPlan => emails([]);

/** A hold the client never paid: confirmed_at is null and the hold ended before the booking did. */
function isLapsedHold(b: Pick<BookingFacts, "confirmedAt" | "holdExpiresAt" | "endedAt">): boolean {
  return b.confirmedAt === null && b.holdExpiresAt !== null && b.endedAt !== null && b.holdExpiresAt.getTime() < b.endedAt.getTime();
}

function linkOf(b: Pick<BookingFacts, "customerId" | "linkVersion">, deps: NotifyDeps): string {
  return personalLinkUrl(deps.appUrl, { id: b.customerId, linkVersion: b.linkVersion }, deps.guestKey);
}

function whenOf(b: Pick<BookingFacts, "startsAt" | "endsAt" | "tz">): string {
  return formatWhen(b.startsAt, b.endsAt, b.tz);
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Plans ───────────────────────────── */

async function planBookingConfirmed(db: Db, bookingId: string, deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  const [b] = await readBookings(db, eq(booking.id, bookingId));
  if (!b || b.status !== "confirmed") return noEmail();
  const ticketTypeName = b.coverage === "ticket" ? await bookedTicketTypeName(db, b) : null;
  const ticketsLeft = await ticketsLeftOf(db, b, deps.now);
  const deadline = clientCancelDeadline(b.startsAt, b.cancelHours);
  const cancelText =
    deadline.getTime() > deps.now.getTime()
      ? `Vous pouvez annuler en ligne jusqu'au ${formatWhenShort(deadline, b.tz)}.`
      : `L'annulation en ligne n'est plus possible : contactez ${b.businessName}.`;
  const calendarInput = {
    title: b.title,
    description: `Avec ${b.businessName}`,
    location: b.location,
    startAt: b.startsAt,
    endAt: b.endsAt,
  };
  const mail = bookingConfirmedEmail({
    customerName: b.customerName,
    businessName: b.businessName,
    title: b.title,
    whenLabel: whenOf(b),
    location: b.location,
    coverageLabel: COVERAGE_LABELS[b.coverage],
    ticketTypeName,
    ticketsLeft,
    cancelText,
    personalLinkUrl: linkOf(b, deps),
    calendar: {
      googleUrl: googleCalendarUrl(calendarInput),
      outlookUrl: outlookCalendarUrl(calendarInput),
      icsUrl: `${deps.appUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/api/bookings/${b.bookingId}/calendar.ics`,
    },
  });
  return emails([{ to: b.customerEmail, ...mail }]);
}

function cancelledMail(b: BookingFacts, by: "pro" | "client", ticketReturned: boolean, deps: NotifyDeps): OutgoingEmail {
  const mail = bookingCancelledEmail({
    customerName: b.customerName,
    businessName: b.businessName,
    title: b.title,
    whenLabel: whenOf(b),
    by,
    ticketReturned,
    reason: b.cancelReason,
    personalLinkUrl: linkOf(b, deps),
  });
  return { to: b.customerEmail, ...mail };
}

async function planBookingCancelled(db: Db, bookingId: string, by: "pro" | "client", deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  const [b] = await readBookings(db, eq(booking.id, bookingId));
  if (!b || b.status !== "cancelled" || isLapsedHold(b)) return noEmail();
  const returned = await returnedBookingIds(db, b.professionalId, [b.bookingId]);
  return emails([cancelledMail(b, by, returned.has(b.bookingId), deps)]);
}

async function planOccurrenceCancelled(
  db: Db,
  occurrenceId: string,
  bookingIds: readonly string[],
  deps: NotifyDeps,
): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  if (bookingIds.length === 0) return noEmail();
  const rows = await readBookings(db, and(eq(booking.occurrenceId, occurrenceId), inArray(booking.id, [...bookingIds])));
  const heard = rows.filter((b) => b.status === "cancelled" && !isLapsedHold(b));
  if (heard.length === 0) return noEmail();
  const returned = await returnedBookingIds(
    db,
    heard[0].professionalId,
    heard.map((b) => b.bookingId),
  );
  return emails(
    heard.map((b) => {
      const mail = occurrenceCancelledEmail({
        customerName: b.customerName,
        businessName: b.businessName,
        title: b.title,
        whenLabel: whenOf(b),
        ticketReturned: returned.has(b.bookingId),
        personalLinkUrl: linkOf(b, deps),
      });
      return { to: b.customerEmail, ...mail };
    }),
  );
}

async function planOccurrenceChanged(
  db: Db,
  occurrenceId: string,
  bookingIds: readonly string[],
  deps: NotifyDeps,
): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  if (bookingIds.length === 0) return noEmail();
  const rows = await readBookings(db, and(eq(booking.occurrenceId, occurrenceId), inArray(booking.id, [...bookingIds])));
  const nowMs = deps.now.getTime();
  const active = rows.filter(
    (b) =>
      b.status === "confirmed" || (b.status === "pending" && b.holdExpiresAt !== null && b.holdExpiresAt.getTime() > nowMs),
  );
  return emails(
    active.map((b) => {
      const mail = occurrenceChangedEmail({
        customerName: b.customerName,
        businessName: b.businessName,
        title: b.title,
        whenLabel: whenOf(b),
        location: b.location,
        canCancelUntilStart: (b.changedAt !== null && b.changedAt.getTime() > b.createdAt.getTime()) || b.movedAt !== null,
        personalLinkUrl: linkOf(b, deps),
      });
      return { to: b.customerEmail, ...mail };
    }),
  );
}

async function planAttendeeMoved(db: Db, bookingId: string, fromOccurrenceId: string, deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  const [b] = await readBookings(db, eq(booking.id, bookingId));
  if (!b || b.status !== "confirmed") return noEmail();
  const from = await readOccurrence(db, b.professionalId, fromOccurrenceId);
  if (!from) return noEmail();
  const mail = attendeeMovedEmail({
    customerName: b.customerName,
    businessName: b.businessName,
    fromTitle: from.title,
    fromWhenLabel: formatWhen(from.startsAt, from.endsAt, b.tz),
    toTitle: b.title,
    toWhenLabel: whenOf(b),
    toLocation: b.location,
    personalLinkUrl: linkOf(b, deps),
  });
  return emails([{ to: b.customerEmail, ...mail }]);
}

async function planTicketsOffered(db: Db, customerId: string, actionId: string, deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  const [c] = await db
    .select({
      id: customer.id,
      professionalId: customer.professionalId,
      name: customer.name,
      email: customer.email,
      linkVersion: customer.linkVersion,
      businessName: professional.businessName,
      tz: professional.timezone,
    })
    .from(customer)
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, customer.professionalId))
    .where(eq(customer.id, customerId));
  if (!c) return noEmail();
  const offered = await db
    .select({ typeName: ticketType.name, expiresAt: ticket.expiresAt })
    .from(ticketMovement)
    .innerJoin(ticket, eq(ticket.id, ticketMovement.ticketId))
    .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, ticket.ticketTypeId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticketMovement.professionalId, c.professionalId),
        eq(ticketMovement.customerId, c.id),
        eq(ticketMovement.actionId, actionId),
        eq(ticketMovement.kind, "offer"),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(ticketMovement.seq));
  if (offered.length === 0) return noEmail();
  const mail = ticketsOfferedEmail({
    customerName: c.name,
    businessName: c.businessName,
    typeName: offered[0].typeName,
    count: offered.length,
    expiryText: expiryLabel(offered[0].expiresAt, c.tz, deps.now),
    personalLinkUrl: personalLinkUrl(deps.appUrl, { id: c.id, linkVersion: c.linkVersion }, deps.guestKey),
  });
  return emails([{ to: c.email, ...mail }]);
}

/**
 * What to do for one effect, from a fresh DB read. A row that no longer exists
 * (or no longer in the state the e-mail talks about) plans no e-mail. The
 * switch is exhaustive: a new Effect type fails the build here.
 */
export async function planEffect(db: Db, effect: Effect, deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  switch (effect.type) {
    case "email.booking_confirmed":
      return planBookingConfirmed(db, effect.bookingId, deps);
    case "email.booking_cancelled":
      return planBookingCancelled(db, effect.bookingId, effect.by, deps);
    case "email.occurrence_cancelled":
      return planOccurrenceCancelled(db, effect.occurrenceId, effect.bookingIds, deps);
    case "email.occurrence_changed":
      return planOccurrenceChanged(db, effect.occurrenceId, effect.bookingIds, deps);
    case "email.attendee_moved":
      return planAttendeeMoved(db, effect.bookingId, effect.fromOccurrenceId, deps);
    case "email.tickets_offered":
      return planTicketsOffered(db, effect.customerId, effect.actionId, deps);
    case "email.pro_new_booking":
    case "email.pro_booking_cancelled":
    case "email.purchase_receipt":
    case "email.late_payment":
      return { kind: "deferred", type: effect.type };
    case "google.sync_occurrence":
      return { kind: "google", occurrenceId: effect.occurrenceId };
    case "stripe.expire_session":
      return { kind: "stripe", purchaseId: effect.purchaseId, checkoutSessionId: effect.checkoutSessionId };
    default: {
      const unreachable: never = effect;
      throw new Error(`Unhandled effect: ${JSON.stringify(unreachable)}`);
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Development aid for the mock e-mail log (src/lib/email.ts): the absolute
 * links of a mail body, so a developer can follow the personal link or the
 * calendar file link without a mailbox. Pure; decodes the entities
 * escapeHtml put in an href.
 */

function decodeEntities(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/&lt;/g, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&");
}

/** Absolute http(s) hrefs of the `<a>` tags of `html`, first-seen order, no repeat, at most `max`. */
export function mockLinks(html: string, max = 5): string[] {
  const links: string[] = [];
  const anchor = /<a\s[^>]*?href="([^"]+)"/gi;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while (links.length < max && (match = anchor.exec(html)) !== null) {
    const href = decodeEntities(match[1]);
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(href) && !links.includes(href)) links.push(href);
  }
  return links;
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import type { Effect } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { syncOccurrence } from "@/lib/calendar-sync";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { sendEmail } from "@/lib/email";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { dedupeEffects, logSafeMessage, planEffect, type EffectPlan, type OutgoingEmail } from "@/lib/notify-core";
import { expireCheckoutSession } from "@/lib/stripe";
import { guestKey } from "@/server/guest-key";

/** Resend allows 2 requests per second by default: with Resend on, e-mails leave one by one, at least 550 ms apart. */
const MAIL_GAP_MS = 550;

/** When the next e-mail may leave (epoch ms). Module level, so it paces every run of this server instance. */
let nextMailAt = 0;

async function sendPaced(mail: OutgoingEmail): Promise<void> {
  if (env.RESEND_ENABLED) {
    // The slot is reserved before the first await: two runs in flight queue behind each other.
    const slot = Math.max(Date.now(), nextMailAt);
    nextMailAt = slot + MAIL_GAP_MS;
    const wait = slot - Date.now();
    if (wait > 0) await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, wait));
  }
  await sendEmail(mail);
}

async function execute(plan: EffectPlan): Promise<void> {
  switch (plan.kind) {
    case "emails":
      for (const mail of plan.emails) await sendPaced(mail);
      return;
    case "google":
      await syncOccurrence(plan.occurrenceId);
      return;
    case "stripe":
      await expireCheckoutSession(plan.checkoutSessionId);
      return;
    case "deferred":
      console.warn(`[notify] ${plan.type} is wired in P4`);
      return;
    default: {
      const unreachable: never = plan;
      throw new Error(`Unhandled plan: ${JSON.stringify(unreachable)}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Runs effects after commit, best effort: duplicates dropped and Google syncs
 * last (dedupeEffects), each effect planned from a fresh read (planEffect),
 * then executed (sendEmail, syncOccurrence, expireCheckoutSession). Never
 * throws: a failing effect logs « [notify] <type> failed: <message> » (no
 * address, token or session id) and the next one still runs. E-mails leave
 * one by one, paced under Resend's 2 requests per second (sendPaced), so a
 * séance of 100 registrants takes about a minute. Scheduled with after() by
 * runProAction, so it never delays the response.
 */
export async function runEffects(effects: readonly Effect[]): Promise<void> {
  try {
    for (const effect of dedupeEffects(effects)) {
      try {
        const plan = await planEffect(db, effect, { appUrl: env.APP_URL, guestKey: guestKey(), now: new Date() });
        await execute(plan);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`[notify] ${effect.type} failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[notify] run failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Copy guard (decision 38): no em dash (U+2014) and no en dash (U+2013) in the
 * files that carry P3 UI text, e-mails or Google bodies, comments included.
 * Run from the repository root: the paths are relative to process.cwd().
 */
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";

const DASH = new RegExp("[" + String.fromCharCode(0x2013, 0x2014) + "]");

/** Always scanned: these directories exist from P3 on. */
const DIRECTORIES = ["src/components/dashboard", "src/app/dashboard", "src/lib/back-office", "src/lib/emails"];

/** Scanned when they exist (a directory is walked); later tasks create most of them. */
const OPTIONAL = [
  "src/lib/pro-messages.ts",
  "src/lib/zod-fr.ts",
  "src/lib/google-event.ts",
  "src/lib/email-layout.ts",
  "src/components/public/customer-space.tsx",
  "src/app/[slug]/espace",
  "src/app/admin/activity/page.tsx",
  "src/components/admin/app-health-card.tsx",
  "src/components/admin/delete-user-card.tsx",
];

/** 1-based numbers of the lines holding a dash (LF or CRLF). */
function dashLines(text: string): number[] {
  const lines: number[] = [];
  text.split(/\r?\n/).forEach((line, index) => {
    if (DASH.test(line)) lines.push(index + 1);
  });
  return lines;
}

/** Every .ts / .tsx file under `path` (a file or a directory), tests excluded. */
function collect(path: string, out: string[]): void {
  const full = join(process.cwd(), path);
  if (!existsSync(full)) return;
  if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) {
    for (const name of readdirSync(full).sort()) collect(`${path}/${name}`, out);
    return;
  }
  if (/\.tsx?$/.test(path) && !/\.test\.ts$/.test(path)) out.push(path);
}

test("dashLines reports the lines holding an em dash or an en dash, LF or CRLF", () => {
  const em = String.fromCharCode(0x2014);
  const en = String.fromCharCode(0x2013);
  assert.deepEqual(dashLines(["a", `b ${em} b`, "c", `d ${en} d`].join("\n")), [2, 4]);
  assert.deepEqual(dashLines(["a", `b ${em}`].join("\r\n")), [2]);
  assert.deepEqual(dashLines("a - b : c"), []);
});

test("the directories that must be scanned exist and hold source files", () => {
  for (const dir of DIRECTORIES) {
    const files: string[] = [];
    collect(dir, files);
    assert.ok(files.length > 0, `${dir} holds no .ts or .tsx file`);
  }
});

test("no em dash or en dash in the P3 UI, e-mail and copy files (comments included)", () => {
  const files: string[] = [];
  for (const path of [...DIRECTORIES, ...OPTIONAL]) collect(path, files);
  const hits: string[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    for (const line of dashLines(readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), file), "utf8"))) hits.push(`${file}:${line}`);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(hits, [], `dashes found:\n${hits.join("\n")}`);
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `src/lib/back-office/result.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Shapes shared by every pro Server Action (spec § 13, contract § 4.5). Pure:
 * the cores in src/lib/back-office/*-actions.ts return a CoreResult (with the
 * effects to run after commit); src/server/pro-context.ts runs the effects and
 * hands the browser an ActionResult without them.
 */
import type { Effect, EngineFail } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { proErrorMessage, type ProErrorContext } from "@/lib/pro-messages";
import type { EngineErrorCode } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

/** Who acts: always built by requireProContext() from the session, never from input. */
export type ProCtx = {
  professionalId: string;
  actorUserId: string;
  timezone: string;
  currency: string;
  slug: string;
};

export type ActionFail = { ok: false; error: string; code?: EngineErrorCode };
export type ActionResult<T extends object = object> = ({ ok: true } & T) | ActionFail;
export type CoreResult<T extends object = object> = ({ ok: true; effects: Effect[] } & T) | ActionFail;

export const UNEXPECTED_ERROR = "Une erreur inattendue est survenue. Réessayez dans un instant.";

/** { ok: false, error } with the code only when one is given. */
export function actionFail(error: string, code?: EngineErrorCode): ActionFail {
  return code === undefined ? { ok: false, error } : { ok: false, error, code };
}

/** An engine failure as a pro-facing failure: the French message of the context, the code kept for the UI. */
export function fromEngine(res: EngineFail, context: ProErrorContext): ActionFail {
  return { ok: false, error: proErrorMessage(res, context), code: res.code };
}

/** The same result without its effects (what reaches the browser). A failure is returned as it is. */
export function withoutEffects<T extends object>(res: CoreResult<T>): ActionResult<T> {
  if (!res.ok) return res;
  const copy: Record<string, unknown> = { ...res };
  delete copy.effects;
  return copy as unknown as ActionResult<T>;
}

/**
 * The revalidatePath calls of a successful action: the dashboard layout always;
 * with `publicPage`, every public page under /[slug] too. The path is a route
 * pattern, not a URL (Next 16 docs, revalidatePath): a dynamic segment takes
 * its pattern plus a type, whereas ("/altinha-paris", "layout") would tag a
 * path no page carries.
 */
export function revalidationTargets(publicPage: boolean): { path: string; type: "layout" }[] {
  return publicPage
    ? [
        { path: "/dashboard", type: "layout" },
        { path: "/[slug]", type: "layout" },
      ]
    : [{ path: "/dashboard", type: "layout" }];
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect, unstable_rethrow } from "next/navigation";
import { after } from "next/server";

import {
  UNEXPECTED_ERROR,
  actionFail,
  revalidationTargets,
  withoutEffects,
  type ActionResult,
  type CoreResult,
  type ProCtx,
} from "@/lib/back-office/result";
import { logSafeMessage } from "@/lib/notify-core";
import { getCurrentProfessional, getSession } from "@/lib/session";
import { runEffects } from "@/server/notify";

/**
 * The acting pro, from the session only (never from input). No session sends
 * to /sign-in, no professional profile to /onboarding. While an admin
 * impersonates, the session is the pro's own: actions stay allowed and
 * `actorUserId` is the impersonated user (decision 10).
 */
export async function requireProContext(): Promise<ProCtx> {
  const session = await getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/sign-in");
  const pro = await getCurrentProfessional();
  if (!pro) redirect("/onboarding");
  return {
    professionalId: pro.id,
    actorUserId: session.user.id,
    timezone: pro.timezone,
    currency: pro.currency,
    slug: pro.slug,
  };
}

/**
 * The wrapper of every pro write. Builds the context, takes ONE `now`, runs the
 * core. A thrown error that is not a Next.js control-flow error is logged
 * (« [pro] <name> failed: <message> », without address or token) and answered
 * with UNEXPECTED_ERROR. On success: the dashboard layout is revalidated (and
 * every public page under /[slug] when `publicPage`), the effects run after the response
 * (after()), and the browser receives the result without them. A failure is
 * returned as it is: no revalidation, no effect.
 */
export async function runProAction<T extends object>(
  name: string,
  fn: (ctx: ProCtx, now: Date) => Promise<CoreResult<T>>,
  opts: { publicPage?: boolean } = {},
): Promise<ActionResult<T>> {
  const ctx = await requireProContext();
  let res: CoreResult<T>;
  try {
    res = await fn(ctx, new Date());
  } catch (err) {
    unstable_rethrow(err);
    console.error(`[pro] ${name} failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
    return actionFail(UNEXPECTED_ERROR);
  }
  if (!res.ok) return res;
  for (const target of revalidationTargets(opts.publicPage === true)) revalidatePath(target.path, target.type);
  const effects = res.effects;
  if (effects.length > 0) after(() => runEffects(effects));
  return withoutEffects(res);
}

/** The wrapper of read cores (search, previews): context and error handling like runProAction, no revalidation, no effect. */
export async function runProQuery<T extends object>(
  name: string,
  fn: (ctx: ProCtx, now: Date) => Promise<ActionResult<T>>,
): Promise<ActionResult<T>> {
  const ctx = await requireProContext();
  try {
    return await fn(ctx, new Date());
  } catch (err) {
    unstable_rethrow(err);
    console.error(`[pro] ${name} failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
    return actionFail(UNEXPECTED_ERROR);
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `src/lib/timezones.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Time zones a pro can pick (spec § 7). Pure. `Europe/Geneva` is not an IANA
 * zone (Intl throws on it): Europe/Zurich replaces it. The server accepts any
 * zone Intl accepts, so a pro already on another valid zone keeps it.
 */

/** Zones offered in forms. */
export const PRO_TIMEZONES: readonly { id: string; label: string }[] = [
  { id: "Europe/Paris", label: "Paris (France)" },
  { id: "Europe/Brussels", label: "Bruxelles (Belgique)" },
  { id: "Europe/Zurich", label: "Genève, Zurich (Suisse)" },
  { id: "Europe/London", label: "Londres (Royaume-Uni)" },
  { id: "America/Montreal", label: "Montréal (Canada)" },
  { id: "America/New_York", label: "New York (États-Unis)" },
];

/** True when Intl accepts the zone (the constructor throws a RangeError otherwise); false for "". */
export function isValidTimeZone(tz: string): boolean {
  if (tz === "") return false;
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fr-FR", { timeZone: tz });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** The list label, else the zone id itself. */
export function timeZoneLabel(tz: string): string {
  return PRO_TIMEZONES.find((zone) => zone.id === tz)?.label ?? tz;
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Create `src/lib/back-office/settings-actions.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Settings and profile cores (spec §§ 7, 13.4). Every core takes
 * `(db, ctx, input, now)`, validates with parseFr, then writes in ONE batch;
 * none imports server-only, next/*, env or the session, so the DB tests call
 * them directly. src/server/pro.ts wraps them with runProAction.
 */
import { eq, sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import { z } from "zod";

import { actionFail, fromEngine, type CoreResult, type ProCtx } from "@/lib/back-office/result";
import { failOf } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { G, lockRows, tryAtomic, ts, type Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { professional } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { isValidTimeZone } from "@/lib/timezones";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

/* ───────────────────────────── Profile ───────────────────────────── */

export const profileInputSchema = z.object({
  businessName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(BOUNDS.name),
  headline: z.string().trim().max(160).nullable(),
  bio: z.string().trim().max(BOUNDS.description).nullable(),
  timezone: z.string().refine(isValidTimeZone, { message: "Fuseau horaire inconnu." }),
});
export type ProfileInput = z.input<typeof profileInputSchema>;

/**
 * SQL: a non-archived event exists, or a future scheduled occurrence (séance
 * or RDV) does. The time zone cannot change while this holds (spec § 7): the
 * stored instants and the recurrence dates were computed in the old zone.
 */
function timezoneLockedSql(professionalId: string, now: Date): SQL {
  return sql`(exists (select 1 from event where professional_id = ${professionalId} and archived_at is null)
    or exists (select 1 from occurrence where professional_id = ${professionalId} and status = 'scheduled' and starts_at > ${ts(now)}))`;
}

/** True when the pro's time zone cannot change (see timezoneLockedSql). Only this pro's rows are read. */
export async function isTimezoneLocked(db: Db, professionalId: string, now: Date): Promise<boolean> {
  const res = await db.execute<{ locked: boolean }>(sql`select ${timezoneLockedSql(professionalId, now)} as locked`);
  return res.rows[0]?.locked === true;
}

/**
 * Profile in ONE batch: lock the professional row (rank 1 of the lock order,
 * the same row createEvent locks), G(the pro exists, 'not_found'),
 * G(zone unchanged OR not locked, 'timezone_locked'), UPDATE. The whole update
 * is refused when the zone is locked, not only the zone. Context "profile".
 */
export async function updateProfileCore(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, input: ProfileInput, now: Date): Promise<CoreResult> {
  const parsed = parseFr(profileInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const p = parsed.data;
  const pid = ctx.professionalId;

  const res = await tryAtomic(db, async () => () => [
    lockRows(db, "professional", [pid]),
    G(db, sql`exists (select 1 from professional where id = ${pid})`, "not_found"),
    G(
      db,
      sql`(select timezone from professional where id = ${pid}) = ${p.timezone}
        or (not exists (select 1 from event where professional_id = ${pid} and archived_at is null)
          and not exists (select 1 from occurrence where professional_id = ${pid} and status = 'scheduled' and starts_at > ${ts(now)}))`,
      "timezone_locked",
    ),
    db
      .update(professional)
      .set({
        businessName: p.businessName,
        headline: p.headline || null,
        bio: p.bio || null,
        timezone: p.timezone,
        updatedAt: now,
      })
      .where(eq(professional.id, pid)),
  ]);
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(failOf(res), "profile");
  return { ok: true, effects: [] };
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { updateProfile } from "@/server/pro";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { PRO_TIMEZONES, timeZoneLabel } from "@/lib/timezones";

export interface ProfileValues {
  businessName: string;
  headline: string | null;
  bio: string | null;
  timezone: string;
}

const LOCKED_HELP = "Fuseau verrouillé : vous avez des séances planifiées.";

export function ProfileForm({ values, timezoneLocked }: { values: ProfileValues; timezoneLocked: boolean }) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // a zone the pro already has but the list does not offer stays selectable
  const zones = PRO_TIMEZONES.some((zone) => zone.id === values.timezone)
    ? PRO_TIMEZONES
    : [...PRO_TIMEZONES, { id: values.timezone, label: timeZoneLabel(values.timezone) }];

  function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const f = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    setSaved(false);
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await updateProfile({
        businessName: String(f.get("businessName") ?? ""),
        headline: String(f.get("headline") ?? ""),
        bio: String(f.get("bio") ?? ""),
        // a disabled select is not part of the form data: keep the current zone
        timezone: String(f.get("timezone") ?? values.timezone),
      });
      if (res.ok) setSaved(true);
      else setError(res.error);
    });
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="businessName">Nom de l&apos;activité</Label>
        <Input id="businessName" name="businessName" defaultValue={values.businessName} required />
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="headline">Accroche</Label>
        <Input id="headline" name="headline" defaultValue={values.headline ?? ""} />
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="bio">Présentation</Label>
        <Textarea id="bio" name="bio" rows={4} defaultValue={values.bio ?? ""} />
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="timezone">Fuseau horaire</Label>
        <Select
          id="timezone"
          name="timezone"
          defaultValue={values.timezone}
          disabled={timezoneLocked}
          aria-describedby={timezoneLocked ? "timezone-help" : undefined}
        >
          {zones.map((zone) => (
            <option key={zone.id} value={zone.id}>
              {zone.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </Select>
        {timezoneLocked && (
          <p id="timezone-help" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {LOCKED_HELP}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
          {pending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
          Enregistrer
        </Button>
        {saved && (
          <span role="status" className="text-sm text-success">
            Enregistré
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```ts
import {
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

import { NOTICE_PRESETS, NOTICE_TOO_LONG, noticeExceedsHorizon, noticeLabel } from "./notice";

test("the presets are the twelve of Q13, in order", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(NOTICE_PRESETS, [
    { minutes: 0, label: "Jusqu'au début" },
    { minutes: 15, label: "15 min avant" },
    { minutes: 30, label: "30 min avant" },
    { minutes: 60, label: "1 h avant" },
    { minutes: 120, label: "2 h avant" },
    { minutes: 180, label: "3 h avant" },
    { minutes: 360, label: "6 h avant" },
    { minutes: 720, label: "12 h avant" },
    { minutes: 1440, label: "24 h avant" },
    { minutes: 2880, label: "2 jours avant" },
    { minutes: 4320, label: "3 jours avant" },
    { minutes: 10080, label: "7 jours avant" },
  ]);
});

test("every preset is inside the notice bounds and the list is strictly increasing", () => {
  let last = -1;
  for (const preset of NOTICE_PRESETS) {
    assert.ok(preset.minutes >= BOUNDS.minNoticeMinutes.min && preset.minutes <= BOUNDS.minNoticeMinutes.max, preset.label);
    assert.ok(preset.minutes > last, preset.label);
    last = preset.minutes;
  }
});

test("noticeLabel returns the preset label, else a readable duration", () => {
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(0), "Jusqu'au début");
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(1440), "24 h avant");
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(45), "45 min avant");
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(1), "1 min avant");
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(90), "1 h 30 min avant");
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(61), "1 h 1 min avant");
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(240), "4 h avant");
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(1500), "25 h avant");
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(7200), "5 jours avant");
  assert.equal(noticeLabel(14400), "10 jours avant");
});

test("noticeExceedsHorizon is true only when the notice is longer than the horizon", () => {
  assert.equal(noticeExceedsHorizon(1440, 1), false);
  assert.equal(noticeExceedsHorizon(1441, 1), true);
  assert.equal(noticeExceedsHorizon(10080, 7), false);
  assert.equal(noticeExceedsHorizon(10080, 6), true);
  assert.equal(noticeExceedsHorizon(0, 1), false);
});

test("NOTICE_TOO_LONG is the exact French sentence", () => {
  assert.equal(NOTICE_TOO_LONG, "Le délai minimum dépasse l'horizon de réservation : réduisez-le ou allongez l'horizon.");
});
```

```ts
/**
 * « Au plus tard … avant le début » (spec § 2.13, Q13): the presets a pro picks
 * for the minimum notice, the label of any value, and the horizon check.
 */

/** Q13 presets. */
export const NOTICE_PRESETS: readonly { minutes: number; label: string }[] = [
  { minutes: 0, label: "Jusqu'au début" },
  { minutes: 15, label: "15 min avant" },
  { minutes: 30, label: "30 min avant" },
  { minutes: 60, label: "1 h avant" },
  { minutes: 120, label: "2 h avant" },
  { minutes: 180, label: "3 h avant" },
  { minutes: 360, label: "6 h avant" },
  { minutes: 720, label: "12 h avant" },
  { minutes: 1440, label: "24 h avant" },
  { minutes: 2880, label: "2 jours avant" },
  { minutes: 4320, label: "3 jours avant" },
  { minutes: 10080, label: "7 jours avant" },
];

/** The preset label, else « 45 min avant », « 1 h 30 min avant », « 5 jours avant ». */
export function noticeLabel(minutes: number): string {
  const n = Math.max(0, Math.round(minutes));
  const preset = NOTICE_PRESETS.find((p) => p.minutes === n);
  if (preset) return preset.label;
  if (n < 60) return `${n} min avant`;
  if (n % 1440 === 0) {
    const days = n / 1440;
    return `${days} ${days > 1 ? "jours" : "jour"} avant`;
  }
  const hours = Math.floor(n / 60);
  const rest = n % 60;
  return rest === 0 ? `${hours} h avant` : `${hours} h ${rest} min avant`;
}

/** True when the notice is longer than the horizon: online booking would never open (OUT L106). */
export function noticeExceedsHorizon(minNoticeMinutes: number, bookingHorizonDays: number): boolean {
  return minNoticeMinutes > bookingHorizonDays * 1440;
}

export const NOTICE_TOO_LONG =
  "Le délai minimum dépasse l'horizon de réservation : réduisez-le ou allongez l'horizon.";
```

```ts
/**
 * Every destructive confirmation of the back-office (Q35): title, body and
 * confirm label, as pure functions of the counts the UI got from a preview.
 * The dialog (ConfirmDialog) only displays them. No dash anywhere.
 */
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";

export type ConfirmCopy = { title: string; body: string; confirm: string };

/** « Annuler cette séance ? » / « Annuler ce rendez-vous ? ». A rendez-vous ignores `past`. */
export function cancelOccurrenceCopy(a: { kind: "seance" | "rdv"; registrants: number; past: boolean }): ConfirmCopy {
  if (a.kind === "rdv") {
    return {
      title: "Annuler ce rendez-vous ?",
      body: "Le client est prévenu par email et son ticket lui est rendu.",
      confirm: "Annuler le rendez-vous",
    };
  }
  const lead =
    a.registrants <= 0
      ? "Personne n'est inscrit : la séance est simplement annulée."
      : a.registrants === 1
        ? "La personne inscrite est désinscrite, son ticket est rendu et elle est prévenue par email."
        : `Les ${a.registrants} inscrits sont désinscrits, leurs tickets sont rendus et ils sont prévenus par email.`;
  return {
    title: "Annuler cette séance ?",
    body: a.past ? `${lead} Cette séance est déjà passée : les tickets sont rendus quand même.` : lead,
    confirm: "Annuler la séance",
  };
}

export function restoreOccurrenceCopy(): ConfirmCopy {
  return {
    title: "Rétablir cette séance ?",
    body: "La séance redevient réservable ; les anciens inscrits ne sont pas réinscrits.",
    confirm: "Rétablir",
  };
}

export function unenrollCopy(a: { names: readonly string[]; ticketCount: number; pendingCount: number }): ConfirmCopy {
  const one = a.names.length === 1;
  const title = one ? `Désinscrire ${a.names[0]} ?` : `Désinscrire ${a.names.length} inscrits ?`;
  const lead =
    a.ticketCount > 0
      ? one
        ? "Le ticket est rendu au client, qui est prévenu par email."
        : "Les tickets sont rendus aux clients, qui sont prévenus par email."
      : one
        ? "Le client est prévenu par email."
        : "Les clients sont prévenus par email.";
  return {
    title,
    body: a.pendingCount > 0 ? `${lead} Le paiement en cours est annulé.` : lead,
    confirm: "Désinscrire",
  };
}

export function closeTicketsCopy(a: { count: number; reasonLabel: string }): ConfirmCopy {
  return {
    title: `Clore ${plural(a.count, "ticket", "tickets")} ?`,
    body: `Motif : ${a.reasonLabel}. Les tickets restent visibles, barrés, dans son portefeuille. Rien n'est remboursé automatiquement.`,
    confirm: "Clore",
  };
}

export function retireTicketsCopy(a: { count: number }): ConfirmCopy {
  return {
    title: `Retirer ${plural(a.count, "ticket offert", "tickets offerts")} ?`,
    body: "Ils restent visibles, barrés, dans son portefeuille.",
    confirm: "Retirer",
  };
}

export function revokeLinksCopy(a: { name: string }): ConfirmCopy {
  return {
    title: `Déconnecter les liens de ${a.name} ?`,
    body: "Les liens personnels déjà envoyés par email cessent de fonctionner. Les prochains emails contiendront un nouveau lien.",
    confirm: "Déconnecter les liens",
  };
}

export function archiveTypeCopy(a: { name: string }): ConfirmCopy {
  return {
    title: `Archiver « ${a.name} » ?`,
    body: "Ses offres ne sont plus en vente et il disparaît de votre page. Les tickets déjà détenus restent dans les portefeuilles, signalés en rouge, et les événements gardent leur lien. Vous pourrez le désarchiver.",
    confirm: "Archiver",
  };
}

/** A type that already served is archived, not deleted; an unused one is deleted and leaves the events that accepted it. */
export function deleteTypeCopy(a: { name: string; used: boolean; acceptedBy: readonly string[] }): ConfirmCopy {
  const title = `Supprimer « ${a.name} » ?`;
  if (a.used) {
    return {
      title,
      body: "Ce type a déjà servi (tickets, achats ou rendez-vous) : il sera archivé, pas supprimé.",
      confirm: "Archiver",
    };
  }
  const base = "Ses offres, ses horaires et ses questions sont supprimés.";
  return {
    title,
    body: a.acceptedBy.length > 0 ? `${base} Il est retiré de ces événements : ${a.acceptedBy.join(", ")}.` : base,
    confirm: "Supprimer",
  };
}

export function deleteOfferCopy(a: { label: string; sold: boolean }): ConfirmCopy {
  return {
    title: `Supprimer l'offre « ${a.label} » ?`,
    body: a.sold
      ? "Elle a déjà été achetée : elle sera archivée, pas supprimée. Les tickets achetés ne changent pas."
      : "Elle disparaît de votre page.",
    confirm: "Supprimer",
  };
}

export function deleteEventCopy(a: {
  title: string;
  fromLabel: string | null;
  deleteWhole: boolean;
  deletedSeances: number;
  cancelledSeances: number;
  registrants: number;
  ticketsReturned: number;
}): ConfirmCopy {
  const title =
    a.deleteWhole || a.fromLabel === null
      ? `Supprimer « ${a.title} » ?`
      : `Supprimer « ${a.title} » à partir du ${a.fromLabel} ?`;
  if (a.deleteWhole) {
    return {
      title,
      body: "L'événement n'a jamais eu d'inscription : il est supprimé définitivement.",
      confirm: "Supprimer",
    };
  }
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (a.deletedSeances > 0) {
    parts.push(
      `${plural(a.deletedSeances, "séance sans inscrit sera supprimée", "séances sans inscrit seront supprimées")}.`,
    );
  }
  if (a.cancelledSeances > 0) {
    parts.push(
      `${plural(a.cancelledSeances, "séance avec inscrits sera annulée", "séances avec inscrits seront annulées")} : ` +
        `${plural(a.registrants, "inscrit prévenu", "inscrits prévenus")} par email, ` +
        `${plural(a.ticketsReturned, "ticket rendu", "tickets rendus")}.`,
    );
  }
  if (parts.length === 0) parts.push("Aucune séance à venir n'est concernée.");
  return { title, body: parts.join(" "), confirm: "Supprimer" };
}

export function deleteTimeOffCopy(): ConfirmCopy {
  return {
    title: "Supprimer cette indisponibilité ?",
    body: "Les séances vides qu'elle masquait réapparaissent sur votre planning et votre page.",
    confirm: "Supprimer",
  };
}

/** The dialog opened when a time off overlaps séances that have registrants. A single séance gets the singular wording. */
export function timeOffConflictCopy(a: { count: number }): {
  title: string;
  intro: string;
  cancelLabel: string;
  keepLabel: string;
  keepNote: string;
  rdvNote: string;
} {
  const single = a.count === 1;
  return {
    title: "Des séances ont des inscrits",
    intro: `Cette indisponibilité chevauche ${plural(a.count, "séance", "séances")} avec des inscrits :`,
    cancelLabel: single
      ? "Annuler cette séance (tickets rendus, clients prévenus)"
      : `Annuler ces ${plural(a.count, "séance", "séances")} (tickets rendus, clients prévenus)`,
    keepLabel: single ? "La garder" : "Les garder",
    keepNote: single
      ? "Gardée, elle reste pour ses inscrits mais n'est plus réservable en ligne. Vous pouvez encore y inscrire quelqu'un."
      : "Gardées, elles restent pour leurs inscrits mais ne sont plus réservables en ligne. Vous pouvez encore y inscrire quelqu'un.",
    rdvNote: "Un rendez-vous compte avec ses marges avant et après.",
  };
}
```

```tsx
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

/**
 * Label above the control, helper and error below (never a placeholder as a
 * label). The child must carry `id={htmlFor}`; it can point at the helper and
 * the error with aria-describedby (`${htmlFor}-help`, `${htmlFor}-error`).
 */
export function FormField({
  label,
  htmlFor,
  help,
  error,
  optional,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  htmlFor: string;
  help?: string;
  error?: string | null;
  optional?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <Label htmlFor={htmlFor}>
        {label}
        {optional && <span className="font-normal text-muted-foreground">{" (facultatif)"}</span>}
      </Label>
      {children}
      {help && (
        <p id={`${htmlFor}-help`} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {help}
        </p>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p id={`${htmlFor}-error`} role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { ALERT_LABELS, type AlertTone } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const TONE_CLASS: Record<AlertTone, string> = {
  red: "bg-destructive",
  orange: "bg-amber-500",
};

/**
 * The 🔴 / 🟠 mark of the spec as a semantic dot: the meaning is in the
 * accessible name and the tooltip, never in the colour alone. No emoji in the UI.
 */
export function StatusMark({ tone, label, className }: { tone: AlertTone; label?: string; className?: string }) {
  const text = label ?? ALERT_LABELS[tone];
  return (
    <span
      role="img"
      aria-label={text}
      title={text}
      className={cn("inline-block size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full", TONE_CLASS[tone], className)}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
      ))}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** An on / off setting: a real switch for assistive technologies, its label and description clickable text. */
export function Switch({
  id,
  checked,
  onCheckedChange,
  label,
  description,
  disabled,
}: {
  id: string;
  checked: boolean;
  onCheckedChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
      <button
        type="button"
        role="switch"
        id={id}
        aria-checked={checked}
        aria-describedby={description ? `${id}-description` : undefined}
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => onCheckedChange(!checked)}
        className={cn(
          "mt-0.5 flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
          checked ? "bg-primary" : "bg-muted-foreground/50",
        )}
      >
        <span
          className={cn("size-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform", checked && "translate-x-4")}
        />
      </button>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <label htmlFor={id} className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium leading-5">
          {label}
        </label>
        {description && (
          <p id={`${id}-description`} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {description}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Create `src/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import type { ConfirmCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";

const noop = () => {};

/**
 * The confirmation of a destructive action: the consequences (from
 * confirm-copy.ts, fed by a preview), optional extra fields as `children`
 * (a reason, a choice), the action error, « Retour » and the confirm button.
 * While the action runs, both buttons are disabled and the dialog cannot be
 * closed. « Retour » has the focus: a stray Enter never destroys anything.
 */
export function ConfirmDialog({
  open,
  copy,
  tone = "destructive",
  pending,
  error,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
  children,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  copy: ConfirmCopy;
  tone?: "destructive" | "primary";
  pending: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={pending ? noop : onClose} title={copy.title}>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{copy.body}</p>
      {children && <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">{children}</div>}
      {error && (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <FormError message={error} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
        <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={pending} autoFocus>
          Retour
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant={tone === "destructive" ? "destructive" : "primary"}
          onClick={onConfirm}
          disabled={pending}
        >
          {pending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
          {copy.confirm}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

Create `src/app/dashboard/error.tsx`. Next 16.2 hands an error boundary `unstable_retry` (re-fetches and re-renders the segment; `reset` only clears the error state, see `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md`):

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";

const TEXT = "Cette page n'a pas pu se charger. Réessayez dans un instant.";

export default function DashboardError({
  error,
  unstable_retry,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  unstable_retry: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error(error);
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <Card role="alert" className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col items-center gap-3 px-6 py-12 text-center">
      <TriangleAlert className="size-8 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
      <h2 className="text-base font-semibold">Une erreur est survenue</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{TEXT}</p>
      <Button onClick={() => unstable_retry()}>Réessayer</Button>
    </Card>
  );
}
```
