```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

import { deleteOffer, setAvailabilityRules, setTicketTypeArchived, setTypeQuestions } from "@/lib/booking/catalog";
import { fulfillPurchase, startPurchase } from "@/lib/booking/fulfillment";
import { editSeriesFrom } from "@/lib/booking/series";
import { convertTickets } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import type { RecurrenceRuleInput } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { addDaysMs, createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, type TestPro } from "@/test/db";
import { dayIn, giveTickets, makeCustomer, makeEvent, makeOffer, makeType } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { rowRdv } from "@/test/rows";

import { getTicketTypeDetail, listActiveTypeOptions, listTicketTypes, type TicketTypeSummary } from "./catalog-reads";

function must<T extends { ok: boolean }>(res: T, what: string): asserts res is Extract<T, { ok: true }> {
  assert.ok(res.ok, `${what}: ${JSON.stringify(res)}`);
}

function found<T>(value: T | undefined | null, what: string): T {
  assert.ok(value, what);
  return value;
}

const weekly = (startDate: string, weekdays: number[], startMinute = 600): RecurrenceRuleInput => ({
  startDate,
  startMinute,
  freq: "weekly",
  interval: 1,
  weekdays,
  monthlyBy: null,
  monthWeek: null,
  endMode: "never",
  untilDate: null,
  occurrenceCount: null,
});

/** A paid purchase through the engine: startPurchase + fulfillPurchase. */
async function buy(db: Db, pro: TestPro, offerId: string, customerId: string): Promise<void> {
  const started = await startPurchase(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, offerId, customerId });
  must(started, "startPurchase");
  const done = await fulfillPurchase(db, started.purchaseId, {
    sessionId: `cs_test_${nanoid()}`,
    paymentIntentId: `pi_test_${nanoid()}`,
    livemode: false,
  });
  must(done, "fulfillPurchase");
}

async function summaryOf(db: Db, pro: TestPro, ticketTypeId: string, now = new Date()): Promise<TicketTypeSummary> {
  const { active, archived } = await listTicketTypes(db, pro.proId, now);
  return found([...active, ...archived].find((t) => t.id === ticketTypeId), `type ${ticketTypeId} in the list`);
}

dbTest("catalog reads: types come back by position, then createdAt, then id, split active / archived", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const a = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "A" });
  const b = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "B" });
  const c = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "C" });
  const d = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "D" });
  await db.execute(sql`update ticket_type set position = 5, created_at = '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z' where id = ${a}`);
  await db.execute(sql`update ticket_type set position = 5, created_at = '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' where id = ${b}`);
  await db.execute(sql`update ticket_type set position = 1 where id = ${c}`);
  await db.execute(sql`update ticket_type set position = 9 where id = ${d}`);
  must(await setTicketTypeArchived(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, ticketTypeId: d, archived: true }), "archive D");

  const res = await listTicketTypes(db, pro.proId, new Date());
  assert.deepEqual(res.active.map((t) => t.id), [c, b, a], "position, then createdAt");
  assert.deepEqual(res.archived.map((t) => [t.id, t.archived]), [[d, true]]);
  assert.deepEqual(res.active.map((t) => t.name), ["C", "B", "A"]);

  // Same position and same createdAt: the id decides (concurrent creates share a position).
  await db.execute(sql`update ticket_type set position = 5, created_at = '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' where id in (${a}, ${b})`);
  const tied = await listTicketTypes(db, pro.proId, new Date());
  assert.deepEqual(tied.active.map((t) => t.id), [c, ...[a, b].sort()]);
});

dbTest("catalog reads: offers carry label, validity text and paid sales; archived offers leave the list", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const unit = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, { quantity: 1, priceCents: 2500 });
  const book = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, { quantity: 4, priceCents: 8500, validityCount: 3, validityUnit: "month" });
  const custom = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, {
    quantity: 10,
    priceCents: 19000,
    label: "Gros carnet",
    validityCount: 30,
    validityUnit: "day",
    isActive: false,
  });
  const gone = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, { quantity: 2, priceCents: 4000 });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);

  await buy(db, pro, book, customerId);
  await buy(db, pro, book, customerId);
  // A pending purchase is not a sale.
  must(await startPurchase(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, offerId: unit, customerId }), "pending purchase");
  // A bought offer is archived by « Supprimer »: it leaves the list.
  await buy(db, pro, gone, customerId);
  const deleted = await deleteOffer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, offerId: gone });
  must(deleted, "deleteOffer");
  assert.equal(deleted.outcome, "archived");

  const type = await summaryOf(db, pro, typeId);
  assert.deepEqual(
    type.offers.map((o) => [o.id, o.label, o.customLabel, o.quantity, o.priceCents, o.validityCount, o.validityUnit, o.validityText, o.isActive, o.archived, o.sold]),
    [
      [unit, "À l'unité", null, 1, 2500, null, null, null, true, false, 0],
      [book, "Carnet de 4", null, 4, 8500, 3, "month", "3 mois", true, false, 2],
      [custom, "Gros carnet", "Gros carnet", 10, 19000, 30, "day", "30 jours", false, false, 0],
    ],
  );
  assert.ok(type.offers.every((o) => o.ticketTypeId === typeId));

  const detail = found(await getTicketTypeDetail(db, pro.proId, typeId, new Date()), "detail");
  assert.deepEqual(detail.offers.map((o) => o.id), [unit, book, custom]);
  assert.deepEqual(detail.archivedOffers.map((o) => [o.id, o.archived, o.sold]), [[gone, true, 1]]);
});

dbTest("catalog reads: acceptedBy lists one entry per series root (its latest segment), by title", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const otherType = await makeType(db, pro);
  const debutants = (await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha débutants", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] })).eventId;
  const equipe = (await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Équipe compétition", isPrivate: true, ticketTypeIds: [typeId] })).eventId;
  const atelier = (await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Atelier technique", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] })).eventId;
  await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Roda libre", ticketTypeIds: [otherType] });
  const archivedEvent = (await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Ancien cours", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] })).eventId;
  await db.execute(sql`update event set archived_at = now() where id = ${archivedEvent}`);

  // A weekly series started two weeks ago and edited « à partir de demain »: two segments, one entry.
  const seriesStart = (
    await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha intermédiaires", ticketTypeIds: [typeId], rule: weekly(dayIn(pro, -14, now), [1, 3, 5]) }, addDaysMs(now, -14))
  ).eventId;
  const split = await editSeriesFrom(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: pro.proId,
      actorUserId: pro.userId,
      eventId: seriesStart,
      seenVersion: 1,
      fromDate: dayIn(pro, 1, now),
      rule: weekly(dayIn(pro, 1, now), [1, 3]),
      durationMin: 60,
      orphans: "keep",
    },
    now,
  );
  must(split, "split the series");
  assert.notEqual(split.eventId, seriesStart, "a new segment was created");

  const type = await summaryOf(db, pro, typeId, now);
  assert.deepEqual(type.acceptedBy, [
    { eventId: debutants, title: "Altinha débutants", isPrivate: false },
    { eventId: split.eventId, title: "Altinha intermédiaires", isPrivate: false },
    { eventId: atelier, title: "Atelier technique", isPrivate: false },
    { eventId: equipe, title: "Équipe compétition", isPrivate: true },
  ]);
  const detail = found(await getTicketTypeDetail(db, pro.proId, typeId, now), "detail");
  assert.deepEqual(detail.acceptedBy, type.acceptedBy);
  assert.deepEqual((await summaryOf(db, pro, otherType, now)).acceptedBy.map((e) => e.title), ["Roda libre"]);
});

dbTest("catalog reads: usableTickets counts available, unexpired tickets of every customer", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro);

dbTest("catalog reads: orphan follows the wallet classes (linked event, private, rdv_free)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const plain = await makeType(db, pro);
  const linked = await makeType(db, pro);
  const privateLinked = await makeType(db, pro);
  const rdvPaid = await makeType(db, pro, { rdvEnabled: true, rdvDurationMin: 60 });
  const rdvFree = await makeType(db, pro, { rdvEnabled: true, rdvFree: true, rdvDurationMin: 15 });
  const archived = await makeType(db, pro);
  must(await setTicketTypeArchived(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, ticketTypeId: archived, archived: true }), "archive");

  const before = await listTicketTypes(db, pro.proId, new Date());
  const orphanIn = (ids: TicketTypeSummary[], id: string) => found(ids.find((t) => t.id === id), id).orphan;
  assert.equal(orphanIn(before.active, plain), true, "unlinked non-RDV type");
  assert.equal(orphanIn(before.active, rdvPaid), false, "a paid RDV type needs no event");
  assert.equal(orphanIn(before.active, rdvFree), true, "an unlinked rdv_free type is an orphan (Q16)");
  assert.equal(orphanIn(before.archived, archived), false, "an archived type is red, not orange");

  await makeEvent(db, pro, { ticketTypeIds: [plain, linked] });
  await makeEvent(db, pro, { ticketTypeIds: [privateLinked], isPrivate: true });
  const after = await listTicketTypes(db, pro.proId, new Date());
  assert.equal(orphanIn(after.active, plain), false, "linked to a future tickets-mode event");
  assert.equal(orphanIn(after.active, linked), false);
  assert.equal(orphanIn(after.active, privateLinked), false, "a private event counts");
  assert.equal(orphanIn(after.active, rdvFree), true);
});

  // A cancelled RDV holds no seat (invariants I1 and I5b) but still names the type, which blocks the DELETE.
  await rowRdv(db, pro, typeId, { status: "cancelled", seatsTaken: 0 }, now);
  assert.deepEqual(await usageOf(typeId), { tickets: 1, purchases: 1, rdvs: 1 });

  // A ticket converted away from « source » still names it in its movement: deleting « source » would fail.
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, source, 1);
  must(
    await convertTickets(db, {
      professionalId: pro.proId,
      actorUserId: pro.userId,
      customerId,
      selection: { ticketTypeId: source, quantity: 1 },
      toTicketTypeId: target,
    }),
    "convert",
  );
  assert.deepEqual(await usageOf(source), { tickets: 1, purchases: 0, rdvs: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(await usageOf(target), { tickets: 1, purchases: 0, rdvs: 0 });
});
```

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/back-office/catalog-reads.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Catalog reads (spec § 13.1 « Tickets »): the ticket types of a pro with
 * their offers, the events that accept them and their usage, plus the RDV
 * libre details of one type. Pure functions of (db, professionalId, now): no
 * server-only and no next/*, so the DB tests call them directly;
 * src/server/catalog-queries.ts wraps them. Every statement filters
 * professional_id.
 */
import { and, asc, eq, gt, isNotNull, isNull, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { loadQuestions, type QuestionRow } from "@/lib/booking/answers";
import { loadTypeFacts } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import type { BookingWindow } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { availabilityRule, professional, ticket, ticketOffer, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import type { AvailabilityRuleInput, WindowOverrides } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { offerLabel, validityLabel, type ValidityUnit } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { classifyTypes } from "@/lib/wallet-rules";

export type OfferView = {
  id: string;
  ticketTypeId: string;
  /** offerLabel(): the typed label, « À l'unité » or « Carnet de N » */
  label: string;
  customLabel: string | null;
  quantity: number;
  priceCents: number;
  validityCount: number | null;
  validityUnit: ValidityUnit | null;
  /** validityLabel(): « 3 mois », « 30 jours », null without validity */
  validityText: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
  archived: boolean;
  /** paid purchases of this offer */
  sold: number;
};

export type AcceptedBy = { eventId: string; title: string; isPrivate: boolean };

export type TicketTypeSummary = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  color: string;
  position: number;
  archived: boolean;
  rdvEnabled: boolean;
  rdvFree: boolean;
  rdvDurationMin: number | null;
  /** non-archived offers (en vente or not), by position, createdAt, id */
  offers: OfferView[];
  /** non-archived events linking the type, one per series root (its latest segment), by title */
  acceptedBy: AcceptedBy[];
  /** available and valid at now, every customer */
  usableTickets: number;
  /** classifyTypes(loadTypeFacts()) === "orphan" */
  orphan: boolean;
};

export type TicketTypeDetail = TicketTypeSummary & {
  rdvBufferBeforeMin: number;
  rdvBufferAfterMin: number;
  rdvOverrides: WindowOverrides;
  questions: QuestionRow[];
  ownHours: AvailabilityRuleInput[];
  globalHours: AvailabilityRuleInput[];
  archivedOffers: OfferView[];
  /** any > 0 means « Supprimer » archives instead of deleting */
  usage: { tickets: number; purchases: number; rdvs: number };
  proWindow: BookingWindow;
};

export type TypeOption = { id: string; name: string; color: string; rdvFree: boolean };

type TypeRow = typeof ticketType.$inferSelect;

/** Pushes `value` on the list of `key`. */
function pushTo<K, V>(map: Map<K, V[]>, key: K, value: V): void {
  const list = map.get(key);
  if (list) list.push(value);
  else map.set(key, [value]);
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Offers ───────────────────────────── */

async function readOffers(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  scope: { ticketTypeId?: string; archived: boolean },
): Promise<OfferView[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: ticketOffer.id,
      ticketTypeId: ticketOffer.ticketTypeId,
      label: ticketOffer.label,
      quantity: ticketOffer.quantity,
      priceCents: ticketOffer.priceCents,
      validityCount: ticketOffer.validityCount,
      validityUnit: ticketOffer.validityUnit,
      isActive: ticketOffer.isActive,
      archivedAt: ticketOffer.archivedAt,
      // single-table select: an interpolated column renders unqualified, so the outer id is written out
      sold: sql<number>`(select count(*)::int from ticket_purchase p
        where p.offer_id = ticket_offer.id and p.professional_id = ticket_offer.professional_id and p.status = 'paid')`,
    })
    .from(ticketOffer)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticketOffer.professionalId, professionalId),
        scope.ticketTypeId === undefined ? undefined : eq(ticketOffer.ticketTypeId, scope.ticketTypeId),
        scope.archived ? isNotNull(ticketOffer.archivedAt) : isNull(ticketOffer.archivedAt),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(ticketOffer.position), asc(ticketOffer.createdAt), asc(ticketOffer.id));
  return rows.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    ticketTypeId: r.ticketTypeId,
    label: offerLabel(r),
    customLabel: r.label,
    quantity: r.quantity,
    priceCents: r.priceCents,
    validityCount: r.validityCount,
    validityUnit: r.validityUnit,
    validityText: validityLabel(r.validityCount, r.validityUnit),
    isActive: r.isActive,
    archived: r.archivedAt !== null,
    sold: Number(r.sold),
  }));
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Accepted by ───────────────────────────── */

/**
 * The latest non-archived segment of each series (same series root), kept when
 * it links the type. An older segment of the same series that still links the
 * type is not listed: a series is one entry, addressed by its current segment.
 */
async function readAcceptedBy(db: Db, professionalId: string, ticketTypeId?: string): Promise<Map<string, AcceptedBy[]>> {
  const res = await db.execute<{ ticket_type_id: string; event_id: string; title: string; is_private: boolean }>(sql`
    select l.ticket_type_id, e.id as event_id, e.title, e.is_private
    from (
      select distinct on (coalesce(series_root_id, id)) id, title, is_private
      from event
      where professional_id = ${professionalId} and archived_at is null
      order by coalesce(series_root_id, id), start_date desc, created_at desc, id desc
    ) e
    join event_ticket_type l on l.event_id = e.id
    where l.professional_id = ${professionalId}${ticketTypeId === undefined ? sql`` : sql` and l.ticket_type_id = ${ticketTypeId}`}`);
  const byType = new Map<string, AcceptedBy[]>();
  for (const r of res.rows) {
    pushTo(byType, r.ticket_type_id, { eventId: r.event_id, title: r.title, isPrivate: r.is_private });
  }
  for (const list of byType.values()) {
    list.sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "fr") || (a.eventId < b.eventId ? -1 : a.eventId > b.eventId ? 1 : 0));
  }
  return byType;
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Usable tickets, usage ───────────────────────────── */

async function readUsableCounts(db: Db, professionalId: string, now: Date, ticketTypeId?: string): Promise<Map<string, number>> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ ticketTypeId: ticket.ticketTypeId, n: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
    .from(ticket)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticket.professionalId, professionalId),
        ticketTypeId === undefined ? undefined : eq(ticket.ticketTypeId, ticketTypeId),
        eq(ticket.status, "available"),
        or(isNull(ticket.expiresAt), gt(ticket.expiresAt, now)),
      ),
    )
    .groupBy(ticket.ticketTypeId);
  return new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.ticketTypeId, Number(r.n)]));
}

/**
 * What blocks a DELETE of the type (the NO ACTION foreign keys): tickets (also
 * those converted away: their movement still names the type), purchases and RDV
 * occurrences.
 */
async function readUsage(db: Db, professionalId: string, ticketTypeId: string): Promise<TicketTypeDetail["usage"]> {
  const res = await db.execute<{ tickets: number; purchases: number; rdvs: number }>(sql`select
    (select count(*)::int from (
      select id from ticket where ticket_type_id = ${ticketTypeId} and professional_id = ${professionalId}
      union
      select ticket_id from ticket_movement
      where professional_id = ${professionalId} and (ticket_type_id = ${ticketTypeId} or from_ticket_type_id = ${ticketTypeId})
    ) u) as tickets,
    (select count(*)::int from ticket_purchase where ticket_type_id = ${ticketTypeId} and professional_id = ${professionalId}) as purchases,
    (select count(*)::int from occurrence where ticket_type_id = ${ticketTypeId} and professional_id = ${professionalId}) as rdvs`);
  const row = res.rows[0];
  return { tickets: Number(row?.tickets ?? 0), purchases: Number(row?.purchases ?? 0), rdvs: Number(row?.rdvs ?? 0) };
}

/** The pro's three booking settings (null when the professional row is gone). */
export async function readProWindow(db: Db, professionalId: string): Promise<BookingWindow | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      bookingHorizonDays: professional.bookingHorizonDays,
      minNoticeMinutes: professional.minNoticeMinutes,
      cancelDeadlineHours: professional.cancelDeadlineHours,
    })
    .from(professional)
    .where(eq(professional.id, professionalId));
  return row ?? null;
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Types ───────────────────────────── */

async function loadSummaries(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  now: Date,
  onlyTypeId?: string,
): Promise<{ row: TypeRow; summary: TicketTypeSummary }[]> {
  const [rows, offers, accepted, usable, facts] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select()
      .from(ticketType)
      .where(and(eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId), onlyTypeId === undefined ? undefined : eq(ticketType.id, onlyTypeId)))
      .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.createdAt), asc(ticketType.id)),
    readOffers(db, professionalId, { ticketTypeId: onlyTypeId, archived: false }),
    readAcceptedBy(db, professionalId, onlyTypeId),
    readUsableCounts(db, professionalId, now, onlyTypeId),
    loadTypeFacts(db, professionalId, now),
  ]);
  const classes = classifyTypes(facts);
  const offersByType = new Map<string, OfferView[]>();
  for (const o of offers) pushTo(offersByType, o.ticketTypeId, o);
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    row,
    summary: {
      id: row.id,
      name: row.name,
      description: row.description,
      color: row.color,
      position: row.position,
      archived: row.archivedAt !== null,
      rdvEnabled: row.rdvEnabled,
      rdvFree: row.rdvFree,
      rdvDurationMin: row.rdvDurationMin,
      offers: offersByType.get(row.id) ?? [],
      acceptedBy: accepted.get(row.id) ?? [],
      usableTickets: usable.get(row.id) ?? 0,
      orphan: classes.get(row.id) === "orphan",
    },
  }));
}

/** Every type of the pro split active / archived, by position, createdAt, id (id tie-break: concurrent creates share a position). */
export async function listTicketTypes(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<{ active: TicketTypeSummary[]; archived: TicketTypeSummary[] }> {
  const all = (await loadSummaries(db, professionalId, now)).map((x) => x.summary);
  return { active: all.filter((t) => !t.archived), archived: all.filter((t) => t.archived) };
}

/** One type of the pro (null for another pro's or an unknown id). */
export async function getTicketTypeDetail(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  ticketTypeId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<TicketTypeDetail | null> {
  const [one] = await loadSummaries(db, professionalId, now, ticketTypeId);
  if (!one) return null;
  const [questions, rules, archivedOffers, usage, proWindow] = await Promise.all([
    loadQuestions(db, { ticketTypeId }),
    db
      .select({
        ticketTypeId: availabilityRule.ticketTypeId,
        dayOfWeek: availabilityRule.dayOfWeek,
        startMinute: availabilityRule.startMinute,
        endMinute: availabilityRule.endMinute,
      })
      .from(availabilityRule)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(availabilityRule.professionalId, professionalId),
          or(isNull(availabilityRule.ticketTypeId), eq(availabilityRule.ticketTypeId, ticketTypeId)),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(asc(availabilityRule.dayOfWeek), asc(availabilityRule.startMinute), asc(availabilityRule.id)),
    readOffers(db, professionalId, { ticketTypeId, archived: true }),
    readUsage(db, professionalId, ticketTypeId),
    readProWindow(db, professionalId),
  ]);
  if (!proWindow) return null;
  const hours = (own: boolean): AvailabilityRuleInput[] =>
    rules
      .filter((r) => (r.ticketTypeId !== null) === own)
      .map((r) => ({ dayOfWeek: r.dayOfWeek, startMinute: r.startMinute, endMinute: r.endMinute }));
  const { row, summary } = one;
  return {
    ...summary,
    rdvBufferBeforeMin: row.rdvBufferBeforeMin,
    rdvBufferAfterMin: row.rdvBufferAfterMin,
    rdvOverrides: {
      bookingHorizonDays: row.rdvBookingHorizonDays,
      minNoticeMinutes: row.rdvMinNoticeMinutes,
      cancelDeadlineHours: row.rdvCancelDeadlineHours,
    },
    questions,
    ownHours: hours(true),
    globalHours: hours(false),
    archivedOffers,
    usage,
    proWindow,
  };
}

/** Non-archived types, by position, createdAt, id. */
export async function listActiveTypeOptions(db: Db, professionalId: string): Promise<TypeOption[]> {
  return db
    .select({ id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name, color: ticketType.color, rdvFree: ticketType.rdvFree })
    .from(ticketType)
    .where(and(eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId), isNull(ticketType.archivedAt)))
    .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.createdAt), asc(ticketType.id));
}
```

```ts
import { NOTICE_TOO_LONG } from "./notice";
import type { CoreResult } from "./result";

const NOT_FOUND = "Type ou offre introuvable.";

/** A success with no effect (every catalog core returns `effects: []`). */
function must<T extends { ok: boolean }>(res: T, what: string): asserts res is Extract<T, { ok: true }> {
  assert.ok(res.ok, `${what}: ${JSON.stringify(res)}`);
  assert.deepEqual((res as { effects?: unknown }).effects, [], `${what}: effects`);
}

/** A refusal with exactly this French message. */
function refused<T extends object>(res: CoreResult<T>, error: string, what: string): void {
  assert.equal(res.ok, false, `${what}: expected a refusal, got ${JSON.stringify(res)}`);
  if (!res.ok) assert.equal(res.error, error, what);
}

async function detailOf(db: Db, pro: TestPro, ticketTypeId: string, now = new Date()) {
  const detail = await getTicketTypeDetail(db, pro.proId, ticketTypeId, now);
  assert.ok(detail, `type ${ticketTypeId} exists`);
  return detail;
}

/** A paid purchase through the engine. */
async function buy(db: Db, pro: TestPro, offerId: string, customerId: string): Promise<void> {
  const started = await startPurchase(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, offerId, customerId });
  if (!started.ok) assert.fail(`startPurchase: ${JSON.stringify(started)}`);
  // fulfillPurchase returns its own effects (receipt e-mail): not a catalog core, so no `must` here.
  const done = await fulfillPurchase(db, started.purchaseId, {
    sessionId: `cs_test_${nanoid()}`,
    paymentIntentId: `pi_test_${nanoid()}`,
    livemode: false,
  });
  assert.ok(done.ok, `fulfillPurchase: ${JSON.stringify(done)}`);
}

dbTest("createTicketTypeCore validates in French, checks the effective window, then creates", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();

  refused(await createTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { name: "   " }, now), "Nom : ce champ est obligatoire.", "empty name");
  refused(await createTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { name: "Test", color: "bleu" }, now), "Couleur : format invalide.", "bad colour");
  refused(
    await createTicketTypeCore(
      db,
      ctx,
      {
        name: "Cours",
        rdvEnabled: true,
        rdvDurationMin: 60,
        rdvOverrides: { bookingHorizonDays: 1, minNoticeMinutes: 10080, cancelDeadlineHours: null },
      },
      now,
    ),
    NOTICE_TOO_LONG,
    "notice longer than the horizon",
  );
  assert.deepEqual(await listActiveTypeOptions(db, pro.proId), [], "the refusals created nothing");

  const created = await createTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { name: "  Cours collectif  ", description: "Un cours", color: "#16a34a" }, now);
  must(created, "create");
  const detail = await detailOf(db, pro, created.ticketTypeId, now);
  assert.deepEqual(
    [detail.name, detail.description, detail.color, detail.rdvEnabled, detail.rdvFree, detail.archived],
    ["Cours collectif", "Un cours", "#16a34a", false, false, false],
  );

  const call = await createTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { name: "Appel découverte", rdvEnabled: true, rdvFree: true, rdvDurationMin: 15 }, now);
  must(call, "create a free RDV type");
  const free = await detailOf(db, pro, call.ticketTypeId, now);
  assert.deepEqual([free.rdvEnabled, free.rdvFree, free.rdvDurationMin], [true, true, 15]);
  assert.deepEqual((await listActiveTypeOptions(db, pro.proId)).map((o) => o.name), ["Cours collectif", "Appel découverte"]);
});

dbTest("updateTicketTypeCore merges a patch over the stored type", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, {
    name: "Cours particulier",
    description: "Avant",
    color: "#0ea5e9",
    rdvEnabled: true,
    rdvDurationMin: 60,
    rdvBufferBeforeMin: 5,
    rdvBufferAfterMin: 10,
    rdvOverrides: { bookingHorizonDays: 30, minNoticeMinutes: 120, cancelDeadlineHours: null },
  });

  // A name-only patch keeps every RDV field.
  must(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, patch: { name: "Cours privé" } }, now), "rename");
  let d = await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now);
  assert.deepEqual(
    [d.name, d.description, d.color, d.rdvEnabled, d.rdvDurationMin, d.rdvBufferBeforeMin, d.rdvBufferAfterMin, d.rdvOverrides],
    ["Cours privé", "Avant", "#0ea5e9", true, 60, 5, 10, { bookingHorizonDays: 30, minNoticeMinutes: 120, cancelDeadlineHours: null }],
  );

  // null clears the description; the other fields stay.
  must(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, patch: { description: null, rdvBufferAfterMin: 15 } }, now), "patch");
  d = await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now);
  assert.deepEqual([d.description, d.rdvBufferAfterMin, d.name, d.rdvBufferBeforeMin], [null, 15, "Cours privé", 5]);

  // An explicit undefined changes nothing.
  must(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, patch: { name: undefined, color: "#16a34a" } }, now), "undefined");
  d = await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now);
  assert.deepEqual([d.name, d.color], ["Cours privé", "#16a34a"]);

  refused(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, patch: { name: "" } }, now), "Nom : ce champ est obligatoire.", "empty name");
  refused(
    await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, patch: { rdvDurationMin: null } }, now),
    "Indiquez la durée du rendez-vous.",
    "RDV without duration",
  );
  refused(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: "inconnu", patch: { name: "X" } }, now), NOT_FOUND, "unknown id");
  assert.equal((await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, patch: null as never }, now)).ok, false, "a patch that is not an object");
  d = await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now);
  assert.deepEqual([d.name, d.rdvDurationMin], ["Cours privé", 60], "the refusals changed nothing");
});

dbTest("rdvFree cannot be switched on while an offer is en vente or a usable ticket exists, and a free type's offers stay off", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const makeFree = (ticketTypeId: string, at = now) =>
    updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId, patch: { rdvFree: true } }, at);

  const withOffer = await makeType(db, pro, { rdvEnabled: true, rdvDurationMin: 15 });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, withOffer);
  refused(await makeFree(withOffer), RDV_FREE_HAS_SALES, "offer en vente");
  must(await setOfferActiveCore(db, ctx, { offerId, isActive: false }, now), "offer off");
  must(await makeFree(withOffer), "free once the offer is off");
  assert.equal((await detailOf(db, pro, withOffer, now)).rdvFree, true);
  // The leftover offer cannot go back en vente on a free type (its tickets would be usable nowhere)...
  refused(await setOfferActiveCore(db, ctx, { offerId, isActive: true }, now), RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER, "a free type's offer cannot go back on sale");
  refused(
    await updateOfferCore(db, ctx, { offerId, offer: { ticketTypeId: withOffer, quantity: 1, priceCents: 2500 } }, now),
    RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER,
    "an edit that puts a free type's offer en vente (isActive defaults to true)",
  );
  // ...but it can still be edited while it stays « Pas en vente ».
  must(
    await updateOfferCore(db, ctx, { offerId, offer: { ticketTypeId: withOffer, quantity: 2, priceCents: 4000, isActive: false } }, now),
    "an edit that keeps the offer off sale",
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await detailOf(db, pro, withOffer, now)).offers.map((o) => [o.id, o.quantity, o.priceCents, o.isActive]),
    [[offerId, 2, 4000, false]],
  );
  must(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: withOffer, patch: { rdvFree: false } }, now), "back to paid");
  must(await setOfferActiveCore(db, ctx, { offerId, isActive: true }, now), "the offer goes back en vente once the type is paid again");
  assert.equal((await detailOf(db, pro, withOffer, now)).rdvFree, false);

  const withTicket = await makeType(db, pro, { rdvEnabled: true, rdvDurationMin: 15 });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, await makeCustomer(db, pro), withTicket, 1, { expiresAt: addDaysMs(now, 1) });
  refused(await makeFree(withTicket), RDV_FREE_HAS_SALES, "usable ticket");
  must(await makeFree(withTicket, addDaysMs(now, 2)), "the ticket is expired two days later: nothing is held");

  const plain = await makeType(db, pro);
  refused(await makeFree(plain), "Le rendez-vous gratuit demande le RDV libre.", "rdv_free needs the RDV option");
});

dbTest("updateTicketTypeCore refuses a notice longer than the effective horizon", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { rdvEnabled: true, rdvDurationMin: 60 });
  const overrides = (bookingHorizonDays: number | null, minNoticeMinutes: number | null) => ({
    bookingHorizonDays,
    minNoticeMinutes,
    cancelDeadlineHours: null,
  });
  const patch = (rdvOverrides: ReturnType<typeof overrides>, extra: TicketTypePatch = {}) =>
    updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, patch: { rdvOverrides, ...extra } }, now);

  refused(await patch(overrides(1, 10080)), NOTICE_TOO_LONG, "7 days notice, 1 day horizon");
  must(await patch(overrides(null, 10080)), "7 days notice inside the pro's 60 days horizon");
  refused(await patch(overrides(1, 10080)), NOTICE_TOO_LONG, "the same again");
  must(await patch(overrides(1, null)), "1 day horizon with the pro's 60 minutes notice");
  assert.deepEqual((await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now)).rdvOverrides, overrides(1, null));

  // The pro lowers their own horizon below this type's 7 days notice: a rename (« Informations » card) still works,
  // a patch of the booking rules is checked again.
  must(await patch(overrides(null, 10080)), "7 days notice again, inside the 60 days horizon");
  await db.execute(sql`update professional set booking_horizon_days = 3 where id = ${pro.proId}`);
  must(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, patch: { name: "Renommé", color: "#16a34a" } }, now), "a rename skips the window check");
  refused(await patch(overrides(null, 10080)), NOTICE_TOO_LONG, "the booking rules are checked against the lowered horizon");
  refused(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, patch: { rdvEnabled: true } }, now), NOTICE_TOO_LONG, "so is the RDV switch");

  // RDV off: the overrides are inert, nothing is checked.
  must(await patch(overrides(1, 10080), { rdvEnabled: false, rdvDurationMin: null }), "RDV off");
});

dbTest("archive, unarchive and delete a type: « Supprimer » archives a used type", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const unused = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Inutilisé" });
  const used = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Utilisé" });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, await makeCustomer(db, pro), used, 1);

  must(await setTicketTypeArchivedCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: unused, archived: true }, now), "archive");
  let list = await listTicketTypes(db, pro.proId, now);
  assert.deepEqual(list.archived.map((t) => t.id), [unused]);
  assert.deepEqual(list.active.map((t) => t.id), [used]);
  must(await setTicketTypeArchivedCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: unused, archived: false }, now), "unarchive");
  list = await listTicketTypes(db, pro.proId, now);
  assert.deepEqual(list.archived, []);
  assert.deepEqual(list.active.map((t) => t.id), [unused, used]);

  const gone = await deleteTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: unused }, now);
  must(gone, "delete an unused type");
  assert.equal(gone.outcome, "deleted");
  assert.equal(await getTicketTypeDetail(db, pro.proId, unused, now), null);

  const kept = await deleteTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: used }, now);
  must(kept, "delete a used type");
  assert.equal(kept.outcome, "archived");
  const detail = await detailOf(db, pro, used, now);
  assert.deepEqual([detail.archived, detail.usage.tickets], [true, 1]);

  refused(await deleteTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: unused }, now), NOT_FOUND, "already deleted");
  refused(await setTicketTypeArchivedCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: "inconnu", archived: true }, now), NOT_FOUND, "unknown id");
});

    "Indiquez une durée et une unité de validité, ou aucune.",
    "validity without unit",

  refused(await createOfferCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: free, quantity: 1, priceCents: 2500 }, now), RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER, "offer on an rdv_free type");
  refused(await createOfferCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: archived, quantity: 1, priceCents: 2500 }, now), NOT_FOUND, "offer on an archived type");

    [created.offerId, "Carnet de 4", 4, 8500, "3 mois", true],

});

dbTest("offers: update keeps the type, « En vente » only flips is_active, delete archives a bought offer", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const typeA = await makeType(db, pro);
  const typeB = await makeType(db, pro);
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeA, { quantity: 4, priceCents: 8500, label: "Carnet été", validityCount: 3, validityUnit: "month" });

  // The body names the other type: it is ignored, the offer stays in its own type.
  must(
    await updateOfferCore(
      db,
      ctx,
      { offerId, offer: { ticketTypeId: typeB, quantity: 5, priceCents: 9000, label: "Carnet été", validityCount: 6, validityUnit: "month", isActive: true } },
      now,
    ),
    "update",
  );
  const a = await detailOf(db, pro, typeA, now);
  assert.deepEqual(a.offers.map((o) => [o.id, o.quantity, o.priceCents, o.validityText]), [[offerId, 5, 9000, "6 mois"]]);
  assert.deepEqual((await detailOf(db, pro, typeB, now)).offers, []);
  refused(
    await updateOfferCore(db, ctx, { offerId, offer: { ticketTypeId: typeA, quantity: 0, priceCents: 9000 } }, now),
    "Quantité : minimum 1.",
    "quantity 0",
  );
  refused(
    await updateOfferCore(db, ctx, { offerId: "inconnu", offer: { ticketTypeId: typeA, quantity: 1, priceCents: 100 } }, now),
    NOT_FOUND,
    "unknown offer",
  );

  // « En vente » flips is_active and keeps every other column.
  const columns = (o: { label: string; customLabel: string | null; quantity: number; priceCents: number; validityCount: number | null; validityUnit: string | null }) =>
    [o.label, o.customLabel, o.quantity, o.priceCents, o.validityCount, o.validityUnit];
  const before = columns((await detailOf(db, pro, typeA, now)).offers[0]);
  must(await setOfferActiveCore(db, ctx, { offerId, isActive: false }, now), "off");
  let [offer] = (await detailOf(db, pro, typeA, now)).offers;
  assert.equal(offer.isActive, false);
  assert.deepEqual(columns(offer), before);
  must(await setOfferActiveCore(db, ctx, { offerId, isActive: true }, now), "on");
  [offer] = (await detailOf(db, pro, typeA, now)).offers;
  assert.equal(offer.isActive, true);
  assert.deepEqual(columns(offer), before);

  // Delete: unsold disappears, bought is archived.
  const unsold = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeA);
  const removed = await deleteOfferCore(db, ctx, { offerId: unsold }, now);
  must(removed, "delete an unsold offer");
  assert.equal(removed.outcome, "deleted");
  await buy(db, pro, offerId, await makeCustomer(db, pro));
  const archived = await deleteOfferCore(db, ctx, { offerId }, now);
  must(archived, "delete a bought offer");
  assert.equal(archived.outcome, "archived");
  const after = await detailOf(db, pro, typeA, now);
  assert.deepEqual(after.offers, []);
  assert.deepEqual(after.archivedOffers.map((o) => [o.id, o.sold]), [[offerId, 1]]);
  refused(await setOfferActiveCore(db, ctx, { offerId, isActive: true }, now), NOT_FOUND, "an archived offer is gone");
  refused(await deleteOfferCore(db, ctx, { offerId }, now), NOT_FOUND, "deleting it again");
});

dbTest("setTypeHoursCore sets, validates and clears the hours of a type", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { rdvEnabled: true, rdvDurationMin: 30 });
  const rules = [
    { dayOfWeek: 1, startMinute: 600, endMinute: 780 },
    { dayOfWeek: 3, startMinute: 840, endMinute: 1020 },
  ];

  must(await setTypeHoursCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, rules }, now), "set");
  assert.deepEqual((await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now)).ownHours, rules);
  refused(
    await setTypeHoursCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, rules: [{ dayOfWeek: 1, startMinute: 900, endMinute: 900 }] }, now),
    "Plage horaire invalide.",
    "empty range",
  );
  const tooMany = Array.from({ length: 169 }, (_, i) => ({ dayOfWeek: i % 7, startMinute: 0, endMinute: 60 }));
  assert.equal((await setTypeHoursCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, rules: tooMany }, now)).ok, false, "more than 168 ranges");
  assert.deepEqual((await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now)).ownHours, rules, "the refusals changed nothing");

  must(await setTypeHoursCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, rules: [] }, now), "clear");
  assert.deepEqual((await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now)).ownHours, []);
});

dbTest("setTypeQuestionsCore saves, keeps ids of saved questions and refuses a one-option choice", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { rdvEnabled: true, rdvDurationMin: 30 });

  must(
    await setTypeQuestionsCore(
      db,
      ctx,
      {
        ticketTypeId: typeId,
        questions: [
          { label: "Quel est votre objectif ?", type: "text", required: true },
          { label: "Niveau", type: "choice", options: ["Débutant", "Confirmé"], required: false },
        ],
      },
      now,
    ),
    "save",
  );
  const saved = (await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now)).questions;
  assert.deepEqual(
    saved.map((q) => [q.label, q.type, q.options, q.required]),
    [
      ["Quel est votre objectif ?", "text", null, true],
      ["Niveau", "choice", ["Débutant", "Confirmé"], false],
    ],
  );

  must(
    await setTypeQuestionsCore(
      db,
      ctx,
      { ticketTypeId: typeId, questions: [{ id: saved[0].id, label: "Votre objectif ?", type: "text", required: false }] },
      now,
    ),
    "edit and remove",
  );
  const edited = (await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now)).questions;
  assert.deepEqual(edited.map((q) => [q.id, q.label, q.required]), [[saved[0].id, "Votre objectif ?", false]]);

  refused(
    await setTypeQuestionsCore(
      db,
      ctx,
      { ticketTypeId: typeId, questions: [{ label: "Niveau", type: "choice", options: ["Seule"], required: false }] },
      now,
    ),
    "Une question à choix demande au moins deux options.",
    "one-option choice",
  );
  assert.equal((await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now)).questions.length, 1, "the refusal changed nothing");

  must(await setTypeQuestionsCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: typeId, questions: [] }, now), "clear");
  assert.deepEqual((await detailOf(db, pro, typeId, now)).questions, []);
});

dbTest("catalog cores never act on another pro's type or offer", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const now = new Date();
    const ctx = proCtx(pro);
    const theirs = await makeType(db, other, { name: "Le leur", rdvEnabled: true, rdvDurationMin: 30 });
    const theirOffer = await makeOffer(db, other, theirs);
    const offerBody = { ticketTypeId: theirs, quantity: 1, priceCents: 100 };

    refused(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: theirs, patch: { name: "Piraté" } }, now), NOT_FOUND, "update type");
    refused(await setTicketTypeArchivedCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: theirs, archived: true }, now), NOT_FOUND, "archive type");
    refused(await deleteTicketTypeCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: theirs }, now), NOT_FOUND, "delete type");
    refused(await createOfferCore(db, ctx, offerBody, now), NOT_FOUND, "create offer");
    refused(await updateOfferCore(db, ctx, { offerId: theirOffer, offer: offerBody }, now), NOT_FOUND, "update offer");
    refused(await setOfferActiveCore(db, ctx, { offerId: theirOffer, isActive: false }, now), NOT_FOUND, "toggle offer");
    refused(await deleteOfferCore(db, ctx, { offerId: theirOffer }, now), NOT_FOUND, "delete offer");
    refused(
      await setTypeHoursCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: theirs, rules: [{ dayOfWeek: 1, startMinute: 600, endMinute: 660 }] }, now),
      NOT_FOUND,
      "hours",
    );
    refused(
      await setTypeQuestionsCore(db, ctx, { ticketTypeId: theirs, questions: [{ label: "Intrus ?", type: "text", required: false }] }, now),
      NOT_FOUND,
      "questions",
    );

    const intact = await detailOf(db, other, theirs, now);
    assert.deepEqual([intact.name, intact.archived], ["Le leur", false]);
    assert.deepEqual(intact.offers.map((o) => [o.id, o.isActive]), [[theirOffer, true]]);
    assert.deepEqual([intact.ownHours, intact.questions], [[], []]);

    // The same call from the owner works.
    must(await updateTicketTypeCore(db, proCtx(other), { ticketTypeId: theirs, patch: { name: "Renommé" } }, now), "owner update");
    assert.equal((await detailOf(db, other, theirs, now)).name, "Renommé");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Catalog cores (spec § 9 and § 13.1): ticket types, offers, per-type RDV
 * hours and questions. Each core takes (db, ctx, input, now), validates its
 * input with parseFr BEFORE the engine (no English zod text reaches the UI),
 * checks the P3 rules the engine does not know (rdv_free, effective booking
 * window) and turns engine failures into French (context "catalog").
 * professionalId always comes from ctx. No server-only and no next/*: the
 * "use server" wrappers live in src/server/pro-catalog.ts.
 */
import { and, eq, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { z } from "zod";

import {
  createOffer,
  createTicketType,
  deleteOffer,
  deleteTicketType,
  setAvailabilityRules,
  setTicketTypeArchived,
  setTypeQuestions,
  updateOffer,
  updateTicketType,
} from "@/lib/booking/catalog";
import { effectiveWindow } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import { ts, type Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { ticketOffer, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import {
  availabilityRuleInputSchema,
  BOUNDS,
  idSchema,
  offerInputSchema,
  questionInputSchema,
  ticketTypeInputSchema,
  type AvailabilityRuleInput,
  type OfferInput,
  type QuestionInput,
  type TicketTypeInput,
} from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

import { readProWindow } from "./catalog-reads";
import { NOTICE_TOO_LONG, noticeExceedsHorizon } from "./notice";
import { actionFail, fromEngine, type ActionFail, type CoreResult, type ProCtx } from "./result";

export type TicketTypePatch = Partial<TicketTypeInput>;

export const RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER = "Un rendez-vous gratuit ne se vend pas : retirez l'option « Gratuit » pour créer une offre.";
export const RDV_FREE_HAS_SALES = "Ce type a des offres en vente ou des tickets valides : il ne peut pas devenir gratuit.";

/** Hours of one type: at most 24 ranges a day. */
const MAX_HOURS_RULES = 7 * 24;

const typeIdSchema = z.object({ ticketTypeId: idSchema });
const archiveSchema = z.object({ ticketTypeId: idSchema, archived: z.boolean() });
const updateTypeSchema = z.object({ ticketTypeId: idSchema, patch: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) });
const offerIdSchema = z.object({ offerId: idSchema });
const updateOfferSchema = z.object({ offerId: idSchema, offer: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) });
const offerActiveSchema = z.object({ offerId: idSchema, isActive: z.boolean() });
const hoursSchema = z.object({
  ticketTypeId: idSchema,
  rules: z.array(availabilityRuleInputSchema).max(MAX_HOURS_RULES),
});
const questionsSchema = z.object({
  ticketTypeId: idSchema,
  questions: z.array(questionInputSchema).max(BOUNDS.questions),
});

/** The fields a patch may carry (anything else is ignored). */
const PATCH_KEYS = [
  "name",
  "description",
  "color",
  "rdvEnabled",
  "rdvFree",
  "rdvDurationMin",
  "rdvBufferBeforeMin",
  "rdvBufferAfterMin",
  "rdvOverrides",
] as const satisfies readonly (keyof TicketTypeInput)[];

type ParsedType = z.output<typeof ticketTypeInputSchema>;

const notFound = (): ActionFail => fromEngine({ ok: false, code: "not_found" }, "catalog");

/** Row → TicketTypeInput (the base a patch is merged over). */
function typeInputOf(row: typeof ticketType.$inferSelect): TicketTypeInput {
  return {
    name: row.name,
    description: row.description,
    color: row.color,
    rdvEnabled: row.rdvEnabled,
    rdvFree: row.rdvFree,
    rdvDurationMin: row.rdvDurationMin,
    rdvBufferBeforeMin: row.rdvBufferBeforeMin,
    rdvBufferAfterMin: row.rdvBufferAfterMin,
    rdvOverrides: {
      bookingHorizonDays: row.rdvBookingHorizonDays,
      minNoticeMinutes: row.rdvMinNoticeMinutes,
      cancelDeadlineHours: row.rdvCancelDeadlineHours,
    },
  };
}

/** The type row of this pro (null for another pro's or an unknown id). */
async function readType(db: Db, professionalId: string, ticketTypeId: string) {
  const [row] = await db
    .select()
    .from(ticketType)
    .where(and(eq(ticketType.id, ticketTypeId), eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId)));
  return row ?? null;
}

/** The non-archived offer of this pro (null otherwise). */
async function readOffer(db: Db, professionalId: string, offerId: string) {
  const [row] = await db
    .select()
    .from(ticketOffer)
    .where(and(eq(ticketOffer.id, offerId), eq(ticketOffer.professionalId, professionalId), isNull(ticketOffer.archivedAt)));
  return row ?? null;
}

/** True while an offer is en vente or a ticket of the type is usable at `now`. */
async function hasSalesOrTickets(db: Db, professionalId: string, ticketTypeId: string, now: Date): Promise<boolean> {
  const res = await db.execute<{ blocked: boolean }>(sql`select (
    exists (select 1 from ticket_offer where ticket_type_id = ${ticketTypeId} and professional_id = ${professionalId}
      and is_active and archived_at is null)
    or exists (select 1 from ticket where ticket_type_id = ${ticketTypeId} and professional_id = ${professionalId}
      and status = 'available' and (expires_at is null or expires_at > ${ts(now)}))
  ) as blocked`);
  return res.rows[0]?.blocked === true;
}

/** NOTICE_TOO_LONG when an RDV type's effective notice is longer than its effective horizon. */
async function noticeRefusal(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, type: ParsedType): Promise<ActionFail | null> {
  if (!type.rdvEnabled) return null;
  const pro = await readProWindow(db, ctx.professionalId);
  if (!pro) return notFound();
  const effective = effectiveWindow(pro, type.rdvOverrides);
  return noticeExceedsHorizon(effective.minNoticeMinutes, effective.bookingHorizonDays) ? actionFail(NOTICE_TOO_LONG) : null;
}

/**
 * RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER when an offer would be (or stay) en vente on an rdv_free type: its tickets
 * are usable nowhere. An offer left inactive by the switch to « Gratuit » can still be edited
 * as long as it stays « Pas en vente » (isActive false).
 */
async function freeTypeRefusal(db: Db, professionalId: string, ticketTypeId: string, isActive: boolean): Promise<ActionFail | null> {
  if (!isActive) return null;
  const [t] = await db
    .select({ rdvFree: ticketType.rdvFree })
    .from(ticketType)
    .where(and(eq(ticketType.id, ticketTypeId), eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId)));
  return t?.rdvFree ? actionFail(RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER) : null;
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Ticket types ───────────────────────────── */

/** parseFr(ticketTypeInputSchema), RDV window check, createTicketType. */
export async function createTicketTypeCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: TicketTypeInput,
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ ticketTypeId: string }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(ticketTypeInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const refusal = await noticeRefusal(db, ctx, parsed.data);
  if (refusal) return refusal;
  const res = await createTicketType(db, { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, type: parsed.data }, now);
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}

/**
 * Reads the type (pro), merges the patch over its current values, parseFr the
 * full type, refuses rdvFree false → true while an offer en vente or a usable
 * ticket exists (RDV_FREE_HAS_SALES), refuses an effective notice longer than
 * the horizon (NOTICE_TOO_LONG) when the patch carries rdvEnabled or rdvOverrides,
 * then updateTicketType.
 */
export async function updateTicketTypeCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { ticketTypeId: string; patch: TicketTypePatch },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult> {
  const head = parseFr(updateTypeSchema, input);
  if (!head.ok) return actionFail(head.error);
  const row = await readType(db, ctx.professionalId, head.data.ticketTypeId);
  if (!row) return notFound();

  const merged: Record<string, unknown> = { ...typeInputOf(row) };
  for (const key of PATCH_KEYS) {
    const value = head.data.patch[key];
    if (value !== undefined) merged[key] = value;
  }
  const parsed = parseFr(ticketTypeInputSchema, merged);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);

  if (parsed.data.rdvFree && !row.rdvFree && (await hasSalesOrTickets(db, ctx.professionalId, row.id, now))) {
    return actionFail(RDV_FREE_HAS_SALES);
  }
  // The window is checked only when the patch touches it: a rename from the « Informations » card must not
  // be refused for booking rules that card does not show (e.g. the pro lowered their horizon since).
  const touchesWindow = head.data.patch.rdvEnabled !== undefined || head.data.patch.rdvOverrides !== undefined;
  const refusal = touchesWindow ? await noticeRefusal(db, ctx, parsed.data) : null;
  if (refusal) return refusal;

  const res = await updateTicketType(db, { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, ticketTypeId: row.id, type: parsed.data }, now);
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}

export async function setTicketTypeArchivedCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { ticketTypeId: string; archived: boolean },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult> {
  const parsed = parseFr(archiveSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const res = await setTicketTypeArchived(
    db,
    { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, ticketTypeId: parsed.data.ticketTypeId, archived: parsed.data.archived },
    now,
  );
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}

/** deleteTicketType: physical delete when unused, else archived (outcome). */
export async function deleteTicketTypeCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { ticketTypeId: string },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ outcome: "deleted" | "archived" }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(typeIdSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const res = await deleteTicketType(db, { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, ticketTypeId: parsed.data.ticketTypeId }, now);
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Offers ───────────────────────────── */

/** parseFr(offerInputSchema); the type must be the pro's, not archived, not rdv_free (RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER); createOffer. */
export async function createOfferCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: OfferInput,
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ offerId: string }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(offerInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const [type] = await db
    .select({ rdvFree: ticketType.rdvFree })
    .from(ticketType)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticketType.id, parsed.data.ticketTypeId),
        eq(ticketType.professionalId, ctx.professionalId),
        isNull(ticketType.archivedAt),
      ),
    );
  if (!type) return notFound();
  if (type.rdvFree) return actionFail(RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER);
  const res = await createOffer(db, { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, offer: parsed.data }, now);
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}

/** parseFr(offerInputSchema) with ticketTypeId forced to the offer's own type; no en vente offer on an rdv_free type (RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER); updateOffer. */
export async function updateOfferCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { offerId: string; offer: OfferInput },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult> {
  const head = parseFr(updateOfferSchema, input);
  if (!head.ok) return actionFail(head.error);
  const row = await readOffer(db, ctx.professionalId, head.data.offerId);
  if (!row) return notFound();
  const parsed = parseFr(offerInputSchema, { ...head.data.offer, ticketTypeId: row.ticketTypeId });
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const refusal = await freeTypeRefusal(db, ctx.professionalId, row.ticketTypeId, parsed.data.isActive);
  if (refusal) return refusal;
  const res = await updateOffer(db, { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, offerId: row.id, offer: parsed.data }, now);
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}

/** « En vente » toggle: reads the offer (pro, not archived), refuses to put it en vente on an rdv_free type (RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER) and calls updateOffer with its fields and the new isActive. */
export async function setOfferActiveCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { offerId: string; isActive: boolean },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult> {
  const parsed = parseFr(offerActiveSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const row = await readOffer(db, ctx.professionalId, parsed.data.offerId);
  if (!row) return notFound();
  const refusal = await freeTypeRefusal(db, ctx.professionalId, row.ticketTypeId, parsed.data.isActive);
  if (refusal) return refusal;
  const res = await updateOffer(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: ctx.professionalId,
      offerId: row.id,
      offer: {
        ticketTypeId: row.ticketTypeId,
        label: row.label,
        quantity: row.quantity,
        priceCents: row.priceCents,
        validityCount: row.validityCount,
        validityUnit: row.validityUnit,
        isActive: parsed.data.isActive,
      },
    },
    now,
  );
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}

export async function deleteOfferCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { offerId: string },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ outcome: "deleted" | "archived" }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(offerIdSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const res = await deleteOffer(db, { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, offerId: parsed.data.offerId }, now);
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Hours and questions ───────────────────────────── */

/** Per-type RDV hours (empty list = back to the global hours): parseFr(array of availabilityRuleInputSchema, max 168), setAvailabilityRules. */
export async function setTypeHoursCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { ticketTypeId: string; rules: AvailabilityRuleInput[] },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult> {
  const parsed = parseFr(hoursSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const res = await setAvailabilityRules(
    db,
    { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, ticketTypeId: parsed.data.ticketTypeId, rules: parsed.data.rules },
    now,
  );
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}

/** RDV questions: parseFr(array of questionInputSchema, max 20), setTypeQuestions. */
export async function setTypeQuestionsCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { ticketTypeId: string; questions: QuestionInput[] },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult> {
  const parsed = parseFr(questionsSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const res = await setTypeQuestions(
    db,
    { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, ticketTypeId: parsed.data.ticketTypeId, questions: parsed.data.questions },
    now,
  );
  return res.ok ? res : fromEngine(res, "catalog");
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { acceptedByText, emptyOffersText, offerLine, rdvBadgeLabel, showOrphanMark } from "./type-view";

/** Intl puts a no-break space before the currency sign: compare with plain spaces. */
const plain = (text: string): string => text.replace(/[\u00a0\u202f]/g, " ");

test("rdvBadgeLabel: « RDV libre », « RDV gratuit », nothing without RDV", () => {
  assert.equal(rdvBadgeLabel({ rdvEnabled: false, rdvFree: false, rdvDurationMin: null }), null);
  assert.equal(rdvBadgeLabel({ rdvEnabled: true, rdvFree: false, rdvDurationMin: 60 }), "RDV libre · 60 min");
  assert.equal(rdvBadgeLabel({ rdvEnabled: true, rdvFree: true, rdvDurationMin: 15 }), "RDV gratuit · 15 min");
  assert.equal(rdvBadgeLabel({ rdvEnabled: true, rdvFree: false, rdvDurationMin: null }), "RDV libre");
});

test("offerLine: label, price, validity", () => {
  assert.equal(plain(offerLine({ label: "À l'unité", priceCents: 2500, validityText: null }, "eur")), "À l'unité · 25 €");
  assert.equal(plain(offerLine({ label: "Carnet de 4", priceCents: 8500, validityText: "3 mois" }, "eur")), "Carnet de 4 · 85 € · 3 mois");
  assert.equal(plain(offerLine({ label: "Carnet de 10", priceCents: 19000, validityText: "6 mois" }, "eur")), "Carnet de 10 · 190 € · 6 mois");
  assert.equal(plain(offerLine({ label: "Essai", priceCents: 2550, validityText: "30 jours" }, "eur")), "Essai · 25,50 € · 30 jours");
});

test("emptyOffersText: a free RDV type has no offer by design", () => {
  assert.equal(emptyOffersText(false), "Aucune offre");
  assert.equal(emptyOffersText(true), "Gratuit, sans ticket");
});

test("acceptedByText: titles or nobody", () => {
  assert.equal(acceptedByText([]), "Accepté par aucun événement");
  assert.equal(acceptedByText([{ title: "Altinha débutants" }]), "Accepté par : Altinha débutants");
```

```ts
/**
 * Copy of the ticket type cards and pages (spec § 13.1 « Tickets »), kept pure
 * so the exact French strings are unit-tested. No React, no server module.
 */
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils";

/** « RDV libre · 60 min », « RDV gratuit · 15 min », null when the type is not bookable as an RDV. */
export function rdvBadgeLabel(t: { rdvEnabled: boolean; rdvFree: boolean; rdvDurationMin: number | null }): string | null {
  if (!t.rdvEnabled) return null;
  const base = t.rdvFree ? "RDV gratuit" : "RDV libre";
  return t.rdvDurationMin === null ? base : `${base} · ${t.rdvDurationMin} min`;
}

/** « À l'unité · 25 € », « Carnet de 4 · 85 € · 3 mois ». */
export function offerLine(o: { label: string; priceCents: number; validityText: string | null }, currency: string): string {
  const base = `${o.label} · ${formatMoney(o.priceCents, currency)}`;
  return o.validityText === null ? base : `${base} · ${o.validityText}`;
}

/** What a type without offer says. */
export function emptyOffersText(rdvFree: boolean): string {
  return rdvFree ? "Gratuit, sans ticket" : "Aucune offre";
}

/** « Accepté par : A, B » or « Accepté par aucun événement ». */
export function acceptedByText(acceptedBy: readonly { title: string }[]): string {
  return acceptedBy.length === 0 ? "Accepté par aucun événement" : `Accepté par : ${acceptedBy.map((e) => e.title).join(", ")}`;
}

/**
 * The orange mark « Lié à aucun événement à venir ». An rdv_free type is an
 * orphan for the wallet alert (its tickets are usable nowhere) but needs no
 * event itself, so its card never shows the mark.
 */
export function showOrphanMark(t: { orphan: boolean; archived: boolean; rdvFree: boolean }): boolean {
  return t.orphan && !t.archived && !t.rdvFree;
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";

import { StatusMark } from "@/components/dashboard/status-mark";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardFooter, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { TicketTypeSummary } from "@/lib/back-office/catalog-reads";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { acceptedByText, emptyOffersText, offerLine, rdvBadgeLabel, showOrphanMark } from "@/lib/back-office/type-view";

/** One ticket type: colour, badges, offers, who accepts it, tickets in circulation. */
export function TicketTypeCard({ type, currency }: { type: TicketTypeSummary; currency: string }) {
  const href = `/dashboard/tickets/${type.id}`;
  const rdv = rdvBadgeLabel(type);

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col">
      <CardHeader className="gap-3 pb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="size-3 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: type.color }} />
          <h2 className="min-w-0 truncate text-base font-semibold leading-tight">
            <Link
              href={href}
              className="rounded-sm hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              {type.name}
            </Link>
          </h2>
        </div>
        {(rdv !== null || type.archived) && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {rdv !== null && <Badge>{rdv}</Badge>}
            {type.archived && <Badge variant="neutral">Archivé</Badge>}
          </div>
        )}
        {showOrphanMark(type) && (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-warning">
            <StatusMark tone="orange" />
            Lié à aucun événement à venir
          </p>
        )}
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-4">
        {type.offers.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{emptyOffersText(type.rdvFree)}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="space-y-2">
            {type.offers.map((offer) => (
              <li key={offer.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-sm">
                <span>{offerLine(offer, currency)}</span>
                {!offer.isActive && <Badge variant="neutral">Pas en vente</Badge>}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        <p className="mt-auto line-clamp-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{acceptedByText(type.acceptedBy)}</p>
      </CardContent>

      <CardFooter className="justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border pt-4">
        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {plural(type.usableTickets, "ticket en circulation", "tickets en circulation")}
        </span>
        <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
          <Link href={href}>Modifier</Link>
        </Button>
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2, Plus } from "lucide-react";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { DEFAULT_COLOR } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { createTicketTypeAction } from "@/server/pro-catalog";

const NAME_HELP = "Par exemple « Cours collectif ».";

/** Opens a dialog (name, colour) and sends the pro to the new type's page, where offers and options are set. */
export function NewTicketTypeButton({ label = "Nouveau type de ticket" }: { label?: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const uid = useId();
  const nameId = `${uid}-name`;
  const colorId = `${uid}-color`;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [color, setColor] = useState<string>(DEFAULT_COLOR);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  // The action reports one message: when it concerns the name it sits under the field, otherwise above the buttons.
  const nameError = error !== null && error.startsWith("Nom :") ? error : null;
  const formError = nameError === null ? error : null;

  function openDialog() {
    setName("");
    setColor(DEFAULT_COLOR);
    setError(null);
    setOpen(true);
  }

  function close() {
    if (!pending) setOpen(false);
  }

  function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await createTicketTypeAction({ name, color });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      router.push(`/dashboard/tickets/${res.ticketTypeId}`);
    });
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Button onClick={openDialog}>
        <Plus />
        {label}
      </Button>
      <Dialog open={open} onClose={close} title="Nouveau type de ticket">
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
          <FormField label="Nom" htmlFor={nameId} help={NAME_HELP} error={nameError}>
            <Input
              id={nameId}
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              maxLength={80}
              autoComplete="off"
              autoFocus
              aria-invalid={nameError !== null ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={nameError !== null ? `${nameId}-error` : `${nameId}-help`}
            />
          </FormField>
          <FormField label="Couleur" htmlFor={colorId}>
            <input
              id={colorId}
              type="color"
              value={color}
              onChange={(e) => setColor(e.target.value)}
              className="h-10 w-16 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-input bg-card p-1"
            />
          </FormField>
          <FormError message={formError} />
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={close} disabled={pending}>
              Retour
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
              {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
              Créer
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { ChevronDown, Ticket } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/dashboard/empty-state";
import { NewTicketTypeButton } from "@/components/dashboard/new-ticket-type-button";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/page-header";
import { TicketTypeCard } from "@/components/dashboard/ticket-type-card";
import { getCurrentProfessional } from "@/lib/session";
import { getTicketTypesPage } from "@/server/catalog-queries";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Tickets" };

export default async function TicketsPage() {
  const pro = (await getCurrentProfessional())!;
  const { active, archived } = await getTicketTypesPage(pro.id);
  const empty = active.length === 0 && archived.length === 0;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Tickets"
        description="Vos types de ticket et les offres qui les vendent."
        // The empty state carries the same button: one call to action per intent.
        action={empty ? undefined : <NewTicketTypeButton />}
      />

      {empty ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={Ticket}
          title="Créez un type de ticket, puis une offre"
          description="Un type de ticket, c'est ce qu'un événement accepte. Une offre le vend à l'unité ou en carnet."
          action={<NewTicketTypeButton />}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {active.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucun type actif : créez-en un ou désarchivez-en un.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              {active.map((type) => (
                <TicketTypeCard key={type.id} type={type} currency={pro.currency} />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {archived.length > 0 && (
            <details className="group mt-8 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card">
              <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 text-sm font-medium focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
                Types archivés ({archived.length})
                <ChevronDown className="size-4 text-muted-foreground transition-transform group-open:rotate-180" />
              </summary>
              <div className="grid gap-4 p-4 pt-0 md:grid-cols-2">
                {archived.map((type) => (
                  <TicketTypeCard key={type.id} type={type} currency={pro.currency} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </details>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { EMPTY_OFFER_FORM, offerErrorField, offerFormFromView, offerInputFromForm, type OfferFormValues } from "./offer-form";

const plain = (text: string): string => text.replace(/[\u00a0\u202f]/g, " ");
const form = (over: Partial<OfferFormValues> = {}): OfferFormValues => ({ ...EMPTY_OFFER_FORM, price: "40", ...over });

test("offerInputFromForm: a unit offer without validity", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ price: "25" })), {
    ok: true,
    input: { ticketTypeId: "t1", quantity: 1, priceCents: 2500, label: null, validityCount: null, validityUnit: null, isActive: true },
  });
});

test("offerInputFromForm: a book with a validity in months and a typed label", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ quantity: "2", price: "40", label: "  Carnet été ", validity: "month", validityCount: "2", isActive: false })),
    {
      ok: true,
      input: { ticketTypeId: "t1", quantity: 2, priceCents: 4000, label: "Carnet été", validityCount: 2, validityUnit: "month", isActive: false },
    },
  );
  const days = offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ validity: "day", validityCount: "30" }));
  assert.ok(days.ok);
  assert.deepEqual([days.input.validityCount, days.input.validityUnit], [30, "day"]);
});

test("offerInputFromForm: the price accepts « 25,50 » and « 25.5 », refuses the rest with « Prix invalide. »", () => {
  const cents = (price: string) => {
    const res = offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ price }));
    return res.ok ? res.input.priceCents : res;
  };
  assert.equal(cents("25,50"), 2550);
  assert.equal(cents("25.5"), 2550);
  for (const bad of ["", "abc", "0", "-5", "1,234", "12 euros"]) {
    assert.deepEqual(cents(bad), { ok: false, field: "price", error: "Prix invalide." }, `price « ${bad} »`);
  }
});

test("offerInputFromForm: a price above the bound names the maximum", () => {
  assert.equal(offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ price: "10000" })).ok, true);
  const res = offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ price: "10001" }));
  assert.ok(!res.ok);
  assert.equal(res.field, "price");
  assert.equal(plain(res.error), "Prix invalide : 10 000 au maximum.");
});

test("offerInputFromForm: quantity and validity count must be whole numbers", () => {
  for (const quantity of ["", "x", "1.5", "-1"]) {
    assert.deepEqual(offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ quantity })), {
      ok: false,
      field: "quantity",
      error: "Quantité : indiquez un nombre entier.",
    });
  }
  assert.deepEqual(offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ validity: "day", validityCount: "" })), {
    ok: false,
    field: "validity",
    error: "Validité : indiquez un nombre entier.",
  });
  // The bounds (1 to 100, 1 to 1000) are the server's: « 0 » goes through to its French message.
  assert.equal(offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ quantity: "0" })).ok, true);
  // Without a validity unit the count is ignored.
  const none = offerInputFromForm("t1", form({ validity: "none", validityCount: "abc" }));
  assert.ok(none.ok);
  assert.deepEqual([none.input.validityCount, none.input.validityUnit], [null, null]);
});

test("offerFormFromView: an offer back to form values", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    offerFormFromView({ quantity: 4, priceCents: 8550, customLabel: "Carnet été", validityCount: 3, validityUnit: "month", isActive: false }),
    { quantity: "4", price: "85,50", label: "Carnet été", validity: "month", validityCount: "3", isActive: false },
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    offerFormFromView({ quantity: 1, priceCents: 2500, customLabel: null, validityCount: null, validityUnit: null, isActive: true }),
    { quantity: "1", price: "25", label: "", validity: "none", validityCount: "1", isActive: true },
  );
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the pure form model**

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/back-office/offer-form.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The offer dialog's form model (spec § 13.1 « Offres »): strings as typed,
 * converted to an OfferInput before the Server Action. Whole-number and price
 * syntax are checked here (no round trip for a typo); the numeric bounds and
 * every other rule stay with the server, whose French messages the dialog
 * shows under the field they belong to.
 */
import type { OfferInput } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { BOUNDS, type ValidityUnit } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

import { moneyInputValue, parseMoneyInput } from "./format";

export type ValidityChoice = "none" | "day" | "month";
export type OfferField = "quantity" | "price" | "label" | "validity";

export type OfferFormValues = {
  quantity: string;
  price: string;
  label: string;
  validity: ValidityChoice;
  validityCount: string;
  isActive: boolean;
};

/** « Nouvelle offre »: one ticket, no price yet, no validity, en vente. */
export const EMPTY_OFFER_FORM: OfferFormValues = {
  quantity: "1",
  price: "",
  label: "",
  validity: "none",
  validityCount: "1",
  isActive: true,
};

export function offerFormFromView(o: {
  quantity: number;
  priceCents: number;
  customLabel: string | null;
  validityCount: number | null;
  validityUnit: ValidityUnit | null;
  isActive: boolean;
}): OfferFormValues {
  return {
    quantity: String(o.quantity),
    price: moneyInputValue(o.priceCents),
    label: o.customLabel ?? "",
    validity: o.validityUnit ?? "none",
    validityCount: o.validityCount === null ? "1" : String(o.validityCount),
    isActive: o.isActive,
  };
}

export type OfferFormResult = { ok: true; input: OfferInput } | { ok: false; field: OfferField; error: string };

const WHOLE = /^\d+$/;

export function offerInputFromForm(ticketTypeId: string, f: OfferFormValues): OfferFormResult {
  const quantity = f.quantity.trim();
  if (!WHOLE.test(quantity)) return { ok: false, field: "quantity", error: "Quantité : indiquez un nombre entier." };

  const priceCents = parseMoneyInput(f.price);
  if (priceCents === null) return { ok: false, field: "price", error: "Prix invalide." };
  if (priceCents > BOUNDS.offerPriceCents.max) {
    const max = (BOUNDS.offerPriceCents.max / 100).toLocaleString("fr-FR");
    return { ok: false, field: "price", error: `Prix invalide : ${max} au maximum.` };
  }

  let validityCount: number | null = null;
  let validityUnit: ValidityUnit | null = null;
  if (f.validity !== "none") {
    const count = f.validityCount.trim();
    if (!WHOLE.test(count)) return { ok: false, field: "validity", error: "Validité : indiquez un nombre entier." };
    validityCount = Number(count);
    validityUnit = f.validity;
  }

  const label = f.label.trim();
  return {
    ok: true,
    input: {
      ticketTypeId,
      quantity: Number(quantity),
      priceCents,
      label: label === "" ? null : label,
      validityCount,
      validityUnit,
      isActive: f.isActive,
    },
  };
}

/** The field a French server message belongs to (by its label prefix or its subject), null for a general message. */
export function offerErrorField(error: string): OfferField | null {
  if (error.startsWith("Quantité")) return "quantity";
  if (error.startsWith("Prix")) return "price";
  if (error.startsWith("Libellé")) return "label";
  if (error.startsWith("Validité") || error.includes("validité")) return "validity";
  return null;
}
```
