```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Check, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { updateTicketTypeAction } from "@/server/pro-catalog";

const INFO_FIELD_PREFIXES = ["Nom :", "Description :", "Couleur :"] as const;

/** « Informations »: name, description and colour of the type. A failed save keeps the form filled. */
export function TicketTypeInfoForm({
  ticketTypeId,
  initial,
}: {
  ticketTypeId: string;
  initial: { name: string; description: string; color: string };
}) {
  const uid = useId();
  const [name, setName] = useState(initial.name);
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(initial.description);
  const [color, setColor] = useState(initial.color);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const under = (prefix: string): string | null => (error !== null && error.startsWith(prefix) ? error : null);
  const general = error !== null && !INFO_FIELD_PREFIXES.some((p) => error.startsWith(p)) ? error : null;

  function edit<T>(set: (value: T) => void, value: T) {
    set(value);
    setSaved(false);
  }

  function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    setError(null);
    setSaved(false);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const trimmed = description.trim();
      const res = await updateTicketTypeAction({
        ticketTypeId,
        patch: { name, description: trimmed === "" ? null : trimmed, color },
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setSaved(true);
    });
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
      <FormField label="Nom" htmlFor={`${uid}-name`} error={under("Nom :")}>
        <Input
          id={`${uid}-name`}
          value={name}
          onChange={(e) => edit(setName, e.target.value)}
          maxLength={80}
          autoComplete="off"
          aria-invalid={under("Nom :") !== null ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={under("Nom :") !== null ? `${uid}-name-error` : undefined}
        />
      </FormField>
      <FormField label="Description" htmlFor={`${uid}-description`} optional error={under("Description :")}>
        <Textarea
          id={`${uid}-description`}
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => edit(setDescription, e.target.value)}
          maxLength={2000}
          rows={3}
          aria-invalid={under("Description :") !== null ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={under("Description :") !== null ? `${uid}-description-error` : undefined}
        />
      </FormField>
      <FormField label="Couleur" htmlFor={`${uid}-color`} error={under("Couleur :")}>
        <input
          id={`${uid}-color`}
          type="color"
          value={color}
          onChange={(e) => edit(setColor, e.target.value)}
          className="h-10 w-16 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-input bg-card p-1"
        />
      </FormField>
      <FormError message={general} />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
          {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
          Enregistrer
        </Button>
        {saved && (
          <span role="status" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-success">
            <Check className="size-4" />
            Enregistré
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useOptimistic, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2, Plus } from "lucide-react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Switch } from "@/components/dashboard/switch";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
import type { OfferView } from "@/lib/back-office/catalog-reads";
import { deleteOfferCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import { currencySymbol, plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import {
  EMPTY_OFFER_FORM,
  offerErrorField,
  offerFormFromView,
  offerInputFromForm,
  type OfferField,
  type OfferFormValues,
  type ValidityChoice,
} from "@/lib/back-office/offer-form";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils";
import { createOfferAction, deleteOfferAction, setOfferActiveAction, updateOfferAction } from "@/server/pro-catalog";

const QUANTITY_HELP = "Nombre de tickets de l'offre : 1 pour « À l'unité ».";
const PRICE_HELP = "Pas d'offre gratuite : pour donner des tickets, utilisez « Offrir » dans la fiche client.";
const LABEL_HELP = "Laissé vide : « À l'unité » ou « Carnet de N ».";
const VALIDITY_HELP = "Comptée à partir de l'achat ; le ticket reste valable jusqu'à la fin du dernier jour.";

/** The dialog works on one offer by id: « new » or the offer to edit. */
type Editing = { kind: "new" } | { kind: "edit"; offerId: string };

/** « Offres » of a type: rows with the « En vente » switch, add / edit dialog, delete with confirmation, archived offers. */
export function OfferList({
  ticketTypeId,
  offers,
  archivedOffers,
  currency,
  rdvFree,
  typeArchived,
}: {
  ticketTypeId: string;
  offers: OfferView[];
  archivedOffers: OfferView[];
  currency: string;
  rdvFree: boolean;
  typeArchived: boolean;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Editing | null>(null);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toggleError, setToggleError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toggling, startToggle] = useTransition();
  const [deleting, startDelete] = useTransition();

  // The switch answers at once; the page props catch up when the action has revalidated the page.
  const [shownOffers, applyToggle] = useOptimistic(offers, (current, change: { offerId: string; isActive: boolean }) =>
    current.map((o) => (o.id === change.offerId ? { ...o, isActive: change.isActive } : o)),
  );

  const edited = editing?.kind === "edit" ? offers.find((o) => o.id === editing.offerId) : undefined;
  const toDelete = deleteId === null ? undefined : offers.find((o) => o.id === deleteId);

  function onToggle(offerId: string, isActive: boolean) {
    setToggleError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    startToggle(async () => {
      applyToggle({ offerId, isActive });
      const res = await setOfferActiveAction({ offerId, isActive });
      if (!res.ok) setToggleError(res.error);
    });
  }

  function onConfirmDelete(offerId: string) {
    setDeleteError(null);
    startDelete(async () => {
      const res = await deleteOfferAction({ offerId });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setDeleteError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setDeleteId(null);
      setNotice(res.outcome === "archived" ? "Offre archivée : elle avait déjà été achetée." : null);
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {rdvFree && (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Un rendez-vous gratuit ne se vend pas : il n&apos;a pas d&apos;offre.</p>
      )}
      {!rdvFree && offers.length === 0 && (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucune offre : ajoutez-en une pour vendre ce type.</p>
      )}

      {shownOffers.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="space-y-3">
          {shownOffers.map((offer) => (
            <li
              key={offer.id}
              className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
            >
              <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
                <p className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5">
                  <span className="font-medium">{offer.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium tabular-nums">{formatMoney(offer.priceCents, currency)}</span>
                </p>
                <p className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-0.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  <span>{plural(offer.quantity, "ticket", "tickets")}</span>
                  <span>{offer.validityText === null ? "Sans limite de validité" : `Validité : ${offer.validityText}`}</span>
                  <span>{plural(offer.sold, "vendue", "vendues")}</span>
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                <Switch
                  id={`on-sale-${offer.id}`}
                  checked={offer.isActive}
                  onCheckedChange={(value) => onToggle(offer.id, value)}
                  label="En vente"
                  disabled={typeArchived || toggling || (rdvFree && !offer.isActive)}
                />
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => setEditing({ kind: "edit", offerId: offer.id })}>
                  Modifier
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  className="text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setDeleteError(null);
                    setNotice(null);
                    setDeleteId(offer.id);
                  }}
                >
                  Supprimer
                </Button>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {typeArchived && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Type archivé : ses offres ne sont pas proposées.</p>}
      <FormError message={toggleError} />
      {notice !== null && (
        <p role="status" className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm">
          {notice}
        </p>
      )}

      {!rdvFree && (
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={typeArchived} onClick={() => setEditing({ kind: "new" })}>
          <Plus />
          Ajouter une offre
        </Button>
      )}

      {archivedOffers.length > 0 && (
        <details className="rounded-xl border border-border">
          <summary className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring">
            Offres archivées ({archivedOffers.length})
          </summary>
          <ul className="divide-y divide-border border-t border-border">
            {archivedOffers.map((offer) => (
              <li key={offer.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1 px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                <span className="font-medium">{offer.label}</span>
                <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 text-muted-foreground">
                  <span>{formatMoney(offer.priceCents, currency)}</span>
                  <span>{plural(offer.sold, "vendue", "vendues")}</span>
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </details>
      )}

      {editing?.kind === "new" && (
        <OfferDialog
          key="new"
          ticketTypeId={ticketTypeId}
          offerId={null}
          initial={EMPTY_OFFER_FORM}
          currency={currency}
          rdvFree={rdvFree}
          onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
        />
      )}
      {editing?.kind === "edit" && edited && (
        <OfferDialog
          key={edited.id}
          ticketTypeId={ticketTypeId}
          offerId={edited.id}
          initial={offerFormFromView(edited)}
          currency={currency}
          rdvFree={rdvFree}
          onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
        />
      )}

      {toDelete && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          open
          copy={deleteOfferCopy({ label: toDelete.label, sold: toDelete.sold > 0 })}
          pending={deleting}
          error={deleteError}
          onConfirm={() => onConfirmDelete(toDelete.id)}
          onClose={() => {
            if (deleting) return;
            setDeleteId(null);
            setDeleteError(null);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Add / edit dialog. Mounted per opening, so its fields start from the offer as it is when the pro clicks.
 * On an rdv_free type the « En vente » switch is locked (the server refuses an offer en vente there).
 */
function OfferDialog({
  ticketTypeId,
  offerId,
  initial,
  currency,
  rdvFree,
  onClose,
}: {
  ticketTypeId: string;
  offerId: string | null;
  initial: OfferFormValues;
  currency: string;
  rdvFree: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const uid = useId();
  const [values, setValues] = useState<OfferFormValues>(initial);
  const [error, setError] = useState<{ field: OfferField | null; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const set = <K extends keyof OfferFormValues>(key: K, value: OfferFormValues[K]) =>
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
  const under = (field: OfferField): string | null => (error !== null && error.field === field ? error.message : null);
  const general = error !== null && error.field === null ? error.message : null;
  const describedBy = (field: OfferField, help: boolean): string | undefined =>
    under(field) !== null ? `${uid}-${field}-error` : help ? `${uid}-${field}-help` : undefined;

  function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const built = offerInputFromForm(ticketTypeId, values);
    if (!built.ok) {
      setError({ field: built.field, message: built.error });
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = offerId === null ? await createOfferAction(built.input) : await updateOfferAction({ offerId, offer: built.input });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError({ field: offerErrorField(res.error), message: res.error });
        return;
      }
      onClose();
    });
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open onClose={() => (pending ? undefined : onClose())} title={offerId === null ? "Nouvelle offre" : "Modifier l'offre"}>
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
        <FormField label="Quantité" htmlFor={`${uid}-quantity`} help={QUANTITY_HELP} error={under("quantity")}>
          <Input
            id={`${uid}-quantity`}
            type="number"
            inputMode="numeric"
            min={1}
            max={100}
            step={1}
            value={values.quantity}
            onChange={(e) => set("quantity", e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={under("quantity") !== null ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={describedBy("quantity", true)}
          />
        </FormField>
        <FormField label={`Prix (${currencySymbol(currency)})`} htmlFor={`${uid}-price`} help={PRICE_HELP} error={under("price")}>
          <Input
            id={`${uid}-price`}
            inputMode="decimal"
            autoComplete="off"
            value={values.price}
            onChange={(e) => set("price", e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={under("price") !== null ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={describedBy("price", true)}
          />
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Libellé" htmlFor={`${uid}-label`} optional help={LABEL_HELP} error={under("label")}>
          <Input
            id={`${uid}-label`}
            value={values.label}
            maxLength={80}
            autoComplete="off"
            onChange={(e) => set("label", e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={under("label") !== null ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={describedBy("label", true)}
          />
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Validité" htmlFor={`${uid}-validity`} help={VALIDITY_HELP} error={under("validity")}>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Select
              id={`${uid}-validity`}
              value={values.validity}
              onChange={(e) => set("validity", e.target.value as ValidityChoice)}
              className="min-w-0 flex-1"
              aria-describedby={describedBy("validity", true)}
            >
              <option value="none">Sans limite</option>
              <option value="day">En jours</option>
              <option value="month">En mois</option>
            </Select>
            <Input
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min={1}
              max={1000}
              step={1}
              aria-label="Durée de validité"
              className="w-28"
              value={values.validityCount}
              disabled={values.validity === "none"}
              onChange={(e) => set("validityCount", e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </FormField>
        <Switch
          id={`${uid}-active`}
          checked={values.isActive}
          onCheckedChange={(value) => set("isActive", value)}
          label="En vente"
          description={rdvFree ? "Un rendez-vous gratuit ne se vend pas." : undefined}
          disabled={rdvFree && !initial.isActive}
        />
        <FormError message={general} />
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={pending}>
            Retour
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
            {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
            {offerId === null ? "Ajouter l'offre" : "Enregistrer"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { archiveTypeCopy, deleteTypeCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import { deleteTicketTypeAction, setTicketTypeArchivedAction } from "@/server/pro-catalog";

const EXPLANATION = "Archiver retire le type de votre page sans rien perdre. Supprimer l'efface, ou l'archive s'il a déjà servi.";

/** « Archiver ou supprimer »: every destructive step is confirmed with its consequences (confirm-copy). */
export function TypeDangerZone({
  ticketTypeId,
  name,
  archived,
  used,
  acceptedBy,
}: {
  ticketTypeId: string;
  name: string;
  archived: boolean;
  used: boolean;
  acceptedBy: readonly string[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<"archive" | "delete" | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  function close() {
    if (pending) return;
    setDialog(null);
    setError(null);
  }

  function setArchived(next: boolean) {
    setError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await setTicketTypeArchivedAction({ ticketTypeId, archived: next });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setDialog(null);
    });
  }

  function remove() {
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await deleteTicketTypeAction({ ticketTypeId });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      if (res.outcome === "deleted") {
        router.push("/dashboard/tickets");
        return;
      }
      setDialog(null);
      setNotice("Ce type a déjà servi : il a été archivé.");
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {archived ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Archivé : ce type n&apos;est plus proposé. Ses tickets restent dans les portefeuilles.</p>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{EXPLANATION}</p>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        {archived ? (
          <Button onClick={() => setArchived(false)} disabled={pending}>
            {pending && dialog === null && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
            Désarchiver
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setDialog("archive")} disabled={pending}>
            Archiver
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => setDialog("delete")} disabled={pending}>
          Supprimer
        </Button>
      </div>
      <FormError message={dialog === null ? error : null} />
      {notice !== null && (
        <p role="status" className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm">
          {notice}
        </p>
      )}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={dialog === "archive"}
        copy={archiveTypeCopy({ name })}
        tone="primary"
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onConfirm={() => setArchived(true)}
        onClose={close}
      />
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={dialog === "delete"}
        copy={deleteTypeCopy({ name, used, acceptedBy })}
        tone={used ? "primary" : "destructive"}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onConfirm={remove}
        onClose={close}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";

import { OfferList } from "@/components/dashboard/offer-list";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/page-header";
import { TicketTypeInfoForm } from "@/components/dashboard/ticket-type-editor";
import { TypeDangerZone } from "@/components/dashboard/type-danger-zone";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { getCurrentProfessional } from "@/lib/session";
import { getTicketTypePage } from "@/server/catalog-queries";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Type de ticket" };

export default async function TicketTypePage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const pro = (await getCurrentProfessional())!;
  const type = await getTicketTypePage(pro.id, id);
  if (!type) notFound();

  const used = type.usage.tickets + type.usage.purchases + type.usage.rdvs > 0;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl">
      <PageHeader
        title={type.name}
        description="Type de ticket"
        action={
          <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">
            <Link href="/dashboard/tickets">
              <ArrowLeft />
              Tous les tickets
            </Link>
          </Button>
        }
      />

      {type.archived && (
        <p role="status" className="mb-6 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-warning">
          Ce type est archivé : ses offres ne sont plus en vente.
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-6">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Informations</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <TicketTypeInfoForm
              ticketTypeId={type.id}
              initial={{ name: type.name, description: type.description ?? "", color: type.color }}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Offres</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <OfferList
              ticketTypeId={type.id}
              offers={type.offers}
              archivedOffers={type.archivedOffers}
              currency={pro.currency}
              rdvFree={type.rdvFree}
              typeArchived={type.archived}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Accepté par</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Les événements choisissent leurs tickets acceptés dans leur page.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {type.acceptedBy.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{"Aucun événement n'accepte ce type."}</p>
                <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
                  <Link href="/dashboard/events/new">Créer un événement</Link>
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
                {type.acceptedBy.map((event) => (
                  <li key={event.eventId}>
                    <Link
                      href={`/dashboard/events/${event.eventId}`}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-sm font-medium hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                    >
                      <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{event.title}</span>
                      {event.isPrivate && <Badge variant="neutral">Privé</Badge>}
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Archiver ou supprimer</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <TypeDangerZone
              ticketTypeId={type.id}
              name={type.name}
              archived={type.archived}
              used={used}
              acceptedBy={type.acceptedBy.map((event) => event.title)}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import type { QuestionRow } from "@/lib/booking/answers";

import { draftsFromRows, inputsFromDrafts, moveDraft, newQuestionDraft, withQuestionType, type QuestionDraft } from "./question-drafts";

const rows: QuestionRow[] = [
  { id: "q1", label: "Quel est votre objectif ?", type: "text", options: null, required: true, position: 0 },
  { id: "q2", label: "Niveau", type: "choice", options: ["Débutant", "Confirmé"], required: false, position: 1 },
];

test("draftsFromRows: saved questions keep their id as key, options default to an empty list", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(draftsFromRows(rows), [
    { key: "q1", id: "q1", label: "Quel est votre objectif ?", type: "text", options: [], required: true },
    { key: "q2", id: "q2", label: "Niveau", type: "choice", options: ["Débutant", "Confirmé"], required: false },
  ]);
});

test("inputsFromDrafts: trims, keeps options for a choice only, drops blank options, keeps ids of saved questions", () => {
  const drafts: QuestionDraft[] = [
    { key: "q1", id: "q1", label: "  Votre objectif ?  ", type: "text", options: ["reste d'un ancien choix"], required: true },
    { key: "new-1", label: "Niveau", type: "choice", options: [" Débutant ", "", "Confirmé", "   "], required: false },
  ];
  const inputs = inputsFromDrafts(drafts);
  assert.deepEqual(inputs, [
    { id: "q1", label: "Votre objectif ?", type: "text", options: [], required: true },
    { label: "Niveau", type: "choice", options: ["Débutant", "Confirmé"], required: false },
  ]);
  assert.equal("id" in inputs[1], false, "a new question carries no id");
});

test("a round trip of saved rows changes nothing", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    inputsFromDrafts(draftsFromRows(rows)),
    rows.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, label: r.label, type: r.type, options: r.options ?? [], required: r.required })),
  );
});

test("newQuestionDraft: an empty optional text question", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(newQuestionDraft("new-a-1"), { key: "new-a-1", label: "", type: "text", options: [], required: false });
});

test("withQuestionType: a choice starts with two empty options, other types keep what was typed", () => {
  const base = newQuestionDraft("k");
  assert.deepEqual(withQuestionType(base, "choice").options, ["", ""]);
  assert.deepEqual(withQuestionType({ ...base, options: ["Oui"] }, "choice").options, ["Oui", ""]);
  assert.deepEqual(withQuestionType({ ...base, options: ["A", "B", "C"] }, "choice").options, ["A", "B", "C"]);
  const back = withQuestionType({ ...base, type: "choice", options: ["A", "B"] }, "boolean");
  assert.equal(back.type, "boolean");
  assert.deepEqual(back.options, ["A", "B"], "kept in the draft, dropped by inputsFromDrafts");
});

test("moveDraft: swaps with the neighbour, never mutates, ignores the ends", () => {
  const list = ["a", "b", "c"];
  assert.deepEqual(moveDraft(list, 1, -1), ["b", "a", "c"]);
  assert.deepEqual(moveDraft(list, 1, 1), ["a", "c", "b"]);
  assert.deepEqual(moveDraft(list, 0, -1), ["a", "b", "c"]);
  assert.deepEqual(moveDraft(list, 2, 1), ["a", "b", "c"]);
  assert.deepEqual(moveDraft(list, 5, 1), ["a", "b", "c"]);
  assert.deepEqual(list, ["a", "b", "c"]);
});
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { canBecomeFree, rdvErrorField, rdvFormFromType, rdvPatchFromForm, type RdvFormValues } from "./rdv-form";

const NO_OVERRIDES = { bookingHorizonDays: null, minNoticeMinutes: null, cancelDeadlineHours: null };

const type = {
  rdvEnabled: true,
  rdvFree: false,
  rdvDurationMin: 60,
  rdvBufferBeforeMin: 0,
  rdvBufferAfterMin: 10,
  rdvOverrides: NO_OVERRIDES,
};

test("rdvFormFromType: stored values as typed strings, 60 minutes when the type has no duration yet", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(rdvFormFromType(type), {
    enabled: true,
    free: false,
    duration: "60",
    before: "0",
    after: "10",
    overrides: NO_OVERRIDES,
  });
  assert.equal(rdvFormFromType({ ...type, rdvEnabled: false, rdvDurationMin: null }).duration, "60");
});

test("rdvPatchFromForm: RDV off sends rdvFree false and no duration, and touches nothing else", () => {
  const off: RdvFormValues = { ...rdvFormFromType(type), enabled: false, free: true };
  assert.deepEqual(rdvPatchFromForm(off), { ok: true, patch: { rdvEnabled: false, rdvFree: false, rdvDurationMin: null } });
});

test("rdvPatchFromForm: RDV on sends every RDV field", () => {
  const overrides = { bookingHorizonDays: 30, minNoticeMinutes: 120, cancelDeadlineHours: null };
  const on: RdvFormValues = { enabled: true, free: true, duration: " 15 ", before: "5", after: "10", overrides };
  assert.deepEqual(rdvPatchFromForm(on), {
    ok: true,
    patch: {
      rdvEnabled: true,
      rdvFree: true,
      rdvDurationMin: 15,
      rdvBufferBeforeMin: 5,
      rdvBufferAfterMin: 10,
      rdvOverrides: overrides,
    },
  });
});

test("rdvPatchFromForm: whole numbers only, the bounds are the server's", () => {
  const base = rdvFormFromType(type);
  assert.deepEqual(rdvPatchFromForm({ ...base, duration: "" }), {
    ok: false,
    field: "duration",
    error: "Durée du rendez-vous : indiquez un nombre entier.",
  });
  assert.deepEqual(rdvPatchFromForm({ ...base, before: "1.5" }), {
    ok: false,
    field: "before",
    error: "Marge avant : indiquez un nombre entier.",
  });
  assert.deepEqual(rdvPatchFromForm({ ...base, after: "-5" }), {
    ok: false,
    field: "after",
    error: "Marge après : indiquez un nombre entier.",
  });
  assert.equal(rdvPatchFromForm({ ...base, duration: "7" }).ok, true, "7 goes through to the server's « multiple de 5 »");
  assert.equal(rdvPatchFromForm({ ...base, enabled: false, duration: "" }).ok, true, "a hidden field is not checked");
});

test("rdvErrorField: the field a French server message belongs to", () => {
  assert.equal(rdvErrorField("Durée du rendez-vous : minimum 5."), "duration");
  assert.equal(rdvErrorField("Durée du rendez-vous : choisissez un multiple de 5."), "duration");
  assert.equal(rdvErrorField("Marge avant : maximum 240."), "before");
  assert.equal(rdvErrorField("Marge après : maximum 240."), "after");
  assert.equal(rdvErrorField("Le délai minimum dépasse l'horizon de réservation : réduisez-le ou allongez l'horizon."), null);
  assert.equal(rdvErrorField("Ce type a des offres en vente ou des tickets valides : il ne peut pas devenir gratuit."), null);
});

test("canBecomeFree: no offer en vente and no usable ticket", () => {
  assert.equal(canBecomeFree({ offers: [], usableTickets: 0 }), true);
  assert.equal(canBecomeFree({ offers: [{ isActive: false }], usableTickets: 0 }), true, "an offer taken off sale");
  assert.equal(canBecomeFree({ offers: [{ isActive: false }, { isActive: true }], usableTickets: 0 }), false);
  assert.equal(canBecomeFree({ offers: [], usableTickets: 2 }), false);
});

test("rdv form copy carries no em dash or en dash", () => {
  const base = rdvFormFromType(type);
  const texts = [{ ...base, duration: "" }, { ...base, before: "x" }, { ...base, after: "x" }]
    .map((f) => rdvPatchFromForm(f))
    .map((r) => (r.ok ? "" : r.error));
  assert.equal(texts.filter((t) => t !== "").length, 3);
  assert.equal(/[\u2013\u2014]/.test(texts.join(" ")), false);
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The questions editor's model (spec § 13.1): drafts as typed in the form,
 * converted to QuestionInput for setTypeQuestions / editEventInPlace. Pure, so
 * the conversion rules are unit-tested; QuestionsEditor re-exports them.
 */
import type { QuestionRow } from "@/lib/booking/answers";
import type { QuestionInput } from "@/lib/tickets";
import type { QuestionType } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export type QuestionDraft = {
  /** React key: the saved id, or a client-made key for a new question */
  key: string;
  /** set for a saved question only */
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  type: QuestionType;
  options: string[];
  required: boolean;
};

/** Drafts of saved questions (key = id). */
export function draftsFromRows(rows: readonly QuestionRow[]): QuestionDraft[] {
  return rows.map((r) => ({
    key: r.id,
    id: r.id,
    label: r.label,
    type: r.type,
    options: r.options ?? [],
    required: r.required,
  }));
}

/** Inputs for setTypeQuestions / editEventInPlace (trimmed; options only for choice, blanks dropped; id kept for saved ones). */
export function inputsFromDrafts(drafts: readonly QuestionDraft[]): QuestionInput[] {
  return drafts.map((d) => ({
    ...(d.id === undefined ? {} : { id: d.id }),
    label: d.label.trim(),
    type: d.type,
    options: d.type === "choice" ? d.options.map((o) => o.trim()).filter((o) => o !== "") : [],
    required: d.required,
  }));
}

/** « Ajouter une question »: an empty optional text question. */
export function newQuestionDraft(key: string): QuestionDraft {
  return { key, label: "", type: "text", options: [], required: false };
}

/** Changes the answer type; a choice starts with at least two (empty) options. */
export function withQuestionType(draft: QuestionDraft, type: QuestionType): QuestionDraft {
  const missing = type === "choice" ? Math.max(0, 2 - draft.options.length) : 0;
  return { ...draft, type, options: [...draft.options, ...Array.from({ length: missing }, () => "")] };
}

/** A copy of `items` with the item at `index` swapped with its neighbour (unchanged at the ends). */
export function moveDraft<T>(items: readonly T[], index: number, delta: -1 | 1): T[] {
  const target = index + delta;
  const next = [...items];
  if (index < 0 || index >= next.length || target < 0 || target >= next.length) return next;
  [next[index], next[target]] = [next[target], next[index]];
  return next;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the RDV form model**

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/back-office/rdv-form.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The « RDV libre » form's model (spec § 13.1): typed strings converted to the
 * patch of updateTicketTypeAction, plus the « Gratuit » precondition. Pure and
 * unit-tested; the bounds and every business rule stay with the server.
 */
import type { TicketTypePatch } from "@/lib/back-office/catalog-actions";
import type { WindowOverrides } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export type RdvField = "duration" | "before" | "after";

export type RdvFormValues = {
  enabled: boolean;
  free: boolean;
  duration: string;
  before: string;
  after: string;
  overrides: WindowOverrides;
};

export function rdvFormFromType(t: {
  rdvEnabled: boolean;
  rdvFree: boolean;
  rdvDurationMin: number | null;
  rdvBufferBeforeMin: number;
  rdvBufferAfterMin: number;
  rdvOverrides: WindowOverrides;
}): RdvFormValues {
  return {
    enabled: t.rdvEnabled,
    free: t.rdvFree,
    duration: String(t.rdvDurationMin ?? BOUNDS.rdvDurationMin.default),
    before: String(t.rdvBufferBeforeMin),
    after: String(t.rdvBufferAfterMin),
    overrides: t.rdvOverrides,
  };
}

export type RdvPatchResult = { ok: true; patch: TicketTypePatch } | { ok: false; field: RdvField; error: string };

const WHOLE = /^\d+$/;
const whole = (text: string): number | null => (WHOLE.test(text.trim()) ? Number(text.trim()) : null);

/** RDV off sends rdvFree false and no duration; RDV on sends every RDV field. */
export function rdvPatchFromForm(f: RdvFormValues): RdvPatchResult {
  if (!f.enabled) return { ok: true, patch: { rdvEnabled: false, rdvFree: false, rdvDurationMin: null } };
  const duration = whole(f.duration);
  if (duration === null) return { ok: false, field: "duration", error: "Durée du rendez-vous : indiquez un nombre entier." };
  const before = whole(f.before);
  if (before === null) return { ok: false, field: "before", error: "Marge avant : indiquez un nombre entier." };
  const after = whole(f.after);
  if (after === null) return { ok: false, field: "after", error: "Marge après : indiquez un nombre entier." };
  return {
    ok: true,
    patch: {
      rdvEnabled: true,
      rdvFree: f.free,
      rdvDurationMin: duration,
      rdvBufferBeforeMin: before,
      rdvBufferAfterMin: after,
      rdvOverrides: f.overrides,
    },
  };
}

/** The field a French server message belongs to (by its label prefix), null for a general message. */
export function rdvErrorField(error: string): RdvField | null {
  if (error.startsWith("Durée")) return "duration";
  if (error.startsWith("Marge avant")) return "before";
  if (error.startsWith("Marge après")) return "after";
  return null;
}

/** « Gratuit » can be switched on only with no offer en vente and no usable ticket (RDV_FREE_HAS_SALES otherwise). */
export function canBecomeFree(t: { offers: readonly { isActive: boolean }[]; usableTickets: number }): boolean {
  return t.usableTickets === 0 && t.offers.every((o) => !o.isActive);
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef } from "react";
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Plus, X } from "lucide-react";

import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { QUESTION_TYPE_LABELS } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";
import { moveDraft, newQuestionDraft, withQuestionType, type QuestionDraft } from "@/lib/back-office/question-drafts";
import { BOUNDS, QUESTION_TYPES, type QuestionType } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export { draftsFromRows, inputsFromDrafts, type QuestionDraft } from "@/lib/back-office/question-drafts";

/** Questions of a type or an event: add, edit, reorder, remove. Owns no persistence. */
export function QuestionsEditor({
  idPrefix,
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled,
}: {
  idPrefix: string;
  value: QuestionDraft[];
  onChange: (next: QuestionDraft[]) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const counter = useRef(0);

  function update(index: number, next: QuestionDraft) {
    onChange(value.map((d, i) => (i === index ? next : d)));
  }

  function add() {
    counter.current += 1;
    onChange([...value, newQuestionDraft(`new-${idPrefix}-${counter.current}`)]);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {value.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucune question.</p>
      ) : (
        <ol className="space-y-4">
          {value.map((d, index) => {
            const base = `${idPrefix}-${d.key}`;
            return (
              <li key={d.key} className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-border p-4">
                <FormField label="Question" htmlFor={`${base}-label`}>
                  <Input
                    id={`${base}-label`}
                    value={d.label}
                    maxLength={BOUNDS.questionLabel}
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onChange={(e) => update(index, { ...d, label: e.target.value })}
                  />
                </FormField>
                <FormField label="Type de réponse" htmlFor={`${base}-type`}>
                  <Select
                    id={`${base}-type`}
                    value={d.type}
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onChange={(e) => update(index, withQuestionType(d, e.target.value as QuestionType))}
                  >
                    {QUESTION_TYPES.map((t) => (
                      <option key={t} value={t}>
                        {QUESTION_TYPE_LABELS[t]}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </Select>
                </FormField>

                {d.type === "choice" && (
                  <fieldset className="space-y-2" disabled={disabled}>
                    <legend className="mb-1.5 text-sm font-medium">Options</legend>
                    {d.options.map((option, optionIndex) => (
                      <div key={optionIndex} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Input
                          aria-label={`Option ${optionIndex + 1}`}
                          value={option}
                          maxLength={BOUNDS.questionLabel}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            update(index, { ...d, options: d.options.map((o, i) => (i === optionIndex ? e.target.value : o)) })
                          }
                        />
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          aria-label={`Retirer l'option ${optionIndex + 1}`}
                          onClick={() => update(index, { ...d, options: d.options.filter((_, i) => i !== optionIndex) })}
                        >
                          <X />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      disabled={d.options.length >= BOUNDS.questionOptions}
                      onClick={() => update(index, { ...d, options: [...d.options, ""] })}
                    >
                      <Plus />
                      Ajouter une option
                    </Button>
                  </fieldset>
                )}

                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    className="size-4 accent-primary"
                    checked={d.required}
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onChange={(e) => update(index, { ...d, required: e.target.checked })}
                  />
                  Obligatoire pour le client
                </label>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    aria-label="Monter la question"
                    disabled={disabled || index === 0}
                    onClick={() => onChange(moveDraft(value, index, -1))}
                  >
                    <ArrowUp />
                    Monter
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    aria-label="Descendre la question"
                    disabled={disabled || index === value.length - 1}
                    onClick={() => onChange(moveDraft(value, index, 1))}
                  >
                    <ArrowDown />
                    Descendre
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    className="text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 sm:ml-auto"
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onClick={() => onChange(value.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}
                  >
                    <X />
                    Retirer
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      )}
      <Button type="button" variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={disabled || value.length >= BOUNDS.questions} onClick={add}>
        <Plus />
        Ajouter une question
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { NOTICE_PRESETS, noticeLabel } from "@/lib/back-office/notice";
import type { BookingWindow } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import type { WindowOverrides } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

const INHERIT = "inherit";
const CUSTOM = "custom";
const SELECT_CLASS = "w-full sm:w-auto sm:min-w-64";

/**
 * A whole-number field that keeps what is being typed: the parent only receives
 * integers, and the text snaps back to the last valid value on blur.
 */
function OverrideNumber({
  label,
  value,
  min,
  max,
  disabled,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange: (next: number) => void;
}) {
  const [text, setText] = useState(String(value));
  return (
    <Input
      type="number"
      inputMode="numeric"
      aria-label={label}
      min={min}
      max={max}
      step={1}
      className="w-24"
      value={text}
      disabled={disabled}
      onChange={(e) => {
        setText(e.target.value);
        const n = Number(e.target.value);
        if (e.target.value.trim() !== "" && Number.isInteger(n)) onChange(n);
      }}
      onBlur={() => setText(String(value))}
    />
  );
}

/**
 * Horizon, minimum notice and client cancellation overrides of a type or an
 * event. Each row starts with « Comme vos réglages (...) » (null) and offers a
 * custom value. Owns no persistence: the server refuses a notice longer than the
 * horizon (NOTICE_TOO_LONG) when the form is saved.
 */
export function WindowOverrideFields({
  idPrefix,
  value,
  onChange,
  proWindow,
  disabled,
}: {
  idPrefix: string;
  value: WindowOverrides;
  onChange: (next: WindowOverrides) => void;
  proWindow: BookingWindow;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const set = (patch: Partial<WindowOverrides>) => onChange({ ...value, ...patch });
  const notice = value.minNoticeMinutes;
  const noticeIsPreset = notice === null || NOTICE_PRESETS.some((p) => p.minutes === notice);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <FormField label="Réservable jusqu'à" htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-horizon`}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Select
            id={`${idPrefix}-horizon`}
            className={SELECT_CLASS}
            disabled={disabled}
            value={value.bookingHorizonDays === null ? INHERIT : CUSTOM}
            onChange={(e) => set({ bookingHorizonDays: e.target.value === INHERIT ? null : proWindow.bookingHorizonDays })}
          >
            <option value={INHERIT}>{`Comme vos réglages (${plural(proWindow.bookingHorizonDays, "jour", "jours")})`}</option>
            <option value={CUSTOM}>Valeur personnalisée</option>
          </Select>
          {value.bookingHorizonDays !== null && (
            <>
              <OverrideNumber
                label="Nombre de jours"
                value={value.bookingHorizonDays}
                min={BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.min}
                max={BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.max}
                disabled={disabled}
                onChange={(next) => set({ bookingHorizonDays: next })}
              />
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{"jours à l'avance"}</span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </FormField>

      <FormField label="Au plus tard" htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-notice`}>
        <Select
          id={`${idPrefix}-notice`}
          className={SELECT_CLASS}
          disabled={disabled}
          value={notice === null ? INHERIT : String(notice)}
          onChange={(e) => set({ minNoticeMinutes: e.target.value === INHERIT ? null : Number(e.target.value) })}
        >
          <option value={INHERIT}>{`Comme vos réglages (${noticeLabel(proWindow.minNoticeMinutes)})`}</option>
          {!noticeIsPreset && notice !== null && <option value={String(notice)}>{noticeLabel(notice)}</option>}
          {NOTICE_PRESETS.map((p) => (
            <option key={p.minutes} value={String(p.minutes)}>
              {p.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </Select>
      </FormField>

      <FormField label="Annulation par le client jusqu'à" htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-cancel`}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Select
            id={`${idPrefix}-cancel`}
            className={SELECT_CLASS}
            disabled={disabled}
            value={value.cancelDeadlineHours === null ? INHERIT : CUSTOM}
            onChange={(e) => set({ cancelDeadlineHours: e.target.value === INHERIT ? null : proWindow.cancelDeadlineHours })}
          >
            <option value={INHERIT}>{`Comme vos réglages (${proWindow.cancelDeadlineHours} h avant)`}</option>
            <option value={CUSTOM}>Valeur personnalisée</option>
          </Select>
          {value.cancelDeadlineHours !== null && (
            <>
              <OverrideNumber
                label="Nombre d'heures"
                value={value.cancelDeadlineHours}
                min={BOUNDS.cancelDeadlineHours.min}
                max={BOUNDS.cancelDeadlineHours.max}
                disabled={disabled}
                onChange={(next) => set({ cancelDeadlineHours: next })}
              />
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">heures avant le début</span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </FormField>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Check, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { Switch } from "@/components/dashboard/switch";
import { WeeklyHoursEditor, byDayFromRules, rulesFromByDay, type ByDay } from "@/components/dashboard/weekly-hours-editor";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { AvailabilityRuleInput } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { setTypeHoursAction } from "@/server/pro-catalog";

/**
 * Weekly hours of an RDV type. Off: the type follows the general availability.
 * On: its own hours replace them, started from a copy of the general ones.
 */
export function TypeHoursEditor({
  ticketTypeId,
  ownHours,
  globalHours,
}: {
  ticketTypeId: string;
  ownHours: AvailabilityRuleInput[];
  globalHours: AvailabilityRuleInput[];
}) {
  const hadOwn = ownHours.length > 0;
  const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(hadOwn);
  const [byDay, setByDay] = useState<ByDay>(() => byDayFromRules(hadOwn ? ownHours : globalHours));
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState<"save" | "revert" | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  function run(kind: "save" | "revert", rules: AvailabilityRuleInput[]) {
    setError(null);
    setSaved(false);
    setRunning(kind);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await setTypeHoursAction({ ticketTypeId, rules });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      if (kind === "revert") {
        setByDay(byDayFromRules(globalHours));
        setEnabled(false);
      } else {
        setSaved(true);
      }
    });
  }

  function save() {
    const rules = rulesFromByDay(byDay);
    if (rules.length === 0) {
      setError("Ajoutez au moins une plage horaire, ou revenez aux disponibilités générales.");
      return;
    }
    if (rules.some((r) => !Number.isInteger(r.startMinute) || !Number.isInteger(r.endMinute))) {
      setError("Une plage horaire est incomplète.");
      return;
    }
    run("save", rules);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Switch
        id={`${ticketTypeId}-own-hours`}
        checked={enabled}
        onCheckedChange={(value) => {
          setEnabled(value);
          setSaved(false);
          setError(null);
        }}
        label="Horaires propres à ce type"
        disabled={pending}
      />

      {enabled ? (
        <>
          <div className="-mx-1 overflow-x-auto px-1">
            <WeeklyHoursEditor
              value={byDay}
              onChange={(next) => {
                setByDay(next);
                setSaved(false);
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <FormError message={error} />
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Button type="button" onClick={save} disabled={pending}>
              {pending && running === "save" && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
              Enregistrer les horaires
            </Button>
            {saved && (
              <span role="status" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-success">
                <Check className="size-4" />
                Enregistré
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Ce type suit vos disponibilités générales.</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
              <Link href="/dashboard/availability">Voir mes disponibilités</Link>
            </Button>
            {hadOwn && (
              <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={pending} onClick={() => run("revert", [])}>
                {pending && running === "revert" && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
                Revenir aux disponibilités générales
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          <FormError message={error} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** « RDV libre »: the option, duration, margins, « Gratuit » and the booking rules of the type. */
export function RdvSettingsForm({
  ticketTypeId,
  initial,
  proWindow,
  canBecomeFree,
}: {
  ticketTypeId: string;
  initial: {
    rdvEnabled: boolean;
    rdvFree: boolean;
    rdvDurationMin: number | null;
    rdvBufferBeforeMin: number;
    rdvBufferAfterMin: number;
    rdvOverrides: WindowOverrides;
  };
  proWindow: BookingWindow;
  canBecomeFree: boolean;
}) {
  const uid = useId();
  const [values, setValues] = useState<RdvFormValues>(() => rdvFormFromType(initial));
  const [error, setError] = useState<{ field: RdvField | null; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  // The rules block starts open when the type already overrides something.
  const [rulesOpen] = useState(() => Object.values(initial.rdvOverrides).some((v) => v !== null));

  const set = <K extends keyof RdvFormValues>(key: K, value: RdvFormValues[K]) => {
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
    setSaved(false);
  };
  const under = (field: RdvField): string | null => (error !== null && error.field === field ? error.message : null);
  const general = error !== null && error.field === null ? error.message : null;
  const freeLocked = !canBecomeFree && !initial.rdvFree;

  function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const built = rdvPatchFromForm(values);
    if (!built.ok) {
      setError({ field: built.field, message: built.error });
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSaved(false);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await updateTicketTypeAction({ ticketTypeId, patch: built.patch });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError({ field: rdvErrorField(res.error), message: res.error });
        return;
      }
      setSaved(true);
    });
  }

  // The three number fields share their props: duration, margin before, margin after.
  const numberField = (field: RdvField, min: number, max: number) => ({
    id: `${uid}-${field}`,
    type: "number" as const,
    inputMode: "numeric" as const,
    min,
    max,
    step: 5,
    className: "w-28",
    value: values[field],
    onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => set(field, e.target.value),
    "aria-invalid": under(field) !== null ? true : undefined,
    "aria-describedby": under(field) !== null ? `${uid}-${field}-error` : undefined,
  });

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-5">
      <Switch
        id={`${uid}-enabled`}
        checked={values.enabled}
        onCheckedChange={(value) => set("enabled", value)}
        label="Réservable en RDV libre"
        description="Vos clients choisissent un créneau dans vos disponibilités."
      />

      {values.enabled && (
        <>
          <FormField label="Durée" htmlFor={`${uid}-duration`} error={under("duration")}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Input {...numberField("duration", BOUNDS.rdvDurationMin.min, BOUNDS.rdvDurationMin.max)} />
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">min</span>
            </div>
          </FormField>
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <FormField label="Marge avant" htmlFor={`${uid}-before`} error={under("before")}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Input {...numberField("before", BOUNDS.rdvBufferMin.min, BOUNDS.rdvBufferMin.max)} />
                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">min</span>
              </div>
            </FormField>
            <FormField label="Marge après" htmlFor={`${uid}-after`} error={under("after")}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Input {...numberField("after", BOUNDS.rdvBufferMin.min, BOUNDS.rdvBufferMin.max)} />
                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">min</span>
              </div>
            </FormField>
          </div>
          <p className="-mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Temps libre réservé avant ou après chaque rendez-vous.</p>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Switch
              id={`${uid}-free`}
              checked={values.free}
              onCheckedChange={(value) => set("free", value)}
              label="Gratuit"
              description="Sans ticket ni paiement, par exemple un appel découverte."
              disabled={freeLocked}
            />
            {freeLocked && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{FREE_LOCKED_HELP}</p>}
          </div>

          <details open={rulesOpen} className="rounded-xl border border-border">
            <summary className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring">
              Règles de réservation de ce type
            </summary>
            <div className="border-t border-border p-4">
              <WindowOverrideFields
                idPrefix={`${uid}-rules`}
                value={values.overrides}
                onChange={(next) => set("overrides", next)}
                proWindow={proWindow}
              />
            </div>
          </details>
        </>
      )}

      <FormError message={general} />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
          {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
          Enregistrer le RDV libre
        </Button>
        {saved && (
          <span role="status" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-success">
            <Check className="size-4" />
            Enregistré
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

/** Questions asked when a client books an RDV of this type. */
export function TypeQuestionsForm({ ticketTypeId, questions }: { ticketTypeId: string; questions: QuestionRow[] }) {
  const uid = useId();
  const signature = JSON.stringify(questions);
  const [seenSignature, setSeenSignature] = useState(signature);
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState<QuestionDraft[]>(() => draftsFromRows(questions));
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  // After a save the page re-reads the questions (new ids for the new ones): follow the server then, never on an unrelated refresh.
  if (signature !== seenSignature) {
    setSeenSignature(signature);
    setDrafts(draftsFromRows(questions));
  }

  function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    setError(null);
    setSaved(false);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await setTypeQuestionsAction({ ticketTypeId, questions: inputsFromDrafts(drafts) });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setSaved(true);
    });
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{QUESTIONS_HELP}</p>
      <QuestionsEditor
        idPrefix={`${uid}-questions`}
        value={drafts}
        onChange={(next) => {
          setDrafts(next);
          setSaved(false);
        }}
        disabled={pending}
      />
      <FormError message={error} />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
          {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
          Enregistrer les questions
        </Button>
        {saved && (
          <span role="status" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-success">
            <Check className="size-4" />
            Enregistré
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```ts
test("previewDates starts at local today in the pro's zone, whatever the host zone", () => {
  // 2026-10-14 22:30Z = Thursday 15 October 00:30 in Paris, Wednesday 14 October 15:30 in Los Angeles
  const now = new Date("2026-10-14T22:30:00.000Z");
  const daily = rule({ startDate: "2026-10-01", startMinute: 600, freq: "daily", interval: 1, weekdays: null });
  const paris = previewDates(daily, 90, PARIS, now, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(
    paris.map((d) => d.seriesDate),
    ["2026-10-15", "2026-10-16", "2026-10-17"],
  );
  assert.equal(paris[0].startsAt.toISOString(), "2026-10-15T08:00:00.000Z");
  assert.equal(paris[0].endsAt.toISOString(), "2026-10-15T09:30:00.000Z");
  const la = previewDates(daily, 90, LA, now, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(
    la.map((d) => d.seriesDate),
    ["2026-10-14", "2026-10-15", "2026-10-16"],
  );
  assert.equal(la[0].startsAt.toISOString(), "2026-10-14T17:00:00.000Z");
});

  assert.deepEqual(
    future.map((d) => d.seriesDate),
    ["2026-11-02", "2026-11-09"],
  );
  const short = previewDates(rule({ weekdays: [1, 3], endMode: "count", occurrenceCount: 2 }), 60, PARIS, now, 5);
  assert.deepEqual(
    short.map((d) => d.seriesDate),
    ["2026-10-14", "2026-10-19"],
  );
  const ended = previewDates(rule({ startDate: "2026-09-01", endMode: "until", untilDate: "2026-09-30" }), 60, PARIS, now, 5);
  assert.deepEqual(ended, []);
  assert.deepEqual(previewDates(rule({ weekdays: [] }), 60, PARIS, now, 5), []);
  assert.deepEqual(previewDates(rule({}), 60, PARIS, now, 0), []);
  const yearly = previewDates(
    rule({ startDate: "2026-01-31", freq: "monthly", interval: 12, weekdays: null, monthlyBy: "day_of_month" }),
    60,

    now,

  );

  );
});
```

Create the file with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Recurrence form model (pure, client-safe). The editor works on a flat
 * `RecurrenceFormValue`; this module converts it to and from the engine rule
 * (`recurrenceRuleSchema`), offers the monthly choices (Q11), the preview dates
 * and the daylight-saving notes (Q12). Every function that reads a clock or a
 * calendar day takes `tz` explicitly: the host zone never matters.
 */
import {
  addDays,
  addMonthsClamped,
  dayOfWeek,
  daysInMonth,
  formatDayMonth,
  instantAt,
  parseKey,
  todayKey,
  type DateKey,
} from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { wallClockMinutes } from "@/lib/datetime";
import { describeRecurrence, dstNotes, expand, monthlyDayWarning, type RecurrenceRule } from "@/lib/recurrence";
import { recurrenceRuleSchema, type RecurrenceRuleInput } from "@/lib/tickets";
import type { RecurrenceEnd, RecurrenceFreq } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

import { WEEKDAY_NAMES } from "./labels";

export type MonthlyChoice = "day_of_month" | "weekday_nth" | "weekday_last";

export type RecurrenceFormValue = {
  startDate: DateKey;
  /** "HH:MM" */
  startTime: string;
  durationMin: number;
  freq: RecurrenceFreq;
  interval: number;
  weekdays: number[];
  monthlyChoice: MonthlyChoice;
  endMode: RecurrenceEnd;
  /** "" while the date field is empty */
  untilDate: DateKey | "";
  occurrenceCount: number;
};

const TIME_PATTERN = /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)$/;
const DEFAULT_DURATION_MIN = 60;
const DEFAULT_OCCURRENCE_COUNT = 10;
const DEFAULT_UNTIL_MONTHS = 3;
/** previewDates looks this far ahead of local today (a yearly rule still shows its next dates). */
const PREVIEW_HORIZON_DAYS = 1830;

const NTH_LABELS: Readonly<Record<number, string>> = { 1: "1er", 2: "2e", 3: "3e", 4: "4e" };

/** 1140 → "19:00" (clamped to 00:00..23:59). */
export function minuteToTime(minute: number): string {
  const m = Number.isFinite(minute) ? Math.min(1439, Math.max(0, Math.trunc(minute))) : 0;
  return `${String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

/** "19:00" → 1140; anything else → null. */
export function timeToMinute(time: string): number | null {
  const match = TIME_PATTERN.exec(time);
  return match ? Number(match[1]) * 60 + Number(match[2]) : null;
}

function isDateKey(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    parseKey(value);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** ceil(day / 7) of a valid date: 1..5. */
function nthOfDate(startDate: DateKey): number {
  return Math.ceil(parseKey(startDate).d / 7);
}

/** True when no later date of the month falls on the same weekday. */
function isLastWeekdayOfMonth(startDate: DateKey): boolean {
  const { y, m, d } = parseKey(startDate);
  return d + 7 > daysInMonth(y, m);
}

/**
 * Defaults: freq once, interval 1, weekdays [weekday of startDate], monthly by
 * day, end never, count 10, until = startDate + 3 months (clamped), duration 60
 * unless given.
 */
export function defaultRecurrenceForm(
  start: { startDate: DateKey; startMinute: number },
  durationMin: number = DEFAULT_DURATION_MIN,
): RecurrenceFormValue {
  return {
    startDate: start.startDate,
    startTime: minuteToTime(start.startMinute),
    durationMin,
    freq: "once",
    interval: 1,
    weekdays: [dayOfWeek(start.startDate)],
    monthlyChoice: "day_of_month",
    endMode: "never",
    untilDate: addMonthsClamped(start.startDate, DEFAULT_UNTIL_MONTHS),
    occurrenceCount: DEFAULT_OCCURRENCE_COUNT,
  };
}

/**
 * The form of a saved rule (monthWeek -1 → weekday_last, 1..4 → weekday_nth).
 * A once rule gives the defaults of the other fields (end never, count 10), so
 * that switching the editor to « Toutes les semaines » starts from sensible values.
 */
export function formFromRule(rule: RecurrenceRuleInput, durationMin: number): RecurrenceFormValue {
  const base = defaultRecurrenceForm({ startDate: rule.startDate, startMinute: rule.startMinute }, durationMin);
  if (rule.freq === "once") return base;
  let monthlyChoice: MonthlyChoice = "day_of_month";
  if (rule.freq === "monthly" && rule.monthlyBy === "weekday") {
    if (rule.monthWeek === -1) monthlyChoice = "weekday_last";
    else if (rule.monthWeek !== null) monthlyChoice = "weekday_nth";
  }
  return {
    ...base,
    freq: rule.freq,
    interval: rule.interval,
    weekdays: rule.weekdays && rule.weekdays.length > 0 ? [...rule.weekdays].sort((a, b) => a - b) : base.weekdays,
    monthlyChoice,
    endMode: rule.endMode,
    untilDate: rule.untilDate ?? base.untilDate,
    occurrenceCount: rule.occurrenceCount ?? base.occurrenceCount,
  };
}

/**
 * Q11 choices for a monthly series starting on startDate: the day of the month
 * always; the nth weekday when nth ≤ 4; the last weekday when no later date of
 * the month falls on that weekday. `[]` when startDate is not a valid date (the
 * date field shows its own error).
 */
export function monthlyChoices(startDate: DateKey): { value: MonthlyChoice; label: string }[] {
  if (!isDateKey(startDate)) return [];
  const { d } = parseKey(startDate);
  const weekday = WEEKDAY_NAMES[dayOfWeek(startDate)];
  const choices: { value: MonthlyChoice; label: string }[] = [
    { value: "day_of_month", label: d === 1 ? "Le 1er de chaque mois" : `Le ${d} de chaque mois` },
  ];
  const nth = nthOfDate(startDate);
  if (nth <= 4) choices.push({ value: "weekday_nth", label: `Le ${NTH_LABELS[nth]} ${weekday} de chaque mois` });
  if (isLastWeekdayOfMonth(startDate)) {
    choices.push({ value: "weekday_last", label: `Le dernier ${weekday} de chaque mois` });
  }
  return choices;
}

/** The choice itself when startDate offers it, else "day_of_month" (a start date changed under a stale choice). */
export function normalizeMonthlyChoice(startDate: DateKey, choice: MonthlyChoice): MonthlyChoice {
  return monthlyChoices(startDate).some((c) => c.value === choice) ? choice : "day_of_month";
}

/**
 * The engine rule: nulls set per freq / endMode exactly as recurrenceRuleSchema
 * wants (once ⇒ interval 1, count 1), weekdays deduped and sorted ascending,
 * monthWeek deduced from startDate (nth = ceil(day / 7); last = -1). Null only
 * when startTime is not "HH:MM" or startDate is not a date: any other mistake
 * (no weekday, until before the start...) still yields a rule, so that the
 * caller gets the French field message from `parseFr(recurrenceRuleSchema, rule)`.
 */
export function ruleFromForm(v: RecurrenceFormValue): { rule: RecurrenceRuleInput; durationMin: number } | null {
  const startMinute = timeToMinute(v.startTime);
  if (startMinute === null || !isDateKey(v.startDate)) return null;
  const base = { startDate: v.startDate, startMinute };

  if (v.freq === "once") {
    return {
      rule: {
        ...base,
        freq: "once",
        interval: 1,
        weekdays: null,
        monthlyBy: null,
        monthWeek: null,
        endMode: "count",
        untilDate: null,
        occurrenceCount: 1,
      },
      durationMin: v.durationMin,
    };
  }

  const choice = normalizeMonthlyChoice(v.startDate, v.monthlyChoice);
  const nth = nthOfDate(v.startDate);
  let monthWeek: RecurrenceRuleInput["monthWeek"] = null;
  if (v.freq === "monthly" && choice === "weekday_last") monthWeek = -1;
  else if (v.freq === "monthly" && choice === "weekday_nth" && (nth === 1 || nth === 2 || nth === 3 || nth === 4)) {
    monthWeek = nth;
  }

  return {
    rule: {
      ...base,
      freq: v.freq,
      interval: v.interval,
      weekdays: v.freq === "weekly" ? [...new Set(v.weekdays)].sort((a, b) => a - b) : null,
      monthlyBy: v.freq === "monthly" ? (choice === "day_of_month" ? "day_of_month" : "weekday") : null,
      monthWeek,
      endMode: v.endMode,
      untilDate: v.endMode === "until" && v.untilDate !== "" ? v.untilDate : null,
      occurrenceCount: v.endMode === "count" ? v.occurrenceCount : null,
    },
    durationMin: v.durationMin,
  };
}

/** The next `limit` séances from local today (pro tz) of the rule, for the preview. `[]` for a rule the schema refuses. */
export function previewDates(
  rule: RecurrenceRuleInput,
  durationMin: number,
  tz: string,
  now: Date,
  limit: number,
): { seriesDate: DateKey; startsAt: Date; endsAt: Date }[] {
  if (limit <= 0 || !recurrenceRuleSchema.safeParse(rule).success) return [];
  const from = todayKey(now, tz);
  const full: RecurrenceRule = { ...rule, durationMin };
  return expand(full, tz, from, addDays(from, PREVIEW_HORIZON_DAYS)).slice(0, limit);
}

/** Q12 notes for the dates whose start is shifted (spring) or repeated (autumn) in tz. */
export function dstNoteTexts(
  rule: RecurrenceRuleInput,
  durationMin: number,
  tz: string,
  dates: readonly DateKey[],
): string[] {
  const full: RecurrenceRule = { ...rule, durationMin };
  const planned = minuteToTime(rule.startMinute);
  return dstNotes(full, tz, dates).map(({ seriesDate, kind }) => {
    const day = formatDayMonth(seriesDate);
    if (kind === "shifted") {
      const real = minuteToTime(wallClockMinutes(instantAt(seriesDate, rule.startMinute, tz), tz));
      return `Le ${day}, ${planned} n'existe pas (heure d'été) : la séance commence à ${real}.`;
    }
    return `Le ${day}, ${planned} existe deux fois (heure d'hiver) : la séance a lieu à la première.`;
  });
}

/** describeRecurrence and monthlyDayWarning of the form; null when the form is not a valid rule. */
export function recurrenceSummary(v: RecurrenceFormValue): { label: string; warning: string | null } | null {
  const built = ruleFromForm(v);
  if (!built || !recurrenceRuleSchema.safeParse(built.rule).success) return null;
  const full: RecurrenceRule = { ...built.rule, durationMin: built.durationMin };
  return { label: describeRecurrence(full), warning: monthlyDayWarning(full) };
}
```

```ts
test("the pro's zone decides, not the host's: a Los Angeles pro at Paris midnight", () => {
  // 2026-10-14 22:00Z = 2026-10-15 00:00 in Paris and 2026-10-14 15:00 in Los Angeles
  const now = new Date("2026-10-14T22:00:00.000Z");
  assert.deepEqual(defaultEventStart({ now, tz: LA }), { startDate: "2026-10-14", startMinute: 960 });
  assert.deepEqual(defaultEventStart({ now, tz: PARIS }), { startDate: "2026-10-15", startMinute: 60 });

});

  // Sunday 25 October 2026: 03:00 summer time becomes 02:00 winter time at 01:00Z.
  assert.deepEqual(defaultEventStart({ now: new Date("2026-10-25T00:30:00.000Z"), tz: PARIS }), {
    startDate: "2026-10-25",

  assert.deepEqual(defaultEventStart({ now: new Date("2026-10-25T22:30:00.000Z"), tz: PARIS }), {

  });

test("parseClickedCell accepts a date and a minute", () => {

test("parseClickedCell rejects bad values", () => {
  const bad: { date?: string | string[]; minute?: string | string[] }[] = [
```

```ts
/**
 * Defaults of the « Nouvel événement » form (pure, client-safe): the new
 * event's values and the start proposed to the pro (Q10). Dates are civil
 * `DateKey`s and minutes from local midnight in the pro's zone; the browser's
 * zone never enters.
 */
import { addDays, parseKey, todayKey, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { wallClockMinutes } from "@/lib/datetime";
import { DEFAULT_COLOR } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export const EVENT_DEFAULTS = {
  durationMin: 60,
  capacity: 12,
  bookingMode: "tickets",
  color: DEFAULT_COLOR,
} as const;

/** Tomorrow's proposed start when today has no full hour left (09:00). */
const TOMORROW_MINUTE = 540;
/** The last full hour proposed today (23:00). */
const LAST_PROPOSED_MINUTE = 1380;

/**
 * Q10: the clicked planning cell when its date is today or later (minute
 * rounded down to 30), else the next full hour today when it is at most 23:00,
 * else tomorrow 09:00.
 */
export function defaultEventStart(args: {
  now: Date;
  tz: string;
  clicked?: { date: DateKey; minute: number } | null;
}): { startDate: DateKey; startMinute: number } {
  const today = todayKey(args.now, args.tz);
  const { clicked } = args;
  if (clicked && clicked.date >= today) {
    return { startDate: clicked.date, startMinute: Math.floor(clicked.minute / 30) * 30 };
  }
  const nextHour = (Math.floor(wallClockMinutes(args.now, args.tz) / 60) + 1) * 60;
  if (nextHour <= LAST_PROPOSED_MINUTE) return { startDate: today, startMinute: nextHour };
  return { startDate: addDays(today, 1), startMinute: TOMORROW_MINUTE };
}

/** ?date=YYYY-MM-DD&minute=0..1439 of /dashboard/events/new; anything malformed → null. */
export function parseClickedCell(params: {
  date?: string | string[];
  minute?: string | string[];
}): { date: DateKey; minute: number } | null {
  const { date, minute } = params;
  if (typeof date !== "string" || typeof minute !== "string") return null;
  if (!/^\d{1,4}$/.test(minute)) return null;
  const value = Number(minute);
  if (value > 1439) return null;
  try {
    parseKey(date);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  return { date, minute: value };
}
```
