  ```ts
  // src/lib/back-office/event-reads.ts
  export type EventListRow = { eventId: string; seriesRootId: string; title: string; color: string; bookingMode: BookingMode; isPrivate: boolean; recurrenceLabel: string; acceptedTypes: { id: string; name: string; color: string; archived: boolean }[]; nextOccurrence: { id: string; startsAt: Date } | null; noActiveType: boolean };
  export type EventSegmentView = { eventId: string; recurrenceLabel: string; firstDate: DateKey; lastDate: DateKey | null; archived: boolean };
  export type DeletePreview = { fromDate: DateKey; deleteWhole: boolean; deletedSeances: number; cancelledSeances: number; registrants: number; ticketsReturned: number };
  export type EventEditorData = { /* see the file */ };
  export type EventEditorLookup = { kind: "ok"; data: EventEditorData } | { kind: "redirect"; eventId: string } | null;
  export async function listEvents(db: Db, professionalId: string, now: Date): Promise<{ live: EventListRow[]; ended: EventListRow[] }>;
  export async function getEventEditor(db: Db, professionalId: string, eventId: string, now: Date): Promise<EventEditorLookup>;
  export async function countRdvConflicts(db: Db, professionalId: string, ranges: readonly { startsAt: Date; endsAt: Date }[]): Promise<number>;
  export async function deleteFromPreview(db: Db, professionalId: string, eventId: string, fromDate: DateKey, now: Date): Promise<DeletePreview | null>;
  // src/server/catalog-queries.ts (added)
  export async function getEventsPage(professionalId: string): Promise<{ live: EventListRow[]; ended: EventListRow[] }>;
  export async function getEventEditorPage(professionalId: string, eventId: string): Promise<EventEditorLookup>;
  ```
- Behaviour the code implements (each point has a test below):
  - Q9 current segment of a series: the non-archived segment owning the next scheduled séance (`starts_at > now`), else the non-archived one with the latest `start_date`, else the latest one. After a split the old segment keeps only past rows, so the new one is current; the old id redirects.
  - `fromDate` is the `series_date` of the first scheduled séance of the current segment after `now`. A cancelled séance is not a séance to come. `null` when the event is read-only or has none.
  - `futureRegistrants` and `DeletePreview.registrants` count confirmed bookings and pending holds that have not lapsed at `now` (a lapsed hold is warned by nothing: Decision 11). `futureRegistrants` leaves out séances that carry their own `location_override`, because `editEventInPlace` does not mail them about a change of place.
  - `deleteFromPreview` mirrors `deleteSeriesFrom` (src/lib/booking/series.ts): rows of the segment with `series_date >= fromDate`, never-booked ones deleted, scheduled ones with a booking history cancelled, `deleteWhole` = never booked, no row before `fromDate`, no other segment rooted on it. `null` for an unknown, other pro's or archived segment (the engine refuses an archived one too).
  - Every query filters on `professional_id` (cross-tenant test).

```ts
} from "../../test/rows";

import { addDays } from "../civil-date";
import type { Db } from "../db/atomic";
import { event, occurrence } from "../db/schema";

import {
  countRdvConflicts,
  deleteFromPreview,
  getEventEditor,
  listEvents,
  type EventEditorData,
  type EventEditorLookup,
} from "./event-reads";

const DAY = 86_400_000;

function must<T extends { ok: boolean }>(res: T, what: string): asserts res is Extract<T, { ok: true }> {
  assert.ok(res.ok, `${what}: ${JSON.stringify(res)}`);
}

function editorOf(lookup: EventEditorLookup): EventEditorData {
  assert.ok(lookup !== null && lookup.kind === "ok", `expected an editor, got ${JSON.stringify(lookup)}`);
  return lookup.data;
}

const weekly = (
  startDate: string,
  weekdays: number[],
  extra: Partial<RecurrenceRuleInput> = {},
): RecurrenceRuleInput => ({
  startDate,
  startMinute: 600,
  freq: "weekly",
  interval: 1,
  weekdays,
  monthlyBy: null,
  monthWeek: null,
  endMode: "never",
  untilDate: null,
  occurrenceCount: null,
  ...extra,
});

/** A Mon / Wed / Fri 10:00 series created 14 days ago, so that séances exist before now. */
async function pastSeries({ db, pro }: DbHarness, now: Date, title = "Série passée") {
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro);
  const { eventId } = await makeEvent(
    db,
    pro,
    { title, ticketTypeIds: [typeId], rule: weekly(dayIn(pro, -14, now), [1, 3, 5]) },
    addDaysMs(now, -14),
  );
  return { typeId, eventId };
}

/** The first scheduled séance of the event after `now`. */
async function firstFuture(db: Db, eventId: string, now: Date) {
  const row = (await occurrencesOf(db, eventId)).find((o) => o.status === "scheduled" && o.startsAt.getTime() > now.getTime());
  assert.ok(row, "a séance after now");
  return row;
}

  assert.equal(fresh.fromDate, next.seriesDate);
  assert.equal(fresh.remainingCount, null);

  assert.equal(fresh.otherSegments.length, 1);
  const previous = fresh.otherSegments[0];
  assert.equal(previous.eventId, eventId);
  assert.equal(previous.archived, false);
  assert.equal(previous.firstDate, dayIn(pro, -14, now));
  assert.equal(previous.lastDate, addDays(d, -1));
  assert.match(previous.recurrenceLabel, /^Toutes les semaines le lundi, le mercredi et le vendredi, jusqu'au \d{2}\/\d{2}(\/\d{4})?$/);
});

dbTest("getEventEditor: an archived series opens read-only and is listed as ended", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();

    "register",

  must(
    await deleteSeriesFrom(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, eventId, seenVersion: 1, fromDate: start }, now),
    "archive by deleting from the first séance",

  const { live, ended } = await listEvents(db, pro.proId, now);

    ended.map((r) => [r.eventId, r.title, r.nextOccurrence]),

  assert.equal(data.remainingCount, null);

dbTest("getEventEditor: typeOptions without archived or rdv_free types; linked archived types apart", async ({ db, pro }) => {

  );

});

dbTest("countRdvConflicts: scheduled RDV overlapping a range, buffers included; cancelled ones and touching ends ignored", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const typeId = await rowRdvType(db, pro);
  const base = new Date(Date.now() + 5 * DAY);
  base.setUTCMinutes(0, 0, 0);
  const at = (minutes: number) => new Date(base.getTime() + minutes * 60_000);
  const range = (fromMin: number, toMin: number) => ({ startsAt: at(fromMin), endsAt: at(toMin) });

  // A 10:00-11:00; B 12:00-13:00 with 15 min buffers (block 11:45-13:15); C 14:00-15:00 cancelled
  const a = await rowRdv(db, pro, typeId, { startsAt: at(600), durationMin: 60 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: a, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro) });
  const b = await rowRdv(db, pro, typeId, { startsAt: at(720), durationMin: 60 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: b, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro) });
  await db
    .update(occurrence)
    .set({ blockStart: at(705), blockEnd: at(795) })
    .where(eq(occurrence.id, b));
  await rowRdv(db, pro, typeId, { startsAt: at(840), durationMin: 60, status: "cancelled", seatsTaken: 0 });

  assert.equal(await countRdvConflicts(db, pro.proId, []), 0);
  assert.equal(await countRdvConflicts(db, pro.proId, [range(630, 690)]), 1, "inside A");
  assert.equal(await countRdvConflicts(db, pro.proId, [range(660, 690)]), 0, "starts where A ends");
  assert.equal(await countRdvConflicts(db, pro.proId, [range(660, 710)]), 1, "reaches B's buffer, not B");
  assert.equal(await countRdvConflicts(db, pro.proId, [range(840, 900)]), 0, "the cancelled RDV");
  assert.equal(await countRdvConflicts(db, pro.proId, [range(630, 690), range(750, 780)]), 2, "A and B");
  assert.equal(await countRdvConflicts(db, pro.proId, [range(630, 640), range(640, 650)]), 1, "one RDV hit by two ranges counts once");
});

dbTest("another pro sees none of it: list, editor, delete preview and RDV conflicts", async ({ db, pro }) => {

});

dbTest("deleteFromPreview: a never-booked event is deleted whole, as deleteSeriesFrom then reports", async ({ db, pro }) => {

dbTest("deleteFromPreview and the editor: a booked series, cancelled séances, registrants and tickets, as deleteSeriesFrom then reports", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;
  const now = new Date();
  const { typeId, eventId } = await pastSeries(h, now);
  const future = (await occurrencesOf(db, eventId)).filter((o) => o.startsAt.getTime() > now.getTime());
  const d = future[0].seriesDate ?? "";
  const withTicket = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, withTicket, typeId, 1);
  const guest = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  const book = (occurrenceId: string, customerId: string, asGuest: boolean) =>
    registerPro(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId, customerId, asGuest });
  must(await book(future[0].id, withTicket, false), "ticket booking");
  must(await book(future[0].id, guest, true), "guest booking");
  must(await book(future[1].id, guest, true), "second guest booking");

  const expected = { fromDate: d, deleteWhole: false, deletedSeances: future.length - 2, cancelledSeances: 2, registrants: 3, ticketsReturned: 1 };
  assert.deepEqual(await deleteFromPreview(db, pro.proId, eventId, d, now), expected);

  const data = editorOf(await getEventEditor(db, pro.proId, eventId, now));
  assert.equal(data.futureRegistrants, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(data.deletePreview, expected);
  assert.deepEqual(
    data.upcoming.slice(0, 2).map((u) => u.seatsTaken),
    [2, 1],
  );

  // a séance with its own place is not warned by a change of the event's place
  await db.update(occurrence).set({ locationOverride: "Ailleurs" }).where(eq(occurrence.id, future[1].id));
  assert.equal(editorOf(await getEventEditor(db, pro.proId, eventId, now)).futureRegistrants, 2);

  const res = await deleteSeriesFrom(
    db,
    { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, eventId, seenVersion: 1, fromDate: d },
    now,
  );
  must(res, "delete from the first séance to come");
  assert.equal(res.deletedEvent, expected.deleteWhole);
  assert.equal(res.cancelledOccurrences, expected.cancelledSeances);
  assert.equal(res.deletedOccurrences, expected.deletedSeances);
  const [ticket] = await ticketsOf(db, withTicket);
  assert.equal(ticket.status, "available", "the ticket is back, as the preview said");
});
```

Create the file with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Event reads (spec § 13.1, Q9): the events list (one row per series, on its
 * current segment), the editor data of a segment, the RDV conflicts of a set of
 * dates and the preview of « Supprimer à partir du ». Plain functions of
 * `(db, professionalId, ..., now)`: no session, no Next, no server-only, so the
 * DB tests call them directly. Every query filters on `professional_id`.
 */
import { and, asc, eq, gt, gte, inArray, isNull, sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";

import { listActiveTypeOptions, readProWindow, type TypeOption } from "@/lib/back-office/catalog-reads";
import { loadQuestions, type QuestionRow } from "@/lib/booking/answers";
import { ruleOf, type EventRow } from "@/lib/booking/occurrences";
import type { BookingWindow } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import type { DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { ts, tsArray, type Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, event, eventTicketType, occurrence, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { describeRecurrence, lastSeriesDate, remainingCount } from "@/lib/recurrence";
import type { BookingMode, OccurrenceStatus, RecurrenceRuleInput, WindowOverrides } from "@/lib/tickets";

/* ───────────────────────────── Types ───────────────────────────── */

export type EventListRow = {
  /** The current segment (Q9). */
  eventId: string;
  seriesRootId: string;
  title: string;
  color: string;
  bookingMode: BookingMode;
  isPrivate: boolean;
  recurrenceLabel: string;
  acceptedTypes: { id: string; name: string; color: string; archived: boolean }[];
  nextOccurrence: { id: string; startsAt: Date } | null;
  /** tickets mode and no non-archived linked type */
  noActiveType: boolean;
};

export type EventSegmentView = {
  eventId: string;
  recurrenceLabel: string;
  firstDate: DateKey;
  lastDate: DateKey | null;
  archived: boolean;
};

export type DeletePreview = {
  fromDate: DateKey;
  deleteWhole: boolean;
  deletedSeances: number;
  cancelledSeances: number;
  registrants: number;
  ticketsReturned: number;
};

export type EventEditorData = {
  event: {
    id: string;
    seriesRootId: string;
    version: number;
    title: string;
    description: string | null;
    location: string | null;
    color: string;
    bookingMode: BookingMode;
    isPrivate: boolean;
    capacity: number;
    durationMin: number;
    overrides: WindowOverrides;
    ticketTypeIds: string[];
    questions: QuestionRow[];
    rule: RecurrenceRuleInput;
    recurrenceLabel: string;
    archived: boolean;
  };
  /** The segment is archived (every segment of the root is). */
  readOnly: boolean;
  /** series_date of the first scheduled séance of this segment with starts_at > now (the cut d). */
  fromDate: DateKey | null;
  /** remainingCount(ruleOf(event), fromDate) in count mode. */
  remainingCount: number | null;
  /** The next 10 séances (scheduled or cancelled) of this segment. */
  upcoming: { id: string; startsAt: Date; endsAt: Date; status: OccurrenceStatus; seatsTaken: number; capacity: number }[];
  /** Same root, other segments, by firstDate. */
  otherSegments: EventSegmentView[];
  /** Active and not rdv_free. */
  typeOptions: TypeOption[];
  linkedArchivedTypes: { id: string; name: string }[];
  /** Live bookings that a change of place would warn: future scheduled séances without their own place. */
  futureRegistrants: number;
  /** deleteFromPreview(fromDate) when fromDate is set and the event is not read-only. */
  deletePreview: DeletePreview | null;
  proWindow: BookingWindow;
};

export type EventEditorLookup = { kind: "ok"; data: EventEditorData } | { kind: "redirect"; eventId: string } | null;

/* ───────────────────────────── Segments ───────────────────────────── */

type NextSeance = { id: string; seriesDate: DateKey; startsAt: Date };

/** Every segment of the pro (archived included), or the segments of one series root. */
async function loadSegments(db: Db, professionalId: string, root?: string): Promise<EventRow[]> {
  const inRoot: SQL | undefined =
    root === undefined ? undefined : sql`coalesce(${event.seriesRootId}, ${event.id}) = ${root}`;
  return db
    .select()
    .from(event)
    .where(and(eq(event.professionalId, professionalId), inRoot))
    .orderBy(asc(event.startDate), asc(event.id));
}

/** The first scheduled séance after `now` of each of these segments. */
async function loadNextSeances(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  eventIds: readonly string[],
  now: Date,
): Promise<Map<string, NextSeance>> {
  const next = new Map<string, NextSeance>();
  if (eventIds.length === 0) return next;
  const rows = await db
    .selectDistinctOn([occurrence.eventId], {
      eventId: occurrence.eventId,
      id: occurrence.id,
      seriesDate: occurrence.seriesDate,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
    })
    .from(occurrence)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId),
        inArray(occurrence.eventId, [...eventIds]),
        eq(occurrence.status, "scheduled"),
        gt(occurrence.startsAt, now),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(occurrence.eventId, asc(occurrence.startsAt), asc(occurrence.id));
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.eventId !== null && r.seriesDate !== null) {
      next.set(r.eventId, { id: r.id, seriesDate: r.seriesDate, startsAt: r.startsAt });
    }
  }
  return next;
}

/**
 * Q9: the current segment of a series: the non-archived one owning the next
 * scheduled séance, else the non-archived one with the latest start_date, else
 * the latest one (every segment archived).
 */
function pickCurrentSegment(segments: readonly EventRow[], next: ReadonlyMap<string, NextSeance>): EventRow {
  const live = segments.filter((s) => s.archivedAt === null);
  const owning = live
    .flatMap((s) => {
      const n = next.get(s.id);
      return n ? [{ segment: s, at: n.startsAt.getTime() }] : [];
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at || a.segment.id.localeCompare(b.segment.id));
  if (owning.length > 0) return owning[0].segment;
  const pool = live.length > 0 ? live : segments;
  return [...pool].sort((a, b) => b.startDate.localeCompare(a.startDate) || b.id.localeCompare(a.id))[0];
}

function ruleInputOf(e: EventRow): RecurrenceRuleInput {
  const r = ruleOf(e);
  return {
    startDate: r.startDate,
    startMinute: r.startMinute,
    freq: r.freq,
    interval: r.interval,
    weekdays: r.weekdays,
    monthlyBy: r.monthlyBy,
    monthWeek: r.monthWeek,
    endMode: r.endMode,
    untilDate: r.untilDate,
    occurrenceCount: r.occurrenceCount,
  };
}

/** A booking a séance still counts on: confirmed, or pending with a hold that has not lapsed. */
function liveRegistrant(now: Date): SQL {
  return sql`(${booking.status} = 'confirmed' or (${booking.status} = 'pending' and ${booking.holdExpiresAt} > ${ts(now)}))`;
}

/* ───────────────────────────── The list ───────────────────────────── */

type LinkedType = { id: string; name: string; color: string; archived: boolean };

async function loadLinkedTypes(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  eventIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<Map<string, LinkedType[]>> {
  const byEvent = new Map<string, LinkedType[]>();
  if (eventIds.length === 0) return byEvent;
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      eventId: eventTicketType.eventId,
      id: ticketType.id,
      name: ticketType.name,
      color: ticketType.color,
      archivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt,
    })
    .from(eventTicketType)
    .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, eventTicketType.ticketTypeId))
    .where(and(eq(eventTicketType.professionalId, professionalId), inArray(eventTicketType.eventId, [...eventIds])))
    .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.createdAt), asc(ticketType.id));
  for (const r of rows) {
    byEvent.set(r.eventId, [
      ...(byEvent.get(r.eventId) ?? []),
      { id: r.id, name: r.name, color: r.color, archived: r.archivedAt !== null },
    ]);
  }
  return byEvent;
}

/**
 * One row per series root, on its current segment (Q9). `live` = the series
 * has a non-archived segment (by next séance, then title); `ended` = the rest
 * (by latest start_date, newest first).
 */
export async function listEvents(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<{ live: EventListRow[]; ended: EventListRow[] }> {
  const segments = await loadSegments(db, professionalId);
  const next = await loadNextSeances(
    db,
    professionalId,
    segments.filter((s) => s.archivedAt === null).map((s) => s.id),
    now,
  );
  const byRoot = new Map<string, EventRow[]>();
  for (const s of segments) {
    const root = s.seriesRootId ?? s.id;
    byRoot.set(root, [...(byRoot.get(root) ?? []), s]);
  }
  const currents = [...byRoot.entries()].map(([root, segs]) => ({ root, current: pickCurrentSegment(segs, next) }));
  const linked = await loadLinkedTypes(
    db,
    professionalId,
    currents.map((c) => c.current.id),
  );

  const toRow = ({ root, current }: { root: string; current: EventRow }) => {
    const acceptedTypes = linked.get(current.id) ?? [];
    const upcoming = next.get(current.id);
    const row: EventListRow = {
      eventId: current.id,
      seriesRootId: root,
      title: current.title,
      color: current.color,
      bookingMode: current.bookingMode,
      isPrivate: current.isPrivate,
      recurrenceLabel: describeRecurrence(ruleOf(current)),
      acceptedTypes,
      nextOccurrence: upcoming ? { id: upcoming.id, startsAt: upcoming.startsAt } : null,
      noActiveType: current.bookingMode === "tickets" && !acceptedTypes.some((t) => !t.archived),
    };
    return row;
  };

  const live = currents
    .filter((c) => c.current.archivedAt === null)
    .map(toRow)
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const at = a.nextOccurrence?.startsAt.getTime() ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      const bt = b.nextOccurrence?.startsAt.getTime() ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      if (at !== bt) return at < bt ? -1 : 1;
      return a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "fr") || a.eventId.localeCompare(b.eventId);
    });
  const ended = currents
    .filter((c) => c.current.archivedAt !== null)
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        b.current.startDate.localeCompare(a.current.startDate) ||
        a.current.title.localeCompare(b.current.title, "fr") ||
        a.current.id.localeCompare(b.current.id),
    )
    .map(toRow);
  return { live, ended };
}

/* ───────────────────────────── The editor ───────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Q9: resolves the series' current segment (the non-archived one owning the
 * next scheduled séance, else the non-archived one with the latest start_date,
 * else the latest one); another id of the series → redirect; unknown id or
 * another pro's event → null.
 */
export async function getEventEditor(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  eventId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<EventEditorLookup> {
  const [requested] = await db
    .select({ id: event.id, seriesRootId: event.seriesRootId })
    .from(event)
    .where(and(eq(event.id, eventId), eq(event.professionalId, professionalId)));
  if (!requested) return null;
  const root = requested.seriesRootId ?? requested.id;
  const segments = await loadSegments(db, professionalId, root);
  const next = await loadNextSeances(
    db,
    professionalId,
    segments.filter((s) => s.archivedAt === null).map((s) => s.id),
    now,
  );
  const current = pickCurrentSegment(segments, next);
  if (current.id !== requested.id) return { kind: "redirect", eventId: current.id };

  const readOnly = current.archivedAt !== null;
  const fromDate = readOnly ? null : (next.get(current.id)?.seriesDate ?? null);
  const rule = ruleOf(current);

  const [links, questions, upcoming, futureRegistrants, typeOptions, proWindow, deletePreview] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({ id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name, archivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt })
      .from(eventTicketType)
      .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, eventTicketType.ticketTypeId))
      .where(and(eq(eventTicketType.professionalId, professionalId), eq(eventTicketType.eventId, current.id)))
      .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.createdAt), asc(ticketType.id)),
    loadQuestions(db, { eventId: current.id }),
    db
      .select({
        id: occurrence.id,
        startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
        endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
        status: occurrence.status,
        seatsTaken: occurrence.seatsTaken,
        capacity: occurrence.capacity,
      })
      .from(occurrence)
      .where(and(eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId), eq(occurrence.eventId, current.id), gt(occurrence.startsAt, now)))
      .orderBy(asc(occurrence.startsAt), asc(occurrence.id))
      .limit(10),
    db
      .select({ n: sql<number>`count(*)::int`.mapWith(Number) })
      .from(booking)
      .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
      .where(
        and(
          eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(occurrence.eventId, current.id),
          eq(occurrence.status, "scheduled"),
          gt(occurrence.startsAt, now),
          isNull(occurrence.locationOverride),
          liveRegistrant(now),
        ),
      ),
    listActiveTypeOptions(db, professionalId),
    readProWindow(db, professionalId),
    fromDate === null ? Promise.resolve(null) : deleteFromPreview(db, professionalId, current.id, fromDate, now),
  ]);
  if (!proWindow) return null;

  const otherSegments: EventSegmentView[] = segments
    .filter((s) => s.id !== current.id)
    .map((s) => ({
      eventId: s.id,
      recurrenceLabel: describeRecurrence(ruleOf(s)),
      firstDate: s.startDate,
      lastDate: lastSeriesDate(ruleOf(s)),
      archived: s.archivedAt !== null,
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.firstDate.localeCompare(b.firstDate) || a.eventId.localeCompare(b.eventId));

  return {
    kind: "ok",
    data: {
      event: {
        id: current.id,
        seriesRootId: root,
        version: current.version,
        title: current.title,
        description: current.description,
        location: current.location,
        color: current.color,
        bookingMode: current.bookingMode,
        isPrivate: current.isPrivate,
        capacity: current.capacity,
        durationMin: current.durationMin,
        overrides: {
          bookingHorizonDays: current.bookingHorizonDays,
          minNoticeMinutes: current.minNoticeMinutes,
          cancelDeadlineHours: current.cancelDeadlineHours,
        },
        ticketTypeIds: links.map((l) => l.id),
        questions,
        rule: ruleInputOf(current),
        recurrenceLabel: describeRecurrence(rule),
        archived: readOnly,
      },
      readOnly,
      fromDate,
      remainingCount: fromDate === null ? null : remainingCount(rule, fromDate),
      upcoming,
      otherSegments,
      typeOptions: typeOptions.filter((t) => !t.rdvFree),
      linkedArchivedTypes: links.filter((l) => l.archivedAt !== null).map((l) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name })),
      futureRegistrants: futureRegistrants[0]?.n ?? 0,
      deletePreview,
      proWindow,
    },
  };
}

/* ───────────────────────────── RDV conflicts ───────────────────────────── */

/** Scheduled RDV (event_id null) whose block (buffers included) overlaps any of the ranges. */
export async function countRdvConflicts(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  ranges: readonly { startsAt: Date; endsAt: Date }[],
): Promise<number> {
  if (ranges.length === 0) return 0;
  const starts = ranges.map((r) => r.startsAt);
  const ends = ranges.map((r) => r.endsAt);
  const first = new Date(Math.min(...starts.map((d) => d.getTime())));
  const last = new Date(Math.max(...ends.map((d) => d.getTime())));
  const res = await db.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`
    select count(*)::int as n from occurrence o
    where o.professional_id = ${professionalId} and o.event_id is null and o.status = 'scheduled'
      and o.block_end > ${ts(first)} and o.block_start < ${ts(last)}
      and exists (
        select 1 from unnest(${tsArray(starts)}, ${tsArray(ends)}) as r(s, e)
        where o.block_start < r.e and o.block_end > r.s)`);
  return Number(res.rows[0]?.n ?? 0);
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Delete preview ───────────────────────────── */

/**
 * What deleteSeriesFrom(fromDate) would do on this segment (same rules as the
 * engine, src/lib/booking/series.ts): the rows of the segment from fromDate,
 * the never-booked ones deleted, the scheduled ones with a booking history
 * cancelled; `deleteWhole` = never booked, no row before fromDate and no other
 * segment rooted on it. `registrants` leaves out the pending holds that have
 * lapsed at `now` (nobody is warned about them). Null for an unknown, other
 * pro's or archived segment (the engine refuses these too).
 */
export async function deleteFromPreview(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  eventId: string,
  fromDate: DateKey,
  now: Date,
): Promise<DeletePreview | null> {
  const [ev] = await db
    .select({ id: event.id })
    .from(event)
    .where(and(eq(event.id, eventId), eq(event.professionalId, professionalId), isNull(event.archivedAt)));
  if (!ev) return null;

  const [rows, flags] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        status: occurrence.status,
        hasHistory: sql<boolean>`exists (select 1 from booking b where b.occurrence_id = occurrence.id)`,
        registrants: sql<number>`(select count(*)::int from booking b where b.occurrence_id = occurrence.id
          and (b.status = 'confirmed' or (b.status = 'pending' and b.hold_expires_at > ${ts(now)})))`.mapWith(Number),
        tickets: sql<number>`(select count(*)::int from booking b where b.occurrence_id = occurrence.id
          and b.status = 'confirmed' and b.coverage = 'ticket')`.mapWith(Number),
      })
      .from(occurrence)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(occurrence.eventId, ev.id),
          gte(occurrence.seriesDate, fromDate),
        ),
      ),
    db.execute<{ booked: boolean; root_in_use: boolean; rows_before: number }>(sql`select
      exists (select 1 from booking b join occurrence o on o.id = b.occurrence_id where o.event_id = ${ev.id}) as booked,
      exists (select 1 from event e where e.series_root_id = ${ev.id} and e.id <> ${ev.id}) as root_in_use,
      (select count(*)::int from occurrence where event_id = ${ev.id} and series_date < ${fromDate}::date) as rows_before`),
  ]);
  const f = flags.rows[0];
  const toCancel = rows.filter((r) => r.hasHistory === true && r.status === "scheduled");
  return {
    fromDate,
    deleteWhole: f?.booked !== true && Number(f?.rows_before ?? 0) === 0 && f?.root_in_use !== true,
    deletedSeances: rows.filter((r) => r.hasHistory !== true).length,
    cancelledSeances: toCancel.length,
    registrants: toCancel.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.registrants, 0),
    ticketsReturned: toCancel.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.tickets, 0),
  };
}
```

  ```ts
  // src/lib/tickets.ts
  export const eventInfoSchema; // eventInputSchema.pick of the ten information fields
  export type EventInfoInput = z.input<typeof eventInfoSchema>;
  // src/lib/back-office/event-actions.ts
  export type SchedulePreview = { summary: SeriesEditSummary; textKeep: string; textCancel: string; remainingCount: number | null; inPlace: boolean; rdvConflicts: number };

  export async function editEventInfoCore(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, input: { eventId: string; seenVersion: number; info: EventInfoInput }, now: Date): Promise<CoreResult<{ version: number }>>;
  export async function previewScheduleCore(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, input: { eventId: string; fromDate: DateKey; rule: RecurrenceRuleInput; durationMin: number }, now: Date): Promise<ActionResult<{ preview: SchedulePreview }>>;
  export async function applyScheduleCore(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, input: { eventId: string; seenVersion: number; fromDate: DateKey; rule: RecurrenceRuleInput; durationMin: number; orphans: "keep" | "cancel" }, now: Date): Promise<CoreResult<{ eventId: string; summaryText: string }>>;
  export async function deleteEventPreviewCore(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, input: { eventId: string; fromDate: DateKey }, now: Date): Promise<ActionResult<{ preview: DeletePreview }>>;
  export async function deleteEventFromCore(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, input: { eventId: string; seenVersion: number; fromDate: DateKey }, now: Date): Promise<CoreResult<{ deletedEvent: boolean; cancelledOccurrences: number; deletedOccurrences: number }>>;

  // src/server/pro-catalog.ts (added): createEventAction, editEventInfoAction, previewScheduleAction, applyScheduleAction, deleteEventPreviewAction, deleteEventFromAction, previewNewEventAction (contract 4.11)
  ```
- Rules the cores implement (each has a test below):
  - Identity: `professionalId` and `actorUserId` come from `ctx` only. Every id of the input reaches an engine call that filters on `professional_id`, or a query that does (`typesUsable` of this file, `readProWindow` of Task 9); another pro's event answers « Événement introuvable ou terminé. ».
  - Validation before the engine, with the engine's own schemas through `parseFr`: no English zod text. The start date of a new event is in [local today, today + 730] in the pro's zone (`ctx.timezone` and the `now` argument, never the host's zone).
  - Types: deduped, each active and not rdv_free; on an edit, also accepted when the event already links it (archived since). Anything else: `EVENT_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE`.
  - Notice against horizon: `effectiveWindow(pro settings, overrides)`; a notice longer than its horizon is `NOTICE_TOO_LONG`.
  - Engine failures go through `fromEngine(res, "event")` (create, edit) or `fromEngine(res, "series")` (cuts, deletion): the engine's own French `message` (« La série change déjà à partir du … », « Une séance concernée a déjà commencé. ») passes through, `stale` reads « Les données ont changé entre-temps : rafraîchissez la page. ».
  - A cut before local today is refused by the preview core with the engine's own text, so both layers agree.

```ts
  const la = await createTestPro(db, { tz: "America/Los_Angeles" });
  try {
    const res = await createEventCore(db, proCtx(la), input, now);
    must(res, "the Los Angeles pro may start on the 14th");
    assert.equal(res.occurrenceCount, 1);
    const [seance] = await occurrencesOf(db, res.eventId);
    assert.equal(seance.startsAt.toISOString(), "2026-10-15T00:00:00.000Z", "17:00 in Los Angeles (UTC-7)");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, la.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("createEventCore: duplicate type ids link once; archived, rdv_free, foreign and unknown types are refused", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const active = await makeType(db, pro);
  const archived = await makeType(db, pro);
  const gratuit = await makeType(db, pro, { rdvEnabled: true, rdvFree: true, rdvDurationMin: 30 });
  must(await setTicketTypeArchived(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, ticketTypeId: archived, archived: true }), "archive");
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const foreign = await makeType(db, other);
    const res = await createEventCore(db, ctx, eventInput(pro, now, { ticketTypeIds: [active, active] }), now);
    must(res, "duplicates are accepted once");
    assert.equal(res.occurrenceCount, 1);
    const links = await db.select().from(eventTicketType).where(eq(eventTicketType.eventId, res.eventId));
    assert.deepEqual(
      links.map((l) => l.ticketTypeId),
      [active],
    );
    for (const bad of [archived, gratuit, foreign, "unknown-type"]) {

      assert.equal(outcome(refused), EVENT_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE, bad);
    }
    assert.equal((await db.select().from(event).where(eq(event.professionalId, pro.proId))).length, 1, "only the first call wrote");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("previewScheduleCore: both texts, the cut kind, the remaining count and the RDV conflicts", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const { eventId } = await pastSeries(h, now);
  const future = await futureRows(db, eventId, now);
  const d = future[0].seriesDate ?? "";
  const rule = weekly(d, [2, 4]);

  // one RDV overlapping the first new séance, one far from it, one cancelled
  const [first] = expand({ ...rule, durationMin: 60 }, pro.tz, d, addDays(d, 14));
  const rdvType = await rowRdvType(db, pro);
  const overlapping = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: new Date(first.startsAt.getTime() + 30 * 60_000), durationMin: 60 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: overlapping, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro) });
  const far = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: new Date(first.startsAt.getTime() + 4 * 3_600_000), durationMin: 60 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: far, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro) });
  await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: new Date(first.startsAt.getTime() + 3 * DAY), durationMin: 60, status: "cancelled", seatsTaken: 0 });

  const res = await previewScheduleCore(db, ctx, { eventId, fromDate: d, rule, durationMin: 60 }, now);
  must(res, "preview");
  const p = res.preview;
  assert.equal(p.inPlace, false, "séances precede the cut: it splits");
  assert.equal(p.remainingCount, null);
  assert.equal(p.rdvConflicts, 1);
  assert.equal(p.summary.orphans, 0);
  assert.equal(p.summary.modified, 0);
  assert.equal(p.summary.deleted, future.length, "every Monday, Wednesday and Friday séance to come disappears");
  assert.ok(p.summary.inserted > 0);
  assert.equal(p.textKeep, `${p.summary.deleted} séances supprimées, ${p.summary.inserted} séances ajoutées`);
  assert.equal(p.textCancel, p.textKeep, "no booked séance: both choices read the same");
  assert.equal((await getEvent(db, eventId)).version, 1, "a preview writes nothing");
});

dbTest("previewScheduleCore: a booked séance that disappears reads differently under « Garder » and « Annuler »", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;
  const now = new Date();
  const { eventId } = await pastSeries(h, now);
  const future = await futureRows(db, eventId, now);

    await registerPro(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: future[0].id, customerId, asGuest: true }),
    "register",
  );
  const res = await previewScheduleCore(db, proCtx(pro), { eventId, fromDate: d, rule: weekly(d, [2, 4]), durationMin: 60 }, now);
  must(res, "preview");
  assert.equal(res.preview.summary.orphans, 1);
  assert.match(res.preview.textKeep, /1 séance gardée à part/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(res.preview.textKeep, /annulée/);
  assert.match(res.preview.textCancel, /1 séance annulée/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(res.preview.textCancel, /gardée à part/);
});

dbTest("previewScheduleCore: French refusals, the engine's own texts and another pro's event", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const { eventId } = await pastSeries(h, now);
  const d = (await futureRows(db, eventId, now))[0].seriesDate ?? "";
  const base = { eventId, fromDate: d, rule: weekly(d, [2, 4]), durationMin: 60 };

  const endsBefore = await previewScheduleCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { ...base, rule: weekly(d, [2, 4], { endMode: "until", untilDate: addDays(d, -1) }) },
    now,
  );
  assert.equal(outcome(endsBefore), "La fin précède le début.");
  const badDuration = await previewScheduleCore(db, ctx, { ...base, durationMin: 7 }, now);
  assert.equal(outcome(badDuration), "Durée : choisissez un multiple de 5.");
  const past = await previewScheduleCore(db, ctx, { ...base, fromDate: dayIn(pro, -3, now) }, now);
  assert.equal(outcome(past), "La modification doit partir d'aujourd'hui ou d'une date future.");
  const unknown = await previewScheduleCore(db, ctx, { ...base, eventId: "unknown-event" }, now);
  assert.equal(outcome(unknown), NOT_FOUND);

  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const foreign = await previewScheduleCore(db, proCtx(other), base, now);
    assert.equal(outcome(foreign), NOT_FOUND);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("applyScheduleCore: a series with past séances splits and returns the new segment; the text is the preview's", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const { eventId } = await pastSeries(h, now);
  const d = (await futureRows(db, eventId, now))[0].seriesDate ?? "";
  const rule = weekly(d, [2, 4]);
  const preview = await previewScheduleCore(db, ctx, { eventId, fromDate: d, rule, durationMin: 60 }, now);
  must(preview, "preview");

  const res = await applyScheduleCore(db, ctx, { eventId, seenVersion: 1, fromDate: d, rule, durationMin: 60, orphans: "keep" }, now);
  must(res, "apply");
  assert.notEqual(res.eventId, eventId, "the new segment");
  assert.equal(res.summaryText, preview.preview.textKeep);
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
  const old = await getEvent(db, eventId);
  assert.equal(old.untilDate, addDays(d, -1));
  assert.equal(old.version, 2);
  assert.equal((await getEvent(db, res.eventId)).seriesRootId, eventId);
});

dbTest("applyScheduleCore: the engine refusal « La série change déjà à partir du … » passes through", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;

  const { eventId: root } = await pastSeries(h, now);
  const future = await futureRows(db, root, now);
  const d1 = future[0].seriesDate ?? "";
  const d2 = future[3].seriesDate ?? "";
  const rule1 = weekly(d1, [1, 3, 5]);

  const second = await applyScheduleCore(db, ctx, { eventId: root, seenVersion: 1, fromDate: d1, rule: rule1, durationMin: 60, orphans: "keep" }, now);
  must(second, "first cut");
  const third = await applyScheduleCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { eventId: second.eventId, seenVersion: 1, fromDate: d2, rule: weekly(d2, [1, 3, 5]), durationMin: 60, orphans: "keep" },
    now,
  );
  must(third, "second cut");

  const refused = await applyScheduleCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { eventId: second.eventId, seenVersion: 2, fromDate: d1, rule: rule1, durationMin: 60, orphans: "keep" },
    now,
  );
  assert.equal(
    outcome(refused),
    `La série change déjà à partir du ${formatDayMonthYear(d2)} : modifiez-la depuis cette date, ou terminez celle-ci avant.`,
  );
}, { timeout: 240_000 });
```

Create the file with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Event cores (contract 4.11): create, edit the information in place, preview
 * and apply a schedule cut (« cette série à partir du »), preview and apply
 * « Supprimer à partir du », and the create-form preview. Plain functions of
 * `(db, ctx, input, now)`: the identity comes from `ctx` (built from the
 * session by requireProContext), never from the input; no Next, no
 * server-only, so the DB tests call them directly. Every input is validated
 * with `parseFr` and the engine's own schema BEFORE the engine runs, so no
 * English zod text reaches the UI; engine failures become French through
 * `fromEngine`. The thin "use server" wrappers live in src/server/pro-catalog.ts.
 */
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { z } from "zod";

import { createEvent, horizonEnd } from "@/lib/booking/occurrences";
import { deleteSeriesFrom, editEventInPlace, editSeriesFrom, previewSeriesEdit } from "@/lib/booking/series";
import { fail } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { effectiveWindow } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import { addDays, maxKey, minKey, todayKey, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { textArray, type Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { expand, lastSeriesDate, type RecurrenceRule } from "@/lib/recurrence";
import { describeSeriesEdit, type SeriesEditSummary } from "@/lib/series-plan";
import {
  BOUNDS,
  MATERIALIZE_DAYS,
  MATERIALIZE_MAX_ROWS,
  dateKeySchema,
  eventInfoSchema,
  eventInputSchema,
  idSchema,
  recurrenceRuleSchema,
  type EventInfoInput,
  type EventInput,
  type RecurrenceRuleInput,
  type WindowOverrides,
} from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

import { readProWindow } from "./catalog-reads";
import { countRdvConflicts, deleteFromPreview, type DeletePreview } from "./event-reads";
import { NOTICE_TOO_LONG, noticeExceedsHorizon } from "./notice";
import { actionFail, fromEngine, type ActionResult, type CoreResult, type ProCtx } from "./result";

export type SchedulePreview = {
  summary: SeriesEditSummary;
  /** describeSeriesEdit(summary, "keep") */
  textKeep: string;
  /** describeSeriesEdit(summary, "cancel") */
  textCancel: string;
  remainingCount: number | null;
  /** true when no séance precedes the cut: the edit applies to the same event */
  inPlace: boolean;
  /** scheduled RDV that overlap a new séance */
  rdvConflicts: number;
};

export const EVENT_START_PAST = "La date de début ne peut pas être passée.";
export const EVENT_START_TOO_FAR = "La date de début doit être dans les deux prochaines années.";
export const EVENT_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE = "Un type de ticket choisi est archivé ou introuvable.";

/** The engine's own text for a cut before local today (src/lib/booking/series.ts), so both layers say the same. */
const PAST_FROM_DATE = "La modification doit partir d'aujourd'hui ou d'une date future.";
/** A new event may start at most this many days after local today (OUT L114). */
const START_MAX_DAYS = 730;

const versionSchema = z.number().int().min(1);
const durationSchema = z
  .number()
  .int()
  .min(BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.min)
  .max(BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.max)
  .multipleOf(BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.step);
const scheduleSchema = z.object({
  eventId: idSchema,
  fromDate: dateKeySchema,
  rule: recurrenceRuleSchema,
  durationMin: durationSchema,
});
const applySchema = scheduleSchema.extend({
  seenVersion: versionSchema,
  orphans: z.enum(["keep", "cancel"]),
});
const editInfoSchema = z.object({ eventId: idSchema, seenVersion: versionSchema, info: eventInfoSchema });
const deletePreviewSchema = z.object({ eventId: idSchema, fromDate: dateKeySchema });
const deleteFromSchema = deletePreviewSchema.extend({ seenVersion: versionSchema });
const newEventSchema = z.object({ rule: recurrenceRuleSchema, durationMin: durationSchema });

/* ───────────────────────────── Shared checks ───────────────────────────── */

/** NOTICE_TOO_LONG when the notice of the effective window (pro settings + overrides) outlasts its horizon (OUT L106). */
async function noticeProblem(db: Db, professionalId: string, overrides: WindowOverrides): Promise<string | null> {
  const pro = await readProWindow(db, professionalId);
  if (!pro) return null; // the engine answers not_found
  const window = effectiveWindow(pro, overrides);
  return noticeExceedsHorizon(window.minNoticeMinutes, window.bookingHorizonDays) ? NOTICE_TOO_LONG : null;
}

/**
 * True when each id is an active, non-rdv_free type of the pro, or (with
 * `eventId`) a type the event already links, which may have been archived
 * since: it stays until the pro unticks it (OUT L92).
 */
async function typesUsable(db: Db, professionalId: string, ids: readonly string[], eventId?: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (ids.length === 0) return true;
  const linked =
    eventId === undefined
      ? sql`false`
      : sql`exists (select 1 from event_ticket_type l
          where l.event_id = ${eventId} and l.ticket_type_id = t.id and l.professional_id = ${professionalId})`;
  const res = await db.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`
    select count(*)::int as n from ticket_type t
    where t.professional_id = ${professionalId} and t.id = any(${textArray(ids)})
      and ((t.archived_at is null and not t.rdv_free) or ${linked})`);
  return Number(res.rows[0]?.n ?? 0) === ids.length;
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Create ───────────────────────────── */

/**
 * parseFr(eventInputSchema); the start date in [local today, today + 730];
 * the types deduped, each an active non-rdv_free type of the pro; the notice
 * of the effective window within its horizon; createEvent. Context "event".
 */
export async function createEventCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: EventInput,
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ eventId: string; occurrenceCount: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(eventInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const draft = parsed.data;

  const today = todayKey(now, ctx.timezone);
  if (draft.rule.startDate < today) return actionFail(EVENT_START_PAST);
  if (draft.rule.startDate > addDays(today, START_MAX_DAYS)) return actionFail(EVENT_START_TOO_FAR);

  const typeIds = [...new Set(draft.ticketTypeIds)];
  if (!(await typesUsable(db, ctx.professionalId, typeIds))) return actionFail(EVENT_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE);
  const tooLong = await noticeProblem(db, ctx.professionalId, draft.overrides);
  if (tooLong !== null) return actionFail(tooLong);

  const res = await createEvent(
    db,
    { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, event: { ...draft, ticketTypeIds: typeIds } },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "event");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, eventId: res.eventId, occurrenceCount: res.occurrenceCount };
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Informations (in place) ───────────────────────────── */

/**
 * « Informations » (in place on one segment, Q7): parseFr(eventInfoSchema);
 * the types deduped, each active and non-rdv_free OR already linked to this
 * event; the notice within its horizon; editEventInPlace with the full info
 * patch. Context "event".
 */
export async function editEventInfoCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { eventId: string; seenVersion: number; info: EventInfoInput },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ version: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(editInfoSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const { eventId, seenVersion, info } = parsed.data;

  const typeIds = [...new Set(info.ticketTypeIds)];
  if (!(await typesUsable(db, ctx.professionalId, typeIds, eventId))) return actionFail(EVENT_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE);
  const tooLong = await noticeProblem(db, ctx.professionalId, info.overrides);
  if (tooLong !== null) return actionFail(tooLong);

  const res = await editEventInPlace(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: ctx.professionalId,
      actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId,
      eventId,
      seenVersion,
      patch: {
        title: info.title,
        description: info.description,
        location: info.location,
        color: info.color,
        isPrivate: info.isPrivate,
        bookingMode: info.bookingMode,
        ticketTypeIds: typeIds,
        questions: info.questions,
        overrides: info.overrides,
        capacity: info.capacity,
      },
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "event");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, version: res.version };
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Horaire et récurrence (cut) ───────────────────────────── */

/**
 * parseFr of the rule and the duration; previewSeriesEdit; describeSeriesEdit
 * for both orphan choices; the RDV that overlap the new dates over
 * [max(fromDate, today), today + MATERIALIZE_DAYS]. Context "series".
 */
export async function previewScheduleCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { eventId: string; fromDate: DateKey; rule: RecurrenceRuleInput; durationMin: number },
  now: Date,
): Promise<ActionResult<{ preview: SchedulePreview }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(scheduleSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const { eventId, fromDate, rule, durationMin } = parsed.data;

  const res = await previewSeriesEdit(db, { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, eventId, fromDate, rule, durationMin }, now);
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "series");

  const today = todayKey(now, ctx.timezone);
  const dates = expand({ ...rule, durationMin }, ctx.timezone, maxKey(fromDate, today), addDays(today, MATERIALIZE_DAYS));
  const rdvConflicts = await countRdvConflicts(db, ctx.professionalId, dates);
  return {
    ok: true,
    preview: {
      summary: res.summary,
      textKeep: describeSeriesEdit(res.summary, "keep"),
      textCancel: describeSeriesEdit(res.summary, "cancel"),
      remainingCount: res.remainingCount,
      inPlace: res.inPlace,
      rdvConflicts,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * editSeriesFrom; `eventId` is the new segment after a split (the same event
 * when nothing precedes the cut). The engine's TIM1 refusal (« La série change
 * déjà à partir du … ») passes through. Context "series".
 */
export async function applyScheduleCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: {
    eventId: string;
    seenVersion: number;
    fromDate: DateKey;
    rule: RecurrenceRuleInput;
    durationMin: number;
    orphans: "keep" | "cancel";
  },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ eventId: string; summaryText: string }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(applySchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const { eventId, seenVersion, fromDate, rule, durationMin, orphans } = parsed.data;

  const res = await editSeriesFrom(
    db,
    { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId, eventId, seenVersion, fromDate, rule, durationMin, orphans },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "series");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, eventId: res.eventId, summaryText: describeSeriesEdit(res.summary, orphans) };
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Supprimer à partir du ───────────────────────────── */

/** deleteFromPreview behind validation (unknown, other pro's or finished event → « Événement introuvable ou terminé. »). */
export async function deleteEventPreviewCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { eventId: string; fromDate: DateKey },
  now: Date,
): Promise<ActionResult<{ preview: DeletePreview }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(deletePreviewSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const { eventId, fromDate } = parsed.data;
  if (fromDate < todayKey(now, ctx.timezone)) return actionFail(PAST_FROM_DATE);

  const preview = await deleteFromPreview(db, ctx.professionalId, eventId, fromDate, now);
  if (!preview) return fromEngine(fail("not_found"), "series");
  return { ok: true, preview };
}

/** deleteSeriesFrom (Q32: « Supprimer l'événement » is a cut from the first séance to come). Context "series". */
export async function deleteEventFromCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { eventId: string; seenVersion: number; fromDate: DateKey },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ deletedEvent: boolean; cancelledOccurrences: number; deletedOccurrences: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(deleteFromSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const { eventId, seenVersion, fromDate } = parsed.data;

  const res = await deleteSeriesFrom(
    db,
    { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId, eventId, seenVersion, fromDate },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "series");
  return {
    ok: true,
    effects: res.effects,
    deletedEvent: res.deletedEvent,
    cancelledOccurrences: res.cancelledOccurrences,
    deletedOccurrences: res.deletedOccurrences,
  };
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Create-form preview ───────────────────────────── */

/**
 * The create form's preview: how many séances the rule would materialise (the
 * rows createEvent inserts: from the start date to the horizon, at most
 * MATERIALIZE_MAX_ROWS) and how many scheduled RDV overlap the ones still to come.
 */
export async function previewNewEventCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { rule: RecurrenceRuleInput; durationMin: number },
  now: Date,
): Promise<ActionResult<{ rdvConflicts: number; occurrenceCount: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(newEventSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const { rule, durationMin } = parsed.data;

  const full: RecurrenceRule = { ...rule, durationMin };
  const last = lastSeriesDate(full);
  const end = horizonEnd(now, ctx.timezone);
  const dates = expand(full, ctx.timezone, rule.startDate, last === null ? end : minKey(last, end)).slice(0, MATERIALIZE_MAX_ROWS);
  const today = todayKey(now, ctx.timezone);
  const rdvConflicts = await countRdvConflicts(
    db,
    ctx.professionalId,
    dates.filter((d) => d.seriesDate >= today),
  );
  return { ok: true, rdvConflicts, occurrenceCount: dates.length };
}
```

```tsx
        <Link
          href={`/dashboard/events/${row.eventId}`}
          className="rounded-sm font-medium hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
        >
          {row.title}
        </Link>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{row.recurrenceLabel}</p>
        {row.isPrivate && (
          <Badge variant="neutral" className="mt-1.5">
            Privé
          </Badge>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The accepted ticket types as chips, « Aucun », and the orange alert when none of them is active. */
function AcceptedTypes({ row }: { row: EventListRow }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1.5">
      {row.acceptedTypes.map((t) => (
        <TypeChip key={t.id} name={t.name} color={t.color} archived={t.archived} />
      ))}
      {row.noActiveType && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-warning">
          <StatusMark tone="orange" label={NO_ACTIVE_TICKET} />
          {NO_ACTIVE_TICKET}
        </span>
      )}
      {row.acceptedTypes.length === 0 && !row.noActiveType && (
        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucun</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function NextOccurrence({ row, tz }: { row: EventListRow; tz: string }) {
  if (!row.nextOccurrence) {
    return <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucune séance à venir</span>;
  }
  return <span className="text-sm">{formatWhenShort(row.nextOccurrence.startsAt, tz)}</span>;
}

/** From 640 px: one table; below: one card per event with the same facts. */
function EventRows({ rows, tz, label }: { rows: EventListRow[]; tz: string; label: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Card className="hidden overflow-hidden sm:block">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
          <caption className="sr-only">{label}</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-border bg-muted/40 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3 font-medium">
                Événement
              </th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">
                Mode
              </th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">
                Tickets acceptés
              </th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3 font-medium">
                Prochaine séance
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
            {rows.map((row) => (
              <tr key={row.eventId} className="align-top transition-colors hover:bg-muted/40">
                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <EventTitle row={row} />
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">{MODE_SHORT_LABELS[row.bookingMode]}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-4">
                  <AcceptedTypes row={row} />
                </td>
                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <NextOccurrence row={row} tz={tz} />
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </Card>

      <ul aria-label={label} className="grid gap-3 sm:hidden">
        {rows.map((row) => (
          <li key={row.eventId}>
            <Card className="p-4">
              <EventTitle row={row} />
              <dl className="mt-4 grid gap-3 text-sm">
                <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                  <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Mode</dt>
                  <dd>{MODE_SHORT_LABELS[row.bookingMode]}</dd>
                </div>
                <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                  <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Tickets acceptés</dt>
                  <dd>
                    <AcceptedTypes row={row} />
                  </dd>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                  <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Prochaine séance</dt>
                  <dd className="text-right">
                    <NextOccurrence row={row} tz={tz} />
                  </dd>
                </div>
              </dl>
            </Card>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The events list (spec § 13.1): one row per series, on its current segment.
 * Server component, no state. `ended` (every segment archived) sits in a
 * closed « Terminés » disclosure.
 */
export function EventList({ live, ended, tz }: { live: EventListRow[]; ended: EventListRow[]; tz: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {live.length > 0 ? (
        <EventRows rows={live} tz={tz} label="Événements en cours" />
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucun événement en cours.</p>
      )}

      {ended.length > 0 && (
        <details>
          <summary className="cursor-pointer rounded-sm text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring">
            Terminés ({ended.length})
          </summary>
          <div className="mt-4">
            <EventRows rows={ended} tz={tz} label="Événements terminés" />
          </div>
        </details>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export default async function EventsPage() {
  // The dashboard layout guarantees a signed-in user with a professional profile.
  const pro = (await getCurrentProfessional())!;
  const { live, ended } = await getEventsPage(pro.id);

  const isEmpty = live.length === 0 && ended.length === 0;
  const newEvent = (
    <Button asChild>
      <Link href="/dashboard/events/new">
        <Plus aria-hidden />
        Nouvel événement
      </Link>
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Événements"
        description="Vos cours et vos ateliers, ponctuels ou récurrents."
        action={isEmpty ? undefined : newEvent}
      />
      {isEmpty ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={CalendarDays}
          title="Créez votre premier événement"
          description="Un cours ponctuel ou récurrent, avec ses places et les tickets qu'il accepte."
          action={newEvent}
        />
      ) : (
        <EventList live={live} ended={ended} tz={pro.timezone} />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `src/lib/back-office/recurrence-submit.ts`**

Create the file with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * The two gates of the event forms (pure, client-safe): whether a recurrence
 * form value may be previewed and submitted (`submittableRule`), and which
 * start field to blame when `ruleFromForm` cannot build a rule at all
 * (`startProblem`). The rule itself is `ruleFromForm`'s; the French messages of
 * the schemas come from `parseFr`, so only the two start fields need their own.
 */
import { parseKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { recurrenceRuleSchema, type RecurrenceRuleInput } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

import { ruleFromForm, timeToMinute, type RecurrenceFormValue } from "./recurrence-form";

/** The rule and duration of a form value when both pass the engine's schemas (rule schema, duration 5..720 by 5), else null. */
export function submittableRule(
  value: RecurrenceFormValue,
): { rule: RecurrenceRuleInput; durationMin: number } | null {
  const built = ruleFromForm(value);
  if (!built) return null;
  if (!recurrenceRuleSchema.safeParse(built.rule).success) return null;
  const { min, max, step } = BOUNDS.eventDurationMin;
  const d = built.durationMin;
  if (!Number.isInteger(d) || d < min || d > max || d % step !== 0) return null;
  return built;
}

function isDay(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    parseKey(value);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Which start field makes `ruleFromForm` return null: "date" when the start date
 * is cleared or not a day (checked first), else "time" when the start time is
 * cleared or not HH:MM, else null (every other mistake still yields a rule that
 * the schemas refuse with their own field message).
 */
export function startProblem(value: RecurrenceFormValue): "date" | "time" | null {
  if (!isDay(value.startDate)) return "date";
  if (timeToMinute(value.startTime) === null) return "time";
  return null;
}
```
