```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Info, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { formatWhenShort, plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { WEEKDAY_LETTERS, WEEKDAY_NAMES, WEEK_ORDER } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";
import {
  dstNoteTexts,
  monthlyChoices,
  previewDates,
  recurrenceSummary,
  ruleFromForm,
  type RecurrenceFormValue,
} from "@/lib/back-office/recurrence-form";
import { addMonthsClamped, dayOfWeek, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { BOUNDS, type RecurrenceEnd, type RecurrenceFreq } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** The pure gates live in a tested module; Tasks 19 and 20 import them from here with the editor. */
export { startProblem, submittableRule } from "@/lib/back-office/recurrence-submit";

const DATE_KEY_PATTERN = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
/** How many séances the preview expands to find the daylight-saving changes (a daily series materialises 400 days). */
const DST_SCAN_LIMIT = 400;
const UPCOMING_SHOWN = 5;
const DST_NOTES_SHOWN = 3;

const FREQ_OPTIONS: readonly { value: RecurrenceFreq; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "once", label: "Une seule fois" },
  { value: "daily", label: "Tous les jours" },
  { value: "weekly", label: "Toutes les semaines" },
  { value: "monthly", label: "Tous les mois" },
];

const INTERVAL_UNITS = { daily: "jours", weekly: "semaines", monthly: "mois" } as const;

/** Shown when the start time is cleared or malformed: ruleFromForm returns null, so no schema can name the field. */
export const START_TIME_ERROR = "Heure de début : indiquez une heure.";
export const START_TIME_FIELD_ERROR = "Indiquez une heure.";
/** Same for a cleared start date (a type=date input reads ""): the time field must not be blamed for it. */
export const START_DATE_ERROR = "Date de début : ce champ est obligatoire.";
export const START_DATE_FIELD_ERROR = "Ce champ est obligatoire.";

const WEEKDAYS_HELP = "Choisissez au moins un jour.";
const DURATION_HELP = "Par pas de 5 minutes.";
const MONTHLY_NEEDS_DATE = "Choisissez d'abord une date de début valide.";
const PREVIEW_INCOMPLETE = "Complétez la récurrence pour voir l'aperçu.";
const NO_UPCOMING = "Aucune séance à venir.";

function isDateKey(value: string): boolean {
  return DATE_KEY_PATTERN.test(value);
}

function parseFreq(text: string): RecurrenceFreq | null {
  const found = FREQ_OPTIONS.find((option) => option.value === text);
  return found ? found.value : null;
}

/** A cleared or partial number field reads as 0, which every schema refuses with its own French message. */
function wholeNumber(input: HTMLInputElement): number {
  const n = input.valueAsNumber;
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.trunc(n) : 0;
}

/** Field error by bare key, with the `rule.` prefix of parseFr(eventInputSchema) accepted too. */
function errorOf(errors: Record<string, string> | undefined, key: string): string | null {
  if (!errors) return null;
  return errors[`rule.${key}`] ?? errors[key] ?? null;
}

function describedBy(id: string, hasHelp: boolean, error: string | null): string | undefined {
  const ids: string[] = [];
  if (hasHelp) ids.push(`${id}-help`);
  if (error) ids.push(`${id}-error`);
  return ids.length > 0 ? ids.join(" ") : undefined;
}

function Radio({
  id,
  name,
  checked,
  onSelect,
  children,
}: {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  checked: boolean;
  onSelect: () => void;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2">
      <input
        id={id}
        type="radio"
        name={name}
        checked={checked}
        onChange={onSelect}
        className="size-4 cursor-pointer accent-primary disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
      />
      <label htmlFor={id} className="cursor-pointer text-sm">
        {children}
      </label>
    </span>
  );
}

function GroupError({ id, message }: { id: string; message: string | null }) {
  if (!message) return null;
  return (
    <p id={id} role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
      {message}
    </p>
  );
}

const LEGEND_CLASS = "mb-2 text-sm font-medium leading-none text-foreground";

export function RecurrenceEditor({
  idPrefix,
  value,
  onChange,
  minDate,
  disabled = false,
  fieldErrors,
}: {
  idPrefix: string;
  value: RecurrenceFormValue;
  onChange: (next: RecurrenceFormValue) => void;
  minDate: DateKey;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
}) {
  const freq = value.freq;
  const startKnown = isDateKey(value.startDate);
  const choices = useMemo(
    () => (startKnown ? monthlyChoices(value.startDate) : []),
    [startKnown, value.startDate],
  );
  const set = (patch: Partial<RecurrenceFormValue>) => onChange({ ...value, ...patch });

  const startDateId = `${idPrefix}-start-date`;
  const startTimeId = `${idPrefix}-start-time`;
  const durationId = `${idPrefix}-duration`;
  const freqId = `${idPrefix}-freq`;
  const intervalId = `${idPrefix}-interval`;
  const weekdaysId = `${idPrefix}-weekdays`;
  const monthlyId = `${idPrefix}-monthly`;
  const endId = `${idPrefix}-end`;
  const untilDateId = `${idPrefix}-until-date`;
  const countId = `${idPrefix}-count`;

  const startDateError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "startDate");
  const startTimeError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "startMinute");
  const durationError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "durationMin");
  const freqError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "freq");
  const intervalError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "interval");
  const weekdaysError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "weekdays");
  const monthlyError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "monthlyBy") ?? errorOf(fieldErrors, "monthWeek");
  const endModeError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "endMode");
  const untilError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "untilDate");
  const countError = errorOf(fieldErrors, "occurrenceCount");

  /** The weekday toggles and the monthly choice follow the start date while the user has not customised them. */
  function changeStartDate(next: string) {
    if (!isDateKey(next)) {
      set({ startDate: next });
      return;
    }
    const followed =
      startKnown && value.weekdays.length === 1 && value.weekdays[0] === dayOfWeek(value.startDate);
    const choiceStillOffered = monthlyChoices(next).some((c) => c.value === value.monthlyChoice);
    set({
      startDate: next,
      weekdays: followed ? [dayOfWeek(next)] : value.weekdays,
      monthlyChoice: choiceStillOffered ? value.monthlyChoice : "day_of_month",
    });
  }

  function changeFreq(next: RecurrenceFreq) {
    set({
      freq: next,
      interval: Math.min(Math.max(value.interval, 1), BOUNDS.interval[next]),
      weekdays:
        next === "weekly" && value.weekdays.length === 0 && startKnown
          ? [dayOfWeek(value.startDate)]
          : value.weekdays,
    });
  }

  function toggleWeekday(day: number) {
    const next = value.weekdays.includes(day)
      ? value.weekdays.filter((d) => d !== day)
      : [...value.weekdays, day];
    set({ weekdays: [...next].sort((a, b) => a - b) });
  }

  function changeEndMode(mode: RecurrenceEnd) {
    const untilUsable = isDateKey(value.untilDate) && value.untilDate >= value.startDate;
    if (mode === "until" && !untilUsable) {
      set({ endMode: mode, untilDate: startKnown ? addMonthsClamped(value.startDate, 3) : "" });
      return;
    }
    set({ endMode: mode });
  }

  const untilMax = startKnown ? addMonthsClamped(value.startDate, BOUNDS.untilYears * 12) : undefined;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <FormField label="Date de début" htmlFor={startDateId} error={startDateError}>
          <Input
            id={startDateId}
            type="date"
            min={minDate}
            value={value.startDate}
            disabled={disabled}
            aria-invalid={startDateError ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={describedBy(startDateId, false, startDateError)}
            onChange={(e) => changeStartDate(e.target.value)}
          />
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Heure de début" htmlFor={startTimeId} error={startTimeError}>
          <Input
            id={startTimeId}
            type="time"
            step={300}
            value={value.startTime}
            disabled={disabled}
            aria-invalid={startTimeError ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={describedBy(startTimeId, false, startTimeError)}
            onChange={(e) => set({ startTime: e.target.value })}
          />
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Durée" htmlFor={durationId} help={DURATION_HELP} error={durationError}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Input
              id={durationId}
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min={BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.min}
              max={BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.max}
              step={BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.step}
              value={value.durationMin > 0 ? value.durationMin : ""}
              disabled={disabled}
              aria-invalid={durationError ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={describedBy(durationId, true, durationError)}
              className="w-28"
              onChange={(e) => set({ durationMin: wholeNumber(e.target) })}
            />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">min</span>
          </div>
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Répétition" htmlFor={freqId} error={freqError}>
          <Select
            id={freqId}
            value={freq}
            disabled={disabled}
            aria-invalid={freqError ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={describedBy(freqId, false, freqError)}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const next = parseFreq(e.target.value);
              if (next) changeFreq(next);
            }}
          >
            {FREQ_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
              <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                {option.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </FormField>
      </div>

      {freq !== "once" && (
        <FormField label="Intervalle" htmlFor={intervalId} error={intervalError}>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <span>Tous les</span>
            <Input
              id={intervalId}
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min={1}
              max={BOUNDS.interval[freq]}
              step={1}
              value={value.interval > 0 ? value.interval : ""}
              disabled={disabled}
              aria-invalid={intervalError ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={describedBy(intervalId, false, intervalError)}
              className="w-20"
              onChange={(e) => set({ interval: wholeNumber(e.target) })}
            />
            <span>{INTERVAL_UNITS[freq]}</span>
          </div>
        </FormField>
      )}

      {freq === "weekly" && (
        <fieldset
          disabled={disabled}
          className="min-w-0 space-y-2"
          aria-describedby={describedBy(weekdaysId, true, weekdaysError)}
        >
          <legend className={LEGEND_CLASS}>Jours</legend>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5 sm:flex sm:gap-2">
            {WEEK_ORDER.map((day) => {
              const on = value.weekdays.includes(day);
              return (
                <button
                  key={day}
                  type="button"
                  aria-pressed={on}
                  aria-label={WEEKDAY_NAMES[day]}
                  onClick={() => toggleWeekday(day)}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex h-10 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-xl border text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 sm:w-10",
                    on
                      ? "border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
                      : "border-input bg-card text-foreground hover:bg-muted",
                  )}
                >
                  {WEEKDAY_LETTERS[day]}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <p id={`${weekdaysId}-help`} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {WEEKDAYS_HELP}
          </p>
          <GroupError id={`${weekdaysId}-error`} message={weekdaysError} />
        </fieldset>
      )}

      {freq === "monthly" && (
        <fieldset
          disabled={disabled}
          className="min-w-0 space-y-1"
          aria-describedby={monthlyError ? `${monthlyId}-error` : undefined}
        >
          <legend className={LEGEND_CLASS}>Jour du mois</legend>
          {choices.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{MONTHLY_NEEDS_DATE}</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex flex-col">
              {choices.map((choice) => (
                <Radio
                  key={choice.value}
                  id={`${monthlyId}-${choice.value}`}
                  name={monthlyId}
                  checked={value.monthlyChoice === choice.value}
                  onSelect={() => set({ monthlyChoice: choice.value })}
                >
                  {choice.label}
                </Radio>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <GroupError id={`${monthlyId}-error`} message={monthlyError} />
        </fieldset>
      )}

      {freq !== "once" && (
        <fieldset disabled={disabled} className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
          <legend className={LEGEND_CLASS}>Fin</legend>
          <div>
            <Radio
              id={`${endId}-never`}
              name={endId}
              checked={value.endMode === "never"}
              onSelect={() => changeEndMode("never")}
            >
              Jamais
            </Radio>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2">
            <Radio
              id={`${endId}-until`}
              name={endId}
              checked={value.endMode === "until"}
              onSelect={() => changeEndMode("until")}
            >
              Le
            </Radio>
            <Input
              id={untilDateId}
              type="date"
              aria-label="Date de fin"
              min={startKnown ? value.startDate : undefined}
              max={untilMax}
              value={value.untilDate}
              disabled={disabled}
              aria-invalid={untilError ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={untilError ? `${untilDateId}-error` : undefined}
              className="w-44"
              onChange={(e) => set({ endMode: "until", untilDate: e.target.value })}
            />
          </div>
          <GroupError id={`${untilDateId}-error`} message={untilError} />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2">
            <Radio
              id={`${endId}-count`}
              name={endId}
              checked={value.endMode === "count"}
              onSelect={() => changeEndMode("count")}
            >
              Après
            </Radio>
            <Input
              id={countId}
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              aria-label="Nombre de séances"
              min={BOUNDS.occurrenceCount.min}
              max={BOUNDS.occurrenceCount.max}
              step={1}
              value={value.occurrenceCount > 0 ? value.occurrenceCount : ""}
              disabled={disabled}
              aria-invalid={countError ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={countError ? `${countId}-error` : undefined}
              className="w-24"
              onChange={(e) => set({ endMode: "count", occurrenceCount: wholeNumber(e.target) })}
            />
            <span className="text-sm">séances</span>
          </div>
          <GroupError id={`${countId}-error`} message={countError} />
          <GroupError id={`${endId}-error`} message={endModeError} />
        </fieldset>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

type PreviewModel = {
  label: string;
  warning: string | null;
  dstNotes: string[];
  dstMore: number;
  upcoming: { key: string; text: string }[];
};

/** Everything the preview shows, computed from the form value; null when the form is not a valid rule yet. */
function buildPreview(value: RecurrenceFormValue, tz: string, now: Date): PreviewModel | null {
  const summary = recurrenceSummary(value);
  const built = ruleFromForm(value);
  if (!summary || !built) return null;
  const dates = previewDates(built.rule, built.durationMin, tz, now, DST_SCAN_LIMIT);
  const notes = dstNoteTexts(
    built.rule,
    built.durationMin,
    tz,
    dates.map((d) => d.seriesDate),
  );
  return {
    label: summary.label,
    warning: summary.warning,
    dstNotes: notes.slice(0, DST_NOTES_SHOWN),
    dstMore: Math.max(0, notes.length - DST_NOTES_SHOWN),
    upcoming: dates.slice(0, UPCOMING_SHOWN).map((d) => ({
      key: `${d.seriesDate}-${d.startsAt.getTime()}`,
      text: formatWhenShort(d.startsAt, tz),
    })),
  };
}

export function RecurrencePreview({
  value,
  tz,
  nowIso,
  rdvConflicts,
}: {
  value: RecurrenceFormValue;
  tz: string;
  nowIso: string;
  rdvConflicts: number | null;
}) {
  const now = useMemo(() => new Date(nowIso), [nowIso]);
  const preview = useMemo(() => buildPreview(value, tz, now), [value, tz, now]);

  if (!preview) {
    return (
      <p
        aria-live="polite"
        className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground"
      >
        {PREVIEW_INCOMPLETE}
      </p>
    );
  }

  const conflicts = rdvConflicts ?? 0;

  return (
    <div
      aria-live="polite"
      className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/40 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
    >
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <p className="font-semibold">{preview.label}</p>
        {preview.warning && (
          <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-xs text-warning">
            <TriangleAlert className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>{preview.warning}</span>
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {preview.dstNotes.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="space-y-1">
          {preview.dstNotes.map((note) => (
            <li key={note} className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-xs">
              <Info className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>{note}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
          {preview.dstMore > 0 && (
            <li className="pl-5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {`et ${preview.dstMore} ${preview.dstMore === 1 ? "autre changement" : "autres changements"} d'heure`}
            </li>
          )}
        </ul>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-1">
        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Prochaines séances</p>
        {preview.upcoming.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{NO_UPCOMING}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="space-y-0.5">
            {preview.upcoming.map((item) => (
              <li key={item.key} className="tabular-nums">
                {item.text}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>

      {conflicts > 0 && (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-xs text-warning">
          <TriangleAlert className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            {`Conflit avec ${plural(conflicts, "RDV déjà réservé", "RDV déjà réservés")} : les deux apparaîtront dans votre planning.`}
          </span>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

Notes on the code (so the implementer does not "fix" them): number fields hold `0` when cleared (`wholeNumber`) and render empty, so typing "6" then "60" works and the schema messages (« Durée : minimum 5. ») cover the empty case; the forms set `noValidate` so the browser never shows its own English bubble; `aria-describedby` on the weekday and monthly fieldsets points to ids that exist only when the help or error is rendered (the weekday help is always rendered).

- Produces (contract § 4.12):

- Page route `/dashboard/events/new` (contract § 6): `searchParams: Promise<{ date?: string | string[]; minute?: string | string[] }>`.

Behaviour decisions this task applies (the implementer must not change them):
- Nothing is preselected in « Tickets acceptés » (the list reads « Une liste vide n'accepte personne : l'événement sera signalé. »).
- The form is `noValidate`: validation is `parseFr(eventInputSchema)`, so every message is French. The first message is shown in a `FormError` above the submit button (`« Titre : ce champ est obligatoire. »`), the per-field messages under their fields, and focus moves to the first `aria-invalid` control.
- `createEventAction` is not idempotent: a ref lock plus a `created` state keep the button disabled from the first submit until the navigation, and only a failure releases the lock (the form stays filled).
- The live preview (`previewNewEventAction`, 600 ms debounce) is attached to the memoised `submittableRule` object: a response for an older rule is ignored by identity, so the conflict line never describes a previous edit. The setState happens inside the timer callback, never synchronously in the effect body.

```tsx

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import type { TypeOption } from "@/lib/back-office/catalog-reads";
import { EVENT_DEFAULTS } from "@/lib/back-office/event-defaults";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { MODE_HELP } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";
import {
  defaultRecurrenceForm,
  ruleFromForm,
  type RecurrenceFormValue,
} from "@/lib/back-office/recurrence-form";
import type { BookingWindow } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import type { DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { eventInputSchema, type EventInfoInput, type EventInput, type WindowOverrides } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { BOOKING_MODES, BOOKING_MODE_LABELS, BOUNDS, type BookingMode } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";
import { createEventAction, previewNewEventAction } from "@/server/pro-catalog";

const PREVIEW_DEBOUNCE_MS = 600;
/** Dot colour of an archived type that is still linked (the page only knows its id and name). */
const ARCHIVED_DOT_COLOR = "#a1a1aa";
/** Shown when a Server Action call itself fails (network): the form stays filled. Shared by the event forms. */
export const REQUEST_FAILED = "La demande n'a pas abouti. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.";
const LEGEND_CLASS = "mb-2 text-sm font-medium leading-none text-foreground";

const NO_OVERRIDES: WindowOverrides = {
  bookingHorizonDays: null,
  minNoticeMinutes: null,
  cancelDeadlineHours: null,
};
const NO_LINKED_ARCHIVED: { id: string; name: string }[] = [];

export type EventInfoValue = {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  location: string;
  color: string;
  bookingMode: BookingMode;
  isPrivate: boolean;
  capacity: number;
  overrides: WindowOverrides;
  ticketTypeIds: string[];
  questions: QuestionDraft[];
};

/** The EventInfoInput of a form value ("" becomes null, questions go through inputsFromDrafts). */
export function eventInfoInput(v: EventInfoValue): EventInfoInput {
  return {
    title: v.title,
    description: v.description.trim() === "" ? null : v.description,
    location: v.location.trim() === "" ? null : v.location,
    color: v.color,
    bookingMode: v.bookingMode,
    isPrivate: v.isPrivate,
    capacity: v.capacity,
    overrides: v.overrides,
    ticketTypeIds: v.ticketTypeIds,
    questions: inputsFromDrafts(v.questions),
  };
}

function newEventInfo(): EventInfoValue {
  return {
    title: "",
    description: "",
    location: "",
    color: EVENT_DEFAULTS.color,
    bookingMode: EVENT_DEFAULTS.bookingMode,
    isPrivate: false,
    capacity: EVENT_DEFAULTS.capacity,
    overrides: NO_OVERRIDES,
    ticketTypeIds: [],
    questions: [],
  };
}

function hasOverrides(o: WindowOverrides): boolean {
  return o.bookingHorizonDays !== null || o.minNoticeMinutes !== null || o.cancelDeadlineHours !== null;
}

/** First message whose dotted key is `prefix` or starts with `prefix.` (parseFr keys: `questions.0.label`). */
function firstErrorUnder(errors: Record<string, string>, prefix: string): string | null {
  for (const [key, message] of Object.entries(errors)) {
    if (key === prefix || key.startsWith(`${prefix}.`)) return message;
  }
  return null;
}

function describedBy(id: string, hasHelp: boolean, error: string | null): string | undefined {
  const ids: string[] = [];
  if (hasHelp) ids.push(`${id}-help`);
  if (error) ids.push(`${id}-error`);
  return ids.length > 0 ? ids.join(" ") : undefined;
}

function GroupError({ id, message }: { id: string; message: string | null }) {
  if (!message) return null;
  return (
    <p id={id} role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
      {message}
    </p>
  );
}

/** After a refused submit: the controls rendered with aria-invalid take focus (the first one wins). */
function focusFirstInvalid(form: HTMLFormElement | null) {
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    form?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-invalid="true"]')?.focus();
  }, 0);
}

export function EventInfoFields({
  idPrefix,
  value,
  onChange,
  typeOptions,
  linkedArchivedTypes,
  proWindow,
  fieldErrors,
  disabled = false,
}: {
  idPrefix: string;
  value: EventInfoValue;
  onChange: (next: EventInfoValue) => void;
  typeOptions: TypeOption[];
  linkedArchivedTypes: { id: string; name: string }[];
  proWindow: BookingWindow;
  fieldErrors: Record<string, string>;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const set = (patch: Partial<EventInfoValue>) => onChange({ ...value, ...patch });
  const [overridesOpen, setOverridesOpen] = useState(() => hasOverrides(value.overrides));

  const titleId = `${idPrefix}-title`;
  const descriptionId = `${idPrefix}-description`;
  const locationId = `${idPrefix}-location`;
  const colorId = `${idPrefix}-color`;
  const capacityId = `${idPrefix}-capacity`;
  const modeName = `${idPrefix}-mode`;
  const typesId = `${idPrefix}-types`;
  const questionsId = `${idPrefix}-questions`;
  const privateId = `${idPrefix}-private`;
  const overridesId = `${idPrefix}-overrides`;

  const titleError = fieldErrors.title ?? null;
  const descriptionError = fieldErrors.description ?? null;
  const locationError = fieldErrors.location ?? null;
  const colorError = fieldErrors.color ?? null;
  const capacityError = fieldErrors.capacity ?? null;
  const modeError = fieldErrors.bookingMode ?? null;
  const typesError = firstErrorUnder(fieldErrors, "ticketTypeIds");
  const questionsError = firstErrorUnder(fieldErrors, "questions");
  const overridesError = firstErrorUnder(fieldErrors, "overrides");

  const typeRows = [
    ...typeOptions.map((t) => ({ id: t.id, name: t.name, color: t.color, archived: false })),
    ...linkedArchivedTypes.map((t) => ({ id: t.id, name: t.name, color: ARCHIVED_DOT_COLOR, archived: true })),
  ];

  function toggleType(id: string) {
    set({
      ticketTypeIds: value.ticketTypeIds.includes(id)
        ? value.ticketTypeIds.filter((t) => t !== id)
        : [...value.ticketTypeIds, id],
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <FormField label="Titre" htmlFor={titleId} error={titleError}>
        <Input
          id={titleId}
          value={value.title}
          maxLength={BOUNDS.title}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-invalid={titleError ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={describedBy(titleId, false, titleError)}
          onChange={(e) => set({ title: e.target.value })}
        />
      </FormField>

      <FormField label="Description" htmlFor={descriptionId} optional error={descriptionError}>
        <Textarea
          id={descriptionId}
          rows={3}
          value={value.description}
          maxLength={BOUNDS.description}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-invalid={descriptionError ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={describedBy(descriptionId, false, descriptionError)}
          onChange={(e) => set({ description: e.target.value })}
        />
      </FormField>

      <FormField
        label="Lieu"
        htmlFor={locationId}
        optional
        help="Le lieu peut aussi changer séance par séance, depuis le planning."
        error={locationError}
      >
        <Input
          id={locationId}
          value={value.location}
          maxLength={BOUNDS.location}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-invalid={locationError ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={describedBy(locationId, true, locationError)}
          onChange={(e) => set({ location: e.target.value })}
        />
      </FormField>

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <FormField label="Couleur" htmlFor={colorId} error={colorError}>
          <input
            id={colorId}
            type="color"
            value={value.color}
            disabled={disabled}
            aria-invalid={colorError ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={describedBy(colorId, false, colorError)}
            onChange={(e) => set({ color: e.target.value })}
            className="h-10 w-16 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-input bg-card p-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
          />
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Places" htmlFor={capacityId} help="Par séance." error={capacityError}>
          <Input
            id={capacityId}
            type="number"
            inputMode="numeric"
            min={BOUNDS.capacity.min}
            max={BOUNDS.capacity.max}
            step={1}
            value={value.capacity > 0 ? value.capacity : ""}
            disabled={disabled}
            aria-invalid={capacityError ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={describedBy(capacityId, true, capacityError)}
            className="w-28"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const n = e.target.valueAsNumber;
              set({ capacity: Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.trunc(n) : 0 });
            }}
          />
        </FormField>
      </div>

      <fieldset disabled={disabled} className="min-w-0 space-y-2">
        <legend className={LEGEND_CLASS}>Mode de réservation</legend>
        <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {BOOKING_MODES.map((mode) => {
            const id = `${modeName}-${mode}`;
            return (
              <label key={mode} htmlFor={id} className="relative block cursor-pointer">
                <input
                  id={id}
                  type="radio"
                  name={modeName}
                  checked={value.bookingMode === mode}
                  onChange={() => set({ bookingMode: mode })}
                  className="peer sr-only"
                />
                <span className="block h-full rounded-xl border border-input bg-card p-3 transition-colors hover:bg-muted peer-checked:border-primary peer-checked:bg-primary-muted peer-focus-visible:ring-2 peer-focus-visible:ring-ring peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed peer-disabled:opacity-50">
                  <span className="block text-sm font-medium">{BOOKING_MODE_LABELS[mode]}</span>
                  <span className="mt-1 block text-xs text-foreground/70">{MODE_HELP[mode]}</span>
                </span>
              </label>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <GroupError id={`${modeName}-error`} message={modeError} />
      </fieldset>

      {value.bookingMode === "tickets" && (
        <fieldset
          disabled={disabled}
          className="min-w-0 space-y-2"
          aria-describedby={describedBy(typesId, typeRows.length > 0, typesError)}
        >
          <legend className={LEGEND_CLASS}>Tickets acceptés</legend>
          {typeRows.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucun type de ticket actif.</p>
              <Link
                href="/dashboard/tickets"
                className="text-sm font-medium text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
              >
                Créer un type de ticket
              </Link>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                {typeRows.map((row) => (
                  <label key={row.id} className="flex min-h-10 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={value.ticketTypeIds.includes(row.id)}
                      onChange={() => toggleType(row.id)}
                      className="size-4 cursor-pointer accent-primary"
                    />
                    <TypeChip name={row.name} color={row.color} archived={row.archived} />
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
              <p id={`${typesId}-help`} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {"Une liste vide n'accepte personne : l'événement sera signalé."}
              </p>
            </>
          )}
          <GroupError id={`${typesId}-error`} message={typesError} />
        </fieldset>
      )}

      <Switch
        id={privateId}
        checked={value.isPrivate}
        onCheckedChange={(isPrivate) => set({ isPrivate })}
        label="Privé"
        description="Masqué de votre page publique : vous y inscrivez vos clients vous-même."
        disabled={disabled}
      />

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <p id={questionsId} className="text-sm font-medium leading-none">
          {"Questions d'inscription"}
        </p>
        <QuestionsEditor
          idPrefix={`${idPrefix}-q`}
          value={value.questions}
          onChange={(questions) => set({ questions })}
          disabled={disabled}
        />
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {"Posées au client quand il s'inscrit. Vous n'êtes jamais obligé d'y répondre."}
        </p>
        <GroupError id={`${questionsId}-error`} message={questionsError} />
      </div>

      <details
        open={overridesOpen || overridesError !== null}
        onToggle={(e) => setOverridesOpen(e.currentTarget.open)}
        className="rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-3"
      >
        <summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium">Règles de réservation</summary>
        <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
          <WindowOverrideFields
            idPrefix={overridesId}
            value={value.overrides}
            onChange={(overrides) => set({ overrides })}
            proWindow={proWindow}
            disabled={disabled}
          />
          <GroupError id={`${overridesId}-error`} message={overridesError} />
        </div>
      </details>
    </div>
  );
}

type NewEventPreview = {
  /** The submittable rule this answer was computed for (compared by identity). */
  forRule: unknown;
  rdvConflicts: number;
  occurrenceCount: number;
};

export function EventCreateForm({
  tz,
  nowIso,
  todayKey,
  initialStart,
  typeOptions,
  proWindow,
}: {
  tz: string;
  nowIso: string;
  todayKey: DateKey;
  initialStart: { startDate: DateKey; startMinute: number };
  typeOptions: TypeOption[];
  proWindow: BookingWindow;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const submitting = useRef(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [created, setCreated] = useState(false);
  const [info, setInfo] = useState<EventInfoValue>(newEventInfo);
  const [recurrence, setRecurrence] = useState<RecurrenceFormValue>(() =>
    defaultRecurrenceForm(initialStart, EVENT_DEFAULTS.durationMin),
  );
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<NewEventPreview | null>(null);

  const locked = pending || created;
  const built = useMemo(() => submittableRule(recurrence), [recurrence]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!built) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      previewNewEventAction({ rule: built.rule, durationMin: built.durationMin })
        .then((res) => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setPreview(
            res.ok
              ? { forRule: built, rdvConflicts: res.rdvConflicts, occurrenceCount: res.occurrenceCount }
              : null,
          );
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (!cancelled) setPreview(null);
        });
    }, PREVIEW_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [built]);

  const livePreview = preview !== null && preview.forRule === built ? preview : null;

  function submit(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (submitting.current) return;

    const rule = ruleFromForm(recurrence);
    if (!rule) {
      // ruleFromForm is null only for a cleared or malformed start date or start time: no schema can name the field.
      const dateWrong = startProblem(recurrence) === "date";
      setFieldErrors(
        dateWrong ? { "rule.startDate": START_DATE_FIELD_ERROR } : { "rule.startMinute": START_TIME_FIELD_ERROR },
      );
      setFormError(dateWrong ? START_DATE_ERROR : START_TIME_ERROR);
      focusFirstInvalid(formRef.current);
      return;
    }
    const input: EventInput = { ...eventInfoInput(info), durationMin: rule.durationMin, rule: rule.rule };
    const parsed = parseFr(eventInputSchema, input);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      setFieldErrors(parsed.fieldErrors);
      setFormError(parsed.error);
      focusFirstInvalid(formRef.current);
      return;
    }

    setFieldErrors({});
    setFormError(null);
    submitting.current = true;
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await createEventAction(input);
        if (!res.ok) {
          submitting.current = false;
          setFormError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setCreated(true);
        router.push(`/dashboard/events/${res.eventId}`);
      } catch {
        submitting.current = false;
        setFormError(REQUEST_FAILED);
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <form ref={formRef} noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="max-w-3xl space-y-6">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Informations</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <EventInfoFields
            idPrefix="new-event"
            value={info}
            onChange={setInfo}
            typeOptions={typeOptions}
            linkedArchivedTypes={NO_LINKED_ARCHIVED}
            proWindow={proWindow}
            fieldErrors={fieldErrors}
            disabled={locked}
          />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Horaire</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <RecurrenceEditor
            idPrefix="new-event-rec"
            value={recurrence}
            onChange={setRecurrence}
            minDate={todayKey}
            fieldErrors={fieldErrors}
            disabled={locked}
          />
          <RecurrencePreview
            value={recurrence}
            tz={tz}
            nowIso={nowIso}
            rdvConflicts={livePreview ? livePreview.rdvConflicts : null}
          />
          {livePreview !== null && livePreview.occurrenceCount > 0 && (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {`${plural(livePreview.occurrenceCount, "séance sera créée", "séances seront créées")}.`}
            </p>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        <FormError message={formError} />
        <Button type="submit" disabled={locked}>
          {locked && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
          {"Créer l'événement"}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";

import { EventCreateForm } from "@/components/dashboard/event-editor";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/page-header";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { defaultEventStart, parseClickedCell } from "@/lib/back-office/event-defaults";
import { todayKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { getCurrentProfessional } from "@/lib/session";
import { getActiveTypeOptions } from "@/server/catalog-queries";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Nouvel événement" };

export default async function NewEventPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ date?: string | string[]; minute?: string | string[] }>;
}) {
  const pro = (await getCurrentProfessional())!;
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const now = new Date();
  const initialStart = defaultEventStart({
    now,
    tz: pro.timezone,
    clicked: parseClickedCell(sp),
  });
  const typeOptions = (await getActiveTypeOptions(pro.id)).filter((t) => !t.rdvFree);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Nouvel événement"
        description="Un cours ponctuel ou récurrent. Vous pourrez tout modifier ensuite."
        action={
          <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">
            <Link href="/dashboard/events">
              <ArrowLeft />
              Tous les événements
            </Link>
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <EventCreateForm
        tz={pro.timezone}
        nowIso={now.toISOString()}
        todayKey={todayKey(now, pro.timezone)}
        initialStart={initialStart}
        typeOptions={typeOptions}
        proWindow={{
          bookingHorizonDays: pro.bookingHorizonDays,
          minNoticeMinutes: pro.minNoticeMinutes,
          cancelDeadlineHours: pro.cancelDeadlineHours,
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

**Files:**

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (Tasks 18, 19): `RecurrenceEditor`, `RecurrencePreview`, `startProblem`, `START_TIME_ERROR`, `START_TIME_FIELD_ERROR`, `START_DATE_ERROR`, `START_DATE_FIELD_ERROR` (`recurrence-editor.tsx`); `EventInfoFields`, `EventInfoValue`, `eventInfoInput`, `REQUEST_FAILED` (`event-editor.tsx`).
- Consumes (Task 16): `eventInfoSchema` (`@/lib/tickets`), `editEventInfoAction`, `previewScheduleAction`, `applyScheduleAction`, `deleteEventPreviewAction`, `deleteEventFromAction` (`@/server/pro-catalog`, signatures in contract § 4.11), `SchedulePreview` (type, `@/lib/back-office/event-actions`).
- Consumes (Task 15): `getEventEditorPage(professionalId, eventId): Promise<EventEditorLookup>` (`@/server/catalog-queries`), `EventEditorData`, `DeletePreview` (types, `@/lib/back-office/event-reads`).
- Consumes (Tasks 3, 8, 14): `formFromRule(rule, durationMin)`, `ruleFromForm` (`recurrence-form`), `formatWhen`, `planningHref`, `plural` (`format`), `MODE_SHORT_LABELS` (`labels`), `deleteEventCopy`, `ConfirmCopy` (`confirm-copy`), `ConfirmDialog`, `FormError`, `FormField`, `StatusMark`, `PageSkeleton`.
- Produces (contract § 4.12):
  ```ts
  export function EventInfoForm(props: {
    eventId: string; seenVersion: number; initial: EventInfoValue; typeOptions: TypeOption[];
    linkedArchivedTypes: { id: string; name: string }[]; proWindow: BookingWindow; futureRegistrants: number; readOnly: boolean;
  }): JSX.Element;
  export function EventScheduleForm(props: {
    eventId: string; seenVersion: number; fromDate: DateKey | null; tz: string; nowIso: string;
    initial: RecurrenceFormValue; remainingCount: number | null; readOnly: boolean;
  }): JSX.Element;
  export function EventDeleteCard(props: {
    eventId: string; seenVersion: number; title: string; todayKey: DateKey; fromDate: DateKey | null; initialPreview: DeletePreview | null;
  }): JSX.Element;
  ```
- Page route `/dashboard/events/[id]` (contract § 6): `params: Promise<{ id: string }>`; unknown id or another pro's id: `notFound()`; an older segment id: `redirect` to the current segment (Q9).

Decisions this task applies (the implementer must not change them):
- The page owns the `Card` chrome; the three client components render card content only.
- The page imports `draftsFromRows` from the pure module `@/lib/back-office/question-drafts` (Task 13), never from the `"use client"` `questions-editor.tsx` (a Server Component cannot call a function exported by a client module); the client components keep importing it from `questions-editor.tsx`.
- `initial` of the schedule form: the engine requires `rule.startDate >= fromDate` (`planEdit`), so the form starts from the saved rule with `startDate = fromDate` (the first upcoming séance, which the rule produces, so weekly parity and the monthly choice stay valid) and, in count mode, `endMode: "count"`, `occurrenceCount = remainingCount`. The form remounts (React `key`) when the saved rule, the duration or `fromDate` change, never on an information save, so a schedule draft survives saving the information card.
- The RDV conflict line of a schedule preview is the `RecurrencePreview` line, fed by the previewed `rdvConflicts` only while that preview is current.
- « Appliquer à partir du … » is enabled only when the preview was computed for the exact current form value (identity of the value object; every edit creates a new object).
- Deleting re-reads the consequences when the confirmation opens (the page data can be minutes old): the dialog opens at once with `initialPreview`, both buttons stay disabled while the fresh `deleteEventPreviewAction` answer is awaited, and the copy is replaced by the fresh counts.
- `seenVersion` is read from props inside each handler at submit time, so the second save after the first one always carries the fresh version.

```tsx
export function EventInfoForm({
  eventId,
  seenVersion,
  initial,
  typeOptions,
  linkedArchivedTypes,
  proWindow,
  futureRegistrants,
  readOnly,
}: {
  eventId: string;
  seenVersion: number;
  initial: EventInfoValue;
  typeOptions: TypeOption[];
  linkedArchivedTypes: { id: string; name: string }[];
  proWindow: BookingWindow;
  futureRegistrants: number;
  readOnly: boolean;
}) {
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [value, setValue] = useState<EventInfoValue>(initial);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);

  function edit(next: EventInfoValue) {
    setValue(next);
    setSaved(false);
    setFieldErrors({});
    setFormError(null);
  }

  /** The saved location is the prop (it follows the page after every save), never the value the form started with. */
  const locationChanged = value.location.trim() !== initial.location.trim();

  function submit(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (readOnly || pending) return;
    const info = eventInfoInput(value);
    const parsed = parseFr(eventInfoSchema, info);
    setSaved(false);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      setFieldErrors(parsed.fieldErrors);
      setFormError(parsed.error);
      focusFirstInvalid(formRef.current);
      return;
    }
    setFieldErrors({});
    setFormError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        // seenVersion is this render's prop: after a save the page re-renders with the new version.
        const res = await editEventInfoAction({ eventId, seenVersion, info });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setFormError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setSaved(true);
      } catch {
        setFormError(REQUEST_FAILED);
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <form ref={formRef} noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
      <EventInfoFields
        idPrefix={`event-${eventId}`}
        value={value}
        onChange={edit}
        typeOptions={typeOptions}
        linkedArchivedTypes={linkedArchivedTypes}
        proWindow={proWindow}
        fieldErrors={fieldErrors}
        disabled={readOnly || pending}
      />
      {locationChanged && futureRegistrants > 0 && (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm">
          <Info className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            {`${plural(futureRegistrants, "inscrit", "inscrits")} des séances à venir seront prévenus du changement de lieu.`}
          </span>
        </p>
      )}
      <FormError message={formError} />
      {!readOnly && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
            {pending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
            Enregistrer les informations
          </Button>
          {saved && (
            <p role="status" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <Check className="size-4 text-success" aria-hidden="true" />
              Informations enregistrées.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Info, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { REQUEST_FAILED } from "@/components/dashboard/event-editor";
import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import {
  RecurrenceEditor,
  RecurrencePreview,
  START_DATE_ERROR,
  START_DATE_FIELD_ERROR,
  START_TIME_ERROR,
  START_TIME_FIELD_ERROR,
  startProblem,
} from "@/components/dashboard/recurrence-editor";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { SchedulePreview } from "@/lib/back-office/event-actions";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { ruleFromForm, type RecurrenceFormValue } from "@/lib/back-office/recurrence-form";
import { formatDayMonth, formatDayMonthYear, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { eventInputSchema, type RecurrenceRuleInput } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";
import { applyScheduleAction, previewScheduleAction } from "@/server/pro-catalog";

/** The two parts of an event this form edits, validated with the schema the server uses (keys `rule.*`, `durationMin`). */
const scheduleSchema = eventInputSchema.pick({ rule: true, durationMin: true });

const NO_FUTURE = "Plus aucune séance à venir dans cette série : l'horaire ne se modifie plus.";
const IN_PLACE_NOTE = "Aucune séance passée dans cette série : la modification s'applique directement.";

type Built = { rule: RecurrenceRuleInput; durationMin: number };
type Previewed = {
  /** The exact form value object the preview was computed for. */
  forValue: RecurrenceFormValue;
  built: Built;
  preview: SchedulePreview;
};

export function EventScheduleForm({
  eventId,
  seenVersion,
  fromDate,
  tz,
  nowIso,
  initial,
  remainingCount,
  readOnly,
}: {
  eventId: string;
  seenVersion: number;
  fromDate: DateKey | null;
  tz: string;
  nowIso: string;
  initial: RecurrenceFormValue;
  remainingCount: number | null;
  readOnly: boolean;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [value, setValue] = useState<RecurrenceFormValue>(initial);
  const [previewed, setPreviewed] = useState<Previewed | null>(null);
  const [orphans, setOrphans] = useState<"keep" | "cancel">("keep");
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState(false);
  const [previewing, startPreview] = useTransition();
  const [applying, startApply] = useTransition();

  if (fromDate === null) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{NO_FUTURE}</p>;
  }
  const from: DateKey = fromDate;

  /** Locked only while a request runs: after an apply that leaves the page key unchanged the form stays usable. */
  const locked = readOnly || previewing || applying;
  /** A preview counts only for the exact value it was computed for: any edit makes a new object. */
  const current = previewed !== null && previewed.forValue === value ? previewed : null;
  const orphanCount = current === null ? 0 : current.preview.summary.orphans;
  const summaryText =
    current === null ? "" : orphanCount > 0 && orphans === "cancel" ? current.preview.textCancel : current.preview.textKeep;

  function edit(next: RecurrenceFormValue) {
    setValue(next);
    setFieldErrors({});
    setFormError(null);
    setApplied(false);
  }

  function validate(): Built | null {
    const built = ruleFromForm(value);
    if (!built) {
      // ruleFromForm is null only for a cleared or malformed start date or start time: no schema can name the field.
      const dateWrong = startProblem(value) === "date";
      setFieldErrors(
        dateWrong ? { "rule.startDate": START_DATE_FIELD_ERROR } : { "rule.startMinute": START_TIME_FIELD_ERROR },
      );
      setFormError(dateWrong ? START_DATE_ERROR : START_TIME_ERROR);
      return null;
    }
    const parsed = parseFr(scheduleSchema, built);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      setFieldErrors(parsed.fieldErrors);
      setFormError(parsed.error);
      return null;
    }
    return built;
  }

  function runPreview() {
    if (locked) return;
    const built = validate();
    if (!built) return;
    setFormError(null);
    startPreview(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await previewScheduleAction({
          eventId,
          fromDate: from,
          rule: built.rule,
          durationMin: built.durationMin,
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setFormError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setPreviewed({ forValue: value, built, preview: res.preview });
        setOrphans("keep");
      } catch {
        setFormError(REQUEST_FAILED);
      }
    });
  }

  function apply() {
    if (locked || current === null) return;
    startApply(async () => {
      try {
        // seenVersion is this render's prop, read at submit time.
        const res = await applyScheduleAction({
          eventId,
          seenVersion,
          fromDate: from,
          rule: current.built.rule,
          durationMin: current.built.durationMin,
          orphans: orphanCount > 0 ? orphans : "keep",
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setFormError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setApplied(true);
        // The preview was for the schedule just applied: a new one is needed before the next apply.
        setPreviewed(null);
        router.push(`/dashboard/events/${res.eventId}`);
      } catch {
        setFormError(REQUEST_FAILED);
      }
    });
  }

  const orphansName = `schedule-${eventId}-orphans`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {`Les changements s'appliquent à partir du ${formatDayMonthYear(from)}, la première séance à venir.`}
        {remainingCount !== null && ` Il reste ${plural(remainingCount, "séance", "séances")}.`}
      </p>

      <RecurrenceEditor
        idPrefix={`schedule-${eventId}`}
        value={value}
        onChange={edit}
        minDate={from}
        disabled={locked}
        fieldErrors={fieldErrors}
      />
      <RecurrencePreview
        value={value}
        tz={tz}
        nowIso={nowIso}
        rdvConflicts={current ? current.preview.rdvConflicts : null}
      />

      {current && (
        <div
          aria-live="polite"
          className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary-muted/50 p-4 text-sm"
        >
          <p className="font-medium">{summaryText}</p>
          {orphanCount > 0 && (
            <fieldset disabled={locked} className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
              <legend className="mb-1 text-sm">
                {`${plural(orphanCount, "séance avec inscrits n'est", "séances avec inscrits ne sont")} plus dans le nouvel horaire :`}
              </legend>
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2">
                  <input
                    id={`${orphansName}-keep`}
                    type="radio"
                    name={orphansName}
                    checked={orphans === "keep"}
                    onChange={() => setOrphans("keep")}
                    className="size-4 cursor-pointer accent-primary"
                  />
                  <label htmlFor={`${orphansName}-keep`} className="cursor-pointer">
                    Garder (séance isolée)
                  </label>
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2">
                  <input
                    id={`${orphansName}-cancel`}
                    type="radio"
                    name={orphansName}
                    checked={orphans === "cancel"}
                    onChange={() => setOrphans("cancel")}
                    className="size-4 cursor-pointer accent-primary"
                  />
                  <label htmlFor={`${orphansName}-cancel`} className="cursor-pointer">
                    Annuler (tickets rendus)
                  </label>
                </span>
              </div>
            </fieldset>
          )}
          {current.preview.inPlace && (
            <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-xs">
              <Info className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>{IN_PLACE_NOTE}</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <FormError message={formError} />

      {!readOnly && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={runPreview} disabled={locked}>
            {previewing && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
            Prévisualiser les changements
          </Button>
          <Button type="button" onClick={apply} disabled={locked || current === null}>
            {applying && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
            {`Appliquer à partir du ${formatDayMonth(from)}`}
          </Button>
          {applied && (
            <p role="status" className="text-sm">
              Horaire appliqué.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { REQUEST_FAILED } from "@/components/dashboard/event-editor";
import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { deleteEventCopy, type ConfirmCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import type { DeletePreview } from "@/lib/back-office/event-reads";
import { formatDayMonth, formatDayMonthYear, maxKey, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { deleteEventFromAction, deleteEventPreviewAction } from "@/server/pro-catalog";

const DATE_KEY_PATTERN = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const CLOSED_COPY: ConfirmCopy = { title: "", body: "", confirm: "" };
const NO_FUTURE = "Plus aucune séance à venir.";
const DONE = "Les séances à venir sont supprimées.";

type Target = { fromDate: DateKey; preview: DeletePreview };

export function EventDeleteCard({
  eventId,
  seenVersion,
  title,
  todayKey,
  fromDate,
  initialPreview,
}: {
  eventId: string;
  seenVersion: number;
  title: string;
  todayKey: DateKey;
  fromDate: DateKey | null;
  initialPreview: DeletePreview | null;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loadingWhole, startWhole] = useTransition();
  const [loadingCustom, startCustom] = useTransition();
  const [deleting, startDeleting] = useTransition();
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState(false);
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<Target | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [customOpen, setCustomOpen] = useState(false);
  const minCustom = fromDate === null ? todayKey : maxKey(todayKey, fromDate);
  const [customDate, setCustomDate] = useState<string>(minCustom);
  const [customError, setCustomError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (fromDate === null) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{NO_FUTURE}</p>;
  }
  const from: DateKey = fromDate;

  const busy = loadingWhole || loadingCustom || deleting || leaving;
  const dialogPending = loadingWhole || deleting || leaving;
  const copy: ConfirmCopy = target
    ? deleteEventCopy({
        title,
        fromLabel: target.preview.deleteWhole ? null : formatDayMonth(target.fromDate),
        ...target.preview,
      })
    : CLOSED_COPY;

  /** The consequences of deleting from `date`, read now; a failure is shown and returns null. */
  async function load(date: DateKey): Promise<DeletePreview | null> {
    try {
      const res = await deleteEventPreviewAction({ eventId, fromDate: date });
      if (res.ok) return res.preview;
      setError(res.error);
    } catch {
      setError(REQUEST_FAILED);
    }
    return null;
  }

  function openWhole() {
    if (busy) return;
    setError(null);
    setDone(false);
    if (initialPreview !== null) setTarget({ fromDate: from, preview: initialPreview });
    startWhole(async () => {
      const preview = await load(from);
      setTarget(preview === null ? null : { fromDate: from, preview });
    });
  }

  function openCustom() {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!DATE_KEY_PATTERN.test(customDate) || customDate < minCustom) {
      setCustomError(`Choisissez une date à partir du ${formatDayMonthYear(minCustom)}.`);
      return;
    }
    setCustomError(null);
    setError(null);
    setDone(false);
    const date: DateKey = customDate;
    startCustom(async () => {
      const preview = await load(date);
      if (preview !== null) setTarget({ fromDate: date, preview });
    });
  }

  function close() {
    if (dialogPending) return;
    setTarget(null);
    setError(null);
  }

  function confirm() {
    if (target === null || dialogPending) return;
    const date = target.fromDate;
    startDeleting(async () => {
      try {
        // seenVersion is this render's prop, read at submit time.
        const res = await deleteEventFromAction({ eventId, seenVersion, fromDate: date });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        if (res.deletedEvent) {
          setLeaving(true);
          router.push("/dashboard/events");
          return;
        }
        setTarget(null);
        setCustomOpen(false);
        setDone(true);
      } catch {
        setError(REQUEST_FAILED);
      }
    });
  }

  const dateId = `delete-${eventId}-from`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <Button type="button" variant="destructive" onClick={openWhole} disabled={busy}>
          {loadingWhole && target === null ? (
            <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Trash2 className="size-4" />
          )}
          {"Supprimer l'événement"}
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="secondary"
          aria-expanded={customOpen}
          onClick={() => setCustomOpen((open) => !open)}
          disabled={busy}
        >
          Supprimer à partir du…
        </Button>
      </div>

      {customOpen && (
        <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-border p-4">
          <FormField label="À partir du" htmlFor={dateId} error={customError}>
            <Input
              id={dateId}
              type="date"
              min={minCustom}
              value={customDate}
              disabled={busy}
              aria-invalid={customError ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={customError ? `${dateId}-error` : undefined}
              className="w-44"
              onChange={(e) => {
                setCustomDate(e.target.value);
                setCustomError(null);
              }}
            />
          </FormField>
          <Button type="button" variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={openCustom} disabled={busy}>
            {loadingCustom && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
            Voir les conséquences
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      <FormError message={target === null ? error : null} />
      {done && (
        <p role="status" className="text-sm">
          {DONE}
        </p>
      )}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={target !== null}
        copy={copy}
        pending={dialogPending}
        error={target !== null ? error : null}
        onConfirm={confirm}
        onClose={close}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";

import { EventDeleteCard } from "@/components/dashboard/event-delete-card";
import { EventInfoForm, type EventInfoValue } from "@/components/dashboard/event-editor";
import { EventScheduleForm } from "@/components/dashboard/event-schedule-form";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/page-header";
import { StatusMark } from "@/components/dashboard/status-mark";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { formatWhen, planningHref } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { MODE_SHORT_LABELS } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";
import { draftsFromRows } from "@/lib/back-office/question-drafts";
import { formFromRule } from "@/lib/back-office/recurrence-form";
import { formatDayMonthYear, todayKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { getCurrentProfessional } from "@/lib/session";
import { OCCURRENCE_STATUS_LABELS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { getEventEditorPage } from "@/server/catalog-queries";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Événement" };

export default async function EventPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const pro = (await getCurrentProfessional())!;
  const lookup = await getEventEditorPage(pro.id, id);
  if (!lookup) notFound();
  if (lookup.kind === "redirect") redirect(`/dashboard/events/${lookup.eventId}`);

  const { data } = lookup;
  const { event } = data;
  const tz = pro.timezone;
  const now = new Date();

  const noActiveType =
    event.bookingMode === "tickets" &&
    !event.ticketTypeIds.some((typeId) => data.typeOptions.some((option) => option.id === typeId));

  const initialInfo: EventInfoValue = {
    title: event.title,
    description: event.description ?? "",
    location: event.location ?? "",
    color: event.color,
    bookingMode: event.bookingMode,
    isPrivate: event.isPrivate,
    capacity: event.capacity,
    overrides: event.overrides,
    ticketTypeIds: event.ticketTypeIds,
    questions: draftsFromRows(event.questions),
  };

  const savedSchedule = formFromRule(event.rule, event.durationMin);
  const initialSchedule =
    data.fromDate === null
      ? savedSchedule
      : {
          ...savedSchedule,
          startDate: data.fromDate,
          ...(data.remainingCount === null
            ? {}
            : { endMode: "count" as const, occurrenceCount: data.remainingCount }),
        };
  const scheduleKey = `${event.id}:${data.fromDate ?? "none"}:${event.durationMin}:${JSON.stringify(event.rule)}`;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={event.title}
        description={event.recurrenceLabel}
        action={
          <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">
            <Link href="/dashboard/events">
              <ArrowLeft />
              Tous les événements
            </Link>
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <div className="-mt-3 mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Badge variant="neutral">{MODE_SHORT_LABELS[event.bookingMode]}</Badge>
        {event.isPrivate && <Badge variant="outline">Privé</Badge>}
        {noActiveType && (
          <Badge variant="warning">
            <StatusMark tone="orange" label="Aucun ticket actif accepté" />
            Aucun ticket actif accepté
          </Badge>
        )}
        {data.readOnly && <Badge variant="neutral">Terminé</Badge>}
      </div>

      {data.readOnly && (
        <p className="mb-6 max-w-3xl rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted px-4 py-3 text-sm">
          Cet événement est terminé : il ne se modifie plus.
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="max-w-3xl space-y-6">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Informations</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <EventInfoForm
              eventId={event.id}
              seenVersion={event.version}
              initial={initialInfo}
              typeOptions={data.typeOptions}
              linkedArchivedTypes={data.linkedArchivedTypes}
              proWindow={data.proWindow}
              futureRegistrants={data.futureRegistrants}
              readOnly={data.readOnly}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Horaire et récurrence</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <EventScheduleForm
              key={scheduleKey}
              eventId={event.id}
              seenVersion={event.version}
              fromDate={data.fromDate}
              tz={tz}
              nowIso={now.toISOString()}
              initial={initialSchedule}
              remainingCount={data.remainingCount}
              readOnly={data.readOnly}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Prochaines séances</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {data.upcoming.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucune séance à venir.</p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="-mx-3 space-y-0.5">
                {data.upcoming.map((occurrence) => (
                  <li key={occurrence.id}>
                    <Link
                      href={planningHref({ occurrenceId: occurrence.id, startsAt: occurrence.startsAt, tz })}
                      className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-muted"
                    >
                      <span className="tabular-nums">{formatWhen(occurrence.startsAt, occurrence.endsAt, tz)}</span>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {occurrence.status === "cancelled" && (
                          <Badge variant="neutral">{OCCURRENCE_STATUS_LABELS.cancelled}</Badge>
                        )}
                        <span>{`${occurrence.seatsTaken} / ${occurrence.capacity} places`}</span>
                      </span>
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {data.otherSegments.length > 0 && (
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Segments précédents</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                {"Une série modifiée « à partir du » garde ses séances passées dans un segment précédent."}
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <ul className="space-y-2">
                {data.otherSegments.map((segment) => (
                  <li
                    key={segment.eventId}
                    className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  >
                    <span>{segment.recurrenceLabel}</span>
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {segment.firstDate > event.rule.startDate && <Badge variant="neutral">À venir</Badge>}
                      <span>
                        {segment.lastDate === null
                          ? `À partir du ${formatDayMonthYear(segment.firstDate)}`
                          : `Du ${formatDayMonthYear(segment.firstDate)} au ${formatDayMonthYear(segment.lastDate)}`}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Supprimer</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <EventDeleteCard
              eventId={event.id}
              seenVersion={event.version}
              title={event.title}
              todayKey={todayKey(now, tz)}
              fromDate={data.fromDate}
              initialPreview={data.deletePreview}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";

import { addDays, instantAt, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";

import type { PlanningAttendee, PlanningItem, PlanningTimeOff } from "./planning-reads";
import {
  dayLongLabel,
  dayShortLabel,
  gridHours,
  hhmm,
  hiddenByTimeOff,
  minuteFromOffset,
  timeOffSegments,
  tintOf,
  toPlanningVM,
  unenrolledMessage,
  weekTitle,
} from "./planning-view";

const PARIS = "Europe/Paris";
const LA = "America/Los_Angeles";
const NO_DASH = new RegExp(`[${String.fromCharCode(0x2013)}${String.fromCharCode(0x2014)}]`);
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-10T10:00:00Z");
const MONDAY: DateKey = "2026-10-12";

const at = (day: DateKey, minute: number, tz: string = PARIS): Date => instantAt(day, minute, tz);

function week(monday: DateKey): DateKey[] {
  return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(monday, i));
}

function item(id: string, startsAt: Date, minutes: number, over: Partial<PlanningItem> = {}): PlanningItem {
  return {
    id,
    kind: "seance",
    eventId: `ev-${id}`,
    eventVersion: 1,
    ticketTypeId: null,
    title: `Séance ${id}`,
    color: "#6366f1",
    startsAt,
    endsAt: new Date(startsAt.getTime() + minutes * 60_000),
    status: "scheduled",
    capacity: 12,
    seatsTaken: 0,
    elapsedHolds: 0,
    seatsShown: 12,
    location: null,
    eventLocation: null,
    locationOverride: null,
    bookingMode: "tickets",
    isPrivate: false,
    acceptedTypes: [],
    questions: [],
    seriesDate: null,
    recurring: false,
    canRestore: false,
    attendees: [],
    ...over,
  };
}

function attendee(over: Partial<PlanningAttendee> = {}): PlanningAttendee {
  return {
    bookingId: "b1",
    customerId: "c1",
    name: "Thomas Leroy",
    email: "thomas@example.com",
    phone: null,
    status: "confirmed",
    coverage: "ticket",
    createdBy: "pro",
    ticket: null,
    holdExpiresAt: null,
    answers: [],
    customerNotes: null,
    movedAt: null,
    createdAt: NOW,
    ...over,
  };
}

test("hiddenByTimeOff hides only an empty scheduled séance that overlaps a time off", () => {
  const off = [{ startAt: at(MONDAY, 540), endAt: at(MONDAY, 720) }]; // 09:00 to 12:00
  const inside = item("a", at(MONDAY, 600), 60);
  assert.equal(hiddenByTimeOff(inside, off), true);
  assert.equal(hiddenByTimeOff({ ...inside, seatsTaken: 1 }, off), false, "booked");
  assert.equal(hiddenByTimeOff({ ...inside, status: "cancelled" }, off), false, "cancelled");
  assert.equal(hiddenByTimeOff({ ...inside, kind: "rdv", seatsTaken: 0 }, off), false, "an RDV is never hidden");
  assert.equal(hiddenByTimeOff(item("b", at(MONDAY, 480), 60), off), false, "ends when the time off starts");
  assert.equal(hiddenByTimeOff(item("c", at(MONDAY, 720), 60), off), false, "starts when the time off ends");
  assert.equal(hiddenByTimeOff(item("d", at(MONDAY, 510), 60), off), true, "overlaps the start");
  assert.equal(hiddenByTimeOff(inside, []), false);
});

test("toPlanningVM: two overlapping séances share the lanes, a third one stands alone", () => {
  const a = item("a", at(MONDAY, 600), 60);
  const b = item("b", at(MONDAY, 630), 60);
  const c = item("c", at(MONDAY, 720), 60);
  const vms = toPlanningVM([c, b, a], [], PARIS, NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(
    vms.map((v) => [v.id, v.dayKey, v.startMinute, v.endMinute, v.lane, v.lanes]),
    [
      ["a", MONDAY, 600, 660, 0, 2],
      ["b", MONDAY, 630, 690, 1, 2],
      ["c", MONDAY, 720, 780, 0, 1],
    ],
  );
  assert.equal(vms[0].startsAt, a.startsAt.toISOString());
  assert.equal(vms[0].endsAt, a.endsAt.toISOString());
});

test("toPlanningVM: séances of two different days never share a lane", () => {
  const [one, two] = toPlanningVM(
    [item("one", at(MONDAY, 600), 60), item("two", at(addDays(MONDAY, 1), 630), 60)],
    [],
    PARIS,
    NOW,
  );
  assert.deepEqual([one.lane, one.lanes, two.lane, two.lanes], [0, 1, 0, 1]);
});

test("toPlanningVM: an end on a later day is endMinute 1440", () => {
  const late = item("late", at(MONDAY, 1380), 90); // 23:00 to 00:30
  const exact = item("exact", at(addDays(MONDAY, 1), 1380), 60); // 23:00 to midnight
  const [l, e] = toPlanningVM([late, exact], [], PARIS, NOW);
  assert.deepEqual([l.startMinute, l.endMinute, l.dayKey], [1380, 1440, MONDAY]);
  assert.deepEqual([e.startMinute, e.endMinute, e.dayKey], [1380, 1440, addDays(MONDAY, 1)]);
});

test("toPlanningVM reads the day and the minutes in the given time zone (Paris and Los Angeles)", () => {
  const x = item("x", new Date("2026-10-13T05:00:00Z"), 60);
  const [paris] = toPlanningVM([x], [], PARIS, NOW);
  const [la] = toPlanningVM([x], [], LA, NOW);
  assert.deepEqual([paris.dayKey, paris.startMinute, paris.endMinute], ["2026-10-13", 420, 480]);
  assert.deepEqual([la.dayKey, la.startMinute, la.endMinute], ["2026-10-12", 1320, 1380]);
});

test("toPlanningVM keeps wall-clock minutes on a 25 hour day (Paris 2026-10-25, Los Angeles 2026-11-01)", () => {
  const paris = item("p", at("2026-10-25", 1140), 60);
  const la = item("l", at("2026-11-01", 1140, LA), 60);
  const [p] = toPlanningVM([paris], [], PARIS, NOW);
  const [l] = toPlanningVM([la], [], LA, NOW);
  assert.deepEqual([p.dayKey, p.startMinute, p.endMinute], ["2026-10-25", 1140, 1200]);
  assert.deepEqual([l.dayKey, l.startMinute, l.endMinute], ["2026-11-01", 1140, 1200]);
});

test("toPlanningVM drops an empty séance under a time off and keeps booked, cancelled and RDV", () => {
  const off: PlanningTimeOff[] = [
    { id: "t1", startAt: at(MONDAY, 0), endAt: at(addDays(MONDAY, 1), 0), allDay: true, reason: "Vacances" },
  ];
  const empty = item("empty", at(MONDAY, 600), 60);
  const booked = item("booked", at(MONDAY, 700), 60, { seatsTaken: 1 });
  const gone = item("gone", at(MONDAY, 800), 60, { status: "cancelled" });
  const rdv = item("rdv", at(MONDAY, 900), 60, { kind: "rdv", eventId: null, eventVersion: null, seatsTaken: 1 });
  const next = item("next", at(addDays(MONDAY, 1), 600), 60);
  assert.deepEqual(
    toPlanningVM([empty, booked, gone, rdv, next], off, PARIS, NOW).map((v) => v.id),
    ["booked", "gone", "rdv", "next"],
  );
});
```
