- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the pure view model**

Create `src/lib/back-office/planning-view.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Pure planning view model (spec § 7, § 13.2). Everything the calendar draws
 * from the week's occurrences: wall-clock minutes and day keys are always read
 * in the pro's time zone, passed explicitly (never the host zone), lanes are
 * computed per day, an empty séance under a time off is hidden, ISO strings
 * replace dates so the result can cross the server/client boundary.
 * It also holds the small pure formatters the planning components share
 * (`hhmm`, `dayShortLabel`, `dayLongLabel`, `tintOf`, `unenrolledMessage`), so
 * that their copy is covered by the pure suite and the dash scan.
 * No server import: only `import type` from the reads module.
 */
import { addDays, parseKey, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { dayKeyInTz, formatTime, startOfDayKey, wallClockMinutes } from "@/lib/datetime";
import { expiryLabel, plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import type { PlanningAttendee, PlanningItem, PlanningQuestion, PlanningTimeOff } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-reads";
import { layoutLanes, type LaneSlot } from "@/lib/lanes";
import type { BookingCoverage, BookingMode, OccurrenceStatus } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export type PlanningAttendeeVM = {
  bookingId: string;
  customerId: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string | null;
  status: "pending" | "confirmed";
  coverage: BookingCoverage;
  /** « Cours collectif · valable jusqu'au 12/01 inclus » (+ « · offert ») */
  ticketLabel: string | null;
  /** « 19:45 », only while the booking is pending */
  holdUntil: string | null;
  answers: { label: string; value: string }[];
  notes: string | null;
  moved: boolean;
};

export type PlanningItemVM = {
  id: string;
  kind: "seance" | "rdv";
  eventId: string | null;
  eventVersion: number | null;
  title: string;
  color: string;
  startsAt: string;
  endsAt: string;
  dayKey: DateKey;
  startMinute: number;
  endMinute: number;
  lane: number;
  lanes: number;
  status: OccurrenceStatus;
  capacity: number;
  seatsTaken: number;
  seatsShown: number;
  location: string | null;
  eventLocation: string | null;
  locationOverride: string | null;
  bookingMode: BookingMode | null;
  isPrivate: boolean;
  acceptedTypes: { id: string; name: string; color: string }[];
  questions: PlanningQuestion[];
  recurring: boolean;
  canRestore: boolean;
  started: boolean;
  past: boolean;
  attendees: PlanningAttendeeVM[];
};

export type TimeOffSegmentVM = {
  id: string;
  dayKey: DateKey;
  startMinute: number;
  endMinute: number;
  allDay: boolean;
  reason: string | null;
};

const MONTHS_FR = [
  "janvier",
  "février",
  "mars",
  "avril",
  "mai",
  "juin",
  "juillet",
  "août",
  "septembre",
  "octobre",
  "novembre",
  "décembre",
] as const;

/** An empty scheduled event séance overlapping a time off is hidden (spec § 7); RDVs and booked or cancelled séances never. */
export function hiddenByTimeOff(
  item: Pick<PlanningItem, "kind" | "status" | "seatsTaken" | "startsAt" | "endsAt">,
  timeOff: readonly { startAt: Date; endAt: Date }[],
): boolean {
  if (item.kind !== "seance" || item.status !== "scheduled" || item.seatsTaken > 0) return false;
  return timeOff.some(
    (t) => item.startsAt.getTime() < t.endAt.getTime() && item.endsAt.getTime() > t.startAt.getTime(),
  );
}

function attendeeVM(a: PlanningAttendee, tz: string, now: Date): PlanningAttendeeVM {
  const ticketLabel = a.ticket
    ? `${a.ticket.typeName} · ${expiryLabel(a.ticket.expiresAt, tz, now)}${a.ticket.purchased ? "" : " · offert"}`
    : null;
  return {
    bookingId: a.bookingId,
    customerId: a.customerId,
    name: a.name,
    email: a.email,
    phone: a.phone,
    status: a.status,
    coverage: a.coverage,
    ticketLabel,
    holdUntil: a.status === "pending" && a.holdExpiresAt ? formatTime(a.holdExpiresAt, tz) : null,
    answers: a.answers,
    notes: a.customerNotes,
    moved: a.movedAt !== null,
  };
}

/**
 * Items → view models in tz: hidden ones dropped, wall-clock minutes (endMinute
 * 1440 when the end falls on a later day), lanes per day via layoutLanes, ISO
 * instants, ordered by start. `started` / `past` are measured against `now`.
 */
export function toPlanningVM(
  items: readonly PlanningItem[],
  timeOff: readonly PlanningTimeOff[],
  tz: string,
  now: Date,
): PlanningItemVM[] {
  const placed = items
    .filter((i) => !hiddenByTimeOff(i, timeOff))
    .map((i) => {
      const dayKey = dayKeyInTz(i.startsAt, tz);
      const startMinute = wallClockMinutes(i.startsAt, tz);
      const sameDay = dayKeyInTz(i.endsAt, tz) === dayKey;
      // A repeated hour (DST fall back) can make the end read before the start.
      const endMinute = sameDay ? Math.min(1440, Math.max(wallClockMinutes(i.endsAt, tz), startMinute + 5)) : 1440;
      return { item: i, dayKey, startMinute, endMinute };
    })
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        a.item.startsAt.getTime() - b.item.startsAt.getTime() ||
        (a.item.id < b.item.id ? -1 : a.item.id > b.item.id ? 1 : 0),
    );

  // Lanes are per day: minutes of two different days must not be compared.
  const byDay = new Map<DateKey, { id: string; start: number; end: number }[]>();
  for (const p of placed) {
    const list = byDay.get(p.dayKey) ?? [];
    list.push({ id: p.item.id, start: p.startMinute, end: p.endMinute });
    byDay.set(p.dayKey, list);
  }
  const slots = new Map<string, LaneSlot>();
  for (const list of byDay.values()) {
    for (const [id, slot] of layoutLanes(list)) slots.set(id, slot);
  }

  return placed.map(({ item: i, dayKey, startMinute, endMinute }): PlanningItemVM => {
    const slot = slots.get(i.id) ?? { lane: 0, lanes: 1 };
    return {
      id: i.id,
      kind: i.kind,
      eventId: i.eventId,
      eventVersion: i.eventVersion,
      title: i.title,
      color: i.color,
      startsAt: i.startsAt.toISOString(),
      endsAt: i.endsAt.toISOString(),
      dayKey,
      startMinute,
      endMinute,
      lane: slot.lane,
      lanes: slot.lanes,
      status: i.status,
      capacity: i.capacity,
      seatsTaken: i.seatsTaken,
      seatsShown: i.seatsShown,
      location: i.location,
      eventLocation: i.eventLocation,
      locationOverride: i.locationOverride,
      bookingMode: i.bookingMode,
      isPrivate: i.isPrivate,
      acceptedTypes: i.acceptedTypes,
      questions: i.questions,
      recurring: i.recurring,
      canRestore: i.canRestore,
      started: i.startsAt.getTime() <= now.getTime(),
      past: i.endsAt.getTime() <= now.getTime(),
      attendees: i.attendees.map((a) => attendeeVM(a, tz, now)),
    };
  });
}

/** A time off cut into one segment per covered day of `days` (wall-clock minutes in tz, half-open on both ends). */
export function timeOffSegments(
  timeOff: readonly PlanningTimeOff[],
  days: readonly DateKey[],
  tz: string,
): TimeOffSegmentVM[] {
  const segments: TimeOffSegmentVM[] = [];
  for (const day of days) {
    const dayStart = startOfDayKey(day, tz).getTime();
    const dayEnd = startOfDayKey(addDays(day, 1), tz).getTime();
    for (const t of timeOff) {
      const start = t.startAt.getTime();
      const end = t.endAt.getTime();
      if (start >= dayEnd || end <= dayStart) continue;
      segments.push({
        id: t.id,
        dayKey: day,
        startMinute: start <= dayStart ? 0 : wallClockMinutes(t.startAt, tz),
        endMinute: end >= dayEnd ? 1440 : wallClockMinutes(t.endAt, tz),
        allDay: t.allDay,
        reason: t.reason,
      });
    }
  }
  return segments;
}

/** Visible hours: 8..21 widened by the items (a time off, all-day or not, never widens the grid). */
export function gridHours(items: readonly PlanningItemVM[]): { startHour: number; endHour: number } {
  let startHour = 8;
  let endHour = 21;
  for (const i of items) {
    startHour = Math.min(startHour, Math.floor(i.startMinute / 60));
    endHour = Math.max(endHour, Math.ceil(i.endMinute / 60));
  }
  return { startHour: Math.max(0, startHour), endHour: Math.min(24, endHour) };
}

/** « 12 au 18 octobre 2026 », « 28 septembre au 4 octobre 2026 », « 29 décembre 2026 au 4 janvier 2027 ». */
export function weekTitle(days: readonly DateKey[]): string {
  if (days.length === 0) return "";
  const first = parseKey(days[0]);
  const last = parseKey(days[days.length - 1]);
  const firstMonth = MONTHS_FR[first.m - 1];
  const lastMonth = MONTHS_FR[last.m - 1];
  if (first.y === last.y && first.m === last.m) return `${first.d} au ${last.d} ${lastMonth} ${last.y}`;
  if (first.y === last.y) return `${first.d} ${firstMonth} au ${last.d} ${lastMonth} ${last.y}`;
  return `${first.d} ${firstMonth} ${first.y} au ${last.d} ${lastMonth} ${last.y}`;
}

/** Minute of a click offset in a day column, rounded down to 30, within 0..1410. */
export function minuteFromOffset(offsetPx: number, startHour: number, hourPx: number): number {
  const base = startHour * 60;
  const raw = Number.isFinite(offsetPx) && hourPx > 0 ? base + (offsetPx / hourPx) * 60 : base;
  return Math.min(1410, Math.max(0, Math.floor(raw / 30) * 30));
}

/** « 09:30 » from a wall-clock minute (1440 reads « 00:00 »). */
export function hhmm(minute: number): string {
  const m = minute % 1440;
  return `${String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

/**
 * Light tint of an event colour: the block text stays the foreground colour
 * (WCAG AA whatever colour the pro picked), the colour itself is carried by
 * the solid left bar.
 */
export function tintOf(color: string): string {
  return `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 16%, white)`;
}

// A civil day is formatted at UTC noon in UTC: its weekday never depends on the host or pro zone.
const civilNoon = (day: DateKey): Date => new Date(`${day}T12:00:00Z`);

/** « lun. 12 » */
export function dayShortLabel(day: DateKey): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fr-FR", { weekday: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(civilNoon(day));
}

/** « lundi 12 octobre » */
export function dayLongLabel(day: DateKey): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fr-FR", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(
    civilNoon(day),
  );
}

/**
 * The status line after « Désinscrire »: « Inscription de Thomas Leroy annulée.
 * Le ticket est rendu au client, qui est prévenu par email. » for one person,
 * « 2 inscriptions annulées. Les clients sont prévenus par email. » for several.
 * `cancelled` and `ticketsReturned` are the engine's counts.
 */
export function unenrolledMessage(names: readonly string[], cancelled: number, ticketsReturned: number): string {
  const who =
    names.length === 1
      ? `Inscription de ${names[0]} annulée.`
      : `${plural(cancelled, "inscription annulée", "inscriptions annulées")}.`;
  const one = cancelled === 1;
  const tail =
    ticketsReturned > 0
      ? one
        ? "Le ticket est rendu au client, qui est prévenu par email."
        : "Les tickets sont rendus aux clients, qui sont prévenus par email."
      : one
        ? "Le client est prévenu par email."
        : "Les clients sont prévenus par email.";
  return `${who} ${tail}`;
}
```

const DAY = 86_400_000;

dbTest("range: séances and RDVs kept, cancelled RDV dropped, cancelled séance kept, half-open bounds, one pro only", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const {
    occurrences: [seance],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha débutants", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] });
  const {
    occurrences: [struck],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha annulée", rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 4) } });
  const cancelled = await cancelOccurrence(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: struck.id }, now);
  assert.ok(cancelled.ok, JSON.stringify(cancelled));
  const rdvType = await rowRdvType(db, pro, { name: "Cours particulier" });
  const beatriz = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida" });
  const rdvId = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 5), 840, pro.tz) });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: rdvId, customerId: beatriz });
  await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 6), 840, pro.tz), status: "cancelled", seatsTaken: 0 });

  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const {
      occurrences: [theirs],
    } = await makeEvent(db, other, { title: "Chez l'autre" });
    const range = { start: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 0), 0, pro.tz), end: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 10), 0, pro.tz) };
    const { items } = await getPlanningRange(db, pro.proId, range, now);
    assert.deepEqual(
      items.map((i) => [i.id, i.kind, i.title, i.status]),
      [
        [seance.id, "seance", "Altinha débutants", "scheduled"],
        [struck.id, "seance", "Altinha annulée", "cancelled"],
        [rdvId, "rdv", "Cours particulier", "scheduled"],
      ],
    );
    const rdv = items[2];
    assert.deepEqual(
      [rdv.eventId, rdv.eventVersion, rdv.ticketTypeId, rdv.bookingMode, rdv.isPrivate, rdv.capacity, rdv.seatsTaken, rdv.acceptedTypes.length],
      [null, null, rdvType, null, false, 1, 1, 0],
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      rdv.attendees.map((a) => [a.name, a.status, a.coverage]),
      [["Beatriz Almeida", "confirmed", "guest"]],
    );
    assert.equal(items[0].eventVersion, 1);
    assert.equal(items[0].kind === "seance" && items[0].eventId !== null, true);

    // Half-open: [start, end) against starts_at < end AND ends_at > start.
    const idsIn = async (start: Date, end: Date) =>
      (await getPlanningRange(db, pro.proId, { start, end }, now)).items.map((i) => i.id);
    assert.deepEqual(await idsIn(seance.startsAt, seance.endsAt), [seance.id]);
    assert.deepEqual(await idsIn(addMinutes(seance.startsAt, 10), addMinutes(seance.startsAt, 20)), [seance.id], "inside");
    assert.deepEqual(await idsIn(addMinutes(seance.startsAt, -1), addMinutes(seance.startsAt, 1)), [seance.id], "straddles the start");
    assert.deepEqual(await idsIn(addMinutes(seance.startsAt, -60), seance.startsAt), [], "ends where the séance starts");
    assert.deepEqual(await idsIn(seance.endsAt, addMinutes(seance.endsAt, 60)), [], "starts where the séance ends");

    // Tenancy: the other pro's séance is neither in the range nor readable by id.
    assert.ok(!items.some((i) => i.id === theirs.id));
    assert.equal(await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, theirs.id, now), null);
    assert.equal((await getPlanningItem(db, other.proId, theirs.id, now))?.id, theirs.id);
    assert.equal(await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, "inconnu", now), null);
    assert.equal((await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, seance.id, now))?.title, "Altinha débutants");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("range: the time off overlapping the range, this pro's only", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const day = dayIn(pro, 3);
  const at = (d: string, m: number) => instantAt(d, m, pro.tz);
  const range = { start: at(day, 0), end: at(addDays(day, 1), 0) };
  const mine = {
    inside: nanoid(),
    before: nanoid(),
    after: nanoid(),
    around: nanoid(),
  };
  await db.insert(timeOff).values([
    { id: mine.inside, professionalId: pro.proId, startAt: at(day, 600), endAt: at(day, 720), allDay: false, reason: "Médecin" },
    { id: mine.before, professionalId: pro.proId, startAt: at(addDays(day, -1), 0), endAt: at(day, 0), allDay: true, reason: null },
    { id: mine.after, professionalId: pro.proId, startAt: at(addDays(day, 1), 0), endAt: at(addDays(day, 2), 0), allDay: true, reason: null },
    { id: mine.around, professionalId: pro.proId, startAt: at(addDays(day, -2), 0), endAt: at(addDays(day, 2), 0), allDay: true, reason: "Vacances" },
  ]);
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    await db.insert(timeOff).values({
      id: nanoid(),
      professionalId: other.proId,
      startAt: at(day, 0),
      endAt: at(addDays(day, 1), 0),
      allDay: true,
      reason: "Autre",
    });
    const { timeOff: found } = await getPlanningRange(db, pro.proId, range, now);
    assert.deepEqual(
      found.map((t) => [t.id, t.allDay, t.reason]),
      [
        [mine.around, true, "Vacances"],
        [mine.inside, false, "Médecin"],
      ],
    );
    assert.deepEqual(found[1].startAt, at(day, 600));
    assert.deepEqual(found[1].endAt, at(day, 720));
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("attendees: pending and confirmed with answers and ticket, cancelled ones left out", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const {
    eventId,
    occurrences: [occ],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { ticketTypeIds: [typeId], capacity: 5 });
  const levelId = nanoid();
  await db.insert(question).values({
    id: levelId,
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    eventId,
    label: "Niveau",
    type: "text",
    options: null,
    required: false,
    position: 0,
  });
  const thomas = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Thomas Leroy" });
  const marina = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Marina Costa" });
  const lea = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Léa Martin" });
  const expiresAt = instantAt(dayIn(pro, 30), 0, pro.tz);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, thomas, typeId, 1);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, marina, typeId, 1, { expiresAt });

  const base = { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: occ.id, asGuest: false };
  // createdAt = the engine's `now`: one distinct minute per booking keeps the order deterministic.
  const first = await registerPro(db, { ...base, customerId: thomas }, addMinutes(now, 1));
  assert.ok(first.ok, JSON.stringify(first));
  const second = await registerPro(
    db,
    { ...base, customerId: marina, answers: [{ questionId: levelId, value: "Débutant" }] },
    addMinutes(now, 2),
  );
  assert.ok(second.ok, JSON.stringify(second));
  const third = await registerPro(db, { ...base, customerId: lea, asGuest: true }, addMinutes(now, 3));
  assert.ok(third.ok, JSON.stringify(third));
  const left = await cancelBookingsByPro(
    db,
    { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: occ.id, bookingIds: [third.bookingId] },
    addMinutes(now, 4),
  );
  assert.ok(left.ok, JSON.stringify(left));

  const found = await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, occ.id, now);
  assert.ok(found);
  assert.equal(found.seatsTaken, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(
    found.attendees.map((a) => [a.name, a.status, a.coverage, a.createdBy, a.bookingId]),
    [
      ["Thomas Leroy", "confirmed", "ticket", "pro", first.bookingId],
      ["Marina Costa", "confirmed", "ticket", "pro", second.bookingId],
    ],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(found.attendees[0].ticket, { id: first.ticketId, typeName: "Cours collectif", expiresAt: null, purchased: false });
  assert.deepEqual(found.attendees[1].ticket, { id: second.ticketId, typeName: "Cours collectif", expiresAt, purchased: false });
  assert.deepEqual(found.attendees[0].answers, []);
  assert.deepEqual(found.attendees[1].answers, [{ label: "Niveau", value: "Débutant" }]);
  assert.equal(found.attendees[0].email.endsWith("@skedul.test"), true);
  assert.equal(found.attendees[0].holdExpiresAt, null);
  assert.equal(found.attendees[0].movedAt, null);
  assert.deepEqual(found.questions.map((q) => [q.id, q.label, q.type, q.required, q.options]), [[levelId, "Niveau", "text", false, null]]);
});

dbTest("attendee ticket: purchased is true when the ticket comes from a purchase", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const eventId = await rowEvent(db, pro, { capacity: 5 });
  await rowLink(db, pro, eventId, typeId);
  const occId = await rowSeance(db, pro, eventId, { seatsTaken: 1 });
  const customerId = await rowCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Marina Costa" });
  const offerId = await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId);
  const purchaseId = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId, status: "paid" });
  const bookingId = await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: occId, customerId, coverage: "ticket" });
  const ticketId = await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId, ticketTypeId: typeId, status: "booked", bookingId, purchaseId });

  const found = await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, occId, now);
  assert.deepEqual(found?.attendees[0].ticket, { id: ticketId, typeName: "Cours collectif", expiresAt: null, purchased: true });
});

dbTest("seatsShown counts an elapsed hold as a free seat; the pending attendee is listed", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro);
  const eventId = await rowEvent(db, pro, { capacity: 3 });
  const occId = await rowSeance(db, pro, eventId, { capacity: 3, seatsTaken: 2 });
  const sure = await rowCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Rafael Souza" });
  const lapsing = await rowCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Léa Martin" });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: occId, customerId: sure });
  const offerId = await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId);
  const purchaseId = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: lapsing, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId });
  const pendingId = await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: occId,
    customerId: lapsing,
    status: "pending",
    coverage: "ticket",
    purchaseId,
    holdExpiresAt: addMinutes(now, 30),
  });

  const live = await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, occId, now);
  assert.ok(live);
  assert.deepEqual([live.seatsTaken, live.elapsedHolds, live.seatsShown, live.capacity], [2, 0, 1, 3]);
  const pending = live.attendees.find((a) => a.bookingId === pendingId);
  assert.deepEqual([pending?.status, pending?.coverage, pending?.ticket], ["pending", "ticket", null]);
  assert.deepEqual(pending?.holdExpiresAt, addMinutes(now, 30));

  const lapsed = await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, occId, addMinutes(now, 60));
  assert.deepEqual([lapsed?.seatsTaken, lapsed?.elapsedHolds, lapsed?.seatsShown], [2, 1, 2]);
  assert.equal(lapsed?.attendees.length, 2, "the lapsed hold is still a row until it is released");
});

dbTest("item facts: location, accepted types, questions, recurring and canRestore", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const tA = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const tB = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours d'essai" });
  const { eventId, occurrences } = await makeEvent(db, pro, {
    title: "Altinha",
    ticketTypeIds: [tA, tB],
    isPrivate: true,
    rule: {
      startDate: dayIn(pro, 3),
      freq: "weekly",
      interval: 1,
      weekdays: [dayOfWeek(dayIn(pro, 3))],
      endMode: "count",
      occurrenceCount: 2,
    },
  });
  assert.equal(occurrences.length, 2);
  await db.update(event).set({ location: "Salle A", color: "#112233" }).where(eq(event.id, eventId));
  await db.execute(sql`update occurrence set location_override = 'Salle B' where id = ${occurrences[1].id}`);
  await db.insert(question).values([
    { id: nanoid(), professionalId: pro.proId, eventId, label: "Avec un ballon ?", type: "boolean", options: null, required: true, position: 1 },
    { id: nanoid(), professionalId: pro.proId, eventId, label: "Niveau", type: "choice", options: ["Débutant", "Confirmé"], required: false, position: 0 },
  ]);

  const first = await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, occurrences[0].id, now);
  const second = await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, occurrences[1].id, now);
  assert.ok(first && second);
  assert.deepEqual([first.location, first.eventLocation, first.locationOverride], ["Salle A", "Salle A", null]);
  assert.deepEqual([second.location, second.eventLocation, second.locationOverride], ["Salle B", "Salle A", "Salle B"]);
  assert.deepEqual([first.recurring, first.isPrivate, first.bookingMode, first.color, first.seriesDate], [true, true, "tickets", "#112233", dayIn(pro, 3)]);
  assert.deepEqual(first.acceptedTypes.map((t) => t.name), ["Cours collectif", "Cours d'essai"]);
  assert.deepEqual(first.questions.map((q) => [q.label, q.type, q.required, q.options]), [
    ["Niveau", "choice", false, ["Débutant", "Confirmé"]],
    ["Avec un ballon ?", "boolean", true, null],
  ]);
  assert.equal(first.canRestore, false, "a scheduled séance has nothing to restore");

  // canRestore: a cancelled future séance of a live segment, up to its until_date.
  await db.execute(sql`update event set end_mode = 'until', until_date = ${dayIn(pro, 5)}::date, occurrence_count = null where id = ${eventId}`);
  for (const o of occurrences) {
    const res = await cancelOccurrence(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: o.id }, now);
    assert.ok(res.ok, JSON.stringify(res));
  }
  assert.equal((await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, occurrences[0].id, now))?.canRestore, true);
  assert.equal((await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, occurrences[1].id, now))?.canRestore, false, "past the until_date");

  const archivedEvent = await rowEvent(db, pro, { archivedAt: now });
  const archivedSeance = await rowSeance(db, pro, archivedEvent, { status: "cancelled" });
  assert.equal((await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, archivedSeance, now))?.canRestore, false, "archived segment");
  const liveEvent = await rowEvent(db, pro);
  const pastSeance = await rowSeance(db, pro, liveEvent, { status: "cancelled", startsAt: new Date(now.getTime() - 2 * DAY) });
  assert.equal((await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, pastSeance, now))?.canRestore, false, "past séance");

  const rdvType = await rowRdvType(db, pro, { name: "Cours particulier" });
  const gone = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { status: "cancelled", seatsTaken: 0 });
  const rdv = await getPlanningItem(db, pro.proId, gone, now);
  assert.deepEqual([rdv?.kind, rdv?.status, rdv?.canRestore, rdv?.title], ["rdv", "cancelled", false, "Cours particulier"]);
});

dbTest("searchCustomers: name or email, wildcards escaped, 2 characters minimum, this pro only", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const yoga = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "100% Yoga" });
  const thousand = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "1000 Yoga" });
  const under = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "a_b Studio" });
  const plain = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "axb Studio" });
  const mail = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Zoé", email: "zoe.durand@example.com" });
  const slash = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Dos\\slash" });
  const alice = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Alice Dupont" });
  const bruno = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Bruno Dupont" });
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    await makeCustomer(db, other, { name: "100% Yoga" });
    const ids = async (q: string, limit?: number) => (await searchCustomers(db, pro.proId, q, limit)).map((c) => c.id);
    assert.deepEqual(await ids("100%"), [yoga], "the % is literal: 1000 Yoga does not match");
    assert.deepEqual(await ids("a_b"), [under], "the _ is literal: axb Studio does not match");
    assert.deepEqual((await ids("  yoga  ")).sort(), [yoga, thousand].sort(), "trimmed, case-insensitive");
    assert.deepEqual(await ids("s\\sl"), [slash], "the backslash is literal");
    assert.deepEqual(await ids("ZOE.durand"), [mail], "e-mail search");
    assert.deepEqual(await ids("dupont"), [alice, bruno], "by name");
    assert.deepEqual(await ids("dupont", 1), [alice], "limit");
    assert.deepEqual(await ids("1"), [], "one character");
    assert.deepEqual(await ids(" a "), [], "one character once trimmed");
    assert.deepEqual(await ids(""), []);
    assert.ok(plain);
    const hit = (await searchCustomers(db, pro.proId, "zoe", 8))[0];
    assert.deepEqual([hit.id, hit.name, hit.email, hit.phone], [mail, "Zoé", "zoe.durand@example.com", null]);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("registerOptions: usable tickets in consumption order, alreadyBooked, tenancy", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const unlinked = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours d'essai" });
  const {
    occurrences: [occ],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { ticketTypeIds: [typeId] });
  const {
    occurrences: [freeOcc],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { bookingMode: "free" });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  const [forever] = await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeId, 1);
  const [soon] = await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeId, 1, { expiresAt: addMinutes(occ.startsAt, 1440) });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, unlinked, 1);

  const options = await registerOptions(db, pro.proId, occ.id, customerId, now);
  assert.ok(options);
  assert.equal(options.mode, "tickets");
  assert.equal(options.alreadyBooked, false);
  assert.deepEqual(
    options.usable.map((u) => [u.id, u.typeName, u.purchased]),
    [
      [soon, "Cours collectif", false],
      [forever, "Cours collectif", false],
    ],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(options.usable[0].expiresAt, addMinutes(occ.startsAt, 1440));
  assert.equal(options.usable[1].expiresAt, null);

  const booked = await registerPro(
    db,
    { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: occ.id, customerId, asGuest: false },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(booked.ok, JSON.stringify(booked));
  const after = await registerOptions(db, pro.proId, occ.id, customerId, now);
  assert.equal(after?.alreadyBooked, true);
  assert.deepEqual(after?.usable.map((u) => u.id), [forever]);

  const free = await registerOptions(db, pro.proId, freeOcc.id, customerId, now);
  assert.deepEqual([free?.mode, free?.alreadyBooked, free?.usable.length], ["free", false, 0]);

  // An RDV and unknown ids give null.
  const rdvType = await rowRdvType(db, pro);
  const rdvId = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { status: "cancelled", seatsTaken: 0 });
  assert.equal(await registerOptions(db, pro.proId, rdvId, customerId, now), null);
  assert.equal(await registerOptions(db, pro.proId, "inconnu", customerId, now), null);
  assert.equal(await registerOptions(db, pro.proId, occ.id, "inconnu", now), null);

  // Tenancy: another pro's customer or occurrence.
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const foreignCustomer = await makeCustomer(db, other);
    const {
      occurrences: [foreignOcc],
    } = await makeEvent(db, other);
    assert.equal(await registerOptions(db, pro.proId, occ.id, foreignCustomer, now), null);
    assert.equal(await registerOptions(db, pro.proId, foreignOcc.id, customerId, now), null);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

type MakeEventOver = NonNullable<Parameters<typeof makeEvent>[2]>;

dbTest(
  "moveTargets: ticket coverage keeps tickets-mode séances, marks accepted, conversion and full; 60 days; no source, past, RDV or cancelled",
  async ({ db, pro }) => {
    const typeX = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
    const typeY = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours d'essai" });
    const typeFree = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Appel découverte", rdvEnabled: true, rdvFree: true, rdvDurationMin: 30 });
    const mk = (title: string, day: number, over: MakeEventOver = {}) =>
      makeEvent(db, pro, { title, ...over, rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, day), ...over.rule } });

    const source = await mk("Source", 3, { ticketTypeIds: [typeX] });
    const accepted = await mk("Acceptée", 4, { ticketTypeIds: [typeX] });
    const conversion = await mk("Conversion", 5, { ticketTypeIds: [typeY, typeFree] });
    await mk("Sans lien", 6);
    await mk("Libre", 7, { bookingMode: "free" });
    const struck = await mk("Annulée", 8, { ticketTypeIds: [typeX] });
    const full = await mk("Complète", 9, { ticketTypeIds: [typeX], capacity: 1 });
    await mk("Passée", -2, { ticketTypeIds: [typeX] });
    const near = await mk("Proche", 59, { ticketTypeIds: [typeX] });
    await mk("Lointaine", 61, { ticketTypeIds: [typeX] });
    const cancelled = await cancelOccurrence(
      db,
      { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: struck.occurrences[0].id },
      new Date(),
    );
    assert.ok(cancelled.ok, JSON.stringify(cancelled));

    const rdvType = await rowRdvType(db, pro);
    const rdvId = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 6), 840, pro.tz) });
    const guest = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
    await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: rdvId, customerId: guest });

    const thomas = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Thomas Leroy" });
    await giveTickets(db, pro, thomas, typeX, 1);
    const booked = await registerPro(db, {
      professionalId: pro.proId,
      actorUserId: pro.userId,
      occurrenceId: source.occurrences[0].id,
      customerId: thomas,
      asGuest: false,
    });
    assert.ok(booked.ok, JSON.stringify(booked));
    const filler = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
    const fill = await registerPro(db, {
      professionalId: pro.proId,
      actorUserId: pro.userId,
      occurrenceId: full.occurrences[0].id,
      customerId: filler,
      asGuest: true,
    });
    assert.ok(fill.ok, JSON.stringify(fill));

    // A fixed "now" (today 12:00, pro tz) keeps the 60-day window and the 5-day window deterministic.
    const noon = instantAt(dayIn(pro, 0), 720, pro.tz);
    const res = await moveTargets(db, pro.proId, booked.bookingId, noon);
    assert.ok(res);
    assert.deepEqual(
      res.targets.map((t) => [t.title, t.occurrenceId, t.accepted, t.conversionTypes, t.full, t.expiresBefore, t.capacity, t.seatsShown]),
      [
        ["Acceptée", accepted.occurrences[0].id, true, [], false, false, 12, 12],
        ["Conversion", conversion.occurrences[0].id, false, [{ id: typeY, name: "Cours d'essai" }], false, false, 12, 12],
        ["Complète", full.occurrences[0].id, true, [], true, false, 1, 0],
        ["Proche", near.occurrences[0].id, true, [], false, false, 12, 12],
      ],
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      res.targets.map((t) => t.seriesRootId),
      [accepted.eventId, conversion.eventId, full.eventId, near.eventId],
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      res.series,
      [
        { seriesRootId: accepted.eventId, title: "Acceptée" },
        { seriesRootId: full.eventId, title: "Complète" },
        { seriesRootId: conversion.eventId, title: "Conversion" },
        { seriesRootId: near.eventId, title: "Proche" },
      ],
    );
    assert.ok(res.targets.every((t) => t.occurrenceId !== source.occurrences[0].id), "the source is excluded");

    const short = await moveTargets(db, pro.proId, booked.bookingId, noon, { days: 5 });
    assert.deepEqual(short?.targets.map((t) => t.title), ["Acceptée", "Conversion"]);
  },
  { timeout: 240_000 },
);

dbTest("moveTargets: expiresBefore compares the ticket expiry with each target start", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const typeX = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const mk = (title: string, day: number) =>
    makeEvent(db, pro, { title, ticketTypeIds: [typeX], rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, day) } });
  const source = await mk("Source", 3);
  const day4 = await mk("Jour 4", 4);
  const day6 = await mk("Jour 6", 6);
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeX, 1, { expiresAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 5), 0, pro.tz) });
  const booked = await registerPro(db, {
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    actorUserId: pro.userId,
    occurrenceId: source.occurrences[0].id,
    customerId,
    asGuest: false,
  });
  assert.ok(booked.ok, JSON.stringify(booked));

  const noon = instantAt(dayIn(pro, 0), 720, pro.tz);
  const res = await moveTargets(db, pro.proId, booked.bookingId, noon);
  assert.deepEqual(
    res?.targets.map((t) => [t.occurrenceId, t.expiresBefore, t.accepted]),
    [
      [day4.occurrences[0].id, false, true],
      [day6.occurrences[0].id, true, true],
    ],
  );
});

dbTest("moveTargets: a guest booking sees every scheduled séance; series filter; null cases", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const typeX = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const source = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Source", ticketTypeIds: [typeX], rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 3) } });
  const weekly = await makeEvent(db, pro, {
    title: "Hebdo",
    rule: {
      startDate: dayIn(pro, 4),
      freq: "weekly",
      interval: 1,
      weekdays: [dayOfWeek(dayIn(pro, 4))],
      endMode: "count",
      occurrenceCount: 3,
    },
  });
  const free = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Libre", bookingMode: "free", rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 6) } });
  assert.equal(weekly.occurrences.length, 3);
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  const booked = await registerPro(db, {
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    actorUserId: pro.userId,
    occurrenceId: source.occurrences[0].id,
    customerId,
    asGuest: true,
  });
  assert.ok(booked.ok, JSON.stringify(booked));

  const noon = instantAt(dayIn(pro, 0), 720, pro.tz);
  const all = await moveTargets(db, pro.proId, booked.bookingId, noon);
  assert.ok(all);
  assert.deepEqual(
    all.targets.map((t) => [t.title, t.accepted, t.conversionTypes, t.expiresBefore]),
    [
      ["Hebdo", true, [], false],
      ["Libre", true, [], false],
      ["Hebdo", true, [], false],
      ["Hebdo", true, [], false],
    ],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(all.series, [
    { seriesRootId: weekly.eventId, title: "Hebdo" },
    { seriesRootId: free.eventId, title: "Libre" },
  ]);
  const onlyWeekly = await moveTargets(db, pro.proId, booked.bookingId, noon, { seriesRootId: weekly.eventId });
  assert.deepEqual(onlyWeekly?.targets.map((t) => t.occurrenceId), weekly.occurrences.map((o) => o.id));
  assert.equal(onlyWeekly?.series.length, 2, "the series list ignores the filter");
  const none = await moveTargets(db, pro.proId, booked.bookingId, noon, { seriesRootId: "inconnu" });
  assert.deepEqual(none?.targets, []);

  // Not movable: another pro, unknown, cancelled booking, RDV booking.
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    assert.equal(await moveTargets(db, other.proId, booked.bookingId, noon), null);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
  assert.equal(await moveTargets(db, pro.proId, "inconnu", noon), null);
  const rdvType = await rowRdvType(db, pro);
  const rdvId = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 6), 840, pro.tz) });
  const rdvBooking = await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: rdvId, customerId: await makeCustomer(db, pro) });
  assert.equal(await moveTargets(db, pro.proId, rdvBooking, noon), null, "an RDV booking is not movable");
  const left = await cancelBookingsByPro(db, {
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    actorUserId: pro.userId,
    occurrenceId: source.occurrences[0].id,
    bookingIds: [booked.bookingId],
  });
  assert.ok(left.ok, JSON.stringify(left));
  assert.equal(await moveTargets(db, pro.proId, booked.bookingId, noon), null, "a cancelled booking is not movable");
});

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement the reads**

Create `src/lib/back-office/planning-reads.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Planning reads (spec § 7, § 13.2): the week's occurrences with their
 * attendees, one occurrence, the customer search and the two « Inscrire » /
 * « Déplacer » option reads. Testable core: takes `db`, imports neither
 * server-only, next/* nor the db index. Every query filters on professional_id
 * and every id that comes from the caller is checked against it.
 */
import { and, asc, eq, gt, ilike, inArray, isNotNull, lt, ne, or, sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";

import { activeBookingOf } from "@/lib/booking/claims";
import { usableTickets } from "@/lib/booking/eligibility";
import { seatsShown } from "@/lib/booking/holds";
import type { DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import {
  booking,
  bookingAnswer,
  customer,
  event,
  eventTicketType,
  occurrence,
  question,
  ticket,
  ticketType,
  timeOff,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import {
  DEFAULT_COLOR,
  type Actor,
  type BookingCoverage,
  type BookingMode,
  type OccurrenceStatus,
  type QuestionType,
} from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export type PlanningAttendee = {
  bookingId: string;
  customerId: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string | null;
  status: "pending" | "confirmed";
  coverage: BookingCoverage;
  createdBy: Actor;
  ticket: { id: string; typeName: string; expiresAt: Date | null; purchased: boolean } | null;
  holdExpiresAt: Date | null;
  answers: { label: string; value: string }[];
  customerNotes: string | null;
  movedAt: Date | null;
  createdAt: Date;
};

export type PlanningQuestion = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  type: QuestionType;
  options: string[] | null;
  required: boolean;
};

export type PlanningItem = {
  id: string;
  kind: "seance" | "rdv";
  eventId: string | null;
  eventVersion: number | null;
  ticketTypeId: string | null;
  title: string;
  color: string;
  startsAt: Date;
  endsAt: Date;
  status: OccurrenceStatus;
  capacity: number;
  seatsTaken: number;
  elapsedHolds: number;
  seatsShown: number;
  location: string | null;
  eventLocation: string | null;
  locationOverride: string | null;
  bookingMode: BookingMode | null;
  isPrivate: boolean;
  acceptedTypes: { id: string; name: string; color: string }[];
  questions: PlanningQuestion[];
  seriesDate: DateKey | null;
  /** the event's frequency is not « once » */
  recurring: boolean;
  /** cancelled event séance, starts_at > now, segment not archived and series_date ≤ until_date (or no until) */
  canRestore: boolean;
  /** pending + confirmed, by createdAt */
  attendees: PlanningAttendee[];
};

export type PlanningTimeOff = { id: string; startAt: Date; endAt: Date; allDay: boolean; reason: string | null };

/* ───────────────────────── Occurrences ───────────────────────── */

function selectOccurrences(db: Db, where: SQL | undefined) {
  return db
    .select({
      id: occurrence.id,
      eventId: occurrence.eventId,
      ticketTypeId: occurrence.ticketTypeId,
      seriesDate: occurrence.seriesDate,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
      status: occurrence.status,
      capacity: occurrence.capacity,
      seatsTaken: occurrence.seatsTaken,
      locationOverride: occurrence.locationOverride,
      eventTitle: event.title,
      eventColor: event.color,
      eventLocation: event.location,
      eventVersion: event.version,
      bookingMode: event.bookingMode,
      isPrivate: event.isPrivate,
      freq: event.freq,
      archivedAt: event.archivedAt,
      untilDate: event.untilDate,
      typeName: ticketType.name,
      typeColor: ticketType.color,
    })
    .from(occurrence)
    .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
    .where(where)
    .orderBy(asc(occurrence.startsAt), asc(occurrence.id));
}
type OccurrenceData = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof selectOccurrences>>[number];

/** Pending bookings whose hold has elapsed, per occurrence (not yet released by R / the sweep). */
async function elapsedHoldsOf(db: Db, professionalId: string, occurrenceIds: readonly string[], now: Date): Promise<Map<string, number>> {
  if (occurrenceIds.length === 0) return new Map();
  const rows = await db
    .select({ occurrenceId: booking.occurrenceId, n: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
    .from(booking)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId),
        inArray(booking.occurrenceId, [...occurrenceIds]),
        eq(booking.status, "pending"),
        lt(booking.holdExpiresAt, now),
      ),
    )
    .groupBy(booking.occurrenceId);
  return new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.occurrenceId, Number(r.n)]));
}

async function loadAttendees(db: Db, professionalId: string, occurrenceIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, PlanningAttendee[]>> {
  const byOccurrence = new Map<string, PlanningAttendee[]>();
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      bookingId: booking.id,
      occurrenceId: booking.occurrenceId,
      customerId: customer.id,
      name: customer.name,
      email: customer.email,
      phone: customer.phone,
      status: booking.status,
      coverage: booking.coverage,
      createdBy: booking.createdBy,
      holdExpiresAt: booking.holdExpiresAt,
      customerNotes: booking.customerNotes,
      movedAt: booking.movedAt,
      createdAt: booking.createdAt,
      ticketId: ticket.id,
      ticketExpiresAt: ticket.expiresAt,
      ticketPurchaseId: ticket.purchaseId,
      ticketTypeName: ticketType.name,
    })
    .from(booking)
    .innerJoin(customer, eq(customer.id, booking.customerId))
    .leftJoin(ticket, eq(ticket.bookingId, booking.id))
    .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, ticket.ticketTypeId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId),
        inArray(booking.occurrenceId, [...occurrenceIds]),
        inArray(booking.status, ["pending", "confirmed"]),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(booking.createdAt), asc(booking.id));
  if (rows.length === 0) return byOccurrence;

  const answerRows = await db
    .select({ bookingId: bookingAnswer.bookingId, label: bookingAnswer.questionLabel, value: bookingAnswer.value })
    .from(bookingAnswer)
    .leftJoin(question, eq(question.id, bookingAnswer.questionId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(bookingAnswer.professionalId, professionalId),
        inArray(bookingAnswer.bookingId, rows.map((r) => r.bookingId)),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(sql`coalesce(${question.position}, 1000000)`), asc(bookingAnswer.createdAt), asc(bookingAnswer.id));
  const answersByBooking = new Map<string, { label: string; value: string }[]>();
  for (const a of answerRows) {
    const list = answersByBooking.get(a.bookingId) ?? [];
    list.push({ label: a.label, value: a.value });
    answersByBooking.set(a.bookingId, list);
  }

  for (const r of rows) {
    const list = byOccurrence.get(r.occurrenceId) ?? [];
    list.push({
      bookingId: r.bookingId,
      customerId: r.customerId,
      name: r.name,
      email: r.email,
      phone: r.phone,
      status: r.status === "pending" ? "pending" : "confirmed",
      coverage: r.coverage,
      createdBy: r.createdBy,
      ticket:
        r.ticketId === null
          ? null
          : { id: r.ticketId, typeName: r.ticketTypeName ?? "", expiresAt: r.ticketExpiresAt, purchased: r.ticketPurchaseId !== null },
      holdExpiresAt: r.holdExpiresAt,
      answers: answersByBooking.get(r.bookingId) ?? [],
      customerNotes: r.customerNotes,
      movedAt: r.movedAt,
      createdAt: r.createdAt,
    });
    byOccurrence.set(r.occurrenceId, list);
  }
  return byOccurrence;
}

async function loadAcceptedTypes(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  eventIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<Map<string, { id: string; name: string; color: string }[]>> {
  const byEvent = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; color: string }[]>();
  if (eventIds.length === 0) return byEvent;
  const rows = await db
    .select({ eventId: eventTicketType.eventId, id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name, color: ticketType.color })
    .from(eventTicketType)
    .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, eventTicketType.ticketTypeId))
    .where(and(eq(eventTicketType.professionalId, professionalId), inArray(eventTicketType.eventId, [...eventIds])))
    .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.name), asc(ticketType.id));
  for (const r of rows) {
    const list = byEvent.get(r.eventId) ?? [];
    list.push({ id: r.id, name: r.name, color: r.color });
    byEvent.set(r.eventId, list);
  }
  return byEvent;
}

async function loadQuestionsByOwner(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  eventIds: readonly string[],
  typeIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<{ byEvent: Map<string, PlanningQuestion[]>; byType: Map<string, PlanningQuestion[]> }> {
  const byEvent = new Map<string, PlanningQuestion[]>();
  const byType = new Map<string, PlanningQuestion[]>();
  const owners: SQL[] = [];
  if (eventIds.length > 0) owners.push(inArray(question.eventId, [...eventIds]));
  if (typeIds.length > 0) owners.push(inArray(question.ticketTypeId, [...typeIds]));
  if (owners.length === 0) return { byEvent, byType };
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: question.id,
      eventId: question.eventId,
      ticketTypeId: question.ticketTypeId,
      label: question.label,
      type: question.type,
      options: question.options,
      required: question.required,
    })
    .from(question)
    .where(and(eq(question.professionalId, professionalId), or(...owners)))
    .orderBy(asc(question.position), asc(question.createdAt), asc(question.id));
  for (const r of rows) {
    const q: PlanningQuestion = { id: r.id, label: r.label, type: r.type, options: r.options, required: r.required };
    const owner = r.eventId !== null ? byEvent : byType;
    const key = r.eventId ?? r.ticketTypeId ?? "";
    const list = owner.get(key) ?? [];
    list.push(q);
    owner.set(key, list);
  }
  return { byEvent, byType };
}

async function loadItems(db: Db, professionalId: string, rows: readonly OccurrenceData[], now: Date): Promise<PlanningItem[]> {
  if (rows.length === 0) return [];
  const ids = rows.map((r) => r.id);
  const eventIds = [...new Set(rows.flatMap((r) => (r.eventId !== null ? [r.eventId] : [])))];
  const rdvTypeIds = [...new Set(rows.flatMap((r) => (r.eventId === null && r.ticketTypeId !== null ? [r.ticketTypeId] : [])))];
  const [elapsed, attendees, types, questions] = await Promise.all([
    elapsedHoldsOf(db, professionalId, ids, now),
    loadAttendees(db, professionalId, ids),
    loadAcceptedTypes(db, professionalId, eventIds),
    loadQuestionsByOwner(db, professionalId, eventIds, rdvTypeIds),
  ]);

  return rows.map((r): PlanningItem => {
    const elapsedHolds = elapsed.get(r.id) ?? 0;
    const isSeance = r.eventId !== null;
    const segmentLive = r.archivedAt === null && (r.untilDate === null || (r.seriesDate !== null && r.seriesDate <= r.untilDate));
    return {
      id: r.id,
      kind: isSeance ? "seance" : "rdv",
      eventId: r.eventId,
      eventVersion: r.eventVersion ?? null,
      ticketTypeId: r.ticketTypeId,
      title: r.eventTitle ?? r.typeName ?? "Rendez-vous",
      color: r.eventColor ?? r.typeColor ?? DEFAULT_COLOR,
      startsAt: r.startsAt,
      endsAt: r.endsAt,
      status: r.status,
      capacity: r.capacity,
      seatsTaken: r.seatsTaken,
      elapsedHolds,
      seatsShown: seatsShown({ capacity: r.capacity, seatsTaken: r.seatsTaken, elapsedHolds }),
      location: r.locationOverride ?? r.eventLocation ?? null,
      eventLocation: r.eventLocation ?? null,
      locationOverride: r.locationOverride,
      bookingMode: r.bookingMode ?? null,
      isPrivate: r.isPrivate ?? false,
      acceptedTypes: r.eventId !== null ? (types.get(r.eventId) ?? []) : [],
      questions:
        r.eventId !== null
          ? (questions.byEvent.get(r.eventId) ?? [])
          : (questions.byType.get(r.ticketTypeId ?? "") ?? []),
      seriesDate: r.seriesDate,
      recurring: r.freq !== null && r.freq !== "once",
      canRestore: isSeance && r.status === "cancelled" && r.startsAt.getTime() > now.getTime() && segmentLive,
      attendees: attendees.get(r.id) ?? [],
    };
  });
}

/**
 * Occurrences overlapping [start, end) (starts_at < end AND ends_at > start),
 * cancelled RDVs excluded, cancelled séances kept; attendees, answers, ticket
 * and accepted types loaded in bulk; the time off overlapping the same range.
 * Never hides anything else (planning-view does).
 */
export async function getPlanningRange(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  range: { start: Date; end: Date },
  now: Date,
): Promise<{ items: PlanningItem[]; timeOff: PlanningTimeOff[] }> {
  const [rows, offRows] = await Promise.all([
    selectOccurrences(
      db,
      and(
        eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId),
        lt(occurrence.startsAt, range.end),
        gt(occurrence.endsAt, range.start),
        or(isNotNull(occurrence.eventId), ne(occurrence.status, "cancelled")),
      ),
    ),
    db
      .select({ id: timeOff.id, startAt: timeOff.startAt, endAt: timeOff.endAt, allDay: timeOff.allDay, reason: timeOff.reason })
      .from(timeOff)
      .where(and(eq(timeOff.professionalId, professionalId), lt(timeOff.startAt, range.end), gt(timeOff.endAt, range.start)))
      .orderBy(asc(timeOff.startAt), asc(timeOff.id)),
  ]);
  return { items: await loadItems(db, professionalId, rows, now), timeOff: offRows };
}

/** One occurrence of the pro (null otherwise), cancelled or not. */
export async function getPlanningItem(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  occurrenceId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PlanningItem | null> {
  const rows = await selectOccurrences(db, and(eq(occurrence.id, occurrenceId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId)));
  const [item] = await loadItems(db, professionalId, rows, now);
  return item ?? null;
}

/* ───────────────────────── Customers ───────────────────────── */

export type CustomerHit = { id: string; name: string; email: string; phone: string | null };

/** Escapes the LIKE metacharacters (the backslash first). */
function likePattern(q: string): string {
  return `%${q.replace(/[\\%_]/g, (c) => `\\${c}`)}%`;
}

/** q trimmed, < 2 chars → []; ILIKE on name or email with %, _ and \ escaped; by name; at most `limit` (default 8). */
export async function searchCustomers(db: Db, professionalId: string, q: string, limit = 8): Promise<CustomerHit[]> {
  const term = q.trim();
  if (term.length < 2) return [];
  const pattern = likePattern(term);
  return db
    .select({ id: customer.id, name: customer.name, email: customer.email, phone: customer.phone })
    .from(customer)
    .where(and(eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId), or(ilike(customer.name, pattern), ilike(customer.email, pattern))))
    .orderBy(asc(customer.name), asc(customer.id))
    .limit(Math.min(50, Math.max(1, Math.trunc(limit))));
}

/* ───────────────────────── « Inscrire » options ───────────────────────── */

export type RegisterOptions = {
  mode: BookingMode;
  alreadyBooked: boolean;
  usable: { id: string; typeName: string; expiresAt: Date | null; purchased: boolean }[];
};

/**
 * Checks that the occurrence is an event séance of the pro and the customer is
 * the pro's (else null), then the tickets « utilisables ici » (consumption
 * order) and whether the customer already holds a live seat.
 */
export async function registerOptions(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  occurrenceId: string,
  customerId: string,
  now: Date = new Date(),
): Promise<RegisterOptions | null> {
  const [seance] = await db
    .select({ mode: event.bookingMode })
    .from(occurrence)
    .innerJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .where(and(eq(occurrence.id, occurrenceId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId)));
  if (!seance) return null;
  const [owner] = await db
    .select({ id: customer.id })
    .from(customer)
    .where(and(eq(customer.id, customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId)));
  if (!owner) return null;

  const usable = await usableTickets(db, { customerId, occurrenceId });
  const typeIds = [...new Set(usable.map((u) => u.ticketTypeId))];
  const names = new Map<string, string>();
  if (typeIds.length > 0) {
    const typeRows = await db
      .select({ id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name })
      .from(ticketType)
      .where(and(eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId), inArray(ticketType.id, typeIds)));
    for (const t of typeRows) names.set(t.id, t.name);
  }
  const active = await activeBookingOf(db, { occurrenceId, customerId }, now);
  return {
    mode: seance.mode,
    alreadyBooked: active !== null,
    usable: usable.map((u) => ({
      id: u.id,
      typeName: names.get(u.ticketTypeId) ?? "",
      expiresAt: u.expiresAt,
      purchased: u.purchaseId !== null,
    })),
  };
}

/* ───────────────────────── « Déplacer » targets ───────────────────────── */

export type MoveTarget = {
  occurrenceId: string;
  seriesRootId: string;
  title: string;
  startsAt: Date;
  endsAt: Date;
  seatsShown: number;
  capacity: number;
  full: boolean;
  accepted: boolean;
  conversionTypes: { id: string; name: string }[];
  expiresBefore: boolean;
};

const MOVE_DAYS = 60;
const MOVE_TARGETS_MAX = 500;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

/**
 * Q18: for a confirmed booking of the pro on an event séance, the scheduled
 * event séances of the next `days` (default 60) other than the source. Ticket
 * coverage keeps only tickets-mode targets: `accepted` = the booked ticket's
 * type is linked, else `conversionTypes` = the active non-rdv_free linked types
 * (a target without any is dropped); `expiresBefore` = the ticket expires at or
 * before the target start. Other coverages see every target, accepted. `series`
 * lists the roots of the targets (before the `seriesRootId` filter). Null when
 * the booking is not the pro's or not movable.
 */
export async function moveTargets(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  bookingId: string,
  now: Date,
  opts: { seriesRootId?: string | null; days?: number } = {},
): Promise<{ series: { seriesRootId: string; title: string }[]; targets: MoveTarget[] } | null> {
  const [source] = await db
    .select({
      id: booking.id,
      status: booking.status,
      coverage: booking.coverage,
      occurrenceId: booking.occurrenceId,
      sourceEventId: occurrence.eventId,
    })
    .from(booking)
    .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
    .where(and(eq(booking.id, bookingId), eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId)));
  if (!source || source.status !== "confirmed" || source.sourceEventId === null) return null;

  let held: { ticketTypeId: string; expiresAt: Date | null } | null = null;
  if (source.coverage === "ticket") {
    const [t] = await db
      .select({ ticketTypeId: ticket.ticketTypeId, expiresAt: ticket.expiresAt })
      .from(ticket)
      .where(and(eq(ticket.bookingId, source.id), eq(ticket.professionalId, professionalId), eq(ticket.status, "booked")));
    if (!t) return null;
    held = t;
  }

  const until = new Date(now.getTime() + (opts.days ?? MOVE_DAYS) * DAY_MS);
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      occurrenceId: occurrence.id,
      eventId: event.id,
      seriesRootId: event.seriesRootId,
      title: event.title,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
      capacity: occurrence.capacity,
      seatsTaken: occurrence.seatsTaken,
      bookingMode: event.bookingMode,
    })
    .from(occurrence)
    .innerJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(occurrence.status, "scheduled"),
        ne(occurrence.id, source.occurrenceId),
        gt(occurrence.startsAt, now),
        lt(occurrence.startsAt, until),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(occurrence.startsAt), asc(occurrence.id))
    .limit(MOVE_TARGETS_MAX);

  const ticketCoverage = held !== null;
  const heldTypeId = held?.ticketTypeId ?? null;
  const heldExpiresAt = held?.expiresAt ?? null;
  const candidates = ticketCoverage ? rows.filter((r) => r.bookingMode === "tickets") : rows;
  const links = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; archived: boolean; rdvFree: boolean }[]>();
  if (ticketCoverage && candidates.length > 0) {
    const linkRows = await db
      .select({
        eventId: eventTicketType.eventId,
        id: ticketType.id,
        name: ticketType.name,
        archivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt,
        rdvFree: ticketType.rdvFree,
      })
      .from(eventTicketType)
      .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, eventTicketType.ticketTypeId))
      .where(
        and(
          eq(eventTicketType.professionalId, professionalId),
          inArray(eventTicketType.eventId, [...new Set(candidates.map((r) => r.eventId))]),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.name), asc(ticketType.id));
    for (const l of linkRows) {
      const list = links.get(l.eventId) ?? [];
      list.push({ id: l.id, name: l.name, archived: l.archivedAt !== null, rdvFree: l.rdvFree });
      links.set(l.eventId, list);
    }
  }
  const elapsed = await elapsedHoldsOf(db, professionalId, candidates.map((r) => r.occurrenceId), now);

  const targets: MoveTarget[] = [];
  for (const r of candidates) {
    let accepted = true;
    let conversionTypes: { id: string; name: string }[] = [];
    let expiresBefore = false;
    if (ticketCoverage) {
      const linked = links.get(r.eventId) ?? [];
      accepted = linked.some((l) => l.id === heldTypeId);
      if (!accepted) {
        conversionTypes = linked.filter((l) => !l.archived && !l.rdvFree).map((l) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name }));
        if (conversionTypes.length === 0) continue;
      }
      expiresBefore = heldExpiresAt !== null && heldExpiresAt.getTime() <= r.startsAt.getTime();
    }
    const shown = seatsShown({ capacity: r.capacity, seatsTaken: r.seatsTaken, elapsedHolds: elapsed.get(r.occurrenceId) ?? 0 });
    targets.push({
      occurrenceId: r.occurrenceId,
      seriesRootId: r.seriesRootId ?? r.eventId,
      title: r.title,
      startsAt: r.startsAt,
      endsAt: r.endsAt,
      seatsShown: shown,
      capacity: r.capacity,
      full: shown === 0,
      accepted,
      conversionTypes,
      expiresBefore,
    });
  }

  const roots = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const t of targets) if (!roots.has(t.seriesRootId)) roots.set(t.seriesRootId, t.title);
  const series = Array.from(roots, ([seriesRootId, title]) => ({ seriesRootId, title })).sort(
    (a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "fr") || a.seriesRootId.localeCompare(b.seriesRootId),
  );
  const wanted = opts.seriesRootId ?? null;
  return { series, targets: wanted === null ? targets : targets.filter((t) => t.seriesRootId === wanted) };
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import { getPlanningRange } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-reads";
import {
  gridHours,
  timeOffSegments,
  toPlanningVM,
  weekTitle,
  type PlanningItemVM,
  type TimeOffSegmentVM,
} from "@/lib/back-office/planning-view";
import { minGeneratedUntil, needsHorizon } from "@/lib/booking/occurrences";
import { addDays, mondayOf, parseKey, todayKey, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { paramForWeek, weekBounds, weekStartFromParam } from "@/lib/planning";

export type PlanningPageData = {
  tz: string;
  days: DateKey[];
  todayKey: DateKey;
  title: string;
  nav: { prev: DateKey; next: DateKey; today: DateKey };
  items: PlanningItemVM[];
  timeOff: TimeOffSegmentVM[];
  startHour: number;
  endHour: number;
  nowIso: string;
  needsHorizon: boolean;
};

/** A well-formed date between 2000 and 2100, else undefined (the page then shows this week). */
function validWeekParam(param: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!param) return undefined;
  try {
    const { y } = parseKey(param);
    return y >= 2000 && y <= 2100 ? param : undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

/**
 * The week of `weekParam` (YYYY-MM-DD, any day; invalid → this week) in the pro
 * time zone: Monday 00:00 to next Monday 00:00 by local date, the range read,
 * the view model, the time-off segments, the grid hours and the title. Reads
 * only: the caller schedules ensureHorizon with after() when `needsHorizon`.
 */
export async function getPlanningPage(
  pro: { id: string; timezone: string },
  weekParam: string | undefined,
): Promise<PlanningPageData> {
  const now = new Date();
  const tz = pro.timezone;
  const weekStart = weekStartFromParam(validWeekParam(weekParam), tz, now);
  const monday = paramForWeek(weekStart, tz);
  const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(monday, i));
  const [{ items, timeOff }, generatedUntil] = await Promise.all([
    getPlanningRange(db, pro.id, weekBounds(weekStart, tz), now),
    minGeneratedUntil(db, pro.id, now),
  ]);
  const vms = toPlanningVM(items, timeOff, tz, now);
  const today = todayKey(now, tz);
  return {
    tz,
    days,
    todayKey: today,
    title: weekTitle(days),
    nav: { prev: addDays(monday, -7), next: addDays(monday, 7), today: mondayOf(today) },
    items: vms,
    timeOff: timeOffSegments(timeOff, days, tz),
    ...gridHours(vms),
    nowIso: now.toISOString(),
    needsHorizon: needsHorizon(generatedUntil, now, tz),
  };
}
```

} from "@/test/fixtures";

  FOLLOWING_DETACHED,
  FOLLOWING_MONTH_DAY,
  TIME_PARTS_REQUIRED,
  applyFollowingCore,
  cancelOccurrenceCore,
  expiringBeforeCore,
  followingRuleOf,
  previewFollowingCore,
  restoreOccurrenceCore,
  unenrollCore,
  updateCapacityCore,
  updateOccurrenceCore,
} from "./planning-actions";

const DAY = 86_400_000;

/** A weekly rule on the weekday of dayIn(pro, 3), `count` séances. */
const weekly = (pro: TestPro, count: number) => ({
  startDate: dayIn(pro, 3),
  freq: "weekly" as const,
  interval: 1,
  weekdays: [dayOfWeek(dayIn(pro, 3))],
  endMode: "count" as const,
  occurrenceCount: count,
});

/** registerPro as the pro, without ticket by default (a guest keeps the fixtures short). Returns the booking id. */
async function register(
  db: Db,
  pro: TestPro,
  occurrenceId: string,
  customerId: string,
  over: { asGuest?: boolean } = {},
): Promise<string> {
  const res = await registerPro(db, {
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    actorUserId: pro.userId,
    occurrenceId,
    customerId,
    asGuest: over.asGuest ?? true,
  });
  assert.ok(res.ok, JSON.stringify(res));
  return res.bookingId;
}

function check(name: string, res: { ok: boolean }, error: string): void {
  assert.equal(res.ok, false, `${name}: ${JSON.stringify(res)}`);
  assert.equal((res as { error: string }).error, error, name);
}

dbTest("updateOccurrenceCore: date + startMinute land on instantAt(date, minute, pro tz), Paris and Los Angeles", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const {
    occurrences: [occ],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro);
  const target = dayIn(pro, 5);
  const res = await updateOccurrenceCore(
    db,
    proCtx(pro),
    { occurrenceId: occ.id, seenStartsAt: occ.startsAt.toISOString(), date: target, startMinute: 1140, durationMin: 90 },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(res.ok, JSON.stringify(res));
  assert.equal(res.timeChanged, true);
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, [{ type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId: occ.id }]);
  const row = await getOccurrence(db, occ.id);
  assert.equal(row.startsAt.toISOString(), instantAt(target, 1140, "Europe/Paris").toISOString());
  assert.equal(row.endsAt.getTime() - row.startsAt.getTime(), 90 * 60_000);
  assert.equal(row.timeDetached, true);

  const la = await createTestPro(db, { tz: "America/Los_Angeles" });
  try {
    const {
      occurrences: [laOcc],
    } = await makeEvent(db, la);
    const laTarget = dayIn(la, 6);
    const laRes = await updateOccurrenceCore(
      db,

      now,

    const laRow = await getOccurrence(db, laOcc.id);
    assert.equal(laRow.startsAt.toISOString(), instantAt(laTarget, 600, "America/Los_Angeles").toISOString());
    assert.notEqual(
      laRow.startsAt.toISOString(),
      instantAt(laTarget, 600, "Europe/Paris").toISOString(),
      "the wall time is read in the pro zone, not in Paris or the host zone",
    );
    assert.deepEqual(await checkInvariants(db, { proId: la.proId }), []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, la.userId);
  }
});

  ]);
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(db, occ.id)).locationOverride, "Studio B");
});

});

dbTest("updateOccurrenceCore: unenrollBookingIds are cancelled with the move, the others are told", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const {
    occurrences: [occ],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro);
  const a = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  const b = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  const bookA = await register(db, pro, occ.id, a);
  const bookB = await register(db, pro, occ.id, b);

  const res = await updateOccurrenceCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    {
      occurrenceId: occ.id,
      seenStartsAt: occ.startsAt.toISOString(),

  assert.ok(res.ok, JSON.stringify(res));
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, [
    { type: "email.booking_cancelled", bookingId: bookA, by: "pro" },
    { type: "email.occurrence_changed", occurrenceId: occ.id, bookingIds: [bookB] },
    { type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId: occ.id },
  ]);
  assert.equal((await getBooking(db, bookA)).status, "cancelled");
  assert.equal((await getBooking(db, bookB)).status, "confirmed");
  const moved = await getOccurrence(db, occ.id);
  assert.equal(moved.seatsTaken, 1);

  // An id that belongs to another séance is refused as a whole.
  const {
    occurrences: [elsewhere],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro);
  const bookC = await register(db, pro, elsewhere.id, await makeCustomer(db, pro));
  const bad = await updateOccurrenceCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { occurrenceId: occ.id, seenStartsAt: moved.startsAt.toISOString(), durationMin: 30, unenrollBookingIds: [bookC] },
    now,
  );
  check("foreign booking id", bad, "Modification invalide.");
  assert.equal((await getBooking(db, bookC)).status, "confirmed");
});

dbTest("updateCapacityCore: « Cette séance » vs « Toutes les séances à venir »", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const { eventId, occurrences } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { rule: weekly(pro, 3) });
  assert.equal(occurrences.length, 3);
  const [first, second, third] = occurrences;
  const snapshot = async () =>
    (await Promise.all(occurrences.map((o) => getOccurrence(db, o.id)))).map((o) => [o.capacity, o.capacityOverride]);

  const one = await updateCapacityCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { occurrenceId: first.id, seenStartsAt: first.startsAt.toISOString(), scope: "occurrence", capacity: 20, seenVersion: null },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(one.ok, JSON.stringify(one));
  assert.deepEqual(one.effects, [{ type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId: first.id }]);
  assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(), [[20, true], [12, false], [12, false]]);

  // Event scope: the séance whose capacity was changed by hand keeps it.
  const all = await updateCapacityCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { occurrenceId: second.id, seenStartsAt: second.startsAt.toISOString(), scope: "event", capacity: 8, seenVersion: 1 },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(all.ok, JSON.stringify(all));
  assert.deepEqual(all.effects, []);
  assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(), [[20, true], [8, false], [8, false]]);
  const [ev] = await db.select({ version: event.version, capacity: event.capacity }).from(event).where(eq(event.id, eventId));
  assert.deepEqual(ev, { version: 2, capacity: 8 });

  // A second event-scope action with the fresh version works; the old version is stale.
  const again = await updateCapacityCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { occurrenceId: second.id, seenStartsAt: second.startsAt.toISOString(), scope: "event", capacity: 9, seenVersion: 2 },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(again.ok, JSON.stringify(again));
  const stale = await updateCapacityCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { occurrenceId: second.id, seenStartsAt: second.startsAt.toISOString(), scope: "event", capacity: 10, seenVersion: 2 },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(!stale.ok);
  assert.equal(stale.error, "Les données ont changé entre-temps : rafraîchissez la page.");
  assert.equal(stale.code, "stale");
  const noVersion = await updateCapacityCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { occurrenceId: second.id, seenStartsAt: second.startsAt.toISOString(), scope: "event", capacity: 10, seenVersion: null },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(!noVersion.ok);
  assert.equal(noVersion.error, "Les données ont changé entre-temps : rafraîchissez la page.");
  assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(), [[20, true], [9, false], [9, false]]);

  // The capacity never drops under the seats already taken.
  await register(db, pro, third.id, await makeCustomer(db, pro));
  await register(db, pro, third.id, await makeCustomer(db, pro));
  const low = await updateCapacityCore(
    db,
    ctx,
    { occurrenceId: third.id, seenStartsAt: third.startsAt.toISOString(), scope: "occurrence", capacity: 1, seenVersion: null },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(low.ok, JSON.stringify(low));
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(db, third.id)).capacity, 2);
});

dbTest("cancelOccurrenceCore: séance and bookings cancelled, one occurrence_cancelled effect, tickets returned", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();

    occurrences: [occ],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { ticketTypeIds: [typeId] });

  const bookB = await register(db, pro, occ.id, b);

  const mail = res.effects.find((e) => e.type === "email.occurrence_cancelled");
