Replace the whole file `src/components/dashboard/planning-calendar.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { CalendarDays, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, CircleCheck, Plus, UserRound } from "lucide-react";

import { OccurrenceDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/occurrence-dialog";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { formatWhen, plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import {
  dayLongLabel,
  dayShortLabel,
  hhmm,
  minuteFromOffset,
  tintOf,
  type PlanningItemVM,
  type TimeOffSegmentVM,
} from "@/lib/back-office/planning-view";
import type { DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { dayKeyInTz, wallClockMinutes } from "@/lib/datetime";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const HOUR_PX = 60;
const MINUTE_PX = HOUR_PX / 60;

/** Hatched block of a time off (planning grid, week preview, mobile list). */
export const OFF_PATTERN =
  "bg-muted/60 [background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,transparent,transparent_6px,rgba(0,0,0,0.05)_6px,rgba(0,0,0,0.05)_12px)]";

// The pure formatters live in planning-view.ts (tested there); week-preview.tsx imports them from this module.
export { dayLongLabel, dayShortLabel, hhmm, tintOf };

const seatsText = (item: PlanningItemVM): string =>
  `${plural(item.seatsTaken, "inscrit", "inscrits")} sur ${item.capacity}`;

function ItemBlock({
  item,
  tz,
  startHour,
  onOpen,
}: {
  item: PlanningItemVM;
  tz: string;
  startHour: number;
  onOpen: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const cancelled = item.status === "cancelled";
  const top = (item.startMinute - startHour * 60) * MINUTE_PX;
  const height = Math.max(22, (item.endMinute - item.startMinute) * MINUTE_PX);
  const second = item.kind === "seance" ? `${item.seatsTaken}/${item.capacity}` : (item.attendees[0]?.name ?? "");
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => onOpen(item.id)}
      aria-label={`${item.title}, ${formatWhen(new Date(item.startsAt), new Date(item.endsAt), tz)}, ${seatsText(item)}`}
      className={cn(
        "absolute overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-l-4 px-1.5 py-1 text-left text-[11px] leading-tight text-foreground shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring active:scale-[0.99]",
        cancelled && "opacity-60 line-through",
      )}
      style={{
        top,
        height,
        left: `calc(${(item.lane / item.lanes) * 100}% + 2px)`,
        width: `calc(${100 / item.lanes}% - 4px)`,
        backgroundColor: tintOf(item.color),
        borderColor: `color-mix(in srgb, ${item.color} 35%, transparent)`,
        borderLeftColor: item.color,
      }}
    >
      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 truncate font-medium">
        {item.kind === "rdv" && <UserRound className="size-3 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />}
        <span className="truncate">{`${hhmm(item.startMinute)} ${item.title}`}</span>
      </span>
      <span className="block truncate text-foreground/80">{second}</span>
      {cancelled && <span className="sr-only">annulée</span>}
    </button>
  );
}

function OffBlock({ segment, startHour, endHour }: { segment: TimeOffSegmentVM; startHour: number; endHour: number }) {
  const top = Math.max(0, (segment.startMinute - startHour * 60) * MINUTE_PX);
  const bottom = Math.min((endHour - startHour) * HOUR_PX, (segment.endMinute - startHour * 60) * MINUTE_PX);
  const height = bottom - top;
  if (height <= 0) return null;
  const label = segment.reason ?? "Indisponible";
  return (
    <div
      className={cn("absolute inset-x-0.5 overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-dashed border-border px-1 pt-0.5", OFF_PATTERN)}
      style={{ top, height }}
      title={label}
    >
      {height >= 20 && <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}

type DayEntry =
  | { kind: "item"; sort: number; item: PlanningItemVM }
  | { kind: "off"; sort: number; segment: TimeOffSegmentVM };

function MobileDay({
  day,
  todayKey,
  items,
  segments,
  onOpen,
}: {
  day: DateKey;
  todayKey: DateKey;
  items: PlanningItemVM[];
  segments: TimeOffSegmentVM[];
  onOpen: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const entries: DayEntry[] = [
    ...segments.map((segment): DayEntry => ({ kind: "off", sort: segment.startMinute, segment })),
    ...items.map((item): DayEntry => ({ kind: "item", sort: item.startMinute, item })),
  ].sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort);

  if (entries.length === 0) {
    // The creation form reads a clicked cell only as a pair (?date + ?minute) and ignores a past day:
    // a future day opens at 10:00, today at the next full hour (no parameter), a past day has no button.
    const newEventHref = day === todayKey ? "/dashboard/events/new" : `/dashboard/events/new?date=${day}&minute=600`;
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-8 text-center">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Rien de prévu ce jour-là.</p>
        {day >= todayKey && (
          <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm" className="mt-3">
            <Link href={newEventHref}>
              <Plus />
              Nouvel événement ce jour
            </Link>
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ul className="grid gap-2">
      {entries.map((entry) => {
        if (entry.kind === "off") {
          const s = entry.segment;
          return (
            <li
              key={`off-${s.id}-${s.dayKey}`}
              className={cn("rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-3 py-2.5", OFF_PATTERN)}
            >
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">{s.reason ?? "Indisponible"}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                {s.startMinute === 0 && s.endMinute === 1440 ? "Toute la journée" : `${hhmm(s.startMinute)} à ${hhmm(s.endMinute)}`}
              </p>
            </li>
          );
        }
        const item = entry.item;
        const cancelled = item.status === "cancelled";
        return (
          <li key={item.id}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onOpen(item.id)}
              className="flex w-full items-stretch gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-3 text-left shadow-sm transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring active:scale-[0.99]"
            >
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="w-1 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: item.color }} />
              <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 gap-0.5">
                <span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                  {`${hhmm(item.startMinute)} à ${hhmm(item.endMinute)}`}
                </span>
                <span className={cn("truncate text-sm font-medium", cancelled && "line-through")}>{item.title}</span>
                <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {item.kind === "seance" ? seatsText(item) : (item.attendees[0]?.name ?? "")}
                </span>
              </span>
              {cancelled && (
                <Badge variant="destructive" className="self-start">
                  Annulée
                </Badge>
              )}
            </button>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

export function PlanningCalendar({
  tz,
  days,
  todayKey,
  title,
  startHour,
  endHour,
  items,
  timeOff,
  nav,
  openOccurrenceId,
  nowIso,
}: {
  tz: string;
  days: DateKey[];
  todayKey: DateKey;
  title: string;
  startHour: number;
  endHour: number;
  items: PlanningItemVM[];
  timeOff: TimeOffSegmentVM[];
  nav: { prev: DateKey; next: DateKey; today: DateKey };
  openOccurrenceId: string | null;
  nowIso: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();

  // A status line left by the dialog when its occurrence leaves the page data after an action (a cancelled
  // RDV is not read any more, so the dialog unmounts and cannot show the line itself). Opening a block, a new
  // deep link or another week clears it.
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [seenWeek, setSeenWeek] = useState<DateKey>(days[0]);
  if (days[0] !== seenWeek) {
    setSeenWeek(days[0]);
    setNotice(null);
  }

  // The dialog is held by id: after an action the page data is refreshed and the
  // dialog shows the fresh séance. A new deep link (?seance=) opens its dialog
  // even though this component instance is reused between two navigations.
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(openOccurrenceId);
  const [seenOpenId, setSeenOpenId] = useState<string | null>(openOccurrenceId);
  if (openOccurrenceId !== seenOpenId) {
    setSeenOpenId(openOccurrenceId);
    setSelectedId(openOccurrenceId);
    setNotice(null);
  }
  const selected = items.find((i) => i.id === selectedId) ?? null;
  const openItem = (id: string) => {
    setNotice(null);
    setSelectedId(id);
  };
  // Only a string is a notice: whatever else a caller hands over is dropped.
  const closeDialog = (text?: string) => {
    setSelectedId(null);
    if (typeof text === "string" && text !== "") setNotice(text);
  };

  // « Maintenant »: the server instant on first render (no hydration gap), then each minute.
  const [nowMs, setNowMs] = useState(() => Date.parse(nowIso));
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => setNowMs(Date.now()), 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);
  const nowDay = dayKeyInTz(new Date(nowMs), tz);
  const nowMinutes = wallClockMinutes(new Date(nowMs), tz);
  const showNow = nowMinutes >= startHour * 60 && nowMinutes <= endHour * 60;

  // Mobile: the day shown. Today when it is in the week, else the first day, else the day of the deep-linked séance.
  const deepLinkDay = openOccurrenceId ? items.find((i) => i.id === openOccurrenceId)?.dayKey : undefined;
  const [pickedDay, setPickedDay] = useState<DateKey | null>(null);
  const defaultDay = deepLinkDay ?? (days.includes(todayKey) ? todayKey : days[0]);
  const activeDay = pickedDay !== null && days.includes(pickedDay) ? pickedDay : defaultDay;

  const hours = Array.from({ length: endHour - startHour }, (_, i) => startHour + i);
  const colHeight = hours.length * HOUR_PX;
  const itemsOf = (day: DateKey) => items.filter((i) => i.dayKey === day);
  const segmentsOf = (day: DateKey) => timeOff.filter((s) => s.dayKey === day);
  const empty = items.length === 0 && timeOff.length === 0;

  // Empty space of a column from today on: a new event at that day and half hour (the pro zone is applied on the server).
  const onColumnClick = (day: DateKey) => (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.target !== e.currentTarget || day < todayKey) return;
    const offset = e.clientY - e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    router.push(`/dashboard/events/new?date=${day}&minute=${minuteFromOffset(offset, startHour, HOUR_PX)}`);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">
              <Link href={`/dashboard/planning?semaine=${nav.prev}`} aria-label="Semaine précédente">
                <ChevronLeft />
              </Link>
            </Button>
            <p className="min-w-[13rem] text-center text-sm font-medium">{title}</p>
            <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">
              <Link href={`/dashboard/planning?semaine=${nav.next}`} aria-label="Semaine suivante">
                <ChevronRight />
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
          <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
            <Link href={`/dashboard/planning?semaine=${nav.today}`}>
              <CalendarDays />
              {"Aujourd'hui"}
            </Link>
          </Button>
        </div>
        <Button asChild size="sm">
          <Link href="/dashboard/events/new">
            <Plus />
            Nouvel événement
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </div>

      {notice && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="mb-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-success-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground"
        >
          <CircleCheck className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-success" aria-hidden="true" />
          {notice}
        </p>
      )}

      {empty && <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucune séance cette semaine.</p>}

      {/* ≥ 640 px: the week grid */}
      <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto sm:block">
        <div className="flex min-w-[640px]">
          <div className="w-12 shrink-0 pt-9">
            {hours.map((h) => (
              <div key={h} className="relative text-right text-[10px] text-muted-foreground" style={{ height: HOUR_PX }}>
                <span className="absolute -top-1.5 right-1 tabular-nums">{hhmm(h * 60)}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {days.map((day) => {
            const isToday = day === todayKey;
            const future = day >= todayKey;
            return (
              <div key={day} className={cn("relative min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-border", isToday && "rounded-md ring-2 ring-inset ring-primary")}>
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "flex h-9 items-center justify-center border-b border-border text-xs font-medium",
                    isToday && "font-semibold text-primary",
                  )}
                >
                  {dayShortLabel(day)}
                </div>
                <div
                  onClick={onColumnClick(day)}
                  className={cn("relative", future && "cursor-cell")}
                  style={{
                    height: colHeight,
                    backgroundImage: "linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent calc(100% - 1px), var(--color-border) calc(100% - 1px))",
                    backgroundSize: `100% ${HOUR_PX}px`,
                  }}
                >
                  {segmentsOf(day).map((s) => (
                    <OffBlock key={`${s.id}-${s.dayKey}`} segment={s} startHour={startHour} endHour={endHour} />
                  ))}
                  {itemsOf(day).map((item) => (
                    <ItemBlock key={item.id} item={item} tz={tz} startHour={startHour} onOpen={openItem} />
                  ))}
                  {day === nowDay && showNow && (
                    <div
                      className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 h-0.5 bg-destructive"
                      style={{ top: (nowMinutes - startHour * 60) * MINUTE_PX }}
                    />
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* < 640 px: day chips and the list of the chosen day */}
      <div className="sm:hidden">
        <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-7 gap-1" role="group" aria-label="Jours de la semaine">
          {days.map((day) => {
            const [weekday, num] = dayShortLabel(day).split(" ");
            const active = day === activeDay;
            const count = itemsOf(day).length;
            return (
              <button
                key={day}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPickedDay(day)}
                aria-pressed={active}
                aria-current={day === todayKey ? "date" : undefined}
                aria-label={`${dayShortLabel(day)}, ${plural(count, "séance", "séances")}`}
                className={cn(
                  "flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 rounded-xl border px-0 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring active:scale-[0.97]",
                  active ? "border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:bg-muted",
                  !active && day === todayKey && "border-primary text-primary",
                )}
              >
                <span>{weekday}</span>
                <span className="text-sm tabular-nums">{num}</span>
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className={cn("h-0.5 w-4 rounded-full", count > 0 ? (active ? "bg-primary-foreground" : "bg-primary") : "bg-transparent")}
                />
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium first-letter:uppercase">{dayLongLabel(activeDay)}</p>
        <MobileDay
          day={activeDay}
          todayKey={todayKey}
          items={itemsOf(activeDay)}
          segments={segmentsOf(activeDay)}
          onOpen={openItem}
        />
      </div>

      {selected && <OccurrenceDialog item={selected} tz={tz} nowIso={nowIso} onClose={closeDialog} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```
The "now" line is `bg-destructive` and the today column has a `ring-primary`, as the contract requires. `new Date(...)` is only given ISO strings or epoch milliseconds read from the server instant: no wall-clock is ever built in the browser, and a click on the grid sends only a `DateKey` and a minute, which the server turns into an instant with `instantAt(date, minute, pro tz)`.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, CircleCheck } from "lucide-react";

import { OccurrenceDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/occurrence-dialog";
import { OFF_PATTERN, dayLongLabel, dayShortLabel, hhmm, tintOf } from "@/components/dashboard/planning-calendar";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { PlanningItemVM, TimeOffSegmentVM } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-view";
import type { DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const HOUR_PX = 36;
const MINUTE_PX = HOUR_PX / 60;

/**
 * Compact day / week grid of the dashboard overview, on the same view model as
 * the planning page. A click opens the same occurrence dialog (held by id, so
 * it follows the refreshed data after an action). The Jour / Semaine toggle
 * switches between one day of the current week and the whole week; the header
 * links to the full planning on that week.
 */
export function WeekPreview({
  tz,
  days,
  todayKey,
  items,
  timeOff,
  startHour,
  endHour,
  weekParam,
  nowIso,
}: {
  tz: string;
  days: DateKey[];
  todayKey: DateKey;
  items: PlanningItemVM[];
  timeOff: TimeOffSegmentVM[];
  startHour: number;
  endHour: number;
  weekParam: DateKey;
  nowIso: string;
}) {
  const hours = Array.from({ length: endHour - startHour }, (_, i) => startHour + i);
  const colHeight = hours.length * HOUR_PX;

  const [view, setView] = useState<"day" | "week">("week");
  const todayIndex = days.indexOf(todayKey);
  const [dayIndex, setDayIndex] = useState(todayIndex >= 0 ? todayIndex : 0);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const selected = items.find((i) => i.id === selectedId) ?? null;
  // The status line the dialog hands over when its occurrence leaves the data after an action (a cancelled RDV).
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const openItem = (id: string) => {
    setNotice(null);
    setSelectedId(id);
  };
  // Only a string is a notice: whatever else a caller hands over is dropped.
  const closeDialog = (text?: string) => {
    setSelectedId(null);
    if (typeof text === "string" && text !== "") setNotice(text);
  };

  const dayColumn = (day: DateKey) => {
    const isToday = day === todayKey;
    return (
      <div key={day} className="min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-border">
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex h-7 items-center justify-center border-b border-border text-[11px] font-medium",
            isToday && "font-semibold text-primary",
          )}
        >
          {dayShortLabel(day)}
        </div>
        <div className="relative" style={{ height: colHeight }}>
          {timeOff
            .filter((s) => s.dayKey === day)
            .map((s) => {
              const top = Math.max(0, (s.startMinute - startHour * 60) * MINUTE_PX);
              const bottom = Math.min(colHeight, (s.endMinute - startHour * 60) * MINUTE_PX);
              if (bottom - top <= 0) return null;
              return (
                <div
                  key={`${s.id}-${s.dayKey}`}
                  className={cn("absolute inset-x-0.5 rounded", OFF_PATTERN)}
                  style={{ top, height: bottom - top }}
                  title={s.reason ?? "Indisponible"}
                />
              );
            })}
          {items
            .filter((i) => i.dayKey === day)
            .map((i) => {
              const cancelled = i.status === "cancelled";
              return (
                <button
                  key={i.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => openItem(i.id)}
                  className={cn(
                    "absolute overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-l-[3px] px-1 py-0.5 text-left text-[10px] leading-tight text-foreground shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring",
                    cancelled && "opacity-60 line-through",
                  )}
                  style={{
                    top: (i.startMinute - startHour * 60) * MINUTE_PX,
                    height: Math.max(16, (i.endMinute - i.startMinute) * MINUTE_PX),
                    left: `calc(${(i.lane / i.lanes) * 100}% + 2px)`,
                    width: `calc(${100 / i.lanes}% - 4px)`,
                    backgroundColor: tintOf(i.color),
                    borderColor: `color-mix(in srgb, ${i.color} 35%, transparent)`,
                    borderLeftColor: i.color,
                  }}
                  title={`${hhmm(i.startMinute)} ${i.title}${i.kind === "seance" ? ` (${i.seatsTaken}/${i.capacity})` : ""}`}
                >
                  <span className="block truncate font-medium">{`${hhmm(i.startMinute)} ${i.title}`}</span>
                  {cancelled && <span className="sr-only">annulée</span>}
                </button>
              );
            })}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const timeGutter = (
    <div className="w-9 shrink-0 pt-7">
      {hours.map((h) => (
        <div key={h} className="relative text-right text-[10px] text-muted-foreground" style={{ height: HOUR_PX }}>
          <span className="absolute -top-1.5 right-1 tabular-nums">{String(h).padStart(2, "0")}h</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 space-y-0">
        <CardTitle>{view === "day" ? "Aujourd'hui" : "Cette semaine"}</CardTitle>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-border p-0.5">
            {(["day", "week"] as const).map((v) => (
              <button
                key={v}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setView(v)}
                aria-pressed={view === v}
                className={cn(
                  "rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring",
                  view === v ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
                )}
              >
                {v === "day" ? "Jour" : "Semaine"}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <Link
            href={`/dashboard/planning?semaine=${weekParam}`}
            className="inline-flex items-center rounded text-sm font-medium text-primary hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          >
            Voir le planning
            <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
          </Link>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {notice && (
          <p
            role="status"
            className="mb-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-success-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground"
          >
            <CircleCheck className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-success" aria-hidden="true" />
            {notice}
          </p>
        )}
        {view === "day" && (
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setDayIndex((i) => Math.max(0, i - 1))}
              disabled={dayIndex === 0}
              aria-label="Jour précédent"
            >
              <ChevronLeft />
            </Button>
            <span className="block min-w-[10rem] text-center text-sm font-medium first-letter:uppercase">{dayLongLabel(days[dayIndex])}</span>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setDayIndex((i) => Math.min(days.length - 1, i + 1))}
              disabled={dayIndex === days.length - 1}
              aria-label="Jour suivant"
            >
              <ChevronRight />
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <div className={cn("flex", view === "week" && "min-w-[640px]")}>
            {timeGutter}
            {view === "week" ? days.map((day) => dayColumn(day)) : dayColumn(days[dayIndex])}
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>

      {selected && <OccurrenceDialog item={selected} tz={tz} nowIso={nowIso} onClose={closeDialog} />}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

### Task 25: Occurrence dialog actions: capacity, cancel, restore, unenroll

Group G4, depends on Task 24. UI task, same design read as Task 24 (back-office, existing system). Every destructive action goes through a `ConfirmDialog` whose text comes from `confirm-copy.ts`; the dialog is held by id by the calendar, and each action revalidates the dashboard layout on the server (no `router.refresh()`), so a second action on the same séance always starts from fresh `seenStartsAt` / `seenVersion` props.

- Modify (rewrite): `src/components/dashboard/occurrence-dialog.tsx`

Replace the whole file `src/components/dashboard/session-capacity-control.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { updateCapacityAction } from "@/server/pro-planning";

const MAX_CAPACITY = 500;

/**
 * Number of seats of a séance. It cannot go under the people already
 * registered. On a recurring event the pro chooses between this séance
 * (which then keeps its own capacity) and every coming séance whose capacity
 * was not changed by hand. `seenStartsAt` and `seenVersion` are props of the
 * current page data: after a save the page is refreshed by the server action
 * and the next save starts from the new values.
 */
export function SessionCapacityControl({
  occurrenceId,
  seenStartsAt,
  capacity,
  seatsTaken,
  seenVersion,
  recurring,
}: {
  occurrenceId: string;
  seenStartsAt: string;
  capacity: number;
  seatsTaken: number;
  seenVersion: number | null;
  recurring: boolean;
}) {
  const inputId = useId();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(String(capacity));
  const [seenCapacity, setSeenCapacity] = useState(capacity);
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<"occurrence" | "event">("occurrence");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  // The capacity changed under us (a refresh after a save): the field follows it.
  if (capacity !== seenCapacity) {
    setSeenCapacity(capacity);
    setValue(String(capacity));
  }

  const min = Math.max(1, seatsTaken);
  const next = value.trim() === "" ? Number.NaN : Number(value);
  const isInteger = Number.isInteger(next);
  const tooLow = isInteger && next < min;
  const tooHigh = isInteger && next > MAX_CAPACITY;
  const valid = isInteger && !tooLow && !tooHigh;
  const choosesScope = recurring && seenVersion !== null;
  const unchanged = scope === "occurrence" && next === capacity;

  function save() {
    if (!valid || unchanged || pending) return;
    setError(null);
    setSaved(false);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await updateCapacityAction({
        occurrenceId,
        seenStartsAt,
        scope: choosesScope ? scope : "occurrence",
        capacity: next,
        seenVersion,
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setSaved(true);
    });
  }

  const helpId = `${inputId}-help`;
  return (
    <form
      className="grid gap-2"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        save();
      }}
    >
      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor={inputId}>Places</Label>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Input
            id={inputId}
            type="number"
            inputMode="numeric"
            min={min}
            max={MAX_CAPACITY}
            value={value}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setValue(e.target.value);
              setSaved(false);
            }}
            aria-invalid={tooLow || tooHigh || undefined}
            aria-describedby={tooLow || tooHigh ? helpId : undefined}
            className="h-9 w-24"
            disabled={pending}
          />
          <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={pending || !valid || unchanged}>
            {pending ? "Enregistrement…" : "Enregistrer"}
          </Button>
        </div>
        {tooLow && (
          <p id={helpId} className="text-xs text-destructive">
            {seatsTaken === 0
              ? "Minimum 1 place."
              : `Minimum ${seatsTaken} : ${plural(seatsTaken, "personne est déjà inscrite", "personnes sont déjà inscrites")}.`}
          </p>
        )}
        {tooHigh && (
          <p id={helpId} className="text-xs text-destructive">
            {`Maximum ${MAX_CAPACITY}.`}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {choosesScope && (
        <fieldset className="grid gap-1.5" disabled={pending}>
          <legend className="sr-only">Portée de la modification</legend>
          <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name={`${inputId}-scope`}
              className="size-4 accent-primary"
              checked={scope === "occurrence"}
              onChange={() => {
                setScope("occurrence");
                setSaved(false);
              }}
            />
            Cette séance
          </label>
          <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name={`${inputId}-scope`}
              className="size-4 accent-primary"
              checked={scope === "event"}
              onChange={() => {
                setScope("event");
                setSaved(false);
              }}
            />
            Toutes les séances à venir
          </label>
          {scope === "event" && (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Sauf celles dont vous avez déjà changé la capacité.</p>
          )}
        </fieldset>
      )}

      {saved && (
        <p role="status" className="text-xs text-foreground">
          Places enregistrées.
        </p>
      )}
      <FormError message={error} />
    </form>
  );
}
```

Replace the whole file `src/components/dashboard/occurrence-dialog.tsx` (Task 24's details part plus the actions):

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowUpRight, Ban, CircleCheck, MapPin, RotateCcw, UserMinus } from "lucide-react";

import { BookingStatusBadge } from "@/components/dashboard/booking-status-badge";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { CoverageBadge } from "@/components/dashboard/coverage-badge";
import { SessionCapacityControl } from "@/components/dashboard/session-capacity-control";
import { TypeChip } from "@/components/dashboard/type-chip";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { cancelOccurrenceCopy, restoreOccurrenceCopy, unenrollCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import { formatWhen, plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { MODE_SHORT_LABELS } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";
import { unenrolledMessage, type PlanningAttendeeVM, type PlanningItemVM } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-view";
import { cancelOccurrenceAction, restoreOccurrenceAction, unenrollAction } from "@/server/pro-planning";

type Confirm = { kind: "cancel" } | { kind: "restore" } | { kind: "unenroll"; ids: string[] };

const REASON_MAX = 500;

function AttendeeRow({
  attendee,
  selectable,
  selected,
  disabled,
  onToggle,
  onUnenroll,
}: {
  attendee: PlanningAttendeeVM;
  selectable: boolean;
  selected: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onUnenroll: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <li className="rounded-xl border border-border p-3 text-sm">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        {selectable && (
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={selected}
            onChange={onToggle}
            disabled={disabled}
            aria-label={`Sélectionner ${attendee.name}`}
            className="mt-1 size-4 shrink-0 cursor-pointer accent-primary"
          />
        )}
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
            <Link
              href={`/dashboard/clients/${attendee.customerId}`}
              className="rounded font-medium text-foreground underline-offset-4 hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              {attendee.name}
            </Link>
            <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{attendee.email}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            <CoverageBadge coverage={attendee.coverage} />
            <BookingStatusBadge status={attendee.status} />
            {attendee.moved && <Badge variant="neutral">Déplacé</Badge>}
          </div>
          {attendee.ticketLabel && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{attendee.ticketLabel}</p>}
          {attendee.holdUntil && (
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-warning">{`Paiement en cours jusqu'à ${attendee.holdUntil}`}</p>
          )}
          {attendee.answers.length > 0 && (
            <ul className="mt-2 space-y-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {attendee.answers.map((a, i) => (
                <li key={`${a.label}-${i}`}>{`${a.label} : ${a.value}`}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
          {attendee.notes && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{`Note : ${attendee.notes}`}</p>}
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onUnenroll} disabled={disabled} className="shrink-0">
          <UserMinus />
          Désinscrire
        </Button>
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

/**
 * A séance or an RDV of the planning. The caller keeps the occurrence's id and
 * passes the item freshly read from the page data, so seats and attendees are
 * never the ones clicked before an action. Every destructive action is behind
 * a ConfirmDialog (texts in confirm-copy.ts); a failure stays in that dialog,
 * a success shows a status line at the top of this one. An RDV is the exception:
 * cancelling it, or removing its only attendee, ends it, and an ended RDV is not
 * in the page data any more, so this dialog would unmount before its line could
 * be read; the line goes to the page through `onClose(notice)` instead.
 */
export function OccurrenceDialog({
  item,
  tz,
  onClose,
}: {
  item: PlanningItemVM;
  tz: string;
  nowIso: string;
  onClose: (notice?: string) => void;
}) {
  const reasonId = useId();
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState<Confirm | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const cancelled = item.status === "cancelled";
  const scheduled = item.status === "scheduled";
  const isSeance = item.kind === "seance";
  const place = item.location
    ? `Lieu : ${item.location}${item.locationOverride !== null ? " (pour cette séance)" : ""}`
    : "Lieu non précisé";

  // Selection by booking id, limited to the rows still there after a refresh.
  const selected = item.attendees.filter((a) => picked.includes(a.bookingId));

  const peopleOf = (ids: string[]) => item.attendees.filter((a) => ids.includes(a.bookingId));
  const copy = (() => {
    if (!confirm) return null;
    if (confirm.kind === "cancel") {
      return cancelOccurrenceCopy({ kind: item.kind, registrants: item.attendees.length, past: item.past });
    }
    if (confirm.kind === "restore") return restoreOccurrenceCopy();
    const people = peopleOf(confirm.ids);
    return unenrollCopy({
      names: people.map((p) => p.name),
      ticketCount: people.filter((p) => p.coverage === "ticket" && p.status === "confirmed").length,
      pendingCount: people.filter((p) => p.status === "pending").length,
    });
  })();

  function closeConfirm() {
    if (pending) return;
    setConfirm(null);
    setError(null);
  }

  function run() {
    if (!confirm) return;
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      let done: string;
      if (confirm.kind === "cancel") {
        const res = await cancelOccurrenceAction({ occurrenceId: item.id });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        done =
          item.kind === "rdv"
            ? "Rendez-vous annulé. Le client est prévenu par email."
            : res.bookingsCancelled > 0
              ? "Séance annulée. Les inscrits sont prévenus par email."
              : "Séance annulée.";
      } else if (confirm.kind === "restore") {
        const res = await restoreOccurrenceAction({ occurrenceId: item.id });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        done = "Séance rétablie.";
      } else {
        const names = peopleOf(confirm.ids).map((p) => p.name);
        const res = await unenrollAction({
          occurrenceId: item.id,
          bookingIds: confirm.ids,
          reason: reason.trim() === "" ? null : reason.trim(),
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        done = unenrolledMessage(names, res.cancelled, res.ticketsReturned);
        setPicked([]);
        setReason("");
      }
      if (item.kind === "rdv") {
        // The RDV is ended and leaves the page data: the calendar shows the line, this dialog goes away.
        onClose(done);
        return;
      }
      setMessage(done);
      setConfirm(null);
    });
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* Escape and the backdrop close the confirmation first, never both dialogs at once. */}
      <Dialog open onClose={() => (confirm || pending ? undefined : onClose())} title={item.title}>
        {message && (
          <p
            role="status"
            className="mb-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-success-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground"
          >
            <CircleCheck className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-success" aria-hidden="true" />
            {message}
          </p>
        )}

        <div className="grid gap-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-foreground">{formatWhen(new Date(item.startsAt), new Date(item.endsAt), tz)}</p>
          <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <MapPin className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>{place}</span>
          </p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            {cancelled && <Badge variant="destructive">Annulée</Badge>}
            {isSeance && item.bookingMode && <Badge variant="outline">{MODE_SHORT_LABELS[item.bookingMode]}</Badge>}
            {item.isPrivate && <Badge variant="neutral">Privé</Badge>}
            {item.acceptedTypes.map((t) => (
              <TypeChip key={t.id} name={t.name} color={t.color} />
            ))}
          </div>
          {isSeance && (
            <p className="text-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
              {`${plural(item.seatsTaken, "inscrit", "inscrits")} sur ${item.capacity} · ${plural(item.seatsShown, "place en ligne", "places en ligne")}`}
            </p>
          )}
          {isSeance && scheduled && (
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-muted/50 p-3">
              <SessionCapacityControl
                occurrenceId={item.id}
                seenStartsAt={item.startsAt}
                capacity={item.capacity}
                seatsTaken={item.seatsTaken}
                seenVersion={item.eventVersion}
                recurring={item.recurring}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {selected.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl bg-muted/60 px-3 py-2">
            <span className="text-sm text-foreground">{plural(selected.length, "sélectionné", "sélectionnés")}</span>
            <Button
              variant="destructive"
              size="sm"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => setConfirm({ kind: "unenroll", ids: selected.map((a) => a.bookingId) })}
            >
              {`Désinscrire la sélection (${selected.length})`}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}

        {item.attendees.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-muted/60 px-3 py-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Personne n&apos;est inscrit pour le moment.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="mt-4 grid gap-2" aria-label="Inscrits">
            {item.attendees.map((a) => (
              <AttendeeRow
                key={a.bookingId}
                attendee={a}
                selectable={isSeance}
                selected={picked.includes(a.bookingId)}
                disabled={pending}
                onToggle={() =>
                  setPicked((ids) => (ids.includes(a.bookingId) ? ids.filter((id) => id !== a.bookingId) : [...ids, a.bookingId]))
                }
                onUnenroll={() => setConfirm({ kind: "unenroll", ids: [a.bookingId] })}
              />
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}

        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-border pt-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {scheduled && (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="text-destructive"
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={() => setConfirm({ kind: "cancel" })}
              >
                <Ban />
                {isSeance ? "Annuler la séance" : "Annuler le rendez-vous"}
              </Button>
            )}
            {item.canRestore && (
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={pending} onClick={() => setConfirm({ kind: "restore" })}>
                <RotateCcw />
                Rétablir
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          {isSeance && item.eventId && (
            <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
              <Link href={`/dashboard/events/${item.eventId}`}>
                Ouvrir l&apos;événement
                <ArrowUpRight />
              </Link>
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </Dialog>

      {confirm && copy && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          open
          copy={copy}
          tone={confirm.kind === "restore" ? "primary" : "destructive"}
          pending={pending}
          error={error}
          onConfirm={run}
          onClose={closeConfirm}
        >
          {confirm.kind === "unenroll" && (
            <div className="grid gap-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor={reasonId}>Motif (facultatif)</Label>
              <Textarea
                id={reasonId}
                value={reason}
                maxLength={REASON_MAX}
                rows={2}
                disabled={pending}
                onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </ConfirmDialog>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```
Notes: the cancel button uses `text-destructive` on the `outline` variant (the rose `#e11d48` on white is 4.6:1, AA); the destructive bulk button is white on the same rose (AA). The status line sets the text colour to the foreground and keeps the green only on its icon, because `text-success` on `bg-success-muted` is under 4.5:1. `ticketCount` counts only confirmed ticket bookings (a pending buy-and-book seat has no ticket yet), `pendingCount` the pending ones, as `unenrollCopy` expects.

  ```tsx
  "use client";

  import { useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
  import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

  import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
  import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
  import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
  import type { PlanningItemVM } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-view";
  import { formatDayMonth, todayKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
  import { minutesToLabel } from "@/lib/datetime";
  import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
  import {
    applyFollowingAction,
    expiringBeforeAction,
    previewFollowingAction,
    updateOccurrenceAction,
  } from "@/server/pro-planning";

  type ExpiringBooking = { bookingId: string; customerName: string; expiryText: string };
  /** The expiring-ticket list is only valid for the date and time it was computed for (`key`). */
  type ExpiringState = { key: string; bookings: ExpiringBooking[] };
  /** The « suivantes » preview is only valid for the time and duration it was computed for (`key`). */
  type FollowingState = { key: string; text: string; fromDate: string };
  type ExpiredChoice = "keep" | "unenroll";

  /** "19:30" to minutes from midnight; null for an empty or malformed field. */
  function parseTime(value: string): number | null {
    const match = /^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(value);
    if (!match) return null;
    const hours = Number(match[1]);
    const minutes = Number(match[2]);
    if (hours > 23 || minutes > 59) return null;
    return hours * 60 + minutes;
  }

  /** Length of the séance in minutes, from its two ISO instants. */
  function durationOf(item: PlanningItemVM): number {
    return Math.round((Date.parse(item.endsAt) - Date.parse(item.startsAt)) / 60_000);
  }

  /** « Modifier cette séance »: date, time, duration and place of ONE séance, or its time and duration for the following ones. */
  export function OccurrenceEditForm({
    item,
    tz,
    nowIso,
    onDone,
    onCancel,
  }: {
    item: PlanningItemVM;
    tz: string;
    nowIso: string;
    onDone: (message: string) => void;
    onCancel: () => void;
  }) {
    const uid = useId();
    const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const currentDuration = durationOf(item);
    const [date, setDate] = useState<string>(item.dayKey);
    const [time, setTime] = useState(minutesToLabel(item.startMinute));
    const [duration, setDuration] = useState(String(currentDuration));
    const [place, setPlace] = useState(item.locationOverride ?? "");
    const [choice, setChoice] = useState<ExpiredChoice>("keep");
    const [expiring, setExpiring] = useState<ExpiringState | null>(null);
    const [following, setFollowing] = useState<FollowingState | null>(null);

    const today = todayKey(new Date(nowIso), tz);
    const minute = parseTime(time);
    const durationValue = Number(duration);
    const durationValid =
      duration.trim() !== "" &&
      Number.isInteger(durationValue) &&
      durationValue >= BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.min &&
      durationValue <= BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.max &&
      durationValue % BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.step === 0;
    const dateValid = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date);
    const placeValue = place.trim() === "" ? null : place.trim();

    const dateChanged = dateValid && date !== item.dayKey;
    const timeChanged = minute !== null && minute !== item.startMinute;
    const startChanged = dateChanged || timeChanged;
    const durationChanged = durationValid && durationValue !== currentDuration;
    const placeChanged = placeValue !== (item.locationOverride ?? null);
    const hasChanges = startChanged || durationChanged || placeChanged;
    const formValid = dateValid && minute !== null && durationValid;
    const canSave = formValid && hasChanges && !pending;
    const canFollow =
      item.recurring &&
      item.eventVersion !== null &&
      !item.started &&
      formValid &&
      !dateChanged &&
      !placeChanged &&
      (timeChanged || durationChanged);

    const startKey = `${date}|${time}`;
    const followKey = `${time}|${duration}`;
    const activeExpiring = expiring !== null && expiring.key === startKey ? expiring : null;
    const activeFollowing = following !== null && following.key === followKey ? following : null;

    async function updateNow(unenrollBookingIds: string[]) {
      if (minute === null) return;
      const res = await updateOccurrenceAction({
        occurrenceId: item.id,
        seenStartsAt: item.startsAt,
        ...(startChanged ? { date, startMinute: minute } : {}),
        ...(durationChanged ? { durationMin: durationValue } : {}),
        ...(placeChanged ? { locationOverride: placeValue } : {}),
        unenrollBookingIds,
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      onDone("Séance modifiée.");
    }

    function save() {
      if (!canSave) return;
      setError(null);
      startTransition(async () => {
        if (startChanged && minute !== null && activeExpiring === null) {
          const check = await expiringBeforeAction({
            occurrenceId: item.id,
            date,
            startMinute: minute,
          });
          if (!check.ok) {
            setError(check.error);
            return;
          }
          if (check.bookings.length > 0) {
            setChoice("keep");
            setExpiring({ key: startKey, bookings: check.bookings });
            return;
          }
        }
        const unenroll =
          activeExpiring !== null && choice === "unenroll"
            ? activeExpiring.bookings.map((b) => b.bookingId)
            : [];
        await updateNow(unenroll);
      });
    }

    function previewFollowing() {
      if (!canFollow || minute === null) return;
      setError(null);
      startTransition(async () => {
        const res = await previewFollowingAction({
          occurrenceId: item.id,
          startMinute: minute,
          durationMin: durationValue,
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setFollowing({ key: followKey, text: res.text, fromDate: res.fromDate });
      });
    }

    function applyFollowing() {
      if (!canFollow || minute === null || item.eventVersion === null) return;
      const seenVersion = item.eventVersion;
      setError(null);
      startTransition(async () => {
        const res = await applyFollowingAction({
          occurrenceId: item.id,
          seenVersion,
          startMinute: minute,
          durationMin: durationValue,
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        onDone("Horaire modifié pour cette séance et les suivantes.");
      });
    }

    return (
      <form
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          save();
        }}
        className="space-y-4"
      >
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <FormField label="Date" htmlFor={`${uid}-date`}>
            <Input
              id={`${uid}-date`}
              type="date"
              value={date}
              min={today}
              disabled={item.started || pending}
              onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)}
            />
          </FormField>
          <FormField label="Heure de début" htmlFor={`${uid}-time`}>
            <Input
              id={`${uid}-time`}
              type="time"
              value={time}
              disabled={item.started || pending}
              onChange={(e) => setTime(e.target.value)}
            />
          </FormField>
        </div>

        <FormField
          label="Durée"
          htmlFor={`${uid}-duration`}
          help={item.started ? "Cette séance a commencé : seul le lieu se modifie ici." : undefined}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Input
              id={`${uid}-duration`}
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min={BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.min}
              max={BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.max}
              step={BOUNDS.eventDurationMin.step}
              value={duration}
              disabled={item.started || pending}
              onChange={(e) => setDuration(e.target.value)}
              className="w-28"
            />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">minutes</span>
          </div>
        </FormField>

        <FormField
          label="Lieu de cette séance"
          htmlFor={`${uid}-place`}
          optional
          help={`Laissez vide pour le lieu de l'événement : ${item.eventLocation ?? "aucun"}.`}
        >
          <Input
            id={`${uid}-place`}
            value={place}
            maxLength={BOUNDS.location}
            disabled={pending}
            onChange={(e) => setPlace(e.target.value)}
          />
        </FormField>

        {item.attendees.length > 0 && hasChanges && (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Les inscrits sont prévenus par email.</p>
        )}

        {activeExpiring !== null && (
          <div
            role="group"
            aria-labelledby={`${uid}-expiring`}
            className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/40 p-3"
          >
            <p id={`${uid}-expiring`} className="text-sm font-medium">
              Ces inscrits ont un ticket qui expire avant la nouvelle date :
            </p>
            <ul className="list-disc space-y-0.5 pl-5 text-sm">
              {activeExpiring.bookings.map((b) => (
                <li key={b.bookingId}>{`${b.customerName} (${b.expiryText})`}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            <label className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
              <input
                type="radio"
                name={`${uid}-expired-choice`}
                checked={choice === "keep"}
                disabled={pending}
                onChange={() => setChoice("keep")}
                className="mt-0.5 size-4 accent-primary"
              />
              <span>Les garder (le ticket reste utilisé)</span>
            </label>
            <label className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
              <input
                type="radio"
                name={`${uid}-expired-choice`}
                checked={choice === "unenroll"}
                disabled={pending}
                onChange={() => setChoice("unenroll")}
                className="mt-0.5 size-4 accent-primary"
              />
              <span>Les désinscrire (ticket rendu, client prévenu)</span>
            </label>
          </div>
        )}

        {activeFollowing !== null && (
          <div role="status" className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/40 p-3 text-sm">
            <p>{activeFollowing.text}</p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">{`À partir du ${formatDayMonth(activeFollowing.fromDate)}.`}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        <FormError message={error} />

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-border pt-4">
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={onCancel} disabled={pending}>
            Retour
          </Button>
          {canFollow &&
            (activeFollowing !== null ? (
              <Button
                type="button"
                onClick={applyFollowing}
                disabled={pending}
                className="h-auto whitespace-normal py-2 text-center sm:whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
                Confirmer pour cette séance et les suivantes
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={previewFollowing}
                disabled={pending}
                className="h-auto whitespace-normal py-2 text-center sm:whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                Appliquer aussi aux séances suivantes
              </Button>
            ))}
          <Button
            type="submit"
            variant={activeFollowing !== null ? "secondary" : "primary"}
            disabled={!canSave}
            className="h-auto whitespace-normal py-2 text-center sm:whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            {pending && activeFollowing === null && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
            {activeExpiring !== null ? "Confirmer" : "Enregistrer pour cette séance"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    );
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 2: Create `src/components/dashboard/move-attendee-dialog.tsx`**

  Write the whole file:

  ```tsx
  "use client";

  import { useEffect, useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
  import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

  import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
  import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
  import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
  import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
  import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
  import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
  import { WEEKDAY_NAMES } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";
  import type { MoveTargetVM } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-actions";
  import { dayOfWeek, formatDayMonth } from "@/lib/civil-date";
  import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
  import { moveAttendeeAction, moveTargetsAction } from "@/server/pro-planning";

  const EXPIRES_BEFORE = "Ticket expiré à la date de cette séance : déplacer quand même ?";
  const LOAD_ERROR = "Une erreur inattendue est survenue. Réessayez dans un instant.";

  const noop = () => {};

  type Series = { seriesRootId: string; title: string };
  /** The result of one `moveTargetsAction` call, tagged with the request it answers. */
  type Loaded =
    | { key: string; ok: true; targets: MoveTargetVM[] }
    | { key: string; ok: false; error: string };
  type DayGroup = { dayKey: string; targets: MoveTargetVM[] };

  /** Targets grouped by local day, in day order (the sort is stable: times keep their order inside a day). */
  function groupByDay(targets: readonly MoveTargetVM[]): DayGroup[] {
    const sorted = [...targets].sort((a, b) => (a.dayKey < b.dayKey ? -1 : a.dayKey > b.dayKey ? 1 : 0));
    const groups: DayGroup[] = [];
    for (const target of sorted) {
      const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
      if (last && last.dayKey === target.dayKey) last.targets.push(target);
      else groups.push({ dayKey: target.dayKey, targets: [target] });
    }
    return groups;
  }

  /** Q18 « Déplacer »: the pro's next séances that can take this registrant, with conversion and « quand même ». */
  export function MoveAttendeeDialog({
    bookingId,
    customerName,
    onClose,
    onDone,
  }: {
    bookingId: string;
    customerName: string;
    onClose: () => void;
    onDone: (message: string) => void;
  }) {
    const uid = useId();
    const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
    const [seriesRootId, setSeriesRootId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [seriesList, setSeriesList] = useState<Series[]>([]);
    const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<Loaded | null>(null);
    const [targetId, setTargetId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [convertTo, setConvertTo] = useState("");
    const [forceNeeded, setForceNeeded] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const key = `${bookingId}|${seriesRootId ?? "all"}`;

    useEffect(() => {
      let stale = false;
      moveTargetsAction({ bookingId, seriesRootId })
        .then((res) => {
          if (stale) return;
          if (!res.ok) {
            setLoaded({ key, ok: false, error: res.error });
            return;
          }
          setLoaded({ key, ok: true, targets: res.targets });
          if (seriesRootId === null) setSeriesList(res.series);
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (!stale) setLoaded({ key, ok: false, error: LOAD_ERROR });
        });
      return () => {
        stale = true;
      };
    }, [bookingId, seriesRootId, key]);

    const current = loaded !== null && loaded.key === key ? loaded : null;
    const loading = current === null;
    const targets = current?.ok ? current.targets : [];
    const loadError = current !== null && !current.ok ? current.error : null;
    const groups = groupByDay(targets);
    const selected = targets.find((t) => t.occurrenceId === targetId) ?? null;
    const needsConversion = selected !== null && !selected.accepted;
    const expiryWarning = selected !== null && (selected.expiresBefore || forceNeeded);
    const canSubmit = selected !== null && (!needsConversion || convertTo !== "") && !pending;

    function pickTarget(id: string) {
      setTargetId(id);
      setConvertTo("");
      setForceNeeded(false);
      setError(null);
    }

    function submit() {
      if (selected === null || !canSubmit) return;
      const targetOccurrenceId = selected.occurrenceId;
      const convertToTicketTypeId = needsConversion ? convertTo : null;
      const force = expiryWarning;
      setError(null);
      startTransition(async () => {
        const res = await moveAttendeeAction({
          bookingId,
          targetOccurrenceId,
          force,
          convertToTicketTypeId,
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          onDone("Inscription déplacée. Le client est prévenu par email.");
          return;
        }
        if (res.code === "ticket_expires_before") {
          setForceNeeded(true);
          return;
        }
        setError(res.error);
      });
    }

    return (
      <Dialog open onClose={pending ? noop : onClose} title={`Déplacer ${customerName}`}>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <FormField label="Événement" htmlFor={`${uid}-series`}>
            <Select
              id={`${uid}-series`}
              value={seriesRootId ?? ""}
              disabled={pending}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSeriesRootId(e.target.value === "" ? null : e.target.value);
                setTargetId(null);
                setConvertTo("");
                setForceNeeded(false);
                setError(null);
              }}
            >
              <option value="">Tous les événements</option>
              {seriesList.map((s) => (
                <option key={s.seriesRootId} value={s.seriesRootId}>
                  {s.title}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </FormField>

          {loading && (
            <p role="status" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />
              Recherche des séances…
            </p>
          )}
          <FormError message={loadError} />
          {!loading && loadError === null && targets.length === 0 && (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Aucune séance disponible dans les 60 prochains jours.
            </p>
          )}

          {groups.length > 0 && (
            <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Séances disponibles" className="space-y-4">
              {groups.map((group) => (
                <div key={group.dayKey} className="space-y-2">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium capitalize text-muted-foreground">
                    {`${WEEKDAY_NAMES[dayOfWeek(group.dayKey)]} ${formatDayMonth(group.dayKey)}`}
                  </p>
                  {group.targets.map((t) => (
                    <label
                      key={t.occurrenceId}
                      className={cn(
                        "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border p-3 text-sm",
                        t.full ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" : "cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50",
                        targetId === t.occurrenceId ? "border-primary bg-primary-muted/40" : "border-border",
                      )}
                    >
                      <input
                        type="radio"
                        name={`${uid}-target`}
                        value={t.occurrenceId}
                        checked={targetId === t.occurrenceId}
                        disabled={t.full || pending}
                        onChange={() => pickTarget(t.occurrenceId)}
                        className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 accent-primary"
                      />
                      <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5">
                        <span>{`${t.whenLabel} · ${t.title} · ${plural(t.seatsShown, "place", "places")}`}</span>
                        <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                          {t.accepted ? (
                            <Badge variant="success">Accepté</Badge>
                          ) : (
                            <Badge variant="warning">Conversion nécessaire</Badge>
                          )}
                          {t.full && <Badge variant="neutral">Complet</Badge>}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {needsConversion && selected !== null && (
            <FormField label="Convertir le ticket en" htmlFor={`${uid}-convert`}>
              <Select
                id={`${uid}-convert`}
                value={convertTo}
                disabled={pending}
                required
                onChange={(e) => setConvertTo(e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="" disabled>
                  Choisir un type
                </option>
                {selected.conversionTypes.map((type) => (
                  <option key={type.id} value={type.id}>
                    {type.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormField>
          )}

          <FormError message={expiryWarning ? EXPIRES_BEFORE : null} />
          <FormError message={error} />

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-border pt-4">
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={pending}>
              Retour
            </Button>
            <Button type="button" onClick={submit} disabled={!canSubmit}>
              {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
              {expiryWarning ? "Déplacer quand même" : "Déplacer"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Dialog>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```ts
  registerOptionsAction(input: { occurrenceId: string; customerId: string }): Promise<ActionResult<{ mode: BookingMode; alreadyBooked: boolean; usable: { id: string; label: string }[] }>>;
  ```
