The dialog never imports `planning-actions.ts` at runtime (its `REGISTER_*` strings are repeated as literals below, as the contract requires for client components). The cores it calls are tested in Task 23; this task has no test of its own and is verified in the browser. The customer search is debounced 250 ms inside an effect that only calls `setState` from the timer callback (never synchronously), so `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` stays quiet.

- [ ] **Step 1: Create `src/components/dashboard/register-attendee-dialog.tsx`**

  Write the whole file:

  ```tsx
  "use client";

  import Link from "next/link";
  import { useEffect, useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
  import { Loader2, Plus } from "lucide-react";

  import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
  import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
  import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
  import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
  import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
  import type { RegisterInput } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-actions";
  import type { CustomerHit } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-reads";
  import type { PlanningItemVM } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-view";
  import { BOUNDS, type BookingMode } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
  import {
    registerAttendeeAction,
    registerOptionsAction,
    searchCustomersAction,
  } from "@/server/pro-planning";

  const UNEXPECTED = "Une erreur inattendue est survenue. Réessayez dans un instant.";

  const noop = () => {};

  type Client = { kind: "existing"; id: string; name: string; email: string } | { kind: "new" };
  /** The answer of one search, tagged with the trimmed query it answers. */
  type Searched =
    | { key: string; ok: true; customers: CustomerHit[] }
    | { key: string; ok: false; error: string };
  /** The answer of `registerOptionsAction` for one customer; the answers are kept per customer id, so a late answer for a client picked earlier never replaces the current one. */
  type Options =
    | { customerId: string; ok: true; mode: BookingMode; alreadyBooked: boolean; usable: { id: string; label: string }[] }
    | { customerId: string; ok: false; error: string };
  /** auto = the engine's mode-driven coverage (earliest-expiring ticket, or free); specific = auto with a forced ticket; guest = « Invité ». */
  type Choice = "auto" | "specific" | "guest";

  const CHOICE_LABELS: Record<BookingMode, Partial<Record<Choice, string>>> = {
    tickets: {
      auto: "Avec un ticket (celui qui expire le plus tôt)",
      specific: "Un ticket précis",
      guest: "Sans ticket (invité)",
    },
    free: { auto: "Inscription libre", guest: "Invité" },
    none: { guest: "Invité" },
  };

  /** « Inscrire »: search or create a client, pick how the seat is covered, answer the questions. */
  export function RegisterAttendeeDialog({
    item,
    onClose,
    onDone,
  }: {
    item: PlanningItemVM;
    onClose: () => void;
    onDone: (message: string) => void;
  }) {
    const uid = useId();
    const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
    const [searched, setSearched] = useState<Searched | null>(null);
    const [client, setClient] = useState<Client | null>(null);
    const [optionsById, setOptionsById] = useState<Record<string, Options>>({});
    const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");
    const [newEmail, setNewEmail] = useState("");
    const [newPhone, setNewPhone] = useState("");
    const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Choice | null>(null);
    const [specificId, setSpecificId] = useState("");
    const [extraSeat, setExtraSeat] = useState(false);
    const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

    const trimmed = query.trim();

    useEffect(() => {
      if (trimmed.length < 2) return;
      let stale = false;
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        searchCustomersAction({ q: trimmed })
          .then((res) => {
            if (stale) return;
            setSearched(
              res.ok
                ? { key: trimmed, ok: true, customers: res.customers }
                : { key: trimmed, ok: false, error: res.error },
            );
          })
          .catch(() => {
            if (!stale) setSearched({ key: trimmed, ok: false, error: UNEXPECTED });
          });
      }, 250);
      return () => {
        stale = true;
        clearTimeout(timer);
      };
    }, [trimmed]);

    const found = searched !== null && searched.key === trimmed ? searched : null;
    const searching = trimmed.length >= 2 && found === null;

    const existingOptions = client !== null && client.kind === "existing" ? (optionsById[client.id] ?? null) : null;
    const optionsLoading = client !== null && client.kind === "existing" && existingOptions === null;
    const optionsFailure = existingOptions !== null && !existingOptions.ok ? existingOptions.error : null;
    const loadedOptions = existingOptions !== null && existingOptions.ok ? existingOptions : null;

    const mode: BookingMode = loadedOptions?.mode ?? item.bookingMode ?? "none";
    const usable = loadedOptions?.usable ?? [];
    const alreadyBooked = loadedOptions?.alreadyBooked ?? false;
    const hasTickets = client !== null && client.kind === "existing" && usable.length > 0;
    const available: Choice[] =
      mode === "tickets" ? (hasTickets ? ["auto", "specific", "guest"] : ["guest"]) : mode === "free" ? ["auto", "guest"] : ["guest"];
    const choice: Choice = picked !== null && available.includes(picked) ? picked : available[0];
    const ticketId = choice === "specific" ? (specificId !== "" ? specificId : (usable[0]?.id ?? null)) : null;

    const newValid = client !== null && client.kind === "new" && newName.trim() !== "" && newEmail.trim() !== "";
    const ready = client !== null && client.kind === "existing" ? loadedOptions !== null && !alreadyBooked : newValid;
    const canSubmit = ready && (choice !== "specific" || ticketId !== null) && !pending;

    function chooseExisting(hit: CustomerHit) {
      setClient({ kind: "existing", id: hit.id, name: hit.name, email: hit.email });
      setPicked(null);
      setSpecificId("");
      setError(null);
      // A client picked again is looked up again: drop the answer kept for it so the spinner shows until the fresh one.
      setOptionsById((prev) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(prev).filter(([id]) => id !== hit.id)));
      registerOptionsAction({ occurrenceId: item.id, customerId: hit.id })
        .then((res) => {
          setOptionsById((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            [hit.id]: res.ok
              ? { customerId: hit.id, ok: true, mode: res.mode, alreadyBooked: res.alreadyBooked, usable: res.usable }
              : { customerId: hit.id, ok: false, error: res.error },
          }));
        })
        .catch(() =>
          setOptionsById((prev) => ({ ...prev, [hit.id]: { customerId: hit.id, ok: false, error: UNEXPECTED } })),
        );
    }

    function startNew() {
      setClient({ kind: "new" });
      setPicked(null);
      setError(null);
    }

    function changeClient() {
      setClient(null);
      setPicked(null);
      setSpecificId("");
      setError(null);
    }

    function submit() {
      if (client === null || !canSubmit) return;
      const customer: RegisterInput["customer"] =
        client.kind === "existing"
          ? { kind: "existing", customerId: client.id }
          : {
              kind: "new",
              name: newName.trim(),
              email: newEmail.trim(),
              phone: newPhone.trim() === "" ? null : newPhone.trim(),
            };
      const displayName = client.kind === "existing" ? client.name : newName.trim();
      const answerList = item.questions.flatMap((q) => {
        const value = (answers[q.id] ?? "").trim();
        return value === "" ? [] : [{ questionId: q.id, value }];
      });
      setError(null);
      startTransition(async () => {
        const res = await registerAttendeeAction({
          occurrenceId: item.id,
          customer,
          coverage: choice === "guest" ? "guest" : "auto",
          ticketId,
          extraSeat,
          answers: answerList,
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        onDone(
          res.customerCreated
            ? `${displayName} est inscrit. Sa fiche client a été créée et un email de confirmation lui a été envoyé.`
            : `${displayName} est inscrit. Un email de confirmation lui a été envoyé.`,
        );
      });
    }

    return (
      <Dialog open onClose={pending ? noop : onClose} title={`Inscrire à « ${item.title} »`}>
        <form
          noValidate
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            submit();
          }}
          className="space-y-4"
        >
          {client === null && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <FormField
                label="Rechercher un client"
                htmlFor={`${uid}-search`}
                help="Nom ou email, 2 caractères minimum."
              >
                <Input
                  id={`${uid}-search`}
                  type="search"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  value={query}
                  onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                />
              </FormField>
              {searching && (
                <p role="status" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />
                  Recherche…
                </p>
              )}
              {found !== null && !found.ok && trimmed.length >= 2 && <FormError message={found.error} />}
              {found !== null && found.ok && trimmed.length >= 2 && (
                found.customers.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucun client trouvé.</p>
                ) : (
                  <ul className="space-y-1.5">
                    {found.customers.map((hit) => (
                      <li key={hit.id}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => chooseExisting(hit)}
                          className="w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-muted"
                        >
                          {`${hit.name} · ${hit.email}`}
                        </button>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                )
              )}
              <Button type="button" variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={startNew}>
                <Plus />
                Nouveau client
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          {client !== null && client.kind === "existing" && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/40 px-3 py-2">
              <p className="min-w-0 truncate text-sm font-medium">{`${client.name} · ${client.email}`}</p>
              <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={changeClient} disabled={pending}>
                Changer
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          {client !== null && client.kind === "new" && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">Nouveau client</p>
                <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={changeClient} disabled={pending}>
                  Changer
                </Button>
              </div>
              <FormField label="Nom" htmlFor={`${uid}-name`}>
                <Input
                  id={`${uid}-name`}
                  value={newName}
                  maxLength={BOUNDS.name}
                  disabled={pending}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                />
              </FormField>
              <FormField label="Email" htmlFor={`${uid}-email`}>
                <Input
                  id={`${uid}-email`}
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  maxLength={254}
                  value={newEmail}
                  disabled={pending}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewEmail(e.target.value)}
                />
              </FormField>
              <FormField label="Téléphone" htmlFor={`${uid}-phone`} optional>
                <Input
                  id={`${uid}-phone`}
                  type="tel"
                  maxLength={BOUNDS.phone}
                  value={newPhone}
                  disabled={pending}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewPhone(e.target.value)}
                />
              </FormField>
            </div>
          )}

          {optionsLoading && (
            <p role="status" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />
              Recherche des tickets…
            </p>
          )}
          <FormError message={optionsFailure} />
          <FormError message={alreadyBooked ? "Ce client est déjà inscrit à cette séance." : null} />

          {client !== null && !optionsLoading && optionsFailure === null && (
            <>
              <fieldset className="space-y-2">
                <legend className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Couverture</legend>
                {mode === "tickets" && client.kind === "existing" && !hasTickets && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {"Ce client n'a aucun ticket utilisable ici. "}
                    <Link
                      href={`/dashboard/clients/${client.id}`}
                      className="font-medium text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
                    >
                      Ouvrir sa fiche
                    </Link>
                    {" pour lui offrir ou convertir un ticket."}
                  </p>
                )}
                {available.map((c) => (
                  <label key={c} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
                    <input
                      type="radio"
                      name={`${uid}-coverage`}
                      checked={choice === c}
                      disabled={pending}
                      onChange={() => setPicked(c)}
                      className="mt-0.5 size-4 accent-primary"
                    />
                    <span>{CHOICE_LABELS[mode][c]}</span>
                  </label>
                ))}
                {choice === "specific" && (
                  <Select
                    aria-label="Ticket"
                    value={ticketId ?? ""}
                    disabled={pending}
                    onChange={(e) => setSpecificId(e.target.value)}
                  >
                    {usable.map((t) => (
                      <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                        {t.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </Select>
                )}
                {mode === "tickets" && client.kind === "new" && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{"Un nouveau client n'a pas encore de ticket."}</p>
                )}
                {mode === "none" && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Séance sans réservation en ligne : le client est inscrit comme invité.
                  </p>
                )}
              </fieldset>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={extraSeat}
                    disabled={pending}
                    onChange={(e) => setExtraSeat(e.target.checked)}
                    className="size-4 accent-primary"
                  />
                  +1 place
                </label>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Ajoute une place si la séance est complète.</p>
                {item.seatsShown === 0 && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-warning">
                    {"Séance complète. Cochez « +1 place » pour l'inscrire quand même."}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {item.questions.length > 0 && (
                <fieldset className="space-y-3">
                  <legend className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Réponses (facultatif)</legend>
                  {item.questions.map((q) => {
                    const id = `${uid}-q-${q.id}`;
                    const value = answers[q.id] ?? "";
                    const choices = q.type === "choice" ? (q.options ?? []) : ["Oui", "Non"];
                    return (
                      <FormField key={q.id} label={q.label} htmlFor={id}>
                        {q.type === "text" ? (
                          <Input
                            id={id}
                            value={value}
                            maxLength={BOUNDS.answer}
                            disabled={pending}
                            onChange={(e) => setAnswers((prev) => ({ ...prev, [q.id]: e.target.value }))}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <Select
                            id={id}
                            value={value}
                            disabled={pending}
                            onChange={(e) => setAnswers((prev) => ({ ...prev, [q.id]: e.target.value }))}
                          >
                            <option value="">Sans réponse</option>
                            {choices.map((o) => (
                              <option key={o} value={o}>
                                {o}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </Select>
                        )}
                      </FormField>
                    );
                  })}
                </fieldset>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          <FormError message={error} />

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-border pt-4">
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={pending}>
              Retour
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={!canSubmit}>
              {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
              Inscrire
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```ts
    assert.ok(res.ok, `${what}: ${JSON.stringify(res)}`);
  }

  function mustFail<T extends { ok: boolean }>(res: T, what: string): asserts res is Extract<T, { ok: false }> {

    return rows.sort((a, b) => a.startAt.getTime() - b.startAt.getTime());
  }

  async function checkInterval(db: Db, pro: TestPro): Promise<void> {

      ctx,

      new Date(),
    );
    must(allDay, "all-day time off");
    assert.equal(allDay.cancelledOccurrences, 0);
    assert.deepEqual(allDay.effects, []);
    const timed = await createTimeOffCore(

      ctx,
      { startDate: addDays(day, 10), endDate: addDays(day, 10), allDay: false, startMinute: 540, endMinute: 600, ...NONE },

    assert.equal(rows[0].endAt.getTime(), instantAt(addDays(day, 2), 0, pro.tz).getTime());
    assert.equal(rows[0].allDay, true);
    assert.equal(rows[0].reason, "Vacances");

    assert.equal(rows[1].endAt.getTime(), instantAt(addDays(day, 10), 600, pro.tz).getTime());
    assert.equal(rows[1].allDay, false);
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `src/lib/back-office/time-off-actions.ts`**

  Write the whole file:

  ```ts
  /**
   * Time off cores (spec § 7, E6c): the preview of the séances and RDVs a time off
   * would collide with, the creation with the pro's choice for the booked ones, and
   * the deletion. No server-only, no next/*: the "use server" wrappers live in
   * src/server/pro-planning.ts.
   */
  import { and, eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
  import { z } from "zod";

  import { createTimeOffWithConflicts, previewTimeOffConflicts } from "@/lib/booking/cancel";
  import { diffDays } from "@/lib/civil-date";
  import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
  import { occurrence, timeOff } from "@/lib/db/schema";
  import { dateKeySchema, idSchema } from "@/lib/tickets";
  import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
  import { buildTimeOffInterval } from "@/lib/timeoff";
  import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

  import { formatWhen } from "./format";
  import { actionFail, fromEngine, type ActionFail, type ActionResult, type CoreResult, type ProCtx } from "./result";

  export const timeOffFormSchema = z.object({
    startDate: dateKeySchema,
    endDate: dateKeySchema,
    allDay: z.boolean(),
    startMinute: z.number().int().min(0).max(1439).optional(),
    endMinute: z.number().int().min(1).max(1440).optional(),
    reason: z.string().trim().max(BOUNDS.note).optional(),
  });
  export type TimeOffForm = z.input<typeof timeOffFormSchema>;

  const createSchema = timeOffFormSchema.extend({
    seenOccurrenceIds: z.array(idSchema).max(500),
    cancelBooked: z.boolean(),
  });

  export type TimeOffConflictVM = {
    occurrenceId: string;
    kind: "seance" | "rdv";
    title: string;
    whenLabel: string;
    activeBookings: number;
  };

  export const TIME_OFF_TOO_LONG = "Une indisponibilité dure au plus un an.";
  /** A calendar year plus the leap day. */
  const MAX_DAYS = 366;

  type Interval = { startAt: Date; endAt: Date };

  /** The pro-tz instants of a parsed form, or the French reason they cannot be built. */
  function intervalOf(
    form: z.output<typeof timeOffFormSchema>,
    tz: string,
  ): { ok: true; interval: Interval } | ActionFail {
    let interval: Interval;
    try {
      interval = buildTimeOffInterval(form, tz);
    } catch (e) {
      return actionFail(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Entrée invalide.");
    }
    if (form.allDay && diffDays(form.startDate, form.endDate) + 1 > MAX_DAYS) return actionFail(TIME_OFF_TOO_LONG);
    return { ok: true, interval };
  }

  /** previewTimeOffConflicts plus the kind (séance or RDV, read from occurrence.event_id) and the French « when » label. */
  async function conflictsOf(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, interval: Interval, now: Date): Promise<TimeOffConflictVM[]> {
    const conflicts = await previewTimeOffConflicts(
      db,
      { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, startAt: interval.startAt, endAt: interval.endAt },
      now,
    );
    if (conflicts.length === 0) return [];
    const rows = await db
      .select({ id: occurrence.id, eventId: occurrence.eventId })
      .from(occurrence)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(occurrence.professionalId, ctx.professionalId),
          inArray(
            occurrence.id,
            conflicts.map((c) => c.occurrenceId),
          ),
        ),
      );
    const kindOf = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r.eventId === null ? "rdv" : "seance"] as const));
    return conflicts.map((c) => ({
      occurrenceId: c.occurrenceId,
      kind: kindOf.get(c.occurrenceId) ?? "seance",
      title: c.title,
      whenLabel: formatWhen(c.startsAt, c.endsAt, ctx.timezone),
      activeBookings: c.activeBookings,
    }));
  }

  /** E6c step 1: the séances and RDVs with registrants that this time off would overlap. */
  export async function previewTimeOffCore(
    db: Db,
    ctx: ProCtx,
    input: TimeOffForm,
    now: Date,
  ): Promise<ActionResult<{ conflicts: TimeOffConflictVM[] }>> {
    const parsed = parseFr(timeOffFormSchema, input);
    if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
    const built = intervalOf(parsed.data, ctx.timezone);
    if (!built.ok) return built;
    return { ok: true, conflicts: await conflictsOf(db, ctx, built.interval, now) };
  }

  /**
   * E6c step 2: creates the time off. `seenOccurrenceIds` is the list the pro looked at;
   * if a registration appeared or vanished since, the engine answers `stale` and the UI
   * previews again. `cancelBooked` cancels those séances (tickets given back).
   */
  export async function createTimeOffCore(
    db: Db,
    ctx: ProCtx,
    input: TimeOffForm & { seenOccurrenceIds: string[]; cancelBooked: boolean },
    now: Date,
  ): Promise<CoreResult<{ cancelledOccurrences: number }>> {
    const parsed = parseFr(createSchema, input);
    if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
    const built = intervalOf(parsed.data, ctx.timezone);
    if (!built.ok) return built;
    const res = await createTimeOffWithConflicts(
      db,
      {
        professionalId: ctx.professionalId,
        actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId,
        startAt: built.interval.startAt,
        endAt: built.interval.endAt,
        allDay: parsed.data.allDay,
        reason: parsed.data.reason ?? null,
        seenOccurrenceIds: parsed.data.seenOccurrenceIds,
        cancelBooked: parsed.data.cancelBooked,
      },
      now,
    );
    if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "timeOff");
    return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, cancelledOccurrences: res.cancelledOccurrences };
  }

  /** One statement, DELETE … WHERE id AND professional_id (ruling C4): another pro's id deletes nothing. */
  export async function deleteTimeOffCore(
    db: Db,
    ctx: ProCtx,
    input: { timeOffId: string },
    now: Date,
  ): Promise<CoreResult> {
    void now;
    const parsed = parseFr(z.object({ timeOffId: idSchema }), input);
    if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
    const deleted = await db
      .delete(timeOff)
      .where(and(eq(timeOff.id, parsed.data.timeOffId), eq(timeOff.professionalId, ctx.professionalId)))
      .returning({ id: timeOff.id });
    if (deleted.length === 0) return actionFail("Indisponibilité introuvable.");
    return { ok: true, effects: [] };
  }
  ```

  ```tsx
  "use client";

  import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
  import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
  import { timeOffConflictCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
  import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
  import type { TimeOffConflictVM } from "@/lib/back-office/time-off-actions";

  const noop = () => {};

  /** E6c: the time off overlaps séances or RDVs that have registrants; the pro cancels them or keeps them. */
  export function TimeOffConflictDialog({
    open,
    conflicts,
    pending,
    error,
    onCancelThem,
    onKeep,
    onClose,
  }: {
    open: boolean;
    conflicts: TimeOffConflictVM[];
    pending: boolean;
    error: string | null;
    onCancelThem: () => void;
    onKeep: () => void;
    onClose: () => void;
  }) {
    const copy = timeOffConflictCopy({ count: conflicts.length });
    const hasRdv = conflicts.some((c) => c.kind === "rdv");

    return (
      <Dialog open={open} onClose={pending ? noop : onClose} title={copy.title}>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm">{copy.intro}</p>
          <ul className="space-y-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/40 p-3 text-sm">
            {conflicts.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.occurrenceId}>
                {`${c.whenLabel} · ${c.title} · ${plural(c.activeBookings, "inscrit", "inscrits")}`}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {hasRdv && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{copy.rdvNote}</p>}
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{copy.keepNote}</p>
          <FormError message={error} />
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="destructive"
              onClick={onCancelThem}
              disabled={pending}
              className="h-auto w-full whitespace-normal py-2 text-center"
            >
              {copy.cancelLabel}
            </Button>
            <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={onKeep} disabled={pending} className="w-full">
              {copy.keepLabel}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Dialog>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```tsx
  import { Switch } from "@/components/dashboard/switch";
  import { TimeOffConflictDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/time-off-conflict-dialog";
  import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
  import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
  import { deleteTimeOffCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
  import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
  import type { TimeOffConflictVM, TimeOffForm } from "@/lib/back-office/time-off-actions";
  import {
    addDays,
    addMonthsClamped,
    daysInMonth,
    diffDays,
    makeKey,
    mondayOf,
    parseKey,
    type DateKey,
  } from "@/lib/civil-date";
  import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
  import { createTimeOffAction, deleteTimeOffAction, previewTimeOffAction } from "@/server/pro-planning";

  const WEEKDAYS = ["Lun", "Mar", "Mer", "Jeu", "Ven", "Sam", "Dim"];
  const MONTH_FORMAT = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fr-FR", { month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });

  export interface TimeOffEntry {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    allDay: boolean;
    reason: string | null;
  }

  /** The conflicts the pro is looking at, with the exact form they were computed for. */
  type Review = { form: TimeOffForm; conflicts: TimeOffConflictVM[] };

  /** "09:00" to minutes from midnight; null for an empty or malformed field. */
  function parseTime(value: string): number | null {
    const match = /^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(value);
    if (!match) return null;
    const hours = Number(match[1]);
    const minutes = Number(match[2]);
    if (hours > 23 || minutes > 59) return null;
    return hours * 60 + minutes;
  }

  /** First day of the month of `key`. */
  function monthOf(key: DateKey): DateKey {
    const { y, m } = parseKey(key);
    return makeKey(y, m, 1);
  }

  /** The Monday-first weeks that cover the month of `month`, as a flat list of days. */
  function monthDays(month: DateKey): DateKey[] {
    const { y, m } = parseKey(month);
    const start = mondayOf(makeKey(y, m, 1));
    const end = addDays(mondayOf(makeKey(y, m, daysInMonth(y, m))), 6);
    return Array.from({ length: diffDays(start, end) + 1 }, (_, i) => addDays(start, i));
  }

  export function UnavailabilityManager({
    markedDays,
    entries,
    todayKey,
  }: {
    markedDays: DateKey[];
    entries: TimeOffEntry[];
    todayKey: DateKey;
  }) {
    const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [viewMonth, setViewMonth] = useState<DateKey>(() => monthOf(todayKey));
    const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState<DateKey>(todayKey);
    const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState<DateKey>(todayKey);
    const [allDay, setAllDay] = useState(true);
    const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState("09:00");
    const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState("17:00");
    const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
    const [review, setReview] = useState<Review | null>(null);
    const [reviewError, setReviewError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [toDelete, setToDelete] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const marked = useMemo(() => new Set(markedDays), [markedDays]);
    const grid = useMemo(() => monthDays(viewMonth), [viewMonth]);

    function pickDay(day: DateKey) {
      setStartDate(day);
      // keep the range coherent: bump the end date when it is now before the start
      setEndDate((prev) => (prev < day ? day : prev));
      setError(null);
    }

    function formOf(): TimeOffForm | null {
      const trimmed = reason.trim();
      const note = trimmed === "" ? undefined : trimmed;
      if (allDay) return { startDate, endDate, allDay: true, reason: note };
      const startMinute = parseTime(startTime);
      const endMinute = parseTime(endTime);
      if (startMinute === null || endMinute === null) return null;
      return { startDate, endDate: startDate, allDay: false, startMinute, endMinute, reason: note };
    }

    /** After a `stale` answer: ask the engine again and keep the dialog open on the new list. */
    async function reviewAgain(form: TimeOffForm, message: string) {
      const preview = await previewTimeOffAction(form);
      if (!preview.ok) {
        setReview(null);
        setError(preview.error);
        return;
      }
      if (preview.conflicts.length === 0) {
        setReview(null);
        setError(message);
        return;
      }
      setReview({ form, conflicts: preview.conflicts });
      setReviewError(message);
    }

    function submit() {
      setError(null);
      setNotice(null);
      const form = formOf();
      if (form === null) {
        setError("Indiquez l'heure de début et l'heure de fin.");
        return;
      }
      startTransition(async () => {
        const preview = await previewTimeOffAction(form);
        if (!preview.ok) {
          setError(preview.error);
          return;
        }
        if (preview.conflicts.length > 0) {
          setReviewError(null);
          setReview({ form, conflicts: preview.conflicts });
          return;
        }
        const res = await createTimeOffAction({ ...form, seenOccurrenceIds: [], cancelBooked: false });
        if (!res.ok) {
          if (res.code === "stale") await reviewAgain(form, res.error);
          else setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setReason("");
        setNotice("Indisponibilité ajoutée.");
      });
    }

    function resolve(cancelBooked: boolean) {
      if (review === null) return;
      const { form, conflicts } = review;
      setReviewError(null);
      startTransition(async () => {
        const res = await createTimeOffAction({
          ...form,
          seenOccurrenceIds: conflicts.map((c) => c.occurrenceId),
          cancelBooked,
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          setReview(null);
          setReason("");
          setNotice(
            res.cancelledOccurrences > 0
              ? `Indisponibilité ajoutée. ${plural(res.cancelledOccurrences, "séance annulée", "séances annulées")}.`
              : "Indisponibilité ajoutée.",
          );
          return;
        }
        if (res.code === "stale") {
          await reviewAgain(form, res.error);
          return;
        }
        setReviewError(res.error);
      });
    }

    function confirmDelete() {
      if (toDelete === null) return;
      const timeOffId = toDelete;
      setDeleteError(null);
      startTransition(async () => {
        const res = await deleteTimeOffAction({ timeOffId });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setDeleteError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setToDelete(null);
        setNotice("Indisponibilité supprimée.");
      });
    }

    return (
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
        {/* Calendar */}
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="icon"
                aria-label="Mois précédent"
                onClick={() => setViewMonth((m) => addMonthsClamped(m, -1))}
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
              </Button>
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold capitalize">
                {MONTH_FORMAT.format(new Date(`${viewMonth.slice(0, 7)}-01T12:00:00Z`))}
              </span>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="icon"
                aria-label="Mois suivant"
                onClick={() => setViewMonth((m) => addMonthsClamped(m, 1))}
              >
                <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {WEEKDAYS.map((d) => (
                <div key={d} className="py-1">
                  {d}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-1 grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
              {grid.map((day) => {
                const inMonth = day.slice(0, 7) === viewMonth.slice(0, 7);
                const past = day < todayKey;
                const isMarked = marked.has(day);
                const selected = day === startDate;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={day}
                    type="button"
                    disabled={past}
                    aria-pressed={selected}
                    onClick={() => pickDay(day)}
                    className={cn(
                      "aspect-square rounded-lg text-sm transition-colors",
                      !inMonth && "text-muted-foreground/40",
                      past && "cursor-not-allowed opacity-40",
                      isMarked && "bg-primary text-primary-foreground",
                      !isMarked && !past && "hover:bg-muted",
                      selected && !isMarked && "ring-2 ring-primary",
                    )}
                  >
                    {parseKey(day).d}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="inline-block size-3 rounded bg-primary" />
              Jour avec indisponibilité
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Add form + list */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <Card>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <form
                noValidate
                onSubmit={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  submit();
                }}
                className="space-y-4"
              >
                <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">Ajouter une indisponibilité</h2>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <FormField label="Du" htmlFor="timeoff-start">
                    <Input
                      id="timeoff-start"
                      type="date"
                      value={startDate}
                      min={todayKey}
                      disabled={pending}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const value = e.target.value;
                        setStartDate(value);
                        setEndDate((prev) => (prev < value ? value : prev));
                      }}
                    />
                  </FormField>
                  <FormField label="Au" htmlFor="timeoff-end">
                    <Input
                      id="timeoff-end"
                      type="date"
                      value={endDate}
                      min={startDate}
                      disabled={!allDay || pending}
                      onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
                    />
                  </FormField>
                </div>

                <Switch
                  id="timeoff-allday"
                  checked={allDay}
                  onCheckedChange={setAllDay}
                  label="Toute la journée"
                  disabled={pending}
                />

                {!allDay && (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <FormField label="Début" htmlFor="timeoff-stime">
                      <Input
                        id="timeoff-stime"
                        type="time"
                        value={startTime}
                        disabled={pending}
                        onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                      />
                    </FormField>
                    <FormField label="Fin" htmlFor="timeoff-etime">
                      <Input
                        id="timeoff-etime"
                        type="time"
                        value={endTime}
                        disabled={pending}
                        onChange={(e) => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
                      />
                    </FormField>
                  </div>
                )}

                <FormField label="Motif" htmlFor="timeoff-reason" optional>
                  <Input
                    id="timeoff-reason"
                    value={reason}
                    disabled={pending}
                    onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </FormField>

                <FormError message={error} />
                {notice !== null && (
                  <p role="status" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-foreground">
                    <CircleCheck className="size-4 shrink-0 text-success" aria-hidden="true" />
                    {notice}
                  </p>
                )}

                <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
                  {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Plus className="size-4" />}
                  Ajouter
                </Button>
              </form>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <h2 className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold">À venir</h2>
              {entries.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucune indisponibilité programmée.</p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="space-y-2">
                  {entries.map((e) => (
                    <li
                      key={e.id}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2"
                    >
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium capitalize">{e.label}</p>
                        {e.reason && <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{e.reason}</p>}
                      </div>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        aria-label="Supprimer cette indisponibilité"
                        disabled={pending}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setDeleteError(null);
                          setToDelete(e.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="size-4" />
                      </Button>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        <TimeOffConflictDialog
          open={review !== null}
          conflicts={review?.conflicts ?? []}
          pending={pending}
          error={reviewError}
          onCancelThem={() => resolve(true)}
          onKeep={() => resolve(false)}
          onClose={() => {
            setReview(null);
            setReviewError(null);
          }}
        />
        <ConfirmDialog
          open={toDelete !== null}
          copy={deleteTimeOffCopy()}
          pending={pending}
          error={deleteError}
          onConfirm={confirmDelete}
          onClose={() => {
            setToDelete(null);
            setDeleteError(null);
          }}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 9: Replace the page and add the loading state**

  Write the whole file `src/app/dashboard/unavailability/page.tsx` (the hour range uses `formatTimeRange`, which has no en dash, and the day comes from the pro time zone):

  ```tsx
  import type { Metadata } from "next";

  import { PageHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/page-header";
  import {
    UnavailabilityManager,
    type TimeOffEntry,
  } from "@/components/dashboard/unavailability-manager";
  import { formatTimeRange } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
  import { todayKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
  import { dayKeyInTz, formatDateLong } from "@/lib/datetime";
  import { getCurrentProfessional } from "@/lib/session";
  import { coveredDayKeys } from "@/lib/timeoff";
  import { getProTimeOff } from "@/server/queries";

  export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Indisponibilités" };

  export default async function UnavailabilityPage() {
    const pro = (await getCurrentProfessional())!;
    const tz = pro.timezone;
    const rows = await getProTimeOff(pro.id);

    const markedDays = [
      ...new Set(rows.flatMap((r) => coveredDayKeys(r.startAt, r.endAt, tz))),
    ];

    const entries: TimeOffEntry[] = rows.map((r) => {
      let label: string;
      if (r.allDay) {
        const last = new Date(r.endAt.getTime() - 1); // exclusive end → inclusive last day
        const startKey = dayKeyInTz(r.startAt, tz);
        const lastKey = dayKeyInTz(last, tz);
        label =
          startKey === lastKey
            ? formatDateLong(r.startAt, tz)
            : `${formatDateLong(r.startAt, tz)} → ${formatDateLong(last, tz)}`;
      } else {
        label = `${formatDateLong(r.startAt, tz)} · ${formatTimeRange(r.startAt, r.endAt, tz)}`;
      }
      return { id: r.id, label, allDay: r.allDay, reason: r.reason };
    });

    return (
      <>
        <PageHeader
          title="Indisponibilités"
          description={`Bloquez des journées ou des plages horaires (fuseau ${tz}). Ces créneaux n'apparaîtront pas pour vos clients.`}
        />
        <UnavailabilityManager
          markedDays={markedDays}
          entries={entries}
          todayKey={todayKey(new Date(), tz)}
        />
      </>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```ts
  import assert from "node:assert/strict";
  import { and, eq, isNull } from "drizzle-orm";

  import { createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, type Db } from "../../test/db";
  import { makeType } from "../../test/fixtures";
  import { proCtx } from "../../test/pro-ctx";
  import { setAvailabilityRules } from "../booking/catalog";
  import { availabilityRule, professional } from "../db/schema";
  import { NOTICE_TOO_LONG } from "./notice";
  import { saveAvailabilityCore, updateBookingSettingsCore } from "./settings-actions";

  const OK = { ok: true, effects: [] } as const;

  async function rowOf(db: Db, proId: string) {
    const [row] = await db.select().from(professional).where(eq(professional.id, proId));
    return row;
  }

  const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = { bookingHorizonDays: 60, minNoticeMinutes: 60, cancelDeadlineHours: 24 };

  async function settingsOf(db: Db, proId: string) {
    const row = await rowOf(db, proId);
    return {
      bookingHorizonDays: row.bookingHorizonDays,
      minNoticeMinutes: row.minNoticeMinutes,
      cancelDeadlineHours: row.cancelDeadlineHours,
    };
  }

  /** [dayOfWeek, startMinute, endMinute] of the global hours (typeId null) or of one type's hours, sorted. */
  async function hoursOf(db: Db, proId: string, typeId: string | null): Promise<number[][]> {
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(availabilityRule)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(availabilityRule.professionalId, proId),
          typeId === null ? isNull(availabilityRule.ticketTypeId) : eq(availabilityRule.ticketTypeId, typeId),
        ),
      );
    return rows
      .map((r) => [r.dayOfWeek, r.startMinute, r.endMinute])
      .sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]);
  }

  dbTest("updateBookingSettingsCore saves the three settings of the acting pro only", async ({ db, pro }) => {
    const now = new Date();
    const other = await createTestPro(db);
    try {
      assert.deepEqual(await settingsOf(db, pro.proId), DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
      assert.deepEqual(
        await updateBookingSettingsCore(db, proCtx(pro), { bookingHorizonDays: 90, minNoticeMinutes: 1440, cancelDeadlineHours: 12 }, now),
        OK,
      );
      assert.deepEqual(await settingsOf(db, pro.proId), { bookingHorizonDays: 90, minNoticeMinutes: 1440, cancelDeadlineHours: 12 });
      assert.deepEqual(await settingsOf(db, other.proId), DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "the other pro is untouched");

      // a notice of exactly the horizon is allowed (3 days = 4320 minutes)
      assert.deepEqual(
        await updateBookingSettingsCore(db, proCtx(pro), { bookingHorizonDays: 3, minNoticeMinutes: 4320, cancelDeadlineHours: 0 }, now),
        OK,
      );
      assert.deepEqual(await settingsOf(db, pro.proId), { bookingHorizonDays: 3, minNoticeMinutes: 4320, cancelDeadlineHours: 0 });
    } finally {
      await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
    }
  });

  dbTest("a notice longer than the horizon is refused with NOTICE_TOO_LONG and nothing is written", async ({ db, pro }) => {
    const now = new Date();
    const before = await settingsOf(db, pro.proId);
    const sevenDaysOneDay = { bookingHorizonDays: 1, minNoticeMinutes: 10080, cancelDeadlineHours: 24 };
    assert.deepEqual(await updateBookingSettingsCore(db, proCtx(pro), sevenDaysOneDay, now), { ok: false, error: NOTICE_TOO_LONG });
    // one minute over a one-day horizon
    assert.deepEqual(
      await updateBookingSettingsCore(db, proCtx(pro), { bookingHorizonDays: 1, minNoticeMinutes: 1441, cancelDeadlineHours: 24 }, now),
      { ok: false, error: NOTICE_TOO_LONG },
    );
    assert.deepEqual(await settingsOf(db, pro.proId), before);
  });

  dbTest("booking settings out of bounds speak French and write nothing", async ({ db, pro }) => {
    const now = new Date();
    const before = await settingsOf(db, pro.proId);
    const cases: [typeof DEFAULT_SETTINGS, string][] = [
      [{ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, bookingHorizonDays: 400 }, "Réservable jusqu'à : maximum 365."],
      [{ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, bookingHorizonDays: 0 }, "Réservable jusqu'à : minimum 1."],
      [{ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, bookingHorizonDays: Number.NaN }, "Réservable jusqu'à : indiquez un nombre."],
      [{ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, cancelDeadlineHours: 721 }, "Annulation par le client : maximum 720."],
    ];
    for (const [settings, error] of cases) {
      assert.deepEqual(await updateBookingSettingsCore(db, proCtx(pro), settings, now), { ok: false, error }, error);
    }
    assert.deepEqual(await settingsOf(db, pro.proId), before);
  });

  dbTest("saveAvailabilityCore replaces the global hours and leaves a type's hours and another pro's alone", async ({ db, pro }) => {
    const now = new Date();
    const typeId = await makeType(db, pro);
    const seeded = await setAvailabilityRules(db, {
      professionalId: pro.proId,
      ticketTypeId: typeId,
      rules: [{ dayOfWeek: 2, startMinute: 600, endMinute: 720 }],
    });
    assert.equal(seeded.ok, true);
    const globalSeeded = await setAvailabilityRules(db, {
      professionalId: pro.proId,
      ticketTypeId: null,
      rules: [
        { dayOfWeek: 1, startMinute: 540, endMinute: 1020 },
        { dayOfWeek: 3, startMinute: 540, endMinute: 1020 },
      ],
    });
    assert.equal(globalSeeded.ok, true);

    const other = await createTestPro(db);
    try {
      const otherSeeded = await setAvailabilityRules(db, {
        professionalId: other.proId,
        ticketTypeId: null,
        rules: [{ dayOfWeek: 4, startMinute: 480, endMinute: 600 }],
      });
      assert.equal(otherSeeded.ok, true);

      const replaced = await saveAvailabilityCore(
        db,
        proCtx(pro),
        {
          rules: [
            { dayOfWeek: 5, startMinute: 480, endMinute: 720 },
            { dayOfWeek: 5, startMinute: 840, endMinute: 1080 },
          ],
        },
        now,
      );
      assert.deepEqual(replaced, OK);
      assert.deepEqual(await hoursOf(db, pro.proId, null), [
        [5, 480, 720],
        [5, 840, 1080],
      ]);
      assert.deepEqual(await hoursOf(db, pro.proId, typeId), [[2, 600, 720]], "the type's own hours are untouched");
      assert.deepEqual(await hoursOf(db, other.proId, null), [[4, 480, 600]], "the other pro's hours are untouched");

      // an empty list closes every day of the global hours, still without touching the type's
      assert.deepEqual(await saveAvailabilityCore(db, proCtx(pro), { rules: [] }, now), OK);
      assert.deepEqual(await hoursOf(db, pro.proId, null), []);
      assert.deepEqual(await hoursOf(db, pro.proId, typeId), [[2, 600, 720]]);
      assert.deepEqual(await hoursOf(db, other.proId, null), [[4, 480, 600]]);
    } finally {
      await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
    }
  });

  dbTest("saveAvailabilityCore refuses an inverted or empty range with « Plage horaire invalide. » and keeps the old hours", async ({ db, pro }) => {
    const now = new Date();
    const seeded = await setAvailabilityRules(db, {
      professionalId: pro.proId,
      ticketTypeId: null,
      rules: [{ dayOfWeek: 1, startMinute: 540, endMinute: 1020 }],
    });
    assert.equal(seeded.ok, true);
    const invalid = { ok: false, error: "Plage horaire invalide." };

    assert.deepEqual(
      await saveAvailabilityCore(db, proCtx(pro), { rules: [{ dayOfWeek: 2, startMinute: 600, endMinute: 540 }] }, now),
      invalid,
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      await saveAvailabilityCore(db, proCtx(pro), { rules: [{ dayOfWeek: 2, startMinute: 600, endMinute: 600 }] }, now),
      invalid,
    );
    assert.deepEqual(await hoursOf(db, pro.proId, null), [[1, 540, 1020]]);
  });
  ```

  ```ts
  import { NOTICE_TOO_LONG, noticeExceedsHorizon } from "@/lib/back-office/notice";
  import { setAvailabilityRules, updateBookingSettings } from "@/lib/booking/catalog";
  import {
    availabilityRuleInputSchema,

    type AvailabilityRuleInput,
    type BookingSettings,
  } from "@/lib/tickets";
  ```

  Edit 2 (the cores, after `updateProfileCore`).

  ```ts
    if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(failOf(res), "profile");
    return { ok: true, effects: [] };
  ```

  New:
  ```ts
    if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(failOf(res), "profile");
    return { ok: true, effects: [] };
  }

  /* ───────────── Réservations and global RDV hours (Task 29) ───────────── */

  /**
   * Booking window and client cancellation deadline (spec § 7). parseFr first, so the
   * bounds speak French (« Réservable jusqu'à : maximum 365. »), then a notice longer
   * than the horizon is refused: online booking would never open (OUT L106).
   * Context "settings".
   */
  export async function updateBookingSettingsCore(
    db: Db,
    ctx: ProCtx,
    input: BookingSettings,
    now: Date,
  ): Promise<CoreResult> {
    const parsed = parseFr(bookingSettingsSchema, input);
    if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
    const settings = parsed.data;
    if (noticeExceedsHorizon(settings.minNoticeMinutes, settings.bookingHorizonDays)) {
      return actionFail(NOTICE_TOO_LONG);
    }
    const res = await updateBookingSettings(db, { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, settings }, now);
    if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "settings");
    return { ok: true, effects: res.effects };
  }

  const globalHoursSchema = z.object({ rules: z.array(availabilityRuleInputSchema).max(168) });

  /**
   * The global RDV hours (ticketTypeId null), replaced in one engine batch: the hours of
   * a ticket type are untouched, an empty list closes every day. An inverted range is
   * « Plage horaire invalide. » (the schema's own message). Context "settings".
   */
  export async function saveAvailabilityCore(
    db: Db,
    ctx: ProCtx,
    input: { rules: AvailabilityRuleInput[] },
    now: Date,
  ): Promise<CoreResult> {
    const parsed = parseFr(globalHoursSchema, input);
    if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
    const res = await setAvailabilityRules(
      db,
      { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, ticketTypeId: null, rules: parsed.data.rules },
      now,
    );
    if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "settings");
    return { ok: true, effects: res.effects };
  }
  ```

  ```ts
  /* ───────────────────────────── Availability ────────────────────── */

  /** Replaces the pro's global weekly hours (rules of a ticket type are untouched). */
  export async function saveAvailability(
    rules: { dayOfWeek: number; startMinute: number; endMinute: number }[],
  ): Promise<void> {
    const pro = await requirePro();
    // Rows the DB CHECKs would refuse are dropped, like the old `end > start` filter.
    const valid = rules.flatMap((r) => {
      const parsed = availabilityRuleInputSchema.safeParse(r);
      return parsed.success ? [parsed.data] : [];
    });
    const clear = db
      .delete(availabilityRule)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(availabilityRule.professionalId, pro.id),
          isNull(availabilityRule.ticketTypeId),
        ),
      );
    if (valid.length > 0) {
      // One batch = one transaction: the old hours never vanish without the new ones.
      await db.batch([
        clear,
        db
          .insert(availabilityRule)
          .values(valid.map((r) => ({ ...r, professionalId: pro.id }))),
      ]);
    } else {
      await clear;
    }
    revalidatePath("/dashboard/availability");
    revalidatePath(`/${pro.slug}`);
  }
  ```

  ```ts
    return runProAction(

      { publicPage: true },
  ```

  ```ts
  /** What the settings page needs beyond the professional row: the time-zone lock and the booking settings. */
  export async function getSettingsExtras(
    professionalId: string,
  ): Promise<{ timezoneLocked: boolean; bookingSettings: BookingSettings }> {
    const [timezoneLocked, [row]] = await Promise.all([
      isTimezoneLocked(db, professionalId, new Date()),
      db
        .select({
          bookingHorizonDays: professional.bookingHorizonDays,
          minNoticeMinutes: professional.minNoticeMinutes,
          cancelDeadlineHours: professional.cancelDeadlineHours,
        })
        .from(professional)
        .where(eq(professional.id, professionalId)),
    ]);
    return { timezoneLocked, bookingSettings: row };
  }
  ```

  ```tsx
  "use client";

  import { useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
  import { Check, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

  import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
  import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
  import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
  import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
  import { NOTICE_PRESETS, noticeLabel } from "@/lib/back-office/notice";
  import type { BookingSettings } from "@/lib/tickets";
  import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
  import { updateBookingSettingsAction } from "@/server/pro";

  /** An empty field is sent as NaN so the server answers « Indiquez un nombre. » instead of a silent 0. */
  function toNumber(value: string): number {
    return value.trim() === "" ? Number.NaN : Number(value);
  }

  /** « Réservations »: how far ahead, how late and how long before the start a client may book and cancel. */
  export function BookingSettingsForm({ initial }: { initial: BookingSettings }) {
    const uid = useId();
    const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
    const [horizon, setHorizon] = useState(String(initial.bookingHorizonDays));
    const [notice, setNotice] = useState(initial.minNoticeMinutes);
    const [deadline, setDeadline] = useState(String(initial.cancelDeadlineHours));

    // a value saved before the presets existed (« 45 min avant ») stays selectable
    const noticeOptions = NOTICE_PRESETS.some((p) => p.minutes === initial.minNoticeMinutes)
      ? NOTICE_PRESETS
      : [...NOTICE_PRESETS, { minutes: initial.minNoticeMinutes, label: noticeLabel(initial.minNoticeMinutes) }].sort(
          (a, b) => a.minutes - b.minutes,
        );

    function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
      e.preventDefault();
      setError(null);
      setSaved(false);
      startTransition(async () => {
        const res = await updateBookingSettingsAction({
          bookingHorizonDays: toNumber(horizon),
          minNoticeMinutes: notice,
          cancelDeadlineHours: toNumber(deadline),
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setSaved(true);
      });
    }

    return (
      <form noValidate onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-5">
        <FormField
          label="Réservable jusqu'à"
          htmlFor={`${uid}-horizon`}
          help="Au-delà, vos séances ne sont pas encore ouvertes aux réservations."
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Input
              id={`${uid}-horizon`}
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min={BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.min}
              max={BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.max}
              value={horizon}
              disabled={pending}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setHorizon(e.target.value);
                setSaved(false);
              }}
              className="w-28"
            />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{"jours à l'avance"}</span>
          </div>
        </FormField>

        <FormField
          label="Au plus tard"
          htmlFor={`${uid}-notice`}
          help="Passé ce délai, la séance affiche « Réservations fermées » en ligne. Vous pouvez toujours inscrire quelqu'un vous-même."
        >
          <Select
            id={`${uid}-notice`}
            value={notice}
            disabled={pending}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setNotice(Number(e.target.value));
              setSaved(false);
            }}
          >
            {noticeOptions.map((p) => (
              <option key={p.minutes} value={p.minutes}>
                {p.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </FormField>

        <FormField
          label="Annulation par le client jusqu'à"
          htmlFor={`${uid}-deadline`}
          help="Passé ce délai, vous seul pouvez annuler. Un client garde ce droit jusqu'au début si vous avez changé l'horaire ou l'avez déplacé."
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Input
              id={`${uid}-deadline`}
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min={BOUNDS.cancelDeadlineHours.min}
              max={BOUNDS.cancelDeadlineHours.max}
              value={deadline}
              disabled={pending}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setDeadline(e.target.value);
                setSaved(false);
              }}
              className="w-28"
            />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">heures avant le début</span>
          </div>
        </FormField>

        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Chaque événement et chaque type en RDV libre peut avoir ses propres règles.
        </p>

        <FormError message={error} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
            {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
            Enregistrer les réglages
          </Button>
          {saved && (
            <span role="status" className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-foreground">
              <Check className="size-4 text-success" aria-hidden="true" />
              Enregistré
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </form>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```tsx
  "use client";

  import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
  import { Check, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

  import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
  import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  import { saveAvailabilityAction } from "@/server/pro";
  import {
    WeeklyHoursEditor,
    byDayFromRules,
    rulesFromByDay,
    type ByDay,
  } from "./weekly-hours-editor";

  export function AvailabilityEditor({
    initial,
  }: {
    initial: { dayOfWeek: number; startMinute: number; endMinute: number }[];
  }) {
    const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
    const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [byDay, setByDay] = useState<ByDay>(() => byDayFromRules(initial));

    function save() {
      const rules = rulesFromByDay(byDay);
      setError(null);
      setSaved(false);
      startTransition(async () => {
        const res = await saveAvailabilityAction(rules);
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setSaved(true);
      });
    }

    return (
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <WeeklyHoursEditor
          value={byDay}
          onChange={(next) => {
            setByDay(next);
            setSaved(false);
            setError(null);
          }}
        />
        <FormError message={error} />
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2">
          <Button onClick={save} disabled={pending}>
            {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
            Enregistrer les disponibilités
          </Button>
          {saved && (
            <span role="status" className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-foreground">
              <Check className="size-4 text-success" aria-hidden="true" />
              Enregistré
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  ```

```ts
// src/lib/back-office/wallet-view.ts
export type WalletTicketRow = {
  id: string; ticketTypeId: string; status: TicketStatus; expiresAt: Date | null; purchaseId: string | null;
  closedReason: TicketCloseReason | null; closedNote: string | null; statusChangedAt: Date; createdAt: Date;
  bookingStartsAt: Date | null;
};
export type WalletTypeRow = { id: string; name: string; color: string; archived: boolean };
export type WalletTicketView = { id: string; origin: "Acheté" | "Offert"; line: string; tone: "ok" | "red" | "muted"; struck: boolean };
export type WalletGroup = {
  ticketTypeId: string; name: string; color: string; archived: boolean; alert: AlertTone | null;
  usableCount: number; expirySummary: string[];
  usable: WalletTicketView[]; booked: WalletTicketView[]; expired: WalletTicketView[]; done: WalletTicketView[];
  ids: { point: string[]; convert: string[]; closePaid: string[]; closeAny: string[]; retire: string[]; unpoint: string[] };
};
export function groupWallet(tickets: readonly WalletTicketRow[], types: readonly WalletTypeRow[], classes: ReadonlyMap<string, TypeClass>, now: Date, tz: string): WalletGroup[];

// src/lib/back-office/history.ts
export type LedgerMovementRow = {
  seq: number; actionId: string; kind: MovementKind; ticketTypeId: string; fromTicketTypeId: string | null; actor: Actor;
  reason: string | null; createdAt: Date; closedReason: TicketCloseReason | null;
  occurrence: { title: string; startsAt: Date } | null;
};
export type HistoryLine = { key: string; text: string };
export const UNKNOWN_TYPE = "type supprimé";
export function historyLines(rows: readonly LedgerMovementRow[], typeNames: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, tz: string): HistoryLine[];

// src/lib/back-office/client-filters.ts
export const CLIENT_FILTERS = ["tous", "tickets", "a-venir", "alertes"] as const;
export type ClientFilter = (typeof CLIENT_FILTERS)[number];
export const CLIENT_FILTER_LABELS: Record<ClientFilter, string>;
export function parseClientFilter(value: unknown): ClientFilter;
export type ClientFacts = {
  usableTickets: number; upcomingConfirmed: number; red: boolean; orange: boolean;
  confirmedBookings: number; ticketsAny: number; bookingsAny: number; purchasesAny: number;
};
export function isClient(f: Pick<ClientFacts, "confirmedBookings" | "ticketsAny">): boolean;
export function isListedClient(f: ClientFacts): boolean;
export function matchesClientFilter(f: ClientFacts, filter: ClientFilter): boolean;
export function clientsHref(filter: ClientFilter, q: string): string;

// src/lib/back-office/dashboard-view.ts

  upcomingSeances7d: number; upcomingRegistrants7d: number; ticketsInCirculation: number; clients: number;
  revenue: readonly { currency: string; cents: number }[]; currency: string;
};
export type KpiTile = { key: "seances" | "tickets" | "clients" | "revenue"; label: string; value: string; hint: string | null; href: string };
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { instantAt } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { classifyTypes } from "@/lib/wallet-rules";

import {
  groupWallet,
  type WalletGroup,
  type WalletTicketRow,
  type WalletTicketView,
  type WalletTypeRow,
} from "./wallet-view";

const PARIS = "Europe/Paris";
const LA = "America/Los_Angeles";
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-14T10:00:00Z"); // Paris 12:00 (CEST), Los Angeles 03:00 (PDT)
const T0 = new Date("2026-09-01T08:00:00Z");
const DASHES = /[\u2013\u2014]/;

const TYPES: WalletTypeRow[] = [
  { id: "coll", name: "Cours collectif", color: "#6366f1", archived: false },
  { id: "priv", name: "Cours particulier", color: "#0ea5e9", archived: false },
  { id: "stage", name: "Stage d'été 2026", color: "#f59e0b", archived: true },
  { id: "plein", name: "Cours en plein air", color: "#22c55e", archived: false },
];

const CLASSES = classifyTypes([
  { ticketTypeId: "coll", archived: false, rdvEnabled: false, linkedToUpcomingEvent: true },
  { ticketTypeId: "priv", archived: false, rdvEnabled: false, linkedToUpcomingEvent: true },
  { ticketTypeId: "stage", archived: true, rdvEnabled: false, linkedToUpcomingEvent: false },
  { ticketTypeId: "plein", archived: false, rdvEnabled: false, linkedToUpcomingEvent: false },
]);

const row = (id: string, over: Partial<WalletTicketRow> = {}): WalletTicketRow => ({
  id,
  ticketTypeId: "coll",
  status: "available",
  expiresAt: null,
  purchaseId: null,
  closedReason: null,
  closedNote: null,
  statusChangedAt: T0,
  createdAt: T0,
  bookingStartsAt: null,
  ...over,
});

function groupOf(groups: WalletGroup[], ticketTypeId: string): WalletGroup {
  const group = groups.find((g) => g.ticketTypeId === ticketTypeId);
  assert.ok(group, `group ${ticketTypeId} expected`);
  return group;
}

const lines = (views: readonly WalletTicketView[]) => views.map((v) => [v.id, v.line]);

/** Every bucket at once, Paris wall clock, NOW = 2026-10-14. */
function bigWallet(): WalletTicketRow[] {
  return [
    row("u1", { purchaseId: "p1", expiresAt: instantAt("2026-12-01", 0, PARIS) }),
    row("u2"),
    row("b1", { status: "booked", bookingStartsAt: new Date("2026-10-20T17:00:00Z") }),
    row("d1", { status: "booked", bookingStartsAt: new Date("2026-10-10T17:00:00Z") }),
    row("e1", { expiresAt: instantAt("2026-10-02", 0, PARIS) }),
    row("e2", { status: "expired", expiresAt: instantAt("2026-10-02", 0, PARIS) }),
    row("p1", { status: "used", statusChangedAt: new Date("2026-10-05T08:00:00Z") }),
    row("c1", {
      status: "closed",
      closedReason: "retire",
      closedNote: "cadeau en double",
      statusChangedAt: new Date("2026-10-06T08:00:00Z"),
    }),
    row("c2", {
      status: "closed",
      closedReason: "rembourse",
      purchaseId: "p2",
      statusChangedAt: new Date("2026-10-07T08:00:00Z"),
    }),
    row("c3", {
      status: "closed",
      closedReason: "autre",
      closedNote: "litige",
      statusChangedAt: new Date("2026-10-08T08:00:00Z"),
    }),
  ];
}

test("groupWallet: buckets and exact lines (Paris)", () => {
  const group = groupOf(groupWallet(bigWallet(), TYPES, CLASSES, NOW, PARIS), "coll");
  assert.deepEqual(group.usable, [
    { id: "u1", origin: "Acheté", line: "Disponible · valable jusqu'au 30/11 inclus", tone: "ok", struck: false },
    { id: "u2", origin: "Offert", line: "Disponible · sans limite de validité", tone: "ok", struck: false },
  ]);
  assert.equal(group.usableCount, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(group.booked, [
    { id: "b1", origin: "Offert", line: "Réservé pour le 20/10", tone: "ok", struck: false },
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(group.expired, [
    { id: "e1", origin: "Offert", line: "Expiré (valable jusqu'au 01/10 inclus)", tone: "red", struck: false },
    { id: "e2", origin: "Offert", line: "Expiré (valable jusqu'au 01/10 inclus)", tone: "red", struck: false },
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(lines(group.done), [
    ["d1", "Utilisé le 10/10"],
    ["c3", "Clos le 08/10 : Autre (litige)"],
    ["c2", "Clos le 07/10 : Remboursé hors Skedul"],
    ["c1", "Retiré le 06/10 (cadeau en double)"],
    ["p1", "Pointé le 05/10"],
  ]);
  assert.ok(group.done.every((v) => v.tone === "muted" && v.struck));
  assert.deepEqual(

      ["d1", "Offert"],
      ["c3", "Offert"],
      ["c2", "Acheté"],
      ["c1", "Offert"],
      ["p1", "Offert"],
    ],

  assert.deepEqual(group.expirySummary, ["1 valable jusqu'au 30/11 inclus", "1 sans limite de validité"]);
});
```
