Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/back-office/wallet-view.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Wallet view model (spec § 13.1, § 9). One group per ticket type the client
 * holds tickets of, with the display lines and the EXPLICIT ticket ids every
 * wallet action sends (OUT L125: an id list is idempotent, a quantity is not).
 * Pure: `now` and `tz` are arguments, the host zone never matters. Tickets of a
 * type that is not in `types` are ignored (the foreign key makes it impossible).
 */
import { expiryLabel, formatDayMonthOf, plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { ORIGIN_LABELS, type AlertTone } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";
import {
  compareKeys,
  formatDayMonth,
  formatDayMonthYear,
  parseKey,
  todayKey,
  type DateKey,
} from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { lastValidDay } from "@/lib/ticket-expiry";
import { CLOSE_REASON_LABELS, type TicketCloseReason, type TicketStatus } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { consumptionOrder, isUsable, type TypeClass } from "@/lib/wallet-rules";

export type WalletTicketRow = {
  id: string;
  ticketTypeId: string;
  status: TicketStatus;
  expiresAt: Date | null;
  purchaseId: string | null;
  closedReason: TicketCloseReason | null;
  closedNote: string | null;
  statusChangedAt: Date;
  createdAt: Date;
  /** starts_at of the occurrence of a booked ticket */
  bookingStartsAt: Date | null;
};

export type WalletTypeRow = { id: string; name: string; color: string; archived: boolean };

export type WalletTicketView = {
  id: string;
  origin: "Acheté" | "Offert";
  line: string;
  tone: "ok" | "red" | "muted";
  struck: boolean;
};

export type WalletGroup = {
  ticketTypeId: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
  archived: boolean;
  alert: AlertTone | null;
  usableCount: number;
  expirySummary: string[];
  usable: WalletTicketView[];
  booked: WalletTicketView[];
  expired: WalletTicketView[];
  done: WalletTicketView[];
  ids: {
    point: string[];
    convert: string[];
    closePaid: string[];
    closeAny: string[];
    retire: string[];
    unpoint: string[];
  };
};

type Bucket = "usable" | "booked" | "expired" | "done";

const compareId = (a: string, b: string): number => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);

/** A booked ticket on a séance that has started is « done » (spec § 7: derived, no state change). */
function bucketOf(t: WalletTicketRow, now: Date): Bucket {
  if (isUsable(t, now)) return "usable";
  if (t.status === "available" || t.status === "expired") return "expired";
  if (t.status === "booked") {
    return t.bookingStartsAt === null || t.bookingStartsAt.getTime() > now.getTime() ? "booked" : "done";
  }
  return "done";
}

function view(t: WalletTicketRow, line: string, tone: WalletTicketView["tone"], struck: boolean): WalletTicketView {
  return {
    id: t.id,
    origin: t.purchaseId === null ? ORIGIN_LABELS.offered : ORIGIN_LABELS.purchased,
    line,
    tone,
    struck,
  };
}

function withNote(text: string, note: string | null): string {
  const trimmed = note?.trim();
  return trimmed ? `${text} (${trimmed})` : text;
}

function usableView(t: WalletTicketRow, now: Date, tz: string): WalletTicketView {
  return view(t, `Disponible · ${expiryLabel(t.expiresAt, tz, now)}`, "ok", false);
}

function bookedView(t: WalletTicketRow, tz: string): WalletTicketView {
  const line = t.bookingStartsAt ? `Réservé pour le ${formatDayMonthOf(t.bookingStartsAt, tz)}` : "Réservé";
  return view(t, line, "ok", false);
}

function expiredView(t: WalletTicketRow, tz: string): WalletTicketView {
  const line = t.expiresAt
    ? `Expiré (valable jusqu'au ${formatDayMonth(lastValidDay(t.expiresAt, tz))} inclus)`
    : "Expiré";
  return view(t, line, "red", false);
}

function doneView(t: WalletTicketRow, tz: string): WalletTicketView {
  if (t.status === "used") {
    return view(t, `Pointé le ${formatDayMonthOf(t.statusChangedAt, tz)}`, "muted", true);
  }
  if (t.status === "closed") {
    const day = formatDayMonthOf(t.statusChangedAt, tz);
    if (t.closedReason === "retire") return view(t, withNote(`Retiré le ${day}`, t.closedNote), "muted", true);
    const reason = t.closedReason ? ` : ${CLOSE_REASON_LABELS[t.closedReason]}` : "";
    return view(t, withNote(`Clos le ${day}${reason}`, t.closedNote), "muted", true);
  }
  return view(t, `Utilisé le ${formatDayMonthOf(t.bookingStartsAt ?? t.statusChangedAt, tz)}`, "muted", true);
}

/** The instant a done ticket left the wallet: the séance for a booked one, else its last status change. */
const doneAt = (t: WalletTicketRow): number =>
  (t.status === "booked" ? (t.bookingStartsAt ?? t.statusChangedAt) : t.statusChangedAt).getTime();

/** One line per last valid day (the year is named like `expiryLabel` does: only when that day is not in now's local year), then the tickets without limit. */
function expirySummaryOf(usable: readonly WalletTicketRow[], tz: string, now: Date): string[] {
  const perDay = new Map<DateKey, number>();
  let unlimited = 0;
  for (const t of usable) {
    if (t.expiresAt === null) {
      unlimited += 1;
      continue;
    }
    const day = lastValidDay(t.expiresAt, tz);
    perDay.set(day, (perDay.get(day) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const thisYear = parseKey(todayKey(now, tz)).y;
  const summary = [...perDay.entries()]
    .sort(([a], [b]) => compareKeys(a, b))
    .map(([day, n]) => {
      const date = parseKey(day).y === thisYear ? formatDayMonth(day) : formatDayMonthYear(day);
      return `${plural(n, "valable", "valables")} jusqu'au ${date} inclus`;
    });
  if (unlimited > 0) summary.push(`${unlimited} sans limite de validité`);
  return summary;
}

function buildGroup(
  type: WalletTypeRow,
  rows: readonly WalletTicketRow[],
  cls: TypeClass,
  now: Date,
  tz: string,
): WalletGroup {
  const inBucket = (bucket: Bucket) => rows.filter((t) => bucketOf(t, now) === bucket);
  const usableRows = consumptionOrder(inBucket("usable"));
  const bookedRows = inBucket("booked").sort(
    (a, b) =>
      (a.bookingStartsAt?.getTime() ?? Infinity) - (b.bookingStartsAt?.getTime() ?? Infinity) || compareId(a.id, b.id),
  );
  const expiredRows = inBucket("expired").sort(
    (a, b) =>
      (b.expiresAt?.getTime() ?? -Infinity) - (a.expiresAt?.getTime() ?? -Infinity) || compareId(a.id, b.id),
  );
  const doneRows = inBucket("done").sort((a, b) => doneAt(b) - doneAt(a) || compareId(a.id, b.id));
  // Same order as the engine's unpointTickets: statusChangedAt desc, then id desc.
  const usedRows = rows
    .filter((t) => t.status === "used")
    .sort((a, b) => b.statusChangedAt.getTime() - a.statusChangedAt.getTime() || compareId(b.id, a.id));
  const usableIds = usableRows.map((t) => t.id);
  const alert: AlertTone | null =
    usableRows.length === 0 ? null : cls === "archived" ? "red" : cls === "orphan" ? "orange" : null;
  return {
    ticketTypeId: type.id,
    name: type.name,
    color: type.color,
    archived: type.archived,
    alert,
    usableCount: usableRows.length,
    expirySummary: expirySummaryOf(usableRows, tz, now),
    usable: usableRows.map((t) => usableView(t, now, tz)),
    booked: bookedRows.map((t) => bookedView(t, tz)),
    expired: expiredRows.map((t) => expiredView(t, tz)),
    done: doneRows.map((t) => doneView(t, tz)),
    ids: {
      point: [...usableIds],
      convert: [...usableIds],
      closePaid: usableRows.filter((t) => t.purchaseId !== null).map((t) => t.id),
      closeAny: [...usableIds],
      retire: usableRows.filter((t) => t.purchaseId === null).map((t) => t.id),
      unpoint: usedRows.map((t) => t.id),
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Spec § 13.1 wallet: one group per type holding tickets (the `types` order),
 * red = usable tickets of an archived type, orange = usable tickets of an
 * orphan class (spec § 9); lines and actionable ids (explicit ids, consumption
 * order, « Annuler le pointage » most recent first).
 */
export function groupWallet(
  tickets: readonly WalletTicketRow[],
  types: readonly WalletTypeRow[],
  classes: ReadonlyMap<string, TypeClass>,
  now: Date,
  tz: string,
): WalletGroup[] {
  const byType = new Map<string, WalletTicketRow[]>();
  for (const t of tickets) {
    const list = byType.get(t.ticketTypeId);
    if (list) list.push(t);
    else byType.set(t.ticketTypeId, [t]);
  }
  const groups: WalletGroup[] = [];
  for (const type of types) {
    const rows = byType.get(type.id);
    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) continue;
    const cls: TypeClass = classes.get(type.id) ?? (type.archived ? "archived" : "ok");
    groups.push(buildGroup(type, rows, cls, now, tz));
  }
  return groups;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Client history (Q27 as amended, Decision 19): ledger movements grouped into
 * readable lines. Format:
 * « JJ/MM HH:mm · {acteur} · {libellé} {n} {type}[ → {type B}][ ({motif ou note})][ · {séance}] ».
 * Newest action first (by the highest seq of its movements); the lines of an
 * action follow seq. Pure: `tz` is an argument.
 */
import { formatDayMonthOf, formatDayMonthTime } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import {
  ACTOR_LABELS,
  CLOSE_REASON_LABELS,
  MOVEMENT_KIND_LABELS,
  type Actor,
  type MovementKind,
  type TicketCloseReason,
} from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export type LedgerMovementRow = {
  seq: number;
  actionId: string;
  kind: MovementKind;
  ticketTypeId: string;
  fromTicketTypeId: string | null;
  actor: Actor;
  reason: string | null;
  createdAt: Date;
  /** the ticket's closed_reason, for close movements */
  closedReason: TicketCloseReason | null;
  /** through booking_id, for spend / return */
  occurrence: { title: string; startsAt: Date } | null;
};

export type HistoryLine = { key: string; text: string };

/** Shown for a ticket type that no longer exists. */
export const UNKNOWN_TYPE = "type supprimé";

type Group = {
  label: string;
  kind: MovementKind;
  ticketTypeId: string;
  fromTicketTypeId: string | null;
  motif: string | null;
  occurrence: LedgerMovementRow["occurrence"];
  count: number;
};

type Action = { actionId: string; lastSeq: number; first: LedgerMovementRow; groups: Map<string, Group> };

/** The motif shown between parentheses: close = reason (+ note), retire / pointage / offer = the note, else none. */
function motifOf(row: LedgerMovementRow): string | null {
  const note = row.reason?.trim() || null;
  switch (row.kind) {
    case "close": {
      if (row.closedReason === "retire" || row.closedReason === null) return note;
      const label = CLOSE_REASON_LABELS[row.closedReason];
      return note ? `${label}, ${note}` : label;
    }
    case "pointage":
    case "offer":
      return note;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

function labelOf(row: LedgerMovementRow): string {
  return row.kind === "close" && row.closedReason === "retire" ? CLOSE_REASON_LABELS.retire : MOVEMENT_KIND_LABELS[row.kind];
}

function nameOf(typeNames: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, id: string): string {
  return typeNames.get(id) ?? UNKNOWN_TYPE;
}

function lineText(first: LedgerMovementRow, group: Group, typeNames: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, tz: string): string {
  const type =
    group.kind === "convert" && group.fromTicketTypeId !== null
      ? `${nameOf(typeNames, group.fromTicketTypeId)} → ${nameOf(typeNames, group.ticketTypeId)}`
      : nameOf(typeNames, group.ticketTypeId);
  const what = `${group.label} ${group.count} ${type}${group.motif ? ` (${group.motif})` : ""}`;
  const fields = [formatDayMonthTime(first.createdAt, tz), ACTOR_LABELS[first.actor], what];
  if (group.occurrence) {
    fields.push(`${group.occurrence.title} du ${formatDayMonthOf(group.occurrence.startsAt, tz)}`);
  }
  return fields.join(" · ");
}

export function historyLines(
  rows: readonly LedgerMovementRow[],
  typeNames: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
  tz: string,
): HistoryLine[] {
  const actions = new Map<string, Action>();
  for (const row of [...rows].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq)) {
    let action = actions.get(row.actionId);
    if (!action) {
      action = { actionId: row.actionId, lastSeq: row.seq, first: row, groups: new Map() };
      actions.set(row.actionId, action);
    }
    action.lastSeq = row.seq; // rows are visited by seq asc: the last assignment is the highest
    const motif = motifOf(row);
    const key = JSON.stringify([
      row.kind,
      row.ticketTypeId,
      row.fromTicketTypeId,
      row.closedReason,
      motif,
      row.occurrence ? [row.occurrence.title, row.occurrence.startsAt.getTime()] : null,
    ]);
    const group = action.groups.get(key);
    if (group) {
      group.count += 1;
    } else {
      action.groups.set(key, {
        label: labelOf(row),
        kind: row.kind,
        ticketTypeId: row.ticketTypeId,
        fromTicketTypeId: row.fromTicketTypeId,
        motif,
        occurrence: row.occurrence,
        count: 1,
      });
    }
  }
  const lines: HistoryLine[] = [];
  for (const action of [...actions.values()].sort((a, b) => b.lastSeq - a.lastSeq)) {
    let index = 0;
    for (const group of action.groups.values()) {
      lines.push({ key: `${action.actionId}:${index}`, text: lineText(action.first, group, typeNames, tz) });
      index += 1;
    }
  }
  return lines;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Client list rules (Q4 listing, Q5 filters). Pure: the SQL twin of these
 * predicates lives in client-reads.ts, which feeds `ClientFacts` to them.
 */

export const CLIENT_FILTERS = ["tous", "tickets", "a-venir", "alertes"] as const;
export type ClientFilter = (typeof CLIENT_FILTERS)[number];

export const CLIENT_FILTER_LABELS: Record<ClientFilter, string> = {
  tous: "Tous",
  tickets: "Avec tickets",
  "a-venir": "Inscriptions à venir",
  alertes: "Alertes",
};

/** ?filter= value; "credits" (v1) → "tickets"; unknown → "tous". */
export function parseClientFilter(value: unknown): ClientFilter {
  if (value === "credits") return "tickets";
  return typeof value === "string" && (CLIENT_FILTERS as readonly string[]).includes(value)
    ? (value as ClientFilter)
    : "tous";
}

export type ClientFacts = {
  /** tickets available and valid now, archived types included */
  usableTickets: number;
  /** confirmed bookings on a future séance or RDV */
  upcomingConfirmed: number;
  red: boolean;
  orange: boolean;
  /** confirmed or completed bookings, ever */
  confirmedBookings: number;
  /** tickets in any state */
  ticketsAny: number;
  /** bookings in any state */
  bookingsAny: number;
  /** purchases in any state */
  purchasesAny: number;
};

/** Spec § 9: a confirmed booking ever, or at least one ticket in any state. */
export function isClient(f: Pick<ClientFacts, "confirmedBookings" | "ticketsAny">): boolean {
  return f.confirmedBookings > 0 || f.ticketsAny > 0;
}

/** Q4: shown in the list = isClient, or never booked nor bought anything (a « Nouveau client »). */
export function isListedClient(f: ClientFacts): boolean {
  return isClient(f) || (f.bookingsAny === 0 && f.purchasesAny === 0 && f.ticketsAny === 0);
}

/** Q5: tickets = usable > 0 (archived types included); a-venir = a confirmed booking on a future séance or RDV; alertes = red or orange. */
export function matchesClientFilter(f: ClientFacts, filter: ClientFilter): boolean {
  switch (filter) {
    case "tous":
      return true;
    case "tickets":
      return f.usableTickets > 0;
    case "a-venir":
      return f.upcomingConfirmed > 0;
    case "alertes":
      return f.red || f.orange;
  }
}

/** /dashboard/clients?filter=…&q=… (empty parts omitted). */
export function clientsHref(filter: ClientFilter, q: string): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (filter !== "tous") parts.push(`filter=${filter}`);
  const query = q.trim();
  if (query !== "") parts.push(`q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
  return parts.length === 0 ? "/dashboard/clients" : `/dashboard/clients?${parts.join("&")}`;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Overview view models: KPI tiles (Q25), alert lines (Q28), getting started
 * steps (Q29). Pure: the reads (dashboard-reads.ts, Task 37) feed the inputs.
 */
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import type { AlertTone } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils";

export type KpiInput = {
  upcomingSeances7d: number;
  upcomingRegistrants7d: number;
  ticketsInCirculation: number;
  clients: number;
  revenue: readonly { currency: string; cents: number }[];
  currency: string;
};

export type KpiTile = {
  key: "seances" | "tickets" | "clients" | "revenue";
  label: string;
  value: string;
  hint: string | null;
  href: string;
};

/** Q25: the pro currency first (0 when absent), the other currencies after, biggest first. */
export function revenueDisplay(
  revenue: readonly { currency: string; cents: number }[],
  currency: string,
): { main: string; others: string[] } {
  const home = currency.toLowerCase();
  const totals = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const r of revenue) {
    const code = r.currency.toLowerCase();
    totals.set(code, (totals.get(code) ?? 0) + r.cents);
  }
  const others = [...totals.entries()]
    .filter(([code]) => code !== home)
    .sort(([codeA, a], [codeB, b]) => b - a || (codeA < codeB ? -1 : codeA > codeB ? 1 : 0))
    .map(([code, cents]) => formatMoney(cents, code));
  return { main: formatMoney(totals.get(home) ?? 0, home), others };
}

/** The 4 tiles of the overview. */
export function kpiTiles(input: KpiInput): KpiTile[] {
  const revenue = revenueDisplay(input.revenue, input.currency);
  return [
    {
      key: "seances",
      label: "Séances à venir (7 j)",
      value: String(input.upcomingSeances7d),
      hint: `dont ${plural(input.upcomingRegistrants7d, "inscrit", "inscrits")}`,
      href: "/dashboard/planning",
    },
    {
      key: "tickets",
      label: "Tickets en circulation",
      value: String(input.ticketsInCirculation),
      hint: null,
      href: "/dashboard/clients?filter=tickets",
    },
    { key: "clients", label: "Clients", value: String(input.clients), hint: null, href: "/dashboard/clients" },
    {
      key: "revenue",
      label: "Encaissé",
      value: revenue.main,
      hint: revenue.others.length > 0 ? revenue.others.join(" · ") : null,
      href: "/dashboard/payments",
    },
  ];
}

export type DashboardAlert = { key: string; tone: AlertTone; text: string; href: string };

/** Q28 alert lines, red first, then orange (clients, then one per event). */
export function dashboardAlerts(input: {
  redClients: number;
  orangeClients: number;
  eventsWithoutActiveType: readonly { eventId: string; title: string }[];
}): DashboardAlert[] {
  const alerts: DashboardAlert[] = [];
  if (input.redClients > 0) {
    alerts.push({
      key: "red-clients",
      tone: "red",
      text: `${plural(input.redClients, "client a", "clients ont")} des tickets d'un type archivé.`,
      href: "/dashboard/clients?filter=alertes",
    });
  }
  if (input.orangeClients > 0) {
    alerts.push({
      key: "orange-clients",
      tone: "orange",
      text: `${plural(input.orangeClients, "client a", "clients ont")} des tickets d'un type lié à aucun événement à venir.`,
      href: "/dashboard/clients?filter=alertes",
    });
  }
  for (const e of input.eventsWithoutActiveType) {
    alerts.push({
      key: `event-${e.eventId}`,
      tone: "orange",
      text: `« ${e.title} » n'accepte aucun ticket actif.`,
      href: `/dashboard/events/${e.eventId}`,
    });
  }
  return alerts;
}

export type GettingStartedStep = { key: "type" | "offer" | "event"; label: string; done: boolean; href: string };

/** Q29: the 3 steps, or null once all are done. */
export function gettingStartedSteps(input: {
  hasType: boolean;
  hasOffer: boolean;
  hasEvent: boolean;
  firstTypeId: string | null;
}): GettingStartedStep[] | null {
  const steps: GettingStartedStep[] = [
    { key: "type", label: "Créer un type de ticket", done: input.hasType, href: "/dashboard/tickets" },
    {
      key: "offer",
      label: "Créer une offre",
      done: input.hasOffer,
      href: input.firstTypeId ? `/dashboard/tickets/${input.firstTypeId}` : "/dashboard/tickets",
    },
    { key: "event", label: "Créer un événement", done: input.hasEvent, href: "/dashboard/events/new" },
  ];
  return steps.every((s) => s.done) ? null : steps;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/back-office/client-reads.ts
export const CLIENT_LIST_LIMIT = 500;
export const RECORD_BOOKINGS_MAX = 300;
export const PAST_BOOKINGS_MAX = 50;
export const HISTORY_MAX_MOVEMENTS = 3000;
export function likePattern(q: string): string; // « %q% » with !, % and _ escaped by « ! » (use with ESCAPE '!')
export type ClientListRow = {
  id: string; name: string; email: string; phone: string | null; linkedAccount: boolean;
  holdings: { ticketTypeId: string; name: string; color: string; archived: boolean; usable: number }[];
  usableTickets: number; upcomingConfirmed: number; red: boolean; orange: boolean;
};
export async function listClients(db: Db, professionalId: string, now: Date, opts: { q: string; filter: ClientFilter }): Promise<{ rows: ClientListRow[]; counts: Record<ClientFilter, number> }>;
export async function customerAlertCounts(db: Db, professionalId: string, now: Date): Promise<{ red: number; orange: number }>;
export type ClientBookingRow = {
  bookingId: string; occurrenceId: string; kind: "seance" | "rdv"; title: string; startsAt: string; endsAt: string; whenLabel: string;
  status: BookingStatus; coverage: BookingCoverage; ticketTypeName: string | null; occurrenceStatus: OccurrenceStatus;
  canMove: boolean; canUnenroll: boolean; moved: boolean; hasTicket: boolean; pending: boolean; planningHref: string;
};
export type ClientPurchaseRow = {
  id: string; label: string; quantity: number; amountCents: number; currency: string; status: PurchaseStatus; livemode: boolean;
  createdAt: Date; paidAt: Date | null;
};
export type ClientRecordData = {
  customer: { id: string; name: string; email: string; phone: string | null; linkedAccount: boolean; createdAt: Date };
  wallet: WalletGroup[]; typeOptions: TypeOption[];
  bookings: { upcoming: ClientBookingRow[]; past: ClientBookingRow[] };
  purchases: ClientPurchaseRow[];
  history: HistoryLine[];
};
export async function getClientRecord(db: Db, professionalId: string, customerId: string, now: Date): Promise<ClientRecordData | null>;

// src/server/client-queries.ts (server-only)
export async function getClientsPage(professionalId: string, opts: { q: string; filter: ClientFilter }): Promise<{ rows: ClientListRow[]; counts: Record<ClientFilter, number> }>;
export async function getClientRecordPage(professionalId: string, customerId: string): Promise<ClientRecordData | null>;
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

import { customerAlertCounts, getClientRecord, listClients } from "@/lib/back-office/client-reads";
import { formatDayMonthOf, formatWhen, planningHref } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { cancelBookingsByPro } from "@/lib/booking/cancel";
import { setTicketTypeArchived } from "@/lib/booking/catalog";
import { registerPro } from "@/lib/booking/claims";
import { fulfillPurchase, startPurchase } from "@/lib/booking/fulfillment";
import { checkInvariants } from "@/lib/booking/invariants";
import { closeTickets, convertTickets, pointTickets } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import { addDaysMs, addMinutes, createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, type DbHarness } from "@/test/db";
import { dayIn, giveTickets, makeCustomer, makeEvent, makeOffer, makeType } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { rowEvent, rowLink, rowSeance } from "@/test/rows";

function must<T extends { ok: boolean }>(res: T): Extract<T, { ok: true }> {
  assert.equal(res.ok, true, JSON.stringify(res));
  return res as Extract<T, { ok: true }>;
}

/** An event that accepts `typeId`, so that the tickets of that type are not « orphan » (spec § 9). */
function linkedEvent(h: DbHarness, typeId: string, title: string, startDate?: string) {
  return makeEvent(h.db, h.pro, { title, ticketTypeIds: [typeId], ...(startDate ? { rule: { startDate } } : {}) });
}

/** A paid purchase of `offerId`: startPurchase then fulfillPurchase, both at `now`. */
async function pay(h: DbHarness, customerId: string, offerId: string, now: Date): Promise<string> {
  const started = must(await startPurchase(h.db, { professionalId: h.pro.proId, offerId, customerId }, now));
  must(
    await fulfillPurchase(
      h.db,
      started.purchaseId,
      { sessionId: `cs_test_${nanoid()}`, paymentIntentId: `pi_test_${nanoid()}`, livemode: false },
      now,
    ),
  );
  return started.purchaseId;
}

const names = (rows: readonly { name: string }[]) => rows.map((r) => r.name);

  must(await startPurchase(h.db, { professionalId: h.pro.proId, offerId, customerId: pending }));
  await giveTickets(h.db, h.pro, holder, typeId, 1);

    await registerPro(h.db, {

dbTest("listClients: the search treats %, _ and ! literally and is trimmed", async (h) => {
  await makeCustomer(h.db, h.pro, { name: "100% Bio", email: "bio.pct@skedul.test" });
  await makeCustomer(h.db, h.pro, { name: "100x Bio", email: "bio.x@skedul.test" });
  await makeCustomer(h.db, h.pro, { name: "Hello! World", email: "hello@skedul.test" });

});

dbTest("client reads never cross the tenant boundary", async (h) => {
  const other = await createTestPro(h.db);
  try {
    const now = new Date();
    const theirType = await makeType(h.db, other, { name: "Type de l'autre" });
    const theirs = await makeCustomer(h.db, other, { name: "Chez l'autre" });
    await giveTickets(h.db, other, theirs, theirType, 1);
    const mine = await makeCustomer(h.db, h.pro, { name: "Chez moi" });

    const out = await listClients(h.db, h.pro.proId, now, { q: "", filter: "tous" });
    assert.deepEqual(names(out.rows), ["Chez moi"]);
    assert.deepEqual(out.counts, { tous: 1, tickets: 0, "a-venir": 0, alertes: 0 });
    assert.deepEqual(await customerAlertCounts(h.db, h.pro.proId, now), { red: 0, orange: 0 });
    // their ticket type is linked to no event: one orange client, for them only
    assert.deepEqual(await customerAlertCounts(h.db, other.proId, now), { red: 0, orange: 1 });

    assert.equal(await getClientRecord(h.db, h.pro.proId, theirs, now), null);
    assert.equal(await getClientRecord(h.db, other.proId, mine, now), null);
    assert.equal(await getClientRecord(h.db, h.pro.proId, "unknown-customer", now), null);

    // a client with no activity: an empty record, not an error
    const empty = await getClientRecord(h.db, h.pro.proId, mine, now);
    assert.ok(empty);
    assert.equal(empty.customer.name, "Chez moi");
    assert.equal(empty.customer.linkedAccount, false);
    assert.deepEqual(empty.wallet, []);
    assert.deepEqual(empty.bookings, { upcoming: [], past: [] });
    assert.deepEqual(empty.purchases, []);
    assert.deepEqual(empty.history, []);

    assert.deepEqual(await checkInvariants(h.db, { proId: other.proId }), []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(h.db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("getClientRecord: wallet groups, bookings, purchases and history of one client", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;
  const p = pro.proId;
  const tz = pro.tz;
  const now = new Date();
  const coll = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif", color: "#6366f1" });
  const priv = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours particulier", color: "#0ea5e9" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, coll, { quantity: 10, priceCents: 19000, validityCount: 6, validityUnit: "month" });
  const future = await linkedEvent(h, coll, "Altinha débutants");
  const second = await linkedEvent(h, coll, "Roda libre", dayIn(pro, 5));
  // A séance that already took place: the engine does not create past séances, a row builder does.
  const pastEvent = await rowEvent(db, pro, { bookingMode: "tickets" });
  await db.execute(sql`update event set title = 'Atelier technique' where id = ${pastEvent}`);
  await rowLink(db, pro, pastEvent, coll);
  const pastStart = addDaysMs(now, -3);
  const pastSeance = await rowSeance(db, pro, pastEvent, { startsAt: pastStart });

  const retiredAt = addMinutes(now, 2); // after the pointage: « Retiré » sorts before « Pointé » in the done list
  const dd = (d: Date) => formatDayMonthOf(d, tz);

  const beatriz = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: "beatriz@skedul.test" });
  await pay(h, beatriz, offerId, now);
  const register = async (occurrenceId: string) =>
    must(
      await registerPro(db, {
        professionalId: p,
        actorUserId: pro.userId,
        occurrenceId,
        customerId: beatriz,
        asGuest: false,
      }),
    );
  const futureBooking = await register(future.occurrences[0].id);
  const pastBooking = await register(pastSeance);
  must(
    await pointTickets(
      db,
      { professionalId: p, actorUserId: pro.userId, customerId: beatriz, selection: { ticketTypeId: coll, quantity: 1 } },
      now,
    ),
  );
  const offered = await giveTickets(db, pro, beatriz, coll, 2);
  must(
    await convertTickets(
      db,
      {
        professionalId: p,
        actorUserId: pro.userId,
        customerId: beatriz,
        selection: { ticketTypeId: coll, quantity: 1 },
        toTicketTypeId: priv,
      },
      now,
    ),
  );
  const secondBooking = await register(second.occurrences[0].id);
  must(
    await cancelBookingsByPro(
      db,
      { professionalId: p, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: second.occurrences[0].id, bookingIds: [secondBooking.bookingId], reason: "Test" },
      now,
    ),
  );
  must(
    await closeTickets(
      db,
      { professionalId: p, actorUserId: pro.userId, customerId: beatriz, selection: { ticketIds: [offered[0]] }, reason: "retire", note: "erreur" },
      retiredAt,
    ),
  );
  must(await startPurchase(db, { professionalId: p, offerId, customerId: beatriz }, addMinutes(now, 1)));

  const record = await getClientRecord(db, p, beatriz, new Date());
  assert.ok(record);

  assert.deepEqual(
    { ...record.customer, createdAt: undefined },
    { id: beatriz, name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: "beatriz@skedul.test", phone: null, linkedAccount: false, createdAt: undefined },
  );
  assert.ok(record.customer.createdAt instanceof Date);
  assert.deepEqual(
    record.typeOptions.map((t) => [t.id, t.name, t.rdvFree]),
    [
      [coll, "Cours collectif", false],
      [priv, "Cours particulier", false],
    ],
  );

  // wallet: 10 bought - 2 booked - 1 pointed - 1 converted (the cancelled booking gave its ticket back) + 2 offered - 1 retired
  assert.deepEqual(
    record.wallet.map((g) => g.ticketTypeId),
    [coll, priv],
  );
  const [gColl, gPriv] = record.wallet;
  assert.equal(gColl.name, "Cours collectif");
  assert.equal(gColl.alert, null);
  assert.equal(gColl.usableCount, 7);
  assert.equal(gColl.usable.length, 7);
  assert.equal(gColl.expired.length, 0);
  assert.equal(gColl.expirySummary.length, 2);
  assert.ok(gColl.expirySummary[0].startsWith("6 valables jusqu'au "), gColl.expirySummary[0]);
  assert.equal(gColl.expirySummary[1], "1 sans limite de validité");
  assert.deepEqual(
    gColl.booked.map((t) => t.line),
    [`Réservé pour le ${formatDayMonthOf(future.occurrences[0].startsAt, tz)}`],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    gColl.done.map((t) => t.line),
    [`Retiré le ${dd(retiredAt)} (erreur)`, `Pointé le ${dd(now)}`, `Utilisé le ${dd(pastStart)}`],
  );
  assert.equal(gColl.ids.point.length, 7);
  assert.equal(gColl.ids.closePaid.length, 6);
  assert.equal(gColl.ids.retire.length, 1);
  assert.equal(gColl.ids.unpoint.length, 1);
  assert.equal(gPriv.name, "Cours particulier");
  assert.equal(gPriv.usableCount, 1);
  assert.equal(gPriv.alert, "orange"); // linked to no event
  assert.equal(gPriv.ids.closePaid.length, 1);

  // bookings: the future one is active, the cancelled one and the past one are history, newest first
  assert.equal(record.bookings.upcoming.length, 1);
  const [up] = record.bookings.upcoming;
  const upOccurrence = future.occurrences[0];
  assert.equal(up.bookingId, futureBooking.bookingId);
  assert.equal(up.occurrenceId, upOccurrence.id);
  assert.equal(up.kind, "seance");
  assert.equal(up.title, "Altinha débutants");
  assert.equal(up.startsAt, upOccurrence.startsAt.toISOString());
  assert.equal(up.endsAt, upOccurrence.endsAt.toISOString());
  assert.equal(up.whenLabel, formatWhen(upOccurrence.startsAt, upOccurrence.endsAt, tz));
  assert.equal(up.status, "confirmed");
  assert.equal(up.coverage, "ticket");
  assert.equal(up.ticketTypeName, "Cours collectif");
  assert.equal(up.occurrenceStatus, "scheduled");
  assert.deepEqual([up.canMove, up.canUnenroll, up.moved, up.hasTicket, up.pending], [true, true, false, true, false]);
  assert.equal(up.planningHref, planningHref({ occurrenceId: upOccurrence.id, startsAt: upOccurrence.startsAt, tz }));
  assert.deepEqual(
    record.bookings.past.map((b) => [b.bookingId, b.title, b.status, b.canMove, b.canUnenroll, b.hasTicket, b.ticketTypeName]),
    [
      [secondBooking.bookingId, "Roda libre", "cancelled", false, false, false, null],
      [pastBooking.bookingId, "Atelier technique", "confirmed", false, true, true, "Cours collectif"],
    ],
  );

  // purchases, newest first
  assert.deepEqual(
    record.purchases.map((x) => [x.status, x.label, x.quantity, x.amountCents, x.currency]),
    [
      ["pending", "Carnet de 10", 10, 19000, "eur"],
      ["paid", "Carnet de 10", 10, 19000, "eur"],
    ],
  );
  assert.equal(record.purchases[0].paidAt, null);
  assert.ok(record.purchases[1].paidAt instanceof Date);
  assert.ok(record.purchases[1].createdAt instanceof Date);

  // history: one line per action, newest first, the séance on spend and return lines only
  const tail = (text: string) => text.split(" · ").slice(2).join(" · ");
  assert.deepEqual(record.history.map((l) => tail(l.text)), [
    "Retiré 1 Cours collectif (erreur)",
    `Rendu 1 Cours collectif · Roda libre du ${dd(second.occurrences[0].startsAt)}`,
    `Utilisé pour une inscription 1 Cours collectif · Roda libre du ${dd(second.occurrences[0].startsAt)}`,
    "Converti 1 Cours collectif → Cours particulier",
    "Offert 2 Cours collectif",
    "Pointé 1 Cours collectif",
    `Utilisé pour une inscription 1 Cours collectif · Atelier technique du ${dd(pastStart)}`,
    `Utilisé pour une inscription 1 Cours collectif · Altinha débutants du ${dd(upOccurrence.startsAt)}`,
    "Acheté 10 Cours collectif",
  ]);
  assert.equal(new Set(record.history.map((l) => l.key)).size, record.history.length);
});
```

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/back-office/client-reads.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Client reads (spec § 9, § 13.1): the list with its filters and counts, the
 * alert counts of the overview and the client record. Every statement filters
 * professional_id; no `server-only`, no `next/*`, no `@/lib/db` index, so the
 * DB harness can test it. The list facts are plain counts (no dates), read with
 * raw SQL; everything that returns an instant goes through the query builder
 * (the neon-http driver returns raw timestamps as strings).
 */
import { and, asc, desc, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { alias } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

import { listActiveTypeOptions, type TypeOption } from "@/lib/back-office/catalog-reads";
import {
  CLIENT_FILTERS,
  isListedClient,
  matchesClientFilter,
  type ClientFacts,
  type ClientFilter,
} from "@/lib/back-office/client-filters";
import { formatWhen, planningHref } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { historyLines, type HistoryLine, type LedgerMovementRow } from "@/lib/back-office/history";
import { groupWallet, type WalletGroup, type WalletTypeRow } from "@/lib/back-office/wallet-view";
import { loadTypeFacts } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import { ts, type Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import {
  booking,
  customer,
  event,
  occurrence,
  professional,
  ticket,
  ticketMovement,
  ticketPurchase,
  ticketType,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import type { BookingCoverage, BookingStatus, OccurrenceStatus, PurchaseStatus } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { classifyTypes, customerAlerts } from "@/lib/wallet-rules";

/** Decision 30: the list shows at most this many clients. */
export const CLIENT_LIST_LIMIT = 500;
/** The record reads the newest bookings only (every upcoming one is among them). */
export const RECORD_BOOKINGS_MAX = 300;
/** « Passées »: at most this many past bookings on a record. */
export const PAST_BOOKINGS_MAX = 50;
/** The record reads the newest ledger movements only. */
export const HISTORY_MAX_MOVEMENTS = 3000;

/** « %q% » for `ILIKE … ESCAPE '!'`: `!`, `%` and `_` typed by the pro are literal characters. */
export function likePattern(q: string): string {
  return `%${q.replace(/[!%_]/g, "!$&")}%`;
}

export type ClientListRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string | null;
  linkedAccount: boolean;
  holdings: { ticketTypeId: string; name: string; color: string; archived: boolean; usable: number }[];
  usableTickets: number;
  upcomingConfirmed: number;
  red: boolean;
  orange: boolean;
};

type FactsRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string | null;
  linked: boolean;
  tickets_any: number;
  bookings_any: number;
  confirmed_bookings: number;
  upcoming_confirmed: number;
  purchases_any: number;
  matches_q: boolean;
};

type HeldRow = { customer_id: string; ticket_type_id: string; usable: number };

type Snapshot = { row: ClientListRow; facts: ClientFacts; matchesQ: boolean };

/**
 * Every LISTED client of the pro (isListedClient), in list order (lower(name),
 * id), with its facts and whether it matches `q`. Four queries in parallel:
 * per-customer counts, usable holdings, the types, the type facts.
 */
async function loadSnapshots(db: Db, professionalId: string, now: Date, q: string): Promise<Snapshot[]> {
  const p = professionalId;
  const matches =
    q === ""
      ? sql`true`
      : sql`(c.name ilike ${likePattern(q)} escape '!' or c.email ilike ${likePattern(q)} escape '!')`;
  const [factsRes, heldRes, types, typeFacts] = await Promise.all([
    db.execute<FactsRow>(sql`
      with tk as (
        select customer_id, count(*)::int as n from ticket where professional_id = ${p} group by customer_id
      ), bk as (
        select b.customer_id,
          count(*)::int as any_n,
          count(*) filter (where b.status = 'confirmed')::int as confirmed_n,
          count(*) filter (where b.status = 'confirmed' and o.status = 'scheduled' and o.starts_at > ${ts(now)})::int as upcoming_n
        from booking b join occurrence o on o.id = b.occurrence_id
        where b.professional_id = ${p}
        group by b.customer_id
      ), pu as (
        select customer_id, count(*)::int as n from ticket_purchase where professional_id = ${p} group by customer_id
      )
      select c.id, c.name, c.email, c.phone, (c.user_id is not null) as linked,
        coalesce(tk.n, 0) as tickets_any, coalesce(bk.any_n, 0) as bookings_any,
        coalesce(bk.confirmed_n, 0) as confirmed_bookings, coalesce(bk.upcoming_n, 0) as upcoming_confirmed,
        coalesce(pu.n, 0) as purchases_any, ${matches} as matches_q
      from customer c
      left join tk on tk.customer_id = c.id
      left join bk on bk.customer_id = c.id
      left join pu on pu.customer_id = c.id
      where c.professional_id = ${p}
      order by lower(c.name), c.id`),
    db.execute<HeldRow>(sql`
      select customer_id, ticket_type_id, count(*)::int as usable
      from ticket
      where professional_id = ${p} and status = 'available' and (expires_at is null or expires_at > ${ts(now)})
      group by customer_id, ticket_type_id`),
    db
      .select({ id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name, color: ticketType.color, archivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt })
      .from(ticketType)
      .where(eq(ticketType.professionalId, p))
      .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.createdAt), asc(ticketType.id)),
    loadTypeFacts(db, p, now),
  ]);
  const classes = classifyTypes(typeFacts);
  const typeOrder = new Map(types.map((t, i) => [t.id, i]));
  const typeById = new Map(types.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
  const heldBy = new Map<string, { ticketTypeId: string; usable: number }[]>();
  for (const h of heldRes.rows) {
    const list = heldBy.get(h.customer_id) ?? [];
    list.push({ ticketTypeId: h.ticket_type_id, usable: Number(h.usable) });
    heldBy.set(h.customer_id, list);
  }

  const out: Snapshot[] = [];
  for (const r of factsRes.rows) {
    const holdings = (heldBy.get(r.id) ?? [])
      .sort((a, b) => (typeOrder.get(a.ticketTypeId) ?? 0) - (typeOrder.get(b.ticketTypeId) ?? 0))
      .flatMap((h) => {
        const t = typeById.get(h.ticketTypeId);
        return t
          ? [{ ticketTypeId: h.ticketTypeId, name: t.name, color: t.color, archived: t.archivedAt !== null, usable: h.usable }]
          : [];
      });
    const usableTickets = holdings.reduce((n, h) => n + h.usable, 0);
    const { red, orange } = customerAlerts(holdings, classes);
    const facts: ClientFacts = {
      usableTickets,
      upcomingConfirmed: Number(r.upcoming_confirmed),
      red,
      orange,
      confirmedBookings: Number(r.confirmed_bookings),
      ticketsAny: Number(r.tickets_any),
      bookingsAny: Number(r.bookings_any),
      purchasesAny: Number(r.purchases_any),
    };
    if (!isListedClient(facts)) continue;
    out.push({
      facts,
      matchesQ: r.matches_q === true,
      row: {
        id: r.id,
        name: r.name,
        email: r.email,
        phone: r.phone,
        linkedAccount: r.linked === true,
        holdings,
        usableTickets,
        upcomingConfirmed: facts.upcomingConfirmed,
        red,
        orange,
      },
    });
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Listed clients (isListedClient) matching the filter and `q` (ILIKE on name or
 * e-mail, escaped), by lower(name), id, at most CLIENT_LIST_LIMIT; the counts
 * are per filter over every listed client (the search is ignored).
 */
export async function listClients(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  now: Date,
  opts: { q: string; filter: ClientFilter },
): Promise<{ rows: ClientListRow[]; counts: Record<ClientFilter, number> }> {
  const all = await loadSnapshots(db, professionalId, now, opts.q.trim());
  const counts: Record<ClientFilter, number> = { tous: 0, tickets: 0, "a-venir": 0, alertes: 0 };
  const rows: ClientListRow[] = [];
  for (const s of all) {
    for (const f of CLIENT_FILTERS) if (matchesClientFilter(s.facts, f)) counts[f] += 1;
    if (s.matchesQ && matchesClientFilter(s.facts, opts.filter) && rows.length < CLIENT_LIST_LIMIT) rows.push(s.row);
  }
  return { rows, counts };
}

/** Listed clients with a red / orange alert (the overview card). */
export async function customerAlertCounts(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<{ red: number; orange: number }> {
  const all = await loadSnapshots(db, professionalId, now, "");
  return { red: all.filter((s) => s.facts.red).length, orange: all.filter((s) => s.facts.orange).length };
}

export type ClientBookingRow = {
  bookingId: string;
  occurrenceId: string;
  kind: "seance" | "rdv";
  title: string;
  startsAt: string;
  endsAt: string;
  whenLabel: string;
  status: BookingStatus;
  coverage: BookingCoverage;
  ticketTypeName: string | null;
  occurrenceStatus: OccurrenceStatus;
  /** confirmed, event séance, scheduled, starts_at > now */
  canMove: boolean;
  /** pending or confirmed (past séances too, E6a) */
  canUnenroll: boolean;
  moved: boolean;
  hasTicket: boolean;
  pending: boolean;
  planningHref: string;
};

export type ClientPurchaseRow = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  quantity: number;
  amountCents: number;
  currency: string;
  status: PurchaseStatus;
  livemode: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
  paidAt: Date | null;
};

export type ClientRecordData = {
  customer: { id: string; name: string; email: string; phone: string | null; linkedAccount: boolean; createdAt: Date };
  wallet: WalletGroup[];
  typeOptions: TypeOption[];
  /** upcoming = active and not ended, by start asc; past = the rest, by start desc, at most PAST_BOOKINGS_MAX */
  bookings: { upcoming: ClientBookingRow[]; past: ClientBookingRow[] };
  /** by created_at desc */
  purchases: ClientPurchaseRow[];
  history: HistoryLine[];
};

type BookingQueryRow = {
  bookingId: string;
  occurrenceId: string;
  status: BookingStatus;
  coverage: BookingCoverage;
  movedAt: Date | null;
  startsAt: Date;
  endsAt: Date;
  occurrenceStatus: OccurrenceStatus;
  eventId: string | null;
  eventTitle: string | null;
  rdvTypeName: string | null;
  heldTicketId: string | null;
  heldTypeName: string | null;
};

function bookingRow(r: BookingQueryRow, now: Date, tz: string): ClientBookingRow {
  const kind = r.eventId === null ? "rdv" : "seance";
  const title = (kind === "seance" ? r.eventTitle : r.rdvTypeName) ?? (kind === "seance" ? "Séance" : "Rendez-vous");
  return {
    bookingId: r.bookingId,
    occurrenceId: r.occurrenceId,
    kind,
    title,
    startsAt: r.startsAt.toISOString(),
    endsAt: r.endsAt.toISOString(),
    whenLabel: formatWhen(r.startsAt, r.endsAt, tz),
    status: r.status,
    coverage: r.coverage,
    ticketTypeName: r.heldTypeName,
    occurrenceStatus: r.occurrenceStatus,
    canMove:
      r.status === "confirmed" &&
      kind === "seance" &&
      r.occurrenceStatus === "scheduled" &&
      r.startsAt.getTime() > now.getTime(),
    canUnenroll: r.status === "pending" || r.status === "confirmed",
    moved: r.movedAt !== null,
    hasTicket: r.heldTicketId !== null,
    pending: r.status === "pending",
    planningHref: planningHref({ occurrenceId: r.occurrenceId, startsAt: r.startsAt, tz }),
  };
}

/**
 * The client record (null for another pro's or an unknown customer): wallet via
 * groupWallet(loadTypeFacts → classifyTypes), history via historyLines.
 */
export async function getClientRecord(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  customerId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<ClientRecordData | null> {
  const p = professionalId;
  const [[cust], [pro]] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        id: customer.id,
        name: customer.name,
        email: customer.email,
        phone: customer.phone,
        userId: customer.userId,
        createdAt: customer.createdAt,
      })
      .from(customer)
      .where(and(eq(customer.id, customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, p))),
    db.select({ timezone: professional.timezone }).from(professional).where(eq(professional.id, p)),
  ]);
  if (!cust || !pro) return null;
  const tz = pro.timezone;

  const rdvType = alias(ticketType, "rdv_type");
  const heldType = alias(ticketType, "held_type");
  const movementRdvType = alias(ticketType, "movement_rdv_type");
  const [tickets, types, typeFacts, bookingRows, purchases, movements, typeOptions] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        id: ticket.id,
        ticketTypeId: ticket.ticketTypeId,
        status: ticket.status,
        expiresAt: ticket.expiresAt,
        purchaseId: ticket.purchaseId,
        closedReason: ticket.closedReason,
        closedNote: ticket.closedNote,
        statusChangedAt: ticket.statusChangedAt,
        createdAt: ticket.createdAt,
        bookingStartsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      })
      .from(ticket)
      .leftJoin(booking, and(eq(booking.id, ticket.bookingId), eq(booking.professionalId, p)))
      .leftJoin(occurrence, and(eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, p)))
      .where(and(eq(ticket.professionalId, p), eq(ticket.customerId, customerId))),
    db
      .select({ id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name, color: ticketType.color, archivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt })
      .from(ticketType)
      .where(eq(ticketType.professionalId, p))
      .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.createdAt), asc(ticketType.id)),
    loadTypeFacts(db, p, now),
    db
      .select({
        bookingId: booking.id,
        occurrenceId: occurrence.id,
        status: booking.status,
        coverage: booking.coverage,
        movedAt: booking.movedAt,
        startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
        endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
        occurrenceStatus: occurrence.status,
        eventId: occurrence.eventId,
        eventTitle: event.title,
        rdvTypeName: rdvType.name,
        heldTicketId: ticket.id,
        heldTypeName: heldType.name,
      })
      .from(booking)
      .innerJoin(occurrence, and(eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, p)))
      .leftJoin(event, and(eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId), eq(event.professionalId, p)))
      .leftJoin(rdvType, and(eq(rdvType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId), eq(rdvType.professionalId, p)))
      .leftJoin(ticket, and(eq(ticket.bookingId, booking.id), eq(ticket.professionalId, p)))
      .leftJoin(heldType, and(eq(heldType.id, ticket.ticketTypeId), eq(heldType.professionalId, p)))
      .where(and(eq(booking.professionalId, p), eq(booking.customerId, customerId)))
      .orderBy(desc(occurrence.startsAt), desc(booking.id))
      .limit(RECORD_BOOKINGS_MAX),
    db
      .select({
        id: ticketPurchase.id,
        label: ticketPurchase.label,
        quantity: ticketPurchase.quantity,
        amountCents: ticketPurchase.amountCents,
        currency: ticketPurchase.currency,
        status: ticketPurchase.status,
        livemode: ticketPurchase.livemode,
        createdAt: ticketPurchase.createdAt,
        paidAt: ticketPurchase.paidAt,
      })
      .from(ticketPurchase)
      .where(and(eq(ticketPurchase.professionalId, p), eq(ticketPurchase.customerId, customerId)))
      .orderBy(desc(ticketPurchase.createdAt), desc(ticketPurchase.id)),
    db
      .select({
        seq: ticketMovement.seq,
        actionId: ticketMovement.actionId,
        kind: ticketMovement.kind,
        ticketTypeId: ticketMovement.ticketTypeId,
        fromTicketTypeId: ticketMovement.fromTicketTypeId,
        actor: ticketMovement.actor,
        reason: ticketMovement.reason,
        createdAt: ticketMovement.createdAt,
        closedReason: ticket.closedReason,
        seanceStartsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
        eventTitle: event.title,
        rdvTypeName: movementRdvType.name,
      })
      .from(ticketMovement)
      .innerJoin(ticket, and(eq(ticket.id, ticketMovement.ticketId), eq(ticket.professionalId, p)))
      .leftJoin(booking, and(eq(booking.id, ticketMovement.bookingId), eq(booking.professionalId, p)))
      .leftJoin(occurrence, and(eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, p)))
      .leftJoin(event, and(eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId), eq(event.professionalId, p)))
      .leftJoin(movementRdvType, and(eq(movementRdvType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId), eq(movementRdvType.professionalId, p)))
      .where(and(eq(ticketMovement.professionalId, p), eq(ticketMovement.customerId, customerId)))
      .orderBy(desc(ticketMovement.seq))
      .limit(HISTORY_MAX_MOVEMENTS),
    listActiveTypeOptions(db, p),
  ]);

  const walletTypes: WalletTypeRow[] = types.map((t) => ({
    id: t.id,
    name: t.name,
    color: t.color,
    archived: t.archivedAt !== null,
  }));
  const wallet = groupWallet(tickets, walletTypes, classifyTypes(typeFacts), now, tz);

  const upcoming: ClientBookingRow[] = [];
  const past: ClientBookingRow[] = [];
  for (const r of bookingRows) {
    const active = r.status === "pending" || r.status === "confirmed";
    (active && r.endsAt.getTime() > now.getTime() ? upcoming : past).push(bookingRow(r, now, tz));
  }
  upcoming.reverse(); // the query is newest first: upcoming reads soonest first

  const ledger: LedgerMovementRow[] = movements.map((m) => ({
    seq: Number(m.seq),
    actionId: m.actionId,
    kind: m.kind,
    ticketTypeId: m.ticketTypeId,
    fromTicketTypeId: m.fromTicketTypeId,
    actor: m.actor,
    reason: m.reason,
    createdAt: m.createdAt,
    // the ticket's closed_reason belongs to its close movement only (it would split the lines of an earlier action)
    closedReason: m.kind === "close" ? m.closedReason : null,
    occurrence:
      (m.kind === "spend" || m.kind === "return") && m.seanceStartsAt !== null
        ? { title: m.eventTitle ?? m.rdvTypeName ?? "Séance", startsAt: m.seanceStartsAt }
        : null,
  }));
  const history = historyLines(ledger, new Map(types.map((t) => [t.id, t.name])), tz);

  return {
    customer: {
      id: cust.id,
      name: cust.name,
      email: cust.email,
      phone: cust.phone,
      linkedAccount: cust.userId !== null,
      createdAt: cust.createdAt,
    },
    wallet,
    typeOptions,
    bookings: { upcoming, past: past.slice(0, PAST_BOOKINGS_MAX) },
    purchases,
    history,
  };
}
```

### Task 32: Client cores and wrappers

The write side of the clients area. Nine cores in `src/lib/back-office/client-actions.ts` (testable: `(db, ctx, input, now)`, no `next/*`, no `server-only`), each validating its input with `parseFr` BEFORE the engine, refusing what the engine cannot see (a `rdv_free` type, a past validity day, a conversion to the same type) and turning engine failures into French with `fromEngine`. Nine thin Server Actions in `src/server/pro-clients.ts` wrap them with `runProAction`. Wallet actions always receive explicit ticket ids (OUT L125): a double submit finds the tickets already moved and answers `no_ticket`, it never moves a second batch.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/back-office/client-actions.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/back-office/client-actions.db.test.ts`
- Create: `src/server/pro-clients.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 6: `type ProCtx`, `type CoreResult<T>`, `actionFail(error: string, code?: EngineErrorCode): ActionFail`, `fromEngine(res: EngineFail, context: ProErrorContext): ActionFail`, `type ActionResult<T>` (`@/lib/back-office/result`); `runProAction<T>(name: string, fn: (ctx: ProCtx, now: Date) => Promise<CoreResult<T>>, opts?: { publicPage?: boolean }): Promise<ActionResult<T>>` (`@/server/pro-context`); `proCtx(pro: TestPro): ProCtx` (`@/test/pro-ctx`).
  - Task 2: `parseFr<S extends z.ZodType>(schema: S, value: unknown): { ok: true; data: z.output<S> } | { ok: false; error: string; fieldErrors: Record<string, string> }` (`@/lib/zod-fr`); `proErrorMessage` through `fromEngine` (contexts `customer` and `wallet`: `customer.not_found` « Client introuvable. », `wallet.not_found` « Ticket ou type introuvable. », `wallet.no_ticket` « Pas assez de tickets pour cette action : rafraîchissez la page. », `retire_paid` « Un ticket payé ne peut pas être retiré : utilisez « Clore ». », the engine's own `message` when it has one, such as « Précisez le motif. » and « Un ticket offert se retire. »).
  - Existing engine (`@/lib/booking/wallet`): `createCustomer`, `updateCustomer`, `revokeLinks`, `offerTickets`, `convertTickets`, `closeTickets`, `pointTickets`, `unpointTickets`; `expiryFromLastDay(lastDay: DateKey, tz: string): Date` (`@/lib/ticket-expiry`); `customerInputSchema`, `idSchema`, `dateKeySchema`, `BOUNDS` (`@/lib/tickets`).

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { asc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

import {
  CONVERT_SAME_TYPE,
  CONVERT_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE,
  EXPIRY_IN_PAST,
  OFFER_RDV_FREE,
  closeTicketsCore,
  convertTicketsCore,
  createCustomerCore,
  offerTicketsCore,
  pointTicketsCore,
  retireTicketsCore,
  revokeLinksCore,
  unpointTicketsCore,
  updateCustomerCore,
} from "@/lib/back-office/client-actions";
import type { CoreResult } from "@/lib/back-office/result";
import { setTicketTypeArchived } from "@/lib/booking/catalog";
import { fulfillPurchase, startPurchase } from "@/lib/booking/fulfillment";
import { checkInvariants } from "@/lib/booking/invariants";
import { addDays, instantAt, todayKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { customer, ticket, ticketMovement } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, testEmail, type DbHarness } from "@/test/db";
import { giveTickets, makeCustomer, makeOffer, makeType, movementsOf, ticketsOf } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { proCtx } from "@/test/pro-ctx";

const NO_TICKET = "Pas assez de tickets pour cette action : rafraîchissez la page.";
const TICKET_NOT_FOUND = "Ticket ou type introuvable.";
const CLIENT_NOT_FOUND = "Client introuvable.";

function must<T extends object>(res: CoreResult<T>): Extract<CoreResult<T>, { ok: true }> {
  assert.equal(res.ok, true, JSON.stringify(res));
  return res as Extract<CoreResult<T>, { ok: true }>;
}

function errorOf(res: CoreResult<object>): string {
  assert.equal(res.ok, false, JSON.stringify(res));
  return res.ok ? "" : res.error;
}

async function customerRow(db: Db, id: string) {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(customer).where(eq(customer.id, id));
  assert.ok(row, `customer ${id}`);
  return row;
}

async function ticketRow(db: Db, id: string) {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(ticket).where(eq(ticket.id, id));
  assert.ok(row, `ticket ${id}`);
  return row;
}

async function movementReasons(db: Db, customerId: string) {
  return db
    .select({ kind: ticketMovement.kind, reason: ticketMovement.reason })
    .from(ticketMovement)
    .where(eq(ticketMovement.customerId, customerId))
    .orderBy(asc(ticketMovement.seq));
}

/** A paid purchase of `offerId`: startPurchase then fulfillPurchase, both at `now`. */
async function payOffer(h: DbHarness, customerId: string, offerId: string, now: Date): Promise<void> {
  const started = await startPurchase(h.db, { professionalId: h.pro.proId, offerId, customerId }, now);
  assert.equal(started.ok, true, JSON.stringify(started));
  if (!started.ok) return;
  await fulfillPurchase(
    h.db,
    started.purchaseId,
    { sessionId: `cs_test_${nanoid()}`, paymentIntentId: `pi_test_${nanoid()}`, livemode: false },
    now,
  );
}

dbTest("createCustomerCore: a new client, then an existing e-mail takes the pro's name and phone", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const email = testEmail();
  const first = must(
    await createCustomerCore(db, ctx, { name: "  Léa Martin ", email: ` ${email.toUpperCase()} `, phone: " 06 12 34 56 78 " }, now),
  );
  assert.equal(first.created, true);
  assert.deepEqual(first.effects, []);
  const row = await customerRow(db, first.customerId);
  assert.deepEqual(
    [row.name, row.email, row.phone, row.professionalId, row.linkVersion],
    ["Léa Martin", email, "06 12 34 56 78", pro.proId, 1],
  );

  // the same e-mail again: created false, the name is replaced, a missing phone keeps the old one
  const again = must(await createCustomerCore(db, ctx, { name: "Léa M.", email, phone: null }, now));
  assert.deepEqual([again.created, again.customerId], [false, first.customerId]);
  const after = await customerRow(db, first.customerId);
  assert.deepEqual([after.name, after.phone], ["Léa M.", "06 12 34 56 78"]);
  must(await createCustomerCore(db, ctx, { name: "Léa M.", email, phone: "07 00 00 00 00" }, now));
  assert.equal((await customerRow(db, first.customerId)).phone, "07 00 00 00 00");

  // another pro with the same e-mail has its own client
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const theirs = must(await createCustomerCore(db, proCtx(other), { name: "Chez l'autre", email, phone: null }, now));
    assert.equal(theirs.created, true);
    assert.notEqual(theirs.customerId, first.customerId);
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, first.customerId)).name, "Léa M.");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("updateCustomerCore: name and phone only, the e-mail is the key", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const email = testEmail();
  const id = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Ancien nom", email });
  must(await updateCustomerCore(db, ctx, { customerId: id, name: " Nouveau nom ", phone: " 06 00 00 00 00 " }, now));
  const row = await customerRow(db, id);
  assert.deepEqual([row.name, row.phone, row.email], ["Nouveau nom", "06 00 00 00 00", email]);
  must(await updateCustomerCore(db, ctx, { customerId: id, name: "Nouveau nom", phone: "" }, now));
  assert.equal((await customerRow(db, id)).phone, null);
  must(await updateCustomerCore(db, ctx, { customerId: id, name: "Nouveau nom", phone: null }, now));

  assert.equal(errorOf(await updateCustomerCore(db, ctx, { customerId: id, name: "  ", phone: null }, now)), "Nom : ce champ est obligatoire.");
  assert.equal(errorOf(await updateCustomerCore(db, ctx, { customerId: id, name: "Nom", phone: "0".repeat(31) }, now)), "Téléphone : 30 caractères au maximum.");
  assert.equal(errorOf(await updateCustomerCore(db, ctx, { customerId: "no-such-customer", name: "Nom", phone: null }, now)), CLIENT_NOT_FOUND);
  assert.equal((await customerRow(db, id)).name, "Nouveau nom");
});

dbTest("offerTicketsCore: valid through the end of the chosen day in the pro's zone, notify adds an effect", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const today = todayKey(now, pro.tz);

  const noLimit = must(
    await offerTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId, ticketTypeId: typeId, quantity: 3, lastValidDay: null, reason: "Cadeau", notify: false }, now),
  );
  assert.equal(noLimit.count, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(noLimit.effects, []);
  const todayOffer = must(
    await offerTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId, ticketTypeId: typeId, quantity: 1, lastValidDay: today, reason: null, notify: true }, now),
  );
  assert.equal(todayOffer.count, 1);
  assert.equal(todayOffer.effects.length, 1);
  const [effect] = todayOffer.effects;
  assert.ok(effect.type === "email.tickets_offered" && effect.customerId === customerId && effect.quantity === 1);

  const tickets = await ticketsOf(db, customerId);
  assert.equal(tickets.length, 4);
  assert.equal(tickets.filter((t) => t.expiresAt === null).length, 3);
  const limited = tickets.find((t) => t.expiresAt !== null);
  assert.equal(limited?.expiresAt?.getTime(), instantAt(addDays(today, 1), 0, pro.tz).getTime());
  assert.ok(tickets.every((t) => t.purchaseId === null && t.status === "available"));
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await movementReasons(db, customerId)).map((m) => [m.kind, m.reason]),
    [
      ["offer", "Cadeau"],
      ["offer", "Cadeau"],
      ["offer", "Cadeau"],
      ["offer", null],
    ],
  );

  // a pro in Los Angeles: the same day key ends at the next Los Angeles midnight
  const la = await createTestPro(db, { tz: "America/Los_Angeles" });
  try {
    const laType = await makeType(db, la, { name: "Cours LA" });
    const laCustomer = await makeCustomer(db, la);
    const laToday = todayKey(now, la.tz);
    must(
      await offerTicketsCore(db, proCtx(la), { customerId: laCustomer, ticketTypeId: laType, quantity: 1, lastValidDay: laToday, reason: null, notify: false }, now),
    );
    const [laTicket] = await ticketsOf(db, laCustomer);
    assert.equal(laTicket.expiresAt?.getTime(), instantAt(addDays(laToday, 1), 0, "America/Los_Angeles").getTime());
    assert.deepEqual(await checkInvariants(db, { proId: la.proId }), []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, la.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("convertTicketsCore: same type, unavailable targets, purchase and expiry kept", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const typeA = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const typeB = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours particulier" });
  const typeFree = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Appel découverte", rdvEnabled: true, rdvFree: true, rdvDurationMin: 30 });
  const typeArchived = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Stage d'été 2026" });
  const archived = await setTicketTypeArchived(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, ticketTypeId: typeArchived, archived: true });
  assert.equal(archived.ok, true);
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeA, { quantity: 3, priceCents: 5000, validityCount: 1, validityUnit: "month" });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  await payOffer(h, customerId, offerId, now);
  const [offered] = await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeA, 1);
  const paid = (await ticketsOf(db, customerId)).filter((t) => t.purchaseId !== null);
  assert.equal(paid.length, 3);
  assert.ok(paid.every((t) => t.expiresAt !== null));
  const convert = (ticketIds: string[], toTicketTypeId: string) =>
    convertTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId, ticketIds, toTicketTypeId }, now);

  assert.equal(errorOf(await convert([paid[0].id], typeA)), CONVERT_SAME_TYPE);
  assert.equal(errorOf(await convert([paid[0].id], typeFree)), CONVERT_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE);
  assert.equal(errorOf(await convert([paid[0].id], typeArchived)), CONVERT_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE);
  assert.equal(errorOf(await convert([paid[0].id], "no-such-type")), CONVERT_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE);
  assert.match(errorOf(await convert([], typeB)), /hoisissez au moins un élément\.$/);
  assert.ok((await ticketsOf(db, customerId)).every((t) => t.ticketTypeId === typeA));

  const ok = must(await convert([paid[0].id, paid[1].id, paid[1].id], typeB)); // a repeated id counts once
  assert.equal(ok.count, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(ok.effects, []);
  const after = await ticketsOf(db, customerId);
  for (const before of [paid[0], paid[1]]) {
    const moved = after.find((t) => t.id === before.id);
    assert.ok(moved);
    assert.equal(moved.ticketTypeId, typeB);
    assert.equal(moved.purchaseId, before.purchaseId);
    assert.equal(moved.expiresAt?.getTime(), before.expiresAt?.getTime());
    assert.deepEqual(
      (await movementsOf(db, before.id)).map((m) => m.kind),
      ["purchase", "convert"],
    );
  }
  assert.equal(after.find((t) => t.id === paid[2].id)?.ticketTypeId, typeA);

  // one ticket of the selection already has the target type
  assert.equal(errorOf(await convert([paid[0].id, paid[2].id], typeB)), CONVERT_SAME_TYPE);
  // a ticket that is not available any more
  must(await pointTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId, ticketIds: [offered], note: null }, now));
  assert.equal(errorOf(await convert([offered], typeB)), NO_TICKET);
});

dbTest("closeTicketsCore: reasons, notes and the paid / offered rule", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, { quantity: 2, priceCents: 3000, validityCount: 1, validityUnit: "month" });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  await payOffer(h, customerId, offerId, now);
  const offered = await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeId, 2);
  const paid = (await ticketsOf(db, customerId)).filter((t) => t.purchaseId !== null).map((t) => t.id);
  assert.equal(paid.length, 2);
  const close = (ticketIds: string[], reason: "rembourse" | "compense" | "autre", note: string | null) =>
    closeTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId, ticketIds, reason, note }, now);

  assert.equal(errorOf(await close([offered[0]], "rembourse", null)), "Un ticket offert se retire.");
  assert.equal(errorOf(await close([offered[0]], "compense", "geste")), "Un ticket offert se retire.");
  assert.equal(errorOf(await close([offered[0]], "autre", null)), "Précisez le motif.");
  assert.equal(errorOf(await close([offered[0]], "autre", "   ")), "Précisez le motif.");
  assert.equal(errorOf(await close([paid[0]], "retire" as never, null)), "Motif : choix invalide.");
  assert.equal(errorOf(await close([paid[0]], "autre", "x".repeat(501))), "Note : 500 caractères au maximum.");
  assert.ok((await ticketsOf(db, customerId)).every((t) => t.status === "available"));

  const refunded = must(await close([paid[0]], "rembourse", "Remboursé par virement"));
  assert.equal(refunded.count, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(refunded.effects, []);
  const refundedRow = await ticketRow(db, paid[0]);
  assert.deepEqual(
    [refundedRow.status, refundedRow.closedReason, refundedRow.closedNote],
    ["closed", "rembourse", "Remboursé par virement"],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await movementsOf(db, paid[0])).map((m) => m.kind),
    ["purchase", "close"],
  );
  must(await close([paid[1]], "compense", null));
  const compensatedRow = await ticketRow(db, paid[1]);
  assert.deepEqual([compensatedRow.status, compensatedRow.closedReason, compensatedRow.closedNote], ["closed", "compense", null]);
  must(await close([offered[0]], "autre", "geste commercial"));
  const otherRow = await ticketRow(db, offered[0]);
  assert.deepEqual([otherRow.status, otherRow.closedReason, otherRow.closedNote], ["closed", "autre", "geste commercial"]);

  // closed is final
  assert.equal(errorOf(await close([paid[0]], "autre", "encore")), NO_TICKET);
  assert.equal((await ticketRow(db, offered[1])).status, "available");
});

dbTest("retireTicketsCore: offered tickets only, a paid one points to « Clore »", async (h) => {
  const { db, pro } = h;
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, { quantity: 1, priceCents: 3000 });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  await payOffer(h, customerId, offerId, now);
  const offered = await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeId, 3);
  const [paid] = (await ticketsOf(db, customerId)).filter((t) => t.purchaseId !== null);
  const retire = (ticketIds: string[], note: string | null) => retireTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId, ticketIds, note }, now);

  assert.equal(errorOf(await retire([paid.id], "erreur")), "Un ticket payé ne peut pas être retiré : utilisez « Clore ».");
  assert.equal((await ticketRow(db, paid.id)).status, "available");

  const res = must(await retire([offered[0], offered[1]], "Cadeau en double"));
  assert.equal(res.count, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
  for (const id of [offered[0], offered[1]]) {
    const row = await ticketRow(db, id);
    assert.deepEqual([row.status, row.closedReason, row.closedNote], ["closed", "retire", "Cadeau en double"]);
  }
  must(await retire([offered[2]], null));
  const last = await ticketRow(db, offered[2]);
  assert.deepEqual([last.status, last.closedReason, last.closedNote], ["closed", "retire", null]);
  assert.equal((await ticketRow(db, paid.id)).status, "available");
});

dbTest("pointTicketsCore and unpointTicketsCore: explicit ids, a double submit changes nothing twice", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  const [o1, o2, o3] = await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeId, 3);
  const point = (ticketIds: string[], note: string | null) => pointTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId, ticketIds, note }, now);
  const unpoint = (ticketIds: string[]) => unpointTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId, ticketIds }, now);

  const res = must(await point([o1, o2], "Cours du jeudi"));
  assert.equal(res.count, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
  assert.deepEqual([(await ticketRow(db, o1)).status, (await ticketRow(db, o2)).status, (await ticketRow(db, o3)).status], ["used", "used", "available"]);
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await movementReasons(db, customerId)).filter((m) => m.kind === "pointage").map((m) => m.reason),
    ["Cours du jeudi", "Cours du jeudi"],
  );

  // the same request again (a double click): the tickets are already used, nothing moves twice
  assert.equal(errorOf(await point([o1, o2], "Cours du jeudi")), NO_TICKET);
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await movementsOf(db, o1)).map((m) => m.kind),
    ["offer", "pointage"],
  );
  assert.match(errorOf(await point([], null)), /hoisissez au moins un élément\.$/);
  assert.match(errorOf(await point(Array.from({ length: 101 }, (_, i) => `t${i}`), null)), /100 éléments au maximum\.$/);
  assert.equal(errorOf(await point([o3], "x".repeat(501))), "Note : 500 caractères au maximum.");
  assert.equal(must(await point([o3, o3], null)).count, 1); // a repeated id counts once

  const undone = must(await unpoint([o1, o2]));
  assert.equal(undone.count, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(undone.effects, []);
  assert.deepEqual([(await ticketRow(db, o1)).status, (await ticketRow(db, o2)).status], ["available", "available"]);
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await movementsOf(db, o1)).map((m) => m.kind),
    ["offer", "pointage", "unpoint"],
  );
  assert.equal(errorOf(await unpoint([o1, o2])), NO_TICKET);
  assert.equal((await movementsOf(db, o2)).length, 3);
});

dbTest("every client core refuses another pro's customer and tickets", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);

  const mine = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Ma cliente" });
  const [myTicket] = await giveTickets(db, pro, mine, typeMine, 1);
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const typeTheirs = await makeType(db, other, { name: "Type de l'autre" });
    const theirs = await makeCustomer(db, other, { name: "Sa cliente" });
    const [theirTicket] = await giveTickets(db, other, theirs, typeTheirs, 1);
    const offerInput = { quantity: 1, lastValidDay: null, reason: null, notify: false };

    assert.equal(errorOf(await updateCustomerCore(db, ctx, { customerId: theirs, name: "Pirate", phone: "0600000000" }, now)), CLIENT_NOT_FOUND);
    assert.equal(errorOf(await revokeLinksCore(db, ctx, { customerId: theirs }, now)), CLIENT_NOT_FOUND);
    assert.equal(errorOf(await offerTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId: theirs, ticketTypeId: typeMine, ...offerInput }, now)), TICKET_NOT_FOUND);
    assert.equal(errorOf(await offerTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId: mine, ticketTypeId: typeTheirs, ...offerInput }, now)), TICKET_NOT_FOUND);
    assert.equal(errorOf(await convertTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId: theirs, ticketIds: [theirTicket], toTicketTypeId: typeMine }, now)), TICKET_NOT_FOUND);
    assert.equal(errorOf(await convertTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId: mine, ticketIds: [theirTicket], toTicketTypeId: typeMine }, now)), TICKET_NOT_FOUND);
    assert.equal(errorOf(await closeTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId: theirs, ticketIds: [theirTicket], reason: "autre", note: "x" }, now)), TICKET_NOT_FOUND);
    assert.equal(errorOf(await retireTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId: theirs, ticketIds: [theirTicket], note: null }, now)), TICKET_NOT_FOUND);
    assert.equal(errorOf(await pointTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId: mine, ticketIds: [theirTicket], note: null }, now)), TICKET_NOT_FOUND);
    assert.equal(errorOf(await unpointTicketsCore(db, ctx, { customerId: theirs, ticketIds: [theirTicket] }, now)), TICKET_NOT_FOUND);

    const theirRow = await customerRow(db, theirs);
    assert.deepEqual([theirRow.name, theirRow.phone, theirRow.linkVersion], ["Sa cliente", null, 1]);
    const theirTicketRow = await ticketRow(db, theirTicket);
    assert.deepEqual([theirTicketRow.status, theirTicketRow.ticketTypeId], ["available", typeTheirs]);
    const myTicketRow = await ticketRow(db, myTicket);
    assert.deepEqual([myTicketRow.status, myTicketRow.ticketTypeId], ["available", typeMine]);
    assert.deepEqual(await checkInvariants(db, { proId: other.proId }), []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});
```
