- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `src/lib/back-office/client-actions.ts`**

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/lib/back-office/client-actions.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Client and wallet cores (spec § 11 E8, § 13.1). Thin wrappers in
 * src/server/pro-clients.ts add the session, the revalidation and the effects.
 * Every core: parseFr BEFORE the engine (no English zod message reaches the UI),
 * the refusals only this layer can make, then the engine, then fromEngine.
 * professionalId and actorUserId come from `ctx`, never from the input; every
 * id of the input is checked against that pro by the engine or by the read of
 * the core. Wallet actions take EXPLICIT ticket ids (OUT L125).
 */
import { and, eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { z } from "zod";

import { actionFail, fromEngine, type CoreResult, type ProCtx } from "@/lib/back-office/result";
import {
  closeTickets,
  convertTickets,
  createCustomer,
  offerTickets,
  pointTickets,
  revokeLinks,
  unpointTickets,
  updateCustomer,
} from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import type { DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { ticket, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { expiryFromLastDay } from "@/lib/ticket-expiry";
import { BOUNDS, customerInputSchema, dateKeySchema, idSchema } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

export const OFFER_RDV_FREE = "Un type « Gratuit » n'utilise pas de tickets : choisissez un autre type.";
export const CONVERT_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE = "Ce type ne peut pas recevoir de tickets.";
export const CONVERT_SAME_TYPE = "Choisissez un autre type de ticket.";
export const EXPIRY_IN_PAST = "La date de fin de validité doit être aujourd'hui ou plus tard.";

/** The explicit ticket ids of a wallet action: 1 to 100. */
export const ticketIdsSchema = z.array(idSchema).min(1).max(BOUNDS.walletQuantity);

const noteSchema = z.string().trim().max(BOUNDS.note).nullable();

/** Same name and phone rules as the engine's updateCustomer (src/lib/booking/wallet.ts). */
const customerEditSchema = z.object({
  customerId: idSchema,
  name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(BOUNDS.name),
  phone: z.string().trim().max(BOUNDS.phone).nullable(),
});

const customerIdSchema = z.object({ customerId: idSchema });

const offerTicketsSchema = z.object({
  customerId: idSchema,
  ticketTypeId: idSchema,
  quantity: z.number().int().min(1).max(BOUNDS.walletQuantity),
  lastValidDay: dateKeySchema.nullable(),
  reason: noteSchema,
  notify: z.boolean(),
});

const convertTicketsSchema = z.object({
  customerId: idSchema,
  ticketIds: ticketIdsSchema,
  toTicketTypeId: idSchema,
});

const closeTicketsSchema = z.object({
  customerId: idSchema,
  ticketIds: ticketIdsSchema,
  reason: z.enum(["rembourse", "compense", "autre"]),
  note: noteSchema,
});

const noteTicketsSchema = z.object({ customerId: idSchema, ticketIds: ticketIdsSchema, note: noteSchema });

const plainTicketsSchema = z.object({ customerId: idSchema, ticketIds: ticketIdsSchema });

/** A string trimmed, anything else as is (parseFr then reports it). */
const trimmed = (value: unknown): unknown => (typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : value);

/** Each id once, first-seen order: a repeated id must not make the engine refuse a valid selection. */
const unique = (ids: readonly string[]): string[] => [...new Set(ids)];

/** « Nouveau client »: parseFr(customerInputSchema); the pro's name (and phone, when given) win on an existing e-mail. */
export async function createCustomerCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { name: string; email: string; phone: string | null },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ customerId: string; created: boolean }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(customerInputSchema, {
    name: input.name,
    email: trimmed(input.email),
    phone: input.phone ?? undefined,
  });
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const res = await createCustomer(
    db,
    { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, name: parsed.data.name, email: parsed.data.email, phone: parsed.data.phone ?? null },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "customer");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, customerId: res.customerId, created: res.created };
}

/** Name and phone only (Q6: the e-mail is the record's key). */
export async function updateCustomerCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { customerId: string; name: string; phone: string | null },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult> {
  const parsed = parseFr(customerEditSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const res = await updateCustomer(
    db,
    { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, customerId: parsed.data.customerId, name: parsed.data.name, phone: parsed.data.phone },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "customer");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects };
}

/** « Déconnecter ses liens »: link_version + 1. */
export async function revokeLinksCore(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, input: { customerId: string }, now: Date): Promise<CoreResult> {
  const parsed = parseFr(customerIdSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const res = await revokeLinks(db, { professionalId: ctx.professionalId, customerId: parsed.data.customerId }, now);
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "customer");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects };
}

/**
 * « Offrir N »: an active non-rdv_free type (OFFER_RDV_FREE; a missing or
 * archived type is the engine's not_found); the chosen last valid day becomes
 * expiryFromLastDay(day, the pro's zone), which must be after now
 * (EXPIRY_IN_PAST); offerTickets, with the tickets_offered effect when `notify`.
 */
export async function offerTicketsCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: {
    customerId: string;
    ticketTypeId: string;
    quantity: number;
    lastValidDay: DateKey | null;
    reason: string | null;
    notify: boolean;
  },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ count: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(offerTicketsSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const data = parsed.data;
  const [type] = await db
    .select({ rdvFree: ticketType.rdvFree, archivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt })
    .from(ticketType)
    .where(and(eq(ticketType.id, data.ticketTypeId), eq(ticketType.professionalId, ctx.professionalId)));
  if (type && type.archivedAt === null && type.rdvFree) return actionFail(OFFER_RDV_FREE);
  const expiresAt = data.lastValidDay === null ? null : expiryFromLastDay(data.lastValidDay, ctx.timezone);
  if (expiresAt !== null && expiresAt.getTime() <= now.getTime()) return actionFail(EXPIRY_IN_PAST);
  const res = await offerTickets(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: ctx.professionalId,
      actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId,
      customerId: data.customerId,
      ticketTypeId: data.ticketTypeId,
      quantity: data.quantity,
      expiresAt,
      reason: data.reason,
      notify: data.notify,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "wallet");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, count: res.ticketIds.length };
}

/**
 * « Convertir »: explicit ids; the target must be an active, non-rdv_free type
 * of the pro (CONVERT_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, also for an unknown or foreign id);
 * a selected ticket of the customer that already has the target type is
 * CONVERT_SAME_TYPE; then convertTickets (purchase and expiry are kept).
 */
export async function convertTicketsCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { customerId: string; ticketIds: string[]; toTicketTypeId: string },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ count: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(convertTicketsSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const data = parsed.data;
  const ticketIds = unique(data.ticketIds);
  const [target] = await db
    .select({ rdvFree: ticketType.rdvFree, archivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt })
    .from(ticketType)
    .where(and(eq(ticketType.id, data.toTicketTypeId), eq(ticketType.professionalId, ctx.professionalId)));
  if (!target || target.archivedAt !== null || target.rdvFree) return actionFail(CONVERT_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE);
  const same = await db
    .select({ id: ticket.id })
    .from(ticket)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticket.professionalId, ctx.professionalId),
        eq(ticket.customerId, data.customerId),
        inArray(ticket.id, ticketIds),
        eq(ticket.ticketTypeId, data.toTicketTypeId),
      ),
    );
  if (same.length > 0) return actionFail(CONVERT_SAME_TYPE);
  const res = await convertTickets(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: ctx.professionalId,
      actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId,
      customerId: data.customerId,
      selection: { ticketIds },
      toTicketTypeId: data.toTicketTypeId,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "wallet");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, count: res.ticketIds.length };
}

/** « Clore » (rembourse / compense: paid tickets; autre: any ticket, the note is required); closeTickets. */
export async function closeTicketsCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { customerId: string; ticketIds: string[]; reason: "rembourse" | "compense" | "autre"; note: string | null },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ count: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(closeTicketsSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const data = parsed.data;
  const res = await closeTickets(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: ctx.professionalId,
      actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId,
      customerId: data.customerId,
      selection: { ticketIds: unique(data.ticketIds) },
      reason: data.reason,
      note: data.note,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "wallet");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, count: res.ticketIds.length };
}

/** « Retirer » (offered tickets): closeTickets with the reason retire; a paid ticket is refused by the engine (retire_paid). */
export async function retireTicketsCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { customerId: string; ticketIds: string[]; note: string | null },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ count: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(noteTicketsSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const data = parsed.data;
  const res = await closeTickets(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: ctx.professionalId,
      actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId,
      customerId: data.customerId,
      selection: { ticketIds: unique(data.ticketIds) },
      reason: "retire",
      note: data.note,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "wallet");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, count: res.ticketIds.length };
}

/** « Pointer »: explicit ids (OUT L125: never a quantity); the note goes to the movement's reason. */
export async function pointTicketsCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { customerId: string; ticketIds: string[]; note: string | null },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ count: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(noteTicketsSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const data = parsed.data;
  const res = await pointTickets(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: ctx.professionalId,
      actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId,
      customerId: data.customerId,
      selection: { ticketIds: unique(data.ticketIds) },
      note: data.note,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "wallet");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, count: res.ticketIds.length };
}

/** « Annuler le pointage »: explicit ids. */
export async function unpointTicketsCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: { customerId: string; ticketIds: string[] },
  now: Date,
): Promise<CoreResult<{ count: number }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(plainTicketsSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const data = parsed.data;
  const res = await unpointTickets(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: ctx.professionalId,
      actorUserId: ctx.actorUserId,
      customerId: data.customerId,
      selection: { ticketIds: unique(data.ticketIds) },
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngine(res, "wallet");
  return { ok: true, effects: res.effects, count: res.ticketIds.length };
}
```

```ts
"use server";

import {
  closeTicketsCore,

// Clients and wallets: every action revalidates the dashboard layout (runProAction); no public page changes.

export async function createCustomerAction(input: {
  name: string;

}): Promise<ActionResult<{ customerId: string; created: boolean }>> {

}): Promise<ActionResult> {

  ticketIds: string[];

}): Promise<ActionResult<{ count: number }>> {

  ticketIds: string[];
  reason: "rembourse" | "compense" | "autre";
  note: string | null;

  ticketIds: string[];
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Let `FilterChips` scroll inside its own row**

The contract asks that the chips row scrolls inside itself at 375 px (the page never scrolls sideways). Replace the whole file `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/components/admin/filter-chips.tsx` with:

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * A row of link "chips" for one search-param filter (no client JS). With
 * `scrollable` the chips stay on ONE line that scrolls inside its own row below
 * 640 px (the page never scrolls sideways) and wrap from 640 px up.
 */
export function FilterChips<T extends string | number>({
  label,
  active,
  options,
  scrollable = false,
}: {
  label: string;
  active: T;
  options: { value: T; label: string; href: string }[];
  scrollable?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <nav
      aria-label={label}
      className={cn(
        "flex gap-1.5",
        scrollable ? "overflow-x-auto pb-1 sm:flex-wrap sm:overflow-visible sm:pb-0" : "flex-wrap",
      )}
    >
      {options.map((o) => {
        const isActive = o.value === active;
        return (
          <Link
            key={String(o.value)}
            href={o.href}
            aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
            className={cn(
              "rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors",
              scrollable && "shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap",
              isActive
                ? "border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
                : "border-border bg-card text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground",
            )}
          >
            {o.label}
          </Link>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";

import { StatusMark } from "@/components/dashboard/status-mark";
import { TypeChip } from "@/components/dashboard/type-chip";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { ClientListRow } from "@/lib/back-office/client-reads";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { ALERT_LABELS } from "@/lib/back-office/labels";

function Holdings({ row }: { row: ClientListRow }) {
  if (row.holdings.length === 0) {
    return <span className="text-muted-foreground">Aucun ticket utilisable</span>;
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      {row.holdings.map((h) => (
        <TypeChip key={h.ticketTypeId} name={h.name} color={h.color} archived={h.archived} count={h.usable} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Desktop cell: the marks alone (each has an accessible name and a tooltip). */
function AlertMarks({ row }: { row: ClientListRow }) {
  if (!row.red && !row.orange) return null;
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
      {row.red && <StatusMark tone="red" />}
      {row.orange && <StatusMark tone="orange" />}
    </span>
  );
}

/** Mobile card: the mark carries the accessible name, the visible text is hidden from assistive technology. */
function AlertLines({ row }: { row: ClientListRow }) {
  if (!row.red && !row.orange) return null;
  return (
    <div className="mt-3 space-y-1">
      {row.red && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-destructive">
          <StatusMark tone="red" />
          <span aria-hidden="true">{ALERT_LABELS.red}</span>
        </p>
      )}
      {row.orange && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-foreground">
          <StatusMark tone="orange" />
          <span aria-hidden="true">{ALERT_LABELS.orange}</span>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Clients of the pro: a table from 640 px, cards below. Every row opens the client record. */
export function ClientList({ rows }: { rows: ClientListRow[] }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Card className="hidden overflow-hidden sm:block">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead className="bg-muted/50 text-left text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <tr>
                <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-2.5 font-medium">Client</th>
                <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-2.5 font-medium">Tickets</th>
                <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-2.5 font-medium">À venir</th>
                <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-2.5 font-medium">Alertes</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-muted/40">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <Link href={`/dashboard/clients/${r.id}`} className="font-medium hover:underline">
                      {r.name}
                    </Link>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.email}</p>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <Holdings row={r} />
                  </td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-muted-foreground">
                    {r.upcomingConfirmed > 0 ? plural(r.upcomingConfirmed, "inscription", "inscriptions") : "Aucune"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <AlertMarks row={r} />
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <ul className="space-y-3 sm:hidden">
        {rows.map((r) => (
          <li key={r.id}>
            <Link
              href={`/dashboard/clients/${r.id}`}
              className="block rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4 shadow-(--shadow-card) transition-colors hover:bg-muted/40 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              <p className="truncate font-medium">{r.name}</p>
              <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.email}</p>
              <div className="mt-3 text-sm">
                <Holdings row={r} />
              </div>
              {r.upcomingConfirmed > 0 && (
                <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {`${plural(r.upcomingConfirmed, "inscription", "inscriptions")} à venir`}
                </p>
              )}
              <AlertLines row={r} />
            </Link>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `src/components/dashboard/new-client-button.tsx`**

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/components/dashboard/new-client-button.tsx`. Validation runs in the browser with the same schema as the engine (`parseFr(customerInputSchema)`), so a bad field is shown under its own input and the dialog stays filled when the action fails. Success navigates with `router.push` alone (no `router.refresh()`).

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2, Plus } from "lucide-react";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { customerInputSchema } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";
import { createCustomerAction } from "@/server/pro-clients";

const EMAIL_HELP = "L'email identifie la fiche : il ne se modifie pas.";

/** aria-describedby for a FormField child: its help id and/or its error id. */
function describedBy(id: string, hasHelp: boolean, hasError: boolean): string | undefined {
  const ids = [hasHelp ? `${id}-help` : null, hasError ? `${id}-error` : null].filter(Boolean);
  return ids.length > 0 ? ids.join(" ") : undefined;
}

export function NewClientButton() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  function openDialog() {
    setName("");
    setEmail("");
    setPhone("");
    setFieldErrors({});
    setError(null);
    setOpen(true);
  }

  function closeDialog() {
    if (!pending) setOpen(false);
  }

  function submit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    setError(null);
    const parsed = parseFr(customerInputSchema, {
      name,
      email: email.trim(),
      phone: phone.trim() === "" ? undefined : phone,
    });
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      setFieldErrors(parsed.fieldErrors);
      return;
    }
    setFieldErrors({});
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await createCustomerAction({
        name: parsed.data.name,
        email: parsed.data.email,
        phone: parsed.data.phone ?? null,
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      router.push(`/dashboard/clients/${res.customerId}`);
    });
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Button onClick={openDialog}>
        <Plus />
        Nouveau client
      </Button>
      <Dialog open={open} onClose={closeDialog} title="Nouveau client">
        <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
          <FormField label="Nom" htmlFor="new-client-name" error={fieldErrors.name}>
            <Input
              id="new-client-name"
              name="name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="off"
              autoFocus
              aria-invalid={fieldErrors.name ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={describedBy("new-client-name", false, Boolean(fieldErrors.name))}
            />
          </FormField>
          <FormField label="Email" htmlFor="new-client-email" help={EMAIL_HELP} error={fieldErrors.email}>
            <Input
              id="new-client-email"
              name="email"
              type="email"
              inputMode="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="off"
              aria-invalid={fieldErrors.email ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={describedBy("new-client-email", true, Boolean(fieldErrors.email))}
            />
          </FormField>
          <FormField label="Téléphone" htmlFor="new-client-phone" optional error={fieldErrors.phone}>
            <Input
              id="new-client-phone"
              name="phone"
              type="tel"
              value={phone}
              onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="off"
              aria-invalid={fieldErrors.phone ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={describedBy("new-client-phone", false, Boolean(fieldErrors.phone))}
            />
          </FormField>
          <FormError message={error} />
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={closeDialog} disabled={pending}>
              Annuler
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
              {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
              Créer la fiche
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}
```

Replace the whole file `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/app/dashboard/clients/page.tsx` (today it renders `ComingSoon`) with the following. `searchParams` is a `Promise` (Next 16); `q` is trimmed and capped at 100 characters, a repeated `?q=a&q=b` is ignored; the « Nouveau client » button sits in the header, except in the empty state where it is the empty state's action (one button, one intent).

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Users } from "lucide-react";

import { FilterChips } from "@/components/admin/filter-chips";
import { ClientList } from "@/components/dashboard/client-list";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/dashboard/empty-state";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { NewClientButton } from "@/components/dashboard/new-client-button";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/page-header";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  CLIENT_FILTERS,
  CLIENT_FILTER_LABELS,
  clientsHref,
  parseClientFilter,
} from "@/lib/back-office/client-filters";
import { getClientsPage } from "@/server/client-queries";
import { requireProContext } from "@/server/pro-context";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Clients" };

const DESCRIPTION = "Les personnes qui réservent chez vous et leurs tickets.";

export default async function ClientsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ filter?: string | string[]; q?: string | string[] }>;
}) {
  const ctx = await requireProContext();
  const params = await searchParams;
  const filter = parseClientFilter(params.filter);
  // A repeated ?q=a&q=b arrives as an array: ignore it rather than crash.
  const q = (typeof params.q === "string" ? params.q : "").trim().slice(0, 100);
  const { rows, counts } = await getClientsPage(ctx.professionalId, { q, filter });

  if (counts.tous === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        <PageHeader title="Clients" description={DESCRIPTION} />
        <EmptyState
          icon={Users}
          title="Vos clients apparaîtront ici"
          description="Ils sont créés à leur première réservation ou à leur premier achat. Vous pouvez aussi en ajouter un."
          action={<NewClientButton />}
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  const emptyText = q !== "" ? `Aucun client ne correspond à « ${q} ».` : "Aucun client dans ce filtre.";

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Clients" description={DESCRIPTION} action={<NewClientButton />} />

      <div className="mb-5 space-y-3">
        <form action="/dashboard/clients" role="search" className="flex max-w-md items-end gap-2">
          {filter !== "tous" && <input type="hidden" name="filter" value={filter} />}
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <FormField label="Rechercher" htmlFor="client-search">
              <Input
                key={q}
                id="client-search"
                name="q"
                type="search"
                defaultValue={q}
                maxLength={100}
                autoComplete="off"
              />
            </FormField>
          </div>
          <Button type="submit" variant="secondary">
            Rechercher
          </Button>
        </form>
        <FilterChips
          label="Filtrer"
          active={filter}
          scrollable
          options={CLIENT_FILTERS.map((f) => ({
            value: f,
            label: `${CLIENT_FILTER_LABELS[f]} (${counts[f]})`,
            href: clientsHref(f, q),
          }))}
        />
      </div>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <p role="status" className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {emptyText}
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <ClientList rows={rows} />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Create `src/components/dashboard/client-header.tsx`**

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/components/dashboard/client-header.tsx`. The edit form is filled from the CURRENT props each time « Modifier » is pressed (never from a stale initial state), the action reads `customer.id` at submit time, and nothing calls `router.refresh()`: the action revalidates the dashboard layout and Next updates the page.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Check, Loader2, Pencil, Unlink } from "lucide-react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { revokeLinksCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import { revokeLinksAction, updateCustomerAction } from "@/server/pro-clients";

const EMAIL_HELP = "L'email identifie la fiche : il ne se modifie pas.";

type HeaderCustomer = { id: string; name: string; email: string; phone: string | null; linkedAccount: boolean };

export function ClientHeader({ customer }: { customer: HeaderCustomer }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [editError, setEditError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saving, startSave] = useTransition();
  const [revokeOpen, setRevokeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [revokeError, setRevokeError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [revoking, startRevoke] = useTransition();

  function startEditing() {
    setName(customer.name);
    setPhone(customer.phone ?? "");
    setEditError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    setEditing(true);
  }

  function save(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    setEditError(null);
    startSave(async () => {
      const res = await updateCustomerAction({
        customerId: customer.id,
        name,
        phone: phone.trim() === "" ? null : phone,
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setEditError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setEditing(false);
    });
  }

  function openRevoke() {
    setRevokeError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    setRevokeOpen(true);
  }

  function confirmRevoke() {
    startRevoke(async () => {
      const res = await revokeLinksAction({ customerId: customer.id });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setRevokeError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setRevokeOpen(false);
      setNotice("Liens déconnectés.");
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Fiche</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {editing ? (
          <form onSubmit={save} noValidate className="space-y-4">
            <FormField label="Nom" htmlFor="client-name">
              <Input
                id="client-name"
                name="name"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                autoComplete="off"
                autoFocus
              />
            </FormField>
            <FormField label="Téléphone" htmlFor="client-phone" optional>
              <Input
                id="client-phone"
                name="phone"
                type="tel"
                value={phone}
                onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                autoComplete="off"
              />
            </FormField>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Email</p>
              <p className="break-all text-sm text-muted-foreground">{customer.email}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{EMAIL_HELP}</p>
            </div>
            <FormError message={editError} />
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={saving}>
                {saving && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
                Enregistrer
              </Button>
              <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setEditing(false)} disabled={saving}>
                Annuler
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
              <p className="break-words font-semibold">{customer.name}</p>
              <p className="break-all text-sm text-muted-foreground">{customer.email}</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{customer.phone ?? "Pas de téléphone"}</p>
            </div>
            <Badge variant={customer.linkedAccount ? "success" : "neutral"}>
              {customer.linkedAccount ? "Compte client lié" : "Pas de compte client"}
            </Badge>
            {notice && (
              <p role="status" className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-success-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground">
                <Check className="size-4 shrink-0 text-success" aria-hidden="true" />
                {notice}
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button type="button" variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={startEditing}>
                <Pencil />
                Modifier
              </Button>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={openRevoke}>
                <Unlink />
                Déconnecter ses liens
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={revokeOpen}
        copy={revokeLinksCopy({ name: customer.name })}
        pending={revoking}
        error={revokeError}
        onConfirm={confirmRevoke}
        onClose={() => {
          if (!revoking) setRevokeOpen(false);
        }}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}
```

It is read-only in this task; `customerId`, `typeOptions` and `todayKey` are part of the props now (the page passes them) and are used by Task 35, which mounts `OfferTicketsButton` and `WalletGroupActions` at the two anchor comments below.

```tsx
import { Ticket } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/dashboard/empty-state";
import { StatusMark } from "@/components/dashboard/status-mark";
import { TypeChip } from "@/components/dashboard/type-chip";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { TypeOption } from "@/lib/back-office/catalog-reads";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import type { WalletGroup, WalletTicketView } from "@/lib/back-office/wallet-view";
import type { DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type ClientWalletProps = {
  customerId: string;
  groups: WalletGroup[];
  typeOptions: TypeOption[];
  todayKey: DateKey;
};

function TicketLine({ view }: { view: WalletTicketView }) {
  return (
    <li
      className={cn(
        "text-sm",
        view.tone === "red" && "text-destructive",
        view.tone === "muted" && "text-muted-foreground",
        view.struck && "line-through",
      )}
    >
      {view.origin} · {view.line}
    </li>
  );
}

function WalletGroupSection({ group }: { group: WalletGroup }) {
  const live = [...group.usable, ...group.booked, ...group.expired];
  return (
    <section aria-label={group.name} className="space-y-3 py-5 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">
          <TypeChip name={group.name} color={group.color} archived={group.archived} />
        </h3>
        {/* Task 35 anchor: <WalletGroupActions customerId={customerId} group={{ ticketTypeId: group.ticketTypeId, name: group.name, ids: group.ids }} typeOptions={typeOptions} /> */}
      </div>

      {group.alert === "red" && (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-destructive">
          <StatusMark tone="red" className="mt-1.5" />
          <span>Type archivé : ces tickets ne servent plus. Proposez « Convertir ».</span>
        </p>
      )}
      {group.alert === "orange" && (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-foreground">
          <StatusMark tone="orange" className="mt-1.5" />
          <span>Lié à aucun événement à venir.</span>
        </p>
      )}

      <div>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium">{plural(group.usableCount, "ticket utilisable", "tickets utilisables")}</p>
        {group.expirySummary.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="mt-1 space-y-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {group.expirySummary.map((line) => (
              <li key={line}>{line}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>

      {live.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="space-y-1">
          {live.map((view) => (
            <TicketLine key={view.id} view={view} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {group.done.length > 0 && (
        <details>
          <summary className="cursor-pointer rounded text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring">
            {`Utilisés et clos (${group.done.length})`}
          </summary>
          <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">
            {group.done.map((view) => (
              <TicketLine key={view.id} view={view} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        </details>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** « Portefeuille »: one section per ticket type the client holds tickets of (read-only until Task 35). */
export function ClientWallet({ groups }: ClientWalletProps) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <CardTitle>Portefeuille</CardTitle>
        {/* Task 35 anchor: <OfferTicketsButton customerId={customerId} typeOptions={typeOptions} todayKey={todayKey} /> */}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {groups.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState icon={Ticket} title="Aucun ticket" />
        ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-border">
            {groups.map((group) => (
              <WalletGroupSection key={group.ticketTypeId} group={group} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { ClientPurchaseRow } from "@/lib/back-office/client-reads";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { formatDateShort } from "@/lib/datetime";
import { PURCHASE_STATUS_LABELS, type PurchaseStatus } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils";

const STATUS_VARIANT: Record<PurchaseStatus, "success" | "warning" | "neutral"> = {
  paid: "success",
  pending: "warning",
  expired: "neutral",
};

/** « Achats »: the client's purchases, newest first; a « Test » badge marks payments made in test mode. */
export function ClientPurchases({ purchases, tz }: { purchases: ClientPurchaseRow[]; tz: string }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Achats</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {purchases.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-4 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucun achat.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
            {purchases.map((p) => (
              <li key={p.id} className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{p.label}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {`${formatDateShort(p.paidAt ?? p.createdAt, tz)} · ${plural(p.quantity, "ticket", "tickets")}`}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-end gap-1">
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium">{formatMoney(p.amountCents, p.currency)}</span>
                  <span className="flex gap-1">
                    <Badge variant={STATUS_VARIANT[p.status]}>{PURCHASE_STATUS_LABELS[p.status]}</Badge>
                    {!p.livemode && <Badge variant="outline">Test</Badge>}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

Create `C:/Users/Matheus/Documents/Codage/skedul/.claude/worktrees/tickets/src/components/dashboard/ledger-list.tsx`. The first 30 lines are always visible; the rest sit under « Afficher tout l'historique (n) », where n is the number of lines that disclosure reveals (Decision 46).

```tsx
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { HistoryLine } from "@/lib/back-office/history";

const VISIBLE_LINES = 30;

function Lines({ lines }: { lines: HistoryLine[] }) {
  return (
    <ol className="divide-y divide-border">
      {lines.map((line) => (
        <li key={line.key} className="py-2 text-sm first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
          {line.text}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

/** « Historique »: the client's ledger as readable lines, newest action first. */
export function LedgerList({ lines }: { lines: HistoryLine[] }) {
  const shown = lines.slice(0, VISIBLE_LINES);
  const rest = lines.slice(VISIBLE_LINES);
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Historique</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {lines.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-4 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucun mouvement.</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Lines lines={shown} />
            {rest.length > 0 && (
              <details className="mt-3">
                <summary className="cursor-pointer rounded text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring">
                  {`Afficher tout l'historique (${rest.length})`}
                </summary>
                <div className="mt-3">
                  <Lines lines={rest} />
                </div>
              </details>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

An unknown id or another pro's client answers `notFound()`. The sections are direct children of one grid, written in the reading order (Fiche, Portefeuille, Achats, Historique; « Inscriptions » joins between Portefeuille and Achats in Task 35), so the DOM, the accessibility tree and the tab order match what a phone shows (no `contents` wrapper, no `order-*`). One column below 1024 px; from `lg` each child is placed explicitly: the wallet and the history in the two left columns, the Fiche and the purchases stacked in the right one (the wallet spans rows 1 and 2, the purchases span the last, `1fr`, row, so the right column never leaves a hole under the Fiche and a tall purchases card only stretches the last row). Task 35 edits this file at the « Task 35 anchor » comment: it mounts the bookings slot as a fourth row (grid rows `auto_auto_auto_1fr`, the purchases wrapper `lg:row-span-3`, the history wrapper `lg:row-start-4`).

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";

import { ClientHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/client-header";
import { ClientPurchases } from "@/components/dashboard/client-purchases";
import { ClientWallet } from "@/components/dashboard/client-wallet";
import { LedgerList } from "@/components/dashboard/ledger-list";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/page-header";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { todayKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { getClientRecordPage } from "@/server/client-queries";
import { requireProContext } from "@/server/pro-context";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Fiche client" };

export default async function ClientRecordPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const ctx = await requireProContext();
  const { id } = await params;
  const record = await getClientRecordPage(ctx.professionalId, id);
  if (!record) notFound();
  const today = todayKey(new Date(), ctx.timezone);
  const { customer } = record;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={customer.name}
        description={customer.email}
        action={
          <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">
            <Link href="/dashboard/clients">
              <ArrowLeft />
              Tous les clients
            </Link>
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-rows-[auto_auto_1fr] lg:items-start">
        <div className="lg:col-start-3 lg:row-start-1">
          <ClientHeader
            customer={{
              id: customer.id,
              name: customer.name,
              email: customer.email,
              phone: customer.phone,
              linkedAccount: customer.linkedAccount,
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 lg:col-start-1 lg:row-span-2 lg:row-start-1">
          <ClientWallet
            customerId={customer.id}
            groups={record.wallet}
            typeOptions={record.typeOptions}
            todayKey={today}
          />
        </div>
        {/* Task 35 anchor: <div className="lg:col-span-2 lg:col-start-1 lg:row-start-3"><ClientBookings customerName={customer.name} upcoming={record.bookings.upcoming} past={record.bookings.past} /></div> */}
        <div className="lg:col-start-3 lg:row-span-2 lg:row-start-2">
          <ClientPurchases purchases={record.purchases} tz={ctx.timezone} />
        </div>
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 lg:col-start-1 lg:row-start-3">
          <LedgerList lines={record.history} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

Design notes for the implementer (binding):
- Every dialog is mounted only while open (`{open && <XDialog />}`), so its form state resets on each opening and a failed action leaves the form filled. Row dialogs of `ClientBookings` keep the booking **id**, never the row object (Review Focus 3).
- The wallet actions always send explicit ticket ids: `ids.<list>.slice(0, n)` (decision 47). No quantity is ever sent.
- No component calls `router.refresh()`: every success goes through `runProAction`, which revalidates the dashboard layout and Next 16 updates the page itself.
- The « Jusqu'au » day is a `DateKey` typed in an `<input type="date">` and compared as a string with the server-supplied `todayKey`; the browser zone is never used (Review Focus 2).
- Notices use `text-foreground` with a green icon (the `text-success` token alone is below WCAG AA on white).

Write the whole file:

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, Gift, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
import type { TypeOption } from "@/lib/back-office/catalog-reads";
import { closeTicketsCopy, retireTicketsCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import type { WalletGroup } from "@/lib/back-office/wallet-view";
import type { DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { BOUNDS, CLOSE_REASON_LABELS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import {
  closeTicketsAction,
  convertTicketsAction,
  offerTicketsAction,
  pointTicketsAction,
  retireTicketsAction,
  unpointTicketsAction,
} from "@/server/pro-clients";

const UNEXPECTED = "Une erreur inattendue est survenue. Réessayez dans un instant.";
const NO_ACTIVE_TYPE = "Aucun type actif : créez-en un dans";

type CountResult = { ok: true; count: number } | { ok: false; error: string };

/** One Server Action call at a time: the count on success, null on failure (the French error is kept in `error`). */
function useSubmit() {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function run(call: () => Promise<CountResult>): Promise<number | null> {
    if (pending) return null;
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await call();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return null;
      }
      return res.count;
    } catch {
      setError(UNEXPECTED);
      return null;
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return { pending, error, setError, run };
}

/** A whole number from 1 to max, else null. */
function parseCount(raw: string, max: number): number | null {
  const text = raw.trim();
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(text)) return null;
  const n = Number(text);
  return n >= 1 && n <= max ? n : null;
}

function countMessage(max: number): string {
  return max === 1 ? "Indiquez 1." : `Indiquez un nombre entier entre 1 et ${max}.`;
}

function cleanNote(raw: string): string | null {
  const text = raw.trim();
  return text === "" ? null : text;
}

function Notice({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <p role="status" className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-sm text-foreground">
      <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-success" aria-hidden />
      {message}
    </p>
  );
}

function FormFooter({
  onBack,
  pending,
  submitLabel,
  disabled = false,
}: {
  onBack: () => void;
  pending: boolean;
  submitLabel: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={onBack} disabled={pending}>
        Retour
      </Button>
      <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || disabled}>
        {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
        {submitLabel}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

function QuantityField({
  id,
  value,
  max,
  error,
  onChange,
}: {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  max: number;
  error: string | null;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <FormField label="Nombre" htmlFor={id} error={error} help={max > 1 ? `Entre 1 et ${max}.` : undefined}>
      <Input
        id={id}
        type="number"
        inputMode="numeric"
        min={1}
        max={max}
        step={1}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
      />
    </FormField>
  );
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Offrir des tickets ───────────────────────────── */

export function OfferTicketsButton({
  customerId,
  typeOptions,
  todayKey,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  typeOptions: TypeOption[];
  todayKey: DateKey;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2 sm:items-end">
      <Button
        type="button"
        size="sm"
        onClick={() => {
          setNotice(null);
          setOpen(true);
        }}
      >
        <Gift aria-hidden />
        Offrir des tickets
      </Button>
      {notice && <Notice message={notice} />}
      {open && (
        <OfferDialog
          customerId={customerId}
          typeOptions={typeOptions}
          todayKey={todayKey}
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          onDone={(message) => {
            setOpen(false);
            setNotice(message);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function OfferDialog({
  customerId,
  typeOptions,
  todayKey,
  onClose,
  onDone,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  typeOptions: TypeOption[];
  todayKey: DateKey;
  onClose: () => void;
  onDone: (message: string) => void;
}) {
  const options = typeOptions.filter((t) => !t.rdvFree);
  const [typeId, setTypeId] = useState(options[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("1");
  const [validity, setValidity] = useState<"none" | "until">("none");
  const [until, setUntil] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [notify, setNotify] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<{ quantity?: string; until?: string }>({});
  const { pending, error, run } = useSubmit();

  // The list can change while the dialog is open (a type archived elsewhere).
  const selectedType = options.some((t) => t.id === typeId) ? typeId : (options[0]?.id ?? "");

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const n = parseCount(quantity, BOUNDS.walletQuantity);
    const next: { quantity?: string; until?: string } = {};
    if (n === null) next.quantity = countMessage(BOUNDS.walletQuantity);
    if (validity === "until") {
      if (until === "") next.until = "Choisissez le dernier jour de validité.";
      else if (until < todayKey) next.until = "La date de fin de validité doit être aujourd'hui ou plus tard.";
    }
    setErrors(next);
    if (n === null || next.until || selectedType === "") return;

    const count = await run(() =>
      offerTicketsAction({
        customerId,
        ticketTypeId: selectedType,
        quantity: n,
        lastValidDay: validity === "until" ? until : null,
        reason: cleanNote(reason),
        notify,
      }),
    );
    if (count !== null) onDone(`${plural(count, "ticket offert", "tickets offerts")}.`);
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open onClose={onClose} title="Offrir des tickets">
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
        {options.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {NO_ACTIVE_TYPE}{" "}
            <Link href="/dashboard/tickets" className="font-medium text-primary hover:underline">
              Tickets
            </Link>
            .
          </p>
        ) : (
          <FormField label="Type" htmlFor="offer-type">
            <Select id="offer-type" value={selectedType} onChange={(e) => setTypeId(e.target.value)}>
              {options.map((t) => (
                <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                  {t.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </FormField>
        )}

        <FormField label="Quantité" htmlFor="offer-quantity" error={errors.quantity}>
          <Input
            id="offer-quantity"
            type="number"
            inputMode="numeric"
            min={1}
            max={BOUNDS.walletQuantity}
            step={1}
            value={quantity}
            onChange={(e) => setQuantity(e.target.value)}
          />
        </FormField>

        <fieldset className="space-y-2">
          <legend className="text-sm font-medium">Validité</legend>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="offer-validity"
              className="size-4 accent-primary"
              checked={validity === "none"}
              onChange={() => setValidity("none")}
            />
            Sans limite
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="offer-validity"
                className="size-4 accent-primary"
                checked={validity === "until"}
                onChange={() => setValidity("until")}
              />
              {"Jusqu'au"}
            </label>
            <Input
              id="offer-until"
              type="date"
              aria-label="Dernier jour de validité"
              min={todayKey}
              value={until}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setUntil(e.target.value);
                setValidity("until");
              }}
              className="w-auto"
            />
          </div>
          {errors.until && (
            <p id="offer-until-error" role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
              {errors.until}
            </p>
          )}
        </fieldset>

        <FormField label="Motif" htmlFor="offer-reason" optional>
          <Input id="offer-reason" maxLength={BOUNDS.note} value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} />
        </FormField>

        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            className="size-4 accent-primary"
            checked={notify}
            onChange={(e) => setNotify(e.target.checked)}
          />
          Prévenir le client par email
        </label>

        <FormError message={error} />
        <FormFooter onBack={onClose} pending={pending} submitLabel="Offrir" disabled={options.length === 0} />
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Actions d'un groupe ───────────────────────────── */

type DialogKind = "point" | "unpoint" | "convert" | "close" | "retire";

type GroupDialogProps = {
  customerId: string;
  groupName: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onDone: (message: string) => void;
};

export function WalletGroupActions({
  customerId,
  group,
  typeOptions,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  group: { ticketTypeId: string; name: string; ids: WalletGroup["ids"] };
  typeOptions: TypeOption[];
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<DialogKind | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { ids } = group;

  const buttons: { kind: DialogKind; label: string; available: number }[] = [
    { kind: "point", label: "Pointer", available: ids.point.length },
    { kind: "unpoint", label: "Annuler le pointage", available: ids.unpoint.length },
    { kind: "convert", label: "Convertir", available: ids.convert.length },
    { kind: "close", label: "Clore", available: ids.closeAny.length },
    { kind: "retire", label: "Retirer", available: ids.retire.length },
  ];
  const visible = buttons.filter((b) => b.available > 0);
  if (visible.length === 0 && notice === null) return null;

  const common = {
    customerId,
    groupName: group.name,
    onClose: () => setOpen(null),
    onDone: (message: string) => {
      setOpen(null);
      setNotice(message);
    },
  };

  return (
    <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 border-t border-border pt-3">
      {visible.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {visible.map((b) => (
            <Button
              key={b.kind}
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setNotice(null);
                setOpen(b.kind);
              }}
            >
              {b.label}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {notice && <Notice message={notice} />}
      {open === "point" && <PointDialog {...common} ids={ids.point} />}
      {open === "unpoint" && <UnpointDialog {...common} ids={ids.unpoint} />}
      {open === "convert" && (
        <ConvertDialog {...common} ids={ids.convert} fromTypeId={group.ticketTypeId} typeOptions={typeOptions} />
      )}
      {open === "close" && <CloseDialog {...common} ids={ids} />}
      {open === "retire" && <RetireDialog {...common} ids={ids.retire} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function PointDialog({ customerId, groupName, ids, onClose, onDone }: GroupDialogProps & { ids: string[] }) {
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("1");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [quantityError, setQuantityError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { pending, error, run } = useSubmit();

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const n = parseCount(quantity, ids.length);
    if (n === null) {
      setQuantityError(countMessage(ids.length));
      return;
    }
    setQuantityError(null);
    const count = await run(() => pointTicketsAction({ customerId, ticketIds: ids.slice(0, n), note: cleanNote(note) }));
    if (count !== null) onDone(`${plural(count, "ticket pointé", "tickets pointés")}.`);
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open onClose={onClose} title={`Pointer des tickets « ${groupName} »`}>
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Le ticket est consommé sur place, sans inscription.</p>
        <QuantityField id="point-quantity" value={quantity} max={ids.length} error={quantityError} onChange={setQuantity} />
        <FormField label="Note" htmlFor="point-note" optional>
          <Input id="point-note" maxLength={BOUNDS.note} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} />
        </FormField>
        <FormError message={error} />
        <FormFooter onBack={onClose} pending={pending} submitLabel="Pointer" />
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function UnpointDialog({ customerId, groupName, ids, onClose, onDone }: GroupDialogProps & { ids: string[] }) {
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("1");
  const [quantityError, setQuantityError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { pending, error, run } = useSubmit();

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const n = parseCount(quantity, ids.length);
    if (n === null) {
      setQuantityError(countMessage(ids.length));
      return;
    }
    setQuantityError(null);
    const count = await run(() => unpointTicketsAction({ customerId, ticketIds: ids.slice(0, n) }));
    if (count !== null) onDone(`Pointage annulé : ${plural(count, "ticket", "tickets")}.`);
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open onClose={onClose} title={`Annuler le pointage « ${groupName} »`}>
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Les derniers tickets pointés redeviennent disponibles, ou expirés si leur date est passée.
        </p>
        <QuantityField id="unpoint-quantity" value={quantity} max={ids.length} error={quantityError} onChange={setQuantity} />
        <FormError message={error} />
        <FormFooter onBack={onClose} pending={pending} submitLabel="Annuler le pointage" />
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function ConvertDialog({
  customerId,
  groupName,
  ids,
  fromTypeId,
  typeOptions,
  onClose,
  onDone,
}: GroupDialogProps & { ids: string[]; fromTypeId: string; typeOptions: TypeOption[] }) {
  const targets = typeOptions.filter((t) => !t.rdvFree && t.id !== fromTypeId);
  const [targetId, setTargetId] = useState(targets[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("1");
  const [quantityError, setQuantityError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { pending, error, run } = useSubmit();

  const target = targets.find((t) => t.id === targetId) ?? targets[0] ?? null;

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const n = parseCount(quantity, ids.length);
    if (n === null) {
      setQuantityError(countMessage(ids.length));
      return;
    }
    setQuantityError(null);
    if (target === null) return;
    const count = await run(() =>
      convertTicketsAction({ customerId, ticketIds: ids.slice(0, n), toTicketTypeId: target.id }),
    );
    if (count !== null) {
      onDone(`${plural(count, "ticket converti", "tickets convertis")} en « ${target.name} ».`);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open onClose={onClose} title={`Convertir des tickets « ${groupName} »`}>
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
        {target === null ? (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Aucun autre type actif : créez-en un dans{" "}
            <Link href="/dashboard/tickets" className="font-medium text-primary hover:underline">
              Tickets
            </Link>
            .
          </p>
        ) : (
          <FormField label="Vers le type" htmlFor="convert-target">
            <Select id="convert-target" value={target.id} onChange={(e) => setTargetId(e.target.value)}>
              {targets.map((t) => (
                <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                  {t.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </FormField>
        )}
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Ils gardent leur statut (payé ou offert) et leur date de validité.</p>
        <QuantityField id="convert-quantity" value={quantity} max={ids.length} error={quantityError} onChange={setQuantity} />
        <FormError message={error} />
        <FormFooter onBack={onClose} pending={pending} submitLabel="Convertir" disabled={target === null} />
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

type CloseReason = "rembourse" | "compense" | "autre";

function CloseDialog({ customerId, groupName, ids, onClose, onDone }: GroupDialogProps & { ids: WalletGroup["ids"] }) {
  const hasPaid = ids.closePaid.length > 0;
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<CloseReason>(hasPaid ? "rembourse" : "autre");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("1");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<{ quantity?: string; note?: string }>({});
  const [step, setStep] = useState<"form" | "confirm">("form");
  const { pending, error, setError, run } = useSubmit();

  // « Remboursé » and « Compensé » concern paid tickets only; « Autre » any usable ticket.
  const pool = reason === "autre" ? ids.closeAny : ids.closePaid;
  const count = parseCount(quantity, pool.length);

  function onReview(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const next: { quantity?: string; note?: string } = {};
    if (count === null) next.quantity = countMessage(pool.length);
    if (reason === "autre" && note.trim() === "") next.note = "Précisez le motif.";
    setErrors(next);
    if (next.quantity || next.note) return;
    setStep("confirm");
  }

  async function onConfirm() {
    if (count === null) return;
    const closed = await run(() =>
      closeTicketsAction({ customerId, ticketIds: pool.slice(0, count), reason, note: cleanNote(note) }),
    );
    if (closed !== null) onDone(`${plural(closed, "ticket clos", "tickets clos")}.`);
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog open={step === "form"} onClose={onClose} title={`Clore des tickets « ${groupName} »`}>
        <form onSubmit={onReview} noValidate className="space-y-4">
          <fieldset className="space-y-2">
            <legend className="text-sm font-medium">Motif</legend>
            {hasPaid && (
              <>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="close-reason"
                    className="size-4 accent-primary"
                    checked={reason === "rembourse"}
                    onChange={() => setReason("rembourse")}
                  />
                  {CLOSE_REASON_LABELS.rembourse}
                </label>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="close-reason"
                    className="size-4 accent-primary"
                    checked={reason === "compense"}
                    onChange={() => setReason("compense")}
                  />
                  {CLOSE_REASON_LABELS.compense}
                </label>
              </>
            )}
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="close-reason"
                className="size-4 accent-primary"
                checked={reason === "autre"}
                onChange={() => setReason("autre")}
              />
              {CLOSE_REASON_LABELS.autre}
            </label>
          </fieldset>
          <QuantityField id="close-quantity" value={quantity} max={pool.length} error={errors.quantity ?? null} onChange={setQuantity} />
          <FormField label="Note" htmlFor="close-note" optional={reason !== "autre"} error={errors.note}>
            <Input id="close-note" maxLength={BOUNDS.note} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} />
          </FormField>
          <FormFooter onBack={onClose} pending={false} submitLabel="Clore" disabled={pool.length === 0} />
        </form>
      </Dialog>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={step === "confirm"}
        copy={closeTicketsCopy({ count: count ?? 0, reasonLabel: CLOSE_REASON_LABELS[reason] })}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onConfirm={onConfirm}
        onClose={() => {
          setError(null);
          setStep("form");
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

function RetireDialog({ customerId, groupName, ids, onClose, onDone }: GroupDialogProps & { ids: string[] }) {
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("1");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [quantityError, setQuantityError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<"form" | "confirm">("form");
  const { pending, error, setError, run } = useSubmit();

  const count = parseCount(quantity, ids.length);

  function onReview(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (count === null) {
      setQuantityError(countMessage(ids.length));
      return;
    }
    setQuantityError(null);
    setStep("confirm");
  }

  async function onConfirm() {
    if (count === null) return;
    const retired = await run(() =>
      retireTicketsAction({ customerId, ticketIds: ids.slice(0, count), note: cleanNote(note) }),
    );
    if (retired !== null) onDone(`${plural(retired, "ticket retiré", "tickets retirés")}.`);
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog open={step === "form"} onClose={onClose} title={`Retirer des tickets « ${groupName} »`}>
        <form onSubmit={onReview} noValidate className="space-y-4">
          <QuantityField id="retire-quantity" value={quantity} max={ids.length} error={quantityError} onChange={setQuantity} />
          <FormField label="Note" htmlFor="retire-note" optional>
            <Input id="retire-note" maxLength={BOUNDS.note} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} />
          </FormField>
          <FormFooter onBack={onClose} pending={false} submitLabel="Retirer" />
        </form>
      </Dialog>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={step === "confirm"}
        copy={retireTicketsCopy({ count: count ?? 0 })}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onConfirm={onConfirm}
        onClose={() => {
          setError(null);
          setStep("form");
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

Write the whole file:

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";

import { BookingStatusBadge } from "@/components/dashboard/booking-status-badge";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { CoverageBadge } from "@/components/dashboard/coverage-badge";
import { MoveAttendeeDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/move-attendee-dialog";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { ClientBookingRow } from "@/lib/back-office/client-reads";
import { unenrollCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import { unenrollAction } from "@/server/pro-planning";

const UNEXPECTED = "Une erreur inattendue est survenue. Réessayez dans un instant.";

function BookingList({
  rows,
  onMove,
  onUnenroll,
}: {
  rows: ClientBookingRow[];
  onMove: (bookingId: string) => void;
  onUnenroll: (bookingId: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
      {rows.map((row) => (
        <li key={row.bookingId} className="flex flex-col gap-3 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">{row.title}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{row.whenLabel}</p>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <CoverageBadge coverage={row.coverage} />
              <BookingStatusBadge status={row.status} />
              {row.ticketTypeName && <Badge variant="outline">{row.ticketTypeName}</Badge>}
              {row.moved && <Badge variant="neutral">Déplacé</Badge>}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">
              <Link href={row.planningHref}>Voir dans le planning</Link>
            </Button>
            {row.canMove && (
              <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => onMove(row.bookingId)}>
                Déplacer
              </Button>
            )}
            {row.canUnenroll && (
              <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => onUnenroll(row.bookingId)}>
                Désinscrire
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

export function ClientBookings({
  customerName,
  upcoming,
  past,
}: {
  customerName: string;
  upcoming: ClientBookingRow[];
  past: ClientBookingRow[];
}) {
  // Dialogs hold a booking id and look the row up on every render: after an
  // action the page refreshes and a dialog never shows a stale row.
  const [moveId, setMoveId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [unenrollId, setUnenrollId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const all = [...upcoming, ...past];
  const moving = moveId === null ? null : (all.find((r) => r.bookingId === moveId) ?? null);
  const unenrolling = unenrollId === null ? null : (all.find((r) => r.bookingId === unenrollId) ?? null);

  function openMove(bookingId: string) {
    setNotice(null);
    setMoveId(bookingId);
  }

  function openUnenroll(bookingId: string) {
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    setUnenrollId(bookingId);
  }

  function closeUnenroll() {
    setUnenrollId(null);
    setError(null);
  }

  async function confirmUnenroll() {
    if (unenrolling === null || pending) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await unenrollAction({
        occurrenceId: unenrolling.occurrenceId,
        bookingIds: [unenrolling.bookingId],
        reason: null,
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setUnenrollId(null);
      setNotice(
        res.ticketsReturned > 0
          ? "Client désinscrit. Son ticket est rendu et il est prévenu par email."
          : "Client désinscrit. Il est prévenu par email.",
      );
    } catch {
      setError(UNEXPECTED);
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Inscriptions</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        {notice && (
          <p role="status" className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-sm text-foreground">
            <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-success" aria-hidden />
            {notice}
          </p>
        )}

        {all.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucune inscription.</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <section>
              <h4 className="text-sm font-medium">À venir</h4>
              {upcoming.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Aucune inscription à venir.</p>
              ) : (
                <BookingList rows={upcoming} onMove={openMove} onUnenroll={openUnenroll} />
              )}
            </section>
            {past.length > 0 && (
              <details>
                <summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
                  Passées ({past.length})
                </summary>
                <BookingList rows={past} onMove={openMove} onUnenroll={openUnenroll} />
              </details>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>

      {moving && (
        <MoveAttendeeDialog
          bookingId={moving.bookingId}
          customerName={customerName}
          onClose={() => setMoveId(null)}
          onDone={(message) => {
            setMoveId(null);
            setNotice(message);
          }}
        />
      )}
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={unenrolling !== null}
        copy={unenrollCopy({
          names: [customerName],
          ticketCount: unenrolling?.hasTicket ? 1 : 0,
          pendingCount: unenrolling?.pending ? 1 : 0,
        })}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onConfirm={confirmUnenroll}
        onClose={closeUnenroll}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}
```

  ```ts
  export const PAYMENTS_PERIODS = ["tout", "30j"] as const;
  export type PaymentsPeriod = (typeof PAYMENTS_PERIODS)[number];
  export function parsePaymentsPeriod(value: unknown): PaymentsPeriod;
  export type PaymentRow = {
    purchaseId: string; paidAt: Date; customerId: string; customerName: string; customerEmail: string;
    label: string; quantity: number; amountCents: number; currency: string; livemode: boolean;
    booking: { occurrenceId: string; title: string; startsAt: Date; status: BookingStatus } | null;

  };
  ```

Design notes (binding):
- The rows list EVERY paid purchase of the pro, live and test (the UI marks test ones « Test »); the totals use the « Encaissé » predicate (`paidPurchaseOf({ live })`) through `revenueByCurrency`, so a test environment still shows figures and a live key counts live payments only (spec § 9, decision 31).
- Every query filters `professional_id` (Review Focus 1): purchases, customer join, bookings, tickets.
- A booking is linked to a purchase through `booking.purchase_id` (unique, `booking_purchase_uq`), so there is at most one linked booking per purchase. Its title is the event title, or the ticket type name for an RDV.
- `closedNotes` come from `ticket.closed_reason` / `ticket.closed_note` of the tickets of that purchase (`ticket.purchase_id`), grouped by (reason, note), ordered by the `TICKET_CLOSE_REASONS` order then note (no note first).
