```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";

import { checkInvariants } from "@/lib/booking/invariants";
import { revenueByCurrency } from "@/lib/booking/revenue";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { event, ticket, ticketPurchase } from "@/lib/db/schema";

import { addDaysMs, createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, type TestPro } from "../../test/db";
import {
  rowBooking,
  rowCustomer,
  rowEvent,
  rowOffer,
  rowPurchase,
  rowRdv,
  rowRdvType,
  rowSeance,
  rowTicket,
  rowType,
} from "../../test/rows";
import { getPayments, parsePaymentsPeriod } from "./payments-reads";

const DAY = 86_400_000;

type Shop = { typeId: string; offerId: string };

async function makeShop(db: Db, pro: TestPro, name: string): Promise<Shop> {
  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro, { name });
  const offerId = await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId);
  return { typeId, offerId };
}

/** A paid purchase and its `quantity` available tickets (invariants I3 and I6 hold). */
async function paidPurchase(
  db: Db,
  pro: TestPro,
  shop: Shop,
  customerId: string,
  args: {
    paidAt: Date;
    label?: string;
    quantity?: number;
    amountCents?: number;
    currency?: string;
    livemode?: boolean;
  },
): Promise<{ purchaseId: string }> {
  const quantity = args.quantity ?? 1;
  const purchaseId = await rowPurchase(db, pro, {
    customerId,
    offerId: shop.offerId,
    ticketTypeId: shop.typeId,
    status: "paid",
    quantity,
    amountCents: args.amountCents,
    currency: args.currency,
    livemode: args.livemode,
    paymentIntentId: args.livemode ? "pi_live_test" : null,
    paidAt: args.paidAt,
  });
  if (args.label) {
    await db.update(ticketPurchase).set({ label: args.label }).where(eq(ticketPurchase.id, purchaseId));
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
    await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId, ticketTypeId: shop.typeId, purchaseId });
  }
  return { purchaseId };
}

dbTest("getPayments groups the closed tickets of a purchase by reason and note", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const shop = await makeShop(db, pro, "Cours collectif");
  const customerId = await rowCustomer(db, pro);

  const carnet = await rowPurchase(db, pro, {
    customerId,
    offerId: shop.offerId,
    ticketTypeId: shop.typeId,
    status: "paid",
    quantity: 5,
    amountCents: 8500,
    paidAt: addDaysMs(now, -1),
  });
  const closedIds: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) {
    closedIds.push(await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId, ticketTypeId: shop.typeId, purchaseId: carnet, status: "closed" }));
  }
  await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId, ticketTypeId: shop.typeId, purchaseId: carnet });
  await db
    .update(ticket)
    .set({ closedReason: "rembourse", closedNote: "Remboursé en espèces" })
    .where(inArray(ticket.id, closedIds.slice(0, 2)));
  await db.update(ticket).set({ closedReason: "rembourse", closedNote: null }).where(eq(ticket.id, closedIds[2]));
  await db.update(ticket).set({ closedReason: "autre", closedNote: "Geste commercial" }).where(eq(ticket.id, closedIds[3]));

  const second = await rowPurchase(db, pro, {
    customerId,
    offerId: shop.offerId,
    ticketTypeId: shop.typeId,
    status: "paid",
    paidAt: addDaysMs(now, -2),
  });
  const secondTicket = await rowTicket(db, pro, {
    customerId,
    ticketTypeId: shop.typeId,
    purchaseId: second,
    status: "closed",
  });
  await db.update(ticket).set({ closedReason: "compense" }).where(eq(ticket.id, secondTicket));

  // An offered ticket closed with no purchase belongs to no payment row.
  await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId, ticketTypeId: shop.typeId, status: "closed" });

  const { rows } = await getPayments(db, pro.proId, now, { period: "tout", live: false });
  const byId = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.purchaseId, r]));

  assert.deepEqual(byId.get(carnet)?.closedNotes, [
    { reason: "rembourse", note: null, count: 1 },
    { reason: "rembourse", note: "Remboursé en espèces", count: 2 },
    { reason: "autre", note: "Geste commercial", count: 1 },
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(byId.get(second)?.closedNotes, [{ reason: "compense", note: null, count: 1 }]);
});
```

Create the whole file:

```ts
import { and, count, desc, eq, gte, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";

import { revenueByCurrency } from "@/lib/booking/revenue";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, customer, event, occurrence, ticket, ticketPurchase, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { TICKET_CLOSE_REASONS, type BookingStatus, type TicketCloseReason } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export const PAYMENTS_PERIODS = ["tout", "30j"] as const;
export type PaymentsPeriod = (typeof PAYMENTS_PERIODS)[number];

/** ?periode= value; unknown becomes "tout". */
export function parsePaymentsPeriod(value: unknown): PaymentsPeriod {
  return (PAYMENTS_PERIODS as readonly unknown[]).includes(value) ? (value as PaymentsPeriod) : "tout";
}

export type PaymentRow = {
  purchaseId: string;
  paidAt: Date;
  customerId: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  label: string;
  quantity: number;
  amountCents: number;
  currency: string;
  livemode: boolean;
  /** booking.purchase_id = purchase.id (buy + book). */
  booking: { occurrenceId: string; title: string; startsAt: Date; status: BookingStatus } | null;
  /** Closed tickets of the purchase, grouped by reason and note. */
  closedNotes: { reason: TicketCloseReason; note: string | null; count: number }[];
};

const PAYMENTS_LIMIT = 200;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

function reasonRank(reason: TicketCloseReason): number {
  return TICKET_CLOSE_REASONS.indexOf(reason);
}

/**
 * Paid purchases (live and test: the UI shows « Test ») by paid_at desc, at
 * most 200; period 30j = paid_at at or after now minus 30 days. The totals
 * are the « Encaissé » predicate (spec § 9): paid, livemode = live, this pro.
 */
export async function getPayments(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  now: Date,
  opts: { period: PaymentsPeriod; live: boolean },
): Promise<{ rows: PaymentRow[]; totals: { currency: string; cents: number }[] }> {
  const since = opts.period === "30j" ? new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * DAY_MS) : undefined;

  const [totals, purchases] = await Promise.all([
    revenueByCurrency(db, { live: opts.live, professionalId, since }),
    db
      .select({
        purchaseId: ticketPurchase.id,
        paidAt: ticketPurchase.paidAt,
        customerId: customer.id,
        customerName: customer.name,
        customerEmail: customer.email,
        label: ticketPurchase.label,
        quantity: ticketPurchase.quantity,
        amountCents: ticketPurchase.amountCents,
        currency: ticketPurchase.currency,
        livemode: ticketPurchase.livemode,
      })
      .from(ticketPurchase)
      .innerJoin(
        customer,
        and(eq(customer.id, ticketPurchase.customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId)),
      )
      .where(
        and(
          eq(ticketPurchase.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(ticketPurchase.status, "paid"),
          since ? gte(ticketPurchase.paidAt, since) : undefined,
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(desc(ticketPurchase.paidAt), desc(ticketPurchase.id))
      .limit(PAYMENTS_LIMIT),
  ]);

  const ids = purchases.map((p) => p.purchaseId);
  if (ids.length === 0) return { rows: [], totals };

  const [bookings, closed] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        purchaseId: booking.purchaseId,
        occurrenceId: occurrence.id,
        startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
        status: booking.status,
        eventTitle: event.title,
        typeName: ticketType.name,
      })
      .from(booking)
      .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
      .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
      .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
      .where(and(eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId), inArray(booking.purchaseId, ids))),
    db
      .select({
        purchaseId: ticket.purchaseId,
        reason: ticket.closedReason,
        note: ticket.closedNote,
        n: count(),
      })
      .from(ticket)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(ticket.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(ticket.status, "closed"),
          inArray(ticket.purchaseId, ids),
        ),
      )
      .groupBy(ticket.purchaseId, ticket.closedReason, ticket.closedNote),
  ]);

  const bookingByPurchase = new Map<string, NonNullable<PaymentRow["booking"]>>();
  for (const b of bookings) {
    if (b.purchaseId === null) continue;
    bookingByPurchase.set(b.purchaseId, {
      occurrenceId: b.occurrenceId,
      title: b.eventTitle ?? b.typeName ?? "Rendez-vous",
      startsAt: b.startsAt,
      status: b.status,
    });
  }

  const closedByPurchase = new Map<string, PaymentRow["closedNotes"]>();
  for (const c of closed) {
    if (c.purchaseId === null || c.reason === null) continue;
    const list = closedByPurchase.get(c.purchaseId) ?? [];
    list.push({ reason: c.reason, note: c.note, count: c.n });
    closedByPurchase.set(c.purchaseId, list);
  }
  for (const list of closedByPurchase.values()) {
    list.sort((a, b) => {
      const byReason = reasonRank(a.reason) - reasonRank(b.reason);
      if (byReason !== 0) return byReason;
      const an = a.note ?? "";
      const bn = b.note ?? "";
      return an < bn ? -1 : an > bn ? 1 : 0;
    });
  }

  const rows: PaymentRow[] = [];
  for (const p of purchases) {
    // ticket_purchase_paid_chk: a paid purchase always has paid_at.
    if (p.paidAt === null) continue;
    rows.push({
      purchaseId: p.purchaseId,
      paidAt: p.paidAt,
      customerId: p.customerId,
      customerName: p.customerName,
      customerEmail: p.customerEmail,
      label: p.label,
      quantity: p.quantity,
      amountCents: p.amountCents,
      currency: p.currency,
      livemode: p.livemode,
      booking: bookingByPurchase.get(p.purchaseId) ?? null,
      closedNotes: closedByPurchase.get(p.purchaseId) ?? [],
    });
  }
  return { rows, totals };
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Euro } from "lucide-react";

import { FilterChips } from "@/components/admin/filter-chips";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/dashboard/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/page-header";
import { PaymentsTable } from "@/components/dashboard/payments-table";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { revenueDisplay } from "@/lib/back-office/dashboard-view";
import { PAYMENTS_PERIODS, parsePaymentsPeriod, type PaymentsPeriod } from "@/lib/back-office/payments-reads";
import { getCurrentProfessional } from "@/lib/session";
import { getPaymentsPage } from "@/server/queries";
import { revenueLive } from "@/server/revenue";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Paiements" };

const PERIOD_LABELS: Record<PaymentsPeriod, string> = { tout: "Tout", "30j": "30 derniers jours" };

const PERIOD_OPTIONS = PAYMENTS_PERIODS.map((value) => ({
  value,
  label: PERIOD_LABELS[value],
  href: value === "tout" ? "/dashboard/payments" : `/dashboard/payments?periode=${value}`,
}));

const REFUND_NOTE = "Les tickets clos « Remboursé hors Skedul » ne diminuent pas l'encaissé.";

export default async function PaymentsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ periode?: string }>;
}) {
  const { periode } = await searchParams;
  const period = parsePaymentsPeriod(periode);
  const pro = (await getCurrentProfessional())!;
  const { rows, totals } = await getPaymentsPage(pro, period);
  const { main, others } = revenueDisplay(totals, pro.currency);
  const hasRefundNote = rows.some((row) => row.closedNotes.some((c) => c.reason === "rembourse"));

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Paiements" description="Les achats de tickets payés par vos clients." />
      <div className="mb-6">
        <FilterChips label="Période" active={period} options={PERIOD_OPTIONS} />
      </div>

      <Card className="mb-6">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Encaissé</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">{main}</p>
          {others.length > 0 && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{others.join(" · ")}</p>}
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {revenueLive()
              ? "Seuls les paiements réels comptent."
              : "Paiements de test : ces montants ne sont pas réels."}
          </p>
          {hasRefundNote && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{REFUND_NOTE}</p>}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        period === "tout" ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Euro}
            title="Aucun paiement pour le moment"
            description="Les achats de tickets de vos clients apparaîtront ici."
          />
        ) : (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Euro}
            title="Aucun paiement sur cette période"
            description="Choisissez « Tout » pour voir l'ensemble de vos paiements."
          />
        )
      ) : (
        <PaymentsTable rows={rows} tz={pro.timezone} />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

Design notes (binding):
- KPI definitions (Q25): séances = occurrences with `starts_at` in `[now, now + 7 d)`: scheduled event séances not hidden by a time off (`hiddenByTimeOff`: an EMPTY scheduled séance overlapping a time off) plus scheduled RDVs with a confirmed booking; registrants = confirmed bookings on those; tickets in circulation = `available` and (`expires_at` null or `> now`), archived types included; clients = `isClient` (spec § 9: a confirmed booking, or at least one ticket in any state); revenue = `revenueByCurrency({ live, professionalId })`, all time.
- « Premiers pas » (Q29): active type = non-archived type; active offer = `is_active` and not archived on a non-archived type; event = non-archived. `firstTypeId` = the first non-archived type that is not `rdv_free` (an RDV « Gratuit » type cannot have offers), by position, created_at, id.
- Every query filters `professional_id` (Review Focus 1). The shared `revenue` predicate is the same as `/dashboard/payments` (Task 36).
- Client components import only types from `dashboard-reads.ts` (`import type`).

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import { checkInvariants } from "@/lib/booking/invariants";
import { revenueByCurrency } from "@/lib/booking/revenue";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, bookingAnswer, event, ticketOffer, timeOff } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import type { OccurrenceStatus } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils";

import { addDaysMs, addMinutes, createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, type TestPro } from "../../test/db";
import {
  rowBooking,
  rowCustomer,
  rowEvent,
  rowLink,
  rowOffer,
  rowPurchase,
  rowRdv,
  rowRdvType,
  rowSeance,
  rowTicket,
  rowType,
} from "../../test/rows";
import { getDashboardData } from "./dashboard-reads";
import { formatWhen, planningHref } from "./format";

const HOUR = 60;
const DAY = 24 * HOUR;

function proInfo(pro: TestPro): { id: string; timezone: string; currency: string } {
  return { id: pro.proId, timezone: pro.tz, currency: pro.currency };
}

/** A one-off event with one séance starting at `startsAt` (own event, so séances never share a series date). */
async function seanceAt(
  db: Db,
  pro: TestPro,
  startsAt: Date,
  over: { seatsTaken?: number; status?: OccurrenceStatus } = {},
): Promise<{ eventId: string; seanceId: string }> {
  const eventId = await rowEvent(db, pro);
  const seanceId = await rowSeance(db, pro, eventId, { startsAt, ...over });
  return { eventId, seanceId };
}

dbTest("getDashboardData counts the séances of the next 7 days and their confirmed registrants", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const alice = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const bruno = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro);
  const offerId = await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId);
  await db.insert(timeOff).values({
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    startAt: addMinutes(now, 36 * HOUR),
    endAt: addMinutes(now, 60 * HOUR),
    allDay: true,
  });

  // Counted: an empty séance before the time off.
  await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, 24 * HOUR));
  // Hidden: an empty séance under the time off.
  await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, 48 * HOUR));
  // Counted: a booked séance under the time off.
  const booked = await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, 49 * HOUR), { seatsTaken: 1 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: booked.seanceId, customerId: alice });
  // Excluded: cancelled, starting exactly at now + 7 days, already started.
  await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, 72 * HOUR), { status: "cancelled" });
  await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, 7 * DAY));
  await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, -HOUR));
  // Counted: the last minute of the window, one confirmed and one pending registrant.
  const last = await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, 7 * DAY - 1), { seatsTaken: 2 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: last.seanceId, customerId: alice });
  const pendingPurchase = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: bruno, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: last.seanceId,
    customerId: bruno,
    status: "pending",
    coverage: "ticket",
    purchaseId: pendingPurchase,
  });
  // RDV: a booked one under the time off is counted (never hidden), a cancelled one is not.
  const rdvType = await rowRdvType(db, pro);
  const rdv = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: addMinutes(now, 50 * HOUR) });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: rdv, customerId: bruno });
  await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: addMinutes(now, 20 * HOUR), seatsTaken: 0, status: "cancelled" });

  const { kpis } = await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false);
  assert.equal(kpis.upcomingSeances7d, 4);
  assert.equal(kpis.upcomingRegistrants7d, 3);
});

dbTest("getDashboardData clients are the customers with a confirmed booking or a ticket", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro);
  const offerId = await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId);

  // A confirmed guest booking only: a client.
  const guest = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const guestSeance = await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, 2 * DAY), { seatsTaken: 2 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: guestSeance.seanceId, customerId: guest });
  // A ticket in any state (closed): a client.
  const holder = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId: holder, ticketTypeId: typeId, status: "closed" });
  // Both: counted once.
  const both = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId: both, ticketTypeId: typeId });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: guestSeance.seanceId, customerId: both });
  // Not clients: a pending purchase only, a brand new customer, a cancelled booking only.
  const buyer = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: buyer, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId });
  await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const cancelled = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const otherSeance = await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, 3 * DAY));
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: otherSeance.seanceId, customerId: cancelled, status: "cancelled" });

  const { kpis } = await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false);
  assert.equal(kpis.clients, 3);
});

dbTest("getDashboardData alerts count red and orange clients and the events without an active type", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const active = await rowType(db, pro);
  const archived = await rowType(db, pro, { archivedAt: now });
  const unlinked = await rowType(db, pro);

  // Linked to a tickets-mode event with an upcoming séance: no alert.
  const e2 = await rowEvent(db, pro);
  await rowSeance(db, pro, e2, {}, now);
  await rowLink(db, pro, e2, active, now);
  // Tickets mode with no type, and with only an archived type: both flagged.
  const e1 = await rowEvent(db, pro);
  const e4 = await rowEvent(db, pro);
  await rowLink(db, pro, e4, archived, now);
  // Free mode with no type: not flagged.
  await rowEvent(db, pro, { bookingMode: "free" });

  const green = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const red = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const orange = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId: green, ticketTypeId: active });
  await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId: red, ticketTypeId: archived });
  await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId: orange, ticketTypeId: unlinked });

  const { alerts } = await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false);
  assert.equal(alerts.redClients, 1);
  assert.equal(alerts.orangeClients, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(alerts.eventsWithoutActiveType.map((e) => e.eventId).sort(), [e1, e4].sort());
  const [e1Row] = await db.select({ title: event.title }).from(event).where(eq(event.id, e1));
  assert.equal(alerts.eventsWithoutActiveType.find((e) => e.eventId === e1)?.title, e1Row.title);
});

dbTest("getDashboardData getting-started flags and the first type", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const empty = await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false);
  assert.deepEqual(empty.gettingStarted, { hasType: false, hasOffer: false, hasEvent: false, firstTypeId: null });

  // An RDV « Gratuit » type counts as a type but cannot take an offer.
  await rowRdvType(db, pro, { rdvFree: true, position: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual((await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false)).gettingStarted, {
    hasType: true,
    hasOffer: false,
    hasEvent: false,
    firstTypeId: null,
  });

  const paid = await rowType(db, pro, { position: 1 });
  await rowType(db, pro, { position: 2 });
  assert.equal((await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false)).gettingStarted.firstTypeId, paid);

  // An offer of an archived type, then an inactive offer: still no active offer.
  const old = await rowType(db, pro, { archivedAt: now });
  await rowOffer(db, pro, old);
  const offerId = await rowOffer(db, pro, paid);
  await db.update(ticketOffer).set({ isActive: false }).where(eq(ticketOffer.id, offerId));
  assert.equal((await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false)).gettingStarted.hasOffer, false);
  await db.update(ticketOffer).set({ isActive: true }).where(eq(ticketOffer.id, offerId));
  assert.equal((await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false)).gettingStarted.hasOffer, true);

  // An archived event does not count, a live one does.
  await rowEvent(db, pro, { archivedAt: now });
  assert.equal((await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false)).gettingStarted.hasEvent, false);
  await rowEvent(db, pro);
  assert.deepEqual((await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false)).gettingStarted, {
    hasType: true,
    hasOffer: true,
    hasEvent: true,
    firstTypeId: paid,
  });
});

dbTest("getDashboardData lists the next 8 confirmed bookings, soonest first", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const alice = await rowCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Alice Martin", email: "alice@skedul.test" });
  const created: { eventId: string; seanceId: string; bookingId: string; startsAt: Date }[] = [];
  for (let day = 1; day <= 10; day += 1) {
    const startsAt = addMinutes(now, day * DAY);
    const s = await seanceAt(db, pro, startsAt, { seatsTaken: 1 });
    const bookingId = await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: s.seanceId, customerId: alice });
    created.push({ ...s, bookingId, startsAt });
  }
  // Excluded: a booking on a séance already started, and a cancelled booking.
  const started = await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, -DAY), { seatsTaken: 1 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: started.seanceId, customerId: alice });
  const unbooked = await seanceAt(db, pro, addMinutes(now, 12 * HOUR));
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: unbooked.seanceId, customerId: alice, status: "cancelled" });

  const { upcomingBookings } = await getDashboardData(db, proInfo(pro), now, false);
  assert.deepEqual(
    upcomingBookings.map((b) => b.bookingId),
    created.slice(0, 8).map((c) => c.bookingId),
  );

  const first = upcomingBookings[0];
  const [eventRow] = await db.select({ title: event.title, color: event.color }).from(event).where(eq(event.id, created[0].eventId));
  const endsAt = addMinutes(created[0].startsAt, 60);
  assert.equal(first.occurrenceId, created[0].seanceId);
  assert.equal(first.kind, "seance");
  assert.equal(first.title, eventRow.title);
  assert.equal(first.color, eventRow.color);
  assert.equal(first.startsAt, created[0].startsAt.toISOString());
  assert.equal(first.endsAt, endsAt.toISOString());
  assert.equal(first.whenLabel, formatWhen(created[0].startsAt, endsAt, pro.tz));
  assert.equal(first.planningHref, planningHref({ occurrenceId: created[0].seanceId, startsAt: created[0].startsAt, tz: pro.tz }));
  assert.equal(first.status, "confirmed");
  assert.equal(first.coverage, "guest");
  assert.equal(first.ticketTypeName, null);
  assert.equal(first.purchase, null);
  assert.equal(first.customerId, alice);
  assert.equal(first.customerName, "Alice Martin");
  assert.equal(first.customerEmail, "alice@skedul.test");
  assert.equal(first.customerPhone, null);
  assert.equal(first.notes, null);
  assert.deepEqual(first.answers, []);
});
```

Create the whole file:

```ts
import { and, asc, count, eq, gt, gte, inArray, isNull, lt, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { alias } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

import { revenueByCurrency } from "@/lib/booking/revenue";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import {
  booking,
  bookingAnswer,
  customer,
  event,
  occurrence,
  ticket,
  ticketOffer,
  ticketPurchase,
  ticketType,
  timeOff,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { DEFAULT_COLOR, type BookingCoverage, type BookingStatus, type PurchaseStatus } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils";

import { customerAlertCounts } from "./client-reads";
import type { KpiInput } from "./dashboard-view";
import { listEvents } from "./event-reads";
import { formatWhen, planningHref } from "./format";
import { hiddenByTimeOff } from "./planning-view";

export type BookingDetailVM = {
  bookingId: string;
  occurrenceId: string;
  kind: "seance" | "rdv";
  title: string;
  color: string;
  startsAt: string;
  endsAt: string;
  whenLabel: string;
  status: BookingStatus;
  coverage: BookingCoverage;
  ticketTypeName: string | null;
  purchase: { status: PurchaseStatus; amountLabel: string; livemode: boolean } | null;
  customerId: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string | null;
  notes: string | null;
  answers: { label: string; value: string }[];
  planningHref: string;
};

export type DashboardData = {
  kpis: KpiInput;
  alerts: {
    redClients: number;
    orangeClients: number;
    eventsWithoutActiveType: { eventId: string; title: string }[];
  };
  gettingStarted: { hasType: boolean; hasOffer: boolean; hasEvent: boolean; firstTypeId: string | null };
  upcomingBookings: BookingDetailVM[];
};

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
const UPCOMING_LIMIT = 8;

/** Séances of [now, now + 7 d) and their confirmed registrants (Q25). */
async function weekCounts(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<{ seances: number; registrants: number }> {
  const end = new Date(now.getTime() + 7 * DAY_MS);
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: occurrence.id,
      eventId: occurrence.eventId,
      status: occurrence.status,
      seatsTaken: occurrence.seatsTaken,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
    })
    .from(occurrence)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(occurrence.status, "scheduled"),
        gte(occurrence.startsAt, now),
        lt(occurrence.startsAt, end),
      ),
    );
  if (rows.length === 0) return { seances: 0, registrants: 0 };

  // A time off that starts after the window can still overlap the last séance.
  const lastEnd = new Date(rows.reduce((max, r) => Math.max(max, r.endsAt.getTime()), 0));
  const rdvIds = rows.filter((r) => r.eventId === null).map((r) => r.id);
  const [offs, rdvBookings] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({ startAt: timeOff.startAt, endAt: timeOff.endAt })
      .from(timeOff)
      .where(and(eq(timeOff.professionalId, professionalId), lt(timeOff.startAt, lastEnd), gt(timeOff.endAt, now))),
    rdvIds.length === 0
      ? Promise.resolve([] as { occurrenceId: string }[])
      : db
          .select({ occurrenceId: booking.occurrenceId })
          .from(booking)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId),
              eq(booking.status, "confirmed"),
              inArray(booking.occurrenceId, rdvIds),
            ),
          ),
  ]);
  const bookedRdv = new Set(rdvBookings.map((b) => b.occurrenceId));

  const counted: string[] = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.eventId !== null) {
      const hidden = hiddenByTimeOff(
        { kind: "seance", status: r.status, seatsTaken: r.seatsTaken, startsAt: r.startsAt, endsAt: r.endsAt },
        offs,
      );
      if (!hidden) counted.push(r.id);
    } else if (bookedRdv.has(r.id)) {
      counted.push(r.id);
    }
  }
  if (counted.length === 0) return { seances: 0, registrants: 0 };

  const [{ n }] = await db
    .select({ n: count() })
    .from(booking)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(booking.status, "confirmed"),
        inArray(booking.occurrenceId, counted),
      ),
    );
  return { seances: counted.length, registrants: n };
}

/** `available` and valid at now, archived types included (the wallet balance predicate). */
async function ticketsInCirculation(db: Db, professionalId: string, now: Date): Promise<number> {
  const [{ n }] = await db
    .select({ n: count() })
    .from(ticket)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticket.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(ticket.status, "available"),
        or(isNull(ticket.expiresAt), gt(ticket.expiresAt, now)),
      ),
    );
  return n;
}

/** isClient (spec § 9): a confirmed booking, or at least one ticket in any state. */
async function clientCount(db: Db, professionalId: string): Promise<number> {
  const res = await db.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`
    select count(*)::int as n
    from customer c
    where c.professional_id = ${professionalId}
      and (
        exists (
          select 1 from booking b
          where b.customer_id = c.id and b.professional_id = c.professional_id and b.status = 'confirmed'
        )
        or exists (
          select 1 from ticket t
          where t.customer_id = c.id and t.professional_id = c.professional_id
        )
      )`);
  return Number(res.rows[0]?.n ?? 0);
}

async function gettingStarted(db: Db, professionalId: string): Promise<DashboardData["gettingStarted"]> {
  const [types, offers, events] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({ id: ticketType.id, rdvFree: ticketType.rdvFree })
      .from(ticketType)
      .where(and(eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId), isNull(ticketType.archivedAt)))
      .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.createdAt), asc(ticketType.id)),
    db
      .select({ n: count() })
      .from(ticketOffer)
      .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, ticketOffer.ticketTypeId))
      .where(
        and(
          eq(ticketOffer.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(ticketOffer.isActive, true),
          isNull(ticketOffer.archivedAt),
          isNull(ticketType.archivedAt),
        ),
      ),
    db
      .select({ n: count() })
      .from(event)
      .where(and(eq(event.professionalId, professionalId), isNull(event.archivedAt))),
  ]);
  return {
    hasType: types.length > 0,
    hasOffer: (offers[0]?.n ?? 0) > 0,
    hasEvent: (events[0]?.n ?? 0) > 0,
    // An RDV « Gratuit » type cannot take an offer: it is never the first type to open.
    firstTypeId: types.find((t) => !t.rdvFree)?.id ?? null,
  };
}

async function upcomingBookings(
  db: Db,
  pro: { id: string; timezone: string },
  now: Date,
): Promise<BookingDetailVM[]> {
  const rdvType = alias(ticketType, "rdv_type");
  const heldType = alias(ticketType, "held_type");
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      bookingId: booking.id,
      occurrenceId: occurrence.id,
      eventId: occurrence.eventId,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
      status: booking.status,
      coverage: booking.coverage,
      notes: booking.customerNotes,
      eventTitle: event.title,
      eventColor: event.color,
      rdvTypeName: rdvType.name,
      rdvTypeColor: rdvType.color,
      heldTypeName: heldType.name,
      purchaseStatus: ticketPurchase.status,
      purchaseCents: ticketPurchase.amountCents,
      purchaseCurrency: ticketPurchase.currency,
      purchaseLive: ticketPurchase.livemode,
      customerId: customer.id,
      customerName: customer.name,
      customerEmail: customer.email,
      customerPhone: customer.phone,
    })
    .from(booking)
    .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
    .innerJoin(customer, and(eq(customer.id, booking.customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, pro.id)))
    .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .leftJoin(rdvType, eq(rdvType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
    .leftJoin(ticketPurchase, eq(ticketPurchase.id, booking.purchaseId))
    .leftJoin(ticket, and(eq(ticket.bookingId, booking.id), eq(ticket.status, "booked")))
    .leftJoin(heldType, eq(heldType.id, ticket.ticketTypeId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(booking.professionalId, pro.id),
        eq(booking.status, "confirmed"),
        eq(occurrence.status, "scheduled"),
        gt(occurrence.startsAt, now),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(occurrence.startsAt), asc(booking.createdAt), asc(booking.id))
    .limit(UPCOMING_LIMIT);
  if (rows.length === 0) return [];

  const answers = await db
    .select({ bookingId: bookingAnswer.bookingId, label: bookingAnswer.questionLabel, value: bookingAnswer.value })
    .from(bookingAnswer)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(bookingAnswer.professionalId, pro.id),
        inArray(
          bookingAnswer.bookingId,
          rows.map((r) => r.bookingId),
        ),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(bookingAnswer.createdAt), asc(bookingAnswer.id));
  const answersByBooking = new Map<string, { label: string; value: string }[]>();
  for (const a of answers) {
    const list = answersByBooking.get(a.bookingId) ?? [];
    list.push({ label: a.label, value: a.value });
    answersByBooking.set(a.bookingId, list);
  }

  return rows.map((r) => ({
    bookingId: r.bookingId,
    occurrenceId: r.occurrenceId,
    kind: r.eventId === null ? "rdv" : "seance",
    title: r.eventTitle ?? r.rdvTypeName ?? "Rendez-vous",
    color: r.eventColor ?? r.rdvTypeColor ?? DEFAULT_COLOR,
    startsAt: r.startsAt.toISOString(),
    endsAt: r.endsAt.toISOString(),
    whenLabel: formatWhen(r.startsAt, r.endsAt, pro.timezone),
    status: r.status,
    coverage: r.coverage,
    ticketTypeName: r.heldTypeName,
    purchase:
      r.purchaseStatus === null || r.purchaseCents === null || r.purchaseCurrency === null || r.purchaseLive === null
        ? null
        : {
            status: r.purchaseStatus,
            amountLabel: formatMoney(r.purchaseCents, r.purchaseCurrency),
            livemode: r.purchaseLive,
          },
    customerId: r.customerId,
    customerName: r.customerName,
    customerEmail: r.customerEmail,
    customerPhone: r.customerPhone,
    notes: r.notes,
    answers: answersByBooking.get(r.bookingId) ?? [],
    planningHref: planningHref({ occurrenceId: r.occurrenceId, startsAt: r.startsAt, tz: pro.timezone }),
  }));
}

/** Q25 KPIs, Q28 alerts (customerAlertCounts + listEvents noActiveType), Q29 steps, the next 8 bookings. */
export async function getDashboardData(
  db: Db,
  pro: { id: string; timezone: string; currency: string },
  now: Date,
  live: boolean,
): Promise<DashboardData> {
  const [week, tickets, clients, revenue, alertCounts, events, steps, bookings] = await Promise.all([
    weekCounts(db, pro.id, now),
    ticketsInCirculation(db, pro.id, now),
    clientCount(db, pro.id),
    revenueByCurrency(db, { live, professionalId: pro.id }),
    customerAlertCounts(db, pro.id, now),
    listEvents(db, pro.id, now),
    gettingStarted(db, pro.id),
    upcomingBookings(db, pro, now),
  ]);

  return {
    kpis: {
      upcomingSeances7d: week.seances,
      upcomingRegistrants7d: week.registrants,
      ticketsInCirculation: tickets,
      clients,
      revenue,
      currency: pro.currency,
    },
    alerts: {
      redClients: alertCounts.red,
      orangeClients: alertCounts.orange,
      eventsWithoutActiveType: events.live
        .filter((e) => e.noActiveType)
        .map((e) => ({ eventId: e.eventId, title: e.title })),
    },
    gettingStarted: steps,
    upcomingBookings: bookings,
  };
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";

import { BookingStatusBadge } from "@/components/dashboard/booking-status-badge";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { CoverageBadge } from "@/components/dashboard/coverage-badge";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { unenrollCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import type { BookingDetailVM } from "@/lib/back-office/dashboard-reads";
import { unenrollAction } from "@/server/pro-planning";

const UNEXPECTED = "Une erreur inattendue est survenue. Réessayez dans un instant.";

function PaymentLine({ purchase }: { purchase: NonNullable<BookingDetailVM["purchase"]> }) {
  if (purchase.status !== "paid") return <p className="text-sm">Paiement en attente</p>;
  return (
    <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
      <span>{`Payé ${purchase.amountLabel}`}</span>
      {!purchase.livemode && <Badge variant="outline">Test</Badge>}
    </p>
  );
}

export function BookingDetailDialog({ booking, onClose }: { booking: BookingDetailVM; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function unenroll() {
    if (pending) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await unenrollAction({
        occurrenceId: booking.occurrenceId,
        bookingIds: [booking.bookingId],
        reason: null,
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      onClose();
    } catch {
      setError(UNEXPECTED);
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog open={!confirming} onClose={onClose} title={booking.title}>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{booking.whenLabel}</p>
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <CoverageBadge coverage={booking.coverage} />
          {booking.ticketTypeName && <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{booking.ticketTypeName}</span>}
          {booking.status !== "confirmed" && <BookingStatusBadge status={booking.status} />}
        </div>
        {booking.purchase && (
          <div className="mt-2">
            <PaymentLine purchase={booking.purchase} />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-muted/50 p-3 text-sm">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Client</p>
          <Link href={`/dashboard/clients/${booking.customerId}`} className="mt-1 block font-medium hover:underline">
            {booking.customerName}
          </Link>
          <a
            href={`mailto:${booking.customerEmail}`}
            className="block truncate text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:underline"
          >
            {booking.customerEmail}
          </a>
          {booking.customerPhone && (
            <a
              href={`tel:${booking.customerPhone}`}
              className="block text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:underline"
            >
              {booking.customerPhone}
            </a>
          )}
        </div>

        {(booking.answers.length > 0 || booking.notes) && (
          <dl className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-sm">
            {booking.answers.map((a, i) => (
              <div key={i}>
                <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{a.label}</dt>
                <dd className="mt-0.5 whitespace-pre-line">{a.value}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
            {booking.notes && (
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Message du client</dt>
                <dd className="mt-0.5 whitespace-pre-line">{booking.notes}</dd>
              </div>
            )}
          </dl>
        )}

        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-border pt-4">
          <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
            <Link href={booking.planningHref}>Voir dans le planning</Link>
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => {
              setError(null);
              setConfirming(true);
            }}
          >
            Désinscrire
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Dialog>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirming}
        copy={unenrollCopy({
          names: [booking.customerName],
          ticketCount: booking.coverage === "ticket" ? 1 : 0,
          pendingCount: booking.status === "pending" ? 1 : 0,
        })}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onConfirm={unenroll}
        onClose={() => {
          setConfirming(false);
          setError(null);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

Task 24's `WeekPreview` starts on « Semaine » whatever the viewport; the contract wants the « Jour » mode on the phone. Three exact edits to `src/components/dashboard/week-preview.tsx` (the Task 24 text). Below 640 px the preview opens on « Jour »; once the pro clicks the toggle, their choice wins. The viewport is read with `useSyncExternalStore`, so no effect calls `setState` (`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` is an error in `eslint-config-next` 16). The server snapshot is `true`: the server render and the first client render show the week, and a narrow browser switches to the day right after hydration.

Edit 1 (import). Old:

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
```
New:

```tsx
import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
```

Edit 2 (the media query helpers). Old:

```tsx
const MINUTE_PX = HOUR_PX / 60;
```
New:

```tsx
const MINUTE_PX = HOUR_PX / 60;
const WIDE_QUERY = "(min-width: 640px)";

function subscribeWide(onChange: () => void): () => void {
  const mq = window.matchMedia(WIDE_QUERY);
  mq.addEventListener("change", onChange);
  return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
}

function readWide(): boolean {
  return window.matchMedia(WIDE_QUERY).matches;
}
```

Edit 3 (the initial view). Old:

```tsx
  const [view, setView] = useState<"day" | "week">("week");
```
New:

```tsx
  // Below 640 px the preview opens on one day; once the pro clicks the toggle, their choice wins.
  const wide = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeWide, readWide, () => true);
  const [picked, setView] = useState<"day" | "week" | null>(null);
  const view = picked ?? (wide ? "week" : "day");
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `authClient.emailOtp.sendVerificationOtp({ email, type: "email-verification" })`, `authClient.emailOtp.verifyEmail({ email, otp })`, `authClient.getSession({ query: { disableCookieCache: true } })` (`@/lib/auth-client`, `emailOTPClient()` is already installed). A failed call resolves to `{ error }` with `error.status` (HTTP status), it does not throw.
  - `FormField`, `FormError` (Task 8), `Dialog`, `Button`, `Input` (`src/components/ui`).
  - The session of the dashboard layout: `session.user.email`, `session.user.emailVerified`, `session.session.impersonatedBy` (already read by the layout).
- Produces:
  ```ts
  // src/components/dashboard/verify-email-banner.tsx ("use client")
  export function VerifyEmailBanner(props: { email: string }): React.JSX.Element;
  ```

Design notes (binding):
- The banner sits in the dashboard layout, above the page content, and is hidden while an admin impersonates (an admin must not verify the pro's address, decision 41): `!session.user.emailVerified && !session.session.impersonatedBy`.
- The sign-up already mails a code (core `emailVerification.sendOnSignUp`); « Recevoir un code » sends the SAME code again within 5 minutes (`resendStrategy: "reuse"`), capped at 5 sends per 10 minutes per IP and per address.
- After a send, whatever the outcome except 429, the answer is the same sentence (the endpoint never reveals whether the address exists). 429 shows « Trop de demandes. Réessayez dans quelques minutes. »; a thrown network error shows « L'envoi a échoué. Réessayez dans un instant. ».
- The session cookie cache (5 minutes) still says `emailVerified: false` after a successful code. So the success path is exactly: `await authClient.getSession({ query: { disableCookieCache: true } })`, then `router.refresh()`. This is not a Server Action, so `router.refresh()` is allowed here.
- 3 wrong attempts burn the code (`allowedAttempts: 3`): the message stays « Code incorrect ou expiré. » and « Renvoyer le code » is the way out.

- [ ] **Step 1: Create `src/components/dashboard/verify-email-banner.tsx`**

Write the whole file:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Loader2, Mail } from "lucide-react";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";

const SENT = "Si l'adresse est valide, un code a été envoyé.";
const RATE_LIMITED = "Trop de demandes. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.";
const WRONG_CODE = "Code incorrect ou expiré.";
const SEND_FAILED = "L'envoi a échoué. Réessayez dans un instant.";
const VERIFY_FAILED = "La vérification a échoué. Réessayez dans un instant.";
const CODE_FORMAT = "Saisissez les 6 chiffres du code.";

/** « Confirmez votre adresse »: the e-mail code flow of an unverified pro account (spec § 12). */
export function VerifyEmailBanner({ email }: { email: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [verifying, setVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [codeError, setCodeError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [bannerError, setBannerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dialogError, setDialogError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function sendCode() {
    if (sending || verifying) return;
    setSending(true);
    setBannerError(null);
    setDialogError(null);
    // The error belongs where the person is looking: the dialog when it is open.
    const fail = (message: string) => (open ? setDialogError(message) : setBannerError(message));
    try {
      const res = await authClient.emailOtp.sendVerificationOtp({ email, type: "email-verification" });
      if (res.error?.status === 429) {
        fail(RATE_LIMITED);
        return;
      }
      // Any other outcome gets the same answer: the endpoint never says whether the address exists.
      setSent(true);
      setCode("");
      setCodeError(null);
      setOpen(true);
    } catch {
      fail(SEND_FAILED);
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  }

  async function verify(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (verifying || sending) return;
    const otp = code.replace(/\s/g, "");
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(otp)) {
      setCodeError(CODE_FORMAT);
      return;
    }
    setCodeError(null);
    setDialogError(null);
    setVerifying(true);
    try {
      const res = await authClient.emailOtp.verifyEmail({ email, otp });
      if (res.error) {
        setDialogError(res.error.status === 429 ? RATE_LIMITED : WRONG_CODE);
        return;
      }
      // The cookie cache still says « not verified »: refresh the session cookie first.
      await authClient.getSession({ query: { disableCookieCache: true } });
      setOpen(false);
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      setDialogError(VERIFY_FAILED);
    } finally {
      setVerifying(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div
        role="status"
        className="mb-6 flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
      >
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3">
          <Mail className="mt-0.5 size-5 shrink-0 text-warning" aria-hidden />
          <div className="min-w-0 text-sm">
            <p className="break-words font-medium text-foreground">
              {`Confirmez votre adresse ${email} pour sécuriser votre compte.`}
            </p>
            {sent && <p className="mt-1 text-foreground">{SENT}</p>}
            {bannerError && (
              <p role="alert" className="mt-1 text-destructive">
                {bannerError}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={sendCode} disabled={sending}>
          {sending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
          Recevoir un code
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Dialog open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Confirmer votre adresse">
        <form onSubmit={verify} noValidate className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{`Saisissez le code à 6 chiffres envoyé à ${email}.`}</p>
          {sent && (
            <p role="status" className="text-sm">
              {SENT}
            </p>
          )}
          <FormField
            label="Code reçu par email"
            htmlFor="verify-email-code"
            help="6 chiffres, valable 5 minutes."
            error={codeError}
          >
            <Input
              id="verify-email-code"
              inputMode="numeric"
              autoComplete="one-time-code"
              maxLength={6}
              value={code}
              onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""))}
              className="text-center text-lg tracking-[0.4em]"
            />
          </FormField>
          <FormError message={dialogError} />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1">
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={sendCode} disabled={sending || verifying}>
              {sending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
              Renvoyer le code
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={verifying || sending}>
              {verifying && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
              Confirmer
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}
```

`src/server/admin-queries.ts` keeps every exported shape the admin pages use today and gains the re-exports `ACTIVITY_LIMIT`, `type ActivityEvent` and the wrappers `listRecentBookings(status)` / `listRecentPurchases(status)`. `getAppHealth`, `getUserDetail`, `getProStats` and `getDeletionImpact` are rewired in Task 40, in the same commit as their consumers (`app-health-card.tsx`, `users/[id]/page.tsx`, `delete-user-card.tsx`), so that tsc stays green after this task (see "Contract deviations").

Design notes (read before coding):
- All queries are platform-wide reads: the only tenant filters are the explicit `professionalId` arguments. The tenancy proof of this file is the scoped cases (`platformRevenue` by pro, `proStats` of two pros, `deletionImpactFor`).
- List reads use the Drizzle builder (typed `Date` columns); counters use one raw `db.execute` of scalar sub-selects each. A `Date` is always passed through `ts()`.
- `horizonLag` mirrors `minGeneratedUntil` (`src/lib/booking/occurrences.ts`): a live segment is behind when its rule can still produce dates (`lastSeriesDate` null or after `generated_until`) AND `generated_until` is before the PRO'S local today + `HORIZON_REFRESH_DAYS` (computed in SQL with `at time zone professional.timezone`, so the cutoff follows each pro's own calendar day).
- `pendingHolds` is `created_at < now - 1 h`, not `hold_expires_at`: a hold that the nightly job has not expired one hour after creation is the anomaly Q24 asks for.

```ts
  db: Db,
  pro: TestPro,
  opts: { livemode: boolean; priceCents?: number; customerName?: string; now?: Date },
): Promise<Paid> {
  const ticketTypeId = await makeType(db, pro);
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, ticketTypeId, { quantity: 2, priceCents: opts.priceCents ?? 4200 });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: opts.customerName });
  const started = await startPurchase(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, offerId, customerId }, opts.now);
  assert.ok(started.ok, JSON.stringify(started));
  const done = await fulfillPurchase(db, started.purchaseId, payment(opts.livemode), opts.now);
  assert.equal(done.outcome, "fulfilled");
  return { purchaseId: started.purchaseId, customerId, ticketTypeId, label: started.label, amountCents: started.amountCents };
}

async function businessNameOf(db: Db, pro: TestPro): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ name: schema.professional.businessName })
    .from(schema.professional)
    .where(eq(schema.professional.id, pro.proId));
  return row.name;
}

/** A one-off event row (rowEvent) renamed to `title`. */
async function titledEvent(db: Db, pro: TestPro, title: string): Promise<string> {
  const eventId = await rowEvent(db, pro);
  await db.update(schema.event).set({ title }).where(eq(schema.event.id, eventId));
  return eventId;
}

async function generatedUntilOf(db: Db, eventId: string): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ value: schema.event.generatedUntil })
    .from(schema.event)
    .where(eq(schema.event.id, eventId));
  return row.value;
}

dbTest("activityCounts30d: a confirmed booking makes its pro active and adds one booking", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const before = await activityCounts30d(db, now);

  // One séance holding three confirmed bookings (two recent, one created 40 days ago) and a cancelled one.
  const seance = await rowSeance(db, pro, await rowEvent(db, pro), { seatsTaken: 3 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: seance, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro), status: "confirmed" });
  const afterOne = await activityCounts30d(db, now);
  assert.equal(afterOne.activePros30d, before.activePros30d + 1);
  assert.equal(afterOne.bookings30d, before.bookings30d + 1);

  // A second confirmed booking of the same pro adds a booking, not a pro.
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: seance, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro), status: "confirmed" });
  const afterTwo = await activityCounts30d(db, now);
  assert.equal(afterTwo.activePros30d, before.activePros30d + 1);
  assert.equal(afterTwo.bookings30d, before.bookings30d + 2);

  // A booking created 40 days ago and a cancelled one count for nothing.
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: seance, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro), status: "confirmed" }, addDaysMs(now, -40));
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: seance, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro), status: "cancelled" });
  assert.deepEqual(await activityCounts30d(db, now), afterTwo);
});

dbTest("activityCounts30d: a paid purchase makes its pro active whatever its mode, without adding a booking", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const before = await activityCounts30d(db, now);

  await paidPurchase(db, pro, { livemode: false });
  const after = await activityCounts30d(db, now);
  assert.equal(after.activePros30d, before.activePros30d + 1);
  assert.equal(after.bookings30d, before.bookings30d);

  // A second purchase of the same pro (live) adds nobody.
  await paidPurchase(db, pro, { livemode: true });
  assert.deepEqual(await activityCounts30d(db, now), after);

  // Another pro whose only purchase was paid 40 days ago, or is still pending, is not active.
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    await paidPurchase(db, other, { livemode: false, now: addDaysMs(now, -40) });
    const typeId = await rowType(db, other);
    await rowPurchase(db, other, {
      customerId: await rowCustomer(db, other),
      offerId: await rowOffer(db, other, typeId),
      ticketTypeId: typeId,
    });
    assert.deepEqual(await activityCounts30d(db, now), after);
    assert.deepEqual(await checkInvariants(db, { proId: other.proId }), []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("platformRevenue: paid purchases of the asked mode, scoped by pro and by period", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  await paidPurchase(db, pro, { livemode: false, priceCents: 4200 });
  await paidPurchase(db, pro, { livemode: true, priceCents: 1000 });

  assert.deepEqual(await platformRevenue(db, { live: false, professionalId: pro.proId }), [{ currency: "eur", cents: 4200 }]);
  assert.deepEqual(await platformRevenue(db, { live: true, professionalId: pro.proId }), [{ currency: "eur", cents: 1000 }]);
  assert.deepEqual(
    await platformRevenue(db, { live: false, professionalId: pro.proId, since: addMinutes(now, -60) }),
    [{ currency: "eur", cents: 4200 }],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(await platformRevenue(db, { live: false, professionalId: pro.proId, since: addMinutes(now, 60) }), []);

  // Another pro sees none of it, and an empty id never widens the scope to the whole platform.
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(await platformRevenue(db, { live: false, professionalId: other.proId }), []);
    assert.deepEqual(await platformRevenue(db, { live: true, professionalId: other.proId }), []);
    assert.deepEqual(await platformRevenue(db, { live: false, professionalId: "" }), []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("feed events read « Réservation · … » and « Achat · … » with the customer, the title and the amount", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const businessName = await businessNameOf(db, pro);

  // A confirmed séance booking, a confirmed RDV and a cancelled booking.
  const seance = await rowSeance(db, pro, await titledEvent(db, pro, "Altinha débutants"), { seatsTaken: 1 });
  const booked = await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: seance,
    customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida" }),
    status: "confirmed",
  });
  const rdv = await rowRdv(db, pro, await rowRdvType(db, pro, { name: "Cours particulier" }));
  const rdvBooked = await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: rdv,
    customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Rafael Souza" }),
    status: "confirmed",
  });
  const cancelled = await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: seance,
    customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Thomas Leroy" }),
    status: "cancelled",
  });

  const bookings = await recentBookingEvents(db, 50);
  const seanceEvent = bookings.find((e) => e.id === `booking-${booked}`);
  assert.ok(seanceEvent, "the séance booking is in the feed");
  assert.equal(seanceEvent.kind, "booking");
  assert.equal(seanceEvent.userId, pro.userId);
  assert.ok(seanceEvent.title.startsWith("Réservation · Test "));
  assert.equal(seanceEvent.title, `Réservation · ${businessName}`);
  assert.equal(seanceEvent.detail, `Beatriz Almeida · Altinha débutants · ${BOOKING_STATUS_LABELS.confirmed}`);
  const rdvEvent = bookings.find((e) => e.id === `booking-${rdvBooked}`);
  assert.ok(rdvEvent, "the RDV booking is in the feed");
  assert.equal(rdvEvent.detail, `Rafael Souza · Cours particulier · ${BOOKING_STATUS_LABELS.confirmed}`);
  assert.equal(bookings.some((e) => e.id === `booking-${cancelled}`), false);
  assert.ok((await recentBookingEvents(db, 2)).length <= 2);

  // A paid purchase is in the purchase feed, a pending one is not.
  const paid = await paidPurchase(db, pro, { livemode: false, customerName: "Marina Costa", priceCents: 4250 });
  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro);
  const pending = await rowPurchase(db, pro, {
    customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro),
    offerId: await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId),
    ticketTypeId: typeId,
  });
  const purchases = await recentPurchaseEvents(db, 50);
  const bought = purchases.find((e) => e.id === `purchase-${paid.purchaseId}`);
  assert.ok(bought, "the paid purchase is in the feed");
  assert.equal(bought.kind, "purchase");
  assert.equal(bought.userId, pro.userId);
  assert.ok(bought.title.startsWith("Achat · Test "));
  assert.equal(bought.title, `Achat · ${businessName}`);
  assert.equal(bought.detail, `Marina Costa · ${paid.label} · ${formatMoney(4250, "eur")}`);
  assert.equal(purchases.some((e) => e.id === `purchase-${pending}`), false);
});

dbTest("listRecentBookings: status filter, newest first, title from the event or from the RDV type", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const businessName = await businessNameOf(db, pro);
  const seance = await rowSeance(db, pro, await titledEvent(db, pro, "Roda libre"), { seatsTaken: 1 });
  const confirmed = await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: seance,
    customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Léa Martin" }),
    status: "confirmed",
    coverage: "free",
  });
  const cancelled = await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: seance,
    customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro),
    status: "cancelled",
  });

  // A pending RDV: its hold belongs to a pending purchase (booking_pending_chk).
  const typeId = await rowRdvType(db, pro, { name: "Cours particulier" });
  const rdv = await rowRdv(db, pro, typeId);
  const buyer = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const purchaseId = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: buyer, offerId: await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId), ticketTypeId: typeId });
  const pending = await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: rdv, customerId: buyer, status: "pending", purchaseId });

  const all = await listRecentBookings(db, null);
  assert.ok(all.length <= ACTIVITY_LIMIT);
  for (let i = 1; i < all.length; i++) {
    assert.ok(all[i - 1].createdAt.getTime() >= all[i].createdAt.getTime(), "newest first");
  }

  const row = all.find((r) => r.id === confirmed);
  assert.ok(row, "the confirmed booking is listed");
  assert.equal(row.title, "Roda libre");
  assert.equal(row.status, "confirmed");
  assert.equal(row.coverage, "free");
  assert.equal(row.proUserId, pro.userId);
  assert.equal(row.businessName, businessName);
  assert.equal(row.timezone, "Europe/Paris");
  assert.equal(row.customerName, "Léa Martin");
  assert.ok(row.customerEmail.endsWith("@skedul.test"));
  assert.equal(row.startsAt.getTime(), (await getOccurrence(db, seance)).startsAt.getTime());
  assert.equal(row.endsAt.getTime(), (await getOccurrence(db, seance)).endsAt.getTime());

  const rdvRow = all.find((r) => r.id === pending);
  assert.ok(rdvRow, "the pending RDV booking is listed");
  assert.equal(rdvRow.title, "Cours particulier");
  assert.equal(rdvRow.status, "pending");

  const onlyCancelled = await listRecentBookings(db, "cancelled");
  assert.ok(onlyCancelled.every((r) => r.status === "cancelled"));
  assert.ok(onlyCancelled.some((r) => r.id === cancelled));
  assert.equal(onlyCancelled.some((r) => r.id === confirmed), false);
  const onlyPending = await listRecentBookings(db, "pending");
  assert.ok(onlyPending.every((r) => r.status === "pending"));
  assert.ok(onlyPending.some((r) => r.id === pending));
  assert.equal(onlyPending.some((r) => r.id === cancelled), false);
});

dbTest("listRecentPurchases: label, quantity, amount, mode and status filter", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const businessName = await businessNameOf(db, pro);
  const test = await paidPurchase(db, pro, { livemode: false, customerName: "Marina Costa", priceCents: 4200 });
  const live = await paidPurchase(db, pro, { livemode: true, priceCents: 1000 });
  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro);
  const pendingId = await rowPurchase(db, pro, {
    customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro),
    offerId: await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId),
    ticketTypeId: typeId,
  });

  const all = await listRecentPurchases(db, null);
  assert.ok(all.length <= ACTIVITY_LIMIT);
  const t = all.find((r) => r.id === test.purchaseId);
  assert.ok(t, "the test-mode purchase is listed");
  assert.equal(t.livemode, false);
  assert.equal(t.status, "paid");
  assert.equal(t.amountCents, 4200);
  assert.equal(t.currency, "eur");
  assert.equal(t.label, test.label);
  assert.equal(t.quantity, 2);
  assert.equal(t.customerName, "Marina Costa");
  assert.equal(t.proUserId, pro.userId);
  assert.equal(t.businessName, businessName);
  assert.ok(t.paidAt instanceof Date);
  assert.equal(all.find((r) => r.id === live.purchaseId)?.livemode, true);
  const p = all.find((r) => r.id === pendingId);
  assert.ok(p, "the pending purchase is listed");
  assert.equal(p.status, "pending");
  assert.equal(p.paidAt, null);

  const paidOnly = await listRecentPurchases(db, "paid");
  assert.ok(paidOnly.every((r) => r.status === "paid"));
  assert.ok(paidOnly.some((r) => r.id === test.purchaseId) && paidOnly.some((r) => r.id === live.purchaseId));
  assert.equal(paidOnly.some((r) => r.id === pendingId), false);
  const pendingOnly = await listRecentPurchases(db, "pending");
  assert.ok(pendingOnly.every((r) => r.status === "pending"));
  assert.ok(pendingOnly.some((r) => r.id === pendingId));
  assert.equal(pendingOnly.some((r) => r.id === test.purchaseId), false);
});

dbTest("healthCounts: pending holds older than 1 h and pending purchases whose checkout expired", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const before = await healthCounts(db, now);
  const twoHoursAgo = addMinutes(now, -120);

  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro);
  const offerId = await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId);
  const seance = await rowSeance(db, pro, await rowEvent(db, pro), { seatsTaken: 2 });

  // A hold created 2 h ago (its checkout expired 89 minutes ago) and a fresh one (checkout open for 31 more minutes).
  const stale = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const stalePurchase = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: stale, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId }, twoHoursAgo);
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: seance, customerId: stale, status: "pending", purchaseId: stalePurchase }, twoHoursAgo);
  const fresh = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const freshPurchase = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: fresh, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId }, now);
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: seance, customerId: fresh, status: "pending", purchaseId: freshPurchase }, now);

  const after = await healthCounts(db, now);
  assert.equal(after.pendingHolds, before.pendingHolds + 1);
  assert.equal(after.pendingPurchases, before.pendingPurchases + 1);

  // A pending purchase without a booking and an expired checkout counts as a purchase only.
  await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro), offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId }, twoHoursAgo);
  const last = await healthCounts(db, now);
  assert.equal(last.pendingHolds, after.pendingHolds);
  assert.equal(last.pendingPurchases, after.pendingPurchases + 1);
});

dbTest("healthCounts: horizonLag counts live segments that can still produce dates and are behind", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const start = dayIn(pro, 3, now);
  const weekly = { freq: "weekly" as const, weekdays: [dayOfWeek(start)], interval: 1 };
  const before = await healthCounts(db, now);
  const lag = (eventId: string, daysAhead: number) =>
    db.update(schema.event).set({ generatedUntil: dayIn(pro, daysAhead, now) }).where(eq(schema.event.id, eventId));

  // An endless series generated 100 days ahead only: behind.
  const behind = await makeEvent(db, pro, { rule: { ...weekly, endMode: "never", occurrenceCount: null } }, now);
  await lag(behind.eventId, 100);
  assert.equal((await healthCounts(db, now)).horizonLag, before.horizonLag + 1);

  // The cutoff is today + 393 days: 392 days ahead is behind, 393 is not.
  await lag(behind.eventId, 392);
  assert.equal((await healthCounts(db, now)).horizonLag, before.horizonLag + 1);
  await lag(behind.eventId, 393);
  assert.equal((await healthCounts(db, now)).horizonLag, before.horizonLag);

  // Never behind although generated_until is far below the cutoff: a finished count series, an until series
  // generated up to its end date, a one-off, and an archived endless series.
  const counted = await makeEvent(db, pro, { rule: { ...weekly, endMode: "count", occurrenceCount: 3 } }, now);
  const until = await makeEvent(db, pro, { rule: { ...weekly, endMode: "until", untilDate: dayIn(pro, 60, now), occurrenceCount: null } }, now);
  const once = await makeEvent(db, pro, {}, now);
  const archived = await makeEvent(db, pro, { rule: { ...weekly, endMode: "never", occurrenceCount: null } }, now);
  await lag(archived.eventId, 100);
  await db.update(schema.event).set({ archivedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.event.id, archived.eventId));
  for (const e of [counted, until, once]) {
    assert.ok((await generatedUntilOf(db, e.eventId)) < dayIn(pro, 393, now), "generated_until is below the cutoff");
  }
  assert.equal((await healthCounts(db, now)).horizonLag, before.horizonLag);

  // The behind series counts again at 100 days, and stops counting once archived.
  await lag(behind.eventId, 100);
  assert.equal((await healthCounts(db, now)).horizonLag, before.horizonLag + 1);
  await db.update(schema.event).set({ archivedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.event.id, behind.eventId));
  assert.equal((await healthCounts(db, now)).horizonLag, before.horizonLag);
});

dbTest("healthCounts: the horizon cutoff is the local today of each pro's own time zone", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const la = await createTestPro(db, { tz: "America/Los_Angeles" });
  try {
    // 2026-11-10 03:00 UTC is already Nov 10 in Paris but still Nov 9 (19:00) in Los Angeles.
    const fixedNow = new Date("2026-11-10T03:00:00Z");
    assert.equal(todayKey(fixedNow, pro.tz), "2026-11-10");
    assert.equal(todayKey(fixedNow, la.tz), "2026-11-09");
    const before = await healthCounts(db, fixedNow);

    const real = new Date();
    const endless = (p: TestPro) =>
      makeEvent(db, p, { rule: { freq: "weekly", weekdays: [dayOfWeek(dayIn(p, 3, real))], endMode: "never", occurrenceCount: null } }, real);
    const paris = await endless(pro);
    const lax = await endless(la);
    const setUntil = (eventId: string, key: string) =>
      db.update(schema.event).set({ generatedUntil: key }).where(eq(schema.event.id, eventId));

    // Exactly at the cutoff of each pro's own today + 393 days: not behind.
    await setUntil(paris.eventId, addDays("2026-11-10", 393));
    await setUntil(lax.eventId, addDays("2026-11-09", 393));
    assert.equal((await healthCounts(db, fixedNow)).horizonLag, before.horizonLag);

    // One day short: behind. Los Angeles first (a Paris or UTC cutoff would have counted it above), then Paris.
    await setUntil(lax.eventId, addDays("2026-11-09", 392));
    assert.equal((await healthCounts(db, fixedNow)).horizonLag, before.horizonLag + 1);
    await setUntil(paris.eventId, addDays("2026-11-10", 392));
    assert.equal((await healthCounts(db, fixedNow)).horizonLag, before.horizonLag + 2);
    assert.deepEqual(await checkInvariants(db, { proId: la.proId }), []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, la.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("healthCounts: orphan payments and the nightly check come from the stored counters, null before the first run", async ({ db }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const keys = Object.values(HEALTH_KEYS);
  const saved = await readHealth(db);
  try {
    await db.delete(schema.throttle).where(inArray(schema.throttle.key, keys));
    const none = await healthCounts(db, now);
    assert.equal(none.orphanPayments, null);
    assert.equal(none.invariantViolations, null);

    const at = new Date("2026-10-01T02:00:00Z");
    await setHealth(db, HEALTH_KEYS.orphanPayments, 3, at);
    await setHealth(db, HEALTH_KEYS.invariantViolations, 0, at);
    const stored = await healthCounts(db, now);
    assert.deepEqual(stored.orphanPayments, { value: 3, at });
    assert.deepEqual(stored.invariantViolations, { value: 0, at });
  } finally {
    await db.delete(schema.throttle).where(inArray(schema.throttle.key, keys));
    for (const key of keys) {
      const entry = saved[key];
      if (entry) await setHealth(db, key, entry.value, entry.at);
    }
  }
});

dbTest("proStats: live series, active types, bookings, clients and paid purchases of one pro only", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  assert.deepEqual(await proStats(db, pro.proId, now), {
    events: 0,
    ticketTypes: 0,
    confirmedBookings: 0,
    upcoming: 0,
    clients: 0,
    paidPurchases: 0,
  });

  // Series: A = an archived first segment and a live second segment (ONE series), B live, C archived.
  const firstSegment = await rowEvent(db, pro, { archivedAt: now });
  const secondSegment = await rowEvent(db, pro);
  await db.update(schema.event).set({ seriesRootId: firstSegment }).where(eq(schema.event.id, secondSegment));
  const live = await rowEvent(db, pro);
  await rowEvent(db, pro, { archivedAt: now });

  // Types: two active, one archived.
  const typeA = await rowType(db, pro);
  await rowType(db, pro);
  await rowType(db, pro, { archivedAt: now });
  const offerA = await rowOffer(db, pro, typeA);

  // Séances of series B: one in two days (confirmed + pending), one three days ago (confirmed).
  const future = await rowSeance(db, pro, live, { seatsTaken: 2 });
  const past = await rowSeance(db, pro, live, { startsAt: addDaysMs(now, -3), seatsTaken: 1 });
  const confirmedFuture = await rowCustomer(db, pro); // a client: confirmed booking
  const pendingOnly = await rowCustomer(db, pro); // not a client: only a pending hold
  const cancelledOnly = await rowCustomer(db, pro); // not a client: only a cancelled booking
  const confirmedPast = await rowCustomer(db, pro); // a client
  const ticketOnly = await rowCustomer(db, pro); // a client: holds a ticket
  await rowCustomer(db, pro); // not a client: nothing yet
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: future, customerId: confirmedFuture, status: "confirmed" });
  const holdPurchase = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: pendingOnly, offerId: offerA, ticketTypeId: typeA });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: future, customerId: pendingOnly, status: "pending", purchaseId: holdPurchase });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: future, customerId: cancelledOnly, status: "cancelled" });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: past, customerId: confirmedPast, status: "confirmed" });
  await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId: ticketOnly, ticketTypeId: typeA });

  // One paid purchase: a new active type, a new client (it holds tickets), one paid purchase.
  await paidPurchase(db, pro, { livemode: false });

  // Another pro's rows never leak in.
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    await rowEvent(db, other);
    await rowType(db, other);
    await paidPurchase(db, other, { livemode: true });

    assert.deepEqual(await proStats(db, pro.proId, now), {
      events: 2, // series A (through its live second segment) and series B
      ticketTypes: 3, // typeA, the second active type, and the paid purchase's type
      confirmedBookings: 2, // the future one and the past one
      upcoming: 2, // the confirmed and the pending booking on the future séance
      clients: 4, // confirmedFuture, confirmedPast, ticketOnly and the buyer
      paidPurchases: 1,
    });
    assert.deepEqual(await proStats(db, other.proId, now), {
      events: 1,
      ticketTypes: 2,
      confirmedBookings: 0,
      upcoming: 0,
      clients: 1,
      paidPurchases: 1,
    });
    assert.deepEqual(await checkInvariants(db, { proId: other.proId }), []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("deletionImpactFor: tickets in circulation, payments in progress and client records elsewhere", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  assert.deepEqual(await deletionImpactFor(db, pro.userId, pro.proId, now), {
    ticketsInCirculation: 0,
    pendingPayments: 0,
    clientRecordsElsewhere: 0,
  });

  // Three usable tickets and one already expired (not in circulation).
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro);
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeId, 3);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeId, 1, { now: addDaysMs(now, -30), expiresAt: addDaysMs(now, -1) });

  // A checkout in progress: a pending purchase whose checkout is still open.
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId);
  const started = await startPurchase(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, offerId, customerId }, now);
  assert.ok(started.ok, JSON.stringify(started));

  // This very user is also a client of another pro; a record at its own pro is not "elsewhere".
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    await rowCustomer(db, other, { userId: pro.userId });
    await rowCustomer(db, pro, { userId: pro.userId });
    assert.deepEqual(await deletionImpactFor(db, pro.userId, pro.proId, now), {
      ticketsInCirculation: 3,
      pendingPayments: 1,
      clientRecordsElsewhere: 1,
    });

    // An account without a pro page: no tickets, no payments, every linked client record counts.
    assert.deepEqual(await deletionImpactFor(db, pro.userId, null, now), {
      ticketsInCirculation: 0,
      pendingPayments: 0,
      clientRecordsElsewhere: 2,
    });
    // Another pro's tickets and payments are never read for this user.
    assert.deepEqual(await deletionImpactFor(db, other.userId, other.proId, now), {
      ticketsInCirculation: 0,
      pendingPayments: 0,
      clientRecordsElsewhere: 0,
    });
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});
```
