```ts
/**
 * Admin reads on the tickets domain (spec § 13.8, Q24). Platform-wide queries
 * for /admin: no professional filter unless an argument asks for one. No
 * `server-only`, no env and no process db: src/server/admin-queries.ts wraps
 * these with the real db and the Stripe mode, and the DB tests call them with
 * the test db.
 */
import { and, desc, eq, isNull, ne, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { mergeMoney, type MoneyTotal } from "@/lib/admin-metrics";
import { deletionImpact } from "@/lib/booking/account";
import { ruleOf } from "@/lib/booking/occurrences";
import { revenueByCurrency } from "@/lib/booking/revenue";
import { compareKeys } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { ts, type Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, customer, event, occurrence, professional, ticketPurchase, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { lastSeriesDate } from "@/lib/recurrence";
import { HEALTH_KEYS, readHealth } from "@/lib/throttle";
import {
  BOOKING_STATUS_LABELS,
  HORIZON_REFRESH_DAYS,
  type BookingCoverage,
  type BookingStatus,
  type PurchaseStatus,
} from "@/lib/tickets";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils";

const HOUR_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;
const DAY_MS = 24 * HOUR_MS;

/* ───────────────────────────── Overview ───────────────────────────── */

export type ActivityEvent = {
  id: string;
  kind: "signup" | "pro" | "booking" | "purchase";
  at: Date;
  /** The account the event belongs to (links to /admin/users/[id]). */
  userId: string;
  title: string;
  detail: string;
};

/** Rows per list of /admin/activity, and the default size of the overview feed sources. */
export const ACTIVITY_LIMIT = 50;

/**
 * Pros with a confirmed booking created, or a paid purchase (whatever its
 * livemode: this measures activity, not revenue), in the last 30 days; and the
 * confirmed bookings created in those 30 days.
 */
export async function activityCounts30d(db: Db, now: Date): Promise<{ activePros30d: number; bookings30d: number }> {
  const since = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * DAY_MS);
  const res = await db.execute<{ pros: number; bookings: number }>(sql`
    select
      (select count(*)::int from (
        select professional_id from booking where status = 'confirmed' and created_at >= ${ts(since)}
        union
        select professional_id from ticket_purchase where status = 'paid' and paid_at >= ${ts(since)}
      ) active) as pros,
      (select count(*)::int from booking where status = 'confirmed' and created_at >= ${ts(since)}) as bookings`);
  const row = res.rows[0];
  return { activePros30d: Number(row?.pros ?? 0), bookings30d: Number(row?.bookings ?? 0) };
}

/**
 * « Encaissé » for the admin: the paid purchases of the asked mode summed per
 * currency (biggest first, zeros dropped). An empty professionalId is refused
 * with an empty result: paidPurchaseOf treats a falsy id as "no scope", which
 * would silently widen the figure to the whole platform.
 */
export async function platformRevenue(
  db: Db,
  opts: { live: boolean; since?: Date; professionalId?: string },
): Promise<MoneyTotal[]> {
  if (opts.professionalId === "") return [];
  return mergeMoney(await revenueByCurrency(db, opts));
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Bookings and purchases ───────────────────────────── */

/** Every booking column the feed and the list need; callers add where / order / limit. */
function bookingRows(db: Db) {
  return db
    .select({
      id: booking.id,
      createdAt: booking.createdAt,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
      status: booking.status,
      coverage: booking.coverage,
      proUserId: professional.userId,
      businessName: professional.businessName,
      timezone: professional.timezone,
      customerName: customer.name,
      customerEmail: customer.email,
      // a séance has an event, an RDV has a ticket type (occurrence_kind_chk)
      title: sql<string>`coalesce(${event.title}, ${ticketType.name})`,
    })
    .from(booking)
    .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
    .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, booking.professionalId))
    .innerJoin(customer, eq(customer.id, booking.customerId));
}

/** Every purchase column the feed and the list need; callers add where / order / limit. */
function purchaseRows(db: Db) {
  return db
    .select({
      id: ticketPurchase.id,
      createdAt: ticketPurchase.createdAt,
      paidAt: ticketPurchase.paidAt,
      status: ticketPurchase.status,
      amountCents: ticketPurchase.amountCents,
      currency: ticketPurchase.currency,
      livemode: ticketPurchase.livemode,
      label: ticketPurchase.label,
      quantity: ticketPurchase.quantity,
      proUserId: professional.userId,
      businessName: professional.businessName,
      customerName: customer.name,
      customerEmail: customer.email,
    })
    .from(ticketPurchase)
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, ticketPurchase.professionalId))
    .innerJoin(customer, eq(customer.id, ticketPurchase.customerId));
}

/** The latest confirmed bookings as feed events: « Réservation · {businessName} ». */
export async function recentBookingEvents(db: Db, limit: number): Promise<ActivityEvent[]> {
  const rows = await bookingRows(db)
    .where(eq(booking.status, "confirmed"))
    .orderBy(desc(booking.createdAt), desc(booking.id))
    .limit(limit);
  return rows.map((r) => ({
    id: `booking-${r.id}`,
    kind: "booking" as const,
    at: r.createdAt,
    userId: r.proUserId,
    title: `Réservation · ${r.businessName}`,
    detail: `${r.customerName} · ${r.title} · ${BOOKING_STATUS_LABELS[r.status]}`,
  }));
}

/** The latest paid purchases as feed events: « Achat · {businessName} ». */
export async function recentPurchaseEvents(db: Db, limit: number): Promise<ActivityEvent[]> {
  const rows = await purchaseRows(db)
    .where(eq(ticketPurchase.status, "paid"))
    .orderBy(desc(ticketPurchase.paidAt), desc(ticketPurchase.id))
    .limit(limit);
  return rows.map((r) => ({
    id: `purchase-${r.id}`,
    kind: "purchase" as const,
    at: r.paidAt ?? r.createdAt,
    userId: r.proUserId,
    title: `Achat · ${r.businessName}`,
    detail: `${r.customerName} · ${r.label} · ${formatMoney(r.amountCents, r.currency)}`,
  }));
}

export type AdminBookingRow = {
  id: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  startsAt: Date;
  endsAt: Date;
  status: BookingStatus;
  coverage: BookingCoverage;
  proUserId: string;
  businessName: string;
  timezone: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  title: string;
};

/** /admin/activity « Inscriptions »: newest first (created_at), ACTIVITY_LIMIT rows, optionally one status. */
export async function listRecentBookings(db: Db, status: BookingStatus | null): Promise<AdminBookingRow[]> {
  return bookingRows(db)
    .where(status ? eq(booking.status, status) : undefined)
    .orderBy(desc(booking.createdAt), desc(booking.id))
    .limit(ACTIVITY_LIMIT);
}

export type AdminPurchaseRow = {
  id: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  paidAt: Date | null;
  status: PurchaseStatus;
  amountCents: number;
  currency: string;
  livemode: boolean;
  label: string;
  quantity: number;
  proUserId: string;
  businessName: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
};

/** /admin/activity « Achats »: newest first (created_at), ACTIVITY_LIMIT rows, optionally one status. */
export async function listRecentPurchases(db: Db, status: PurchaseStatus | null): Promise<AdminPurchaseRow[]> {
  return purchaseRows(db)
    .where(status ? eq(ticketPurchase.status, status) : undefined)
    .orderBy(desc(ticketPurchase.createdAt), desc(ticketPurchase.id))
    .limit(ACTIVITY_LIMIT);
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Health ───────────────────────────── */

export type HealthCounts = {
  /** Pending bookings created more than 1 h ago. */
  pendingHolds: number;
  /** Pending purchases whose checkout has expired. */
  pendingPurchases: number;
  /** Live segments that can still produce dates, generated less than HORIZON_REFRESH_DAYS ahead (pro time zone). */
  horizonLag: number;
  /** Payments received for a purchase that no longer exists (refund by hand in Stripe). */
  orphanPayments: { value: number; at: Date } | null;
  /** Result of the last nightly invariant check; null = it never ran. */
  invariantViolations: { value: number; at: Date } | null;
};

/**
 * Same rule as minGeneratedUntil (src/lib/booking/occurrences.ts): a segment
 * is complete once generated_until reaches the last date its rule can produce
 * (never for an endless one). SQL keeps the candidates (live, recurring, behind
 * the cutoff of its pro's OWN local today + HORIZON_REFRESH_DAYS); the rule
 * check needs the recurrence walk, so it runs here.
 */
async function laggingSeries(db: Db, now: Date): Promise<number> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ row: event })
    .from(event)
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, event.professionalId))
    .where(
      and(
        isNull(event.archivedAt),
        ne(event.freq, "once"),
        or(ne(event.endMode, "until"), sql`${event.untilDate} > ${event.generatedUntil}`),
        sql`${event.generatedUntil} < ((${ts(now)} at time zone ${professional.timezone})::date + ${HORIZON_REFRESH_DAYS}::int)`,
      ),
    );
  return rows.filter(({ row }) => {
    const last = lastSeriesDate(ruleOf(row));
    return last === null || compareKeys(row.generatedUntil, last) < 0;
  }).length;
}

export async function healthCounts(db: Db, now: Date): Promise<HealthCounts> {
  const holdCutoff = new Date(now.getTime() - HOUR_MS);
  const [pending, horizonLag, health] = await Promise.all([
    db.execute<{ holds: number; purchases: number }>(sql`
      select
        (select count(*)::int from booking where status = 'pending' and created_at < ${ts(holdCutoff)}) as holds,
        (select count(*)::int from ticket_purchase where status = 'pending' and checkout_expires_at < ${ts(now)}) as purchases`),
    laggingSeries(db, now),
    readHealth(db),
  ]);
  const row = pending.rows[0];
  return {
    pendingHolds: Number(row?.holds ?? 0),
    pendingPurchases: Number(row?.purchases ?? 0),
    horizonLag,
    orphanPayments: health[HEALTH_KEYS.orphanPayments] ?? null,
    invariantViolations: health[HEALTH_KEYS.invariantViolations] ?? null,
  };
}

/* ───────────────────────────── One pro ───────────────────────────── */

export type ProStats = {
  events: number;
  ticketTypes: number;
  confirmedBookings: number;
  upcoming: number;
  clients: number;
  paidPurchases: number;
};

/**
 * One pro's footprint for /admin/users/[id]. events = live series (distinct
 * series root among the non-archived segments: a split series is ONE event);
 * ticketTypes = non-archived; upcoming = pending + confirmed bookings on
 * future occurrences; clients = spec § 9 (a confirmed booking ever, or a
 * ticket in any state); paidPurchases = paid whatever the livemode.
 */
export async function proStats(db: Db, professionalId: string, now: Date): Promise<ProStats> {
  const res = await db.execute<{
    events: number;
    ticket_types: number;
    confirmed: number;
    upcoming: number;
    clients: number;
    paid: number;
  }>(sql`
    select
      (select count(distinct coalesce(series_root_id, id))::int from event
        where professional_id = ${professionalId} and archived_at is null) as events,
      (select count(*)::int from ticket_type
        where professional_id = ${professionalId} and archived_at is null) as ticket_types,
      (select count(*)::int from booking
        where professional_id = ${professionalId} and status = 'confirmed') as confirmed,
      (select count(*)::int from booking b join occurrence o on o.id = b.occurrence_id
        where b.professional_id = ${professionalId} and b.status in ('pending', 'confirmed')
          and o.starts_at > ${ts(now)}) as upcoming,
      (select count(*)::int from customer c
        where c.professional_id = ${professionalId}
          and (exists (select 1 from booking b where b.customer_id = c.id and b.status = 'confirmed')
            or exists (select 1 from ticket t where t.customer_id = c.id))) as clients,
      (select count(*)::int from ticket_purchase
        where professional_id = ${professionalId} and status = 'paid') as paid`);
  const row = res.rows[0];
  return {
    events: Number(row?.events ?? 0),
    ticketTypes: Number(row?.ticket_types ?? 0),
    confirmedBookings: Number(row?.confirmed ?? 0),
    upcoming: Number(row?.upcoming ?? 0),
    clients: Number(row?.clients ?? 0),
    paidPurchases: Number(row?.paid ?? 0),
  };
}

/**
 * What deleting this account changes beyond its own pro page: usable tickets
 * and payments in progress of its page (deletionImpact), and the client
 * records of this user at OTHER pros (kept, detached from the account).
 */
export async function deletionImpactFor(
  db: Db,
  userId: string,
  professionalId: string | null,
  now: Date,
): Promise<{ ticketsInCirculation: number; pendingPayments: number; clientRecordsElsewhere: number }> {
  const [impact, elsewhere] = await Promise.all([
    professionalId ? deletionImpact(db, professionalId, now) : { ticketsInCirculation: 0, pendingPayments: 0 },
    db.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`
      select count(*)::int as n from customer
      where user_id = ${userId} ${professionalId ? sql`and professional_id <> ${professionalId}` : sql``}`),
  ]);
  return { ...impact, clientRecordsElsewhere: Number(elsewhere.rows[0]?.n ?? 0) };
}
```

- Consumes: Task 39 (`healthCounts`, `proStats`, `deletionImpactFor`, `listRecentBookings`, `listRecentPurchases`, `ACTIVITY_LIMIT`, `HealthCounts`, `ProStats`, `AdminBookingRow`, `AdminPurchaseRow`); Task 3 `formatWhen(start, end, tz)` and `plural(n, one, many)` from `@/lib/back-office/format`; Task 8 `TableSkeleton` from `@/components/dashboard/skeleton`; Task 5 `expireCheckoutSession(checkoutSessionId): Promise<"expired" | "not_open" | "mock" | "failed">` from `@/lib/stripe` (never throws); `pendingCheckoutSessions(db, professionalId)` from `@/lib/booking/account`; `parseActivityTab`, `parseBookingStatus`, `parsePurchaseStatus`, `BOOKING_STATUS_LABELS`, `COVERAGE_LABELS`, `PURCHASE_STATUS_LABELS` from `@/lib/admin-params` (already there); `FilterChips`, `PageHeader`, `Badge`, `Card`.
- Produces:

```ts
// src/lib/admin-health.ts (pure)
export type HealthAlert = { key: "holds" | "purchases" | "orphans" | "horizon"; text: string; href: string | null };
export function healthAlerts(health: HealthCounts, tz: string): HealthAlert[];
export type NightlyCheck = { tone: "neutral" | "success" | "warning"; label: string };
export function nightlyCheck(result: HealthCounts["invariantViolations"], tz: string): NightlyCheck;
```

`getAppHealth(now)` returns the existing fields minus `pendingBookings`, plus `pendingHolds`, `pendingPurchases`, `horizonLag`, `orphanPayments`, `invariantViolations`. `getUserDetail(userId, now)` returns `stats: ProStats | null` and `deletion: { ticketsInCirculation, pendingPayments, clientRecordsElsewhere }`. `DeleteUserCard` props become `stats: ProStats | null; deletion: { ticketsInCirculation: number; pendingPayments: number; clientRecordsElsewhere: number }`.

Notes:
- UI rule: before writing the JSX of Steps 6 to 9, invoke the `design-taste-frontend` skill (project rule). These screens keep the existing admin system (tables inside `overflow-x-auto` cards, `FilterChips`, amber alert boxes, `Badge` variants), so the skill is applied as a consistency and mobile check, not as a redesign.
- The alert and nightly-check strings live in the pure `admin-health.ts` so their exact French copy is unit-tested; they are JS strings on purpose (an apostrophe entity followed by a line break in JSX text makes Next's SWC drop the space in front of the text).
- Deletion order (E13): the pro's open Stripe Checkout sessions are expired BEFORE the `DELETE FROM "user"`, so no client can pay a session whose purchase is about to disappear (a payment that still lands is an orphan, counted by `healthCounts`).

Create `src/lib/admin-health.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Copy of the admin « État de l'app » card (pure, so the French strings are
 * tested). Alerts are JS strings on purpose: in JSX text, an apostrophe
 * entity followed by a line break makes Next's SWC drop the whitespace in
 * front of the text. Dates are formatted in the zone the caller passes.
 */
import type { HealthCounts } from "@/lib/admin-reads";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { formatDateShort } from "@/lib/datetime";

export type HealthAlert = {
  key: "holds" | "purchases" | "orphans" | "horizon";
  text: string;
  /** null = informational, nothing to open. */
  href: string | null;
};

/** The alerts to show under the health rows, in a stable order; empty when all is well. */
export function healthAlerts(health: HealthCounts, tz: string): HealthAlert[] {
  const alerts: HealthAlert[] = [];
  if (health.pendingHolds > 0) {
    alerts.push({
      key: "holds",
      text: `${plural(health.pendingHolds, "place en attente de paiement", "places en attente de paiement")} depuis plus d'1 h`,
      href: "/admin/activity?tab=bookings&status=pending",
    });
  }
  if (health.pendingPurchases > 0) {
    alerts.push({
      key: "purchases",
      text: `${plural(health.pendingPurchases, "achat en attente", "achats en attente")} après l'expiration du paiement`,
      href: "/admin/activity?tab=purchases&status=pending",
    });
  }
  if (health.orphanPayments && health.orphanPayments.value > 0) {
    const { value, at } = health.orphanPayments;
    alerts.push({
      key: "orphans",
      text: `${plural(value, "paiement orphelin", "paiements orphelins")} à rembourser dans Stripe (dernier le ${formatDateShort(at, tz)})`,
      href: null,
    });
  }
  if (health.horizonLag > 0) {
    alerts.push({
      key: "horizon",
      text: plural(health.horizonLag, "série en retard d'horizon", "séries en retard d'horizon"),
      href: null,
    });
  }
  return alerts;
}

export type NightlyCheck = { tone: "neutral" | "success" | "warning"; label: string };

/** The « Contrôle nocturne » row: the nightly job's last invariant check (null = it never ran). */
export function nightlyCheck(result: HealthCounts["invariantViolations"], tz: string): NightlyCheck {
  if (result === null) return { tone: "neutral", label: "Jamais exécuté" };
  const date = formatDateShort(result.at, tz);
  if (result.value === 0) return { tone: "success", label: `OK le ${date}` };
  return { tone: "warning", label: `${plural(result.value, "violation", "violations")} le ${date}` };
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { healthAlerts, nightlyCheck } from "@/lib/admin-health";
import type { IntegrationMode } from "@/lib/admin-metrics";
import { ADMIN_TZ } from "@/lib/analytics";
import type { AppHealth } from "@/server/admin-queries";

const MODE: Record<
  IntegrationMode,
  { label: string; variant: "success" | "warning" | "neutral" }
> = {
  live: { label: "Réel", variant: "success" },
  test: { label: "Test", variant: "warning" },
  mock: { label: "Simulé", variant: "neutral" },
};

function onOff(on: boolean, yes: string, no: string) {
  return <Badge variant={on ? "success" : "neutral"}>{on ? yes : no}</Badge>;
}

const ALERT_CLASS = "flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 p-3 text-sm text-warning";

export function AppHealthCard({ health }: { health: AppHealth }) {
  const check = nightlyCheck(health.invariantViolations, ADMIN_TZ);
  const rows: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    { label: "Environnement", value: <Badge variant="outline">{health.appEnv}</Badge> },
    {
      label: "Paiements (Stripe)",
      value: <Badge variant={MODE[health.stripe].variant}>{MODE[health.stripe].label}</Badge>,
    },
    ...(health.stripe === "mock"
      ? []
      : [
          {
            label: "Webhook Stripe",
            value: health.stripeWebhook ? (
              <Badge variant="success">Configuré</Badge>
            ) : (
              <Badge variant="warning">Manquant</Badge>
            ),
          },
        ]),
    { label: "E-mails (Resend)", value: onOff(health.resend, "Réel", "Simulé") },
    { label: "Images (Blob)", value: onOff(health.blob, "Réel", "Simulé") },
    { label: "Google Agenda", value: onOff(health.google, "Configuré", "Non configuré") },
    {
      label: "Base de données",
      value: <span className="text-sm tabular-nums">{health.dbLatencyMs} ms</span>,
    },
    { label: "Contrôle nocturne", value: <Badge variant={check.tone}>{check.label}</Badge> },
  ];

  const alerts = healthAlerts(health, ADMIN_TZ);

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>État de l&apos;app</CardTitle>
        <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{health.appUrl}</p>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-3">
        <dl className="space-y-2">
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <div
              key={r.label}
              className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1"
            >
              <dt className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{r.label}</dt>
              <dd>{r.value}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
        {alerts.map((a) => {
          const content = (
            <>
              <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
              <span>{a.text}</span>
            </>
          );
          return a.href ? (
            <Link key={a.key} href={a.href} className={`${ALERT_CLASS} hover:bg-amber-100`}>
              {content}
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <div key={a.key} className={ALERT_CLASS}>
              {content}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export default async function AdminActivityPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ tab?: string; status?: string }>;
}) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const params = await searchParams;
  const tab = parseActivityTab(params.tab);
  const bookingStatus = tab === "bookings" ? parseBookingStatus(params.status) : null;
  const purchaseStatus = tab === "purchases" ? parsePurchaseStatus(params.status) : null;
  const status: string | null = bookingStatus ?? purchaseStatus;

  const href = (next: { tab?: ActivityTab; status?: string | null }) => {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams();
    const t = next.tab ?? tab;
    if (t !== "bookings") sp.set("tab", t);
    const s = next.status === undefined ? status : next.status;
    if (s) sp.set("status", s);
    const qs = sp.toString();
    return qs ? `/admin/activity?${qs}` : "/admin/activity";
  };

  const statusLabels: Record<string, string> =
    tab === "bookings" ? BOOKING_STATUS_LABELS : PURCHASE_STATUS_LABELS;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Activité"
        description={`Les ${ACTIVITY_LIMIT} dernières opérations, toutes pages pro confondues.`}
      />
      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <FilterChips
          label="Type d'opération"
          active={tab}
          options={[
            { value: "bookings", label: "Inscriptions", href: href({ tab: "bookings", status: null }) },
            { value: "purchases", label: "Achats", href: href({ tab: "purchases", status: null }) },
          ]}
        />
        <FilterChips
          label="Statut"
          active={status ?? "all"}
          options={[
            { value: "all", label: "Tous", href: href({ status: null }) },
            ...Object.entries(statusLabels).map(([value, label]) => ({
              value,
              label,
              href: href({ status: value }),
            })),
          ]}
        />
      </div>
      <Card className="overflow-hidden">
        {tab === "bookings" ? (
          <BookingsTable status={bookingStatus} />
        ) : (
          <PurchasesTable status={purchaseStatus} />
        )}
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";

const TEXT = "Cette page n'a pas pu se charger. Réessayez dans un instant.";

export default function ActivityError({
  error,
  unstable_retry,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  unstable_retry: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error(error);
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <Card role="alert" className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col items-center gap-3 px-6 py-12 text-center">
      <TriangleAlert className="size-8 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
      <h2 className="text-base font-semibold">Une erreur est survenue</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{TEXT}</p>
      <Button onClick={() => unstable_retry()}>Réessayer</Button>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { deletionConfirmed, type UserRole } from "@/lib/admin-params";
import type { ProStats } from "@/lib/admin-reads";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { deleteUser } from "@/server/admin";

export function DeleteUserCard({
  userId,
  email,
  role,
  pro,
  stats,
  deletion,
}: {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  role: UserRole;
  pro: { slug: string } | null;
  stats: ProStats | null;
  deletion: {
    ticketsInCirculation: number;
    pendingPayments: number;
    clientRecordsElsewhere: number;
  };
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const confirmed = deletionConfirmed(typed, email);

  function onDelete() {
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      // On success the action redirects to /admin/users and never resolves here.
      const res = await deleteUser({ userId, confirmEmail: typed });
      if (!res.ok) setError(res.error);
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card className="mt-6 border-destructive/30">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Supprimer le compte</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-3">
        {role === "admin" ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Retirez d&apos;abord le rôle admin pour pouvoir supprimer ce compte.
          </p>
        ) : !open ? (
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            className="w-full justify-start border-destructive/40 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
            onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
          >
            <Trash2 />
            Supprimer le compte…
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <>
            <p className="text-sm">Suppression définitive, sans retour possible. Seront supprimés :</p>
            <ul className="list-disc space-y-1 pl-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <li>Le compte, ses connexions et ses sessions.</li>
              {pro && stats && (
                <li>
                  {`La page /${pro.slug} et tout son contenu : ${plural(stats.events, "événement", "événements")}, ${plural(stats.ticketTypes, "type de ticket", "types de ticket")}, ${plural(stats.confirmedBookings, "inscription confirmée", "inscriptions confirmées")}, ${plural(stats.clients, "client", "clients")}, ${plural(stats.paidPurchases, "achat payé", "achats payés")}.`}
                </li>
              )}
            </ul>

            {stats && stats.upcoming > 0 && (
              <p className="rounded-lg bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-warning">
                {`${plural(stats.upcoming, "inscription à venir disparaîtra", "inscriptions à venir disparaîtront")} sans que les clients soient prévenus.`}
              </p>
            )}
            {deletion.ticketsInCirculation > 0 && (
              <p className="rounded-lg bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-warning">
                {`${plural(deletion.ticketsInCirculation, "ticket en circulation sera perdu", "tickets en circulation seront perdus")} pour ses clients, sans remboursement automatique.`}
              </p>
            )}
            {deletion.pendingPayments > 0 && (
              <p className="rounded-lg bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-warning">
                {`${plural(deletion.pendingPayments, "paiement en cours", "paiements en cours")} : leurs sessions Stripe seront expirées avant la suppression.`}
              </p>

            {deletion.clientRecordsElsewhere > 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {`Ses ${plural(deletion.clientRecordsElsewhere, "fiche client chez un autre pro est conservée", "fiches client chez d'autres pros sont conservées")}, mais détachées du compte.`}
              </p>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="confirm-delete">{`Pour confirmer, tapez ${email}`}</Label>
              <Input
                id="confirm-delete"

              <Button

                size="sm"
                variant="destructive"

              <Button

                size="sm"

                }}
              >
                Annuler
              </Button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-destructive">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

Design notes (read before coding):
- Tenancy (Review Focus 1): the token is only a claim. `findGuestCustomer` reads the customer by id; the route then compares the verified `linkVersion` with the row; the espace re-checks `customer.professional_id = pro.id` at its current `link_version` on EVERY request (`customerFromGuestCookie`), so a cookie of pro A is worthless on pro B's page and a revoked link dies at once, cookie or not.
- Order of identity (spec § 12, Decision 36): a verified, non-impersonated FRESH session wins (its customer, or `no_record`), else the `skedul_guest` cookie, else anonymous. An admin impersonating a pro never sees a client's data through the pro's session.
- `getCustomerSpace` is read-only (P4 adds cancel and spend, Decision 51). Wallet wording comes from `groupWallet` (`expirySummary`) so it never drifts from the client record.
- Same answer for every unauthorised token (404 « Not found », `Cache-Control: no-store`), except a stale version: 303 to `/{slug}/espace?lien=invalide` and the cookie is cleared (Decision 35).
- UI rule: before writing the JSX of Step 14, invoke the `design-taste-frontend` skill (project rule). The espace sits inside `PublicShell` and keeps its card system; apply the skill as a consistency and mobile check.

```ts
test("guestLinkDecision: a version different from the customer's current one is stale", () => {

test("guestLinkDecision: a link for another customer than the row is not found", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(guestLinkDecision({ customerId: "c2", linkVersion: 3 }, ROW), { kind: "not_found" });
});

test("guestLinkDecision: the current version of an existing customer is ok", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(guestLinkDecision(LINK, ROW), { kind: "ok", slug: "altinha-paris", customerId: "c1" });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Personal link and client space access (spec § 12). The pure decision of
 * /api/c/<token> lives here; the customer lookups follow below.
 */
import type { GuestLink } from "@/lib/guest-link";

export type GuestCustomerRow = { customerId: string; linkVersion: number; slug: string; proSuspended: boolean };

export type GuestLinkDecision =
  | { kind: "not_found" }
  | { kind: "stale"; slug: string }
  | { kind: "ok"; slug: string; customerId: string };

/**
 * Q21: no verified link, no customer row, a row of another customer or a
 * suspended pro are all "not found" (one answer for every unauthorised case);
 * a verified link whose version is not the customer's current one is "stale"
 * (the link was revoked); else "ok".
 */
export function guestLinkDecision(link: GuestLink | null, row: GuestCustomerRow | null): GuestLinkDecision {
  if (!link || !row || row.proSuspended || link.customerId !== row.customerId) return { kind: "not_found" };
  if (link.linkVersion !== row.linkVersion) return { kind: "stale", slug: row.slug };
  return { kind: "ok", slug: row.slug, customerId: row.customerId };
}
```

Replace the whole content of `src/lib/back-office/guest-access.ts` (Write) with:

```ts
/**
 * Personal link and client space access (spec § 12). The pure decision of
 * /api/c/<token> and the customer lookups the route and the espace page use.
 * No `server-only`, no env and no process db: the callers pass `db` and the
 * guest key.
 */
import { and, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { customer, professional, user } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { verifyGuestLink, type GuestLink } from "@/lib/guest-link";
import { userIsSuspended } from "@/lib/suspension";
import { normalizeEmail } from "@/lib/tickets";

export type GuestCustomerRow = { customerId: string; linkVersion: number; slug: string; proSuspended: boolean };

/** The customer, its pro's slug and whether that pro's user is suspended (a lapsed ban counts as lifted). */
export async function findGuestCustomer(db: Db, customerId: string): Promise<GuestCustomerRow | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      customerId: customer.id,
      linkVersion: customer.linkVersion,
      slug: professional.slug,
      proSuspended: sql<boolean>`${userIsSuspended()}`,
    })
    .from(customer)
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, customer.professionalId))
    .innerJoin(user, eq(user.id, professional.userId))
    .where(eq(customer.id, customerId));
  return row ?? null;
}

export type GuestLinkDecision =
  | { kind: "not_found" }
  | { kind: "stale"; slug: string }
  | { kind: "ok"; slug: string; customerId: string };

/**
 * Q21: no verified link, no customer row, a row of another customer or a
 * suspended pro are all "not found" (one answer for every unauthorised case);
 * a verified link whose version is not the customer's current one is "stale"
 * (the link was revoked); else "ok".
 */
export function guestLinkDecision(link: GuestLink | null, row: GuestCustomerRow | null): GuestLinkDecision {
  if (!link || !row || row.proSuspended || link.customerId !== row.customerId) return { kind: "not_found" };
  if (link.linkVersion !== row.linkVersion) return { kind: "stale", slug: row.slug };
  return { kind: "ok", slug: row.slug, customerId: row.customerId };
}

/**
 * Espace by cookie: the customer of the token when the MAC verifies, the
 * customer belongs to THIS pro and the token carries its current link_version
 * (a revoked link, or a token of another pro's customer, gives null).
 */
export async function customerFromGuestCookie(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  token: string | undefined,
  key: Buffer,
): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!token) return null;
  const link = verifyGuestLink(token, key);
  if (!link) return null;
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ id: customer.id, linkVersion: customer.linkVersion })
    .from(customer)
    .where(and(eq(customer.id, link.customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId)));
  return row && row.linkVersion === link.linkVersion ? row.id : null;
}

/** Espace by verified session: the customer of this pro whose e-mail is normalizeEmail(email) (customer_pro_email_uq), else null. */
export async function customerFromVerifiedEmail(db: Db, professionalId: string, email: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ id: customer.id })
    .from(customer)
    .where(and(eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId), eq(customer.email, normalizeEmail(email))));
  return row?.id ?? null;
}
```

```ts
});

dbTest("getCustomerSpace: another pro's customer, or an unknown id, gives null", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const mine = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const theirs = await makeCustomer(db, other);
    assert.ok(await getCustomerSpace(db, pro.proId, mine, now));
    assert.equal(await getCustomerSpace(db, other.proId, mine, now), null);
    assert.equal(await getCustomerSpace(db, pro.proId, theirs, now), null);
    assert.equal(await getCustomerSpace(db, pro.proId, "unknown-customer", now), null);

    // A customer with nothing yet: an empty space, not null.
    const empty = await getCustomerSpace(db, pro.proId, mine, now);
    assert.deepEqual(empty?.upcoming, []);
    assert.deepEqual(empty?.wallet, []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});
```

Create `src/lib/back-office/customer-space.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Read-only espace of one customer at one pro (spec § 12, Q22). P3 shows what
 * is booked and what is left in the wallet; P4 reuses this read and adds the
 * cancel and spend actions. No `server-only`, no env, no process db.
 */
import { and, asc, eq, gt, inArray, isNull, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { formatWhen, formatWhenShort } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { groupWallet, type WalletTicketRow, type WalletTypeRow } from "@/lib/back-office/wallet-view";
import { clientCanCancel, clientCancelDeadline } from "@/lib/cancellation";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, customer, event, occurrence, professional, ticket, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { COVERAGE_LABELS } from "@/lib/tickets";

export type CustomerSpace = {
  customer: { id: string; name: string; email: string };
  upcoming: {
    bookingId: string;
    title: string;
    whenLabel: string;
    location: string | null;
    coverageLabel: string;
    cancelText: string | null;
  }[];
  wallet: { ticketTypeId: string; name: string; color: string; archived: boolean; usable: number; expiries: string[] }[];
};

/** The online cancellation hint of one booking; null when the client can no longer cancel online (P4 turns it into a button). */
function cancelTextOf(
  b: { startsAt: Date; bookingCreatedAt: Date; changedAt: Date | null; movedAt: Date | null },
  deadlineHours: number,
  now: Date,
  tz: string,
): string | null {
  const check = clientCanCancel({
    startsAt: b.startsAt,
    now,
    deadlineHours,
    bookingCreatedAt: b.bookingCreatedAt,
    occurrenceChangedAt: b.changedAt,
    movedAt: b.movedAt,
  });
  if (!check.allowed) return null;
  if (check.reason === "before_deadline") {
    return `Annulation en ligne possible jusqu'au ${formatWhenShort(clientCancelDeadline(b.startsAt, deadlineHours), tz)}.`;
  }
  return "Annulation en ligne possible jusqu'au début de la séance.";
}

/**
 * Confirmed bookings on scheduled future occurrences (soonest first) and the
 * usable tickets by type with their expiries; null when the customer is not
 * this pro's. Dates are formatted in the PRO's time zone.
 */
export async function getCustomerSpace(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  customerId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<CustomerSpace | null> {
  const [owner] = await db
    .select({
      id: customer.id,
      name: customer.name,
      email: customer.email,
      tz: professional.timezone,
      cancelHours: professional.cancelDeadlineHours,
    })
    .from(customer)
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, customer.professionalId))
    .where(and(eq(customer.id, customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId)));
  if (!owner) return null;

  const [bookings, tickets] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        bookingId: booking.id,
        coverage: booking.coverage,
        bookingCreatedAt: booking.createdAt,
        movedAt: booking.movedAt,
        startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
        endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
        changedAt: occurrence.changedAt,
        title: sql<string>`coalesce(${event.title}, ${ticketType.name})`,
        location: sql<string | null>`coalesce(${occurrence.locationOverride}, ${event.location})`,
        cancelHours: sql<number | null>`coalesce(${event.cancelDeadlineHours}, ${ticketType.rdvCancelDeadlineHours})`,
      })
      .from(booking)
      .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
      .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
      .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
      .where(
        and(
          eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(booking.customerId, customerId),
          eq(booking.status, "confirmed"),
          eq(occurrence.status, "scheduled"),
          gt(occurrence.startsAt, now),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(asc(occurrence.startsAt), asc(booking.id)),
    db
      .select({
        id: ticket.id,
        ticketTypeId: ticket.ticketTypeId,
        status: ticket.status,
        expiresAt: ticket.expiresAt,
        purchaseId: ticket.purchaseId,
        closedReason: ticket.closedReason,
        closedNote: ticket.closedNote,
        statusChangedAt: ticket.statusChangedAt,
        createdAt: ticket.createdAt,
      })
      .from(ticket)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(ticket.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(ticket.customerId, customerId),
          eq(ticket.status, "available"),
          or(isNull(ticket.expiresAt), gt(ticket.expiresAt, now)),
        ),
      ),
  ]);

  const typeIds = [...new Set(tickets.map((t) => t.ticketTypeId))];
  const typeRows =
    typeIds.length === 0
      ? []
      : await db
          .select({ id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name, color: ticketType.color, archivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt })
          .from(ticketType)
          .where(and(eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId), inArray(ticketType.id, typeIds)))
          .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.createdAt), asc(ticketType.id));
  const types: WalletTypeRow[] = typeRows.map((t) => ({
    id: t.id,
    name: t.name,
    color: t.color,
    archived: t.archivedAt !== null,
  }));
  const walletRows: WalletTicketRow[] = tickets.map((t) => ({ ...t, bookingStartsAt: null }));

  return {
    customer: { id: owner.id, name: owner.name, email: owner.email },
    upcoming: bookings.map((b) => ({
      bookingId: b.bookingId,
      title: b.title,
      whenLabel: formatWhen(b.startsAt, b.endsAt, owner.tz),
      location: b.location && b.location.trim() !== "" ? b.location : null,
      coverageLabel: COVERAGE_LABELS[b.coverage],
      cancelText: cancelTextOf(b, b.cancelHours ?? owner.cancelHours, now, owner.tz),
    })),
    wallet: groupWallet(walletRows, types, new Map(), now, owner.tz).map((g) => ({
      ticketTypeId: g.ticketTypeId,
      name: g.name,
      color: g.color,
      archived: g.archived,
      usable: g.usableCount,
      expiries: g.expirySummary,
    })),
  };
}
```

```ts
/* ───────────────────────────── Client space (/[slug]/espace) ───────────────────────────── */

export type SpaceIdentity =
  | { kind: "customer"; customerId: string; via: "session" | "guest" }
  | { kind: "no_record"; email: string }
  | { kind: "anonymous" };

/**
 * Who is looking at this pro's espace (spec § 12, Decision 36). A verified,
 * non-impersonated FRESH session wins: its customer at this pro, or no_record.
 * Else the skedul_guest cookie, which is checked against this pro and the
 * customer's current link version on every request. Else anonymous. An admin
 * impersonating the pro never reads a client's data through the pro's session.
 */
export async function resolveSpaceCustomer(pro: { id: string }): Promise<SpaceIdentity> {
  const session = await getFreshSession();
  if (session && session.user.emailVerified && !session.session.impersonatedBy) {
    const customerId = await customerFromVerifiedEmail(db, pro.id, session.user.email);
    return customerId
      ? { kind: "customer", customerId, via: "session" }
      : { kind: "no_record", email: session.user.email };
  }
  const token = (await cookies()).get(GUEST_COOKIE)?.value;
  const customerId = await customerFromGuestCookie(db, pro.id, token, guestKey());
  return customerId ? { kind: "customer", customerId, via: "guest" } : { kind: "anonymous" };
}

/** The read-only espace of one customer of the pro (null when the customer is not this pro's). */
export function getCustomerSpacePage(professionalId: string, customerId: string): Promise<CustomerSpace | null> {
  return getCustomerSpace(db, professionalId, customerId, new Date());
}
```

Create `src/app/api/c/[token]/route.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { findGuestCustomer, guestLinkDecision } from "@/lib/back-office/guest-access";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { GUEST_COOKIE, GUEST_COOKIE_MAX_AGE, verifyGuestLink } from "@/lib/guest-link";
import { guestKey } from "@/server/guest-key";

const NO_STORE = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } as const;

/** The same answer for a bad MAC, an unknown customer and a suspended pro: nothing to learn from it. */
function notFound(): Response {
  return new Response("Not found", { status: 404, headers: NO_STORE });
}

/**
 * Personal link of a client e-mail (spec § 12): a valid link sets the
 * skedul_guest cookie for this pro's path and sends the client to the espace;
 * a revoked one clears the cookie and says so (Q21).
 */
export async function GET(request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ token: string }> }): Promise<Response> {
  const { token } = await params;
  if (token.length > 200) return notFound();

  const link = verifyGuestLink(token, guestKey());
  const row = link ? await findGuestCustomer(db, link.customerId) : null;
  const decision = guestLinkDecision(link, row);
  if (decision.kind === "not_found") return notFound();

  const secure = process.env.NODE_ENV === "production";
  if (decision.kind === "stale") {
    const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(`/${decision.slug}/espace?lien=invalide`, request.url), 303);
    res.cookies.set(GUEST_COOKIE, "", { path: `/${decision.slug}`, maxAge: 0, httpOnly: true, sameSite: "lax", secure });
    res.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
    return res;
  }

  const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(`/${decision.slug}/espace`, request.url), 303);
  res.cookies.set(GUEST_COOKIE, token, {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure,
    sameSite: "lax",
    path: `/${decision.slug}`,
    maxAge: GUEST_COOKIE_MAX_AGE,
  });
  res.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
  return res;
}
```

Create `src/app/[slug]/espace/page.tsx` with exactly this content:

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { CustomerSpaceView } from "@/components/public/customer-space";
import { PublicShell } from "@/components/public/public-shell";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { getCustomerSpacePage, resolveSpaceCustomer } from "@/server/client-queries";
import { getPublicProfile } from "@/server/queries";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Mon espace", robots: { index: false } };

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ lien?: string }>;
};

const ANONYMOUS_HINT = "Ouvrez le lien personnel reçu par email pour voir vos réservations.";

/**
 * Read-only client space (spec § 12, Q22). Identity: a verified fresh session
 * first, else the personal-link cookie, else a hint. Never indexed, never
 * counted in the page-view stats.
 */
export default async function EspacePage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const { lien } = await searchParams;

  // An unknown or suspended pro is offline.
  const profile = await getPublicProfile(slug);
  if (!profile) notFound();
  const { pro } = profile;

  const identity = await resolveSpaceCustomer(pro);
  const space =
    identity.kind === "customer" ? await getCustomerSpacePage(pro.id, identity.customerId) : null;

  return (
    <PublicShell branding={pro} backHref={`/${slug}`}>
      {space ? (
        <CustomerSpaceView businessName={pro.businessName} slug={slug} space={space} />
      ) : identity.kind === "no_record" ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4 py-8">
            <p className="text-sm">{`Aucun ticket chez ${pro.businessName} pour ${identity.email}.`}</p>
            <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
              <Link href={`/${slug}`}>{`Voir la page de ${pro.businessName}`}</Link>
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {lien === "invalide" && <FormError message="Ce lien n'est plus valide." />}
          <Card>
            <CardContent className="py-8">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{ANONYMOUS_HINT}</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}
    </PublicShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";

const TEXT = "Cette page n'a pas pu se charger. Réessayez dans un instant.";

export default function EspaceError({
  error,
  unstable_retry,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  unstable_retry: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error(error);
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl px-5 py-8">
      <Card role="alert" className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col items-center gap-3 px-6 py-12 text-center">
        <TriangleAlert className="size-8 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
        <h2 className="text-base font-semibold">Une erreur est survenue</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{TEXT}</p>
        <Button onClick={() => unstable_retry()}>Réessayer</Button>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/back-office/ics.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/back-office/ics.db.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/app/api/bookings/[id]/calendar.ics/route.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `buildIcs(input: CalendarLinkInput & { uid: string }): string` from `@/lib/calendar-links` (Task 4: `CalendarLinkInput` gains `location?: string | null`, and `buildIcs` writes `LOCATION:` after `DESCRIPTION:` when it is set); `Db` (`@/lib/db/atomic`); `db` (`@/lib/db`) in the route; test harness and row helpers.
- Produces (contract § 4.23):

```ts
// src/lib/back-office/ics.ts
export type IcsFacts = { bookingId: string; title: string; location: string | null; startAt: Date; endAt: Date; businessName: string };
export async function loadIcsFacts(db: Db, bookingId: string): Promise<IcsFacts | null>;
// src/app/api/bookings/[id]/calendar.ics/route.ts
export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }): Promise<Response>;
```

Design notes:
- The unguessable booking id is the capability (as before P2, Decision 37): the mail's « Télécharger pour mon agenda (.ics) » button carries it, so the read has no pro filter. Its tenancy proof is that an id only ever resolves to its own booking's facts.
- Only a `confirmed` booking on a `scheduled` occurrence has a file (Q34): a pending, cancelled or expired booking, or a cancelled occurrence, answers 404, exactly like an unknown id.
- Title = the event title, or the type name for an RDV (`coalesce(event.title, ticket_type.name)`); location = `coalesce(occurrence.location_override, event.location)` (an RDV has neither: null); an empty string counts as no location.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `loadIcsFacts`**

Create `src/lib/back-office/ics.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Facts of the calendar file (ICS) of one booking (spec Q34). The unguessable
 * booking id is the capability, as before the tickets redesign: the mail's
 * download button carries it. No `server-only`, no env, no process db.
 */
import { and, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, event, occurrence, professional, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export type IcsFacts = {
  bookingId: string;
  title: string;
  location: string | null;
  startAt: Date;
  endAt: Date;
  businessName: string;
};

/**
 * A confirmed booking on a scheduled occurrence: title = event title or RDV
 * type name, location = coalesce(location_override, event.location) (an empty
 * string counts as none). Null for an unknown id, a pending, cancelled or
 * expired booking and a cancelled occurrence.
 */
export async function loadIcsFacts(db: Db, bookingId: string): Promise<IcsFacts | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      bookingId: booking.id,
      title: sql<string>`coalesce(${event.title}, ${ticketType.name})`,
      location: sql<string | null>`coalesce(${occurrence.locationOverride}, ${event.location})`,
      startAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endAt: occurrence.endsAt,
      businessName: professional.businessName,
    })
    .from(booking)
    .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
    .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, booking.professionalId))
    .where(and(eq(booking.id, bookingId), eq(booking.status, "confirmed"), eq(occurrence.status, "scheduled")));
  if (!row) return null;
  return { ...row, location: row.location && row.location.trim() !== "" ? row.location : null };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Rebuild the route**

Replace the whole content of `src/app/api/bookings/[id]/calendar.ics/route.ts` (Write) with:

```ts
import { loadIcsFacts } from "@/lib/back-office/ics";
import { buildIcs } from "@/lib/calendar-links";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

function notFound(): Response {
  return new Response("Not found", { status: 404, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
}

/**
 * ICS download of a confirmed booking, rebuilt on the occurrence (event title
 * or RDV type, effective location). The booking id is the capability; a
 * pending, cancelled or unknown booking, or a cancelled séance, is a 404.
 */
export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }): Promise<Response> {
  const { id } = await params;
  if (id.length > 64) return notFound();
  const facts = await loadIcsFacts(db, id);
  if (!facts) return notFound();

  const body = buildIcs({
    uid: `${facts.bookingId}@skedul.app`,
    title: facts.title,
    description: `Avec ${facts.businessName}`,
    location: facts.location,
    startAt: facts.startAt,
    endAt: facts.endAt,
  });
  return new Response(body, {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/calendar; charset=utf-8",
      "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="seance.ics"',
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
    },
  });
}
```

## Contract deviations and writer notes

Each section writer listed where the plan departs from the contract and why; the review and fix passes kept these lists current.

### Contract deviations (W1)

- Global Constraints below are the contract text verbatim except two en dashes in ranges ("13.4-13.9" and "I1-I6"), written with an ASCII hyphen to honour the zero em/en dash rule, and the Validation bullet, which names `src/lib/back-office/result.ts` (Task 6, W2) as the home of `fromEngine` (the contract file map puts it there; `src/lib/pro-messages.ts` only holds the messages).
- Task 4 adds `clearGoogleLink(db: Db, professionalId: string): Promise<void>` to `src/lib/calendar-sync-load.ts` (not in the contract): the Q33 `db.batch` (clear `professional.google_calendar_id` + every `occurrence.google_event_id` of the pro) lives there so it is DB-tested with a cross-tenant case; `disconnectGoogleCalendar` in `src/server/pro.ts` calls it. Behaviour is the contract's: one batch, after the unlink, no backfill on reconnect.

Clarifications where the contract is silent (no signature change): `bookingConfirmedEmail` omits the `cancelText` paragraph when it is blank; `mailButton` returns the bare `<a>` (templates wrap buttons in a `<p>`); `parseMoneyInput` accepts at most 7 integer digits (the schema bound of 10 000 euros is enforced by `offerInputSchema`); `plural` uses `Math.abs(n) < 2` for the singular.

Validation status: the code of Tasks 2 to 4 (tests included) was typechecked, linted with the repo ESLint config and run (pure tests, also under several host time zones) on a scratchpad overlay of the worktree. The Task 4 loader query was run read-only (SELECT) on tickets-dev against the seeded occurrences (séance with location, RDV, cancelled). `calendar-sync-load.db.test.ts` itself could not be run by the writer (writes to tickets-test); its tests were typechecked and linted only, so the implementer's first run of it is the real check.

### Contract deviations (W2)

- Task 5: `src/lib/notify-core.ts` also exports `logSafeMessage(err)` (an addition): one log line with no e-mail address, no `/api/c/` token and no Checkout session id, 200 characters at most. `runEffects`, `expireCheckoutSession` (Task 5) and `runProAction` / `runProQuery` (Task 6) log through it, which is how « logged without addresses, codes or tokens » is made true and unit-tested; a raw Drizzle or Stripe error can carry query parameters or a Checkout session id.
- Task 5 (addition): `runEffects` sends e-mails one by one, paced at least 550 ms apart across every run of the server instance when Resend is on (Resend answers 429 above 2 requests per second by default, and `sendEmail` would swallow the rejection, so the clients of a cancelled séance would silently get no e-mail). The next send slot is reserved before the first `await`, so two runs in flight queue behind each other. In mock mode there is no pause. Otherwise behaviour and logs are as in the brief.
- Task 5: the DB test has ten tests (the nine of the brief plus one for the effective location of the séance in the confirmation e-mail).
- Task 5 (moved here from Task 41 of part W10, controller ruling): `src/lib/emails/mock-links.ts` and its test are created here, and `src/lib/email.ts` makes the mock e-mail log (outside production) also print the absolute links of the mail (`   link: <url>`). Task 5 is the first task that sends client e-mails with a personal link, and the browser checks of Tasks 24, 27, 41 and 42 read the `/api/c/` and `calendar.ics` links from the dev log. Part W10 drops its own copy of these files and of the `email.ts` edit.
- Task 6: `src/lib/back-office/result.ts` also exports `revalidationTargets(publicPage)` (an addition), so the revalidation policy of `runProAction` is covered by a pure test; `runProAction` loops over it. It deviates from the contract (``revalidatePath(`/${ctx.slug}`, "layout")``): the installed Next 16.2.9 docs (`03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidatePath.md`) say the path is the route file structure (a literal path such as `/product/1` takes no `type`; a dynamic segment takes its route pattern plus a `type`), and the implementation turns `("/altinha-paris", "layout")` into the tag `_N_T_/altinha-paris/layout`, which no page carries (a page of that route carries `_N_T_/[slug]/layout`, `_N_T_/[slug]/page` and the tag of its literal pathname). So the dashboard layout is revalidated by its route path (`/dashboard`, `"layout"`, no dynamic segment) and, when `publicPage`, every public page and nested page under `/[slug]` by the route pattern (`/[slug]`, `"layout"`). The effects run only on `ok` structurally (an early return on failure) and `withoutEffects` is tested.
- Task 6: the dashes the scan reports are removed with `sed` on byte sequences (`\xe2\x80\x94`, `\xe2\x80\x93`) because this plan file must itself contain no dash; the result is verified by `grep -c` and by `ui-copy.test.ts`.
- Task 7: `updateProfileCore` adds `G(the professional row exists, 'not_found')` between the lock and the time-zone guard (the contract lists lock, tz guard, UPDATE). It makes a vanished profile answer « Profil introuvable. » instead of a silent zero-row update.
- Task 7: `ProfileForm` shows the action error in an inline `role="alert"` box with the exact markup of `FormError`, because `FormError` is created by Task 8 (which depends on 7). Task 8 Step 9 swaps the box for `<FormError message={error} />`; the final state is the contract's.
- Task 7: `ProfileForm` no longer calls `router.refresh()` (decision 9) and sends the current zone when the select is disabled (a disabled control is absent from `FormData`).
- Task 8: `src/app/dashboard/error.tsx` receives `{ error, unstable_retry }` and the button calls `unstable_retry()`, not `reset()`: the installed Next 16.2.9 docs (`node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md`, v16.2.0 note) say `unstable_retry` re-fetches and re-renders the segment and `reset` should only be used to clear the error state without re-fetching. Title, text and button label are the brief's.
- Task 8: `timeOffConflictCopy({ count: 1 })` uses singular wording for `cancelLabel` (« Annuler cette séance (tickets rendus, clients prévenus) »), `keepLabel` (« La garder ») and `keepNote`; for two or more the texts are the brief's. The literal « Annuler ces 1 séance » is ungrammatical.
- Task 8: `cancelOccurrenceCopy` for `kind: "rdv"` ignores `past` (the brief gives the past sentence for a séance only).
- Task 8: an extra `src/lib/back-office/labels.test.ts` locks the exact label strings and the exhaustiveness against the vocabulary arrays (the brief lists no test for `labels.ts`).
- Task 8: `Switch` draws its off state with `bg-muted-foreground/50` (the existing hand-rolled toggles use `bg-muted`, nearly invisible on a white card); the knob and `aria-checked` carry the state as well. The day toggle of `weekly-hours-editor.tsx` (used by the availability page and, unchanged, by the type hours of Task 13) gets the same off colour here (one exact edit in Step 9); Task 28 replaces the « Toute la journée » toggle of the time-off manager by the `Switch`. No task is left with a nearly invisible off state.
- Task 8: `TableSkeleton` draws the rows only (no title block of its own): every `loading.tsx` that uses it (Tasks 17, 33, 36 and 40) draws its own header first, so the title block would have appeared twice. `PageSkeleton` keeps its title block.

### Contract deviations (W3)

- **Task 11, `TicketTypeCard`**: the orange `StatusMark` + « Lié à aucun événement à venir » is rendered when `orphan && !archived && !rdvFree` (contract: `orphan && !archived`). Reason: after Task 9 an unlinked `rdv_free` type is `orphan` (Q16, needed for the orange client alert), but a free call type needs no event, and the Task 11 browser check expects the mark on « Cours en plein air » only (« Appel découverte » shows « Gratuit, sans ticket »).
- **Task 9, `catalog-reads.ts`** exports one helper beyond § 4.8, `readProWindow(db, professionalId): Promise<BookingWindow | null>`, reused by `catalog-actions.ts` (effective-window check, `NOTICE_TOO_LONG`) and by `getTicketTypeDetail` (`proWindow`).
- **Task 9, `usage.tickets`** counts the tickets of the type plus the tickets that have a movement naming the type (`ticket_type_id` or `from_ticket_type_id`): a ticket converted away from the type keeps a `ticket_movement` row referencing it, which blocks `DELETE` (23503) exactly like a held ticket, so « Supprimer » must announce « archivé ».
- **Task 10, `NOTICE_TOO_LONG` check** runs only when the merged type has `rdvEnabled: true` (the overrides are inert, and not editable, otherwise); it uses `effectiveWindow(proWindow, rdvOverrides)` and `noticeExceedsHorizon`. `updateTicketTypeCore` runs it only when the patch carries `rdvEnabled` or `rdvOverrides` (a rename from the « Informations » card is never refused for booking rules that card does not show); `createTicketTypeCore` always runs it.
- **Task 10, `RDV_FREE_NO_OFFER` also guards the « En vente » state**: contract § 4.8 only lists it for `createOfferCore`. `updateOfferCore` and `setOfferActiveCore` also return it when the offer would be en vente (`isActive` true) on an `rdv_free` type (an inactive offer left over by the switch to « Gratuit » must not go back on sale: its tickets would be usable nowhere, decision 16). Editing such an offer while it stays « Pas en vente » is allowed.
- **Extra pure modules (Tasks 11, 12, 13)**: `src/lib/back-office/type-view.ts`, `offer-form.ts`, `question-drafts.ts`, `rdv-form.ts` (each with a pure `*.test.ts`) are not in § 3.2. They hold the exact French copy and the form-to-input conversions of the components so they are unit-tested (there is no component test framework). `questions-editor.tsx` re-exports `QuestionDraft`, `draftsFromRows`, `inputsFromDrafts` from `question-drafts.ts`, so § 4.9 consumers (Tasks 19, 20) import them from the component file as the contract says. `canBecomeFree` lives in `rdv-form.ts`.
- **Task 11, `/dashboard/tickets` empty state**: the header button `NewTicketTypeButton` is rendered only when there is at least one type; the empty state carries the same button (one call to action per intent, design rule), as § 6 gives it.
- **Task 12, back link**: « Tous les tickets » is a `<Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">` + `<Link>` + `<ArrowLeft />` in the `action` slot of `PageHeader`, the same pattern as the event pages (Tasks 19, 20) and the client record (Task 34). `TypeDangerZone` uses the `primary` tone for the delete confirmation when the type is used (the button reads « Archiver »); `OfferList` rows show « Validité : 3 mois » (contract: the validity text) so a bare « 3 mois » is not misread next to the ticket count.
- **Task 12, delete of a type**: `deleteTicketTypeAction` revalidates the dashboard layout before the client calls `router.push("/dashboard/tickets")` (the contract forbids `redirect()` in wrappers and `router.refresh()`), so the deleted type's page may flash the 404 for a frame. Cosmetic; the browser check asks the implementer to report it.
- **Task 13, `WindowOverrideFields`**: the pro label of the horizon row uses `plural` (« 1 jour », « 60 jours ») instead of « {n} jours »; `TypeHoursEditor` wraps `WeeklyHoursEditor` in an `overflow-x-auto` container (the shared editor's range rows are wider than a 375 px card).
- **En dash / em dash**: the two en dashes of the verbatim Global Constraints block below (« 13.4-13.9 », « I1-I6 ») are written with an ASCII hyphen, because this plan must contain none.

### Contract deviations (W4)

Task 14 (recurrence form, event defaults)
- Addition: `recurrence-form.ts` also exports `normalizeMonthlyChoice(startDate, choice)` (the choice when the start date still offers it, else `"day_of_month"`). `ruleFromForm` and `recurrenceSummary` use it, so a stale radio never yields an invalid rule; `RecurrenceEditor` (Task 18) may call it when the start date changes so the checked radio matches the rule.
- `ruleFromForm` returns `null` when `startTime` is not `"HH:MM"` OR `startDate` is not a real date (the contract says time only; an empty date would make `parseKey` throw). Any other mistake (no weekday, `until` before the start...) still yields a rule that `recurrenceRuleSchema` refuses, so callers get the French message from `parseFr(recurrenceRuleSchema, rule)`; `recurrenceSummary` returns `null` and `previewDates` returns `[]` for such a rule.
- `monthlyChoices` returns `[]` for an invalid `startDate` (the editor renders while the date input is retyped); `formFromRule` of a `once` rule returns the defaults of the end fields (`endMode: "never"`, count 10) because the saved once rule stores `endMode: "count"`, which the form hides.

Task 15 (event reads)
- `EventEditorData.fromDate` = `series_date` of the first SCHEDULED séance after `now` (a cancelled séance is not a séance to come); `futureRegistrants` counts confirmed bookings and pending holds not lapsed at `now`, on future scheduled séances WITHOUT their own `location_override` (the brief says "active bookings on future séances"; `editEventInPlace` does not mail séances that have their own place, so the Task 20 notice would otherwise overcount).
- `DeletePreview.registrants` also leaves out pending holds already lapsed at `now` (Decision 11: nobody is warned about them); this is also what gives `deleteFromPreview` its `now` argument a use (an unused argument is an eslint warning here).
- `deleteFromPreview` returns `null` for an archived segment (the engine's `loadSeriesContext` refuses it with `not_found`) as well as for an unknown or other pro's one.
- `src/server/catalog-queries.ts` and `src/server/pro-catalog.ts` are created by Tasks 9 and 10, and the Task 15 and 16 Edits quote the text those tasks give: the end of the `catalog-reads` import and the last wrapper `getActiveTypeOptions` in the first file; the four contiguous import lines (`ActionResult`, `db`, `@/lib/tickets` types, `runProAction`) and the last wrapper `setTypeQuestionsAction` in the second. Those lines must stay as Tasks 9 and 10 write them.
- `getEventEditor` (Task 15) and the cores (Task 16) read the pro's three `booking_*` columns through Task 9's `readProWindow` (`catalog-reads.ts`), not through a copy of the query.

Task 16 (event cores)
- `ProCtx` carries no booking settings, so the cores read the three `professional.booking_*` columns themselves, through Task 9's `readProWindow`, for the NOTICE_TOO_LONG check.
- `deleteEventPreviewCore` refuses a `fromDate` before local today with the engine's own text (« La modification doit partir d'aujourd'hui ou d'une date future. »), so preview and deletion say the same thing.
- Adds a pure test file `src/lib/event-info.test.ts` for `eventInfoSchema` (not in the file map).

Task 17 (events list)
- Adds one string the contract lacks: « Aucun événement en cours. » when every series is finished (state "no live event, some ended").
- The header button « Nouvel événement » is rendered only when the pro has at least one event; with none, the empty state carries it (one call to action per intent, the same rule as Task 11 and Task 33).

Engine facts the brief did not state (no deviation, for the reviewer): `describeRecurrence`, `dstNotes`, `expand`, `monthlyDayWarning` take a `RecurrenceRule` (rule + `durationMin`), so Task 14 builds `{ ...rule, durationMin }`; `deleteSeriesFrom` refuses an archived segment, a `fromDate` before local today and a séance at or after `fromDate` that already started.

### Contract deviations (W6)

- `registerOptions(db, professionalId, occurrenceId, customerId, now?)` (Task 21): optional fifth parameter `now` (default `new Date()`), because `activeBookingOf` needs a clock; `registerOptionsCore` passes its own `now` so the core and its tests are deterministic.

The first two refuse the two cases where the contract rule (`startDate` = this séance's `series_date`) is wrong: a séance past the last counted date (`occurrenceCount` would be 0) and, as a defensive guard only, a monthly « jour du mois » series whose `series_date` has a day different from the rule's (not produced by the engine: `walk()` in `src/lib/recurrence.ts` skips a month without that day, RFC 5545; the guard keeps a corrupted row from silently changing the day of every later month).
- `registerAttendeeCore` (Task 23): the typed e-mail is trimmed before `customerInputSchema` (a pasted address with spaces would otherwise be refused); `expiringBeforeCore` (Task 22) checks that the occurrence is the pro's first (a foreign id says « Séance introuvable. » instead of returning an empty list).
- Seats copy (Task 24): `plural` is used, « 1 inscrit sur 12 », « 0 inscrit sur 12 », « 1 place en ligne » (the contract's fixed « inscrits » / « places » is wrong for 0 and 1); same in the block `aria-label`.
- Event blocks (Task 24): light tint of the event colour, solid left bar in the colour, foreground text (the contract says only « colour »): white text on a colour picked by the pro cannot meet WCAG AA.
- Success lines the contract does not give (Task 25): RDV cancel « Rendez-vous annulé. Le client est prévenu par email. », séance cancelled with nobody registered « Séance annulée. », restore « Séance rétablie. », unenroll « Inscription de {name} annulée. … » (`unenrolledMessage`, now a pure tested function of `planning-view.ts`); `SessionCapacityControl` shows « Places enregistrées. » itself (its props are unchanged). An RDV that an action ends (its cancellation, or the removal of its only attendee) leaves the page data, so the dialog would unmount before its line could be read: for an RDV the line is handed to the page through `onClose(notice)` and shown above the calendar (and above the dashboard week preview), cleared when a block is opened or the week changes.

- `OccurrenceDialog` (Task 24) takes `nowIso` as the contract says but does not use it until the edit form of Task 26; `WeekPreview` keeps the existing default « Semaine » (the Jour mode on mobile is the dashboard wiring of Task 37).
- `OccurrenceDialog.onClose` (Tasks 24, 25) is typed `(notice?: string) => void`, a superset of the contract's `() => void` (every caller of the contract still compiles). A separate `onNotice` prop was not used because Task 26 (plan part W7) rewrites the destructure `item, tz, onClose` with an exact edit that must keep matching. `Dialog` calls its `onClose` with the click event, so the dialog never passes `onClose` to it directly (`onClose={() => onClose()}`) and the calendar and the week preview only accept a string as a notice.

- Mobile day view (Task 24): the empty-day button « Nouvel événement ce jour » is shown only from today on and links to `/dashboard/events/new?date={day}&minute=600` (today: `/dashboard/events/new`, next full hour), because the creation form of Task 14 reads a clicked cell only as a `date` + `minute` pair and ignores a past day.

### Contract deviations (W10)

- **Task 39 / Task 40 split of `admin-queries.ts`.** `getAppHealth`, `getUserDetail`, `getProStats` and `getDeletionImpact` are rewired in Task 40, in the same commit as `app-health-card.tsx`, `users/[id]/page.tsx` and `delete-user-card.tsx`; Task 39 only wraps overview, revenue, activity feed and the two activity lists. Reason: those exported shapes change (`pendingBookings` disappears, `stats` and `deletion` get new fields), so rewiring them in Task 39 would break `tsc` until Task 40 ("every task ends green").
- **`proStats.events`** counts distinct live series (distinct `series_root_id` among non-archived segments), not literally "non-archived series roots". Reason: after a split the root segment is archived while a later segment is live (P2 outcome, Task 30 carry: never address a series by its root), which would count the series as 0.
- **`platformRevenue`** returns `[]` for `professionalId: ""` instead of passing it on. Reason: the contract warns that `paidPurchaseOf` widens to the whole platform on a falsy id; the guard makes the misuse harmless and is tested.
- **`healthCounts.horizonLag`** is computed in two stages (SQL candidates behind the pro's own local today + `HORIZON_REFRESH_DAYS`, then the rule check with `lastSeriesDate`, the same predicate as `minGeneratedUntil`). Reason: "still producing dates" for a count-mode series needs the recurrence walk, not expressible in SQL.
- **Task 40 adds `src/lib/admin-health.ts` + `admin-health.test.ts`** (pure copy of the health alerts and the « Contrôle nocturne » row) and **`src/app/admin/activity/loading.tsx`**. Reason: exact French strings get a unit test (TDD order for testable code) and the UI rule "every page has a loading state". `src/app/admin/page.tsx` is listed in the file map but needs no edit.
- **Task 40 `/admin/activity` « Inscriptions »** has one extra first column « Créée le » and the « Achats » label cell shows `plural(quantity, "ticket", "tickets")` under the label. Reason: rows are ordered by `created_at` and the contract's column list leaves that date invisible.
- The mock e-mail log prints the mail's links from Task 5 on (controller ruling); Tasks 27, 41 and 42 read them. The browser checks of Tasks 41 and 42 read a `/api/c/` link and a `calendar.ics` link from the `   link: <url>` lines of the dev log. This fragment creates and edits nothing for that log.
- **Tasks 40 and 41 add an error state** (`src/app/admin/activity/error.tsx`, `src/app/[slug]/espace/error.tsx`, same card and `unstable_retry` button as `src/app/dashboard/error.tsx` of Task 8). Reason: the ruling "every page has a loading, an empty and an error state"; neither route has an error boundary, so a failing read (a Neon timeout) would show Next's bare default screen.
- **Task 41 `getCustomerSpace`** takes the wallet wording from `groupWallet` (Task 30, empty `classes` map: a type absent from it falls back to `archived` / `ok`) instead of recomputing `expirySummary`, so the espace and the client record never drift.
- **`guestLinkDecision`** also answers `not_found` when the link's customer id differs from the row's (defence in depth, tested); the route always reads the row by the link's id, so this never changes normal behaviour.
- **Task 43** touches `src/lib/booking/series.ts` with a comment only: the engine file never imported the planner's input type, so the rename affects `series-plan.ts` and its test.
- **Global Constraints** above: the two numeric ranges that were written with an en dash in the brief (the spec section range and the invariant range) are written with the word "to" (zero-dash rule).
